// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/CopyrightBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;

/**
 * Bloco de Rodapé / Direitos Autorais e Links Institucionais.
 */
class CopyrightBlock implements BlockInterface, StylableElementInterface
{
    use StylableElementTrait;

    private PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver ?? new BaseUrlResolver();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'copyright';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Direitos Autorais (Copyright)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '©';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'footer';
    }

    public function getAllowedPartTypes(): array
    {
        return [ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER];
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;
        $defaultSiteName = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_SITE_NAME') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_SITE_NAME : 'Domain System';
        $siteName = !empty($data['site_name']) ? trim((string)$data['site_name']) : $defaultSiteName;
        $year = date('Y');
        $rawText = (string)($data['text'] ?? '© {year} {site_name}. Todos os direitos reservados.');

        $text = str_replace(['{year}', '{site_name}'], [$year, $siteName], $rawText);
        if (!empty($data['site_name']) && !str_contains($rawText, '{site_name}') && !str_contains($text, $siteName)) {
            $text .= ' — ' . $siteName;
        }
        $safeText = htmlspecialchars($text, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $showLgpd = (bool)($data['show_lgpd_links'] ?? true);
        $baseUrl = $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl();

        $textColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_color'] ?? $data['color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-text-color, var(--color-text-muted, #8b8c8d))'));
        $linkColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['link_color'] ?? $data['text_color'] ?? $data['color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-link-color, var(--color-text-muted, #8b8c8d))'));
        $fontSize = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_size'] ?? $data['size'] ?? '0.88rem'));
        $align = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['align'] ?? $data['text_align'] ?? 'center'));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_family'] ?? ''));

        $resolvedFont = match ($fontFamily) {
            'secondary' => 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)',
            'tertiary'  => 'var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)',
            'primary'   => 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)',
            default     => $fontFamily !== '' ? $fontFamily : 'var(--font-primary, inherit)',
        };

        $justifyLinks = match ($align) {
            'left'  => 'flex-start',
            'right' => 'flex-end',
            default => 'center',
        };

        $linksHtml = '';
        if ($showLgpd) {
            $linksHtml = <<<HTML
<div style="display: flex; gap: 16px; justify-content: {$justifyLinks}; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: {$fontSize};">
    <a href="{$baseUrl}/sobre" style="color: {$linkColor}; text-decoration: none;">Sobre Nós</a>
    <a href="{$baseUrl}/privacidade" style="color: {$linkColor}; text-decoration: none;">Privacidade</a>
    <a href="{$baseUrl}/termos" style="color: {$linkColor}; text-decoration: none;">Termos de Uso</a>
</div>
HTML;
        }

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-copyright" style="text-align: {$align}; color: {$textColor}; font-size: {$fontSize}; font-family: {$resolvedFont}; line-height: 1.6;">
    {$linksHtml}
    <div>{$safeText}</div>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'copyright',
            'fields' => [
                'text'            => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto (usa {year} e {site_name})', 'default' => '© {year} {site_name}. Todos os direitos reservados.'],
                'show_lgpd_links' => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Links (Sobre, Privacidade, Termos)', 'default' => true],
                'text_color'      => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor do Texto', 'default' => 'var(--color-text-muted)'],
                'link_color'      => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor dos Links', 'default' => 'var(--color-text-muted)'],
                'font_size'       => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho da Fonte', 'units' => ['rem', 'px'], 'default' => '0.88rem'],
                'align'           => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'center'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/CoreBlockProvider.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PostProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;

/**
 * Provedor dos 14 Blocos Semânticos Nativos do Kernel (SOLID - OCP / SRP).
 */
class CoreBlockProvider implements BlockProviderInterface
{
    private ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider;
    private ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager;
    private ?PostProviderInterface $postProvider;
    private ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;

    public function __construct(
        ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider = null,
        ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager = null,
        ?PostProviderInterface $postProvider = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null
    ) {
        $this->menuProvider = $menuProvider;
        $this->shortcodeManager = $shortcodeManager;
        $this->postProvider = $postProvider;
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer;
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver;
    }

    public function registerBlocks(BlockRegistryInterface $registry): void
    {
        $registry->register(new HeadingBlock());
        $registry->register(new ParagraphBlock($this->htmlSanitizer));
        $registry->register(new ImageBlock());
        $registry->register(new VideoBlock());
        $registry->register(new LogoBlock($this->htmlSanitizer, $this->urlResolver));
        $registry->register(new ButtonBlock());
        $registry->register(new CtaButtonBlock());
        $registry->register(new DividerBlock());
        $registry->register(new ShortcodeBlock($this->shortcodeManager));
        $registry->register(new CustomCodeBlock());
        $registry->register(new SocialIconsBlock());
        $registry->register(new CopyrightBlock($this->urlResolver));
        $registry->register(new NavMenuBlock($this->menuProvider));
        $registry->register(new PostCardsGridBlock($this->postProvider));
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/CtaButtonBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\ColorValue;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Botão de Ação / CTA (Call to Action).
 */
class CtaButtonBlock extends AbstractBlock
{
    public function __construct(
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        parent::__construct($htmlSanitizer, null, $styleRenderer);
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'cta_button';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Botão de Ação (CTA)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🚀';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'action';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $label = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['label'] ?? 'Clique Aqui'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)($data['url'] ?? '#'), '#');
        $url = htmlspecialchars($safeUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $variant = (string)($data['variant'] ?? $data['style'] ?? 'primary');
        $size = (string)($data['size'] ?? 'medium');
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'left');
        $rawTarget = (string)($data['target'] ?? '_self');
        $target = in_array($rawTarget, ['_self', '_blank'], true) ? $rawTarget : '_self';
        $hoverAnim = (string)($data['hover_animation'] ?? '');
        $borderRadius = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['border_radius'] ?? '8px'));
        $customPadding = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['padding'] ?? ''));
        $customBg = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['bg_color'] ?? $data['background'] ?? ''));
        $customText = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_color'] ?? $data['color'] ?? ''));
        $hoverBgColor = !empty($data['hover_bg_color'])
            ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(ColorValue::fromString((string)$data['hover_bg_color'])->getCssValue())
            : '';
        $hoverTextColor = !empty($data['hover_text_color'])
            ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(ColorValue::fromString((string)$data['hover_text_color'])->getCssValue())
            : '';

        $hoverCssVars = '';
        if ($hoverBgColor !== '') {
            $hoverCssVars .= " --btn-hover-bg: {$hoverBgColor};";
        }
        if ($hoverTextColor !== '') {
            $hoverCssVars .= " --btn-hover-color: {$hoverTextColor};";
        }
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_family'] ?? ''));
        $fontSize = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_size'] ?? ''));
        $fontWeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_weight'] ?? '700'));
        $textTransform = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_transform'] ?? ''));

        $sizeCss = match ($size) {
            'small'  => 'padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.85rem;',
            'large'  => 'padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 1.15rem;',
            default  => 'padding: 10px 22px; font-size: 0.95rem;',
        };
        if ($customPadding !== '') {
            $sizeCss .= " padding: {$customPadding};";
        }
        if ($fontSize !== '') {
            $sizeCss .= " font-size: {$fontSize};";
        }
        if ($fontFamily !== '') {
            $sizeCss .= " font-family: {$fontFamily};";
        }
        if ($textTransform !== '') {
            $sizeCss .= " text-transform: {$textTransform};";
        }

        $baseStyles = "display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: {$fontWeight}; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.25s ease; cursor: pointer; {$sizeCss}";

        $variantStyles = match ($variant) {
            'secondary' => "background: var(--color-secondary, #1f2833); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);",
            'outline'   => "background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #45f3ff); border: 2px solid var(--primary, #45f3ff);",
            'ghost'     => "background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-main, #fff); border: 1px solid transparent;",
            'gradient'  => "background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8), var(--color-accent, #818cf8)); color: #0b0c10; border: none;",
            'glow'      => "background: var(--primary, #45f3ff); color: #0b0c10; border: none; box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--color-primary, rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.4));",
            default     => "background: var(--primary, #45f3ff); color: #0b0c10; border: 2px solid var(--primary, #45f3ff);",
        };

        if ($customBg !== '') {
            $variantStyles .= " background: {$customBg};";
        }
        if ($customText !== '') {
            $variantStyles .= " color: {$customText};";
        }

        $animClass = match ($hoverAnim) {
            'grow'    => ' ds-btn-grow',
            'lift'    => ' ds-btn-lift',
            'glow'    => ' ds-btn-glow',
            'shimmer' => ' ds-btn-shimmer',
            'bounce'  => ' ds-btn-bounce',
            default   => '',
        };

        $justifyBtn = match ($align) {
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-start',
        };
        $safeAlign = in_array($align, ['left', 'center', 'right'], true) ? $align : 'left';
        $safeVariant = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $variant) ?: 'primary';
        $wrapperStyle = "display: flex; justify-content: {$justifyBtn}; width: 100%; text-align: {$safeAlign};";
        $absorbAttr = (($data['absorb_in_mobile'] ?? true) !== false) ? ' data-mobile-absorb="true"' : ' data-mobile-absorb="false"';

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-cta-wrapper ds-block-button-wrapper"{$absorbAttr} style="{$wrapperStyle}">
    <a href="{$url}" target="{$target}" class="ds-block-cta ds-btn-{$safeVariant}{$animClass}" style="{$baseStyles} {$variantStyles}{$hoverCssVars}">
        <span>{$label}</span>
    </a>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'cta_button',
            'fields' => [
                'label'       => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto do Botão', 'default' => 'Começar Agora'],
                'url'         => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Link de Destino', 'default' => '#'],
                'variant'     => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Estilo Visual', 'options' => ['primary', 'secondary', 'outline', 'glow'], 'default' => 'primary'],
                'bg_color'         => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor de Fundo', 'default' => 'var(--color-primary)'],
                'text_color'       => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor do Texto', 'default' => '#0b0c10'],
                'hover_bg_color'   => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor de Fundo no Hover', 'default' => ''],
                'hover_text_color' => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor do Texto no Hover', 'default' => ''],
                'font_family' => ['type' => 'font', 'label' => 'Família da Fonte', 'default' => 'var(--font-primary)'],
                'font_size'   => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho da Fonte', 'default' => '0.95rem'],
                'font_weight' => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Peso da Fonte', 'options' => ['400', '500', '600', '700', '800'], 'default' => '700'],
                'size'        => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Tamanho', 'options' => ['small', 'medium', 'large'], 'default' => 'medium'],
                'align'       => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'left'],
                'target'      => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Abrir em', 'options' => ['_self', '_blank'], 'default' => '_self'],
                'absorb_in_mobile' => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Incluir no Menu Hambúrguer (Mobile)', 'default' => true],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;

/**
 * Bloco de Código Customizado (HTML, CSS e JS inline seguro).
 */
class CustomCodeBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;
    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'custom_code';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Código Customizado (HTML/CSS)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '💻';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'advanced';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $html = (string)($data['html'] ?? $data['code'] ?? '');
        $css = (string)($data['css'] ?? '');

        $output = '';
        if (trim($css) !== '') {
            $safeCss = str_ireplace('</style>', '', $css);
            $output .= "<style>{$safeCss}</style>\n";
        }
        if (trim($html) !== '') {
            $output .= $html;
        }

        return $output;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'custom_code',
            'fields' => [
                'html' => ['type' => 'code_html', 'label' => 'Código HTML', 'default' => '<div>Código customizado</div>'],
                'css'  => ['type' => 'code_css', 'label' => 'Estilos CSS Inline', 'default' => ''],
            ],
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/DefaultBlockRegistryFactory.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PostProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;

/**
 * Fábrica e Registrador dos Blocos Semânticos Nativos e Extensíveis do Motor Visual (SOLID - OCP).
 */
class DefaultBlockRegistryFactory
{
    /**
     * @param array<int, BlockProviderInterface> $extraProviders
     */
    public static function create(
        ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider = null,
        ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager = null,
        ?PostProviderInterface $postProvider = null,
        array $extraProviders = []
    ): BlockRegistryInterface {
        $registry = new BlockRegistry();

        $coreProvider = new CoreBlockProvider($menuProvider, $shortcodeManager, $postProvider);
        $coreProvider->registerBlocks($registry);

        foreach ($extraProviders as $provider) {
            if ($provider instanceof BlockProviderInterface) {
                $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
            }
        }

        return $registry;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/DividerBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;

/**
 * Bloco de Divisória ou Espaçador.
 */
class DividerBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null)
    {
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'divider';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Divisória / Espaçador';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '➖';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'layout';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $style = (string)($data['style'] ?? 'solid');
        $height = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['height'] ?? '20px'));
        $color = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['color'] ?? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'));
        $width = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['width'] ?? '100%'));
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'center');

        if ($style === 'spacer' || $style === 'transparent') {
            return "<div class=\"ds-block-spacer\" style=\"height: {$height}; width: 100%;\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>";
        }

        $marginAuto = match ($align) {
            'left'   => 'margin: 0 auto 0 0;',
            'right'  => 'margin: 0 0 0 auto;',
            default  => 'margin: 0 auto;',
        };

        if ($style === 'gradient') {
            return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-divider-wrap" style="padding: {$height} 0;">
    <div style="height: 1px; width: {$width}; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, {$color}, transparent); {$marginAuto}"></div>
</div>
HTML;
        }

        $borderStyle = ($style === 'dashed') ? 'dashed' : 'solid';
        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-divider-wrap" style="padding: {$height} 0;">
    <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px {$borderStyle} {$color}; width: {$width}; {$marginAuto}">
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'divider',
            'fields' => [
                'style'  => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Tipo de Divisória', 'options' => ['solid', 'dashed', 'gradient', 'spacer'], 'default' => 'solid'],
                'height' => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Altura / Espaçamento', 'units' => ['px', 'rem', 'vh'], 'default' => '20px'],
                'color'  => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor da Linha', 'default' => 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'],
                'width'  => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Largura da Linha', 'units' => ['%', 'px', 'vw'], 'default' => '100%'],
                'align'  => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['center', 'left', 'right'], 'default' => 'center'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/HeadingBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;

/**
 * Bloco de Título / Cabeçalho (H1 - H6).
 */
class HeadingBlock extends AbstractBlock
{
    public function __construct(?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null)
    {
        parent::__construct(null, null, $styleRenderer);
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'heading';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Título (Heading)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🔤';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'typography';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;
        $rawLevel = $data['level'] ?? 2;
        if (is_string($rawLevel) && preg_match('/^h?([1-6])$/i', trim($rawLevel), $m)) {
            $parsedLevel = (int)$m[1];
        } else {
            $parsedLevel = (int)$rawLevel;
        }
        $level = in_array($parsedLevel, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], true) ? $parsedLevel : 2;
        $tag = 'h' . $level;

        $text = (string)($data['text'] ?? 'Título');
        $size = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['size'] ?? $data['font_size'] ?? ''));
        $color = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['color'] ?? $data['text_color'] ?? $data['heading_color'] ?? ''));
        $align = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['align'] ?? $data['text_align'] ?? 'left'));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_family'] ?? 'primary'));
        $fontWeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_weight'] ?? ''));
        $lineHeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['line_height'] ?? ''));
        $letterSpacing = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['letter_spacing'] ?? ''));
        $textTransform = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_transform'] ?? ''));

        $styles = [
            "text-align: {$align}",
            "margin: 0",
        ];

        if ($fontFamily === 'secondary') {
            $styles[] = "font-family: var(--font-secondary, monospace)";
        } elseif ($fontFamily === 'tertiary') {
            $styles[] = "font-family: var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)";
        } elseif ($fontFamily === 'primary' || $fontFamily === '') {
            $styles[] = "font-family: var(--font-primary, sans-serif)";
        } else {
            $styles[] = "font-family: {$fontFamily}";
        }

        if ($size !== '') {
            $styles[] = "font-size: {$size}";
        }
        if ($fontWeight !== '') {
            $styles[] = "font-weight: {$fontWeight}";
        }
        if ($lineHeight !== '') {
            $styles[] = "line-height: {$lineHeight}";
        }
        if ($letterSpacing !== '') {
            $styles[] = "letter-spacing: {$letterSpacing}";
        }
        if ($textTransform !== '') {
            $styles[] = "text-transform: {$textTransform}";
        }
        if ($color !== '') {
            $styles[] = "color: {$color}";
        } else {
            $styles[] = "color: var(--ds-local-heading-color, var(--ds-local-text-color, var(--color-text-main, #ffffff)))";
        }

        $styleAttr = implode('; ', $styles) . ';';
        $safeText = htmlspecialchars($text, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        return "<{$tag} class=\"ds-block-heading ds-heading-{$level}\" style=\"{$styleAttr}\">{$safeText}</{$tag}>";
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'heading',
            'fields' => [
                'text'           => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto do Título', 'default' => 'Meu Título'],
                'level'          => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Nível (H1-H6)', 'options' => [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], 'default' => 2],
                'size'           => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho da Fonte', 'units' => ['rem', 'px', 'em', 'vw'], 'default' => '1.8rem'],
                'color'          => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor', 'default' => 'var(--color-text-main)'],
                'align'          => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'left'],
                'font_family'    => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Família de Fonte', 'options' => ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary'], 'default' => 'primary'],
                'font_weight'    => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Peso da Fonte', 'options' => ['300', '400', '500', '600', '700', '800', '900'], 'default' => '800'],
                'line_height'    => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Altura de Linha', 'default' => '1.25'],
                'letter_spacing' => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Espaçamento entre Letras', 'units' => ['px', 'em'], 'default' => '0px'],
                'text_transform' => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Transformação de Texto', 'options' => ['none', 'uppercase', 'lowercase', 'capitalize'], 'default' => 'none'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/ImageBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Imagem com Dimensões e Alinhamento.
 */
class ImageBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;

    public function __construct(
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'image';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Imagem';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🖼️';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'media';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $rawUrl = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['url_mobile'] ?? ''));
        if ($rawUrl === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $url = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawUrl, '');
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $alt = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['alt'] ?? 'Imagem'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $width = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['width'] ?? 'auto'));
        $height = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['height'] ?? 'auto'));
        $borderRadius = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['border_radius'] ?? '0'));
        $rawLink = trim((string)($data['link'] ?? ''));
        $link = $rawLink !== '' ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawLink, '') : '';
        $rawAlign = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'left');
        $align = in_array($rawAlign, ['left', 'center', 'right'], true) ? $rawAlign : 'left';

        $styles = [
            "max-width: 100%",
            "height: {$height}",
            "border-radius: {$borderRadius}",
            "display: inline-block",
        ];
        if ($width !== 'auto' && $width !== '') {
            $styles[] = "width: {$width}";
        }

        $styleAttr = implode('; ', $styles) . ';';
        $wrapperStyle = "text-align: {$align}; line-height: 0;";

        $imgHtml = "<img src=\"" . htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "\" alt=\"{$alt}\" style=\"{$styleAttr}\" loading=\"lazy\">";

        if ($link !== '') {
            $safeLink = htmlspecialchars($link, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $imgHtml = "<a href=\"{$safeLink}\" style=\"display: inline-block;\">{$imgHtml}</a>";
        }

        return "<div class=\"ds-block-image\" style=\"{$wrapperStyle}\">{$imgHtml}</div>";
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'image',
            'fields' => [
                'url'           => ['type' => 'media', 'label' => 'URL da Imagem', 'default' => ''],
                'alt'           => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto Alternativo (Alt)', 'default' => ''],
                'width'         => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Largura', 'units' => ['auto', 'px', '%', 'vw'], 'default' => 'auto'],
                'height'        => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Altura', 'units' => ['auto', 'px', 'vh'], 'default' => 'auto'],
                'border_radius' => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Arredondamento de Bordas', 'units' => ['px', 'rem', '%'], 'default' => '8px'],
                'link'          => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Link de Destino (Opcional)', 'default' => ''],
                'align'         => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'left'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/LogoBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Logotipo Responsivo (Imagem e Tipografia com suporte a Desktop e Mobile).
 * Segue a abstração pai AbstractBlock (SOLID - OCP / LSP / DIP / ISP).
 */
class LogoBlock extends AbstractBlock
{
    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'logo';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Logotipo / Marca';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🛡️';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'identity';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;
        $baseUrl = $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl();
        $rawLink = (string)($data['link'] ?? $data['url'] ?? $baseUrl . '/');
        $link = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawLink, $baseUrl . '/');
        $safeLink = htmlspecialchars($link, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $logoId = $this->generateBlockId($data, 'ds_logo');

        // 1. Dimensões Desktop & Mobile
        $heightDesktop = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['height'] ?? '40px'));
        $heightMobile = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['height_mobile'] ?? $heightDesktop));

        // 2. Alinhamento e Flex Direction Desktop & Mobile
        $alignDesktop = (string)($data['align'] ?? $data['text_align'] ?? 'left');
        $justifyDesktop = match ($alignDesktop) {
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-start',
        };

        $alignMobile = (string)($data['align_mobile'] ?? $alignDesktop);
        $justifyMobile = match ($alignMobile) {
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-start',
        };

        $flexDirDesktop = (string)($data['flex_direction'] ?? 'row');
        $flexDirMobile = (string)($data['flex_direction_mobile'] ?? $flexDirDesktop);

        $alignItemsDesktop = ($flexDirDesktop === 'column')
            ? match ($alignDesktop) {
                'center' => 'center',
                'right'  => 'flex-end',
                default  => 'flex-start',
            }
            : 'center';

        $alignItemsMobile = ($flexDirMobile === 'column')
            ? match ($alignMobile) {
                'center' => 'center',
                'right'  => 'flex-end',
                default  => 'flex-start',
            }
            : 'center';

        // 3. Imagens Desktop & Mobile
        $rawImageUrl = (string)($data['image_url'] ?? $baseUrl . '/assets/img/logo.png');
        $imageUrl = $rawImageUrl !== '' ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawImageUrl, '') : '';
        $rawImageUrlMobile = (string)($data['image_url_mobile'] ?? '');
        $imageUrlMobile = $rawImageUrlMobile !== '' ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawImageUrlMobile, '') : $imageUrl;

        $showImage = (bool)($data['show_image'] ?? true);
        $showImageMobile = (bool)($data['show_image_mobile'] ?? $showImage);

        // 4. Tipografia & Textos Desktop & Mobile
        $brandText = (string)($data['brand_text'] ?? $data['text'] ?? 'Domain<span class="text-primary">System</span>');
        $brandTextMobile = (string)($data['text_mobile'] ?? $data['brand_text_mobile'] ?? '');

        $showText = (bool)($data['show_text'] ?? true);
        $showTextMobile = (bool)($data['show_text_mobile'] ?? $showText);

        $textColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_color'] ?? $data['color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-heading-color, var(--ds-local-text-color, var(--color-text-main, #ffffff)))'));
        $textColorMobile = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_color_mobile'] ?? $data['color_mobile'] ?? $textColor));
        $fontSizeDesktop = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_size'] ?? $data['size'] ?? '1.4rem'));
        $fontSizeMobile = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_size_mobile'] ?? $fontSizeDesktop));
        $fontWeightDesktop = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_weight'] ?? '800'));
        $fontWeightMobile = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_weight_mobile'] ?? $fontWeightDesktop));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_family'] ?? ''));

        $resolvedFont = $this->resolveFontFamily($fontFamily);

        // Montagem das tags de Imagem
        $imgDesktopHtml = '';
        if ($showImage && $imageUrl !== '') {
            $safeImg = htmlspecialchars($imageUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $imgDesktopHtml = "<img src=\"{$safeImg}\" class=\"ds-logo-img ds-logo-img-desktop\" alt=\"Logo\" onerror=\"this.style.display='none'\">";
        }
        $imgMobileHtml = '';
        if ($showImageMobile && $imageUrlMobile !== '') {
            $safeImgMobile = htmlspecialchars($imageUrlMobile, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $imgMobileHtml = "<img src=\"{$safeImgMobile}\" class=\"ds-logo-img ds-logo-img-mobile\" alt=\"Logo\" onerror=\"this.style.display='none'\">";
        }

        // Montagem das tags de Texto
        $sanitizedDesktop = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($brandText);
        $sanitizedMobile = $brandTextMobile !== '' ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($brandTextMobile) : $sanitizedDesktop;

        $hasDistinctMobileText = ($brandTextMobile !== '' && $brandTextMobile !== $brandText);
        $hasDistinctMobileImg = ($imageUrlMobile !== '' && $imageUrlMobile !== $imageUrl);

        $textHtml = '';
        if ($showText || $showTextMobile) {
            if ($hasDistinctMobileText) {
                $textHtml = "<div class=\"ds-logo-text\"><span class=\"ds-logo-text-desktop\">{$sanitizedDesktop}</span><span class=\"ds-logo-text-mobile\">{$sanitizedMobile}</span></div>";
            } else {
                $textHtml = "<div class=\"ds-logo-text\"><span>{$sanitizedDesktop}</span></div>";
            }
        }

        $imgHtml = $hasDistinctMobileImg ? ($imgDesktopHtml . $imgMobileHtml) : $imgDesktopHtml;

        $showImgMobileCss = !$showImageMobile ? 'display: none !important;' : 'display: block !important;';
        $showTxtMobileCss = !$showTextMobile ? 'display: none !important;' : 'display: block !important;';

        $distinctImgCssDesktop = $hasDistinctMobileImg ? "#{$logoId} .ds-logo-img-mobile { display: none !important; }" : "";
        $distinctImgCssMobile = $hasDistinctMobileImg ? "#{$logoId} .ds-logo-img-desktop { display: none !important; } #{$logoId} .ds-logo-img-mobile { display: block !important; }" : "";

        return <<<HTML
<style>
#{$logoId}.ds-block-logo-root {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
#{$logoId} .ds-block-logo-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: {$justifyDesktop};
    text-align: {$alignDesktop};
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
#{$logoId} .ds-block-logo {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-direction: {$flexDirDesktop};
    align-items: {$alignItemsDesktop};
    justify-content: {$justifyDesktop};
    gap: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    line-height: 1.2;
}
#{$logoId} .ds-logo-img {
    height: {$heightDesktop};
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
#{$logoId} .ds-logo-text {
    font-size: {$fontSizeDesktop};
    font-weight: {$fontWeightDesktop};
    font-family: {$resolvedFont};
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    color: {$textColor};
    line-height: 1.2;
    white-space: nowrap;
    display: inline-block;
}
#{$logoId} .ds-logo-text span {
    font-weight: inherit;
    font-size: inherit;
    font-family: inherit;
}
#{$logoId} .ds-logo-text .text-primary {
    color: var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
}
#{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-mobile {
    display: none !important;
}
{$distinctImgCssDesktop}

/* ========================================================
   📱 REGRAS MOBILE (≤ 768px) & SIMULADOR LIVE PREVIEW
   ======================================================== */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo-wrapper {
        justify-content: {$justifyMobile} !important;
        text-align: {$alignMobile} !important;
    }
    #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo {
        flex-direction: {$flexDirMobile} !important;
        align-items: {$alignItemsMobile} !important;
        justify-content: {$justifyMobile} !important;
        gap: 6px !important;
    }
    #{$logoId} .ds-logo-img {
        height: {$heightMobile} !important;
        {$showImgMobileCss}
    }
    #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text {
        font-size: {$fontSizeMobile} !important;
        font-weight: {$fontWeightMobile} !important;
        color: {$textColorMobile} !important;
        {$showTxtMobileCss}
    }
    #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-desktop {
        display: none !important;
    }
    #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-mobile {
        display: inline-block !important;
    }
    {$distinctImgCssMobile}
}

.ds-mobile-mode #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo-wrapper,
.ds-device-375 #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo-wrapper,
.ds-device-768 #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo-wrapper {
    justify-content: {$justifyMobile} !important;
    text-align: {$alignMobile} !important;
}
.ds-mobile-mode #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo,
.ds-device-375 #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo,
.ds-device-768 #{$logoId} .ds-block-logo {
    flex-direction: {$flexDirMobile} !important;
    align-items: {$alignItemsMobile} !important;
    justify-content: {$justifyMobile} !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
}
.ds-mobile-mode #{$logoId} .ds-logo-img,
.ds-device-375 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-img,
.ds-device-768 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-img {
    height: {$heightMobile} !important;
    {$showImgMobileCss}
}
.ds-mobile-mode #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text,
.ds-device-375 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text,
.ds-device-768 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text {
    font-size: {$fontSizeMobile} !important;
    font-weight: {$fontWeightMobile} !important;
    color: {$textColorMobile} !important;
    {$showTxtMobileCss}
}
.ds-mobile-mode #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-desktop,
.ds-device-375 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-desktop,
.ds-device-768 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-desktop {
    display: none !important;
}
.ds-mobile-mode #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-mobile,
.ds-device-375 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-mobile,
.ds-device-768 #{$logoId} .ds-logo-text-mobile {
    display: inline-block !important;
}
</style>
<div id="{$logoId}" class="ds-block-logo-root">
    <div class="ds-block-logo-wrapper">
        <a href="{$safeLink}" class="ds-block-logo">
            {$imgHtml}
            {$textHtml}
        </a>
    </div>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'logo',
            'fields' => [
                'image_url'             => ['type' => 'media', 'label' => 'URL da Imagem do Logo', 'default' => 'assets/img/logo.png'],
                'image_url_mobile'      => ['type' => 'media', 'label' => 'URL da Imagem do Logo (Mobile)', 'default' => ''],
                'brand_text'            => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto da Marca', 'default' => 'Domain<span class="text-primary">System</span>'],
                'text_mobile'           => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto da Marca (Mobile)', 'default' => ''],
                'text_color'            => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor do Texto da Marca', 'default' => 'var(--color-text-main)'],
                'font_family'           => ['type' => 'font', 'label' => 'Família da Fonte', 'default' => 'var(--font-primary)'],
                'font_size'             => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho do Texto', 'units' => ['rem', 'px'], 'default' => '1.4rem'],
                'font_size_mobile'      => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho do Texto (Mobile)', 'units' => ['rem', 'px'], 'default' => '1.1rem'],
                'font_weight'           => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Peso da Fonte', 'options' => ['400', '500', '600', '700', '800', '900'], 'default' => '800'],
                'font_weight_mobile'    => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Peso da Fonte (Mobile)', 'options' => ['400', '500', '600', '700', '800', '900'], 'default' => '500'],
                'height'                => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Altura do Logo', 'units' => ['px', 'rem'], 'default' => '40px'],
                'height_mobile'         => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Altura do Logo (Mobile)', 'units' => ['px', 'rem'], 'default' => '30px'],
                'align'                 => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'left'],
                'align_mobile'          => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento (Mobile)', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'center'],
                'flex_direction'        => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Direção Flex', 'options' => ['row', 'column'], 'default' => 'row'],
                'flex_direction_mobile' => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Direção Flex (Mobile)', 'options' => ['row' => 'Lado a Lado (Horizontal)', 'column' => 'Empilhado (Vertical)'], 'default' => 'row'],
                'show_image'            => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Imagem', 'default' => true],
                'show_image_mobile'     => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Imagem (Mobile)', 'default' => true],
                'show_text'             => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Texto da Marca', 'default' => true],
                'show_text_mobile'      => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Exibir Texto da Marca (Mobile)', 'default' => true],
                'link'                  => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Link de Destino', 'default' => '/'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/NavMenuBlock.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuTreeBuilderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\MenuTreeBuilder;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Navegação e Menu Dinâmico com Suporte a Menus e Submenus Hierárquicos (Walker SOLID),
 * 8 Estilos de Toggle Mobile, Janela Lateral Customizável e Botões Mobile.
 */
class NavMenuBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider;
    /** @var (\Closure(): ?MenuProviderInterface)|null */
    private ?\Closure $menuProviderResolver;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;
    private MenuTreeBuilderInterface $treeBuilder;

    /**
     * @param MenuProviderInterface|null $menuProvider
     * @param (\Closure(): ?MenuProviderInterface)|null $menuProviderResolver
     * @param ElementStyleRendererInterface|null $styleRenderer
     * @param HtmlSanitizerInterface|null $htmlSanitizer
     * @param PublicUrlResolverInterface|null $urlResolver
     * @param MenuTreeBuilderInterface|null $treeBuilder
     */
    public function __construct(
        ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider = null,
        ?\Closure $menuProviderResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null,
        ?MenuTreeBuilderInterface $treeBuilder = null
    ) {
        $this->menuProvider = $menuProvider;
        $this->menuProviderResolver = $menuProviderResolver;
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver ?? new BaseUrlResolver();
        $this->treeBuilder = $treeBuilder ?? new MenuTreeBuilder();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'nav_menu';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Menu de Navegação';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🧭';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'navigation';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl();
        $location = (string)($data['menu_location'] ?? 'header');
        $rawToggleStyle = (string)($data['toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC);
        $toggleStyle = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $rawToggleStyle) ?: MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC;
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'center');
        $justifyNav = match ($align) {
            'left'  => 'flex-start',
            'right' => 'flex-end',
            default => 'center',
        };

        $toggleAlign = (string)($data['toggle_align'] ?? $data['align'] ?? 'right');
        $linkColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['link_color'] ?? $data['text_color'] ?? $data['color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-link-color, var(--ds-local-text-color, var(--color-text-main, #c5c6c7)))'));
        $activeColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['active_color'] ?? $data['link_hover_color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-link-hover-color, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8))'));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['font_family']) ? (string)$data['font_family'] : 'var(--font-primary, inherit)'
        );
        $fontSize = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['font_size']) ? (string)$data['font_size'] : '0.95rem'
        );
        $fontWeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['font_weight']) ? (string)$data['font_weight'] : '500'
        );
        $textTransform = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['text_transform']) ? (string)$data['text_transform'] : 'none'
        );
        $hoverAnim = (string)($data['hover_animation'] ?? 'underline');
        $justifyToggle = match ($toggleAlign) {
            'left'   => 'flex-start',
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-end',
        };

        // ==========================================
        // 1. CUSTOMIZAÇÃO DO BOTÃO TOGGLE HAMBURGUER MOBILE
        // ==========================================
        $toggleLabelText = htmlspecialchars(trim((string)($data['toggle_label'] ?? 'MENU')) ?: 'MENU', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $toggleColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['toggle_color']) ? (string)$data['toggle_color'] : $activeColor
        );
        $toggleBgDefault = match ($toggleStyle) {
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_BOXED => $activeColor,
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_ROUNDED_GLOW,
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL  => 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)',
            default                                 => 'transparent',
        };
        $toggleBgColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['toggle_bg_color']) ? (string)$data['toggle_bg_color'] : $toggleBgDefault
        );
        if ($toggleStyle === MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_BOXED && empty($data['toggle_color'])) {
            $toggleColor = 'var(--color-background, #0b0c10)';
        }
        $toggleBorderColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['toggle_border_color']) ? (string)$data['toggle_border_color'] : 'rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.28)'
        );
        $toggleHoverColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['toggle_hover_color']) ? (string)$data['toggle_hover_color'] : $toggleColor
        );
        $toggleHoverBgColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['toggle_hover_bg_color']) ? (string)$data['toggle_hover_bg_color'] : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18)'
        );
        $toggleRadiusDefault = match ($toggleStyle) {
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL,
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_ROUNDED_GLOW => '999px',
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CYBER        => '2px',
            default                                        => '8px',
        };
        $toggleRadius = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['toggle_radius']) ? (string)$data['toggle_radius'] : $toggleRadiusDefault
        );

        // ==========================================
        // 2. CUSTOMIZAÇÃO DA JANELA LATERAL (MOBILE DRAWER)
        // ==========================================
        $drawerTitleRaw = array_key_exists('drawer_title', $data) ? trim((string)$data['drawer_title']) : 'Navegação';
        $drawerTitle = htmlspecialchars($drawerTitleRaw, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $drawerTitleColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['drawer_title_color']) ? (string)$data['drawer_title_color'] : $activeColor
        );
        $drawerBg = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['drawer_bg']) ? (string)$data['drawer_bg'] : 'var(--color-surface, rgba(11, 14, 18, 0.98))'
        );
        $drawerBorderColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['drawer_border_color']) ? (string)$data['drawer_border_color'] : 'var(--color-border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08))'
        );
        $drawerWidth = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['drawer_width']) ? (string)$data['drawer_width'] : '320px'
        );
        $drawerPosition = (string)($data['drawer_position'] ?? ($toggleAlign === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right'));
        $drawerPlacementCss = match ($drawerPosition) {
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::DRAWER_POS_LEFT => "top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 85vw; max-width: {$drawerWidth}; border-right: 1px solid {$drawerBorderColor}; transform: translateX(-105%);",
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::DRAWER_POS_TOP => "top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; width: 100vw; max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 85vh; border-bottom: 1px solid {$drawerBorderColor}; transform: translateY(-105%);",
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::DRAWER_POS_FULLSCREEN => "inset: 0; width: 100vw; max-width: 100vw; height: 100vh; transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;",
            default => "top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 85vw; max-width: {$drawerWidth}; border-left: 1px solid {$drawerBorderColor}; transform: translateX(105%);",
        };
        $drawerOpenCss = match ($drawerPosition) {
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::DRAWER_POS_TOP        => 'transform: translateY(0);',
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::DRAWER_POS_FULLSCREEN => 'transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto;',
            default                                           => 'transform: translateX(0);',
        };

        // ==========================================
        // 3. CUSTOMIZAÇÃO DOS BOTÕES DE MENU DENTRO DO DRAWER MOBILE
        // ==========================================
        $mobileItemStyle = (string)($data['mobile_item_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::ITEM_STYLE_CARD);
        if (!in_array($mobileItemStyle, MobileToggleStyleInterface::ALL_ITEM_STYLES, true)) {
            $mobileItemStyle = MobileToggleStyleInterface::ITEM_STYLE_CARD;
        }
        $mobileItemAlign = (string)($data['mobile_item_align'] ?? 'left');
        $mobileItemJustify = match ($mobileItemAlign) {
            'center' => 'center',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'flex-start',
        };
        $mobileItemTextAlign = in_array($mobileItemAlign, ['left', 'center', 'right'], true) ? $mobileItemAlign : 'left';
        $mobileItemGap = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['mobile_item_gap']) ? (string)$data['mobile_item_gap'] : '8px'
        );
        $mobileItemPadding = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['mobile_item_padding']) ? (string)$data['mobile_item_padding'] : '12px 16px'
        );
        $mobileLinkColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['mobile_link_color']) ? (string)$data['mobile_link_color'] : $linkColor
        );
        $mobileHoverTextColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            !empty($data['mobile_hover_text_color']) ? (string)$data['mobile_hover_text_color'] : $activeColor
        );

        // Valores padrões inteligentes conforme o formato do botão mobile escolhido
        $defaultItemBg = match ($mobileItemStyle) {
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::ITEM_STYLE_CARD      => 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)',
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::ITEM_STYLE_PILL      => 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',

    <script>
        if (!window.toggleDsNavDrawer) {
            window.toggleDsNavDrawer = function(navId, open) {
                const drawer = document.getElementById(navId + '_drawer');
                const backdrop = document.getElementById(navId + '_backdrop');
                if (!drawer || !backdrop) return;
                if (open) {
                    if (window.syncDsNavDrawerActions) {
                        window.syncDsNavDrawerActions(navId);
                    }
                    drawer.classList.add('is-open');
                    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
                } else {
                    drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
                    backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
                }
            };
            window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.ds-mobile-drawer.is-open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('is-open'));
                    document.querySelectorAll('.ds-mobile-backdrop.is-open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('is-open'));
                }
            });
        }
        if (!window.toggleDsMobileSubmenu) {
            window.toggleDsMobileSubmenu = function(btnEl, subId) {
                const sub = document.getElementById(subId);
                if (!sub) return;
                const isOpen = sub.classList.toggle('is-open');
                if (btnEl) {
                    btnEl.classList.toggle('is-open', isOpen);
                    btnEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
                }
            };
        }
        if (!window.syncDsNavDrawerActions) {
            window.syncDsNavDrawerActions = function(navId) {
                const nav = document.getElementById(navId);
                const drawer = document.getElementById(navId + '_drawer');
                const actionsContainer = document.getElementById(navId + '_actions');
                if (!drawer || !actionsContainer) return;

                const header = nav ? (nav.closest('header') || nav.closest('.ds-theme-header') || nav.closest('.ds-theme-part') || nav.closest('.container') || document.querySelector('header, .ds-theme-header, .ds-theme-part')) : document.querySelector('header, .ds-theme-header, .ds-theme-part');
                const rootEl = header || document.body;
                const candidates = rootEl.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-absorb="true"], .ds-block-button-wrapper[data-mobile-absorb="true"], .ds-block-cta-wrapper[data-mobile-absorb="true"], .ds-block-user-auth[data-mobile-absorb="true"]');
                candidates.forEach(function(el) {
                    if (drawer.contains(el)) return;
                    if (el.getAttribute('data-mobile-absorb') === 'false') return;

                    el.classList.add('ds-swallowed-in-mobile');
                    const wrapper = el.closest('.ds-element-wrapper');
                    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ds-swallowed-in-mobile');

                    const origId = el.id || ('ds_orig_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7));
                    if (!el.id) el.id = origId;
                    if (actionsContainer.querySelector('[data-absorbed-from="' + origId + '"]')) return;

                    const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
                    clone.setAttribute('data-absorbed-from', origId);
                    clone.removeAttribute('data-mobile-absorb');
                    clone.classList.remove('ds-swallowed-in-mobile');
                    clone.style.display = 'flex';
                    clone.style.flexDirection = 'column';
                    clone.style.width = '100%';
                    clone.style.margin = '0';
                    clone.style.gap = '8px';
                    clone.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
                    clone.style.justifyContent = 'stretch';
                    clone.querySelectorAll('.ds-block-btn, .ds-block-cta, .ds-auth-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
                        btn.style.width = '100%';
                        btn.style.maxWidth = '100%';
                        btn.style.justifyContent = 'center';
                        btn.style.textAlign = 'center';
                        btn.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
                        btn.style.margin = '0';
                    });
                    actionsContainer.appendChild(clone);
                });

                if (actionsContainer.children.length > 0) {
                    actionsContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                }
            };
        }
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            const initSync = function() {
                if (window.syncDsNavDrawerActions) {
                    window.syncDsNavDrawerActions('{$navId}');
                }
            };
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSync);
            } else {
                setTimeout(initSync, 50);
            }
        }
    </script>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    /**
     * Renderiza recursivamente a árvore de menus e submenus para Desktop.
     *
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $nodes
     */
    private function renderDesktopTree(
        array $nodes,
        string $baseUrl,
        string $currentUri,
        string $linkColor,
        string $activeColor,
        string $fontFamily,
        string $fontSize,
        string $fontWeight,
        string $textTransform,
        string $animClass,
        int $level = 0
    ): string {
        $itemsHtml = [];

        foreach ($nodes as $item) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($item['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $safeUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)($item['url'] ?? '#'), '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safeUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $target = (($item['target'] ?? '_self') === '_blank') ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
            $extraClass = !empty($item['css_classes'])
                ? ' ' . htmlspecialchars(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]/', '', (string)$item['css_classes']) ?? '', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')
                : '';

            $isActive = ($currentUri === $url || ($url !== $baseUrl . '/' && $url !== '#' && str_starts_with($currentUri, $url)));
            $children = (!empty($item['children']) && is_array($item['children'])) ? $item['children'] : [];
            $hasChildren = !empty($children);
            $liClass = 'ds-menu-item' . ($hasChildren ? ' menu-item-has-children' : '') . $extraClass;

            if ($level === 0) {
                $itemColor = $isActive ? $activeColor : $linkColor;
                $activeClass = $isActive ? ' active' : '';
                $activeStyle = "color: {$itemColor}; font-weight: " . ($isActive ? '700' : $fontWeight) . "; text-transform: {$textTransform};";
                $chevron = $hasChildren ? '<span class="ds-submenu-chevron" aria-hidden="true">&#9662;</span>' : '';
                $linkHtml = "<a href=\"{$url}\"{$target} class=\"ds-nav-link{$activeClass}{$animClass}\" style=\"{$activeStyle} text-decoration: none; font-family: {$fontFamily}; font-size: {$fontSize}; transition: all 0.25s ease;\">{$title}{$chevron}</a>";
            } else {
                $activeClass = $isActive ? ' active' : '';
                $chevron = $hasChildren ? '<span class="ds-submenu-chevron" aria-hidden="true">&#9656;</span>' : '';
                $linkHtml = "<a href=\"{$url}\"{$target} class=\"ds-submenu-link{$activeClass}\" style=\"font-family: {$fontFamily}; text-transform: {$textTransform};\">{$title}{$chevron}</a>";
            }

            $submenuHtml = '';
            if ($hasChildren) {
                $inner = $this->renderDesktopTree(
                    $children,
                    $baseUrl,
                    $currentUri,
                    $linkColor,
                    $activeColor,
                    $fontFamily,
                    $fontSize,
                    $fontWeight,
                    $textTransform,
                    $animClass,
                    $level + 1
                );
                $submenuHtml = "\n<ul class=\"sub-menu ds-sub-menu\">\n{$inner}\n</ul>";
            }

            $itemsHtml[] = "<li class=\"{$liClass}\">{$linkHtml}{$submenuHtml}</li>";
        }

        return implode("\n", $itemsHtml);
    }

    /**
     * Renderiza recursivamente a árvore de menus e submenus para a Gaveta Mobile (Acordeão).
     *
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $nodes
     */
    private function renderMobileTree(
        array $nodes,
        string $baseUrl,
        string $currentUri,
        string $mobileItemStyle,
        string $fontFamily,
        string $fontWeight,
        string $textTransform,
        string $navId,
        int $level = 0
    ): string {
        $itemsHtml = [];

        foreach ($nodes as $idx => $item) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($item['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $safeUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)($item['url'] ?? '#'), '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safeUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $target = (($item['target'] ?? '_self') === '_blank') ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
            $isActive = ($currentUri === $url || ($url !== $baseUrl . '/' && $url !== '#' && str_starts_with($currentUri, $url)));
            $activeClass = $isActive ? ' active' : '';
            $children = (!empty($item['children']) && is_array($item['children'])) ? $item['children'] : [];
            $hasChildren = !empty($children);

            $subId = "{$navId}_mob_sub_{$level}_{$idx}_" . (int)($item['id'] ?? $idx);
            $linkFontSize = $level > 0 ? 'font-size: 0.92rem;' : '';
            $onClickToggle = ($hasChildren && ($url === '#' || $url === ''))
                ? " onclick=\"event.preventDefault(); window.toggleDsMobileSubmenu(this.nextElementSibling, '{$subId}')\""
                : '';

            if ($hasChildren) {
                $innerMobile = $this->renderMobileTree(
                    $children,
                    $baseUrl,
                    $currentUri,
                    $mobileItemStyle,
                    $fontFamily,
                    $fontWeight,
                    $textTransform,
                    $navId,
                    $level + 1
                );
                $itemsHtml[] = "<li class=\"ds-mobile-menu-item menu-item-has-children\" style=\"margin: 0;\">"
                    . "<div class=\"ds-mobile-item-row\">"
                    . "<a href=\"{$url}\"{$target}{$onClickToggle} class=\"ds-mobile-nav-link ds-mobile-item-{$mobileItemStyle}{$activeClass}\" style=\"font-weight: " . ($isActive ? '700' : $fontWeight) . "; text-transform: {$textTransform}; font-family: {$fontFamily}; {$linkFontSize}\">{$title}</a>"
                    . "<button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-mobile-submenu-toggle\" onclick=\"window.toggleDsMobileSubmenu(this, '{$subId}')\" aria-label=\"Expandir Submenu\" aria-expanded=\"false\">&#9662;</button>"
                    . "</div>"
                    . "<ul id=\"{$subId}\" class=\"ds-mobile-sub-menu\">{$innerMobile}</ul>"
                    . "</li>";
            } else {
                $itemsHtml[] = "<li class=\"ds-mobile-menu-item\" style=\"margin: 0;\"><a href=\"{$url}\"{$target} class=\"ds-mobile-nav-link ds-mobile-item-{$mobileItemStyle}{$activeClass}\" style=\"font-weight: " . ($isActive ? '700' : $fontWeight) . "; text-transform: {$textTransform}; font-family: {$fontFamily}; {$linkFontSize}\">{$title}</a></li>";
            }
        }

        return implode("\n", $itemsHtml);
    }

    private function resolveMenuItems(array $data, string $location): array
    {
        if (!empty($data['custom_items']) && is_array($data['custom_items'])) {
            return $data['custom_items'];
        }

        $provider = $this->menuProvider;
        if ($provider === null && $this->menuProviderResolver !== null) {
            try {
                $provider = ($this->menuProviderResolver)();
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $provider = null;
            }
        }

        if ($provider === null) {
            return [];
        }

        try {
            $menuId = !empty($data['menu_id']) ? (int)$data['menu_id'] : null;
            return $provider->getMenuItems($location, $menuId);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        return [];
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'nav_menu',
            'fields' => [
                'menu_location'             => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Local do Menu', 'options' => ['header', 'footer', 'custom'], 'default' => 'header'],
                'menu_id'                   => ['type' => 'number', 'label' => 'ID Específico do Menu (Opcional)', 'default' => 0],
                'toggle_style'              => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Estilo do Botão Hamburguer', 'options' => MobileToggleStyleInterface::ALL_TOGGLE_STYLES, 'default' => 'classic'],
                'toggle_color'              => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor do Ícone Hamburguer', 'default' => 'var(--color-primary)'],
                'toggle_bg_color'           => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor de Fundo do Hamburguer', 'default' => 'transparent'],
                'toggle_hover_color'        => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor Hover do Hamburguer', 'default' => 'var(--color-primary)'],
                'toggle_hover_bg_color'     => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Fundo Hover do Hamburguer', 'default' => 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18)'],
                'drawer_title'              => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Título da Janela Mobile', 'default' => 'Navegação'],
                'drawer_title_color'        => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor do Título da Janela Mobile', 'default' => 'var(--color-primary)'],

                'mobile_item_style'         => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Formato dos Botões Mobile', 'options' => MobileToggleStyleInterface::ALL_ITEM_STYLES, 'default' => 'card'],

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/ParagraphBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Parágrafo / Texto Corrido.
 */
class ParagraphBlock extends AbstractBlock
{
    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        parent::__construct($htmlSanitizer, null, $styleRenderer);
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'paragraph';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Parágrafo (Texto)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '📄';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'typography';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;
        $text = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $size = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['size'] ?? $data['font_size'] ?? ''));
        $color = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['color'] ?? $data['text_color'] ?? ''));
        $align = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['align'] ?? $data['text_align'] ?? 'left'));
        $lineHeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['line_height'] ?? '1.7'));
        $fontFamily = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_family'] ?? ''));
        $fontWeight = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['font_weight'] ?? ''));
        $letterSpacing = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['letter_spacing'] ?? ''));
        $textTransform = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['text_transform'] ?? ''));

        $resolvedFont = match ($fontFamily) {
            'secondary' => 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)',
            'tertiary'  => 'var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)',
            '', 'primary' => 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)',
            default     => $fontFamily,
        };

        $styles = [
            "text-align: {$align}",
            "line-height: {$lineHeight}",
            "margin: 0",
            "font-family: {$resolvedFont}",
        ];

        if ($size !== '') {
            $styles[] = "font-size: {$size}";
        }
        if ($fontWeight !== '') {
            $styles[] = "font-weight: {$fontWeight}";
        }
        if ($letterSpacing !== '') {
            $styles[] = "letter-spacing: {$letterSpacing}";
        }
        if ($textTransform !== '') {
            $styles[] = "text-transform: {$textTransform}";
        }
        if ($color !== '') {
            $styles[] = "color: {$color}";
        } else {
            $styles[] = "color: var(--ds-local-text-color, var(--color-text-muted, #8b8c8d))";
        }

        $styleAttr = implode('; ', $styles) . ';';
        // Sanitização segura de HTML inline contra XSS (atributos on*, javascript:, etc.)
        $sanitized = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($text);

        return "<p class=\"ds-block-paragraph\" style=\"{$styleAttr}\">{$sanitized}</p>";
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'paragraph',
            'fields' => [
                'text'           => ['type' => 'textarea', 'label' => 'Conteúdo do Texto', 'default' => 'Texto do parágrafo.'],
                'size'           => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Tamanho da Fonte', 'units' => ['rem', 'px', 'em'], 'default' => '1.05rem'],
                'color'          => ['type' => 'color', 'label' => 'Cor', 'default' => 'var(--color-text-muted)'],
                'align'          => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right', 'justify'], 'default' => 'left'],
                'line_height'    => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Altura de Linha', 'default' => '1.7'],
                'font_family'    => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Família de Fonte', 'options' => ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary'], 'default' => 'primary'],
                'font_weight'    => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Peso da Fonte', 'options' => ['300', '400', '500', '600', '700', '800'], 'default' => '400'],
                'letter_spacing' => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Espaçamento entre Letras', 'units' => ['px', 'em'], 'default' => '0px'],
                'text_transform' => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Transformação de Texto', 'options' => ['none', 'uppercase', 'lowercase', 'capitalize'], 'default' => 'none'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}
