                'label' => 'Exibir Autor',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_excerpt' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Resumo (Excerto)',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_read_more' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Link "Ler Artigo"',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'read_more_text' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Texto do Botão / Link',
                'default' => 'Ler Artigo →',
            ],
            'title_color' => [
                'type' => 'color',
                'label' => 'Cor dos Títulos dos Cards',
                'default' => 'var(--color-primary)',
            ],
            'excerpt_color' => [
                'type' => 'color',
                'label' => 'Cor do Resumo (Texto)',
                'default' => 'var(--color-text-main)',
            ],
            'meta_color' => [
                'type' => 'color',
                'label' => 'Cor da Data / Autor',
                'default' => 'var(--color-text-muted)',
            ],
            'readmore_color' => [
                'type' => 'color',
                'label' => 'Cor do Link "Ler Artigo"',
                'default' => 'var(--color-primary)',
            ],
            'badge_bg_color' => [
                'type' => 'color',
                'label' => 'Cor de Fundo da Categoria (Badge)',
                'default' => 'var(--color-primary)',
            ],
            'badge_text_color' => [
                'type' => 'color',
                'label' => 'Cor do Texto da Categoria (Badge)',
                'default' => '#0b0c10',
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;

        $rawCols = (int)($data['columns'] ?? 3);
        $columns = in_array($rawCols, [1, 2, 3, 4], true) ? $rawCols : 3;

        $limit = max(1, (int)($data['limit'] ?? 6));
        $rawCardStyle = (string)($data['card_style'] ?? 'cyber_glass');
        $cardStyle = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $rawCardStyle) ?: 'cyber_glass';
        $rawHoverEffect = (string)($data['hover_effect'] ?? 'lift');
        $hoverEffect = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $rawHoverEffect) ?: 'lift';
        $gap = !empty($data['gap']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['gap']) : '24px';

        $showImage = (bool)($data['show_image'] ?? true);
        $showDate = (bool)($data['show_date'] ?? true);
        $showAuthor = (bool)($data['show_author'] ?? true);
        $showExcerpt = (bool)($data['show_excerpt'] ?? true);
        $showReadMore = (bool)($data['show_read_more'] ?? true);
        $readMoreText = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['read_more_text'] ?? 'Ler Artigo →'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $titleColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['title_color'] ?? $data['heading_color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-heading-color, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8))'));
        $excerptColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['excerpt_color'] ?? $data['text_color'] ?? $data['color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-text-color, var(--text-main, #c5c6c7))'));
        $metaColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['meta_color'] ?? 'var(--text-muted, #8b8c8d)'));
        $readmoreColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['readmore_color'] ?? $data['link_color'] ?? 'var(--ds-local-link-color, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8))'));
        $badgeBgColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['badge_bg_color'] ?? 'var(--color-primary, #38bdf8)'));
        $badgeTextColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['badge_text_color'] ?? '#0b0c10'));

        // Se o usuário passou posts manuais estáticos no schema, usa-os; caso contrário consulta o provedor
        if (isset($data['manual_posts']) && is_array($data['manual_posts']) && !empty($data['manual_posts'])) {
            $posts = array_slice($data['manual_posts'], 0, $limit);
        } else {
            $posts = $this->postProvider->getPosts(['limit' => $limit]);
        }

        if (empty($posts)) {
            return '<div class="ds-post-cards-empty" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted, #8b8c8d); font-family: var(--font-primary, sans-serif);">'
                 . '<p>Nenhum artigo encontrado para exibição no momento.</p>'
                 . '</div>';
        }

        $cardsHtml = [];
        foreach ($posts as $post) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['title'] ?? 'Sem Título'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $excerpt = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['excerpt'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $safePostUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)($post['url'] ?? '#'), '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safePostUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $author = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['author'] ?? 'Redação'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $publishedAt = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['published_at'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $category = htmlspecialchars((string)($post['category'] ?? 'Artigo'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $rawFeaturedImage = !empty($post['featured_image']) ? $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl((string)$post['featured_image'], '') : '';
            $featuredImage = $rawFeaturedImage !== '' ? htmlspecialchars($rawFeaturedImage, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
            $readingTime = !empty($post['reading_time']) ? htmlspecialchars((string)$post['reading_time'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';

            $imageHtml = '';
            if ($showImage) {
                if ($featuredImage !== '') {
                    $imageHtml = "<div class=\"ds-card-thumb\">\n"
                               . "    <a href=\"{$url}\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n"
                               . "        <img src=\"{$featuredImage}\" alt=\"{$title}\" loading=\"lazy\" itemprop=\"image\" class=\"ds-card-img\">\n"
                               . "    </a>\n"
                               . "    <span class=\"ds-card-badge\">{$category}</span>\n"
                               . "</div>\n";
                } else {
                    $imageHtml = "<div class=\"ds-card-thumb ds-card-thumb-placeholder\">\n"
                               . "    <span class=\"ds-card-badge\">{$category}</span>\n"
                               . "</div>\n";
                }
            }

            $metaParts = [];
            if ($showDate && $publishedAt !== '') {
                $metaParts[] = "<time itemprop=\"datePublished\" datetime=\"{$publishedAt}\">{$publishedAt}</time>";
            }
            if ($showAuthor && $author !== '') {
                $metaParts[] = "<span itemprop=\"author\" itemscope itemtype=\"https://schema.org/Person\"><span itemprop=\"name\">{$author}</span></span>";
            }
            if ($readingTime !== '') {
                $metaParts[] = "<span class=\"ds-card-reading-time\">{$readingTime}</span>";
            }
            $metaHtml = !empty($metaParts) ? "<div class=\"ds-card-meta\">\n    " . implode(" • \n    ", $metaParts) . "\n</div>\n" : '';

            $excerptHtml = ($showExcerpt && $excerpt !== '') ? "<p class=\"ds-card-excerpt\" itemprop=\"description\">{$excerpt}</p>\n" : '';
            $readMoreHtml = $showReadMore ? "<div class=\"ds-card-footer\">\n    <a href=\"{$url}\" class=\"ds-card-readmore\" itemprop=\"url\">{$readMoreText}</a>\n</div>\n" : '';

            $cardsHtml[] = <<<HTML
<article class="ds-post-card ds-style-{$cardStyle} ds-hover-{$hoverEffect}" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/BlogPosting">
    {$imageHtml}
    <div class="ds-card-content">
        {$metaHtml}
        <h3 class="ds-card-title" itemprop="headline">
            <a href="{$url}" itemprop="mainEntityOfPage">{$title}</a>
        </h3>
        {$excerptHtml}
        {$readMoreHtml}
    </div>
</article>
HTML;
        }

        $allCards = implode("\n", $cardsHtml);

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-post-cards-grid ds-cols-{$columns}" style="--ds-grid-cols: {$columns}; --ds-grid-gap: {$gap}; --ds-card-title-color: {$titleColor}; --ds-card-excerpt-color: {$excerptColor}; --ds-card-meta-color: {$metaColor}; --ds-card-readmore-color: {$readmoreColor}; --ds-card-badge-bg: {$badgeBgColor}; --ds-card-badge-text: {$badgeTextColor};">
{$allCards}
</div>
<style>
.ds-post-cards-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--ds-grid-cols, 3), minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--ds-grid-gap, 24px);
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .ds-post-cards-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(min(var(--ds-grid-cols, 3), 2), minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .ds-post-cards-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    }
}
.ds-post-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
    font-family: var(--font-primary, 'Inter', sans-serif);
}
.ds-style-cyber_glass {
    background: var(--surface, rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.7));
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15));
}
.ds-style-minimal {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08));
    border-radius: 0;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
}
.ds-style-bordered {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18));
}
.ds-style-flat {
    background: var(--surface, #1f2833);
    border: none;
}
.ds-hover-lift:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.ds-hover-glow:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
    border-color: var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
}
.ds-hover-border_accent:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-primary, #38bdf8);
}
.ds-card-thumb {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0f172a;
}
.ds-card-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}
.ds-post-card:hover .ds-card-img {
    transform: scale(1.05);
}
.ds-card-thumb-placeholder {
    height: 80px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15), rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.8));
}
.ds-card-badge {
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;
    left: 12px;
    background: var(--ds-card-badge-bg, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8));
    color: var(--ds-card-badge-text, #0b0c10);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    z-index: 2;

    color: var(--ds-card-title-color, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8));
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s ease, text-shadow 0.2s ease;

    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--ds-card-title-color, var(--color-primary, #38bdf8));

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/ShortcodeBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;

/**
 * Bloco de Shortcode do Sistema (Execução Dinâmica com 1-Clique).
 */
class ShortcodeBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;
    private ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager;
    /** @var (\Closure(): ?ShortcodeManager)|null */
    private ?\Closure $shortcodeResolver;

    /**
     * @param ShortcodeManager|null $shortcodeManager
     * @param (\Closure(): ?ShortcodeManager)|null $shortcodeResolver
     */
    public function __construct(?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager = null, ?\Closure $shortcodeResolver = null)
    {
        $this->shortcodeManager = $shortcodeManager;
        $this->shortcodeResolver = $shortcodeResolver;
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'shortcode';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Shortcode Dinâmico';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '⚡';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'system';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $code = trim((string)($data['code'] ?? $data['tag'] ?? ''));
        if ($code === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $sm = $this->shortcodeManager;
        if ($sm === null && $this->shortcodeResolver !== null) {
            try {
                $sm = ($this->shortcodeResolver)();
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $sm = null;
            }
        }

        if ($sm !== null) {
            return $sm->parse($code);
        }

        return $code;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'shortcode',
            'fields' => [
                'code' => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Código do Shortcode (ex: [hub_de_cursos])', 'default' => '[hub_de_cursos]'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/SocialIconsBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Icons\SvgIconRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Icons\DefaultSvgIconsFactory;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\ColorValue;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Redes Sociais com Vetores SVG Nativos Puros (SOLID - SRP / OCP).
 * 
 * Suporta formatos vetoriais puros (sem dependência de fontes externas como FontAwesome),
 * cores oficiais das marcas ou cores conectadas aos Design Tokens, 4 formatos de silhueta
 * (circle, rounded, square, minimal) e micro-interações de hover.
 */
class SocialIconsBlock implements BlockInterface, StylableElementInterface
{
    use StylableElementTrait;
    use AllowedPartTypesTrait;

    private SvgIconRegistryInterface $iconRegistry;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;

    public function __construct(
        ?SvgIconRegistryInterface $iconRegistry = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->iconRegistry = $iconRegistry ?? DefaultSvgIconsFactory::create();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'social_icons';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Redes Sociais (SVG Vetorial)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🌐';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'contact';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;

        $networksRaw = $data['networks'] ?? [
            ['network' => 'instagram', 'url' => 'https://instagram.com'],
            ['network' => 'whatsapp',  'url' => 'https://wa.me/5511999999999'],
            ['network' => 'youtube',   'url' => 'https://youtube.com'],
        ];

        // Normalização defensiva: aceita array associativo clássico ['github' => 'url'] ou lista de objetos
        $itemsList = [];
        if (is_array($networksRaw)) {
            foreach ($networksRaw as $key => $val) {
                if (is_array($val)) {
                    $net = (string)($val['network'] ?? '');
                    $url = (string)($val['url'] ?? '');
                } else {
                    $net = (string)$key;
                    $url = (string)$val;
                }
                $net = strtolower(trim($net));
                $url = trim($url);
                if ($net !== '' && $url !== '') {
                    $itemsList[] = ['network' => $net, 'url' => $url];
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($itemsList)) {
            return '';
        }

        $shape = (string)($data['shape'] ?? 'circle');
        $colorMode = (string)($data['color_mode'] ?? 'official'); // 'official' | 'custom'
        $hoverAnim = (string)($data['hover_animation'] ?? 'lift');
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? 'center');
        $gap = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['gap'] ?? '12px'));
        $iconSize = (int)preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string)($data['icon_size'] ?? '20')) ?: 20;
        $buttonSize = (int)preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', (string)($data['button_size'] ?? '40')) ?: 40;

        // Resolução de cores personalizadas via Design Tokens
        $customIconColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            ColorValue::fromString((string)($data['icon_color'] ?? '#ffffff'))->toCss()
        );
        $customBgColor = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue(
            ColorValue::fromString((string)($data['bg_color'] ?? 'var(--color-surface, #1f2833)'))->toCss()
        );

        $borderRadius = match ($shape) {
            'circle'  => '50%',
            'rounded' => '10px',
            'square'  => '0px',
            default   => '0px',
        };

        $animClass = match ($hoverAnim) {
            'grow'   => 'ds-btn-grow',
            'lift'   => 'ds-btn-lift',
            'glow'   => 'ds-btn-glow',
            'bounce' => 'ds-btn-bounce',
            default  => '',
        };

        $justify = match ($align) {
            'left'   => 'flex-start',
            'right'  => 'flex-end',
            default  => 'center',
        };

        $renderedIcons = [];
        foreach ($itemsList as $item) {
            $net = $item['network'];
            $safeItemUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($item['url'], '#');
            $url = htmlspecialchars($safeItemUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $label = $this->iconRegistry->getLabel($net) ?? ucfirst($net);
            $officialBrandColor = $this->iconRegistry->getBrandColor($net) ?? '#38bdf8';

            if ($colorMode === 'official') {
                if ($shape === 'minimal') {
                    $itemFill = $officialBrandColor;
                    $itemBg = 'transparent';
                } else {
                    $itemFill = '#ffffff';
                    $itemBg = $officialBrandColor;
                }
            } else {
                $itemFill = $customIconColor;
                $itemBg = ($shape === 'minimal') ? 'transparent' : $customBgColor;
            }

            $svgHtml = $this->iconRegistry->getSvg($net, [
                'width'  => (string)$iconSize,
                'height' => (string)$iconSize,
                'fill'   => $itemFill,
            ]);

            if ($svgHtml === null) {
                // Fallback seguro caso seja uma rede desconhecida
                $svgHtml = $this->iconRegistry->getSvg('website', [
                    'width'  => (string)$iconSize,
                    'height' => (string)$iconSize,
                    'fill'   => $itemFill,
                ]);
            }

            $btnStyle = "display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: {$buttonSize}px; height: {$buttonSize}px; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; background: {$itemBg}; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);";

            $renderedIcons[] = "<a href=\"{$url}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" aria-label=\"{$label}\" class=\"ds-social-btn {$animClass}\" style=\"{$btnStyle}\">{$svgHtml}</a>";
        }

        $iconsOutput = implode("\n", $renderedIcons);

        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-social-wrapper" style="display: flex; gap: {$gap}; justify-content: {$justify}; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 100%;">
    {$iconsOutput}
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'social_icons',
            'fields' => [
                'networks' => [
                    'type'    => 'repeater',
                    'label'   => 'Redes Sociais',
                    'default' => [
                        ['network' => 'instagram', 'url' => 'https://instagram.com'],
                        ['network' => 'whatsapp',  'url' => 'https://wa.me/5511999999999'],
                        ['network' => 'youtube',   'url' => 'https://youtube.com'],
                    ],
                ],
                'shape' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Formato da Silhueta',
                    'options' => [
                        'circle'  => 'Círculo (50%)',
                        'rounded' => 'Cantos Arredondados (Rounded)',
                        'square'  => 'Quadrado (Square)',
                        'minimal' => 'Minimalista (Sem Fundo)',
                    ],
                    'default' => 'circle',
                ],
                'color_mode' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Esquema de Cores',
                    'options' => [
                        'official' => 'Cores Oficiais das Marcas',
                        'custom'   => 'Cores Personalizadas (Design Tokens)',
                    ],
                    'default' => 'official',
                ],
                'icon_color' => [
                    'type'    => 'color',
                    'label'   => 'Cor do Ícone (Modo Custom)',
                    'default' => '#ffffff',
                ],
                'bg_color' => [
                    'type'    => 'color',
                    'label'   => 'Cor de Fundo (Modo Custom)',
                    'default' => 'var(--color-surface)',
                ],
                'hover_animation' => [
                    'type'    => 'select',
                    'label'   => 'Animação no Hover',
                    'options' => [
                        'lift'   => 'Elevar com Sombra (Lift)',
                        'grow'   => 'Aumentar Escala (Grow)',
                        'glow'   => 'Brilho Fluorescente (Glow)',

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/UserAuthBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\Traits\AllowedPartTypesTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco Semântico de Autenticação / Login e Cadastro de Alunos no Header & Footer Builder (SOLID - SRP / OCP).
 * 
 * Renderiza dinamicamente:
 * - Deslogado: Botão Login ("Entrar") e Botão Cadastrar ("Criar Conta") vinculados ao Academy.
 * - Logado: Atalho para a Área do Aluno ("🎓 Meu Painel") e Botão Sair ("Logout").
 */
class UserAuthBlock extends AbstractBlock
{
    private ?SessionManagerInterface $session;

    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?SessionManagerInterface $session = null
    ) {
        parent::__construct($htmlSanitizer, $urlResolver, $styleRenderer);
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'user_auth';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Área de Login / Aluno';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '👤';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'navigation';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;
        $baseUrl = $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl();

        // 1. Detecção do Estado de Autenticação do Aluno (Isolado da Sessão Administrativa)
        $isLoggedIn = false;
        $userName = 'Aluno';

        $isExplicitlyLoggedOut = $this->session !== null && (bool)$this->session->get('academy_logged_out', false);

        if (!$isExplicitlyLoggedOut) {
            if (isset($context['is_logged_in'])) {
                $isLoggedIn = (bool)$context['is_logged_in'];
                $userName = (string)($context['user_name'] ?? 'Aluno');
            } elseif ($this->session !== null && $this->session->has('academy_student_id')) {
                $isLoggedIn = true;
                $userName = (string)($this->session->get('academy_student_name', 'Aluno'));
            }
        }

        // 2. Parâmetros e Rotas Personalizáveis com Resolução Dinâmica de Base URL
        $loginText = (string)($data['login_text'] ?? 'Entrar');
        $rawLoginUrl = (string)($data['login_url'] ?? '/aluno/login');
        $loginUrl = $this->urlResolver->resolve($rawLoginUrl);
        $loginUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($loginUrl, $this->urlResolver->resolve('/aluno/login'));

        $registerText = (string)($data['register_text'] ?? 'Cadastrar');
        $rawRegisterUrl = (string)($data['register_url'] ?? '/aluno/cadastro');
        $registerUrl = $this->urlResolver->resolve($rawRegisterUrl);
        $registerUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($registerUrl, $this->urlResolver->resolve('/aluno/cadastro'));

        $dashboardText = (string)($data['dashboard_text'] ?? '🎓 Área do Aluno');
        $rawDashboardUrl = (string)($data['dashboard_url'] ?? '/aluno/painel');
        $dashboardUrl = $this->urlResolver->resolve($rawDashboardUrl);
        $dashboardUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($dashboardUrl, $this->urlResolver->resolve('/aluno/painel'));

        $logoutText = (string)($data['logout_text'] ?? 'Sair');
        $rawLogoutUrl = (string)($data['logout_url'] ?? '/aluno/logout');
        $logoutUrl = $this->urlResolver->resolve($rawLogoutUrl);
        $logoutUrl = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($logoutUrl, $this->urlResolver->resolve('/aluno/logout'));

        // 3. Alinhamento e Espaçamento
        $align = (string)($data['align'] ?? $data['text_align'] ?? 'right');
        $justify = match ($align) {
            'left'   => 'flex-start',
            'center' => 'center',
            default  => 'flex-end',
        };

        $safeLoginUrl = htmlspecialchars($loginUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeRegisterUrl = htmlspecialchars($registerUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeDashboardUrl = htmlspecialchars($dashboardUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeLogoutUrl = htmlspecialchars($logoutUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $safeLoginText = htmlspecialchars($loginText, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeRegisterText = htmlspecialchars($registerText, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeDashboardText = htmlspecialchars($dashboardText, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeLogoutText = htmlspecialchars($logoutText, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $absorbAttr = (($data['absorb_in_mobile'] ?? true) !== false) ? ' data-mobile-absorb="true"' : ' data-mobile-absorb="false"';

        // 4. Renderização do Estado Autenticado (Limpo, sem expor o nome do usuário/admin como sufixo)
        if ($isLoggedIn) {
            return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-user-auth"{$absorbAttr} style="display: flex; justify-content: {$justify}; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%;">
    <a href="{$safeDashboardUrl}" class="ds-auth-btn ds-auth-dashboard" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.35); color: #45f3ff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease;">
        <span>{$safeDashboardText}</span>
    </a>
    <a href="{$safeLogoutUrl}" class="ds-auth-btn ds-auth-logout" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); color: #cbd5e1; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease;">
        {$safeLogoutText}
    </a>
</div>
HTML;
        }

        // 5. Renderização do Estado Visitante / Deslogado
        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-user-auth"{$absorbAttr} style="display: flex; justify-content: {$justify}; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%;">
    <a href="{$safeLoginUrl}" class="ds-auth-btn ds-auth-login" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: #f8fafc; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.86rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease;">
        <span>🔑</span>
        <span>{$safeLoginText}</span>
    </a>
    <a href="{$safeRegisterUrl}" class="ds-auth-btn ds-auth-register" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 7px 15px; border-radius: 6px; background: #00d284; border: 1px solid #00d284; color: #0b0c10; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.86rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.2);">
        <span>✨</span>
        <span>{$safeRegisterText}</span>
    </a>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'user_auth',
            'fields' => [
                'login_text'     => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto do Botão Login', 'default' => 'Entrar'],
                'login_url'      => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'URL de Login', 'default' => '/aluno/login'],
                'register_text'  => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto do Botão Cadastrar', 'default' => 'Cadastrar'],
                'register_url'   => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'URL de Cadastro', 'default' => '/aluno/cadastro'],
                'dashboard_text' => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto da Área do Aluno', 'default' => '🎓 Área do Aluno'],
                'dashboard_url'  => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'URL do Painel do Aluno', 'default' => '/aluno/painel'],
                'logout_text'    => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto de Logout', 'default' => 'Sair'],
                'logout_url'     => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'URL de Logout', 'default' => '/aluno/logout'],
                'align'          => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'right'],
                'absorb_in_mobile' => ['type' => 'boolean', 'label' => 'Incluir no Menu Hambúrguer (Mobile)', 'default' => true],
            ],
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Blocks/VideoBlock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;

/**
 * Bloco de Vídeo Responsivo (YouTube, Vimeo, MP4 com modo cinema).
 */
class VideoBlock implements BlockInterface
{
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;

    public function __construct(
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    public function getAllowedPartTypes(): array
    {
        return [
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION,
        ];
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'video';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Vídeo';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🎥';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'media';
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $rawUrl = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['url_tablet'] ?? $data['url_mobile'] ?? ''));
        if ($rawUrl === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Se o usuário colou um iframe completo <iframe ... src="..." ...>, extrai o atributo src
        if (preg_match('#<iframe[^>]+src=["\']([^"\']+)["\']#i', $rawUrl, $matches)) {
            $rawUrl = trim($matches[1]);
        }

        $url = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($rawUrl, '');
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $aspectRatio = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['aspect_ratio'] ?? '16/9'));
        $borderRadius = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($data['border_radius'] ?? '10px'));

        $embedUrl = $this->resolveEmbedUrl($url);

        if ($embedUrl !== null) {
            $safeEmbed = htmlspecialchars($embedUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-video" style="width: 100%; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: {$aspectRatio}; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
    <iframe src="{$safeEmbed}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none;" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
HTML;
        }

        // Caso seja MP4, WebM ou arquivo de vídeo direto
        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        return <<<HTML
<div class="ds-block-video" style="width: 100%; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: {$borderRadius}; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: {$aspectRatio}; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
    <video src="{$safeUrl}" controls preload="metadata" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;"></video>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    private function resolveEmbedUrl(string $url): ?string
    {
        // 1. YouTube Shorts, Live, Embed ou v/
        if (preg_match('#(?:youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com/(?:embed/|v/|shorts/|live/)|youtu\.be/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{6,15})#i', $url, $m)) {
            return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $m[1];
        }

        // 2. YouTube watch?v=... (com query parameters arbitrários, ex: watch?feature=share&v=...)
        if (preg_match('#youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com/watch#i', $url)) {
            $queryString = parse_url($url, PHP_URL_QUERY);
            if ($queryString) {
                parse_str($queryString, $queryParams);
                if (!empty($queryParams['v']) && is_string($queryParams['v'])) {
                    $cleanId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $queryParams['v']);
                    if ($cleanId !== '') {
                        return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $cleanId;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Vimeo: vimeo.com/123456789, player.vimeo.com/video/123456789, canais, grupos
        if (preg_match('#vimeo(?:\.com/video/|\.com/channels/(?:\w+/)?|\.com/groups/[^/]+/videos/|\.com/|player\.vimeo\.com/video/)([0-9]+)#i', $url, $m)) {
            return 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' . $m[1];
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'video',
            'fields' => [
                'url'           => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'URL do Vídeo (YouTube, Vimeo ou MP4)', 'default' => ''],
                'aspect_ratio'  => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Proporção', 'options' => ['16/9', '4/3', '1/1'], 'default' => '16/9'],
                'border_radius' => ['type' => 'dimension', 'label' => 'Arredondamento', 'units' => ['px', 'rem'], 'default' => '10px'],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Registro e Gerenciador de Blocos do Motor Visual.
 */
interface BlockRegistryInterface
{
    /**
     * Registra um novo bloco no motor.
     */
    public function register(BlockInterface $block): void;

    /**
     * Retorna a instância de um bloco pelo seu tipo único.
     */
    public function get(string $type): ?BlockInterface;

    /**
     * Verifica se um tipo de bloco já está registrado.
     */
    public function has(string $type): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna todos os blocos registrados.
     * @return array<string, BlockInterface>
     */
    public function all(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna todos os blocos agrupados por categoria.
     * @return array<string, array<string, BlockInterface>>
     */
    public function allByCategory(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna apenas os blocos permitidos para o tipo de parte estrutural informada ('header', 'footer', 'section').
     * @return array<string, BlockInterface>
     */
    public function allForPartType(string $partType): array;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/ElementStyleRendererInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato para renderização e higienização de estilos CSS e classes responsivas de elementos (SOLID - SRP / ISP).
 */
interface ElementStyleRendererInterface
{
    /**
     * Gera a string de atributos de estilo CSS (ex: "margin: 10px; padding: 5px;")
     * a partir de um array de propriedades de dados do bloco.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function renderStyleString(array $data): string;

    /**
     * Higieniza um valor individual de propriedade CSS contra injeção de sintaxe ou URLs maliciosas.
     */
    public function sanitizeCssValue(string $value): string;

    /**
     * Retorna as classes CSS utilitárias de visibilidade responsiva (.ds-hide-desktop, .ds-hide-tablet, .ds-hide-mobile).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function getResponsiveVisibilityClasses(array $data): string;

    /**
     * Decompõe uma string de espaçamento nos 4 lados (superior, direita, inferior, esquerda).
     *
     * @return array{top: string, right: string, bottom: string, left: string}
     */
    public function parse4Sides(string $spacing): array;

    /**
     * Gera regras CSS em bloco com Media Queries responsivas por resolução (tablet, mobile, laptop)
     * para overrides específicos de elementos (font-size, text-align, padding, margin, width, etc.).
     *
     * @param string $elementSelector Seletor CSS do elemento (ex: "#ds-elem-123")
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data Dados do elemento contendo eventuais chaves responsivas (*_tablet, *_mobile, etc.)
     */
    public function renderResponsiveStyles(string $elementSelector, array $data): string;
}

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de Sanitização Segura de HTML inline para blocos tipográficos (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 */
interface HtmlSanitizerInterface
{
    /**
     * Sanitiza HTML inline preservando apenas tags seguras permitidas e removendo
     * vetores XSS (atributos de evento on*, javascript:, data:, style malicioso).
     */
    public function sanitizeInlineHtml(string $html): string;

    /**
     * Valida e higieniza uma URL contra protocolos maliciosos (javascript:, vbscript:, data:).
     * Retorna o fallback seguro se a URL contiver um esquema proibido.
     */
    public function sanitizeUrl(string $url, string $fallback = '#'): string;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/Icons/SvgIconRegistryInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Icons;

/**
 * Contrato para o Catálogo e Registro de Ícones Vetoriais SVG (SOLID - OCP / Ring 0).
 * 
 * Permite renderizar vetores SVG puros inline com personalização de cores,
 * atributos e estilos, sem dependência de bibliotecas externas de fontes (FontAwesome, etc.).
 */
interface SvgIconRegistryInterface
{
    /**
     * Registra uma nova definição vetorial no catálogo.
     *
     * @param string $name Identificador do ícone (ex: 'whatsapp', 'instagram')
     * @param string $viewBox Dimensões do viewBox (ex: '0 0 24 24')
     * @param string $pathData Conteúdo interno do SVG (<path d="..."/>)
     * @param string|null $brandColor Cor hexadecimal oficial da marca (ex: '#25D366')
     * @param string|null $label Rótulo legível (ex: 'WhatsApp')
     */
    public function register(
        string $name,
        string $viewBox,
        string $pathData,
        ?string $brandColor = null,
        ?string $label = null
    ): void;

    /**
     * Renderiza o markup completo da tag <svg> para o ícone solicitado.
     *
     * @param string $name Nome do ícone registrado
     * @param array<string, string> $attributes Atributos HTML extras (width, height, fill, class, style)
     * @return string|null Retorna a tag <svg> compilada ou null se o ícone não existir
     */
    public function getSvg(string $name, array $attributes = []): ?string;

    /**
     * Retorna a cor oficial da marca associada ao ícone (se houver).
     */
    public function getBrandColor(string $name): ?string;

    /**
     * Retorna o rótulo legível do ícone.
     */
    public function getLabel(string $name): ?string;

    /**
     * Verifica se o ícone está registrado.
     */
    public function has(string $name): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna todos os dados brutos registrados.
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function all(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna lista associativa simplificada [ 'name' => 'Label' ] para seletores de UI.
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getAvailableIcons(): array;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/LayerTreeInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de Hierarquia e Árvore de Camadas (Layers / Navigator).
 * 
 * Permite extrair e manipular a estrutura em árvore de qualquer ThemePartInterface
 * para alimentar a interface do construtor visual (Elementor Navigator),
 * auditorias de acessibilidade e renderização de layouts hierárquicos.
 */
interface LayerTreeInterface
{
    /**
     * Limites de seções verticais por tipo de parte.
     */
    public const MAX_SECTIONS_HEADER = 3;
    public const MAX_SECTIONS_FOOTER = 3;
    public const MAX_SECTIONS_DEFAULT = 12;

    /**
     * Constrói a árvore hierárquica completa da parte do tema.
     *
     * @param ThemePartInterface $part
     * @return array<string, mixed> Estrutura em árvore padronizada contendo root, seções, colunas e blocos.
     */
    public function buildTree(ThemePartInterface $part): array;

    /**
     * Retorna a contagem total de nós na hierarquia (seções, colunas, blocos).
     *
     * @param ThemePartInterface $part
     * @return array{sections: int, columns: int, blocks: int}
     */
    public function getCounts(ThemePartInterface $part): array;

    /**
     * Valida se uma contagem de seções respeita o limite do tipo da parte.
     *
     * @param string $partType (header, footer, section)
     * @param int $sectionCount
     * @return bool
     */
    public function validateDepth(string $partType, int $sectionCount): bool;
}

    /** Nome legível para o usuário (ex: 'Grid de Cards / Blog (4 Colunas)') */

    public function getDesktopTemplate(): string;

    /** Template CSS Grid para Tablet (ex: 'repeat(2, 1fr)') */
    public function getTabletTemplate(): string;

    /** Template CSS Grid para Mobile (ex: '1fr') */
    public function getMobileTemplate(): string;

    /** Ícone representativo do preset */
    public function getIcon(): string;

    /** Serializa o preset em array para a API e Views */
    public function toArray(): array;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Contracts/ThemePartAssociationInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de Associação e Vínculo: Tema <-> Header / Footer / Seções de Template Ativos.
 */
interface ThemePartAssociationInterface
{
    /**
     * Retorna o ID da parte atribuída a um tema específico.
     * Retorna null se não houver parte customizada (acionando fallback nativo do tema).
     */
    public function getAssignedPartId(string $themeFolder, string $partType): ?string;

    /**
     * Associa uma parte (header, footer ou template:slug) a um tema específico.
     * Passar $partId = null remove o vínculo customizado (restaura fallback nativo).
     */
    public function assignPart(string $themeFolder, string $partType, ?string $partId): bool;

    /**
     * Define a parte padrão global do sistema para um determinado tipo.
     */
    public function setGlobalDefault(string $partType, ?string $partId): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna o ID da parte padrão global.
     */
    public function getGlobalDefault(string $partType): ?string;

    /**
     * Retorna o mapa completo de todas as atribuições registradas ('themes' e 'globals').
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getAllAssignments(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna as atribuições exclusivas de um tema específico ([partType => partId]).
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getThemeAssignments(string $themeFolder): array;

    /**
     * Retorna o slug do template (ex: 'home', 'sobre') ao qual uma seção está atribuída em um tema, ou null.
     */
    public function getAssignedTemplateForSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId): ?string;

    /**
     * Atribui exclusivamente uma seção a um template do tema (removendo vínculos anteriores da mesma seção).
     * Passar $templateSlug = null ou 'none' desvincula a seção de qualquer template no tema.
     */
    public function assignTemplateToSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId, ?string $templateSlug): bool;

    /**
     * Remove todas as referências e vínculos de uma parte excluída em todos os temas e padrões globais.
     */
    public function removePartReferences(string $partId): bool;
}

    public function compilePart(

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de Parte Estrutural de Tema (Header, Footer, Seção ou Template Part).
 * Compõe LayoutContainerInterface, SectionedPartInterface e MobileToggleAwareInterface (SOLID - ISP).
 */
interface ThemePartInterface extends LayoutContainerInterface, SectionedPartInterface, MobileToggleAwareInterface
{
    public const TYPE_HEADER  = 'header';
    public const TYPE_FOOTER  = 'footer';
    public const TYPE_SECTION = 'section';

    /** Identificador único (slug ou hash) */
    public function getId(): string;

    /** Tipo da parte: 'header', 'footer' ou 'section' */
    public function getType(): string;

    /** Título ou nome de exibição da parte */
    public function getTitle(): string;

    /** Se é a parte padrão de fallback global */
    public function isDefault(): bool;

    public function getCreatedAt(): int;

    public function getUpdatedAt(): int;

    /** Serializa a parte para array compatível com JSON */
    public function toArray(): array;
}

/**
 * Orquestrador de Renderização de Partes com Garantia de Fallback Gracioso.

interface ThemePartRendererInterface extends ThemePartCompilerInterface
{

     * Renderiza o Header ativo do tema.
     * Se houver parte dinâmica configurada, compila os blocos com o motor de grade.
     * Caso contrário, faz fallback seguro para o arquivo partials/header.php do tema.
     */
    public function renderHeader(string $themeFolder, array $context = []): string;

    /**
     * Renderiza o Footer ativo do tema com mesma garantia de fallback.
     */
    public function renderFooter(string $themeFolder, array $context = []): string;

     * Renderiza uma seção ou bloco central específico.
     */
    public function renderSection(string $sectionId, array $context = []): string;

    /**
     * Renderiza a seção customizada atribuída diretamente a um template (ex: home, sobre, blog).
     * Retorna string vazia caso não haja seção atribuída ao template.
     */
    public function renderTemplateSection(string $themeFolder, string $templateName, array $context = []): string;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Grid/LayoutGridRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;

/**
 * Motor de Renderização de Grade e Divisórias (CSS Grid / Flexbox) (SOLID - OCP / DIP).
 * 
 * Totalmente extensível via LayoutPresetRegistryInterface: novos layouts podem ser adicionados
 * por plugins ou código de temas sem alterar o motor interno (Open-Closed Principle).
 */
class LayoutGridRenderer implements LayoutGridInterface
{
    private LayoutPresetRegistryInterface $presetRegistry;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        ?LayoutPresetRegistryInterface $presetRegistry = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->presetRegistry = $presetRegistry ?? DefaultLayoutPresetsFactory::create();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function getPresetRegistry(): LayoutPresetRegistryInterface
    {
        return $this->presetRegistry;
    }

    public function getPresets(): array
    {
        return $this->presetRegistry->allAsArray();
    }

    public function renderSection(string $preset, array $columnsHtml, array $settings = []): string
    {
        $presetObj = $this->presetRegistry->get($preset) ?? $this->presetRegistry->get('1_col');
        $presetConfig = $presetObj !== null ? $presetObj->toArray() : [
            'columns'  => 1,
            'template' => '1fr',
            'tablet'   => '1fr',
            'mobile'   => '1fr',
        ];

        $sectionId = 'ds_sec_' . substr(md5(uniqid((string)mt_rand(), true)), 0, 8);

        $isBoxed = (bool)($settings['boxed'] ?? true);
        $maxWidth = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['max_width'] ?? '1280px'));
        if ($maxWidth === '') {
            $maxWidth = '1280px';
        }

        $rawGap = (string)($settings['gap'] ?? '24px');
        $mappedGap = match ($rawGap) {
            'none'   => '0px',
            'small'  => '12px',
            'medium' => '24px',
            'large'  => '40px',
            default  => $rawGap !== '' ? $rawGap : '24px',
        };
        $gap = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue($mappedGap);
        if ($gap === '') {
            $gap = '24px';
        }

        $alignItems = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['align_items'] ?? 'center'));
        if ($alignItems === '') {
            $alignItems = 'center';
        }

        $justifyContent = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['justify_content'] ?? 'space-between'));
        if ($justifyContent === '') {
            $justifyContent = 'space-between';
        }

        $padding = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['padding'] ?? '20px 16px'));
        if ($padding === '') {
            $padding = '20px 16px';
        }

        $margin = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['margin'] ?? '0px'));
        if ($margin === '') {
            $margin = '0px';
        }

        $background = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)($settings['background'] ?? 'transparent'));
        if ($background === '') {
            $background = 'transparent';
        }

        $customClass = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\s]/', '', (string)($settings['custom_class'] ?? '')) ?? '';
        $combinedClasses = trim("ds-section-wrapper {$customClass}");

        // Estilos Visuais Avançados da Seção (Bordas, Sombras, Opacidade)
        $borderVal = !empty($settings['border']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['border']) : '';
        $borderRadiusVal = !empty($settings['border_radius']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['border_radius']) : '';
        $boxShadowVal = !empty($settings['box_shadow']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['box_shadow']) : '';
        $opacityVal = (isset($settings['opacity']) && (string)$settings['opacity'] !== '' && (string)$settings['opacity'] !== '1')
            ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['opacity'])
            : '';

        $border = $borderVal !== '' ? "border: {$borderVal};" : '';
        $borderRadius = $borderRadiusVal !== '' ? "border-radius: {$borderRadiusVal};" : '';
        $boxShadow = $boxShadowVal !== '' ? "box-shadow: {$boxShadowVal};" : '';
        $opacity = $opacityVal !== '' ? "opacity: {$opacityVal};" : '';

        $extraStyles = array_filter([$border, $borderRadius, $boxShadow, $opacity]);

        // Cores Tipográficas & Formatação de Texto da Seção / Container (Cascading via Contrato)
        $rawTextColor = (string)($settings['text_color'] ?? $settings['color'] ?? '');
        $secTextColor = $rawTextColor !== '' ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue($rawTextColor) : '';
        $secHeadingColor = !empty($settings['heading_color']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['heading_color']) : '';
        $secLinkColor = !empty($settings['link_color']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['link_color']) : '';
        $secLinkHoverColor = !empty($settings['link_hover_color']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['link_hover_color']) : '';
        $secFontFamily = !empty($settings['font_family']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['font_family']) : '';
        $secFontSize = !empty($settings['font_size']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['font_size']) : '';
        $secFontWeight = !empty($settings['font_weight']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['font_weight']) : '';
        $secLineHeight = !empty($settings['line_height']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['line_height']) : '';
        $secLetterSpacing = !empty($settings['letter_spacing']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['letter_spacing']) : '';
        $secTextTransform = !empty($settings['text_transform']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['text_transform']) : '';
        $secTextAlign = !empty($settings['text_align']) ? $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$settings['text_align']) : '';

        if ($secTextColor !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "color: {$secTextColor};";
            $extraStyles[] = "--ds-local-text-color: {$secTextColor};";
        }
        if ($secHeadingColor !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "--ds-local-heading-color: {$secHeadingColor};";
        }
        if ($secLinkColor !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "--ds-local-link-color: {$secLinkColor};";
        }
        if ($secLinkHoverColor !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "--ds-local-link-hover-color: {$secLinkHoverColor};";
        }
        if ($secFontFamily !== '') {
            $resolvedSecFont = match ($secFontFamily) {
                'primary'   => 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)',
                'secondary' => 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)',
                'tertiary'  => 'var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)',
                default     => $secFontFamily,
            };
            $extraStyles[] = "font-family: {$resolvedSecFont};";
        }
        if ($secFontSize !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "font-size: {$secFontSize};";
        }
        if ($secFontWeight !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "font-weight: {$secFontWeight};";
        }
        if ($secLineHeight !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "line-height: {$secLineHeight};";
        }
        if ($secLetterSpacing !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "letter-spacing: {$secLetterSpacing};";
        }
        if ($secTextTransform !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "text-transform: {$secTextTransform};";
        }
        if ($secTextAlign !== '') {
            $extraStyles[] = "text-align: {$secTextAlign};";
        }

        $extraStylesStr = !empty($extraStyles) ? ' ' . implode(' ', $extraStyles) : '';

        $secCascadingCss = '';
        if ($secHeadingColor !== '') {
            $secCascadingCss .= "\n        #{$sectionId} h1, #{$sectionId} h2, #{$sectionId} h3, #{$sectionId} h4, #{$sectionId} h5, #{$sectionId} h6, #{$sectionId} .ds-block-heading, #{$sectionId} .ds-logo-text, #{$sectionId} .ds-card-title a { color: {$secHeadingColor}; }";
        }
        if ($secTextColor !== '') {
            $secCascadingCss .= "\n        #{$sectionId} p, #{$sectionId} .ds-block-paragraph, #{$sectionId} .ds-block-copyright, #{$sectionId} .ds-card-excerpt { color: {$secTextColor}; }";
        }
        if ($secLinkColor !== '') {
            $secCascadingCss .= "\n        #{$sectionId} a:not(.ds-block-btn):not(.ds-block-cta), #{$sectionId} .ds-nav-link, #{$sectionId} .ds-card-readmore { color: {$secLinkColor}; }";
        }
        if ($secLinkHoverColor !== '') {
            $secCascadingCss .= "\n        #{$sectionId} a:not(.ds-block-btn):not(.ds-block-cta):hover, #{$sectionId} .ds-nav-link:hover, #{$sectionId} .ds-card-readmore:hover { color: {$secLinkHoverColor} !important; }";
        }

        $baseDesktopTemplate = $presetConfig['template'];
        $baseTabletTemplate = $presetConfig['tablet'];
        $baseMobileTemplate = $presetConfig['mobile'];

        $numCols = (int)$presetConfig['columns'];
        $colHiddenMap = is_array($settings['_col_hidden'] ?? null) ? $settings['_col_hidden'] : [];

        $gridTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseDesktopTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'desktop');
        $laptopTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseDesktopTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'laptop');
        $tabletTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseTabletTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'tablet');
        $mobileTemplate = $this->resolveResponsiveGridTemplate($baseMobileTemplate, $numCols, $colHiddenMap, 'mobile');

        $colsOutput = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $numCols; $i++) {
            $colContent = $columnsHtml[$i] ?? '';
            $colVisClasses = [];
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['desktop'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-desktop';
            }
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['laptop'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-laptop';
            }
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['tablet'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-tablet';
            }
            if (!empty($colHiddenMap[$i]['mobile'])) {
                $colVisClasses[] = 'ds-hide-mobile';
            }
            $colClassStr = trim("ds-grid-col ds-grid-col-{$i} " . implode(' ', $colVisClasses));
            $colsOutput[] = "<div class=\"{$colClassStr}\">{$colContent}</div>";
        }
        $innerHtml = implode("\n", $colsOutput);

        $containerStyle = $isBoxed
            ? "max-width: {$maxWidth}; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; width: 100%;"
            : "width: 100%;";

        return <<<HTML
<div id="{$sectionId}" class="{$combinedClasses}" style="background: {$background}; width: 100%; margin: {$margin};{$extraStylesStr}">
    <style>
        #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: {$gridTemplate};
            gap: {$gap};
            align-items: {$alignItems};
            justify-content: {$justifyContent};
            box-sizing: border-box;
            padding: {$padding};
            {$containerStyle}
        }
        #{$sectionId} .ds-grid-col {
            min-width: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: {$alignItems};
            height: 100%;
        }{$secCascadingCss}
        @media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
                grid-template-columns: {$laptopTemplate} !important;
            }
        }
        @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 768px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
                grid-template-columns: {$tabletTemplate} !important;
                gap: 16px !important;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            body:not(.ds-live-preview) #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
                grid-template-columns: {$mobileTemplate} !important;
                gap: 12px !important;
                padding-left: 12px !important;
                padding-right: 12px !important;
            }
        }
        .ds-laptop-mode #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-is-laptop #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-device-1024 #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            grid-template-columns: {$laptopTemplate} !important;
        }
        .ds-tablet-mode #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-is-tablet #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-device-768 #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            grid-template-columns: {$tabletTemplate} !important;
            gap: 16px !important;
        }
        .ds-mobile-mode #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-is-mobile #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid,
        .ds-device-375 #{$sectionId} .ds-section-grid {
            grid-template-columns: {$mobileTemplate} !important;
            gap: 12px !important;
            padding-left: 12px !important;
            padding-right: 12px !important;
        }
    </style>
    <div class="ds-section-grid">
        {$innerHtml}
    </div>
</div>
HTML;
    }

    /**
     * Reajusta dinamicamente as colunas do CSS Grid quando todos os elementos de uma ou mais colunas
     * estão ocultos na resolução alvo, redistribuindo 100% da largura entre as colunas visíveis restantes.
     *
     * @param array<int, array<string, bool>> $colHiddenMap
     */
    private function resolveResponsiveGridTemplate(
        string $baseTemplate,
        int $numCols,
        array $colHiddenMap,
        string $resolution
    ): string {
        if ($numCols <= 1 || empty($colHiddenMap)) {
            return $baseTemplate;
        }

        $visibleIndices = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $numCols; $i++) {
            if (empty($colHiddenMap[$i][$resolution])) {
                $visibleIndices[] = $i;
            }
        }

        $visibleCount = count($visibleIndices);
        if ($visibleCount === $numCols || $visibleCount === 0) {
            return $baseTemplate;
        }

        if ($visibleCount === 1) {
            return '1fr';
        }

        $tracks = $this->parseGridTracks($baseTemplate);
        if (count($tracks) === $numCols) {
            $remainingTracks = [];
            foreach ($visibleIndices as $idx) {
                $remainingTracks[] = $tracks[$idx];
            }
            return implode(' ', $remainingTracks);
        }

        return $baseTemplate;
    }

    /**
     * Divide um template CSS Grid em suas tracks individuais (suportando repeat() e funções como minmax()).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function parseGridTracks(string $template): array
    {
        $trimmed = trim($template);
        if (preg_match('/^repeat\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(.+)\)$/i', $trimmed, $m)) {
            $count = max(1, (int)$m[1]);
            return array_fill(0, $count, trim($m[2]));
        }

        $tracks = [];
        $current = '';
        $depth = 0;
        $len = strlen($trimmed);

        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $ch = $trimmed[$i];
            if ($ch === '(') {
                $depth++;
                $current .= $ch;
            } elseif ($ch === ')') {
                $depth = max(0, $depth - 1);
                $current .= $ch;
            } elseif (ctype_space($ch) && $depth === 0) {
                if ($current !== '') {
                    $tracks[] = $current;
                    $current = '';
                }
            } else {
                $current .= $ch;
            }
        }

        if ($current !== '') {
            $tracks[] = $current;
        }

        return $tracks;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Grid/LayoutPresetRegistry.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Layout\LayoutPresetRegistryInterface;

/**
 * Registro dinâmico de Presets de Grade e Layout (SOLID - OCP).
 */
class LayoutPresetRegistry implements LayoutPresetRegistryInterface
{
    /** @var array<string, LayoutPresetInterface> */
    private array $presets = [];

    public function register(LayoutPresetInterface $preset): void
    {
        $this->presets[$preset->getId()] = $preset;
    }

    public function get(string $id): ?LayoutPresetInterface
    {
        return $this->presets[$id] ?? null;
    }

    public function has(string $id): bool
    {
        return isset($this->presets[$id]);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->presets;
    }

    public function allAsArray(): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($this->presets as $id => $preset) {
            $result[$id] = $preset->toArray();
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public function allByCategory(): array
    {
        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($this->presets as $preset) {
            $cat = $preset->getCategory();
            if (!isset($grouped[$cat])) {
                $grouped[$cat] = [];
            }
            $grouped[$cat][] = $preset;
        }
        return $grouped;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Icons/SvgIconRegistry.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Icons;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Icons\SvgIconRegistryInterface;

/**
 * Registro e Compilador de Ícones Vetoriais SVG Nativos (SOLID - SRP / OCP).
 */
class SvgIconRegistry implements SvgIconRegistryInterface
{
    /** @var array<string, array<string, mixed>> */
    private array $icons = [];

    public function register(
        string $name,
        string $viewBox,
        string $pathData,
        ?string $brandColor = null,
        ?string $label = null
    ): void {
        $cleanName = strtolower(trim($name));
        $this->icons[$cleanName] = [
            'name'       => $cleanName,
            'viewBox'    => trim($viewBox),
            'path'       => trim($pathData),
            'brandColor' => $brandColor !== null ? trim($brandColor) : null,
            'label'      => $label !== null ? trim($label) : ucfirst($cleanName),
        ];
    }

    public function getSvg(string $name, array $attributes = []): ?string
    {
        $cleanName = strtolower(trim($name));
        $def = $this->icons[$cleanName] ?? null;
        if ($def === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $viewBox = htmlspecialchars($def['viewBox'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $width = $attributes['width'] ?? '24';
        $height = $attributes['height'] ?? '24';
        $fill = $attributes['fill'] ?? 'currentColor';

        $attrs = [
            'xmlns'       => 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',
            'viewBox'     => $viewBox,
            'width'       => $width,
            'height'      => $height,
            'fill'        => $fill,
            'aria-hidden' => 'true',
            'focusable'   => 'false',
        ];

        // Mescla atributos adicionais
        foreach ($attributes as $k => $v) {
            if (!in_array($k, ['width', 'height', 'fill', 'xmlns', 'viewBox'], true)) {
                $attrs[$k] = $v;
            }
        }

        $compiledAttrs = [];
        foreach ($attrs as $attrKey => $attrVal) {
            $safeKey = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '', $attrKey) ?? '';
            $safeVal = htmlspecialchars((string)$attrVal, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $compiledAttrs[] = "{$safeKey}=\"{$safeVal}\"";
        }
        $attrsStr = implode(' ', $compiledAttrs);

        return "<svg {$attrsStr}>{$def['path']}</svg>";
    }

    public function getBrandColor(string $name): ?string
    {
        $cleanName = strtolower(trim($name));
        return $this->icons[$cleanName]['brandColor'] ?? null;
    }

    public function getLabel(string $name): ?string
    {
        $cleanName = strtolower(trim($name));
        return $this->icons[$cleanName]['label'] ?? null;
    }

    public function has(string $name): bool
    {
        $cleanName = strtolower(trim($name));
        return isset($this->icons[$cleanName]);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->icons;
    }

    public function getAvailableIcons(): array
    {
        $list = [];
        foreach ($this->icons as $k => $v) {
            $list[$k] = $v['label'];
        }
        return $list;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Models/DesignTokens.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\DesignTokensInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;

/**
 * Gestão Centralizada de Design Tokens Globais (Paleta de Cores e Tipografia).
 */
class DesignTokens implements DesignTokensInterface
{
    private string $storagePath;
    private array $palette;
    private array $typography;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    private const DEFAULT_PALETTE = [
        'primary'    => '#45f3ff',
        'secondary'  => '#1f2833',
        'tertiary'   => '#60a5fa',
        'background' => '#0b0c10',
        'surface'    => 'rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.7)',
        'text_main'  => '#c5c6c7',
        'text_muted' => '#8b8c8d',
        'border'     => 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
    ];

    private const DEFAULT_TYPOGRAPHY = [
        'primary_font'   => 'Inter, sans-serif',
        'secondary_font' => 'Fira Code, monospace',
        'tertiary_font'  => 'Montserrat, sans-serif',
        'base_size'      => '16px',
        'heading_weight' => '800',
        'body_weight'    => '400',
    ];

    public function __construct(?string $storagePath = null, ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null)
    {
        $this->storagePath = $storagePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config/design_tokens.json' : __DIR__ . '/../../../../../config/design_tokens.json');
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->load();
    }

    private function load(): void
    {
        $this->palette = self::DEFAULT_PALETTE;
        $this->typography = self::DEFAULT_TYPOGRAPHY;

        if (file_exists($this->storagePath)) {
            $raw = @file_get_contents($this->storagePath);
            if ($raw !== false) {
                $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    if (isset($decoded['palette']) && is_array($decoded['palette'])) {
                        $this->palette = array_merge(self::DEFAULT_PALETTE, $decoded['palette']);
                    }
                    if (isset($decoded['typography']) && is_array($decoded['typography'])) {
                        $this->typography = array_merge(self::DEFAULT_TYPOGRAPHY, $decoded['typography']);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function getColorPalette(): array
    {
        return $this->palette;
    }

    public function getTypography(): array
    {
        return $this->typography;
    }

    public function generateCssVariables(?string $scope = null): string
    {
        $rootVars = [];
        $scopedVars = [];

        foreach ($this->palette as $key => $rawVal) {
            $cssKey = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/', '', str_replace('_', '-', (string)$key)) ?: 'token';
            $val = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$rawVal);
            $rootVars[] = "    --ds-color-{$cssKey}: {$val};";
            $scopedVars[] = "    --color-{$cssKey}: {$val};";
            $scopedVars[] = "    --{$cssKey}: {$val};";
            if ($key === 'primary') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-primary: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'secondary') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-secondary: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'tertiary') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-tertiary: {$val};";
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-color-accent: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --color-accent: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --accent: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'background') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-bg-color: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --bg-color: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'surface') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-surface: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'text_main') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-text-main: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --text_main: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'text_muted') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-text-muted: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --text_muted: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'border') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-border: {$val};";
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->typography as $key => $rawVal) {
            $cssKey = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/', '', str_replace('_', '-', (string)$key)) ?: 'font';
            $val = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$rawVal);
            $rootVars[] = "    --ds-font-{$cssKey}: {$val};";
            $scopedVars[] = "    --font-{$cssKey}: {$val};";
            if ($key === 'primary_font') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-font-primary: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --font-primary: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'secondary_font') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-font-secondary: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --font-secondary: {$val};";
            }
            if ($key === 'tertiary_font') {
                $rootVars[] = "    --ds-font-tertiary: {$val};";
                $scopedVars[] = "    --font-tertiary: {$val};";
            }
        }

        $rawScope = $scope ?? '.ds-part-wrapper, .ds-section-wrapper';
        $targetScope = preg_replace('/[{};<>]/', '', $rawScope) ?: '.ds-part-wrapper, .ds-section-wrapper';

        return ":root {\n" . implode("\n", $rootVars) . "\n}\n\n" .
               "{$targetScope} {\n" . implode("\n", $scopedVars) . "\n}";
    }

    public function updateTokens(array $tokens): bool
    {
        if (isset($tokens['palette']) && is_array($tokens['palette'])) {
            foreach ($tokens['palette'] as $k => $v) {
                $this->palette[(string)$k] = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$v);
            }
        }
        if (isset($tokens['typography']) && is_array($tokens['typography'])) {
            foreach ($tokens['typography'] as $k => $v) {
                $this->typography[(string)$k] = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$v);
            }
        }

        $dir = dirname($this->storagePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        $payload = [
            'palette'    => $this->palette,
            'typography' => $this->typography,
            'updated_at' => time(),
        ];

        $json = json_encode($payload, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($json === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $tmpPath = $this->storagePath . '.' . uniqid('tmp_', true) . '.tmp';
        if (@file_put_contents($tmpPath, $json, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!@rename($tmpPath, $this->storagePath)) {
            $copied = @copy($tmpPath, $this->storagePath);
            @unlink($tmpPath);
            return $copied;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
