// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Models/ThemePart.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Modelo de Dados Imutável de uma Parte Estrutural de Tema.
 */
class ThemePart implements ThemePartInterface
{
    private string $id;
    private string $type;
    private string $title;
    private string $layoutPreset;
    private array $containerSettings;
    private array $columnsData;
    private array $sections;
    private string $mobileToggleStyle;
    private string $mobileToggleAlign;
    private bool $isDefault;
    private int $createdAt;
    private int $updatedAt;

    public function __construct(
        string $id,
        string $type,
        string $title,
        string $layoutPreset = '1_col',
        array $containerSettings = [],
        array $columnsData = [],
        string $mobileToggleStyle = MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC,
        bool $isDefault = false,
        ?int $createdAt = null,
        ?int $updatedAt = null,
        array $sections = [],
        string $mobileToggleAlign = 'right'
    ) {
        $cleanId = trim($id);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O ID da parte de tema não pode ser vazio.");
        }

        $validTypes = [self::TYPE_HEADER, self::TYPE_FOOTER, self::TYPE_SECTION];
        if (!in_array($type, $validTypes, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo de parte de tema inválido: '{$type}'.");
        }

        $this->id = $cleanId;
        $this->type = $type;
        $this->title = trim($title) !== '' ? trim($title) : 'Parte Sem Título';
        $this->layoutPreset = $layoutPreset;
        $this->containerSettings = $containerSettings;
        $this->columnsData = $columnsData;

        // Se seções forem fornecidas, armazena; caso contrário, sintetiza uma seção padrão retrocompatível
        if (!empty($sections)) {
            $firstKey = array_key_first($sections);
            if ($firstKey !== null && is_array($sections[$firstKey])) {
                if (!isset($sections[$firstKey]['layout_preset']) || $sections[$firstKey]['layout_preset'] === '') {
                    $sections[$firstKey]['layout_preset'] = $this->layoutPreset;
                }
                if ($this->layoutPreset === '1_col' && !empty($sections[$firstKey]['layout_preset'])) {
                    $this->layoutPreset = (string)$sections[$firstKey]['layout_preset'];
                }
                if (empty($this->containerSettings) && !empty($sections[$firstKey]['container_settings'])) {
                    $this->containerSettings = (array)$sections[$firstKey]['container_settings'];
                }
                if (empty($this->columnsData) && !empty($sections[$firstKey]['columns_data'])) {
                    $this->columnsData = (array)$sections[$firstKey]['columns_data'];
                }
            }
            $this->sections = $sections;
        } else {
            $this->sections = [
                [
                    'id'                 => 'sec_' . substr(md5($cleanId . '_default'), 0, 8),
                    'title'              => 'Seção 1',
                    'layout_preset'      => $this->layoutPreset,
                    'container_settings' => $this->containerSettings,
                    'columns_data'       => $this->columnsData,
                ]
            ];
        }

        $this->mobileToggleStyle = in_array($mobileToggleStyle, MobileToggleStyleInterface::ALL_TOGGLE_STYLES, true)
            ? $mobileToggleStyle
            : MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC;
        $this->mobileToggleAlign = in_array($mobileToggleAlign, ['left', 'center', 'right'], true) ? $mobileToggleAlign : 'right';
        $this->isDefault = $isDefault;
        $this->createdAt = $createdAt ?? time();
        $this->updatedAt = $updatedAt ?? time();
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return $this->id;
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return $this->type;
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return $this->title;
    }

    public function getLayoutPreset(): string
    {
        return $this->layoutPreset;
    }

    public function getContainerSettings(): array
    {
        return $this->containerSettings;
    }

    public function getColumnsData(): array
    {
        return $this->columnsData;
    }

    public function getMobileToggleStyle(): string
    {
        return $this->mobileToggleStyle;
    }

    public function getMobileToggleAlign(): string
    {
        return $this->mobileToggleAlign;
    }

    public function isDefault(): bool
    {
        return $this->isDefault;
    }

    public function getCreatedAt(): int
    {
        return $this->createdAt;
    }

    public function getUpdatedAt(): int
    {
        return $this->updatedAt;
    }

    public function getSections(): array
    {
        return $this->sections;
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'id'                  => $this->id,
            'type'                => $this->type,
            'title'               => $this->title,
            'layout_preset'       => $this->layoutPreset,
            'container_settings'  => $this->containerSettings,
            'columns_data'        => $this->columnsData,
            'sections'            => $this->sections,
            'mobile_toggle_style' => $this->mobileToggleStyle,
            'mobile_toggle_align' => $this->mobileToggleAlign,
            'is_default'          => $this->isDefault,
            'created_at'          => $this->createdAt,
            'updated_at'          => $this->updatedAt,
        ];
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            (string)($data['id'] ?? uniqid('part_', true)),
            (string)($data['type'] ?? self::TYPE_HEADER),
            (string)($data['title'] ?? 'Sem Título'),
            (string)($data['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col'),
            (array)($data['container_settings'] ?? []),
            (array)($data['columns_data'] ?? []),
            (string)($data['mobile_toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC),
            (bool)($data['is_default'] ?? false),
            isset($data['created_at']) ? (int)$data['created_at'] : null,
            isset($data['updated_at']) ? (int)$data['updated_at'] : null,
            (array)($data['sections'] ?? []),
            (string)($data['mobile_toggle_align'] ?? 'right')
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Providers/PagesPostProvider.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Providers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PostProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Adapter desacoplado (Ring 0 Pure) que conecta qualquer repositório de Páginas/Artigos
 * (que implemente getAll(): array) ao contrato PostProviderInterface sem acoplar a Plugins (SOLID - DIP).
 */
class PagesPostProvider implements PostProviderInterface
{
    private ?object $pageRepo;
    private PostProviderInterface $fallbackProvider;
    private PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;

    public function __construct(
        ?object $pageRepo = null,
        ?PostProviderInterface $fallbackProvider = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null
    ) {
        $this->pageRepo = $pageRepo;
        $this->fallbackProvider = $fallbackProvider ?? new MockPostProvider();
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver ?? new BaseUrlResolver();
    }

    public function getPosts(array $options = []): array
    {
        if ($this->pageRepo === null || !method_exists($this->pageRepo, 'getAll')) {
            return $this->fallbackProvider->getPosts($options);
        }

        try {
            $pages = $this->pageRepo->getAll();
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return $this->fallbackProvider->getPosts($options);
        }

        if (!is_array($pages) || empty($pages)) {
            return $this->fallbackProvider->getPosts($options);
        }

        $posts = [];
        $limit = isset($options['limit']) ? (int)$options['limit'] : 6;

        foreach ($pages as $page) {
            if (!is_array($page)) {
                continue;
            }
            $content = (string)($page['content'] ?? '');
            $cleanExcerpt = mb_substr(trim(strip_tags($content)), 0, 160);
            if (mb_strlen($cleanExcerpt) >= 160) {
                $cleanExcerpt .= '...';
            }

            $createdAt = $page['created_at'] ?? null;
            $dateFormatted = 'Recente';
            if ($createdAt) {
                $time = is_numeric($createdAt) ? (int)$createdAt : strtotime((string)$createdAt);
                if ($time > 0) {
                    $dateFormatted = date('d/m/Y', $time);
                }
            }

            $slug = (string)($page['slug'] ?? 'post-' . ($page['id'] ?? '1'));
            $url = $this->urlResolver->resolve('/' . ltrim($slug, '/'));

            $posts[] = [
                'id'             => $page['id'] ?? $slug,
                'title'          => (string)($page['title'] ?? 'Sem Título'),
                'slug'           => $slug,
                'excerpt'        => $cleanExcerpt !== '' ? $cleanExcerpt : 'Confira os detalhes completos deste artigo.',
                'featured_image' => $page['featured_image'] ?? null,
                'published_at'   => $dateFormatted,
                'author'         => (string)($page['author'] ?? 'Redação'),
                'category'       => (string)($page['category'] ?? 'Artigos'),
                'url'            => $url,
                'reading_time'   => max(1, (int)ceil(str_word_count(strip_tags($content)) / 200)) . ' min de leitura',
            ];

            if ($limit > 0 && count($posts) >= $limit) {
                break;
            }
        }

        return $posts;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Repositories/JsonThemePartAssociation.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;

/**
 * Persistência do Mapa de Associação: Tema <-> Header / Footer / Seções Ativas (config/theme_parts_associations.json).
 */
class JsonThemePartAssociation implements ThemePartAssociationInterface
{
    private string $filePath;
    private array $data;

    public function __construct(?string $filePath = null)
    {
        $this->filePath = $filePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config/theme_parts_associations.json' : __DIR__ . '/../../../../../config/theme_parts_associations.json');
        $this->load();
    }

    private function load(): void
    {
        $this->data = [
            'themes'  => [],
            'globals' => [],
        ];

        if (file_exists($this->filePath)) {
            $raw = @file_get_contents($this->filePath);
            if ($raw !== false) {
                $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    $this->data = [
                        'themes'  => is_array($decoded['themes'] ?? null) ? $decoded['themes'] : [],
                        'globals' => is_array($decoded['globals'] ?? null) ? $decoded['globals'] : [],
                    ];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function save(): bool
    {
        $dir = dirname($this->filePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        $json = json_encode($this->data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($json === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $tmpPath = $this->filePath . '.' . uniqid('tmp_', true) . '.tmp';
        if (@file_put_contents($tmpPath, $json, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!@rename($tmpPath, $this->filePath)) {
            $copied = @copy($tmpPath, $this->filePath);
            @unlink($tmpPath);
            return $copied;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function getAssignedPartId(string $themeFolder, string $partType): ?string
    {
        // 1. Verifica associação direta do tema
        if (isset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder][$partType])) {
            $id = (string)$this->data['themes'][$themeFolder][$partType];
            if (trim($id) !== '') {
                return $id;
            }
        }

        // 2. Fallback para padrão global (se configurado)
        if (isset($this->data['globals'][$partType])) {
            $globalId = (string)$this->data['globals'][$partType];
            if (trim($globalId) !== '') {
                return $globalId;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function assignPart(string $themeFolder, string $partType, ?string $partId): bool
    {
        if (!isset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder])) {
            $this->data['themes'][$themeFolder] = [];
        }

        if ($partId === null || trim($partId) === '') {
            unset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder][$partType]);
            if (empty($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder])) {
                unset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder]);
            }
        } else {
            $this->data['themes'][$themeFolder][$partType] = trim($partId);
        }

        return $this->save();
    }

    public function setGlobalDefault(string $partType, ?string $partId): bool
    {
        if ($partId === null || trim($partId) === '') {
            unset($this->data['globals'][$partType]);
        } else {
            $this->data['globals'][$partType] = trim($partId);
        }

        return $this->save();
    }

    public function getGlobalDefault(string $partType): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->data['globals'][$partType]) ? (string)$this->data['globals'][$partType] : null;
    }

    public function getAllAssignments(): array
    {
        return $this->data;
    }

    public function getThemeAssignments(string $themeFolder): array
    {
        return is_array($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder] ?? null)
            ? $this->data['themes'][$themeFolder]
            : [];
    }

    public function getAssignedTemplateForSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId): ?string
    {
        $themeAssoc = $this->getThemeAssignments($themeFolder);
        foreach ($themeAssoc as $partType => $assignedId) {
            if ($assignedId === $sectionId && str_starts_with((string)$partType, 'template:')) {
                return substr((string)$partType, strlen('template:'));
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function assignTemplateToSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId, ?string $templateSlug): bool
    {
        $cleanSectionId = trim($sectionId);
        if ($cleanSectionId === '') {
            return false;
        }

        if (!isset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder]) || !is_array($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder])) {
            $this->data['themes'][$themeFolder] = [];
        }

        // Remove qualquer vínculo anterior desta seção com templates do tema
        foreach ($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder] as $tKey => $pId) {
            if ($pId === $cleanSectionId && str_starts_with((string)$tKey, 'template:')) {
                unset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder][$tKey]);
            }
        }

        $cleanSlug = $templateSlug !== null
            ? trim(str_replace(['templates/', '.php'], '', $templateSlug))
            : '';

        if ($cleanSlug !== '' && $cleanSlug !== 'none' && $cleanSlug !== 'fallback') {
            $this->data['themes'][$themeFolder]['template:' . $cleanSlug] = $cleanSectionId;
        }

        if (empty($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder])) {
            unset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder]);
        }

        return $this->save();
    }

    public function removePartReferences(string $partId): bool
    {
        $cleanId = trim($partId);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $changed = false;

        foreach ($this->data['globals'] as $partType => $assignedId) {
            if ($assignedId === $cleanId) {
                unset($this->data['globals'][$partType]);
                $changed = true;
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->data['themes'] as $themeFolder => $assignments) {
            if (!is_array($assignments)) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach ($assignments as $partType => $assignedId) {
                if ($assignedId === $cleanId) {
                    unset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder][$partType]);
                    $changed = true;
                }
            }
            if (empty($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder])) {
                unset($this->data['themes'][$themeFolder]);
            }
        }

        return $changed ? $this->save() : true;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Repositories/JsonThemePartRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Repositório de Persistência em JSON Estruturado de Partes de Tema (config/theme_parts/).
 */
class JsonThemePartRepository implements ThemePartRepositoryInterface
{
    private string $storageDir;

    public function __construct(?string $storageDir = null)
    {
        $this->storageDir = $storageDir ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config/theme_parts' : __DIR__ . '/../../../../../config/theme_parts');
        $this->ensureDirectory();
    }

    private function ensureDirectory(): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->storageDir)) {
            @mkdir($this->storageDir, 0755, true);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Valida estritamente o ID contra Path Traversal e caracteres inválidos.
     */
    private function validateId(string $id): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($id);
        if (
            $trimmed === '' ||
            str_contains($trimmed, '..') ||
            str_contains($trimmed, '/') ||
            str_contains($trimmed, '\\') ||
            !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,128}$/', $trimmed)
        ) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("ID de parte de tema inválido ou inseguro: '{$id}'.");
        }

        // Mantém compatibilidade com nomes de arquivos onde '.' vira '_'
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '_', $trimmed) ?? $trimmed;
    }

    private function getFilePath(string $id): string
    {
        $safeId = $this->validateId($id);
        return rtrim($this->storageDir, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeId . '.json';
    }

    public function findByType(string $type): array
    {
        $all = $this->all();
        return array_values(array_filter($all, fn(ThemePartInterface $p) => $p->getType() === $type));
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?ThemePartInterface
    {
        try {
            $path = $this->getFilePath($id);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return null;
        }

        $content = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($content === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $data = json_decode($content, true);
        if (!is_array($data)) {
            return null;
        }

        return ThemePart::fromArray($data);
    }

    public function save(ThemePartInterface $part): bool
    {
        $this->ensureDirectory();
        $path = $this->getFilePath($part->getId());
        $json = json_encode($part->toArray(), JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($json === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $tmpPath = $path . '.' . uniqid('tmp_', true) . '.tmp';
        if (@file_put_contents($tmpPath, $json, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!@rename($tmpPath, $path)) {
            $copied = @copy($tmpPath, $path);
            @unlink($tmpPath);
            return $copied;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function delete(string $id): bool
    {
        try {
            $path = $this->getFilePath($id);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException) {
            return false;
        }

        if (file_exists($path)) {
            return @unlink($path);
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        $this->ensureDirectory();
        $parts = [];
        $files = glob(rtrim($this->storageDir, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . '*.json');

        if (is_array($files)) {
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                $raw = @file_get_contents($file);
                if ($raw !== false) {
                    $data = json_decode($raw, true);
                    if (is_array($data) && isset($data['id'])) {
                        $parts[] = ThemePart::fromArray($data);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ordenação determinística estável: decrescente por updatedAt, desempate por ID
        usort($parts, static function (ThemePartInterface $a, ThemePartInterface $b): int {
            $updatedCmp = $b->getUpdatedAt() <=> $a->getUpdatedAt();
            if ($updatedCmp !== 0) {
                return $updatedCmp;
            }
            return strcmp($a->getId(), $b->getId());
        });

        return $parts;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Services/ThemePartRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\DesignTokensInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Orquestrador de Renderização de Partes de Tema (Header, Footer, Seções)
 * com compilação de blocos, injeção de Design Tokens, Visibilidade Responsiva e Fallback Gracioso.
 */
class ThemePartRenderer implements ThemePartRendererInterface
{
    private ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo;
    private ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc;
    private LayoutGridInterface $gridRenderer;
    private BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry;
    private DesignTokensInterface $designTokens;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private ?string $baseRoot;
    private bool $tokensInjected = false;
    /** @var array<int, string> Pilha de proteção contra recursão infinita (ex: Shortcode [section] auto-referenciado) */
    private array $renderingStack = [];
    private const MAX_RENDER_DEPTH = 10;

    public function resetTokensInjection(): void
    {
        $this->tokensInjected = false;
    }

    public static function resetInjectedState(): void
    {
        // Mantido por retrocompatibilidade; o controle de injeção agora é escopado por instância (SOLID - SRP).
    }

    public function __construct(
        ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo,
        ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc,
        LayoutGridInterface $gridRenderer,
        BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry,
        DesignTokensInterface $designTokens,
        ?string $baseRoot = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->partRepo = $partRepo;
        $this->partAssoc = $partAssoc;
        $this->gridRenderer = $gridRenderer;
        $this->blockRegistry = $blockRegistry;
        $this->designTokens = $designTokens;
        $this->baseRoot = $baseRoot !== null ? rtrim($baseRoot, '/\\') : (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 5));
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function renderHeader(string $themeFolder, array $context = []): string
    {
        $partId = $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId($themeFolder, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER);
        if ($partId !== null) {
            $part = $this->partRepo->findById($partId);
            if ($part !== null && $part->getType() === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER) {
                return $this->compileDynamicPart($part, $context, true);
            }
        }

        // Fallback gracioso: Carrega o arquivo nativo do tema
        return $this->renderFileFallback($themeFolder, 'header', $context);
    }

    public function renderFooter(string $themeFolder, array $context = []): string
    {
        $partId = $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId($themeFolder, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER);
        if ($partId !== null) {
            $part = $this->partRepo->findById($partId);
            if ($part !== null && $part->getType() === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER) {
                return $this->compileDynamicPart($part, $context, false);
            }
        }

        // Fallback gracioso: Carrega o arquivo nativo do tema
        return $this->renderFileFallback($themeFolder, 'footer', $context);
    }

    public function renderSection(string $sectionId, array $context = []): string
    {
        $part = $this->partRepo->findById($sectionId);
        if ($part === null) {
            return "<!-- Section not found: " . htmlspecialchars($sectionId, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . " -->";
        }

        return $this->compileDynamicPart($part, $context, false);
    }

    public function renderTemplateSection(string $themeFolder, string $templateName, array $context = []): string
    {
        $cleanTemplate = str_replace(['templates/', '.php'], '', $templateName);
        $partId = $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId($themeFolder, 'template:' . $cleanTemplate);
        if ($partId === null || trim($partId) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $part = $this->partRepo->findById($partId);
        if ($part === null) {
            return '';
        }

        return $this->compileDynamicPart($part, $context, false);
    }

    /**
     * Compila uma instância de ThemePart (persistida ou efêmera de preview) aplicando todas as regras
     * de contrato (getAllowedPartTypes), estilos de elemento e classes responsivas.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $context
     */
    public function compilePart(ThemePartInterface $part, array $context = [], bool $injectDesignTokens = true, bool $wrapWithSemanticTag = true): string
    {
        return $this->compileDynamicPart($part, $context, $injectDesignTokens, $wrapWithSemanticTag);
    }

    private function compileDynamicPart(
        ThemePartInterface $part,
        array $context,
        bool $injectDesignTokens,
        bool $wrapWithSemanticTag = true
    ): string {
        $partId = trim($part->getId());
        if ($partId !== '') {
            if (in_array($partId, $this->renderingStack, true) || count($this->renderingStack) >= self::MAX_RENDER_DEPTH) {
                $safeId = htmlspecialchars($partId, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                return "<!-- Recursion guard triggered for part: {$safeId} -->";
            }
            $this->renderingStack[] = $partId;
        }

        try {
            $sections = $part->getSections();
            $sectionsOutput = [];

            foreach ($sections as $secIdx => $section) {
                $preset = (string)($section['layout_preset'] ?? ($part->getLayoutPreset() !== '' ? $part->getLayoutPreset() : '1_col'));
                $settings = (array)($section['container_settings'] ?? []);
                $columnsData = (array)($section['columns_data'] ?? []);

                $columnsHtml = [];
                $colHiddenMap = [];
                foreach ($columnsData as $colIndex => $blocksList) {
                    $colBlocksOutput = [];
                    $validBlocksCount = 0;
                    $hiddenCounts = [
                        'desktop' => 0,
                        'laptop'  => 0,
                        'tablet'  => 0,
                        'mobile'  => 0,
                    ];

                    if (is_array($blocksList)) {
                        foreach ($blocksList as $bIdx => $blockDef) {
                            if (!is_array($blockDef)) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            $blockType = (string)($blockDef['type'] ?? '');
                            $blockData = (array)($blockDef['data'] ?? []);

                            // Se for bloco de nav_menu, garante o estilo e alinhamento do toggle configurados na parte
                            if ($blockType === 'nav_menu') {
                                if (!isset($blockData['toggle_style']) || empty($blockData['toggle_style'])) {
                                    $blockData['toggle_style'] = $part->getMobileToggleStyle();
                                }
                                if (!isset($blockData['toggle_align']) || empty($blockData['toggle_align'])) {
                                    $blockData['toggle_align'] = $part->getMobileToggleAlign();
                                }
                            }

                            $block = $this->blockRegistry->get($blockType);
                            if ($block !== null) {
                                $enforcePartType = ($context['_enforce_part_type'] ?? true) !== false;
                                if ($enforcePartType) {
                                    // Validação estrita por contrato: impede que blocos de conteúdo vazem para headers ou footers
                                    $allowedTypes = $block->getAllowedPartTypes();
                                    if (!empty($allowedTypes) && !in_array($part->getType(), $allowedTypes, true)) {
                                        continue;
                                    }
                                }

                                $renderedHtml = $block->render($blockData, $context);
                                $elementId = !empty($blockData['_id']) ? (string)$blockData['_id'] : ('ds-elem-' . substr(md5($part->getId() . '-' . $secIdx . '-' . $colIndex . '-' . $bIdx), 0, 10));
                                $elementStyles = $this->styleRenderer->renderStyleString($blockData);
                                $responsiveCss = $this->styleRenderer->renderResponsiveStyles("#{$elementId}", $blockData);
                                $visibilityClasses = $this->styleRenderer->getResponsiveVisibilityClasses($blockData);

                                $validBlocksCount++;
                                if (str_contains($visibilityClasses, 'ds-hide-desktop')) {
                                    $hiddenCounts['desktop']++;
                                }
                                if (str_contains($visibilityClasses, 'ds-hide-laptop')) {
                                    $hiddenCounts['laptop']++;
                                }
                                if (str_contains($visibilityClasses, 'ds-hide-tablet')) {
                                    $hiddenCounts['tablet']++;
                                }
                                if (str_contains($visibilityClasses, 'ds-hide-mobile')) {
                                    $hiddenCounts['mobile']++;
                                }

                                if ($elementStyles !== '' || $visibilityClasses !== '' || $responsiveCss !== '') {
                                    $wrapperClass = trim("ds-element-wrapper {$visibilityClasses}");
                                    $styleAttr = $elementStyles !== '' ? " style=\"{$elementStyles}\"" : '';
                                    $styleTag = $responsiveCss !== '' ? "<style>{$responsiveCss}</style>" : '';
                                    $renderedHtml = "{$styleTag}<div id=\"{$elementId}\" class=\"{$wrapperClass}\"{$styleAttr}>{$renderedHtml}</div>";
                                }
                                $colBlocksOutput[] = $renderedHtml;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    $cIdx = (int)$colIndex;
                    $columnsHtml[$cIdx] = implode("\n", $colBlocksOutput);
                    if ($validBlocksCount > 0) {
                        $colHiddenMap[$cIdx] = [
                            'desktop' => $hiddenCounts['desktop'] === $validBlocksCount,
                            'laptop'  => $hiddenCounts['laptop'] === $validBlocksCount,
                            'tablet'  => $hiddenCounts['tablet'] === $validBlocksCount,
                            'mobile'  => $hiddenCounts['mobile'] === $validBlocksCount,
                        ];
                    }
                }

                $settings['_col_hidden'] = $colHiddenMap;
                $sectionsOutput[] = $this->gridRenderer->renderSection($preset, $columnsHtml, $settings);
            }

            $allSectionsHtml = implode("\n", $sectionsOutput);

            if ($wrapWithSemanticTag) {
                $partType = $part->getType();
                $wrapperTag = 'section';
                $roleAttr = '';
                $typeClass = 'ds-theme-section';

                if ($partType === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER) {
                    $wrapperTag = 'header';
                    $roleAttr = ' role="banner"';
                    $typeClass = 'ds-theme-header';
                } elseif ($partType === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER) {
                    $wrapperTag = 'footer';
                    $roleAttr = ' role="contentinfo"';
                    $typeClass = 'ds-theme-footer';
                }

                $wrappedHtml = "<{$wrapperTag} class=\"ds-part-wrapper {$typeClass}\"{$roleAttr}>\n{$allSectionsHtml}\n</{$wrapperTag}>";
            } else {
                $wrappedHtml = $allSectionsHtml;
            }

            // Injeta variáveis CSS, animações runtime e utilitários responsivos dos Design Tokens
            if ($injectDesignTokens || !$this->tokensInjected) {
                $this->tokensInjected = true;
                $tokensCss = $this->designTokens->generateCssVariables();
                $runtimeCss = self::getRuntimeCss();
                $tokensTag = "<style id=\"ds-design-tokens\">\n{$tokensCss}\n</style>\n<style id=\"ds-builder-runtime\">\n{$runtimeCss}\n</style>\n";
                return $tokensTag . $wrappedHtml;
            }

            return $wrappedHtml;
        } finally {
            if ($partId !== '') {
                array_pop($this->renderingStack);
            }
        }
    }

    public static function getRuntimeCss(): string
    {
        return <<<CSS

    }

    private function renderFileFallback(string $themeFolder, string $partName, array $context): string
    {
        $themeDir = $this->resolveThemeDir($themeFolder);
        if ($themeDir === null) {
            return '';
        }

        $candidates = [
            $themeDir . '/partials/' . $partName . '.php',
            $themeDir . '/' . $partName . '.php',
        ];

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            if (file_exists($candidate)) {
                $realCandidate = realpath($candidate);
                $realThemeDir = realpath($themeDir);
                if ($realCandidate !== false && $realThemeDir !== false && str_starts_with($realCandidate, $realThemeDir)) {
                    // Isolamento estrito de escopo: impede vazamento de $this para o arquivo de template
                    $isolatedInclude = static function (string $__file, array $__ctx): string {
                        ob_start();
                        try {
                            extract($__ctx, EXTR_SKIP);
                            include $__file;
                            return (string)ob_get_clean();
                        } catch (Throwable $e) {
                            if (ob_get_level() > 0) {
                                ob_end_clean();
                            }
                            throw $e;
                        }
                    };

                    return $isolatedInclude($realCandidate, $context);
                }
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    private function resolveThemeDir(string $themeFolder): ?string
    {
        // Se já for um caminho absoluto válido
        if (is_dir($themeFolder)) {
            return rtrim($themeFolder, '/\\');
        }

        $candidates = [
            $this->baseRoot . '/themes/' . $themeFolder,
            $this->baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/' . $themeFolder,
            $this->baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/default',
        ];

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            if (is_dir($candidate)) {
                return rtrim($candidate, '/\\');
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/ElementStyleRenderer.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;

/**
 * Renderizador resiliente e higienizador de estilos CSS para blocos e elementos (SOLID - SRP).
 */
class ElementStyleRenderer implements ElementStyleRendererInterface
{
    public function renderStyleString(array $data): string
    {
        $rules = [];

        // Margem e Padding
        if (!empty($data['margin'])) {
            $rules[] = 'margin: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['margin']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['padding'])) {
            $rules[] = 'padding: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['padding']);
        }

        // Flex & Flexbox
        if (!empty($data['display'])) {
            $rules[] = 'display: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['display']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['flex_direction'])) {
            $rules[] = 'flex-direction: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['flex_direction']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['justify_content'])) {
            $rules[] = 'justify-content: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['justify_content']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['align_items'])) {
            $rules[] = 'align-items: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['align_items']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['flex_wrap'])) {
            $rules[] = 'flex-wrap: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['flex_wrap']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['gap'])) {
            $rules[] = 'gap: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['gap']);
        }

        // Dimensões & Visual
        if (!empty($data['width'])) {
            $rules[] = 'width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['width']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['max_width'])) {
            $rules[] = 'max-width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['max_width']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['height'])) {
            $rules[] = 'height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['height']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['min_height'])) {
            $rules[] = 'min-height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['min_height']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['background'])) {
            $rules[] = 'background: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['background']);
        }
        $resolvedTextColor = !empty($data['text_color']) ? (string)$data['text_color'] : (!empty($data['color']) ? (string)$data['color'] : '');
        if ($resolvedTextColor !== '') {
            $rules[] = 'color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue($resolvedTextColor);
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-text-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue($resolvedTextColor);
        }
        if (!empty($data['heading_color'])) {
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-heading-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['heading_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['link_color'])) {
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-link-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['link_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['link_hover_color'])) {
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-link-hover-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['link_hover_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_width'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_width']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_style'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-style: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_style']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_color'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_radius'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-radius: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_radius']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['box_shadow'])) {
            $rules[] = 'box-shadow: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['box_shadow']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['opacity']) && $data['opacity'] !== '1' && $data['opacity'] !== 1) {
            $rules[] = 'opacity: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['opacity']);
        }

        // Tipografia
        if (!empty($data['font_family'])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-family: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_family']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_size'])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-size: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_size']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_weight'])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-weight: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_weight']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['line_height'])) {
            $rules[] = 'line-height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['line_height']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['letter_spacing'])) {
            $rules[] = 'letter-spacing: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['letter_spacing']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['text_transform'])) {
            $rules[] = 'text-transform: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['text_transform']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['text_align'])) {
            $rules[] = 'text-align: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['text_align']);
        }

        return !empty($rules) ? implode('; ', $rules) . ';' : '';
    }

    public function getResponsiveVisibilityClasses(array $data): string
    {
        $classes = [];
        if (!empty($data['hide_desktop']) && $data['hide_desktop'] !== 'false' && $data['hide_desktop'] !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-desktop';
        }
        $hideLaptop = $data['hide_laptop'] ?? $data['hide_1024'] ?? false;
        if (!empty($hideLaptop) && $hideLaptop !== 'false' && $hideLaptop !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-laptop';
        }
        $hideTablet = $data['hide_tablet'] ?? $data['hide_768'] ?? false;
        if (!empty($hideTablet) && $hideTablet !== 'false' && $hideTablet !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-tablet';
        }
        $hideMobile = $data['hide_mobile'] ?? $data['hide_375'] ?? false;
        if (!empty($hideMobile) && $hideMobile !== 'false' && $hideMobile !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-mobile';
        }

        return implode(' ', $classes);
    }

    public function parse4Sides(string $spacing): array
    {
        $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($spacing));
        if ($parts === false || empty($parts) || $parts[0] === '') {
            return ['top' => '0px', 'right' => '0px', 'bottom' => '0px', 'left' => '0px'];
        }

        return match (count($parts)) {
            1 => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[0], 'bottom' => $parts[0], 'left' => $parts[0]],
            2 => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[1], 'bottom' => $parts[0], 'left' => $parts[1]],
            3 => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[1], 'bottom' => $parts[2], 'left' => $parts[1]],
            default => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[1], 'bottom' => $parts[2], 'left' => $parts[3]],
        };
    }

    public function sanitizeCssValue(string $value): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($value);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Bloqueia expressões maliciosas de CSS (expression, javascript:, vbscript:)
        $lower = strtolower($trimmed);
        if (
            str_contains($lower, 'expression(') ||
            str_contains($lower, 'javascript:') ||
            str_contains($lower, 'vbscript:') ||
            str_contains($lower, '@import')
        ) {
            return '';
        }

        // Higienização contra injeção de CSS ou quebra de sintaxe
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[;<>{}\\\\]/', '', $trimmed) ?? '';
        return htmlspecialchars($sanitized, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }

    public function renderResponsiveStyles(string $elementSelector, array $data): string
    {
        $devices = [
            'laptop' => [
                'media' => '@media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px)',
                'class' => ".ds-laptop-mode {$elementSelector}, .ds-device-1024 {$elementSelector}",
            ],
            'tablet' => [
                'media' => '@media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 768px)',
                'class' => ".ds-tablet-mode {$elementSelector}, .ds-device-768 {$elementSelector}",
            ],
            'mobile' => [
                'media' => '@media (max-width: 480px)',
                'class' => ".ds-mobile-mode {$elementSelector}, .ds-device-375 {$elementSelector}",
            ],
        ];

        $output = '';

        foreach ($devices as $dev => $config) {
            $rules = $this->buildDeviceRules($data, $dev);
            if (empty($rules)) {
                continue;
            }

            $rulesStr = implode("; ", $rules) . ";";
            
            // Regras adicionais em cascata para elementos de texto internos (headings e parágrafos)
            $textRules = [];
            foreach ($rules as $r) {
                if (
                    str_starts_with($r, 'font-size:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'font-weight:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'font-family:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'text-align:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'line-height:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'letter-spacing:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'color:')
                ) {
                    $textRules[] = $r;
                }
            }
            $textCascadeStr = '';
            if (!empty($textRules)) {
                $textInnerRules = implode("; ", $textRules) . ";";
                $textSelector = "{$elementSelector} h1, {$elementSelector} h2, {$elementSelector} h3, {$elementSelector} h4, {$elementSelector} h5, {$elementSelector} h6, {$elementSelector} p, {$elementSelector} .ds-block-heading, {$elementSelector} .ds-block-paragraph";
                $textCascadeStr = " {$textSelector} { {$textInnerRules} }";
            }

            $mediaQuery = $config['media'];
            $classSelector = $config['class'];

            $output .= "{$mediaQuery} { {$elementSelector} { {$rulesStr} }{$textCascadeStr} } ";
            $output .= "{$classSelector} { {$rulesStr} } ";
        }

        return trim($output);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function buildDeviceRules(array $data, string $device): array
    {
        $rules = [];
        $suffix = "_{$device}";

        // Margem e Padding
        if (!empty($data['margin' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'margin: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['margin' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['padding' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'padding: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['padding' . $suffix]);
        }

        // Flex & Flexbox
        if (!empty($data['display' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'display: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['display' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['flex_direction' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'flex-direction: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['flex_direction' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['justify_content' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'justify-content: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['justify_content' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['align_items' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'align-items: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['align_items' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['gap' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'gap: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['gap' . $suffix]);
        }

        // Dimensões
        if (!empty($data['width' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['width' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['max_width' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'max-width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['max_width' . $suffix]);
        }

        // Tipografia, Cores & Alinhamento
        if (!empty($data['font_size' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-size: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_size' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_weight' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-weight: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_weight' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_family' . $suffix])) {
            $ff = $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_family' . $suffix]);
            $resolved = match ($ff) {
                'secondary' => 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)',
                'tertiary'  => 'var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)',
                'primary'   => 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)',
                default     => $ff,
            };
            $rules[] = 'font-family: ' . $resolved;
        }
        if (!empty($data['color' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['color' . $suffix]);
        } elseif (!empty($data['text_color' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['text_color' . $suffix]);
        }
        $textAlign = !empty($data['text_align' . $suffix]) ? (string)$data['text_align' . $suffix] : (!empty($data['align' . $suffix]) ? (string)$data['align' . $suffix] : '');
        if ($textAlign !== '') {
            $rules[] = 'text-align: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue($textAlign);
        }
        if (!empty($data['line_height' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'line-height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['line_height' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['letter_spacing' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'letter-spacing: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['letter_spacing' . $suffix]);
        }

        return $rules;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\ShadowContractInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\ColorValue;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\DimensionValue;

/**
 * Trait de implementação padrão e reutilizável para StylableElementInterface (SOLID - DRY / Ring 0).
 */
trait StylableElementTrait
{
    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    protected array $styleData = [];

    /**
     * Define ou atualiza os dados de estilo do elemento.
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     * @return static
     */
    public function setStyleData(array $data): static
    {
        $this->styleData = $data;
        return $this;
    }

    public function getBackgroundColor(): ?ColorValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['background'] ?? ($this->styleData['bg_color'] ?? null);
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? ColorValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getTextColor(): ?ColorValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['text_color'] ?? ($this->styleData['color'] ?? null);
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? ColorValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getHeadingColor(): ?ColorValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['heading_color'] ?? ($this->styleData['title_color'] ?? null);
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? ColorValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getLinkColor(): ?ColorValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['link_color'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? ColorValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getLinkHoverColor(): ?ColorValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['link_hover_color'] ?? ($this->styleData['active_color'] ?? null);
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? ColorValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getBorderColor(): ?ColorValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['border_color'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? ColorValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getFontFamily(): ?string
    {
        if (!isset($this->styleData['font_family']) || (string)$this->styleData['font_family'] === '') {
            return null;
        }
        $raw = (string)$this->styleData['font_family'];
        return match ($raw) {
            'primary'   => 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)',
            'secondary' => 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)',
            'tertiary'  => 'var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)',
            default     => $raw,
        };
    }

    public function getFontSize(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['font_size'] ?? ($this->styleData['size'] ?? null);
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getFontWeight(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['font_weight']) && (string)$this->styleData['font_weight'] !== ''
            ? (string)$this->styleData['font_weight']
            : null;
    }

    public function getLineHeight(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['line_height']) && (string)$this->styleData['line_height'] !== ''
            ? (string)$this->styleData['line_height']
            : null;
    }

    public function getLetterSpacing(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['letter_spacing'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getTextTransform(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['text_transform']) && (string)$this->styleData['text_transform'] !== ''
            ? (string)$this->styleData['text_transform']
            : null;
    }

    public function getTextAlign(): ?string
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['text_align'] ?? ($this->styleData['align'] ?? null);
        return $raw !== null && (string)$raw !== '' ? (string)$raw : null;
    }

    public function getWidth(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['width'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getMaxWidth(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['max_width'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getHeight(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['height'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getMinHeight(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['min_height'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getBorderStyle(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['border_style']) ? (string)$this->styleData['border_style'] : null;
    }

    public function getBorderWidth(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['border_width'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getBorderRadius(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['border_radius'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getShadowPreset(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->styleData['shadow_preset'] ?? ShadowContractInterface::SHADOW_NONE);
    }

    public function getBoxShadowCss(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['box_shadow']) ? (string)$this->styleData['box_shadow'] : null;
    }

    public function getHoverEffect(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['hover_animation']) 
            ? (string)$this->styleData['hover_animation'] 
            : (isset($this->styleData['hover_effect']) ? (string)$this->styleData['hover_effect'] : null);
    }

    public function getEntranceAnimation(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['entrance_animation']) ? (string)$this->styleData['entrance_animation'] : null;
    }

    public function getTransitionDuration(): ?string
    {
        return (string)($this->styleData['transition_duration'] ?? '0.25s');
    }

    public function getTimingFunction(): ?string
    {
        return (string)($this->styleData['timing_function'] ?? 'ease');
    }

    public function getStyleProperties(): array
    {
        return $this->styleData;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/Values/ColorValue.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use JsonSerializable;

/**
 * Value Object imutável que representa uma cor CSS tipada (Design Token, Hex, RGBA, Gradiente ou Transparente).
 * Garante a filosofia "Token-First" e higienização estrita contra injeção de CSS (SOLID - Ring 0).
 */
final class ColorValue implements JsonSerializable
{
    public const TYPE_TOKEN       = 'token';
    public const TYPE_HEX         = 'hex';
    public const TYPE_RGB         = 'rgb';
    public const TYPE_GRADIENT    = 'gradient';
    public const TYPE_TRANSPARENT = 'transparent';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $type,
        private readonly string $value,
        private readonly ?string $tokenName = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromToken(string $tokenName, ?string $fallback = null): self
    {
        $clean = strtolower(trim($tokenName));
        $clean = preg_replace('/^var\(--|\)$/', '', $clean) ?? $clean;

        if (str_contains($clean, ',')) {
            $parts = explode(',', $clean, 2);
            $clean = trim($parts[0]);
            if ($fallback === null) {
                $fallback = trim($parts[1]);
            }
        }

        $clean = ltrim($clean, '-');

        if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/', $clean)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Nome de Design Token inválido: '{$tokenName}'.");
        }

        if ($fallback !== null && $fallback !== '') {
            $sanitizedFallback = preg_replace('/[;<>{}\\\\]/', '', $fallback) ?? '';
            return new self(self::TYPE_TOKEN, "var(--{$clean}, {$sanitizedFallback})", $clean);
        }

        return new self(self::TYPE_TOKEN, "var(--{$clean})", $clean);
    }

    public static function fromHex(string $hex): self
    {
        $clean = trim($hex);
        if (!preg_match('/^#([a-f0-9]{3,4}|[a-f0-9]{6}|[a-f0-9]{8})$/i', $clean)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Formato hexadecimal de cor inválido: '{$hex}'.");
        }

        return new self(self::TYPE_HEX, $clean);
    }

    public static function fromRgba(int $r, int $g, int $b, float $a = 1.0): self
    {
        $r = max(0, min(255, $r));
        $g = max(0, min(255, $g));
        $b = max(0, min(255, $b));
        $a = max(0.0, min(1.0, $a));

        $val = $a < 1.0 ? "rgba({$r}, {$g}, {$b}, {$a})" : "rgb({$r}, {$g}, {$b})";
        return new self(self::TYPE_RGB, $val);
    }

    public static function transparent(): self
    {
        return new self(self::TYPE_TRANSPARENT, 'transparent');
    }

    public static function fromGradient(string $gradient): self
    {
        $clean = trim($gradient);
        // Higieniza contra injeção
        if (preg_match('/[;<>{}\\\\]/', $clean) || !preg_match('/^(linear|radial|conic)-gradient\(.+\)$/i', $clean)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Declaração de gradiente CSS inválida.");
        }

        return new self(self::TYPE_GRADIENT, $clean);
    }

    /**
     * Faz o parse automático de uma string de cor (Token, Hex, RGBA, Gradiente ou Palavra-chave).
     */
    public static function fromString(string $raw): self
    {
        $clean = trim($raw);
        if ($clean === '' || $clean === 'transparent') {
            return self::transparent();
        }

        // Caso 1: Design Token explícito ex: var(--primary)
        if (str_starts_with($clean, 'var(--') && str_ends_with($clean, ')')) {
            $token = substr($clean, 6, -1);
            return self::fromToken($token);
        }

        // Caso 2: Hexadecimal (#fff, #45f3ff)
        if (str_starts_with($clean, '#')) {
            return self::fromHex($clean);
        }

        // Caso 3: Nome de token sem var() ex: "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "color-primary", "text_main"
        $knownTokens = [
            'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'background', 'surface', 'text_main', 'text_muted', 'border', 'accent',
            'color-primary', 'color-secondary', 'color-tertiary', 'color-background', 'color-surface',
            'color-text-main', 'color-text-muted', 'color-border', 'color-accent',
            'text-main', 'text-muted', 'bg-color',
        ];
        if (in_array(strtolower($clean), $knownTokens, true)) {
            return self::fromToken($clean);
        }

        // Caso 4: RGB / RGBA / HSL
        if (preg_match('/^(rgba?|hsla?)\([0-9.,% ]+\)$/i', $clean)) {
            return new self(self::TYPE_RGB, $clean);
        }

        // Caso 5: Gradiente
        if (preg_match('/^(linear|radial|conic)-gradient\(/i', $clean)) {
            return self::fromGradient($clean);
        }

        // Caso 6: Palavras-chave CSS permitidas
        if (in_array(strtolower($clean), ['currentcolor', 'inherit', 'initial'], true)) {
            return new self(self::TYPE_TRANSPARENT, strtolower($clean));
        }

        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Formato de cor não suportado: '{$raw}'.");
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return $this->type;
    }

    public function isToken(): bool
    {
        return $this->type === self::TYPE_TOKEN;
    }

    public function getTokenName(): ?string
    {
        return $this->tokenName;
    }

    public function toCss(): string
    {
        return $this->value;
    }

    public function getCssValue(): string
    {
        return $this->toCss();
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->toCss();
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'type'       => $this->type,
            'value'      => $this->value,
            'token_name' => $this->tokenName,
            'is_token'   => $this->isToken(),
        ];
    }

    public function jsonSerialize(): array
    {
        return $this->toArray();
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/Values/CssUnit.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values;

/**
 * Unidades CSS suportadas pelo construtor visual com tipagem forte (SOLID - Ring 0).
 */
enum CssUnit: string
{
    // Absolutas / Pixels
    case PX = 'px';
    case CM = 'cm';
    case MM = 'mm';
    case PT = 'pt';
    case IN = 'in';

    // Relativas ao Container / Layout
    case PERCENT = '%';
    case AUTO = 'auto';
    case FIT_CONTENT = 'fit-content';
    case MIN_CONTENT = 'min-content';
    case MAX_CONTENT = 'max-content';

    // Relativas à Viewport (Tela)
    case VH = 'vh';
    case VW = 'vw';
    case VMIN = 'vmin';
    case VMAX = 'vmax';

    // Tipográficas / Escalares
    case REM = 'rem';
    case EM = 'em';
    case CH = 'ch';

    /**
     * Tenta identificar a unidade a partir de uma string (ex: "px", "%", "vh").
     */
    public static function tryFromString(string $raw): ?self
    {
        $clean = strtolower(trim($raw));
        return self::tryFrom($clean);
    }

    /**
     * Retorna se a unidade é de valor numérico dimensional.
     */
    public function isNumeric(): bool
    {
        return !in_array($this, [self::AUTO, self::FIT_CONTENT, self::MIN_CONTENT, self::MAX_CONTENT], true);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/Values/DimensionValue.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use JsonSerializable;

/**
 * Value Object imutável que representa uma dimensão CSS tipada (largura, altura, margem, etc.).
 * Segue Ring 0 e valida todas as unidades sem risco de injeção CSS.
 */
final class DimensionValue implements JsonSerializable
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly float $amount,
        private readonly CssUnit $unit
    ) {}

    public static function px(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::PX);
    }

    public static function percent(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::PERCENT);
    }

    public static function rem(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::REM);
    }

    public static function em(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::EM);
    }

    public static function vh(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::VH);
    }

    public static function vw(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::VW);
    }

    public static function cm(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::CM);
    }

    public static function auto(): self
    {
        return new self(0.0, CssUnit::AUTO);
    }

    public static function fitContent(): self
    {
        return new self(0.0, CssUnit::FIT_CONTENT);
    }

    /**
     * Faz o parse seguro de uma string CSS dimensional (ex: "100vh", "50%", "24px", "2.5cm", "auto").
     */
    public static function fromString(string $raw): self
    {
        $clean = trim($raw);
        if ($clean === '' || $clean === '0') {
            return new self(0.0, CssUnit::PX);
        }

        $lower = strtolower($clean);

        // Keywords sem número
        if ($lower === 'auto') return self::auto();
        if ($lower === 'fit-content') return self::fitContent();
        if ($lower === 'min-content') return new self(0.0, CssUnit::MIN_CONTENT);
        if ($lower === 'max-content') return new self(0.0, CssUnit::MAX_CONTENT);

        // Extrai número e unidade via regex seguro
        if (preg_match('/^([+-]?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*([a-z%]*)$/i', $clean, $matches)) {
            $amount = (float)$matches[1];
            $unitStr = strtolower(trim($matches[2]));

            if ($unitStr === '') {
                $unit = CssUnit::PX; // Default para pixels
            } else {
                $unit = CssUnit::tryFromString($unitStr);
                if ($unit === null) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unidade CSS não suportada: '{$unitStr}'.");
                }
            }

            return new self($amount, $unit);
        }

        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Valor de dimensão CSS inválido: '{$raw}'.");
    }

    public function getAmount(): float
    {
        return $this->amount;
    }

    public function getUnit(): CssUnit
    {
        return $this->unit;
    }

    public function toCss(): string
    {
        if (!$this->unit->isNumeric()) {
            return $this->unit->value;
        }

        // Formata float removendo zeros à direita desnecessários (ex: 2.0 -> 2, 2.5 -> 2.5)
        $formatted = (string)(fmod($this->amount, 1.0) === 0.0 ? (int)$this->amount : $this->amount);
        return $formatted . $this->unit->value;
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->toCss();
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'amount' => $this->amount,
            'unit'   => $this->unit->value,
            'css'    => $this->toCss(),
        ];
    }

    public function jsonSerialize(): array
    {
        return $this->toArray();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Support/BaseUrlResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;

/**
 * Resolvedor padrão de URLs públicas baseado na configuração de ambiente / BASE_URL.
 */
class BaseUrlResolver implements PublicUrlResolverInterface
{
    private ?string $explicitBaseUrl;

    public function __construct(?string $explicitBaseUrl = null)
    {
        $this->explicitBaseUrl = $explicitBaseUrl !== null ? rtrim($explicitBaseUrl, '/') : null;
    }

    public function getBaseUrl(): string
    {
        if ($this->explicitBaseUrl !== null) {
            return $this->explicitBaseUrl;
        }

        return defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim((string)BASE_URL, '/') : '';
    }

    public function resolve(string $path = ''): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($path);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            $base = $this->getBaseUrl();
            return $base !== '' ? $base . '/' : '/';
        }

        // URLs absolutas ou âncoras permanecem intactas
        if (
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'http://') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'https://') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, '//') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, '#') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'mailto:') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'tel:')
        ) {
            return $trimmed;
        }

        $base = $this->getBaseUrl();
        if ($base !== '' && str_starts_with($trimmed, $base . '/')) {
            return $trimmed;
        }

        return $base . '/' . ltrim($trimmed, '/');
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Support/MenuTreeBuilder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuTreeBuilderInterface;

/**
 * Construtor de Árvore Hierárquica de Menus e Submenus (Walker SOLID).
 *
 * Suporta tanto hierarquia por `parent_id` (banco relacional) quanto por
 * `depth` sequencial (estilo wpNavMenu drag-and-drop) ou arrays `children` pré-aninhados.
 */
final class MenuTreeBuilder implements MenuTreeBuilderInterface
{
    public function buildTree(array $items): array
    {
        if (empty($items)) {
            return [];
        }

        // Normaliza cada item garantindo chaves padrões
        $normalized = [];
        $hasExplicitParentIds = false;
        $hasExplicitDepths = false;

        foreach (array_values($items) as $idx => $raw) {
            if (!is_array($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $id = isset($raw['id']) && (int)$raw['id'] > 0 ? (int)$raw['id'] : ($idx + 1);
            $parentId = isset($raw['parent_id']) && (int)$raw['parent_id'] > 0 ? (int)$raw['parent_id'] : null;
            $depth = isset($raw['depth']) ? max(0, (int)$raw['depth']) : 0;

            if ($parentId !== null) {
                $hasExplicitParentIds = true;
            }
            if ($depth > 0) {
                $hasExplicitDepths = true;
            }

            $children = [];
            if (!empty($raw['children']) && is_array($raw['children'])) {
                $children = $this->buildTree($raw['children']);
            }

            $normalized[] = [
                'id'          => $id,
                'parent_id'   => $parentId,
                'depth'       => $depth,
                'title'       => (string)($raw['title'] ?? ''),
                'url'         => (string)($raw['url'] ?? '#'),
                'page_id'     => !empty($raw['page_id']) ? (int)$raw['page_id'] : null,
                'target'      => (string)($raw['target'] ?? '_self'),
                'css_classes' => (string)($raw['css_classes'] ?? ''),
                'order_index' => isset($raw['order_index']) ? (int)$raw['order_index'] : $idx,
                'children'    => $children,
            ];
        }

        // Se existir parent_id explícito, monta a árvore por referência de ID pai
        if ($hasExplicitParentIds) {
            return $this->buildByParentId($normalized);
        }

        // Se existir depth sequencial (> 0), monta a árvore por pilha de profundidade (wpNavMenu)
        if ($hasExplicitDepths) {
            return $this->buildByDepthStack($normalized);
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function buildByParentId(array $items): array
    {
        $byId = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $byId[(int)$item['id']] = $item;
        }

        $tree = [];
        foreach ($byId as $id => &$node) {
            $parentId = $node['parent_id'];
            if ($parentId !== null && $parentId !== $id && isset($byId[$parentId])) {
                $byId[$parentId]['children'][] = &$node;
            } else {
                $tree[] = &$node;
            }
        }
        unset($node);

        return $tree;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function buildByDepthStack(array $items): array
    {
        $root = [];
        /** @var array<int, array<string, mixed>> $stack */
        $stack = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $depth = (int)$item['depth'];
            if ($depth <= 0 || empty($stack)) {
                $item['depth'] = 0;
                $root[] = $item;
                $stack = [0 => &$root[ count($root) - 1 ]];
                continue;
            }

            // Garante que a profundidade não salte mais que 1 nível em relação ao último pai válido
            $parentDepth = min($depth - 1, max(array_keys($stack)));
            while (count($stack) > $parentDepth + 1) {
                array_pop($stack);
            }

            $parent = &$stack[$parentDepth];
            $parent['children'][] = $item;
            $newChildIdx = count($parent['children']) - 1;
            $stack[$parentDepth + 1] = &$parent['children'][$newChildIdx];
            unset($parent);
        }

        return $root;
    }
}
