// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/ZipDirectoryBackup.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\RollbackFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupRecord;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Backup e restauração de código e configuração em arquivos ZIP (`storage/backups/`).
 *
 * Para `BackupScope(core)`:
 * - Inclui: `src/`, `public/` (exceto `uploads`), `themes/`, `vendor/`, `bin/`, `tools/`,
 *   arquivos da raiz e `config/*.json`.
 * - Exclui: `storage/`, `temp/`, `.git/`, `.env`, `database.sqlite`, `uploads/`, `public/uploads/`.
 */
final class ZipDirectoryBackup implements BackupInterface
{
    private const CORE_INCLUDED_DIRS = [
        'src',
        'public',
        'themes',
        'vendor',
        'bin',
        'tools',
        'release',
    ];

    private const EXCLUDED_PREFIXES = [
        'storage/',
        'temp/',
        '.git/',
        'uploads/',
        'public/uploads/',
    ];

    private const EXCLUDED_EXACT = [
        '.env',
        'database.sqlite',
        '.git',
        '.DS_Store',
        'Thumbs.db',
    ];

    private string $rootPath;
    private string $backupsBaseDir;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;
    private ZipPackageExtractor $extractor;

    public function __construct(
        string $rootPath,
        ?string $backupsBaseDir = null,
        ?JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = null,
        ?ZipPackageExtractor $extractor = null,
    ) {
        $this->rootPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->backupsBaseDir = $backupsBaseDir !== null
            ? rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $backupsBaseDir), '/')
            : $this->rootPath . '/storage/backups';
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore ?? new AtomicJsonStore();
        $this->extractor = $extractor ?? new ZipPackageExtractor();
    }

    public function create(BackupScope $scope, string $label): BackupRecord
    {
        $this->ensureBackupsRootProtected();

        $id = gmdate('Ymd_His') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3));
        $scopeDir = $this->resolveScopeDirectory($scope) . '/' . $id;

        if (!is_dir($scopeDir) && !@mkdir($scopeDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($scopeDir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de backup: "%s".', $scopeDir));
        }

        $zipPath = $scopeDir . '/code.zip';

        $filesToBackup = $scope->kind === UpdateKind::Core
            ? $this->collectCoreFiles()
            : $this->collectPluginFiles($scope->slug);

        if (class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            $zip = new ZipArchive();
            if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
                throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar arquivo ZIP de backup: "%s".', $zipPath));
            }

            foreach ($filesToBackup as $relPath) {
                $fullPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;
                if (is_file($fullPath) && !is_link($fullPath)) {
                    $zip->addFile($fullPath, $relPath);
                }
            }

            // Garante que o arquivo ZIP seja gravado mesmo se a árvore tiver apenas marcador vazio
            if ($filesToBackup === []) {
                $zip->addFromString('.ds_empty_backup', '');
            }

            if (!$zip->close()) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao finalizar gravação do arquivo code.zip no backup.');
            }
        } elseif (class_exists(\PharData::class)) {
            @unlink($zipPath);
            $phar = new \PharData($zipPath, 0, null, \Phar::ZIP);
            $fileMap = [];
            foreach ($filesToBackup as $relPath) {
                $fullPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;
                if (is_file($fullPath) && !is_link($fullPath)) {
                    $fileMap[$relPath] = $fullPath;
                }
            }

            if ($fileMap === []) {
                $phar->addFromString('.ds_empty_backup', '');
            } else {
                $phar->buildFromIterator(new \ArrayIterator($fileMap));
            }
        } else {
            throw new RuntimeException('A extensão PHP "zip" ou PharData é obrigatória para criar backups.');
        }

        $record = new BackupRecord(
            id: $id,
            scope: $scope,
            label: $label,
            createdAt: gmdate('c'),
            codePath: $zipPath,
            dumpPath: null,
        );

        $this->jsonStore->write($scopeDir . '/meta.json', $record->toArray());

        return $record;
    }

    /**
     * Associa um caminho de dump de banco de dados ao registro de backup e atualiza `meta.json`.
     */
    public function attachDumpPath(BackupRecord $record, string $dumpPath): BackupRecord
    {
        $updated = new BackupRecord(
            id: $record->id,
            scope: $record->scope,
            label: $record->label,
            createdAt: $record->createdAt,
            codePath: $record->codePath,
            dumpPath: $dumpPath,
        );

        $metaPath = dirname($record->codePath) . '/meta.json';
        $this->jsonStore->write($metaPath, $updated->toArray());

        return $updated;
    }

    public function restore(BackupRecord $record): void
    {
        if (!is_file($record->codePath) || !is_readable($record->codePath)) {
            throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                'Arquivo de backup não encontrado ou ilegível: "%s".',
                $record->codePath
            ));
        }

        $stagingDir = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/.restore-staging-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));

        try {
            $this->extractor->extract($record->codePath, $stagingDir);

            $marker = $stagingDir . '/.ds_empty_backup';
            if (is_file($marker)) {
                @unlink($marker);
            }

            $baseLen = strlen($stagingDir) + 1;
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($stagingDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
                RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
            );

            foreach ($iterator as $item) {
                if (!$item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                    continue;
                }

                $relPath = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
                $this->extractor->assertSafeRelativePath($relPath);

                if ($this->isExcludedRelativePath($relPath)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $destPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;
                $destDir = dirname($destPath);
                if (!is_dir($destDir) && !@mkdir($destDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($destDir)) {
                    throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                        'Não foi possível criar diretório "%s" durante a restauração.',
                        $destDir
                    ));
                }

                $tmpPath = $destDir . '/.' . basename($destPath) . '.dsrestore.' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3));
                if (!@copy($item->getPathname(), $tmpPath)) {
                    throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                        'Falha ao copiar arquivo temporário para "%s" durante a restauração.',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }

                if (DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR === '\\' && is_file($destPath)) {
                    @unlink($destPath);
                }

                if (!@rename($tmpPath, $destPath)) {
                    @unlink($tmpPath);
                    throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                        'Falha ao substituir "%s" durante a restauração.',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($e instanceof RollbackFailedException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new RollbackFailedException('Erro ao restaurar backup de código: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        } finally {
            ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($stagingDir);
        }
    }

    public function list(?BackupScope $scope = null): array
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->backupsBaseDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $scopeDirs = [];
        if ($scope !== null) {
            $dir = $this->resolveScopeDirectory($scope);
            if (is_dir($dir)) {
                $scopeDirs[] = $dir;
            }
        } else {
            $coreDir = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/core';
            if (is_dir($coreDir)) {
                $scopeDirs[] = $coreDir;
            }
            $pluginsBase = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/plugins';
            if (is_dir($pluginsBase)) {
                foreach (scandir($pluginsBase) ?: [] as $slug) {
                    if ($slug === '.' || $slug === '..') {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $pDir = $pluginsBase . '/' . $slug;
                    if (is_dir($pDir)) {
                        $scopeDirs[] = $pDir;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $records = [];
        foreach ($scopeDirs as $sDir) {
            foreach (scandir($sDir) ?: [] as $entry) {
                if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                    continue;
                }
                $metaPath = $sDir . '/' . $entry . '/meta.json';
                if (!is_file($metaPath)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $data = $this->jsonStore->read($metaPath, []);
                if ($data === []) {
                    continue;
                }
                try {
                    $records[] = BackupRecord::fromArray($data);
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }

        usort(
            $records,
            static function (BackupRecord $a, BackupRecord $b): int {
                $cmp = strcmp($b->createdAt, $a->createdAt);
                return $cmp !== 0 ? $cmp : strcmp($b->id, $a->id);
            }
        );

        return $records;
    }

    public function prune(BackupScope $scope, int $keep): int
    {
        $keep = max(0, $keep);
        $records = $this->list($scope);

        if (count($records) <= $keep) {
            return 0;
        }

        $toRemove = array_slice($records, $keep);
        $removedCount = 0;

        foreach ($toRemove as $record) {
            $backupDir = dirname($record->codePath);
            if (is_dir($backupDir)) {
                ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($backupDir);
                $removedCount++;
            }
        }

        return $removedCount;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function collectCoreFiles(): array
    {
        $files = [];

        // 1. Arquivos soltos na raiz
        foreach (scandir($this->rootPath) ?: [] as $entry) {
            if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $full = $this->rootPath . '/' . $entry;
            if (is_file($full) && !is_link($full) && !$this->isExcludedRelativePath($entry)) {
                $files[] = $entry;
            }
        }

        // 2. config/*.json
        $configDir = $this->rootPath . '/config';
        if (is_dir($configDir)) {
            foreach (glob($configDir . '/*.json') ?: [] as $jsonFile) {
                if (is_file($jsonFile) && !is_link($jsonFile)) {
                    $files[] = 'config/' . basename($jsonFile);
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Diretórios do núcleo
        foreach (self::CORE_INCLUDED_DIRS as $dirName) {
            $dirFull = $this->rootPath . '/' . $dirName;
            if (!is_dir($dirFull)) {
                continue;
            }

            $baseLen = strlen($this->rootPath) + 1;
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dirFull, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
                RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
            );

            foreach ($iterator as $item) {
                if (!$item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                    continue;
                }
                $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
                if (!$this->isExcludedRelativePath($rel)) {
                    $files[] = $rel;
                }
            }
        }

        sort($files);
        return array_values(array_unique($files));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function collectPluginFiles(string $slug): array
    {
        $cleanSlug = trim($slug, '/\\');
        $pluginDir = $this->rootPath . '/src/Plugins/' . $cleanSlug;
        if (!is_dir($pluginDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $files = [];
        $baseLen = strlen($this->rootPath) + 1;
        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pluginDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            if (!$item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                continue;
            }
            $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
            if (!$this->isExcludedRelativePath($rel)) {
                $files[] = $rel;
            }
        }

        sort($files);
        return $files;
    }

    private function isExcludedRelativePath(string $relPath): bool
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return true;
        }

        $basename = basename($normalized);
        if (in_array($normalized, self::EXCLUDED_EXACT, true) || in_array($basename, ['.DS_Store', 'Thumbs.db'], true)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (
            str_ends_with($normalized, '.phar')
            || str_ends_with($normalized, '.sqlite')
            || str_ends_with($normalized, '.zip')
            || str_ends_with($normalized, '.sha256')
        ) {
            return true;
        }

        foreach (self::EXCLUDED_PREFIXES as $prefix) {
            if (str_starts_with($normalized, $prefix)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function resolveScopeDirectory(BackupScope $scope): string
    {
        if ($scope->kind === UpdateKind::Core) {
            return $this->backupsBaseDir . '/core';
        }

        return $this->backupsBaseDir . '/plugins/' . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '_', $scope->slug);
    }

    private function ensureBackupsRootProtected(): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->backupsBaseDir)) {
            @mkdir($this->backupsBaseDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $htaccess = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/.htaccess';
        if (!is_file($htaccess)) {
            @file_put_contents(
                $htaccess,
                "<IfModule mod_authz_core.c>\n    Require all denied\n</IfModule>\n<IfModule !mod_authz_core.c>\n    Deny from all\n</IfModule>\n"
            );
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/ZipPackageExtractor.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Extrator seguro de pacotes ZIP em diretório de quarentena.
 *
 * Aplica defesas contra:
 * - Zip-Slip (`..`, caminhos absolutos, barras invertidas, letras de unidade, bytes nulos)
 * - Links simbólicos (atributos Unix S_IFLNK no cabeçalho ZIP ou link criado em disco)
 * - Colisão de caminhos case-insensitive (`Foo.php` vs `foo.php`)
 * - Zip-Bomb (limite de quantidade de arquivos, tamanho total descompactado e razão de compressão)
 */
final class ZipPackageExtractor
{
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_FILES = 20000;
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 157286400; // 150 MB
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO = 100.0;
    private const RATIO_MIN_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES = 1024;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly int $maxFiles = self::DEFAULT_MAX_FILES,
        private readonly int $maxTotalBytes = self::DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES,
        private readonly float $maxCompressionRatio = self::DEFAULT_MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Extrai todos os arquivos do ZIP para `$destinationDir`.
     * Em caso de qualquer violação, remove `$destinationDir` antes de lançar `PackageIntegrityException`.
     *
     * @throws PackageIntegrityException
     */
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationDir): void
    {
        if (!is_file($archivePath) || !is_readable($archivePath)) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Arquivo ZIP de pacote não encontrado ou ilegível: %s', $archivePath));
        }

        if (!class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            if (class_exists(\PharData::class)) {
                $this->extractWithPharData($archivePath, $destinationDir);
                return;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('A extensão PHP "zip" (ZipArchive) ou PharData é obrigatória para extrair pacotes de atualização.');
        }

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $openResult = $zip->open($archivePath, ZipArchive::RDONLY);
        if ($openResult !== true) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Falha ao abrir arquivo ZIP (código %s).', (string)$openResult));
        }

        if (!is_dir($destinationDir) && !@mkdir($destinationDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($destinationDir)) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de quarentena: %s', $destinationDir));
        }

        try {
            $numFiles = $zip->numFiles;
            if ($numFiles > $this->maxFiles) {
                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                    'O pacote excede o limite máximo de entradas permitido (%d > %d).',
                    $numFiles,
                    $this->maxFiles
                ));
            }

            $totalUncompressedBytes = 0;
            $seenLowerPaths = [];

            for ($i = 0; $i < $numFiles; $i++) {
                $stat = $zip->statIndex($i);
                if (!is_array($stat) || !isset($stat['name'])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível ler metadados da entrada #%d do ZIP.', $i));
                }

                $entryName = (string)$stat['name'];
                $this->assertSafeRelativePath($entryName);

                $opsys = 0;
                $attr = 0;
                if ($zip->getExternalAttributesIndex($i, $opsys, $attr)) {
                    $unixMode = ($attr >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
                    if (($unixMode & 0xF000) === 0xA000) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                            'Link simbólico detectado e bloqueado no pacote: "%s".',
                            $entryName
                        ));
                    }
                }

                // Diretório puro
                if (str_ends_with($entryName, '/')) {
                    $dirPath = $destinationDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, rtrim($entryName, '/'));
                    if (!is_dir($dirPath) && !@mkdir($dirPath, 0755, true) && !is_dir($dirPath)) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Falha ao criar diretório na quarentena: "%s".', $entryName));
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                $lowerKey = strtolower($entryName);
                if (isset($seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Colisão de caminhos case-insensitive detectada no pacote: "%s" e "%s".',
                        $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey],
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }
                $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey] = $entryName;

                $declaredUncompressed = (int)($stat['size'] ?? 0);
                $declaredCompressed = (int)($stat['comp_size'] ?? 0);

                if ($declaredUncompressed < 0 || $declaredCompressed < 0) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Tamanho negativo inválido na entrada "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                if ($declaredUncompressed >= self::RATIO_MIN_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES) {
                    if ($declaredCompressed === 0) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Suspeita de Zip-Bomb na entrada "%s" (comp_size=0).', $entryName));
                    }
                    $ratio = (float)$declaredUncompressed / (float)$declaredCompressed;
                    if ($ratio > $this->maxCompressionRatio) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                            'Suspeita de Zip-Bomb na entrada "%s": razão de compressão %.1f excede o limite de %.1f.',
                            $entryName,
                            $ratio,
                            $this->maxCompressionRatio
                        ));
                    }
                }

                if (($totalUncompressedBytes + $declaredUncompressed) > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'O pacote excede o limite máximo de tamanho descompactado (%d bytes).',
                        $this->maxTotalBytes
                    ));
                }

                $targetFile = $destinationDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $entryName);
                $parentDir = dirname($targetFile);
                if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório pai para "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $stream = $zip->getStream($entryName);
                if (!is_resource($stream)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível abrir stream da entrada "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $out = @fopen($targetFile, 'wb');
                if (!is_resource($out)) {
                    fclose($stream);
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar arquivo extraído "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $writtenForFile = 0;
                try {
                    while (!feof($stream)) {
                        $chunk = fread($stream, 65536);
                        if ($chunk === false) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de leitura ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                        $chunkLen = strlen($chunk);
                        if ($chunkLen === 0) {
                            break;
                        }

                        $writtenForFile += $chunkLen;
                        $totalUncompressedBytes += $chunkLen;

                        if ($totalUncompressedBytes > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                                'Limite máximo descompactado (%d bytes) excedido durante a extração de "%s".',
                                $this->maxTotalBytes,
                                $entryName
                            ));
                        }

                        if ($writtenForFile >= self::RATIO_MIN_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES && $declaredCompressed > 0) {
                            $liveRatio = (float)$writtenForFile / (float)$declaredCompressed;
                            if ($liveRatio > $this->maxCompressionRatio) {
                                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                                    'Suspeita de Zip-Bomb em streaming na entrada "%s" (razão %.1f).',
                                    $entryName,
                                    $liveRatio
                                ));
                            }
                        }

                        $written = fwrite($out, $chunk);
                        if ($written === false || $written !== $chunkLen) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de escrita ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    fclose($out);
                    fclose($stream);
                }

                if ($writtenForFile !== $declaredUncompressed) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Tamanho extraído (%d) diverge do cabeçalho ZIP (%d) para "%s".',
                        $writtenForFile,
                        $declaredUncompressed,
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }

                if (is_link($targetFile)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Link simbólico detectado após extração: "%s".', $entryName));
                }
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $zip->close();
            self::removeDirectory($destinationDir);
            if ($e instanceof PackageIntegrityException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Erro ao extrair pacote ZIP: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        $zip->close();
    }

    private function extractWithPharData(string $archivePath, string $destinationDir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($destinationDir) && !@mkdir($destinationDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($destinationDir)) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de quarentena: %s', $destinationDir));
        }

        try {
            $phar = new \PharData($archivePath);
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator($phar, RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY);
            $fileCount = 0;
            $totalUncompressedBytes = 0;
            $seenLowerPaths = [];

            foreach ($iterator as $entry) {
                $fileCount++;
                if ($fileCount > $this->maxFiles) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'O pacote excede o limite máximo de entradas permitido (%d > %d).',
                        $fileCount,
                        $this->maxFiles
                    ));
                }

                $entryName = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $iterator->getSubPathName()), '/');

                $this->assertSafeRelativePath($entryName);

                $lowerKey = strtolower($entryName);
                if (isset($seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Colisão de caminhos case-insensitive detectada no pacote: "%s" e "%s".',
                        $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey],
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }
                $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey] = $entryName;

                $declaredUncompressed = (int)$entry->getSize();
                if (($totalUncompressedBytes + $declaredUncompressed) > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'O pacote excede o limite máximo de tamanho descompactado (%d bytes).',
                        $this->maxTotalBytes
                    ));
                }

                $targetFile = $destinationDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $entryName);
                $parentDir = dirname($targetFile);
                if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório pai para "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $stream = @fopen($entry->getPathname(), 'rb');
                if (!is_resource($stream)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível abrir stream da entrada "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $out = @fopen($targetFile, 'wb');
                if (!is_resource($out)) {
                    fclose($stream);
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar arquivo extraído "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $writtenForFile = 0;
                try {
                    while (!feof($stream)) {
                        $chunk = fread($stream, 65536);
                        if ($chunk === false) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de leitura ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                        $chunkLen = strlen($chunk);
                        if ($chunkLen === 0) {
                            break;
                        }
                        $writtenForFile += $chunkLen;
                        $totalUncompressedBytes += $chunkLen;

                        if ($totalUncompressedBytes > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                                'Limite máximo descompactado (%d bytes) excedido durante a extração de "%s".',
                                $this->maxTotalBytes,
                                $entryName
                            ));
                        }

                        $written = fwrite($out, $chunk);
                        if ($written === false || $written !== $chunkLen) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de escrita ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    fclose($out);
                    fclose($stream);
                }

                if ($writtenForFile !== $declaredUncompressed) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Tamanho extraído (%d) diverge do cabeçalho ZIP (%d) para "%s".',
                        $writtenForFile,
                        $declaredUncompressed,
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }

                if (is_link($targetFile)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Link simbólico detectado após extração: "%s".', $entryName));
                }
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            self::removeDirectory($destinationDir);
            if ($e instanceof PackageIntegrityException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Erro ao extrair pacote ZIP: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Valida que o caminho da entrada do ZIP é seguro e relativo.
     *
     * @throws PackageIntegrityException
     */
    public function assertSafeRelativePath(string $path): void
    {
        if ($path === '' || str_contains($path, "\0")) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Caminho de arquivo vazio ou contendo byte nulo no pacote.');
        }

        if (str_contains($path, '\\')) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Barra invertida não permitida no caminho do pacote: "%s".', $path));
        }

        if (str_starts_with($path, '/')) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Caminho absoluto não permitido no pacote: "%s".', $path));
        }

        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z]:/', $path) === 1) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Letra de unidade não permitida no caminho do pacote: "%s".', $path));
        }

        $trimmed = rtrim($path, '/');
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Entrada de diretório raiz "/" inválida no pacote.');
        }

        $segments = explode('/', $trimmed);
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                    'Segmento de caminho inválido ("%s") detectado em "%s".',
                    $segment,
                    $path
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Remove recursivamente um diretório de quarentena.
     */
    public static function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }

        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::CHILD_FIRST
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            $itemPath = $item->getPathname();
            if ($item->isDir() && !$item->isLink()) {
                @rmdir($itemPath);
            } else {
                @unlink($itemPath);
            }
        }

        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/CoreUpdater.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\CoreUpdaterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\DatabaseBackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MaintenanceModeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ReleaseSourceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaMigratorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaPlannerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateApplierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateLockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateManifestParserInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdatePackageVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStep;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\ApplyException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PreflightFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\RollbackFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SchemaMigrationException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\UpdateException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ApplyResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupRecord;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DownloadedPackage;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HealthReport;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaPlan;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateCheckResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Orquestrador da máquina de estados de atualização do Núcleo (Modelo A).
 *
 * Executa uma etapa por chamada a `advance()`, persistindo o estado antes e depois.
 * Depende exclusivamente de contratos (`DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\*`).
 */
final class CoreUpdater implements CoreUpdaterInterface
{
    private const DEFAULT_LOCK_TTL = 1800;

    private ?VerifiedPackage $cachedVerifiedPackage = null;
    private ?SchemaPlan $cachedSchemaPlan = null;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly UpdateTargetResolverInterface $targetResolver,
        private readonly UpdateCheckerInterface $checker,
        private readonly ReleaseSourceInterface $releaseSource,
        private readonly UpdateManifestParserInterface $manifestParser,
        private readonly UpdatePackageVerifierInterface $packageVerifier,
        private readonly PreflightInterface $preflight,
        private readonly SchemaPlannerInterface $schemaPlanner,
        private readonly BackupInterface $backup,
        private readonly DatabaseBackupInterface $databaseBackup,
        private readonly MaintenanceModeInterface $maintenanceMode,
        private readonly UpdateApplierInterface $applier,
        private readonly SchemaMigratorInterface $schemaMigrator,
        private readonly SchemaVerifierInterface $schemaVerifier,
        private readonly HealthCheckInterface $healthCheck,
        private readonly UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore,
        private readonly UpdateLockInterface $lock,
        private readonly string $tempUpdatesDir,
        private readonly bool $autoRollback = true,
        private readonly ?EventDispatcherInterface $events = null,
        private readonly ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifications = null,
        private readonly int $lockTtlSeconds = self::DEFAULT_LOCK_TTL,
    ) {
    }

    public function kind(): UpdateKind
    {
        return UpdateKind::Core;
    }

    public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult
    {
        $result = $this->checker->check($target, $force);
        if ($result->status === UpdateStatus::Available && $result->release !== null) {
            $this->dispatchEvent('update.available', [
                'target'  => $target,
                'release' => $result->release,
            ]);
        }

        return $result;
    }

    public function begin(UpdateTarget $target, array $options = []): UpdateState
    {
        if (!$this->lock->acquire($target, $this->lockTtlSeconds)) {
            throw new UpdateException('Já existe uma atualização do núcleo em andamento (lock ativo).');
        }

        try {
            $checkResult = $this->checker->check($target, false);
            if ($checkResult->status !== UpdateStatus::Available || $checkResult->release === null) {
                $checkResult = $this->checker->check($target, true);
            }

            if ($checkResult->status !== UpdateStatus::Available || $checkResult->release === null) {
                throw new UpdateException('Nenhuma nova versão disponível para iniciar a atualização.');
            }

            $existing = $this->stateStore->load($target);
            $updateId = 'upd_' . gmdate('Ymd_His') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));

            $context = [
                'options' => [
                    'confirmNoDbBackup' => !empty($options['confirmNoDbBackup']),
                    'inlineHealthCheck' => !empty($options['inlineHealthCheck']),
                ],
            ];
            if (isset($existing->context['notified_version'])) {
                $context['notified_version'] = $existing->context['notified_version'];
            }

            $state = new UpdateState(
                updateId: $updateId,
                target: $target,
                step: UpdateStep::Checked,
                release: $checkResult->release,
                etag: $existing->etag ?? $checkResult->release->etag,
                lastCheckAt: $checkResult->checkedAt,
                context: $context,
                error: null,
                updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
            );

            $this->stateStore->save($state);
            $this->dispatchEvent('update.started', [
                'updateId' => $updateId,
                'target'   => $target,
                'release'  => $checkResult->release,
            ]);

            return $state;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->lock->release($target);
            if ($e instanceof UpdateException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new UpdateException('Não foi possível iniciar a atualização: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    public function advance(string $updateId): UpdateState
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);

        if ($state->updateId !== $updateId) {
            throw new UpdateException(sprintf(
                'ID de atualização "%s" não corresponde ao estado ativo ("%s").',
                $updateId,
                $state->updateId
            ));
        }

        if (in_array($state->step, [UpdateStep::Idle, UpdateStep::Done, UpdateStep::RolledBack, UpdateStep::Failed], true)) {
            return $state;
        }

        // Tratamento de etapa interrompida por queda anterior
        if (isset($state->context['in_progress_step']) && is_string($state->context['in_progress_step'])) {
            $interrupted = UpdateStep::tryFrom($state->context['in_progress_step']);
            if ($interrupted === UpdateStep::Applied || $interrupted === UpdateStep::Migrated) {
                return $this->handleStepFailure(
                    $state,
                    new ApplyException(sprintf('A etapa "%s" foi interrompida abruptamente na execução anterior.', $interrupted->value))
                );
            }
            // Etapas seguras (Downloaded, Verified, Preflighted) limpam o marcador e repetem
            $cleanContext = $state->context;
            unset($cleanContext['in_progress_step']);
            $state = $this->replaceContext($state, $cleanContext);
            $this->stateStore->save($state);
        }

        try {
            return match ($state->step) {
                UpdateStep::Checked        => $this->executeDownloadStep($state),
                UpdateStep::Downloaded     => $this->executeVerifyStep($state),
                UpdateStep::Verified       => $this->executePreflightStep($state),
                UpdateStep::Preflighted    => $this->executeBackupStep($state),
                UpdateStep::BackedUp       => $this->executeMaintenanceOnStep($state),
                UpdateStep::MaintenanceOn  => $this->executeApplyStep($state),
                UpdateStep::Applied        => $this->executeMigrateStep($state),
                UpdateStep::Migrated       => $this->executeVerifySchemaStep($state),
                UpdateStep::SchemaVerified => $this->executeHealthCheckStep($state),
                UpdateStep::HealthChecked  => $this->executeFinalizeStep($state),
                default                    => $state,
            };
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $latestState = $this->stateStore->load($target);
            $effectiveState = $latestState->updateId === $state->updateId ? $latestState : $state;
            return $this->handleStepFailure($effectiveState, $e);
        }
    }

    public function rollback(string $updateId): UpdateState
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);

        if ($state->updateId !== $updateId && $state->updateId !== 'idle') {
            throw new UpdateException(sprintf('ID de atualização "%s" inválido para rollback.', $updateId));
        }

        return $this->executeRollback($state, $state->error ?? 'Rollback solicitado manualmente.');
    }

    public function status(string $updateId): UpdateState
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);

        if ($updateId !== '' && $state->updateId !== 'idle' && $state->updateId !== $updateId) {
            throw new UpdateException(sprintf('ID de atualização "%s" não encontrado.', $updateId));
        }

        return $state;
    }

    private function executeDownloadStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::Downloaded);
        if ($state->release === null) {
            throw new UpdateException('Release ausente no estado para download.');
        }

        $destDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $this->tempUpdatesDir), '/') . '/' . $state->release->version;
        $downloaded = $this->releaseSource->fetchPackage($state->release, $destDir);

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::Downloaded, [
            'archive_path' => $downloaded->archivePath,
            'archive_size' => $downloaded->sizeBytes,
        ]);
    }

    private function executeVerifyStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::Verified);
        if ($state->release === null) {
            throw new UpdateException('Release ausente no estado para verificação.');
        }

        $archivePath = (string)($state->context['archive_path'] ?? '');
        $archiveSize = (int)($state->context['archive_size'] ?? $state->release->sizeBytes);

        $downloaded = new DownloadedPackage(
            release: $state->release,
            archivePath: $archivePath,
            sizeBytes: max(1, $archiveSize),
        );

        $verified = $this->packageVerifier->verify($downloaded);
        $this->cachedVerifiedPackage = $verified;

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::Verified, [
            'extracted_path' => $verified->extractedPath,
        ]);
    }

    private function executePreflightStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::Preflighted);
        $verified = $this->resolveVerifiedPackage($state);

        $report = $this->preflight->run($verified, $state->target);
        if (!$report->canProceed()) {
            $firstBlock = $report->blocks()[0]->message ?? 'Pré-checagem reprovada.';
            throw new PreflightFailedException($firstBlock);
        }

        $schemaPlan = $this->schemaPlanner->plan($verified->manifest, $verified->extractedPath);
        $this->cachedSchemaPlan = $schemaPlan;

        if ($schemaPlan->blocked !== []) {
            throw new PreflightFailedException(sprintf(
                'Downgrade de banco detectado: migrações já executadas ausentes no pacote (%s).',
                implode(', ', $schemaPlan->blocked)
            ));
        }

        $dbSupported = $this->databaseBackup->isSupported();
        $confirmNoDbBackup = !empty($state->context['options']['confirmNoDbBackup']);

        if (($schemaPlan->requiresDatabaseBackup || !$dbSupported) && !$confirmNoDbBackup) {
            throw new PreflightFailedException(
                'O plano exige confirmação explícita (confirmNoDbBackup) para prosseguir sem backup automático de banco ou com migração destrutiva.'
            );
        }

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::Preflighted, [
            'preflight_report' => $report->toArray(),
            'schema_plan'      => [
                'scope'                  => $schemaPlan->scope,
                'pending'                => $schemaPlan->pending,
                'blocked'                => $schemaPlan->blocked,
                'destructive'            => $schemaPlan->destructive,
                'requiresDatabaseBackup' => $schemaPlan->requiresDatabaseBackup,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    private function executeBackupStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::BackedUp);
        $scope = new BackupScope($state->target->kind, $state->target->slug);
        $label = 'pre-update-' . ($state->release?->version ?? 'unknown');

        $record = $this->backup->create($scope, $label);

        if ($this->databaseBackup->isSupported()) {
            $dumpFile = dirname($record->codePath) . '/database.dump';
            $dumpResult = $this->databaseBackup->dump($dumpFile);
            $record = new BackupRecord(
                id: $record->id,
                scope: $record->scope,
                label: $record->label,
                createdAt: $record->createdAt,
                codePath: $record->codePath,
                dumpPath: $dumpResult->dumpPath,
            );
            if (method_exists($this->backup, 'attachDumpPath')) {
                $record = $this->backup->attachDumpPath($record, $dumpResult->dumpPath);
            }
        }

        $this->backup->prune($scope, 2);

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::BackedUp, [
            'backup' => $record->toArray(),
        ]);
    }

    private function executeMaintenanceOnStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::MaintenanceOn);
        $wasOn = $this->maintenanceMode->isEnabled();

        $this->maintenanceMode->enable('Atualizando núcleo para v' . ($state->release?->version ?? ''));

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::MaintenanceOn, [
            'maintenance_was_on' => $wasOn,
        ]);
    }

    private function executeApplyStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        // Instancia/resolve todos os dados necessários antes da troca de arquivos
        $verified = $this->resolveVerifiedPackage($state);
        $backupRecord = $this->resolveBackupRecord($state);

        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::Applied);

        $applyResult = $this->applier->apply($verified, $state->target, $backupRecord);

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::Applied, [
            'apply_result' => [
                'written'          => $applyResult->written,
                'removed'          => $applyResult->removed,
                'skippedProtected' => $applyResult->skippedProtected,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    private function executeMigrateStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::Migrated);
        $schemaPlan = $this->resolveSchemaPlan($state);

        // Registra que a etapa de migração de banco foi iniciada para que o rollback saiba restaurar o dump se falhar
        $stateWithFlag = $this->replaceContext($state, array_replace($state->context, ['migrations_ran' => true]));
        $this->stateStore->save($stateWithFlag);
        $state = $stateWithFlag;

        $result = $this->schemaMigrator->migrate($schemaPlan);
        if (!$result->isOk()) {
            throw new SchemaMigrationException(sprintf(
                'Falha na migração "%s": %s',
                (string)$result->failed,
                (string)$result->error
            ));
        }

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::Migrated, [
            'migrations_ran' => true,
            'schema_result'  => [
                'executed' => $result->executed,
                'failed'   => $result->failed,
                'error'    => $result->error,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    private function executeVerifySchemaStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::SchemaVerified);
        $verified = $this->resolveVerifiedPackage($state);

        $verification = $this->schemaVerifier->verify($verified->manifest);
        if (!$verification->ok) {
            throw new SchemaMigrationException('A verificação pós-migração do schema acusou inconsistências.');
        }

        return $this->completeStep($state, UpdateStep::SchemaVerified, [
            'schema_verification' => [
                'ok'             => $verification->ok,
                'missingTables'  => $verification->missingTables,
                'missingColumns' => $verification->missingColumns,
                'unrecorded'     => $verification->unrecorded,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    private function executeHealthCheckStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        // Emenda 5 / Passo 13: a saúde roda em requisição nova via GET /admin/settings/updates/core/health.
        // Caso o relatório ainda não esteja gravado no contexto, sinaliza `awaiting = health`
        // (exceto quando `inlineHealthCheck` está habilitado explicitamente).
        if (!isset($state->context['health_report']) || !is_array($state->context['health_report'])) {
            if (!empty($state->context['options']['inlineHealthCheck'])) {
                $inlineReport = $this->healthCheck->run($state->target);
                $state = $this->replaceContext($state, array_replace($state->context, [
                    'health_report' => $inlineReport->toArray(),
                ]));
            } else {
                $awaitingContext = $state->context;
                $awaitingContext['awaiting'] = 'health';
                $awaitingState = $this->replaceContext($state, $awaitingContext);
                $this->stateStore->save($awaitingState);
                return $awaitingState;
            }
        }

        $state = $this->markInProgress($state, UpdateStep::HealthChecked);
        $report = HealthReport::fromArray($state->context['health_report']);

        if (!$report->ok) {
            throw new UpdateException('O check de saúde pós-atualização reprovou o estado do sistema.');
        }

        $cleanContext = $state->context;
        unset($cleanContext['awaiting'], $cleanContext['in_progress_step']);

        $nextState = new UpdateState(
            updateId: $state->updateId,
            target: $state->target,
            step: UpdateStep::HealthChecked,
            release: $state->release,
            etag: $state->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
            context: $cleanContext,
            error: null,
            updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
        );

        $this->stateStore->save($nextState);
        $this->dispatchEvent('update.step', [
            'updateId' => $nextState->updateId,
            'step'     => UpdateStep::HealthChecked->value,
        ]);

        return $nextState;
    }

    private function executeFinalizeStep(UpdateState $state): UpdateState
    {
        $wasMaintenanceOn = !empty($state->context['maintenance_was_on']);
        if (!$wasMaintenanceOn) {
            $this->maintenanceMode->disable();
        }

        $this->lock->release($state->target);

        $newVersion = $state->release?->version ?? $state->target->installedVersion;
        $updatedTarget = new UpdateTarget(
            kind: $state->target->kind,
            slug: $state->target->slug,
            repository: $state->target->repository,
            installedVersion: $newVersion,
            channel: $state->target->channel,
        );

        $cleanContext = $state->context;
        unset($cleanContext['in_progress_step'], $cleanContext['awaiting']);

        $doneState = new UpdateState(
            updateId: $state->updateId,
            target: $updatedTarget,
            step: UpdateStep::Done,
            release: $state->release,
            etag: $state->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
            context: $cleanContext,
            error: null,
            updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
        );

        $this->stateStore->save($doneState);

        $this->dispatchEvent('update.completed', [
            'updateId' => $doneState->updateId,
            'version'  => $newVersion,
        ]);

        $this->notifications?->push(
            sprintf('Sistema atualizado com sucesso para a versão v%s.', $newVersion),
            'success',
            'SystemUpdater',
            ['version' => $newVersion]
        );

        return $doneState;
    }

    private function handleStepFailure(UpdateState $state, Throwable $e): UpdateState
    {
        $hasBackup = isset($state->context['backup']) && is_array($state->context['backup']);

        if ($hasBackup && $this->autoRollback) {
            return $this->executeRollback($state, $e->getMessage());
        }

        // Sem backup ainda (ou auto_rollback desligado): desliga manutenção se foi o updater que ligou e libera lock
        if (array_key_exists('maintenance_was_on', $state->context) && empty($state->context['maintenance_was_on'])) {
            $this->maintenanceMode->disable();
        }

        $this->lock->release($state->target);

        $cleanContext = $state->context;
        unset($cleanContext['in_progress_step'], $cleanContext['awaiting']);

        $failedState = new UpdateState(
            updateId: $state->updateId,
            target: $state->target,
            step: UpdateStep::Failed,
            release: $state->release,
            etag: $state->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
            context: $cleanContext,
            error: $e->getMessage(),
            updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
        );

        $this->stateStore->save($failedState);

        $this->dispatchEvent('update.failed', [
            'updateId' => $failedState->updateId,
            'error'    => $e->getMessage(),
        ]);

        $this->notifications?->push(
            'Falha na atualização do sistema: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            'error',
            'SystemUpdater',
            ['updateId' => $failedState->updateId]
        );

        return $failedState;
    }

    private function executeRollback(UpdateState $state, string $reason): UpdateState
    {
        $rollingBackState = $state->withStep(UpdateStep::RollingBack);
        $this->stateStore->save($rollingBackState);

        try {
            if (isset($state->context['backup']) && is_array($state->context['backup'])) {
                $backupRecord = BackupRecord::fromArray($state->context['backup']);

                $applyData = is_array($state->context['apply_result'] ?? null)
                    ? $state->context['apply_result']
                    : ['written' => [], 'removed' => [], 'skippedProtected' => []];

                $applyResult = new ApplyResult(
                    backup: $backupRecord,
                    written: array_values(array_map('strval', $applyData['written'] ?? [])),
                    removed: array_values(array_map('strval', $applyData['removed'] ?? [])),
                    skippedProtected: array_values(array_map('strval', $applyData['skippedProtected'] ?? [])),
                );

                $this->applier->revert($applyResult);

                if (!empty($state->context['migrations_ran']) && $backupRecord->dumpPath !== null) {
                    $this->databaseBackup->restore($backupRecord->dumpPath);
                }
            }

            $wasMaintenanceOn = !empty($state->context['maintenance_was_on']);
            if (!$wasMaintenanceOn) {
                $this->maintenanceMode->disable();
            }

            $this->lock->release($state->target);

            $cleanContext = $state->context;
            unset($cleanContext['in_progress_step'], $cleanContext['awaiting']);

            $rolledBackState = new UpdateState(
                updateId: $state->updateId,
                target: $state->target,
                step: UpdateStep::RolledBack,
                release: $state->release,
                etag: $state->etag,
                lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
                context: $cleanContext,
                error: $reason !== '' ? $reason : 'Atualização revertida.',
                updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
            );

            $this->stateStore->save($rolledBackState);

            $this->dispatchEvent('update.rolled_back', [
                'updateId' => $rolledBackState->updateId,
                'reason'   => $reason,
            ]);

            $this->notifications?->push(
                'A atualização falhou e foi revertida automaticamente: ' . $reason,
                'warning',
                'SystemUpdater',
                ['updateId' => $rolledBackState->updateId]
            );

            return $rolledBackState;
        } catch (RollbackFailedException|Throwable $rollbackError) {
            // Pior caso (Passo 14): mantém o modo de manutenção ligado para proteger os visitantes!
            try {
                if (!$this->maintenanceMode->isEnabled()) {
                    $this->maintenanceMode->enable('Manutenção de emergência após falha de rollback.');
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
            }

            $this->lock->release($state->target);

            $criticalMessage = sprintf(
                'Falha crítica no rollback (%s) após erro (%s). Execute via CLI: php os-cli.php system:rollback',
                $rollbackError->getMessage(),
                $reason
            );

            $cleanContext = $state->context;
            unset($cleanContext['in_progress_step'], $cleanContext['awaiting']);

            $failedState = new UpdateState(
                updateId: $state->updateId,
                target: $state->target,
                step: UpdateStep::Failed,
                release: $state->release,
                etag: $state->etag,
                lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
                context: $cleanContext,
                error: $criticalMessage,
                updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
            );

            $this->stateStore->save($failedState);

            $this->dispatchEvent('update.failed', [
                'updateId' => $failedState->updateId,
                'error'    => $criticalMessage,
                'critical' => true,
            ]);

            $this->notifications?->push(
                $criticalMessage,
                'error',
                'SystemUpdater',
                ['updateId' => $failedState->updateId, 'cli' => 'php os-cli.php system:rollback']
            );

            return $failedState;
        }
    }

    private function markInProgress(UpdateState $state, UpdateStep $targetStep): UpdateState
    {
        $ctx = $state->context;
        $ctx['in_progress_step'] = $targetStep->value;
        $updated = $this->replaceContext($state, $ctx);
        $this->stateStore->save($updated);
        return $updated;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $extraContext
     */
    private function completeStep(UpdateState $state, UpdateStep $completedStep, array $extraContext = []): UpdateState
    {
        $ctx = array_replace($state->context, $extraContext);
        unset($ctx['in_progress_step'], $ctx['awaiting']);

        $next = new UpdateState(
            updateId: $state->updateId,
            target: $state->target,
            step: $completedStep,
            release: $state->release,
            etag: $state->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
            context: $ctx,
            error: null,
            updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
        );

        $this->stateStore->save($next);

        $this->dispatchEvent('update.step', [
            'updateId' => $next->updateId,
            'step'     => $completedStep->value,
        ]);

        return $next;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $newContext
     */
    private function replaceContext(UpdateState $state, array $newContext): UpdateState
    {
        return new UpdateState(
            updateId: $state->updateId,
            target: $state->target,
            step: $state->step,
            release: $state->release,
            etag: $state->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
            context: $newContext,
            error: $state->error,
            updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
        );
    }

    private function resolveVerifiedPackage(UpdateState $state): VerifiedPackage
    {
        if ($this->cachedVerifiedPackage !== null) {
            return $this->cachedVerifiedPackage;
        }

        if ($state->release === null) {
            throw new UpdateException('Release ausente no estado.');
        }

        $extractedPath = (string)($state->context['extracted_path'] ?? '');
        if ($extractedPath === '') {
            throw new UpdateException('Caminho de quarentena (extracted_path) ausente no estado.');
        }

        $manifestPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $extractedPath), '/') . '/manifest.json';
        $rawManifest = is_file($manifestPath) ? (string)file_get_contents($manifestPath) : '';
        $manifest = $this->manifestParser->parse($rawManifest);

        $this->cachedVerifiedPackage = new VerifiedPackage(
            release: $state->release,
            manifest: $manifest,
            extractedPath: $extractedPath,
        );

        return $this->cachedVerifiedPackage;
    }

    private function resolveBackupRecord(UpdateState $state): BackupRecord
    {
        if (!isset($state->context['backup']) || !is_array($state->context['backup'])) {
            throw new UpdateException('Registro de backup ausente no estado.');
        }

        return BackupRecord::fromArray($state->context['backup']);
    }

    private function resolveSchemaPlan(UpdateState $state): SchemaPlan
    {
        if ($this->cachedSchemaPlan !== null) {
            return $this->cachedSchemaPlan;
        }

        if (isset($state->context['schema_plan']) && is_array($state->context['schema_plan'])) {
            $raw = $state->context['schema_plan'];
            return new SchemaPlan(
                scope: (string)($raw['scope'] ?? '__core__'),
                pending: is_array($raw['pending'] ?? null) ? $raw['pending'] : [],
                blocked: is_array($raw['blocked'] ?? null) ? $raw['blocked'] : [],
                destructive: !empty($raw['destructive']),
                requiresDatabaseBackup: !empty($raw['requiresDatabaseBackup']),
            );
        }

        $verified = $this->resolveVerifiedPackage($state);
        return $this->schemaPlanner->plan($verified->manifest, $verified->extractedPath);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
     */
    private function dispatchEvent(string $eventName, array $payload): void
    {
        try {
            $this->events?->dispatch($eventName, $payload);
        } catch (Throwable) {
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/JsonUpdateManifestParser.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateManifestParserInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\InvalidManifestException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateManifest;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use JsonException;

/**
 * Parser e validador estrito do `manifest.json` de pacotes de atualização (protocolo v1).
 */
final class JsonUpdateManifestParser implements UpdateManifestParserInterface
{
    /**
     * @return list<int>
     */
    public function supportedProtocols(): array
    {
        return [1];
    }

    public function parse(string $json): UpdateManifest
    {
        if (trim($json) === '') {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O conteúdo do manifest.json está vazio.');
        }

        try {
            $data = json_decode($json, true, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException $e) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('JSON inválido no manifest.json: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        if (!is_array($data)) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O manifest.json deve representar um objeto JSON.');
        }

        $requiredKeys = [
            'protocol',
            'minUpdaterProtocol',
            'kind',
            'slug',
            'version',
            'requires',
            'files',
            'removed',
            'migrations',
            'expects',
        ];

        foreach ($requiredKeys as $key) {
            if (!array_key_exists($key, $data)) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Campo obrigatório "%s" ausente no manifest.json.', $key));
            }
        }

        if (!is_int($data['protocol'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "protocol" deve ser um inteiro.');
        }

        if (!in_array($data['protocol'], $this->supportedProtocols(), true)) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf(
                'Protocolo de manifest %d não suportado por este atualizador (suportados: %s).',
                $data['protocol'],
                implode(', ', $this->supportedProtocols())
            ));
        }

        if (!is_int($data['minUpdaterProtocol']) || $data['minUpdaterProtocol'] < 1) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "minUpdaterProtocol" deve ser um inteiro >= 1.');
        }

        if (!is_string($data['kind'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "kind" deve ser uma string.');
        }

        $kind = UpdateKind::tryFrom($data['kind']);
        if ($kind === null) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Valor inválido para "kind": "%s".', $data['kind']));
        }

        if (!is_string($data['slug']) || trim($data['slug']) === '') {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "slug" deve ser uma string não vazia.');
        }

        if (!is_string($data['version']) || trim($data['version']) === '') {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "version" deve ser uma string não vazia.');
        }

        if (!is_array($data['requires'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "requires" deve ser um objeto.');
        }

        if (
            !array_key_exists('php', $data['requires'])
            || !array_key_exists('extensions', $data['requires'])
            || !array_key_exists('osVersion', $data['requires'])
            || !is_string($data['requires']['php'])
            || !is_array($data['requires']['extensions'])
            || !is_string($data['requires']['osVersion'])
        ) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "requires" deve conter "php" (string), "extensions" (lista) e "osVersion" (string).');
        }

        $extensions = [];
        foreach ($data['requires']['extensions'] as $ext) {
            if (!is_string($ext) || trim($ext) === '') {
                throw new InvalidManifestException('Cada item de "requires.extensions" deve ser uma string não vazia.');
            }
            $extensions[] = $ext;
        }

        if (!is_array($data['files'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "files" deve ser uma lista.');
        }

        $files = [];
        foreach ($data['files'] as $idx => $entry) {
            if (!is_array($entry)) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Entrada files[%d] deve ser um objeto.', (int)$idx));
            }
            if (
                !array_key_exists('path', $entry)
                || !array_key_exists('sha256', $entry)
                || !array_key_exists('size', $entry)
                || !is_string($entry['path'])
                || !is_string($entry['sha256'])
                || !is_int($entry['size'])
            ) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Entrada files[%d] não possui path, sha256 ou size válidos.', (int)$idx));
            }
            $mode = $entry['mode'] ?? 'replace';
            if (!is_string($mode) || !in_array($mode, ['replace', 'default_if_missing'], true)) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Entrada files[%d] possui mode inválido.', (int)$idx));
            }

            $files[] = [
                'path' => $entry['path'],
                'sha256' => strtolower($entry['sha256']),
                'size' => $entry['size'],
                'mode' => $mode,
            ];
        }

        if (!is_array($data['removed'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "removed" deve ser uma lista.');
        }

        $removed = [];
        foreach ($data['removed'] as $idx => $removedPath) {
            if (!is_string($removedPath) || trim($removedPath) === '') {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Entrada removed[%d] deve ser uma string não vazia.', (int)$idx));
            }
            $removed[] = $removedPath;
        }

        if (!is_array($data['migrations'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "migrations" deve ser uma lista.');
        }

        $migrations = [];
        foreach ($data['migrations'] as $idx => $mig) {
            if (!is_array($mig)) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Entrada migrations[%d] deve ser um objeto.', (int)$idx));
            }
            if (
                !array_key_exists('scope', $mig)
                || !array_key_exists('name', $mig)
                || !array_key_exists('sha256', $mig)
                || !array_key_exists('type', $mig)
                || !is_string($mig['scope'])
                || !is_string($mig['name'])
                || !is_string($mig['sha256'])
                || !is_string($mig['type'])
            ) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Entrada migrations[%d] incompleta ou com tipos inválidos.', (int)$idx));
            }

            $migrations[] = [
                'scope' => $mig['scope'],
                'name' => $mig['name'],
                'sha256' => strtolower($mig['sha256']),
                'type' => $mig['type'],
            ];
        }

        if (!is_array($data['expects'])) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException('O campo "expects" deve ser um objeto mapa de tabela => colunas.');
        }

        $expects = [];
        foreach ($data['expects'] as $table => $columns) {
            if (!is_string($table) || trim($table) === '' || !is_array($columns)) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException('Cada entrada em "expects" deve mapear nome de tabela (string) para lista de colunas.');
            }
            $colList = [];
            foreach ($columns as $col) {
                if (!is_string($col) || trim($col) === '') {
                    throw new InvalidManifestException(sprintf('Coluna inválida em expects["%s"].', $table));
                }
                $colList[] = $col;
            }
            $expects[$table] = $colList;
        }

        try {
            return new UpdateManifest(
                protocol: $data['protocol'],
                minUpdaterProtocol: $data['minUpdaterProtocol'],
                kind: $kind,
                slug: $data['slug'],
                version: $data['version'],
                requires: [
                    'php' => $data['requires']['php'],
                    'extensions' => $extensions,
                    'osVersion' => $data['requires']['osVersion'],
                ],
                files: $files,
                removed: $removed,
                migrations: $migrations,
                expects: $expects,
            );
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            throw new InvalidManifestException($e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }
}
