// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/Preflight.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightReport;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Agregador Composite das verificações de pré-atualização (Preflight).
 */
final class Preflight implements PreflightInterface
{
    /** @var list<PreflightCheckInterface> */
    private array $checks = [];

    /**
     * @param iterable<PreflightCheckInterface> $checks
     */
    public function __construct(iterable $checks = [])
    {
        foreach ($checks as $check) {
            $this->checks[] = $check;
        }
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): PreflightReport
    {
        $items = [];

        foreach ($this->checks as $check) {
            try {
                $results = $check->run($package, $target);
                foreach ($results as $item) {
                    $items[] = $item;
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $items[] = new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $check->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: sprintf('Erro na verificação "%s": %s', $check->id(), $e->getMessage()),
                );
            }
        }

        return new PreflightReport($items);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/SchemaPlanner.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MigrationRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaPlannerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SchemaPlanException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaPlan;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateManifest;

/**
 * Planejador estático (dry-run) de migrações declaradas no `UpdateManifest`.
 *
 * Valida existência, hash SHA-256 e estrutura estática de cada arquivo de migration
 * na quarentena sem executar nem dar `require` no arquivo PHP.
 */
final class SchemaPlanner implements SchemaPlannerInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly MigrationRegistryInterface $registry,
    ) {
    }

    public function plan(UpdateManifest $manifest, string $extractedPath): SchemaPlan
    {
        $baseDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $extractedPath), '/');
        $defaultScope = $manifest->kind === UpdateKind::Core ? '__core__' : $manifest->slug;

        /** @var array<string, list<string>> $executedByScope */
        $executedByScope = [
            $defaultScope => $this->registry->executed($defaultScope),
        ];

        /** @var array<string, array<string, bool>> $manifestNamesByScope */
        $manifestNamesByScope = [
            $defaultScope => [],
        ];

        $pending = [];
        $destructive = false;

        foreach ($manifest->migrations as $mig) {
            $scope = $mig['scope'];
            $name = $mig['name'];
            $expectedSha = strtolower($mig['sha256']);
            $type = $mig['type'];

            if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/', $name) !== 1) {
                throw new SchemaPlanException(sprintf('Nome de migration inválido no manifest: "%s".', $name));
            }

            if (!isset($executedByScope[$scope])) {
                $executedByScope[$scope] = $this->registry->executed($scope);
            }
            $manifestNamesByScope[$scope][$name] = true;

            $relPath = $this->resolveRelativeMigrationPath($scope, $name);
            $fullPath = $baseDir . '/' . $relPath;

            if (!is_file($fullPath) || !is_readable($fullPath)) {
                throw new SchemaPlanException(sprintf(
                    'Arquivo de migration declarado no manifest não encontrado na quarentena: "%s".',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            $actualSha = hash_file('sha256', $fullPath);
            if ($actualSha === false || !hash_equals($expectedSha, strtolower($actualSha))) {
                throw new SchemaPlanException(sprintf(
                    'Hash SHA-256 da migration "%s" diverge do declarado no manifest.',
                    $name
                ));
            }

            $source = file_get_contents($fullPath);
            if ($source === false || !$this->hasValidMigrationStructure($source)) {
                throw new SchemaPlanException(sprintf(
                    'Estrutura estática inválida na migration "%s": deve retornar array com chave "up".',
                    $name
                ));
            }

            if (!in_array($name, $executedByScope[$scope], true)) {
                $pending[] = [
                    'scope' => $scope,
                    'name' => $name,
                    'sha256' => $expectedSha,
                    'type' => $type,
                    'path' => $relPath,
                ];

                if ($type === 'destructive') {
                    $destructive = true;
                }
            }
        }

        $blocked = [];
        foreach ($executedByScope as $scope => $executedList) {
            $knownInManifest = $manifestNamesByScope[$scope] ?? [];
            foreach ($executedList as $executedName) {
                if (!isset($knownInManifest[$executedName])) {
                    $blocked[] = $executedName;
                }
            }
        }

        return new SchemaPlan(
            scope: $defaultScope,
            pending: $pending,
            blocked: $blocked,
            destructive: $destructive,
            requiresDatabaseBackup: $destructive,
        );
    }

    private function resolveRelativeMigrationPath(string $scope, string $name): string
    {
        if ($scope === '__core__') {
            return 'src/Core/Database/migrations/' . $name . '.php';
        }

        return 'src/Plugins/' . trim($scope, '/\\') . '/migrations/' . $name . '.php';
    }

    private function hasValidMigrationStructure(string $phpSource): bool
    {
        if (!str_contains($phpSource, '<?php')) {
            return false;
        }

        if (preg_match('/\breturn\s*(\[|array\s*\()/s', $phpSource) !== 1) {
            return false;
        }

        if (preg_match('/[\'"]up[\'"]\s*=>/s', $phpSource) !== 1) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/SchemaVerifier.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MigrationRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaProbeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaVerification;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateManifest;

/**
 * Verificador pós-migração da estrutura efetiva do banco de dados (`expects` + `migrations`).
 */
final class SchemaVerifier implements SchemaVerifierInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly SchemaProbeInterface $probe,
        private readonly MigrationRegistryInterface $registry,
    ) {
    }

    public function verify(UpdateManifest $manifest): SchemaVerification
    {
        $missingTables = [];
        $missingColumns = [];
        $unrecorded = [];

        foreach ($manifest->expects as $table => $columns) {
            if (!$this->probe->hasTable($table)) {
                $missingTables[] = $table;
                foreach ($columns as $col) {
                    $missingColumns[] = $table . '.' . $col;
                }
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($columns as $col) {
                if (!$this->probe->hasColumn($table, $col)) {
                    $missingColumns[] = $table . '.' . $col;
                }
            }
        }

        /** @var array<string, list<string>> $executedByScope */
        $executedByScope = [];
        foreach ($manifest->migrations as $mig) {
            $scope = $mig['scope'];
            $name = $mig['name'];

            if (!isset($executedByScope[$scope])) {
                $executedByScope[$scope] = $this->registry->executed($scope);
            }

            if (!in_array($name, $executedByScope[$scope], true)) {
                $unrecorded[] = $name;
            }
        }

        $ok = ($missingTables === [] && $missingColumns === [] && $unrecorded === []);

        return new SchemaVerification(
            ok: $ok,
            missingTables: $missingTables,
            missingColumns: $missingColumns,
            unrecorded: $unrecorded,
        );
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/SemverComparator.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\VersionComparatorInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final class SemverComparator implements VersionComparatorInterface
{
    private const SEMVER_REGEX = '/^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:-((?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*))?$/';

    public function isValid(string $version): bool
    {
        return preg_match(self::SEMVER_REGEX, $version) === 1;
    }

    public function normalize(string $versionOrTag): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($versionOrTag);
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, 'v') || str_starts_with($trimmed, 'V')) {
            $trimmed = substr($trimmed, 1);
        }

        if (!$this->isValid($trimmed)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Versão SemVer inválida: {$versionOrTag}");
        }

        return $trimmed;
    }

    public function compare(string $a, string $b): int
    {
        $parsedA = $this->parse($a);
        $parsedB = $this->parse($b);

        foreach (['major', 'minor', 'patch'] as $part) {
            if ($parsedA[$part] !== $parsedB[$part]) {
                return $parsedA[$part] <=> $parsedB[$part];
            }
        }

        $preA = $parsedA['prerelease'];
        $preB = $parsedB['prerelease'];

        if ($preA === null && $preB === null) {
            return 0;
        }
        // Versão sem prerelease tem precedência maior que com prerelease (ex.: 2.4.0 > 2.4.0-beta.1)
        if ($preA === null) {
            return 1;
        }
        if ($preB === null) {
            return -1;
        }

        $idsA = explode('.', $preA);
        $idsB = explode('.', $preB);
        $max = max(count($idsA), count($idsB));

        for ($i = 0; $i < $max; $i++) {
            if (!isset($idsA[$i])) {
                return -1;
            }
            if (!isset($idsB[$i])) {
                return 1;
            }

            $idA = $idsA[$i];
            $idB = $idsB[$i];
            if ($idA === $idB) {
                continue;
            }

            $numA = ctype_digit($idA);
            $numB = ctype_digit($idB);

            if ($numA && $numB) {
                return ((int)$idA) <=> ((int)$idB);
            }
            if ($numA) {
                return -1; // Identificador numérico tem menor precedência que alfanumérico em SemVer 2.0.0
            }
            if ($numB) {
                return 1;
            }

            return strcmp($idA, $idB) < 0 ? -1 : 1;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public function isNewer(string $candidate, string $installed): bool
    {
        return $this->compare($candidate, $installed) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{major: int, minor: int, patch: int, prerelease: ?string}
     */
    private function parse(string $version): array
    {
        if (preg_match(self::SEMVER_REGEX, $version, $matches) !== 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Versão SemVer estrita inválida: {$version}");
        }

        return [
            'major'      => (int)$matches[1],
            'minor'      => (int)$matches[2],
            'patch'      => (int)$matches[3],
            'prerelease' => isset($matches[4]) && $matches[4] !== '' ? $matches[4] : null,
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/UpdateChecker.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use Closure;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ReleaseSourceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\VersionComparatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateCheckResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use Throwable;

final class UpdateChecker implements UpdateCheckerInterface
{
    /**
     * @var Closure(): int
     */
    private Closure $clock;

    /**
     * @param (Closure(): int)|null $clock
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReleaseSourceInterface $releaseSource,
        private readonly VersionComparatorInterface $versionComparator,
        private readonly UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore,
        private readonly int $ttlHours = 12,
        ?Closure $clock = null,
        private readonly ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifications = null,
    ) {
        $this->clock = $clock ?? static fn(): int => time();
    }

    public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult
    {
        $nowTs = ($this->clock)();
        $nowIso = gmdate('c', $nowTs);

        try {
            $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);

            if (!$force && $this->isCacheFresh($state->lastCheckAt, $nowTs) && $state->release !== null) {
                $result = $this->evaluateRelease($target, $state->release, $state->lastCheckAt ?? $nowIso);
                (new UpdateNotifier($this->stateStore, $this->notifications))->notifyIfAvailable($result);
                return $result;
            }

            $knownEtag = $force ? null : $state->etag;
            $latest = $this->releaseSource->latest($target, $knownEtag);

            if ($latest === null) {
                // 304 Not Modified: usa release em cache se existir, atualizando lastCheckAt
                if ($state->release === null) {
                    return new UpdateCheckResult(
                        status: UpdateStatus::Unknown,
                        target: $target,
                        release: null,
                        reasons: ['Resposta 304 recebida sem release prévia em cache.'],
                        checkedAt: $nowIso,
                    );
                }

                $updatedState = $state->withRelease(
                    release: $state->release,
                    etag: $state->etag,
                    lastCheckAt: $nowIso,
                    updatedAt: $nowIso,
                );
                $this->stateStore->save($updatedState);

                $result = $this->evaluateRelease($target, $state->release, $nowIso);
                (new UpdateNotifier($this->stateStore, $this->notifications))->notifyIfAvailable($result);
                return $result;
            }

            $updatedState = $state->withRelease(
                release: $latest,
                etag: $latest->etag ?? $state->etag,
                lastCheckAt: $nowIso,
                updatedAt: $nowIso,
            );
            $this->stateStore->save($updatedState);

            $result = $this->evaluateRelease($target, $latest, $nowIso);
            (new UpdateNotifier($this->stateStore, $this->notifications))->notifyIfAvailable($result);
            return $result;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return new UpdateCheckResult(
                status: UpdateStatus::Unknown,
                target: $target,
                release: null,
                reasons: [$e->getMessage()],
                checkedAt: $nowIso,
            );
        }
    }

    private function evaluateRelease(UpdateTarget $target, ReleaseInfo $release, string $checkedAt): UpdateCheckResult
    {
        if ($this->versionComparator->isNewer($release->version, $target->installedVersion)) {
            return new UpdateCheckResult(
                status: UpdateStatus::Available,
                target: $target,
                release: $release,
                reasons: ["Nova versão {$release->version} disponível."],
                checkedAt: $checkedAt,
            );
        }

        return new UpdateCheckResult(
            status: UpdateStatus::UpToDate,
            target: $target,
            release: $release,
            reasons: [],
            checkedAt: $checkedAt,
        );
    }

    private function isCacheFresh(?string $lastCheckAt, int $nowTs): bool
    {
        if ($lastCheckAt === null || trim($lastCheckAt) === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $parsed = strtotime($lastCheckAt);
        if ($parsed === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $ttlSeconds = max(1, $this->ttlHours) * 3600;
        return ($nowTs - $parsed) < $ttlSeconds;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/UpdateNotifier.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateCheckResult;

final class UpdateNotifier
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore,
        private readonly ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifications = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Dispara uma notificação no painel administrativo caso haja nova versão disponível
     * e ela ainda não tenha sido notificada anteriormente.
     */
    public function notifyIfAvailable(UpdateCheckResult $result): bool
    {
        if (
            $this->notifications === null
            || $result->status !== UpdateStatus::Available
            || $result->release === null
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        $newVersion = $result->release->version;
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($result->target);
        $alreadyNotified = (string)($state->context['notified_version'] ?? '');

        if ($alreadyNotified === $newVersion) {
            return false;
        }

        $updatedState = $state->withContext(['notified_version' => $newVersion]);
        $this->stateStore->save($updatedState);

        $this->notifications->push(
            "Nova versão v{$newVersion} do Domain-System OS disponível para atualização.",
            'info',
            'SystemUpdater',
            [
                'version' => $newVersion,
                'tag'     => $result->release->tag,
            ],
        );

        return true;
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Value/HealthReport.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value;

use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class HealthReport
{
    /**
     * @param list<PreflightCheck|array{id: string, ok: bool, message: string}> $checks
     */
    public function __construct(
        public bool $ok,
        public array $checks,
    ) {
        foreach ($this->checks as $check) {
            if ($check instanceof PreflightCheck) {
                continue;
            }
            if (
                !is_array($check)
                || !isset($check['id'], $check['ok'], $check['message'])
                || !is_string($check['id'])
                || trim($check['id']) === ''
                || !is_bool($check['ok'])
                || !is_string($check['message'])
                || trim($check['message']) === ''
            ) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Item inválido em HealthReport::checks.');
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array{ok: bool, checks: list<array<string, mixed>>}
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'ok'     => $this->ok,
            'checks' => array_values(array_map(
                static fn(PreflightCheck|array $check): array => $check instanceof PreflightCheck ? $check->toArray() : $check,
                $this->checks,
            )),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        $rawChecks = is_array($data['checks'] ?? null) ? $data['checks'] : [];
        $parsed = [];
        foreach ($rawChecks as $item) {
            if (!is_array($item)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (isset($item['level'])) {
                $parsed[] = PreflightCheck::fromArray($item);
            } else {
                $parsed[] = [
                    'id'      => (string)($item['id'] ?? ''),
                    'ok'      => (bool)($item['ok'] ?? false),
                    'message' => (string)($item['message'] ?? ''),
                ];
            }
        }

        return new self(
            ok: (bool)($data['ok'] ?? false),
            checks: $parsed,
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value;

use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class HttpResponse
{
    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $headers
     */
    public function __construct(
        public int $statusCode,
        public array $headers,
        public string $body,
        public ?string $etag = null,
    ) {
        if ($this->statusCode < 100 || $this->statusCode > 599) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O statusCode de HttpResponse deve estar entre 100 e 599.');
        }
        foreach ($this->headers as $name => $val) {
            if (!is_string($name) || trim($name) === '' || !is_string($val)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Cabeçalhos de HttpResponse devem ter chave string não vazia e valor string.');
            }
        }
    }

    public function isNotModified(): bool
    {
        return $this->statusCode === 304;
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Value/PreflightReport.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class PreflightReport
{
    /**
     * @param list<PreflightCheck> $checks
     */
    public function __construct(
        public array $checks,
    ) {
        foreach ($this->checks as $check) {
            if (!$check instanceof PreflightCheck) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Todos os itens de PreflightReport::checks devem ser instâncias de PreflightCheck.');
            }
        }
    }

    public function canProceed(): bool
    {
        foreach ($this->checks as $check) {
            if ($check->level === CheckLevel::Block) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<PreflightCheck>
     */
    public function warnings(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            $this->checks,
            static fn(PreflightCheck $check): bool => $check->level === CheckLevel::Warn,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<PreflightCheck>
     */
    public function blocks(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            $this->checks,
            static fn(PreflightCheck $check): bool => $check->level === CheckLevel::Block,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return array{canProceed: bool, checks: list<array{id: string, level: string, message: string}>}
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'canProceed' => $this->canProceed(),
            'checks'     => array_values(array_map(
                static fn(PreflightCheck $check): array => $check->toArray(),
                $this->checks,
            )),
        ];
    }
}

            sha256: (string)($data['sha256'] ?? ''),
            etag: isset($data['etag']) && $data['etag'] !== '' ? (string)$data['etag'] : null,
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Value/SchemaPlan.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value;

use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class SchemaPlan
{
    /**
     * @param list<array{scope: string, name: string, sha256: string, type: string, path?: string}> $pending
     * @param list<string> $blocked
     */
    public function __construct(
        public string $scope,
        public array $pending,
        public array $blocked,
        public bool $destructive,
        public bool $requiresDatabaseBackup,
    ) {
        if (trim($this->scope) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O escopo do SchemaPlan não pode ser vazio.');
        }

        foreach ($this->pending as $item) {
            if (
                !is_array($item)
                || !isset($item['scope'], $item['name'], $item['sha256'], $item['type'])
                || !is_string($item['scope'])
                || trim($item['scope']) === ''
                || !is_string($item['name'])
                || trim($item['name']) === ''
                || !is_string($item['sha256'])
                || preg_match('/^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/', $item['sha256']) !== 1
                || !in_array($item['type'], ['additive', 'destructive'], true)
            ) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Item pendente inválido em SchemaPlan::pending.');
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->blocked as $blockedMigration) {
            if (!is_string($blockedMigration) || trim($blockedMigration) === '') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Cada item em SchemaPlan::blocked deve ser uma string não vazia.');
            }
        }
    }
}

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class UpdateManifest
{
    /**
     * @param array{php: string, extensions: list<string>, osVersion: string} $requires
     * @param list<array{path: string, sha256: string, size: int, mode: string}> $files
     * @param list<string> $removed
     * @param list<array{scope: string, name: string, sha256: string, type: string}> $migrations
     * @param array<string, list<string>> $expects
     */
    public function __construct(
        public int $protocol,
        public int $minUpdaterProtocol,
        public UpdateKind $kind,
        public string $slug,
        public string $version,
        public array $requires,
        public array $files,
        public array $removed,
        public array $migrations,
        public array $expects,
    ) {
        if ($this->protocol < 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O protocolo do UpdateManifest deve ser >= 1.');
        }
        if ($this->minUpdaterProtocol < 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O minUpdaterProtocol do UpdateManifest deve ser >= 1.');
        }
        if (trim($this->slug) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O slug do UpdateManifest não pode ser vazio.');
        }
        if (trim($this->version) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A versão do UpdateManifest não pode ser vazia.');
        }

        if (
            !isset($this->requires['php'], $this->requires['extensions'], $this->requires['osVersion'])
            || !is_string($this->requires['php'])
            || trim($this->requires['php']) === ''
            || !is_array($this->requires['extensions'])
            || !is_string($this->requires['osVersion'])
            || trim($this->requires['osVersion']) === ''
        ) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo requires do UpdateManifest é inválido.');
        }
        foreach ($this->requires['extensions'] as $ext) {
            if (!is_string($ext) || trim($ext) === '') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Cada extensão em requires.extensions deve ser uma string não vazia.');
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->files as $entry) {
            if (
                !is_array($entry)
                || !isset($entry['path'], $entry['sha256'], $entry['size'])
                || !is_string($entry['path'])
                || trim($entry['path']) === ''
                || !is_string($entry['sha256'])
                || preg_match('/^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/', $entry['sha256']) !== 1
                || !is_int($entry['size'])
                || $entry['size'] < 0
            ) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Entrada inválida em files do UpdateManifest.');
            }
            $mode = $entry['mode'] ?? 'replace';
            if (!in_array($mode, ['replace', 'default_if_missing'], true)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Modo de arquivo inválido em files do UpdateManifest.');
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->removed as $removedPath) {
            if (!is_string($removedPath) || trim($removedPath) === '') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Cada caminho em removed deve ser uma string não vazia.');
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->migrations as $mig) {
            if (
                !is_array($mig)
                || !isset($mig['scope'], $mig['name'], $mig['sha256'], $mig['type'])
                || !is_string($mig['scope'])
                || trim($mig['scope']) === ''
                || !is_string($mig['name'])
                || trim($mig['name']) === ''
                || !is_string($mig['sha256'])
                || preg_match('/^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/', $mig['sha256']) !== 1
                || !in_array($mig['type'], ['additive', 'destructive'], true)
            ) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Entrada inválida em migrations do UpdateManifest.');
            }
        }

        foreach ($this->expects as $table => $columns) {
            if (!is_string($table) || trim($table) === '' || !is_array($columns)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Entrada inválida em expects do UpdateManifest.');
            }
            foreach ($columns as $col) {
                if (!is_string($col) || trim($col) === '') {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException('Coluna inválida em expects do UpdateManifest.');
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Value/UpdateState.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStep;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class UpdateState
{
    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $context
     */
    public function __construct(
        public string $updateId,
        public UpdateTarget $target,
        public UpdateStep $step,
        public ?ReleaseInfo $release = null,
        public ?string $etag = null,
        public ?string $lastCheckAt = null,
        public array $context = [],
        public ?string $error = null,
        public string $updatedAt = '',
    ) {
        if (trim($this->updateId) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O updateId de UpdateState não pode ser vazio.');
        }
        if (trim($this->updatedAt) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O updatedAt de UpdateState não pode ser vazio.');
        }
        if ($this->error !== null && trim($this->error) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo error de UpdateState não pode ser string vazia.');
        }
    }

    public static function idle(UpdateTarget $target, ?string $updatedAt = null): self
    {
        return new self(
            updateId: 'idle',
            target: $target,
            step: UpdateStep::Idle,
            updatedAt: $updatedAt ?? gmdate('c'),
        );
    }

    public function withStep(UpdateStep $step, ?string $updatedAt = null): self
    {
        return new self(
            updateId: $this->updateId,
            target: $this->target,
            step: $step,
            release: $this->release,
            etag: $this->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $this->lastCheckAt,
            context: $this->context,
            error: $step === UpdateStep::Failed ? $this->error : null,
            updatedAt: $updatedAt ?? gmdate('c'),
        );
    }

    public function withError(string $error, UpdateStep $step = UpdateStep::Failed, ?string $updatedAt = null): self
    {
        return new self(
            updateId: $this->updateId,
            target: $this->target,
            step: $step,
            release: $this->release,
            etag: $this->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $this->lastCheckAt,
            context: $this->context,
            error: $error,
            updatedAt: $updatedAt ?? gmdate('c'),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $extraContext
     */
    public function withContext(array $extraContext, ?string $updatedAt = null): self
    {
        return new self(
            updateId: $this->updateId,
            target: $this->target,
            step: $this->step,
            release: $this->release,
            etag: $this->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $this->lastCheckAt,
            context: array_replace($this->context, $extraContext),
            error: $this->error,
            updatedAt: $updatedAt ?? gmdate('c'),
        );
    }

    public function withRelease(
        ?ReleaseInfo $release,
        ?string $etag = null,
        ?string $lastCheckAt = null,
        ?string $updatedAt = null,
    ): self {
        return new self(
            updateId: $this->updateId,
            target: $this->target,
            step: $this->step,
            release: $release,
            etag: $etag ?? $this->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $lastCheckAt ?? $this->lastCheckAt,
            context: $this->context,
            error: $this->error,
            updatedAt: $updatedAt ?? gmdate('c'),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'updateId'    => $this->updateId,
            'target'      => $this->target->toArray(),
            'step'        => $this->step->value,
            'release'     => $this->release?->toArray(),
            'etag'        => $this->etag,
            'lastCheckAt' => $this->lastCheckAt,
            'context'     => $this->context,
            'error'       => $this->error,
            'updatedAt'   => $this->updatedAt,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $data, UpdateTarget $defaultTarget): self
    {
        $target = isset($data['target']) && is_array($data['target'])
            ? UpdateTarget::fromArray($data['target'])
            : $defaultTarget;

        $release = isset($data['release']) && is_array($data['release'])
            ? ReleaseInfo::fromArray($data['release'])
            : null;

        return new self(
            updateId: (string)($data['updateId'] ?? 'idle'),
            target: $target,
            step: UpdateStep::from((string)($data['step'] ?? 'idle')),
            release: $release,
            etag: isset($data['etag']) && $data['etag'] !== '' ? (string)$data['etag'] : null,
            lastCheckAt: isset($data['lastCheckAt']) && $data['lastCheckAt'] !== '' ? (string)$data['lastCheckAt'] : null,
            context: is_array($data['context'] ?? null) ? $data['context'] : [],
            error: isset($data['error']) && $data['error'] !== '' ? (string)$data['error'] : null,
            updatedAt: (string)($data['updatedAt'] ?? gmdate('c')),
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final readonly class UpdateTarget
{
    public function __construct(
        public UpdateKind $kind,
        public string $slug,
        public string $repository,
        public string $installedVersion,
        public string $channel = 'stable',
    ) {
        if (trim($this->slug) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O slug do UpdateTarget não pode ser vazio.');
        }
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/', $this->repository) !== 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O repositório do UpdateTarget deve estar no formato owner/repo.');
        }
        if (trim($this->installedVersion) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A versão instalada do UpdateTarget não pode ser vazia.');
        }
        if (trim($this->channel) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O canal do UpdateTarget não pode ser vazio.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'kind'             => $this->kind->value,
            'slug'             => $this->slug,
            'repository'       => $this->repository,
            'installedVersion' => $this->installedVersion,
            'channel'          => $this->channel,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            kind: UpdateKind::from((string)($data['kind'] ?? 'core')),
            slug: (string)($data['slug'] ?? ''),
            repository: (string)($data['repository'] ?? ''),
            installedVersion: (string)($data['installedVersion'] ?? ''),
            channel: (string)($data['channel'] ?? 'stable'),
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

use Exception;

class ExtractorFactory
{
    public static function create(): ExtractorInterface
    {
        if (class_exists('ZipArchive')) {
            return new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        }

        if (class_exists('PharData')) {
            return new PharDataExtractor();
        }

        throw new Exception("Nenhum descompactador disponível no sistema (ZipArchive ou PharData).");
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Utils/Archive/ExtractorInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

interface ExtractorInterface
{
    /**
     * Extrai um pacote ZIP e retorna o nome da pasta do componente.
     * Deve lançar uma Exception caso seja um pacote inválido (sem o descritor).
     */
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationPath, string $descriptorFile = 'plugin.json'): string;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Utils/Archive/PharDataExtractor.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

use Exception;
use PharData;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

class PharDataExtractor implements ExtractorInterface
{
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationPath, string $descriptorFile = 'plugin.json'): string
    {
        $phar = new PharData($archivePath);
        $archiveRootPrefix = 'phar://' . str_replace('\\', '/', $archivePath) . '/';

        // 1. Valida recursivamente todos os caminhos internos do arquivo
        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator($phar, RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST);
        foreach ($iterator as $entry) {
            $fullPath = str_replace('\\', '/', $entry->getPathname());
            $relative = str_starts_with($fullPath, $archiveRootPrefix)
                ? substr($fullPath, strlen($archiveRootPrefix))
                : $entry->getFilename();

            if (
                $relative === ''
                || strpos($relative, "\0") !== false
                || str_starts_with($relative, '/')
                || str_starts_with($relative, '\\')
                || preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z]:|^[a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+:\/\//', $relative) === 1
                || strpos($relative, '../') !== false
                || strpos($relative, '..\\') !== false
            ) {
                throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Caminho inválido detectado no pacote.");
            }

            foreach (explode('/', rtrim($relative, '/')) as $segment) {
                if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                    throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Segmento inválido detectado no pacote.");
                }
            }
        }

        $hasDescriptor = false;
        $componentDirName = null;

        foreach ($phar as $file) {
            if ($file->isDir()) {
                $dirName = $file->getFilename();
                if (
                    preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $dirName) === 1
                    && isset($phar[$dirName . '/' . $descriptorFile])
                ) {
                    $hasDescriptor = true;
                    $componentDirName = $dirName;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!$hasDescriptor && isset($phar[$descriptorFile])) {
            $json = file_get_contents($phar[$descriptorFile]->getPathname());
            $data = is_string($json) ? json_decode($json, true) : null;
            if (is_array($data) && isset($data['name']) && is_string($data['name'])) {
                $hasDescriptor = true;
                $componentDirName = trim((string) preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', strtolower($data['name'])), '-');

                if ($componentDirName === '') {
                    throw new Exception("Nome de componente inválido no manifesto ($descriptorFile).");
                }

                @mkdir($destinationPath . '/' . $componentDirName, 0755, true);
                $phar->extractTo($destinationPath . '/' . $componentDirName, null, true);
                return $componentDirName;
            }
        }

        if ($hasDescriptor && $componentDirName) {
            $phar->extractTo($destinationPath, null, true);
            return $componentDirName;
        }

        throw new Exception("ZIP inválido: Não possui um arquivo $descriptorFile válido no pacote.");
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Utils/Archive/ZipArchiveExtractor.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

use Exception;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CLASSE: ZipArchiveExtractor (Extração Segura em Quarentena)
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Responsável por validar e extrair pacotes ZIP de plugins e temas em
 * diretório temporário de quarentena antes da movimentação final.
 *
 * MEDIDAS DE SEGURANÇA NA EXTRAÇÃO:
 * 1. Bloqueia Path Traversal relativo ("../", "..\") e segmentos "." / "..".
 * 2. Bloqueia caminhos absolutos Unix/Windows ("/home/...", "\...", "C:\...")
 *    e wrappers de stream ("phar://", "file://").
 * 3. Bloqueia links simbólicos (symlinks UNIX no cabeçalho externo do ZIP).
 * 4. Realiza extração controlada via stream entrada por entrada (sem delegar
 *    caminhos ao ZipArchive::extractTo nativo), validando que o destino real
 *    (realpath) permanece estritamente confinado dentro da pasta de quarentena.
 */
class ZipArchiveExtractor implements ExtractorInterface
{
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationPath, string $descriptorFile = 'plugin.json'): string
    {
        $zip = new ZipArchive();

        if ($zip->open($archivePath) !== true) {
            throw new Exception("Não foi possível abrir o arquivo ZIP com ZipArchive.");
        }

        $hasDescriptor = false;
        $componentDirName = null;
        $escapedDescriptor = preg_quote($descriptorFile, '#');

        try {
            // 1. ANÁLISE DO PACOTE E VALIDAÇÃO ESTRITA DE CAMINHOS E SYMLINKS
            for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
                $filename = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
                if (!is_string($filename) || $filename === '') {
                    throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Entrada inválida no pacote ZIP.");
                }

                $this->assertSafeEntry($zip, $i, $filename);

                $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $filename);
                if (preg_match('#^([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/' . $escapedDescriptor . '$#', $normalized, $matches)) {
                    $hasDescriptor = true;
                    $componentDirName = $matches[1];
                }
            }

            // 2. PREPARAÇÃO DA QUARENTENA
            $baseTemp = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') && is_dir(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp')
                ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp'
                : sys_get_temp_dir();
            $tempDir = $baseTemp . '/quarentena_zip_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
            if (!@mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($tempDir)) {
                throw new Exception("Não foi possível criar o diretório de quarentena para extração.");
            }

            // Se o ZIP não tem pasta raiz (os arquivos estão soltos na raiz do ZIP)
            if (!$hasDescriptor) {
                $idx = $zip->locateName($descriptorFile);
                if ($idx !== false) {
                    $json = $zip->getFromIndex($idx);
                    $data = is_string($json) ? json_decode($json, true) : null;
                    if (is_array($data) && isset($data['name']) && is_string($data['name'])) {
                        $hasDescriptor = true;
                        $componentDirName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', strtolower($data['name'])) ?: '';
                        $componentDirName = trim($componentDirName, '-');

                        if ($componentDirName === '') {
                            throw new Exception("Nome de componente inválido no manifesto ($descriptorFile).");
                        }

                        $this->safeExtract($zip, $tempDir);
                        $zip->close();

                        $this->moveToDestination($tempDir, $destinationPath, $componentDirName, $descriptorFile);
                        return $componentDirName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!$hasDescriptor || !$componentDirName) {
                if (is_dir($tempDir)) {
                    $this->deleteDirectory($tempDir);
                }
                throw new Exception("ZIP inválido: Não possui o arquivo manifesto ($descriptorFile) válido no pacote.");
            }

            // 3. EXTRAÇÃO CONTROLADA PARA QUARENTENA
            $this->safeExtract($zip, $tempDir);
            $zip->close();

            // 4. TRANSFERÊNCIA DA QUARENTENA PARA A PASTA FINAL
            $sourcePath = $tempDir . '/' . $componentDirName;
            $this->moveToDestination($sourcePath, $destinationPath, $componentDirName, $descriptorFile);
            $this->deleteDirectory($tempDir);

            return $componentDirName;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            @$zip->close();
            if (isset($tempDir) && is_dir($tempDir)) {
                $this->deleteDirectory($tempDir);
            }
            throw $e instanceof Exception ? $e : new Exception($e->getMessage(), (int) $e->getCode(), $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Valida se uma entrada do ZIP é segura contra Zip-Slip, caminhos absolutos,
     * letras de unidade, wrappers de stream e symlinks UNIX.
     */
    private function assertSafeEntry(ZipArchive $zip, int $index, string $filename): void
    {
        if (strpos($filename, "\0") !== false) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Byte nulo detectado no caminho do ZIP.");
        }

        // Bloqueia caminhos absolutos Unix (/...) ou Windows (\... ou \\...)
        if (str_starts_with($filename, '/') || str_starts_with($filename, '\\')) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Caminho absoluto não permitido no pacote ZIP.");
        }

        // Bloqueia letras de unidade do Windows (C:...) e wrappers (phar://, file://, etc.)
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z]:|^[a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+:\/\//', $filename) === 1) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Drive ou protocolo absoluto não permitido no pacote ZIP.");
        }

        // Bloqueia traversal relativo bruto
        if (strpos($filename, '../') !== false || strpos($filename, '..\\') !== false) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): O pacote contém caminhos maliciosos.");
        }

        $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $filename);
        $segments = explode('/', rtrim($normalized, '/'));
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Segmento de diretório inválido no pacote ZIP.");
            }
        }

        // Bloqueia links simbólicos UNIX (S_IFLNK = 0120000 nos atributos externos)
        $opsys = 0;
        $attr = 0;
        if ($zip->getExternalAttributesIndex($index, $opsys, $attr)) {
            $unixMode = ($attr >> 16) & 0170000;
            if ($unixMode === 0120000) {
                throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Links simbólicos (symlinks) não são permitidos no pacote ZIP.");
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extrai os arquivos via stream entrada por entrada (sem usar ZipArchive::extractTo),
     * garantindo confinamento real dentro de $tempDir via realpath().
     */
    private function safeExtract(ZipArchive $zip, string $tempDir): void
    {
        $realTempRoot = realpath($tempDir);
        if ($realTempRoot === false) {
            throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Diretório de quarentena inacessível.");
        }
        $realTempPrefix = rtrim($realTempRoot, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $filename = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
            if (!is_string($filename) || $filename === '') {
                throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Entrada inválida dentro do ZIP.");
            }

            $this->assertSafeEntry($zip, $i, $filename);

            $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $filename);
            $isDirectory = str_ends_with($normalized, '/');
            $relativePath = str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, rtrim($normalized, '/'));
            $targetPath = $realTempPrefix . $relativePath;

            if ($isDirectory) {
                if (!is_dir($targetPath) && !@mkdir($targetPath, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetPath)) {
                    throw new Exception("Falha ao criar diretório na quarentena.");
                }
                $realTargetDir = realpath($targetPath);
                if ($realTargetDir === false || !str_starts_with($realTargetDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $realTempPrefix)) {
                    throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Escape de diretório detectado na quarentena.");
                }
                continue;
            }

            $parentDir = dirname($targetPath);
            if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                throw new Exception("Falha ao criar diretório pai na quarentena.");
            }

            $realParent = realpath($parentDir);
            if (
                $realParent === false
                || ($realParent !== $realTempRoot && !str_starts_with($realParent . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $realTempPrefix))
            ) {
                throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Caminho fora da área de quarentena.");
            }

            $stream = $zip->getStream($filename);
            if (!is_resource($stream)) {
                throw new Exception("Falha ao ler stream do arquivo no pacote ZIP.");
            }

            $out = @fopen($targetPath, 'wb');
            if (!is_resource($out)) {
                fclose($stream);
                throw new Exception("Falha ao gravar arquivo na quarentena.");
            }

            stream_copy_to_stream($stream, $out);
            fclose($out);
            fclose($stream);
        }
    }

    private function moveToDestination(string $sourcePath, string $destinationPath, string $componentDirName, string $descriptorFile): void
    {
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $componentDirName) !== 1) {
            $this->deleteDirectory($sourcePath);
            throw new Exception("Bloqueio de Segurança: Nome de diretório de componente inválido.");
        }

        if (!is_dir($destinationPath)) {
            @mkdir($destinationPath, 0755, true);
        }

        $targetPath = $destinationPath . '/' . $componentDirName;

        // Proteção Ring 0: impede sobrescrever um SystemApp protegido via upload ZIP
        if (file_exists($targetPath . '/' . $descriptorFile)) {
            $meta = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($targetPath . '/' . $descriptorFile), true);
            if (!empty($meta['core'])) {
                $this->deleteDirectory($sourcePath);
                throw new Exception("Bloqueio de Segurança: Não é permitido sobrescrever um SystemApp protegido via upload ZIP.");
            }
        }

        if (file_exists($targetPath)) {
            $this->deleteDirectory($targetPath);
        }

        if (!@rename($sourcePath, $targetPath)) {
            $this->copyDirectory($sourcePath, $targetPath);
            $this->deleteDirectory($sourcePath);
        }
    }

    private function copyDirectory(string $source, string $dest): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dest)) {
            @mkdir($dest, 0755, true);
        }
        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($source, \RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            \RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST
        );
        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            $target = $dest . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $iterator->getSubPathname();
            if ($item->isDir()) {
                if (!is_dir($target)) {
                    @mkdir($target, 0755, true);
                }
            } else {
                copy($item->getPathname(), $target);
            }
        }
    }

    private function deleteDirectory(string $dir): bool
    {
        if (!file_exists($dir)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return unlink($dir);
        }

        $items = scandir($dir);
        if ($items === false) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!$this->deleteDirectory($dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return rmdir($dir);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Utils/SlugHelper.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils;

/**
 * Utilitário canônico de sanitização e geração de slugs em todo o sistema.
 * Trata acentuação pt-BR, caracteres especiais e transliteração sem dependências externas.
 */
class SlugHelper
{
    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    /**
     * Converte qualquer string em slug limpo no padrão URL/pasta (kebab-case).
     */
    public static function slugify(string $text, string $fallback = 'item'): string
    {
        $text = strtr(trim($text), self::$accentMap);

        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $clean = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        return $clean !== '' ? $clean : $fallback;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Workspace/DefaultWorkspace.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Workspace;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;

class DefaultWorkspace implements WorkspaceInterface
{
    private ThemeManager $theme;
    private ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifManager;

    public function __construct(ThemeManager $theme, ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifManager = null)
    {
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->notifManager = $notifManager;
    }

    public function wrap(string $content): string
    {
        $unreadNotifs = [];
        $allNotifs = [];

        if ($this->notifManager) {
            $unreadNotifs = $this->notifManager->getUnread();
            $allNotifs = $this->notifManager->getAll();
            if (!empty($unreadNotifs)) {
                $this->notifManager->markAsRead();
            }
        }

        return $this->theme->render('layout', [
            'content' => $content,
            'unreadNotifs' => $unreadNotifs,
            'allNotifs' => $allNotifs
        ]);
    }

    public function getThemeName(): string
    {
        return 'admin';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Workspace/WorkspaceManager.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Workspace;

use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;

/**
 * O Gerenciador de Workspaces
 * Funciona como um Registro de Tomadas. Não sabe nada sobre médicos ou advogados.
 */
class WorkspaceManager
{
    private Container $container;
    private ThemeManager $theme;
    private array $workspaces = [];

    public function __construct(Container $container, ThemeManager $theme)
    {
        $this->container = $container;
        $this->theme = $theme;
    }

    /**
     * Registra um novo layout/workspace para um cargo específico.
     */
    public function registerWorkspace(string $role, WorkspaceInterface $workspace): void
    {
        $this->workspaces[strtolower($role)] = $workspace;
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a implementação correta da interface baseada no cargo
     */
    public function getWorkspace(string $role): WorkspaceInterface
    {
        $role = strtolower($role);
        
        if (isset($this->workspaces[$role])) {
            $workspace = $this->workspaces[$role];
        } else {
            $notifManager = null;
            if ($this->container->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface::class)) {
                $notifManager = $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface::class);
            }
            $workspace = new DefaultWorkspace($this->theme, $notifManager);
        }

        // Troca automaticamente a fiação do motor de renderização para o CockPIT atual!
        $basePath = dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $themeName = $workspace->getThemeName();
        if (is_dir($themeName)) {
            $this->theme->setActiveThemePath($themeName);
        } else {
            $this->theme->setActiveThemePath($basePath . '/themes/' . $themeName);
        }

        return $workspace;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/helpers.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Domain-System Helper Functions
 * (Inspirado no WordPress e Laravel)
 */

if (!function_exists('encrypt_string')) {
    function encrypt_string(string $plaintext): string
    {
        if (empty($plaintext)) return '';
        $key = getenv('APP_KEY') ?: ($_ENV['APP_KEY'] ?? ($_SERVER['APP_KEY'] ?? ''));
        if (!$key) throw new \Exception('APP_KEY não configurada no arquivo .env');
        
        $iv = openssl_random_pseudo_bytes(openssl_cipher_iv_length('aes-256-gcm'));
        $tag = '';
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($plaintext, 'aes-256-gcm', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ciphertext);
    }
}

if (!function_exists('decrypt_string')) {
    function decrypt_string(string $payload): string
    {
        if (empty($payload)) return '';
        $key = getenv('APP_KEY') ?: ($_ENV['APP_KEY'] ?? ($_SERVER['APP_KEY'] ?? ''));
        if (!$key) throw new \Exception('APP_KEY não configurada no arquivo .env');
        
        $decoded = base64_decode($payload, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return '';
        }
        
        // Backward compatibility for AES-256-CBC
        $ivLenCbc = openssl_cipher_iv_length('AES-256-CBC');
        if (strlen($decoded) > $ivLenCbc + 2 && substr($decoded, $ivLenCbc, 2) === '::') {
            $iv = substr($decoded, 0, $ivLenCbc);
            $ciphertext = substr($decoded, $ivLenCbc + 2);
            $plaintext = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'AES-256-CBC', $key, 0, $iv);
            if ($plaintext !== false) {
                return $plaintext;
            }
        } elseif (strpos($decoded, '::') !== false) {
            list($iv, $ciphertext) = explode('::', $decoded, 2);
            if (strlen($iv) === $ivLenCbc) {
                $plaintext = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'AES-256-CBC', $key, 0, $iv);
                if ($plaintext !== false) {
                    return $plaintext;
                }
            }
        }
        
        $ivLen = openssl_cipher_iv_length('aes-256-gcm');
        $tagLen = 16; // GCM default tag length
        
        if (strlen($decoded) < $ivLen + $tagLen) {
            return '';
        }
        
        $iv = substr($decoded, 0, $ivLen);
        $tag = substr($decoded, $ivLen, $tagLen);
        $ciphertext = substr($decoded, $ivLen + $tagLen);
        
        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-gcm', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        return $plaintext !== false ? $plaintext : '';
    }
}

<?php

/**
 * Adaptador que transforma um Curso do Academy em um Item Vendável do Commerce (Padrão Adapter / DIP).
 */
class CoursePurchasableAdapter implements PurchasableItemInterface
{
    private array $course;
    private ?string $thumbnailUrl;

    public function __construct(array $course, ?string $thumbnailUrl = null)
    {
        $this->course = $course;
        $this->thumbnailUrl = $thumbnailUrl;
    }

    public function getId(): int
    {
        return (int)($this->course['id'] ?? 0);
    }

    public function getItemType(): string
    {
        return 'course';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->course['title'] ?? 'Curso sem título');
    }

    public function getPrice(): float
    {
        return (float)($this->course['price'] ?? 0.0);
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool
    {
        return ($this->course['status'] ?? '') === 'published';
    }

    public function getDescription(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->course['description'] ?? '');
    }

    public function getThumbnailUrl(): ?string
    {
        return $this->thumbnailUrl ?: ($this->course['image'] ?? null);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Blocks/AcademyBlockProvider.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\UserAuthBlock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;

/**
 * Provedor de Blocos Semânticos do Plugin Academy para o Flex Builder (SOLID - OCP / DIP).
 *
 * Registra o bloco 'Área de Login / Aluno' (user_auth) de forma extensível.
 * Caso o plugin Academy esteja desativado, este provedor não é carregado,
 * mantendo o Flex Builder 100% desacoplado.
 */
class AcademyBlockProvider implements BlockProviderInterface
{
    private ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;
    private ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private ?SessionManagerInterface $session;

    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?SessionManagerInterface $session = null
    ) {
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer;
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver;
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer;
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    public function registerBlocks(BlockRegistryInterface $registry): void
    {
        if (!$registry->has('user_auth')) {
            $registry->register(new UserAuthBlock(
                $this->htmlSanitizer,
                $this->urlResolver,
                $this->styleRenderer,
                $this->session
            ));
        }
    }
}

        int $courseId,
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool;

    /**
     * Revoga ou cancela o acesso do aluno ao curso (ex: estorno, inadimplência ou cancelamento).
     */
    public function revoke(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool;

     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): ?array;
}

     * @return array<int, array{
     *     id: int,
     *     course_id: int,
     *     module_id: ?int,
     *     title: string,
     *     slug: string,
     *     source_type: string,
     *     source: ?string,
     *     content: ?string,
     *     position: int,
     *     status: string,
     *     created_at?: string
     * }>
     */
    public function getLessons(int $courseId, ?int $moduleId = null): array;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getLessonById(int $id): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getPublishedLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array;

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function createLesson(array $data): int;

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function updateLesson(int $id, array $data): bool;

    public function deleteLesson(int $id): bool;

    /**
     * Substitui a estrutura completa do curso de forma atômica e transacional (com rollback em erros).
     *
     * @param int $courseId
     * @param array<int, array{
     *     id?: int,
     *     title: string,
     *     position?: int,
     *     lessons: array<int, array{
     *         id?: int,
     *         title: string,
     *         slug?: string,
     *         source_type?: string,
     *         source?: ?string,
     *         content?: ?string,
     *         status?: string
     *     }>
     * }> $structure
     */
    public function replaceCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool;

    /**
     * Garante a criação resiliente das tabelas 'academy_modules' e 'academy_lessons'.
     */
    public function ensureTables(): void;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Contracts/LessonFileScaffolderInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato para fabricação automática de pastas (módulos) e arquivos PHP pré-configurados
 * de aulas diretamente no tema ativo, integrados ao Editor de Blocos e às resoluções Mobile/Desktop.
 */
interface LessonFileScaffolderInterface
{
    /**
     * Normaliza um título (ex: "Estrutura de Dados") para slug de arquivo ("estrutura-de-dados").
     */
    public function slugify(string $title): string;

    /**
     * Cria fisicamente uma pasta/módulo dentro de `pages/` do tema ativo.
     *
     * @param string $folderTitle Nome ou título da pasta/módulo
     * @return array{slug: string, relative_path: string, full_path: string}
     */
    public function createFolder(string $folderTitle): array;

    /**
     * Fabrica automaticamente um arquivo `.php` pré-configurado (com CSS e JS padrão Mobile/Desktop
     * e suporte ao Editor de Blocos) a partir do Título da aula/página.
     *
     * Ex: Título "Estrutura de Dados" -> arquivo `estrutura-de-dados.php`
     *     Slug relativo: `pages/estrutura-de-dados.php` (ou `pages/{folder}/estrutura-de-dados.php`)
     *
     * @param string      $title         Título da aula ou página (ex: "Estrutura de Dados")
     * @param string|null $folder        Subpasta opcional dentro de pages/ (ex: "curso-de-python" ou "")
     * @param string|null $blocksJson    Conteúdo opcional em blocos JSON para pré-popular o arquivo
     * @param string      $mobileProfile Perfil mobile padrão ('drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema')
     * @return array{
     *   title: string,
     *   slug: string,
     *   file_name: string,
     *   relative_path: string,
     *   full_path: string,
     *   public_url: string
     * }
     */
    public function fabricateLessonFile(
        string $title,
        ?string $folder = null,
        ?string $blocksJson = null,
        string $mobileProfile = 'drawer'
    ): array;

    /**
     * Inspeciona um arquivo PHP existente de aula para extrair metadados inteligentes:
     * - Título real (via docblock "* Título: ..." ou tag <h1>)
     * - Slug normalizado
     * - Perfil mobile ("* Perfil Mobile: ...")
     * - Se contém blocos DS_BLOCKS_B64 e seu JSON decodificado
     *
     * @param string $relativePath Caminho relativo ao tema (ex: 'pages/curso/aula.php')
     * @return array{
     *   title: string,
     *   slug: string,
     *   mobile_profile: string,
     *   has_blocks: bool,
     *   blocks_json: string|null
     * }
     */
    public function inspectLessonFile(string $relativePath): array;
}

/**

    public function getStudentNote(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): string;

    /**
     * Lista os arquivos salvos pelo aluno na sua pasta pessoal.
     *
     * @return array<array{name: string, size: int, modified_at: int}>
     */
    public function listStudentFiles(int $studentId): array;

    /**
     * Remove um arquivo da pasta pessoal do aluno de forma segura (com proteção contra traversal).
     */
    public function deleteStudentFile(int $studentId, string $filename): bool;
}
