/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/CourseAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CoursePackageServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CoursePackageService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Throwable;

class CourseAdminController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private CourseService $service;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private ThemePageResolverInterface|ThemeManagerInterface|null $pageResolver;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder;
    private ?CoursePackageServiceInterface $packageService;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $repository,
        CourseService $service,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo = null,
        ThemePageResolverInterface|ThemeManagerInterface|null $pageResolver = null,
        ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null,
        ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder = null,
        ?CoursePackageServiceInterface $packageService = null
    ) {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->service = $service;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->pageResolver = $pageResolver;
        $this->storage = $storage;
        $this->scaffolder = $scaffolder;
        $this->packageService = $packageService;

        if ($this->packageService === null && $this->structureRepo !== null && $this->pageResolver instanceof ThemePageResolverInterface) {
            $this->packageService = new CoursePackageService(
                $this->repository,
                $this->structureRepo,
                $this->pageResolver,
                $this->service,
                $this->scaffolder
            );
        }
    }

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $courses = $this->repository->findAll();
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/courses/index', [
            'courses'          => $courses,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'flashType'        => $flashType,
            'flashMsg'         => $flashMsg,
            'storage'          => $this->storage,
            'commerceSettings' => $this->getCommerceSettings(),
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById((int)$id);
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;

        $initialStructure = [];
        $availablePages = [];

        if ($this->structureRepo !== null) {
            $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$course['id']);
            $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);
            $availablePages = $this->resolvePublicThemePages();
            $availablePagesMeta = [];
            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                foreach ($availablePages as $p) {
                    $availablePagesMeta[$p] = $this->scaffolder->inspectLessonFile($p);
                }
            }

            $lessonsByMod = [];
            $standaloneLessons = [];
            foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
                $mId = $l['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$l['module_id'] : null;
                if ($mId !== null && $mId > 0) {
                    $lessonsByMod[$mId][] = $l;
                } else {
                    $standaloneLessons[] = $l;
                }
            }

            foreach ($modules as $m) {
                $mId = (int)$m['id'];
                $initialStructure[] = [
                    'id'          => $mId,
                    'title'       => (string)$m['title'],
                    'folder_slug' => (string)($m['folder_slug'] ?? ''),
                    'position'    => (int)$m['position'],
                    'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $les): array {
                        return [
                            'id'             => (int)$les['id'],
                            'title'          => (string)$les['title'],
                            'slug'           => (string)$les['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => (string)$les['source_type'],
                            'source'         => (string)($les['source'] ?? ''),
                            'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                            'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                            'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                        ];
                    }, $lessonsByMod[$mId] ?? []),
                ];
            }

            if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
                $initialStructure[] = [
                    'title'       => 'Módulo Geral',
                    'folder_slug' => '',
                    'position'    => 999,
                    'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $les): array {
                        return [
                            'id'             => (int)$les['id'],
                            'title'          => (string)$les['title'],
                            'slug'           => (string)$les['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => (string)$les['source_type'],
                            'source'         => (string)($les['source'] ?? ''),
                            'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                            'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                            'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                        ];
                    }, $standaloneLessons),
                ];
            }
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/courses/edit', [
            'course'           => $course,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'flashType'        => $flashType,
            'flashMsg'         => $flashMsg,
            'storage'          => $this->storage,
            'hasStructureRepo' => $this->structureRepo !== null,
            'initialStructure' => $initialStructure,
            'availablePages'       => $availablePages,
            'availablePagesMeta'   => $availablePagesMeta ?? [],
            'commerceSettings' => $this->getCommerceSettings(),
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    /**
     * Cria uma pasta física dentro de pages/ do tema ativo e adiciona o módulo correspondente ao curso.
     */
    public function createThemeFolder(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $folderName = trim((string)($request->input('folder_name') ?? ''));
        if ($folderName === '') {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O nome da pasta/módulo é obrigatório.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        try {
            $folderSlug = null;
            $relDir = '';
            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                $courseSlug = trim((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));
                $targetPath = $this->resolveCourseWorkspacePath($courseSlug, $folderName);

                $folderInfo = $this->scaffolder->createFolder($targetPath);
                $relDir = (string)($folderInfo['relative_path'] ?? '');
                $folderSlug = (string)($folderInfo['slug'] ?? $this->scaffolder->slugify($targetPath));
            }

            if ($this->structureRepo !== null) {
                $existingModules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
                $nextPos = count($existingModules) + 1;
                if (method_exists($this->structureRepo, 'createModule')) {
                    $this->structureRepo->createModule($courseId, $folderName, $nextPos, $folderSlug);
                }
            }

            $msg = $relDir !== ''
                ? "Pasta '{$relDir}' e módulo '{$folderName}' criados com sucesso!"
                : "Módulo '{$folderName}' criado com sucesso!";
            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao criar pasta/módulo: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function updateStructure(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->structureRepo === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Repositório de estrutura não disponível.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $rawJson = $request->input('structure_json');
        if (!empty($rawJson)) {
            $structure = json_decode((string)$rawJson, true);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', "Formato da estrutura inválido.");
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
            }
        } else {
            $structure = $request->input('structure', []);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $structure = [];
            }
        }

        $autoFabricate = (string)($request->input('auto_fabricate_php') ?? '') === '1';

        try {
            $fabricatedFilesCount = 0;
            $courseSlug = trim((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));

            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                foreach ($structure as &$modData) {
                    $rawFolder = isset($modData['folder_slug']) && trim((string)$modData['folder_slug']) !== ''
                        ? trim((string)$modData['folder_slug'])
                        : '';

                    // Assegura isolamento no workspace do curso: se folder_slug estiver vazio, usa a pasta do curso.
                    // Se especificado, aninha dentro de pages/{course_slug}/{modulo}
                    if ($rawFolder === '') {
                        $folderSlug = $courseSlug !== '' ? $courseSlug : null;
                    } else {
                        $folderSlug = $this->resolveCourseWorkspacePath($courseSlug, $rawFolder);
                    }

                    if ($folderSlug !== null && $autoFabricate) {
                        $this->scaffolder->createFolder($folderSlug);
                    }
                    $modData['folder_slug'] = $folderSlug ?? '';

                    if (!isset($modData['lessons']) || !is_array($modData['lessons'])) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    foreach ($modData['lessons'] as &$lesson) {
                        $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? ''));
                        if ($title === '') {
                            continue;
                        }

                        $srcType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                        $source = trim((string)($lesson['source'] ?? ''));
                        $shouldFabricate = !empty($lesson['auto_fabricate'])
                            || ($autoFabricate && ($source === '' || $srcType === 'content'));

                        if ($shouldFabricate) {
                            $rawContent = (string)($lesson['content'] ?? '');

                            $fabricated = $this->scaffolder->fabricateLessonFile(
                                $title,
                                $folderSlug,
                                $rawContent !== '' ? $rawContent : null,
                                (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer')
                            );

                            if (empty($lesson['slug']) || preg_match('/^aula-\d+$/', (string)$lesson['slug'])) {
                                $lesson['slug'] = $fabricated['slug'];
                            }
                            if ($source === '') {
                                $lesson['source'] = $fabricated['relative_path'];
                            }
                            $fabricatedFilesCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    unset($lesson);
                }
                unset($modData);
            }

            $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
            $extraMsg = $fabricatedFilesCount > 0 ? " ({$fabricatedFilesCount} arquivo(s) .php fabricado(s) em pages/)" : '';
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Estrutura do curso atualizada com sucesso!{$extraMsg}");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar estrutura: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $this->extractUploadedThumbnail($request);
            $rawPrice = str_replace(',', '.', (string)($request->input('price') ?? '0'));
            $price = max(0.0, (float)$rawPrice);
            $isFreeInput = $request->input('is_free');
            if ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '1') {
                $isFree = 1;
                $price = 0.00;
            } elseif ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '0') {
                $isFree = 0;
                if ($price <= 0.0) {
                    $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe um preço maior que zero para cursos pagos ou marque o curso como gratuito.');
                    return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
                }
            } else {
                $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? 0 : 1;
            }
            $maxInstallments = max(1, min(24, (int)($request->input('max_installments') ?? 12)));

            $data = [
                'title'                 => $request->input('title'),
                'description'           => $request->input('description'),
                'status'                => $request->input('status'),
                'link'                  => $request->input('link'),
                'price'                 => $price,
                'is_free'               => $isFree,
                'max_installments'      => $maxInstallments,
                'external_platform'     => $request->input('external_platform'),
                'external_product_id'   => $request->input('external_product_id'),
                'external_checkout_url' => $request->input('external_checkout_url'),
            ];

            $this->service->createCourse($data, $file);
            $this->syncGatewaySettingsFromRequest($request);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso cadastrado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao cadastrar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $this->extractUploadedThumbnail($request);
            $rawPrice = str_replace(',', '.', (string)($request->input('price') ?? '0'));
            $price = max(0.0, (float)$rawPrice);
            $isFreeInput = $request->input('is_free');
            if ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '1') {
                $isFree = 1;
                $price = 0.00;
            } elseif ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '0') {
                $isFree = 0;
                if ($price <= 0.0) {
                    $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe um preço maior que zero para cursos pagos ou marque o curso como gratuito.');
                    return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $id);
                }
            } else {
                $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? 0 : 1;
            }
            $maxInstallments = max(1, min(24, (int)($request->input('max_installments') ?? 12)));

            $data = [
                'title'                 => $request->input('title'),
                'description'           => $request->input('description'),
                'status'                => $request->input('status'),
                'link'                  => $request->input('link'),
                'price'                 => $price,
                'is_free'               => $isFree,
                'max_installments'      => $maxInstallments,
                'external_platform'     => $request->input('external_platform'),
                'external_product_id'   => $request->input('external_product_id'),
                'external_checkout_url' => $request->input('external_checkout_url'),
            ];

            $this->service->updateCourse((int)$id, $data, $file);
            $this->syncGatewaySettingsFromRequest($request);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso atualizado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $id);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function delete(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $this->service->deleteCourse((int)$id);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso excluído com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao excluir curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    private function extractUploadedThumbnail(Request $request): ?array
    {
        $file = $request->file('thumbnail');
        if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo de imagem enviado excedeu o tamanho máximo permitido pelo servidor.");
            }
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo de imagem (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
        }
        return $file;
    }

    public function exportZip(Request $request, $id = null): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)($id ?? $request->input('id'));
        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);

        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso ID {$courseId} não encontrado para exportação.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->packageService === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O serviço de empacotamento de cursos não está configurado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $zipPath = $this->packageService->exportCourseZip($courseId);
            $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '_', (string)$course['slug']) ?: 'curso';
            $fileName = 'curso-' . $slug . '.zip';
            $zipContent = (string)file_get_contents($zipPath);
            @unlink($zipPath);

            return new Response($zipContent, 200, [
                'Content-Type'        => 'application/zip',
                'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $fileName . '"',
                'Content-Length'      => (string)strlen($zipContent),
                'Pragma'              => 'no-cache',
                'Expires'             => '0',
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao exportar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }
    }

    public function importZip(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->packageService === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O serviço de importação de cursos não está configurado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $zipUpload = $this->extractUploadedZipFile($request);
            if (!$zipUpload || empty($zipUpload['tmp_name'])) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', "Por favor, selecione um arquivo .zip de curso para importar.");
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
            }

            $res = $this->packageService->importCourseZip($zipUpload['tmp_name']);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso '{$res['title']}' importado com sucesso! ({$res['modules_count']} módulo(s) e {$res['lessons_count']} aula(s) restauradas).");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $res['course_id']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha na importação do curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }
    }

    private function extractUploadedZipFile(Request $request): ?array
    {
        $file = $request->file('course_zip');
        if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo ZIP (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
        }
        return $file;
    }

    private function verifyCsrfToken(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || $expected === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        if ($this->pageResolver instanceof ThemePageResolverInterface) {
            return $this->pageResolver->resolvePublicThemePages();
        }

        if ($this->pageResolver instanceof ThemeManagerInterface) {
            $pages = $this->pageResolver->getAvailablePages();
            $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
            natsort($pages);
            return array_values($pages);
        }

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }

    /**
     * Retorna as configurações ativas do DomainCommerce para pré-preenchimento dos gateways.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function getCommerceSettings(): array
    {
        if (class_exists(\DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings::class)) {
            return (new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings())->all();
        }
        return [];
    }

    /**
     * Salva ou sincroniza credenciais do PayPal ou Stripe enviadas diretamente pelo formulário do curso.
     */
    private function syncGatewaySettingsFromRequest(Request $request): void
    {
        if (!class_exists(\DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings::class)) {
            return;
        }

        $commSettings = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings();
        $toSave = [];

        // PayPal
        if ($request->input('paypal_client_id') !== null) {
            $cid = trim((string)$request->input('paypal_client_id'));
            $csec = trim((string)$request->input('paypal_client_secret'));
            if ($cid !== '') $toSave['paypal_client_id'] = $cid;
            if ($csec !== '') $toSave['paypal_client_secret'] = $csec;
            if ($cid !== '' && $csec !== '') $toSave['paypal_enabled'] = true;
            // Checkbox HTML: se não vier no POST, significa que foi desmarcado (false)
            $toSave['paypal_sandbox'] = !empty($request->input('paypal_sandbox'));
        }

        // Stripe
        if ($request->input('stripe_secret_key') !== null) {
            $ssec = trim((string)$request->input('stripe_secret_key'));
            $spub = trim((string)$request->input('stripe_publishable_key'));
            if ($ssec !== '') $toSave['stripe_secret_key'] = $ssec;
            if ($spub !== '') $toSave['stripe_publishable_key'] = $spub;
            if ($ssec !== '') $toSave['stripe_enabled'] = true;
            // Checkbox HTML: se não vier no POST, significa que foi desmarcado (false)
            $toSave['stripe_sandbox'] = !empty($request->input('stripe_sandbox'));
        }

        if (!empty($toSave)) {
            $commSettings->save($toSave);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Garante que subpastas ou módulos fiquem isolados sob o workspace do curso: pages/{course_slug}/{modulo}
     */
    private function resolveCourseWorkspacePath(string $courseSlug, string $rawFolder): string
    {
        $clean = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rawFolder), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($clean, 'pages/')) {
            $clean = substr($clean, 6);
        }
        if ($courseSlug !== '' && !str_starts_with($clean, $courseSlug . '/') && $clean !== $courseSlug) {
            return $courseSlug . '/' . $clean;
        }
        return $clean;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\AccountStatusProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\seo\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface;
use Throwable;

class CourseFrontController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private CourseNavigationInterface $navService;
    private CourseCatalogRendererInterface $catalogRenderer;
    private ?SeoManagerInterface $seo;
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private ?LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer;
    private ?ThemePageResolverInterface $pageResolver;
    private ?CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollment;
    private ?SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?StudentProgressInterface $progressService;
    private ?AccountStatusProviderInterface $accountStatus;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        CourseNavigationInterface $navService,
        CourseCatalogRendererInterface $catalogRenderer,
        ?SeoManagerInterface $seo = null,
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer = null,
        ?ThemePageResolverInterface $pageResolver = null,
        ?CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollment = null,
        ?SessionManagerInterface $session = null,
        ?StudentProgressInterface $progressService = null,
        ?AccountStatusProviderInterface $accountStatus = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->navService = $navService;
        $this->catalogRenderer = $catalogRenderer;
        $this->seo = $seo;
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
        $this->pageResolver = $pageResolver;
        $this->enrollment = $enrollment;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->progressService = $progressService;
        $this->accountStatus = $accountStatus;
    }

    /**
     * Catálogo geral de cursos: GET /cursos
     */
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $this->seo->setTitle('Cursos & Tutoriais | Academy')
                ->setDescription('Explore os cursos e tutoriais disponíveis na plataforma Academy.');
        }

        $catalogHtml = $this->catalogRenderer->render();

        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $academyTemplateCandidate = $themePath !== '' ? ($themePath . '/templates/academy.php') : '';

        if ($this->themeManager !== null && $academyTemplateCandidate !== '' && file_exists($academyTemplateCandidate)) {
            try {
                $html = $this->themeManager->render('templates/academy', [
                    'page' => [
                        'title'   => 'Cursos & Tutoriais',
                        'content' => $catalogHtml,
                    ],
                ]);
                return new Response($html);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback para renderização direta
            }
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('front/catalog', [
            'catalogHtml' => $catalogHtml,
        ]);

        return new Response($html);
    }

    /**
     * Página de apresentação do curso ou acesso direto a uma aula/página fabricada: GET /cursos/{courseSlug}
     */
    public function showCourse(string $courseSlug): Response
    {
        $course = $this->courseRepo->findBySlug($courseSlug);

        // Suporte a link direto /cursos/{lessonSlug} (ex: /cursos/estrutura-de-dados -> pages/estrutura-de-dados.php)
        if (!$course) {
            if (method_exists($this->structureRepo, 'findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug')) {
                $directLesson = $this->structureRepo->findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug($courseSlug);
                if ($directLesson) {
                    $parentCourse = $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$directLesson['course_id']);
                    if ($parentCourse && ($parentCourse['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
                        return $this->showLesson((string)$parentCourse['slug'], (string)$directLesson['slug']);
                    }
                }
            }

            $candidateThemeFile = 'pages/' . ltrim($courseSlug, '/\\') . '.php';
            if ($this->themeFileExists($candidateThemeFile)) {
                $renderedFile = $this->renderThemeFile($candidateThemeFile, [
                    'course'   => ['title' => 'Academy', 'slug' => 'cursos'],
                    'lesson'   => ['title' => ucwords(str_replace('-', ' ', $courseSlug)), 'slug' => $courseSlug],
                    'adjacent' => ['prev' => null, 'next' => null],
                    'navHtml'  => '',
                ]);
                return new Response($renderedFile);
            }

            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1><p>Não encontramos o curso solicitado: [" . htmlspecialchars($courseSlug, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "]</p>", 404);
        }

        if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'draft') {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1><p>Não encontramos o curso solicitado: [" . htmlspecialchars($courseSlug, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "]</p>", 404);
        }

        $title = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $this->seo->setTitle($title . ' | Academy')
                ->setDescription(mb_substr(strip_tags((string)($course['description'] ?? '')), 0, 150) . '...');
        }

        $navHtml = $this->navService->renderCourseNav($courseSlug);
        $tree = $this->navService->getCourseTree($courseSlug);
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $firstLessonUrl = null;
        if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
            foreach ($tree as $mod) {
                if (!empty($mod['lessons'])) {
                    $firstLessonUrl = $mod['lessons'][0]['url'] ?? null;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $price = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
        $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? false : (isset($course['is_free']) ? (bool)$course['is_free'] : true);
        $externalCheckout = trim((string)($course['external_checkout_url'] ?? ''));
        $externalLink = trim((string)($course['link'] ?? ''));

        $ctaButton = '';
        if ($isFree || $price <= 0.0) {
            if ($firstLessonUrl) {
                $ctaButton = "<a href='{$firstLessonUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='display:inline-block; margin-top:20px; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:6px; background:#45f3ff; color:#0b0c10; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none;'>🚀 Começar Agora &rarr;</a>";
            }
        } else {
            // Curso pago: direciona para checkout externo ou DomainCommerce interno
            if ($externalCheckout !== '') {
                $checkoutUrl = htmlspecialchars($externalCheckout, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $ctaButton = "<a href='{$checkoutUrl}' target='_blank' class='btn btn-primary' style='display:inline-block; margin-top:20px; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:6px; background:#00d284; color:#0b0c10; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none;'>🛒 Comprar / Matricular-se &rarr;</a>";
            } elseif ($externalLink !== '' && (str_starts_with($externalLink, 'http://') || str_starts_with($externalLink, 'https://'))) {
                $checkoutUrl = htmlspecialchars($externalLink, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $ctaButton = "<a href='{$checkoutUrl}' target='_blank' class='btn btn-primary' style='display:inline-block; margin-top:20px; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:6px; background:#00d284; color:#0b0c10; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none;'>🛒 Comprar / Matricular-se &rarr;</a>";
            } else {
                $commerceUrl = htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/checkout/curso/' . (int)$course['id'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $ctaButton = "<a href='{$commerceUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='display:inline-block; margin-top:20px; padding:12px 28px; border-radius:6px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00d284, #00b370); color:#000; font-weight:800; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,210,132,0.35); font-size:1.05rem;'>Comprar</a>";
            }
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('front/course', [
            'course'    => $course,
            'title'     => $title,
            'desc'      => $desc,
            'ctaButton' => $ctaButton,
            'navHtml'   => $navHtml,
            'baseUrl'   => $baseUrl,
        ]);

        return new Response($html);
    }

    /**
     * Exibição de aula específica com sidebar navegável e 3 Perfis Mobile: GET /cursos/{courseSlug}/{lessonSlug}
     */
    public function showLesson(string $courseSlug, string $lessonSlug): Response
    {
        $course = $this->courseRepo->findBySlug($courseSlug);
        if (!$course) {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1>", 404);
        }
        if (($course['status'] ?? '') !== 'published') {
            $statusLabel = ($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon' ? 'Em Breve' : 'Rascunho';
            return new Response(
                "<h1>404 - Curso não encontrado</h1>" .
                "<p>O curso <strong>" . htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</strong> está com o status <strong>{$statusLabel}</strong>. Altere o status do curso para <strong>Publicado</strong> no painel Academy para liberar o acesso às aulas.</p>",
                404
            );
        }

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getPublishedLessonBySlug((int)$course['id'], $lessonSlug);
        if (!$lesson || ($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Aula não encontrada</h1><p>A aula solicitada não existe ou está em rascunho neste curso.</p>", 404);
        }

        $lessonTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($this->seo !== null) {
            $plainDesc = $this->blockRenderer !== null
                ? $this->blockRenderer->extractPlainText((string)($lesson['content'] ?? ''))
                : strip_tags((string)($lesson['content'] ?? ''));
            if ($plainDesc === '') {
                $plainDesc = strip_tags((string)($course['description'] ?? ''));
            }
            $this->seo->setTitle($lessonTitle . ' - ' . $courseTitle . ' | Academy')
                ->setDescription(mb_substr($plainDesc, 0, 150) . '...');
        }

        $navHtml = $this->navService->renderCourseNav($courseSlug, $lessonSlug);
        $adjacent = $this->navService->getAdjacentLessons($courseSlug, $lessonSlug);

        $studentId = 0;
        if ($this->session !== null) {
            $studentId = (int)$this->session->get('academy_student_id', 0);
            if ($studentId <= 0) {
                $studentId = (int)$this->session->get('user_id', 0);
            }
        }

        // T12: Se o usuário foi banido ou suspenso, destrói a sessão e redireciona
        if ($studentId > 0 && $this->accountStatus !== null && $this->accountStatus->statusOf($studentId) !== 'active') {
            $this->session?->destroy();
            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
            return new Response('', 302, ['Location' => $baseUrl . '/login']);
        }

        // Guarda de Acesso (Matrícula Ativa / Aulas Fechadas vs. Gratuitas)
        $isRestricted = false;
        $coursePrice = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
        $isCoursePaid = $coursePrice > 0.0;
        $isLessonFreePreview = !empty($lesson['is_free']) || !empty($lesson['is_preview']);

        if ($this->enrollment !== null && $isCoursePaid && !$isLessonFreePreview) {
            $userRole = $this->session !== null ? (string)$this->session->get('user_role', '') : '';
            $isAdmin = in_array($userRole, ['admin', 'manager', 'instructor'], true);

            if (!$isAdmin && !$this->enrollment->hasActiveEnrollment($studentId, (int)$course['id'])) {
                $isRestricted = true;
            }
        }

        $bodyContent = '';
        if ($isRestricted) {
            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
            $checkoutUrl = $baseUrl . '/checkout/curso/' . (int)$course['id'];
            $loginUrl = $baseUrl . '/aluno/login?redirect=' . urlencode($checkoutUrl);
            $registerUrl = $baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro?redirect=' . urlencode($checkoutUrl);
            $formattedPrice = number_format($coursePrice, 2, ',', '.');

            $thumb = (string)($course['thumbnail'] ?? $course['image'] ?? '');
            $imgHtml = '';
            if (!empty($thumb)) {
                $imgSrc = (str_starts_with($thumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'data:'))
                    ? htmlspecialchars($thumb, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')
                    : htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($thumb, '/'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $imgHtml = "<div style='margin-bottom: 22px; display: flex; justify-content: center;'>
                    <img src='{$imgSrc}' alt='Capa do Curso' style='max-width: 380px; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.25); box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);'>
                </div>";
            }

            $bodyContent = "
            <div class='ds-academy-restricted-box' style='margin: 30px 0; padding: 40px 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: #0f141c; border: 1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);'>
                {$imgHtml}
                <div style='font-size: 2.4rem; margin-bottom: 12px;'>🔒</div>
                <h3 style='color: #fff; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px;'>Conteúdo Exclusivo para Alunos Matriculados</h3>
                <p style='color: #94a3b8; max-width: 540px; margin: 0 auto 24px auto; font-size: 0.96rem; line-height: 1.65;'>
                    Esta aula faz parte do curso <strong>" . htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</strong>.
                    Para desbloquear os vídeos, apostilas e códigos completos, garanta sua vaga agora mesmo!
                </p>
                <div style='display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;'>
                    <a href='{$checkoutUrl}' style='display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d284, #00b370); color: #000; font-weight: 800; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,210,132,0.35); transition: transform 0.2s;'>
                        🛒 Matricular-se por R$ {$formattedPrice} (Mercado Pago)
                    </a>
                    <a href='{$loginUrl}' style='display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #cbd5e1; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.94rem;'>
                        🔑 Já sou Aluno (Entrar)
                    </a>
                    <a href='{$registerUrl}' style='display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(69,243,255,0.08); color: #45f3ff; border: 1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.94rem;'>
                        📝 Criar Conta de Aluno
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        } else {
            $themeFile = $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? null;
            if (!empty($themeFile) && ($lesson['source_type'] ?? '') !== 'content') {
                $bodyContent = $this->renderThemeFile((string)$themeFile, [
                    'course'   => $course,
                    'lesson'   => $lesson,
                    'adjacent' => $adjacent,
                    'navHtml'  => $navHtml,
                ]);
            } elseif (!empty($lesson['content'])) {
                $bodyContent = $this->blockRenderer !== null
                    ? $this->blockRenderer->render((string)$lesson['content'])
                    : (string)$lesson['content'];
            } elseif (!empty($themeFile)) {
                $bodyContent = $this->renderThemeFile((string)$themeFile, [
                    'course'   => $course,
                    'lesson'   => $lesson,
                    'adjacent' => $adjacent,
                    'navHtml'  => $navHtml,
                ]);
            } else {
                $bodyContent = "<div class='ds-academy-empty-lesson' style='padding:40px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted);'><p>O conteúdo desta aula está sendo preparado.</p></div>";
            }
        }

        $paginationHtml = $this->renderPagination($adjacent);
        $courseUrl = (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '') . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);
        $mobileProfile = (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');

        $studentId = 0;
        if ($this->session !== null) {
            $studentId = (int)$this->session->get('academy_student_id', 0);
            if ($studentId <= 0) {
                $studentId = (int)$this->session->get('user_id', 0);
            }
        }
        $isLessonCompleted = false;
        if ($studentId > 0 && $this->progressService !== null && isset($lesson['id'])) {
            $isLessonCompleted = $this->progressService->isLessonCompleted($studentId, (int)$lesson['id']);
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('front/lesson', [
            'courseUrl'         => $courseUrl,
            'courseTitle'       => $courseTitle,
            'lessonTitle'       => $lessonTitle,
            'bodyContent'       => $bodyContent,
            'navHtml'           => $navHtml,
            'paginationHtml'    => $paginationHtml,
            'adjacent'          => $adjacent,
            'mobileProfile'     => $mobileProfile,
            'lessonId'          => (int)($lesson['id'] ?? 0),
            'courseId'          => (int)($course['id'] ?? 0),
            'userId'            => $studentId,
            'isCompleted'       => $isLessonCompleted,
            'isRestricted'      => $isRestricted,
            'csrfToken'         => $this->session ? (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken() : '',
        ]);

        return new Response($html);
    }

    private function renderPagination(array $adjacent): string
    {
        $prev = $adjacent['prev'] ?? null;
        $next = $adjacent['next'] ?? null;

        if (!$prev && !$next) {
            return '';
        }

        $prevHtml = '';
        if ($prev) {
            $prevTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$prev['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $prevUrl = htmlspecialchars((string)$prev['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $prevHtml = "<a href='{$prevUrl}' class='btn btn-outline' style='text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;'>
                &larr; Anterior: {$prevTitle}
            </a>";
        }

        $nextHtml = '';
        if ($next) {
            $nextTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$next['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $nextUrl = htmlspecialchars((string)$next['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $nextHtml = "<a href='{$nextUrl}' class='btn btn-primary' style='text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;'>
                Próxima Aula: {$nextTitle} &rarr;
            </a>";
        }

        return "
        <nav class='ds-academy-pagination' aria-label='Navegação entre Aulas' style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; margin-top:50px; padding-top:30px; border-top:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15);'>
            <div>{$prevHtml}</div>
            <div>{$nextHtml}</div>
        </nav>";
    }

    private function themeFileExists(string $themeFile): bool
    {
        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        if ($themePath === '') {
            return false;
        }
        $target = $themePath . '/' . ltrim($themeFile, '/\\');
        $realTarget = realpath($target);
        $realTheme = realpath($themePath);
        if ($realTarget === false || $realTheme === false) {
            return false;
        }
        $prefix = rtrim($realTheme, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
        return str_starts_with($realTarget, $prefix) && is_file($realTarget);
    }

    private function renderThemeFile(string $themeFile, array $context): string
    {
        $themePath = $this->resolveActiveThemePath();
        if ($themePath === '') {
            return "<div class='alert alert-warning' style='padding:20px; color:#ffb703; background:rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.1); border-radius:8px;'>Arquivo do tema não encontrado ou inacessível: " . htmlspecialchars($themeFile, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</div>";
        }

        $target = $themePath . '/' . ltrim($themeFile, '/\\');
        $realTarget = realpath($target);
        $realTheme = realpath($themePath);
        $realThemePrefix = $realTheme !== false ? rtrim($realTheme, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR : '';

        if ($realTarget === false || $realTheme === false || !str_starts_with($realTarget, $realThemePrefix) || !is_file($realTarget)) {
            return "<div class='alert alert-warning' style='padding:20px; color:#ffb703; background:rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.1); border-radius:8px;'>Arquivo do tema não encontrado ou inacessível: " . htmlspecialchars($themeFile, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "</div>";
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($context, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $realTarget;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }

    private function resolveActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->pageResolver !== null) {
            return $this->pageResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        }

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $activePath = $this->themeManager->getActiveThemePath();
            if (!empty($activePath) && is_dir($activePath)) {
                return $activePath;
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonPdfStorageInterface;
use Throwable;

class LessonAdminController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder;
    private ?LessonPdfStorageInterface $pdfStorage;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder = null,
        ?LessonPdfStorageInterface $pdfStorage = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->scaffolder = $scaffolder;
        $this->pdfStorage = $pdfStorage;
    }

    public function editor(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Aula não encontrada.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $course = $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$lesson['course_id']);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso vinculado à aula não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $moduleTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
        $moduleFolderSlug = null;
        $allModules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$course['id']);
        $allCourseLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);
        if (!empty($lesson['module_id'])) {
            foreach ($allModules as $m) {
                if ((int)$m['id'] === (int)$lesson['module_id']) {
                    $moduleTitle = (string)$m['title'];
                    $moduleFolderSlug = !empty($m['folder_slug']) ? (string)$m['folder_slug'] : null;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $prevLessonTitle = null;
        $nextLessonTitle = null;
        $flatLessons = array_values($allCourseLessons);
        foreach ($flatLessons as $idx => $fl) {
            if ((int)$fl['id'] === $lessonId) {
                if ($idx > 0) {
                    $prevLessonTitle = (string)$flatLessons[$idx - 1]['title'];
                }
                if ($idx < count($flatLessons) - 1) {
                    $nextLessonTitle = (string)$flatLessons[$idx + 1]['title'];
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        $rawContent = (string)($lesson['content'] ?? '');
        $initialBlocks = [];

        if ($rawContent !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($rawContent, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $initialBlocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : []);
            } else {
                $initialBlocks = [
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_init_1',
                        'type' => 'paragraph',
                        'data' => ['text' => $rawContent],
                    ],
                ];
            }
        } elseif (!empty($lesson['source']) && $this->scaffolder !== null && method_exists($this->scaffolder, 'extractBlocksFromFile')) {
            $extractedJson = $this->scaffolder->extractBlocksFromFile((string)$lesson['source']);
            if (is_string($extractedJson) && $extractedJson !== '') {
                $decoded = json_decode($extractedJson, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    $initialBlocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : []);
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($initialBlocks)) {
            $initialBlocks = [
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_init_h',
                    'type' => 'header',
                    'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => (string)$lesson['title']],
                ],
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_init_p',
                    'type' => 'paragraph',
                    'data' => ['text' => 'Digite aqui o conteúdo da aula ou adicione novos blocos abaixo...'],
                ],
            ];
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $siteLessonUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)$course['slug']) . '/' . urlencode((string)$lesson['slug']);

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/lessons/editor', [
            'lessonId'         => $lessonId,
            'lesson'           => $lesson,
            'course'           => $course,
            'moduleTitle'      => $moduleTitle,
            'moduleFolderSlug' => $moduleFolderSlug,
            'flatLessons'      => $flatLessons,
            'prevLessonTitle'  => $prevLessonTitle,
            'nextLessonTitle'  => $nextLessonTitle,
            'initialBlocks'    => $initialBlocks,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'siteLessonUrl'    => $siteLessonUrl,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function updateContent(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $jsonData = $request->json();
        if (empty($jsonData)) {
            $rawBody = $request->rawBody();
            if ($rawBody !== '') {
                $decoded = json_decode($rawBody, true);
                if (is_array($decoded)) {
                    $jsonData = $decoded;
                }
            }
        }

        $token = '';
        $title = null;
        $status = null;
        $mobileProfile = null;
        $fabricatePhp = false;
        $blocks = null;

        if (!empty($jsonData) && is_array($jsonData)) {
            $token = (string)($jsonData['csrf_token'] ?? '');
            $title = isset($jsonData['title']) ? (string)$jsonData['title'] : null;
            $status = isset($jsonData['status']) ? (string)$jsonData['status'] : null;
            $mobileProfile = isset($jsonData['mobile_profile']) ? (string)$jsonData['mobile_profile'] : null;
            $fabricatePhp = !empty($jsonData['fabricate_php']);
            $blocks = $jsonData['blocks'] ?? null;
        } else {
            $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
            $title = $request->input('title');
            $status = $request->input('status');
            $mobileProfile = $request->input('mobile_profile');
            $fabricatePhp = !empty($request->input('fabricate_php'));
            $rawBlocks = $request->input('blocks_json');
            if ($rawBlocks) {
                $blocks = is_array($rawBlocks) ? $rawBlocks : json_decode((string)$rawBlocks, true);
            } elseif (is_array($request->input('blocks'))) {
                $blocks = $request->input('blocks');
            }
        }

        if ($token === '' && !empty($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'])) {
            $token = (string)$request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'];
        }
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido']), 403, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        }

        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aula não encontrada']), 404, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Aula não encontrada.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $contentToSave = is_array($blocks)
            ? (string)json_encode(['time' => time(), 'blocks' => $blocks], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)
            : '';

        $effectiveTitle = ($title !== null && trim($title) !== '') ? trim($title) : (string)$lesson['title'];
        $effectiveProfile = ($mobileProfile !== null && in_array($mobileProfile, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true))
            ? $mobileProfile
            : (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');

        $updateData = [
            'source_type'    => 'content',
            'content'        => $contentToSave,
            'mobile_profile' => $effectiveProfile,
        ];

        if ($title !== null && trim($title) !== '') {
            $updateData['title'] = $effectiveTitle;
        }
        if ($status !== null && in_array($status, ['published', 'draft'], true)) {
            $updateData['status'] = $status;
        }

        try {
            $fabricatedPath = null;
            if ($fabricatePhp && $this->scaffolder !== null) {
                $folderSlug = null;
                if (!empty($lesson['module_id'])) {
                    foreach ($this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$lesson['course_id']) as $m) {
                        if ((int)$m['id'] === (int)$lesson['module_id'] && !empty($m['folder_slug'])) {
                            $folderSlug = (string)$m['folder_slug'];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $fabricated = $this->scaffolder->fabricateLessonFile(
                    $effectiveTitle,
                    $folderSlug,
                    $contentToSave !== '' ? $contentToSave : null,
                    $effectiveProfile
                );
                $updateData['slug'] = $fabricated['slug'];
                $updateData['source'] = $fabricated['relative_path'];
                $fabricatedPath = $fabricated['relative_path'];
            }

            $this->structureRepo->updateLesson($lessonId, $updateData);

            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success'         => true,
                    'message'         => $fabricatedPath ? "Aula salva e arquivo '{$fabricatedPath}' fabricado!" : 'Aula salva com sucesso!',
                    'fabricated_path' => $fabricatedPath,
                ]), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Conteúdo da aula atualizado com sucesso!");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Erro ao salvar: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                ]), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao salvar aula: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/lessons/' . $lessonId . '/editor');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Endpoint AJAX para envio de arquivo PDF local (pasta na Hostinger / XAMPP) vinculado a um bloco da aula.
     */
    public function uploadPdf(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (ob_get_length() > 0) {
            @ob_clean();
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        if ($token === '' && !empty($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'])) {
            $token = (string)$request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'];
        }
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido ou tamanho do arquivo excedeu o post_max_size do PHP (' . ini_get('post_max_size') . ').',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 403, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        if ($this->pdfStorage === null) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Serviço de armazenamento de PDF indisponível.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 503, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        $file = $request->file('pdf') ?? ($request->file('file') ?? null);
        if (!is_array($file)) {
            $contentLength = (int)($request->server['CONTENT_LENGTH'] ?? ($request->server['HTTP_CONTENT_LENGTH'] ?? 0));
            if ($contentLength > 0) {
                $mbSent = number_format($contentLength / 1048576, 1, ',', '.');
                $postMax = (string)ini_get('post_max_size');
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => "O arquivo PDF enviado ({$mbSent} MB) excede o limite de post_max_size do servidor PHP ({$postMax}).",
                ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 413, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Nenhum arquivo PDF foi enviado.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 400, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        try {
            $stored = $this->pdfStorage->storePdfUpload($file);
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success'       => true,
                'url'           => $stored['url'],
                'relative_path' => $stored['relative_path'],
                'file_name'     => $stored['file_name'],
                'size'          => $stored['size'],
                'message'       => 'Arquivo PDF enviado com sucesso!',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => $e->getMessage(),
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 422, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Falha ao salvar o arquivo PDF no servidor.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }
    }

    private function isAjax(Request $request): bool
    {
        $accept = (string)($request->server['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '');
        $xrw = (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'] ?? '');
        $ct = (string)($request->server['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '');

        return str_contains($accept, 'application/json')
            || str_contains($xrw, 'XMLHttpRequest')
            || str_contains($ct, 'application/json');
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/StudentAdminController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PasswordPolicyInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAdminServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentViewRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentViewRenderer;

class StudentAdminController
{
    private StudentAdminServiceInterface $studentService;
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $theme;
    private StudentViewRendererInterface $viewRenderer;
    private ?PasswordPolicyInterface $passwordPolicy;

    public function __construct(
        StudentAdminServiceInterface $studentService,
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $theme = null,
        ?StudentViewRendererInterface $viewRenderer = null,
        ?PasswordPolicyInterface $passwordPolicy = null
    ) {
        $this->studentService = $studentService;
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->viewRenderer = $viewRenderer ?? new StudentViewRenderer();
        $this->passwordPolicy = $passwordPolicy;
    }

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $search = trim((string)$request->input('q', ''));
        $status = trim((string)$request->input('status', 'all'));
        $page = max(1, (int)$request->input('page', 1));
        $perPage = 15;

        $searchParam = $search !== '' ? $search : null;
        $statusParam = $status !== 'all' ? $status : null;

        $data = $this->studentService->listStudents($page, $perPage, $searchParam, $statusParam);
        $metrics = $this->studentService->getStudentMetrics();
        $allCourses = $this->courseRepo->findAll();

        $totalPages = max(1, (int)ceil($data['total'] / $perPage));
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = is_array($flash) ? ($flash['type'] ?? null) : null;
        $flashMsg = is_array($flash) ? ($flash['msg'] ?? null) : null;

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/students/index', [
            'students' => $data['items'],
            'total' => $data['total'],
            'page' => $page,
            'perPage' => $perPage,
            'totalPages' => $totalPages,
            'currentSearch' => $search,
            'currentStatus' => $status,
            'metrics' => $metrics,
            'allCourses' => $allCourses,
            'csrfToken' => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl' => $baseUrl,
            'flashType' => $flashType,
            'flashMsg' => $flashMsg,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function changeStatus(Request $request, int|string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }
        $studentId = (int)$id;
        $status = (string)$request->input('status', '');

        if ($this->studentService->setStudentStatus($studentId, $status)) {
            $labels = [
                'active' => 'reativado',
                'suspended' => 'suspenso',
                'banned' => 'banido com sucesso'
            ];
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Status do aluno atualizado: ' . ($labels[$status] ?? $status));
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Falha ao alterar o status do aluno.');
        }

        return $this->redirectBack();
    }

    public function enroll(Request $request, int|string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }
        $studentId = (int)$id;
        $courseId = (int)$request->input('course_id', 0);

        if ($courseId <= 0) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Selecione um curso válido para matricular o aluno.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }

        if ($this->studentService->enrollStudent($studentId, $courseId)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Aluno matriculado no curso com sucesso!');
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Não foi possível concluir a matrícula.');
        }

        return $this->redirectBack();
    }

    public function revoke(Request $request, int|string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }
        $studentId = (int)$id;
        $courseId = (int)$request->input('course_id', 0);

        if ($courseId <= 0) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Identificador de curso inválido para revogação.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }

        if ($this->studentService->revokeEnrollment($studentId, $courseId)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Matrícula cancelada/revogada com sucesso.');
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Falha ao revogar a matrícula.');
        }

        return $this->redirectBack();
    }

    public function resetPassword(Request $request, int|string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }
        $studentId = (int)$id;
        $newPassword = (string)$request->input('new_password', '');

        if ($this->passwordPolicy !== null && !$this->passwordPolicy->isAcceptable($newPassword)) {
            $missing = implode(' ', $this->passwordPolicy->getMissingRequirements($newPassword));
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'A nova senha não atende aos requisitos: ' . $missing);
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }

        if ($this->passwordPolicy === null && strlen($newPassword) < 8) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'A nova senha deve ter no mínimo 8 caracteres.');
            return $this->redirectBack();
        }

        if ($this->studentService->resetStudentPassword($studentId, $newPassword)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Senha do aluno redefinida com sucesso!');
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Erro ao redefinir senha do aluno.');
        }

        return $this->redirectBack();
    }

    private function verifyCsrfToken(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token', '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || $expected === '') {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    private function redirectBack(): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/students');
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}
