// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/StudentAuthController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PasswordPolicyInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SafeRedirectValidatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\SafeRedirectValidator;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAuthServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentViewRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoStudentCredentialRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentAuthService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentViewRenderer;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\LoginThrottleInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Controlador de Autenticação e Cadastro da Sala de Aula / Alunos (SRP / DIP / Sem Superglobais).
 * Totalmente desacoplado do Painel Administrativo através dos contratos
 * StudentAuthServiceInterface, StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface e StudentViewRendererInterface.
 */
class StudentAuthController
{
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?PDO $pdo;
    private StudentAuthServiceInterface $studentAuth;
    private StudentViewRendererInterface $viewRenderer;
    private SafeRedirectValidatorInterface $redirectValidator;
    private ?PasswordPolicyInterface $passwordPolicy;
    private ?LoginThrottleInterface $throttle;
    private ?StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface $credentialRepo;

    public function __construct(
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO|null $db = null,
        ?StudentAuthServiceInterface $studentAuth = null,
        ?StudentViewRendererInterface $viewRenderer = null,
        ?SafeRedirectValidatorInterface $redirectValidator = null,
        ?PasswordPolicyInterface $passwordPolicy = null,
        ?LoginThrottleInterface $throttle = null,
        ?StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface $credentialRepo = null
    ) {
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->pdo = $db instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $db->getPdo() : $db;
        $this->studentAuth = $studentAuth ?? new StudentAuthService($session);
        $this->viewRenderer = $viewRenderer ?? new StudentViewRenderer();
        $this->redirectValidator = $redirectValidator ?? new SafeRedirectValidator();
        $this->passwordPolicy = $passwordPolicy;
        $this->throttle = $throttle;
        $this->credentialRepo = $credentialRepo ?? ($this->pdo !== null ? new PdoStudentCredentialRepository($this->pdo) : null);
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Login do Aluno: GET /aluno/login
     */
    public function showLoginForm(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        // Se o usuário solicitou logout explícito (?logged_out=1), garante purga do escopo
        if ($request->has('logged_out')) {
            $this->studentAuth->logout();
        } elseif ($this->studentAuth->isLoggedIn()) {
            // Se já houver aluno autenticado no escopo da academia, redireciona para o painel de aulas
            $rawRedirect = (string)$request->input('redirect', $baseUrl . '/aluno/painel');
            $safeRedirect = $this->redirectValidator->sanitize($rawRedirect, $baseUrl . '/aluno/painel');
            return Response::redirect($safeRedirect);
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $rawRedirect = (string)$request->input('redirect', '');
        $redirect = $this->redirectValidator->sanitize($rawRedirect, '');
        $error = $this->studentAuth->getFlash('error') ?: (is_array($f = $this->session->getFlash()) && ($f['type'] ?? '') === 'error' ? $f['msg'] : null);
        $success = $this->studentAuth->getFlash('success') ?: (isset($f) && is_array($f) && ($f['type'] ?? '') === 'success' ? $f['msg'] : null);

        return $this->viewRenderer->render('front/student/login', [
            'baseUrl'   => $baseUrl,
            'csrfToken' => $csrfToken,
            'redirect'  => $redirect,
            'error'     => $error,
            'success'   => $success,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Processa a Autenticação do Aluno: POST /aluno/login
     */
    public function authenticate(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $rawRedirect = (string)$request->input('redirect', '');
        $redirect = $this->redirectValidator->sanitize($rawRedirect, '');
        $targetUrl = $redirect !== '' ? $redirect : ($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel');

        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token', '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $token)) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login' . ($redirect !== '' ? '?redirect=' . urlencode($redirect) : ''));
        }

        $email = strtolower(trim((string)$request->input('email', '')));
        $password = (string)$request->input('password', '');

        if ($email === '' || $password === '') {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Informe seu e-mail e sua senha de acesso.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login' . ($redirect !== '' ? '?redirect=' . urlencode($redirect) : ''));
        }

        // T14: Throttle anti-força bruta por chave de e-mail e IP
        $clientIp = (string)($request->server['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1');
        $throttleKey = $email . '|' . $clientIp;

        if ($this->throttle !== null && $this->throttle->tooManyAttempts($throttleKey)) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Muitas tentativas de login incorretas. Aguarde alguns minutos antes de tentar novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login' . ($redirect !== '' ? '?redirect=' . urlencode($redirect) : ''));
        }

        if ($this->credentialRepo === null) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Serviço de autenticação temporariamente indisponível.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login');
        }

        $user = $this->credentialRepo->findByEmail($email);

        // T21: Mitigação de timing attack via dummy hash (CWE-208)
        $dummyHash = '$2y$10$abcdefghijklmnopqrstuuABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ012';
        $hashToVerify = ($user && !empty($user->passwordHash)) ? $user->passwordHash : $dummyHash;
        $passwordValid = password_verify($password, $hashToVerify);

        if (!$user || !$passwordValid) {
            $this->throttle?->hit($throttleKey);
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login' . ($redirect !== '' ? '?redirect=' . urlencode($redirect) : ''));
        }

        $this->throttle?->clear($throttleKey);

        if ($user->status === 'banned') {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Sua conta de aluno foi banida por violação das diretrizes da plataforma.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login' . ($redirect !== '' ? '?redirect=' . urlencode($redirect) : ''));
        }
        if ($user->status === 'suspended') {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Sua conta de aluno está temporariamente suspensa. Entre em contato com o suporte.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login' . ($redirect !== '' ? '?redirect=' . urlencode($redirect) : ''));
        }

        // Regenera ID de sessão para mitigar Session Fixation
        $this->session->regenerate();

        // Login bem sucedido no escopo isolado do Aluno
        $this->studentAuth->login($user->id, $user->name, $user->email, $user->username);
        $this->session->set('academy_student_role', $user->role);

        // Define mensagem no escopo exclusivo do aluno e elimina resquícios de flashes administrativos
        $this->studentAuth->setFlash('success', 'Bem-vindo de volta, ' . htmlspecialchars($user->name) . '!');
        $this->session->remove('flash_message');
        return Response::redirect($targetUrl);
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Cadastro do Novo Aluno: GET /aluno/cadastro
     */
    public function showRegisterForm(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if ($this->studentAuth->isLoggedIn()) {
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel');
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $redirect = (string)$request->input('redirect', '');
        $error = $this->studentAuth->getFlash('error') ?: (is_array($f = $this->session->getFlash()) && ($f['type'] ?? '') === 'error' ? $f['msg'] : null);

        return $this->viewRenderer->render('front/student/register', [
            'baseUrl'   => $baseUrl,
            'csrfToken' => $csrfToken,
            'redirect'  => $redirect,
            'error'     => $error,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Processa a Criação de Conta do Aluno: POST /aluno/cadastro
     */
    public function register(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $rawRedirect = (string)$request->input('redirect', '');
        $redirect = $this->redirectValidator->sanitize($rawRedirect, '');
        $targetUrl = $redirect !== '' ? $redirect : ($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel');

        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token', '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $token)) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        $name = trim((string)$request->input('name', ''));
        $username = strtolower(trim((string)$request->input('username', '')));
        $email = strtolower(trim((string)$request->input('email', '')));
        $password = (string)$request->input('password', '');
        $passwordConfirm = (string)$request->input('password_confirmation', '');

        if ($name === '' || $email === '' || $password === '') {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Preencha todos os campos obrigatórios.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        // Se o username não foi preenchido, sugere a partir do nome
        if ($username === '') {
            $username = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_.]/', '', strtolower(str_replace(' ', '', $name)));
        }

        // Se ainda for muito curto
        if (strlen($username) < 3) {
            $username = 'aluno' . substr(md5($email . (string)microtime(true)), 0, 6);
        }

        // Validação de formato de username
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9_.-]{3,40}$/', $username)) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'O nome de usuário deve conter apenas letras minúsculas, números, ponto ou traço (de 3 a 40 caracteres).');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Por favor, informe um endereço de e-mail válido.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        if ($this->passwordPolicy !== null && !$this->passwordPolicy->isAcceptable($password)) {
            $missing = implode(' ', $this->passwordPolicy->getMissingRequirements($password));
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'A senha não atende aos requisitos: ' . $missing);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }
        if ($this->passwordPolicy === null && strlen($password) < 8) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'A senha de acesso deve ter pelo menos 8 caracteres.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        if ($password !== $passwordConfirm) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'A confirmação de senha não confere.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        if ($this->credentialRepo === null) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Serviço de cadastro temporariamente indisponível.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        // Verifica duplicidade de e-mail
        if ($this->credentialRepo->findByEmail($email) !== null) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Este e-mail já possui cadastro. Faça login para continuar.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login');
        }

        // Verifica duplicidade de nome de usuário
        if ($this->credentialRepo->findByUsername($username) !== null) {
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', "O nome de usuário '@{$username}' já está em uso. Por favor, escolha outro.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }

        try {
            $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
            $newId = $this->credentialRepo->createStudent($name, $username, $email, $hash);

            // Regenera ID de sessão para mitigar Session Fixation
            $this->session->regenerate();

            // Auto-login do novo aluno na sessão isolada da academia
            $this->studentAuth->login($newId, $name, $email, $username);

            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('success', 'Conta de aluno criada com sucesso! Seja bem-vindo à sala de aula.');
            $this->session->remove('flash_message');
            return Response::redirect($targetUrl);

        } catch (\PDOException $e) {
            // Código 23000 (ANSI SQL) / 1062 (MySQL) / SQLITE_CONSTRAINT
            if ($e->getCode() === '23000' || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'UNIQUE') || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'Integrity constraint')) {
                $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Este e-mail ou nome de usuário já possui cadastro. Faça login para continuar.');
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login');
            }

            error_log('[StudentAuthController] Erro interno no cadastro: ' . $e->getMessage());
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Não foi possível concluir seu cadastro no momento. Por favor, tente novamente mais tarde.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            error_log('[StudentAuthController] Falha inesperada no cadastro: ' . $e->getMessage());
            $this->studentAuth->setFlash('error', 'Ocorreu uma falha no processamento do cadastro. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/cadastro');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Logout do Aluno: GET|POST /aluno/logout
     */
    public function logout(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $this->studentAuth->logout();
        $this->studentAuth->setFlash('success', 'Você saiu da sua conta.');
        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Você saiu da sua conta.');

        $homeUrl = $baseUrl !== '' ? $baseUrl . '/' : '/';
        return Response::redirect($homeUrl);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Controllers/StudentDashboardController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\AccountStatusProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAuthServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentViewRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentAuthService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentViewRenderer;

/**
 * Controlador do Cockpit / Painel do Aluno (SRP / DIP / Sem Superglobais).
 * Totalmente isolado através de StudentAuthServiceInterface e StudentViewRendererInterface.
 */
class StudentDashboardController
{
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService;
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private StudentProgressInterface $progressService;
    private StudentStorageInterface $studentStorage;
    private StudentAuthServiceInterface $studentAuth;
    private StudentViewRendererInterface $viewRenderer;
    private ?\PDO $pdo;
    private ?AccountStatusProviderInterface $accountStatus;

    public function __construct(
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService,
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        StudentProgressInterface $progressService,
        StudentStorageInterface $studentStorage,
        ?StudentAuthServiceInterface $studentAuth = null,
        ?StudentViewRendererInterface $viewRenderer = null,
        \DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface|\PDO|null $db = null,
        ?AccountStatusProviderInterface $accountStatus = null
    ) {
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->enrollmentService = $enrollmentService;
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->progressService = $progressService;
        $this->studentStorage = $studentStorage;
        $this->studentAuth = $studentAuth ?? new StudentAuthService($session);
        $this->viewRenderer = $viewRenderer ?? new StudentViewRenderer();
        $this->pdo = $db instanceof \DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $db->getPdo() : $db;
        $this->accountStatus = $accountStatus;
    }

    /**
     * Painel do Aluno: GET /aluno/painel
     */
    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->studentAuth->isLoggedIn()) {
            $this->session->setFlash('warning', 'Faça login na sua conta de aluno para acessar o painel de aulas.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login?redirect=' . urlencode($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel'));
        }

        $studentId = (int)$this->studentAuth->getStudentId();
        if ($studentId > 0 && $this->accountStatus !== null && $this->accountStatus->statusOf($studentId) !== 'active') {
            $this->studentAuth->logout();
            $this->session->destroy();
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login');
        }
        $studentName = (string)($this->studentAuth->getStudentName() ?? 'Aluno');
        $studentUsername = $this->studentAuth->getStudentUsername();

        // Sincroniza dados atualizados do banco (nome oficial, username e role)
        if ($studentId > 0 && $this->pdo !== null) {
            try {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT name, username, role FROM users WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1");
                $stmt->execute([$studentId]);
                if ($u = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
                    $studentName = (string)$u['name'];
                    $this->session->set('academy_student_name', $studentName);
                    if (!empty($u['username'])) {
                        $studentUsername = (string)$u['username'];
                        $this->session->set('academy_student_username', $studentUsername);
                    }
                    if (!empty($u['role'])) {
                        $this->session->set('academy_student_role', (string)$u['role']);
                        $this->session->set('user_role', (string)$u['role']);
                    }
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback defensivo caso a coluna username não exista na tabela users
                try {
                    $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT name, role FROM users WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1");
                    $stmt->execute([$studentId]);
                    if ($u = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
                        $studentName = (string)$u['name'];
                        $this->session->set('academy_student_name', $studentName);
                        if (!empty($u['role'])) {
                            $this->session->set('academy_student_role', (string)$u['role']);
                            $this->session->set('user_role', (string)$u['role']);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (\Throwable $e2) {
                    // Silencioso se não conseguir ler
                }
            }
        }

        $userRole = (string)$this->session->get('academy_student_role', (string)$this->session->get('user_role', ''));
        $isAdmin = in_array($userRole, ['admin', 'manager', 'instructor'], true);

        // Se for administrador/instrutor, tem acesso irrestrito a todas as formações publicadas
        $allPublished = $this->courseRepo->findPublished(['limit' => 100]);

        if ($isAdmin) {
            $activeCourseIds = array_map(fn($c) => (int)$c['id'], $allPublished);
        } else {
            $activeCourseIds = $this->enrollmentService->getActiveCourseIds($studentId);
        }

        $enrolledCourses = [];

        foreach ($activeCourseIds as $cId) {
            $c = $this->courseRepo->findById($cId);
            if ($c && ($c['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
                $pct = $this->progressService->getCourseProgressPercentage($studentId, $cId);
                $lessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($cId);
                $completedIds = $this->progressService->getCompletedLessonIds($studentId, $cId);

                // Identifica a próxima aula pendente para continuar assistindo
                $nextLesson = null;
                foreach ($lessons as $l) {
                    if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') === 'published' && !in_array((int)$l['id'], $completedIds, true)) {
                        $nextLesson = $l;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if ($nextLesson === null && !empty($lessons)) {
                    $nextLesson = $lessons[0];
                }

                $enrolledCourses[] = [
                    'course'           => $c,
                    'progress_pct'     => $pct,
                    'completed_count'  => count($completedIds),
                    'total_lessons'    => count($lessons),
                    'next_lesson'      => $nextLesson,
                    'course_url'       => $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)$c['slug']),
                    'resume_url'       => $nextLesson ? ($baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)$c['slug']) . '/' . urlencode((string)$nextLesson['slug'])) : null,
                ];
            }
        }

        // Cursos disponíveis para compra ou novas matrículas no catálogo (alunos comuns)
        $availableCourses = [];
        if (!$isAdmin) {
            foreach ($allPublished as $pub) {
                if (!in_array((int)$pub['id'], $activeCourseIds, true)) {
                    $availableCourses[] = $pub;
                }
            }
        }

        $studentFiles = $this->studentStorage->listStudentFiles($studentId);
        $flash = $this->studentAuth->getFlash();

        return $this->viewRenderer->render('front/student/dashboard', [
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'studentId'        => $studentId,
            'studentName'      => $studentName,
            'studentUsername'  => $studentUsername,
            'isAdmin'          => $isAdmin,
            'enrolledCourses'  => $enrolledCourses,
            'availableCourses' => $availableCourses,
            'studentFiles'     => $studentFiles,
            'flash'            => $flash,
            'csrfToken'        => (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Alterna a conclusão de uma aula: POST /aluno/aulas/{id}/toggle-complete
     */
    public function toggleLessonProgress(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $studentId = (int)$this->studentAuth->getStudentId();
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Usuário não autenticado.'], 401);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''));
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aula não encontrada.'], 404);
        }

        $courseId = (int)$lesson['course_id'];
        $isCompleted = $this->progressService->isLessonCompleted($studentId, $lessonId);

        if ($isCompleted) {
            $this->progressService->markLessonIncomplete($studentId, $courseId, $lessonId);
            $newStatus = false;
        } else {
            $this->progressService->markLessonCompleted($studentId, $courseId, $lessonId);
            $newStatus = true;
        }

        $newPct = $this->progressService->getCourseProgressPercentage($studentId, $courseId);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success'      => true,
            'completed'    => $newStatus,
            'progress_pct' => $newPct,
            'message'      => $newStatus ? 'Aula marcada como concluída!' : 'Aula desmarcada.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Salva anotação pessoal do aluno: POST /aluno/aulas/{id}/notes
     */
    public function saveLessonNote(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $studentId = (int)$this->studentAuth->getStudentId();
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Usuário não autenticado.'], 401);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''));
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aula não encontrada.'], 404);
        }

        $content = (string)($request->input('content') ?? '');
        $saved = $this->studentStorage->saveStudentNote($studentId, (int)$lesson['course_id'], $lessonId, $content);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success' => $saved,
            'message' => $saved ? 'Anotação salva com sucesso!' : 'Falha ao salvar anotação.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Carrega anotação pessoal do aluno: GET /aluno/aulas/{id}/notes
     */
    public function getLessonNote(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $studentId = (int)$this->studentAuth->getStudentId();
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Usuário não autenticado.'], 401);
        }

        $lessonId = (int)$id;
        $lesson = $this->structureRepo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        if (!$lesson) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aula não encontrada.'], 404);
        }

        $note = $this->studentStorage->getStudentNote($studentId, (int)$lesson['course_id'], $lessonId);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success' => true,
            'content' => $note,
        ]);
    }
}

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->requireLink('core.storage');
        $os->requireLink('core.session');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
        $os->listenHook('payment.approved');
        $os->listenHook('payment.refunded');
        $os->listenHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers');
        $os->listenHook('theme.blocks.register');
        $os->listenHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // 1. Injeção de Dependências no Container via Contratos (DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(CourseRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoCourseRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoCourseStructureRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseEnrollmentService(
                $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentStorageInterface::class, function () {
            return new LocalStudentStorage();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentAuthServiceInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new StudentAuthService($runtime->make(SessionManagerInterface::class));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentViewRendererInterface::class, function () {
            return new StudentViewRenderer();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoStudentCredentialRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentProgressRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoStudentProgressRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentProgressInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new StudentProgressService(
                $runtime->make(StudentProgressRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentAdminRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoStudentAdminRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(StudentAdminServiceInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new StudentAdminService(
                $runtime->make(StudentAdminRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(StudentProgressRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->getLink('core.db')
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseImageStorageInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new LocalCourseImageStorage($runtime->getLink('core.storage'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseService::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseImageStorageInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseNavigationInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
            return new CourseNavigationService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class),
                $baseUrl
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new CourseCatalogRenderer(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->getLink('core.storage')
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseCatalogRenderer::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return $runtime->make(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class);
        });

            return new LessonBlockRenderer($runtime->make(LessonPdfStorageInterface::class));
        });

            return $runtime->make(LessonBlockRendererInterface::class);
        });

            $themeResolver = null;
            $siteState = null;
            try {
                if ($runtime->has(ThemeManagerInterface::class)) {
                    $themeManager = $runtime->make(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
                }
                if ($runtime->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemePathResolverInterface::class)) {
                    $themeResolver = $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemePathResolverInterface::class);
                }
                if ($runtime->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface::class)) {
                    $siteState = $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface::class);
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback seguro
            }
            return new ThemePageResolver($themeManager, $themeResolver, $siteState);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(LessonFileScaffolderInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new ThemeLessonFileScaffolder(
                $runtime->make(ThemePageResolverInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(LessonBlockRendererInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CoursePackageServiceInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new CoursePackageService(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(ThemePageResolverInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseService::class),
                $runtime->make(LessonFileScaffolderInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CourseFrontController::class, function () use ($runtime) {

                ? $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface::class)

                ? $runtime->make(ThemeManagerInterface::class)
                : null;
            $accountStatus = $runtime->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\AccountStatusProviderInterface::class)
                ? $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\AccountStatusProviderInterface::class)
                : null;

            return new CourseFrontController(
                $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseNavigationInterface::class),

                $seo,
                $themeManager,
                $runtime->make(LessonBlockRendererInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(ThemePageResolverInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(SessionManagerInterface::class),
                $runtime->make(StudentProgressInterface::class),
                $accountStatus
            );
        });

        // 2. Menu Administrativo
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role = 'guest') {
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title'   => 'Academy (Cursos)',
                    'url'     => '#',
                    'icon'    => '🎓',
                    'submenu' => [
                        [
                            'title' => 'Cursos & Aulas',
                            'url'   => '/admin/academy',
                            'icon'  => '📚',
                        ],
                        [
                            'title' => 'Alunos & Matrículas',
                            'url'   => '/admin/academy/students',
                            'icon'  => '👨‍🎓',
                        ],
                    ],
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // 3. Rotas Administrativas e Públicas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function (Router $router) {
            // Administrativas - Cursos & Fábrica de Pastas/Arquivos
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy', [CourseAdminController::class, 'index'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/edit/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'edit'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/store', [CourseAdminController::class, 'store'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/structure/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'updateStructure'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/scaffold/folder/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'createThemeFolder'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/export/{id}', [CourseAdminController::class, 'exportZip'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/import-zip', [CourseAdminController::class, 'importZip'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Administrativas - Gestão de Alunos & Matrículas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/students', [StudentAdminController::class, 'index'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/students/{id}/status', [StudentAdminController::class, 'changeStatus'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/students/{id}/enroll', [StudentAdminController::class, 'enroll'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/students/{id}/revoke', [StudentAdminController::class, 'revoke'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/students/{id}/reset-password', [StudentAdminController::class, 'resetPassword'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Administrativas - Editor em Blocos de Aulas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/editor', [LessonAdminController::class, 'editor'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/update-content', [LessonAdminController::class, 'updateContent'], 'academy', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/academy/lessons/{id}/upload-pdf', [LessonAdminController::class, 'uploadPdf'], 'academy', ['admin']);

            // Públicas
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos', [CourseFrontController::class, 'index'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos/{courseSlug}', [CourseFrontController::class, 'showCourse'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cursos/{courseSlug}/{lessonSlug}', [CourseFrontController::class, 'showLesson'], 'academy');

            // Autenticação e Cadastro da Sala de Aula / Alunos
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/aluno/login', [StudentAuthController::class, 'showLoginForm'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/aluno/login', [StudentAuthController::class, 'authenticate'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/aluno/cadastro', [StudentAuthController::class, 'showRegisterForm'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/aluno/cadastro', [StudentAuthController::class, 'register'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/aluno/logout', [StudentAuthController::class, 'logout'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/aluno/logout', [StudentAuthController::class, 'logout'], 'academy');

            // Cockpit / Espaço Individual do Aluno
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/aluno/painel', [StudentDashboardController::class, 'index'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/aluno/aulas/{id}/toggle-complete', [StudentDashboardController::class, 'toggleLessonProgress'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/aluno/aulas/{id}/notes', [StudentDashboardController::class, 'saveLessonNote'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/aluno/aulas/{id}/notes', [StudentDashboardController::class, 'getLessonNote'], 'academy');
        });

        // 4. Shortcode: [hub_de_cursos]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('hub_de_cursos', function ($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseCatalogRendererInterface $renderer */
                    $renderer = $runtime->make(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class);
                    return $renderer->render(is_array($attrs) ? $attrs : []);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>Hub de Cursos em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });

        // 5. Integração com Pagamentos / Webhooks (DIP & Event-driven): ativa matrícula automaticamente
        $runtime->onHook('payment.approved', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $userId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $courseId = (int)($payload['course_id'] ?? ($payload['item_id'] ?? 0));
            $orderRef = isset($payload['order_ref']) ? (string)$payload['order_ref'] : null;
            $expiresAt = isset($payload['expires_at']) && $payload['expires_at'] instanceof \DateTimeImmutable
                ? $payload['expires_at']
                : null;

            if ($userId > 0 && $courseId > 0) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService */
                    $enrollmentService = $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class);
                    $enrollmentService->enroll($userId, $courseId, $expiresAt, $orderRef);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Proteção de isolamento de falhas
                }
            }
        });

        // 5b. Revogação de Matrícula por Reembolso (T13):
        $runtime->onHook('payment.refunded', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $userId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $courseId = (int)($payload['course_id'] ?? ($payload['item_id'] ?? 0));

            if ($userId > 0 && $courseId > 0) {
                try {
                    if ($runtime->has(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class)) {
                        /** @var CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo */
                        $enrollmentRepo = $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $enrollmentRepo->updateStatus($userId, $courseId, 'cancelled');
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[Academy] Falha ao revogar matrícula por reembolso: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 6. Conexão com o Commerce (Padrão Adapter): expõe cursos como itens vendíveis
        $runtime->onHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers', function ($resolver) use ($runtime) {
            if ($resolver instanceof PurchasableItemResolverInterface) {
                $resolver->registerResolver('course', function (int $id) use ($runtime) {
                    try {
                        /** @var CourseRepositoryInterface $repo */
                        $repo = $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $course = $repo->findById($id);
                        return $course ? new CoursePurchasableAdapter($course) : null;
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                });
            }
        });

        // 7. Registro de Blocos Semânticos no Flex Builder via Contrato (SOLID - OCP / DIP)
        $registerAcademyBlocks = function ($registry) use ($runtime) {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'has') && !$registry->has('user_auth')) {
                $session = null;
                try {
                    $session = $runtime->getLink('core.session');
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

                $provider = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Blocks\AcademyBlockProvider(
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    $session
                );
                $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
            }
        };

        $runtime->onHook('theme.blocks.register', $registerAcademyBlocks);
        $runtime->onHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks', $registerAcademyBlocks);
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db');
        new PdoCourseRepository($db);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($db);
        $structureRepo->ensureTables();
        $enrollmentRepo = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($db);
        $enrollmentRepo->ensureTable();
        $progressRepo = new PdoStudentProgressRepository($db);
        $progressRepo->ensureTable();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência de matrículas (SQLite e MySQL / ANSI SQL).
 */
class PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository implements CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tableEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = false)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTable();
        }
    }

    public function ensureTable(): void
    {
        if ($this->tableEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $sql = "
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_enrollments (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                expires_at DATETIME NULL,
                order_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ";

        // Ajuste sintático para MySQL/MariaDB caso não seja SQLite
        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        if ($driver === 'mysql') {
            $sql = "
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_enrollments (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id INT NOT NULL,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                    expires_at DATETIME NULL,
                    order_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_course (user_id, course_id),
                    INDEX idx_status (status)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ";
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec($sql);
            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_academy_enrollments_uc ON academy_enrollments(user_id, course_id)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_enrollments_st ON academy_enrollments(status)");
            }
            $this->tableEnsured = true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Registra erro sem silenciar cegamente
            error_log("[Academy] Falha ao verificar/criar tabela academy_enrollments: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function findByStudentAndCourse(int $studentId, int $courseId): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_enrollments 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY id DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function findActiveByStudent(int $studentId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_enrollments 
            WHERE user_id = ? 
              AND status = 'active'
              AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?)
            ORDER BY id DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $now]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function saveEnrollment(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        string $status = 'active',
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Aluno ou curso inválido.');
        }

        $this->ensureTable();
        $existing = $this->findByStudentAndCourse($studentId, $courseId);
        $expiresStr = $expiresAt ? $expiresAt->format('Y-m-d H:i:s') : null;
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        if ($existing) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE academy_enrollments 
                SET status = ?, expires_at = ?, order_ref = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            return $stmt->execute([$status, $expiresStr, $orderRef, $now, (int)$existing['id']]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_enrollments (user_id, course_id, status, expires_at, order_ref, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        try {
            return $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId, $status, $expiresStr, $orderRef, $now, $now]);
        } catch (\PDOException $e) {
            // Trata exclusivamente violação comprovada de unicidade (concorrência)
            if ($this->isUniqueConstraintViolation($e)) {
                return $this->updateExistingEnrollment($studentId, $courseId, $status, $expiresStr, $orderRef, $now);
            }

            // Propaga qualquer outro erro real de banco (conexão, sintaxe, colunas)
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function isUniqueConstraintViolation(\PDOException $e): bool
    {
        $sqlState = (string)($e->errorInfo[0] ?? $e->getCode());
        $driverCode = (int)($e->errorInfo[1] ?? 0);
        $message = strtolower($e->getMessage());

        // MySQL / MariaDB: SQLSTATE 23000 + driver code 1062
        if ($sqlState === '23000' && $driverCode === 1062) {
            return true;
        }

        // SQLite: constraint violation unique
        if (str_contains($message, 'unique constraint') || str_contains($message, 'unique key') || str_contains($message, 'duplicate entry')) {
            return true;
        }

        if ($sqlState === '23000' && ($driverCode === 19 || $driverCode === 2067)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function updateExistingEnrollment(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        string $status,
        ?string $expiresAt,
        ?string $orderRef,
        string $now
    ): bool {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_enrollments 
            SET status = ?, expires_at = ?, order_ref = ?, updated_at = ?
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$status, $expiresAt, $orderRef, $now, $studentId, $courseId]);
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $studentId, int $courseId, string $status): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_enrollments 
            SET status = ?, updated_at = ?
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$status, $now, $studentId, $courseId]);
    }

    public function countEnrolledInCourse(int $courseId): int
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as total 
            FROM academy_enrollments 
            WHERE course_id = ? AND status = 'active'
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return (int)($row['total'] ?? 0);
    }

    public function countActiveEnrollments(): int
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM academy_enrollments WHERE status = 'active'");
            return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

class PdoCourseRepository implements CourseRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tableEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTableExists();
        }
    }

    public function findAll(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM academy_courses ORDER BY id DESC");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findByExternalProductId(string $externalProductId): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE external_product_id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$externalProductId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublished(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;
        $limit = isset($filters['limit']) ? (int)$filters['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        if (!empty($status)) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute([$status]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status IN ('published', 'soon') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute();
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $this->ensureTableExists();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_courses (title, slug, thumbnail, description, status, link, price, is_free, max_installments, external_platform, external_product_id, external_checkout_url)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
            (float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0),
            isset($data['is_free']) ? (int)(bool)$data['is_free'] : ((float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0) > 0 ? 0 : 1),
            isset($data['max_installments']) && (int)$data['max_installments'] > 0 ? (int)$data['max_installments'] : 12,
            $data['external_platform'] ?? null,
            $data['external_product_id'] ?? null,
            $data['external_checkout_url'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function update(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTableExists();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_courses
            SET title = ?, slug = ?, thumbnail = ?, description = ?, status = ?, link = ?, price = ?, is_free = ?, max_installments = ?, external_platform = ?, external_product_id = ?, external_checkout_url = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
            (float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0),
            isset($data['is_free']) ? (int)(bool)$data['is_free'] : ((float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0) > 0 ? 0 : 1),
            isset($data['max_installments']) && (int)$data['max_installments'] > 0 ? (int)$data['max_installments'] : 12,
            $data['external_platform'] ?? null,
            $data['external_product_id'] ?? null,
            $data['external_checkout_url'] ?? null,
            $id
        ]);
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function ensureTableExists(): void
    {
        if ($this->tableEnsured) {
            return;
        }
        $this->tableEnsured = true;

        $migrationFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations/2026_10_15_000001_create_academy_courses.php';
        if (is_file($migrationFile)) {
            $migration = require $migrationFile;
            if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
            }
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN is_free INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN max_installments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN external_platform VARCHAR(50) NULL");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN external_product_id VARCHAR(100) NULL");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN external_checkout_url VARCHAR(255) NULL");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

class PdoCourseStructureRepository implements CourseStructureRepositoryInterface
{
    private const VALID_STATUSES = ['draft', 'published'];
    private const VALID_SOURCE_TYPES = ['theme_file', 'content'];
    private const VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES = ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'];

    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tablesEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTables();
        }
    }

    public function getModules(int $courseId): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_modules 
            WHERE course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function createModule(int $courseId, string $title, int $position = 0, ?string $folderSlug = null): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_modules (course_id, title, position, folder_slug) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $title, $position, $folderSlug]);
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateModule(int $moduleId, array $data): bool
    {
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        if (isset($data['title'])) {
            $fields[] = 'title = ?';
            $values[] = $data['title'];
        }
        if (isset($data['position'])) {
            $fields[] = 'position = ?';
            $values[] = (int)$data['position'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('folder_slug', $data)) {
            $fields[] = 'folder_slug = ?';
            $values[] = $data['folder_slug'];
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $moduleId;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_modules SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteModule(int $moduleId): bool
    {
        // Ao excluir módulo, desvincula as aulas para não perdê-las (ou exclui dependendo da regra)
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET module_id = NULL WHERE module_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$moduleId]);

        $del = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE id = ?");
        return $del->execute([$moduleId]);
    }

    public function getLessons(int $courseId, ?int $moduleId = null): array
    {
        if ($moduleId !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? AND module_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId, $moduleId]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function getLessonById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getPublishedLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ? AND status = 'published'");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
            WHERE slug = ? AND status = 'published' 
            ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function createLesson(array $data): int
    {
        $sourceType = (string)($data['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
        $status = (string)($data['status'] ?? 'published');
        $mobileProfile = (string)($data['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');
        if (!in_array($mobileProfile, self::VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES, true)) {
            $mobileProfile = 'drawer';
        }

        $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

        $rawSlug = trim((string)($data['slug'] ?? ''));
        $rawTitle = trim((string)($data['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
        $slug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $rawTitle, (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_lessons (
                course_id, module_id, title, slug, source_type, source, content, mobile_profile, position, status
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $data['course_id'],
            $data['module_id'] ?? null,
            $rawTitle !== '' ? $rawTitle : 'Aula',
            $slug,
            $sourceType,
            $data['source'] ?? null,
            $data['content'] ?? null,
            $mobileProfile,
            $data['position'] ?? 0,
            $status,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateLesson(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        if (array_key_exists('source_type', $data) || array_key_exists('status', $data)) {
            $sourceType = array_key_exists('source_type', $data) ? (string)$data['source_type'] : 'theme_file';
            $status = array_key_exists('status', $data) ? (string)$data['status'] : 'published';
            $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);
        }

        if (array_key_exists('mobile_profile', $data)) {
            $mp = (string)$data['mobile_profile'];
            $data['mobile_profile'] = in_array($mp, self::VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES, true) ? $mp : 'drawer';
        }

        if (array_key_exists('slug', $data)) {
            $data['slug'] = $this->sanitizeSlug((string)$data['slug'], (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));
        }

        $allowed = ['title', 'slug', 'module_id', 'source_type', 'source', 'content', 'mobile_profile', 'position', 'status'];
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        foreach ($allowed as $col) {
            if (array_key_exists($col, $data)) {
                $fields[] = "{$col} = ?";
                $values[] = $data[$col];
            }
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $id;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_lessons SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteLesson(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    /**
     * Sincroniza a estrutura do curso por diff (H-04), preservando os IDs existentes de módulos
     * e aulas quando correspondem por ID (ou por slug do curso) e validando os campos (M-10).
     */
    public function replaceCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        return $this->syncCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
    }

    public function syncCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $existingModules = [];
            foreach ($this->getModules($courseId) as $m) {
                $existingModules[(int)$m['id']] = $m;
            }

            $existingLessonsById = [];
            $existingLessonsBySlug = [];
            foreach ($this->getLessons($courseId) as $l) {
                $lId = (int)$l['id'];
                $existingLessonsById[$lId] = $l;
                $existingLessonsBySlug[(string)$l['slug']] = $l;
            }

            $keptModuleIds = [];
            $keptLessonIds = [];
            $usedSlugs = [];

            $modulePos = 1;
            $lessonPosGlobal = 1;

            foreach ($structure as $modData) {
                $modTitle = trim((string)($modData['title'] ?? 'Módulo Geral'));
                if ($modTitle === '') {
                    $modTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
                }
                $folderSlug = isset($modData['folder_slug']) && trim((string)$modData['folder_slug']) !== ''
                    ? trim((string)$modData['folder_slug'])
                    : null;

                $candidateModId = isset($modData['id']) ? (int)$modData['id'] : 0;
                if ($candidateModId > 0 && isset($existingModules[$candidateModId]) && !in_array($candidateModId, $keptModuleIds, true)) {
                    $this->updateModule($candidateModId, [
                        'title'       => $modTitle,
                        'position'    => $modulePos++,
                        'folder_slug' => $folderSlug ?? ($existingModules[$candidateModId]['folder_slug'] ?? null),
                    ]);
                    $moduleId = $candidateModId;
                } else {
                    $moduleId = $this->createModule($courseId, $modTitle, $modulePos++, $folderSlug);
                }
                $keptModuleIds[] = $moduleId;

                $lessons = $modData['lessons'] ?? [];
                if (!is_array($lessons)) {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                    $pos = $lessonPosGlobal++;
                    $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
                    if ($title === '') {
                        $title = 'Aula ' . $pos;
                    }

                    $sourceType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                    $status = (string)($lesson['status'] ?? 'published');
                    $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

                    $rawSlug = trim((string)($lesson['slug'] ?? ''));
                    $baseSlug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $title, $pos);
                    $slug = $this->deduplicateSlugInBatch($baseSlug, $usedSlugs);
                    $usedSlugs[$slug] = true;

                    $matchedLessonId = 0;
                    $candidateLessonId = isset($lesson['id']) ? (int)$lesson['id'] : 0;
                    if ($candidateLessonId > 0 && isset($existingLessonsById[$candidateLessonId]) && !in_array($candidateLessonId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                        $matchedLessonId = $candidateLessonId;
                    } elseif (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug])) {
                        $bySlugId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug]['id'];
                        if (!in_array($bySlugId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                            $matchedLessonId = $bySlugId;
                        }
                    }

                    // Se vai atualizar ou criar com um slug que já pertence a outra aula do curso ainda no BD,
                    // limpa temporariamente o slug conflitante caso a outra aula vá ser removida/renomeada.
                    if (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]) && (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'] !== $matchedLessonId) {
                        $conflictId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'];
                        $tmpStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?");
                        $tmpStmt->execute(['__tmp_' . $conflictId . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), $conflictId]);
                    }

                    $mobileProfile = (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer') : 'drawer'));

                    $lessonPayload = [
                        'course_id'      => $courseId,
                        'module_id'      => $moduleId,
                        'title'          => $title,
                        'slug'           => $slug,
                        'source_type'    => $sourceType,
                        'source'         => $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? $lesson['file_path'] ?? null,
                        'content'        => $lesson['content'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['content'] ?? null) : null),
                        'mobile_profile' => $mobileProfile,
                        'position'       => $pos,
                        'status'         => $status,
                    ];

                    if ($matchedLessonId > 0) {
                        $this->updateLesson($matchedLessonId, $lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $matchedLessonId;
                    } else {
                        $newLessonId = $this->createLesson($lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $newLessonId;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Remove apenas aulas que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptLessonIds)) {
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delLessons->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptLessonIds), '?'));
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delLessons->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptLessonIds));
            }

            // Remove apenas módulos que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptModuleIds)) {
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delModules->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptModuleIds), '?'));
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delModules->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptModuleIds));
            }

            $this->pdo->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function ensureTables(): void
    {
        if ($this->tablesEnsured) {
            return;
        }
        $this->tablesEnsured = true;

        $migrationFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations/2026_10_15_000002_create_academy_structure.php';
        if (is_file($migrationFile)) {
            $migration = require $migrationFile;
            if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
            }
        }

        $this->tablesEnsured = true;
    }

    private function assertValidLessonEnums(string $sourceType, string $status): void
    {
        if (!in_array($sourceType, self::VALID_SOURCE_TYPES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo de origem de aula inválido: {$sourceType}");
        }

        if (!in_array($status, self::VALID_STATUSES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status de aula inválido: {$status}");
        }
    }

    private function sanitizeSlug(string $raw, int $fallbackPos = 1): string
    {
        $text = strtr($raw, self::$accentMap);
        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : ('aula-' . $fallbackPos);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, bool> $usedSlugs
     */
    private function deduplicateSlugInBatch(string $baseSlug, array $usedSlugs): string
    {
        $slug = $baseSlug;
        $counter = 1;
        while (isset($usedSlugs[$slug])) {
            $slug = "{$baseSlug}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }
        return $slug;
    }
}
