// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoStudentAdminRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAdminRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência e consulta administrativa de alunos.
 * Resiliente a variações de schema da tabela users em produção (ex: ausência de username ou status).
 */
class PdoStudentAdminRepository implements StudentAdminRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $hasUsername = true;
    private bool $hasStatus = true;
    private bool $columnsChecked = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
    }

    /**
     * Inspeciona as colunas da tabela users e executa auto-heal não-destrutivo se necessário.
     */
    private function ensureSchema(): void
    {
        if ($this->columnsChecked) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $colNames = [];
            $driver = '';
            try {
                $driver = (string)$this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            } catch (Throwable) {
                $driver = 'mysql';
            }

            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(users)");
                if ($stmt) {
                    $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'name'));
                }
            } else {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users");
                if ($stmt) {
                    $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'Field'));
                }
            }

            $this->hasUsername = in_array('username', $colNames, true);
            $this->hasStatus = in_array('status', $colNames, true);

            // Auto-heal: tenta adicionar a coluna username se ausente
            if (!$this->hasUsername) {
                try {
                    $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN username VARCHAR(100) NULL");
                    $this->hasUsername = true;
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Se falhar (ex: sem privilégio DDL), mantém fallback para alias
                }
            }

            // Auto-heal: tenta adicionar a coluna status se ausente
            if (!$this->hasStatus) {
                try {
                    $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'");
                    $this->hasStatus = true;
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Mantém fallback para alias
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable) {
            // Em caso de falha de conexão ou tabela restrita, opera em modo seguro
            $this->hasUsername = false;
            $this->hasStatus = false;
        }

        $this->columnsChecked = true;
    }

    public function getPaginatedStudents(
        int $page = 1,
        int $perPage = 20,
        ?string $search = null,
        ?string $status = null
    ): array {
        $this->ensureSchema();

        $page = max(1, $page);
        $perPage = max(1, min(100, $perPage));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

        [$whereSql, $params] = $this->buildWhere($search, $status);

        $usernameField = $this->hasUsername ? "username" : "'' AS username";
        $statusField = $this->hasStatus ? "status" : "'active' AS status";

        $sql = "SELECT id, name, {$usernameField}, email, role, {$statusField}, created_at 
                FROM users 
                {$whereSql} 
                ORDER BY id DESC 
                LIMIT {$perPage} OFFSET {$offset}";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function countStudents(?string $search = null, ?string $status = null): int
    {
        $this->ensureSchema();

        [$whereSql, $params] = $this->buildWhere($search, $status);

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users {$whereSql}";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $studentId, string $status): void
    {
        $valid = ['active', 'suspended', 'banned'];
        if (!in_array($status, $valid, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status inválido para aluno: {$status}");
        }

        $this->ensureSchema();
        if (!$this->hasStatus) {
            try {
                $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'");
                $this->hasStatus = true;
            } catch (Throwable) {
                return;
            }
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE users SET status = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$status, $studentId]);
    }

    public function updatePassword(int $studentId, string $passwordHash): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$passwordHash, $studentId]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: string, 1: array<string, mixed>}
     */
    private function buildWhere(?string $search = null, ?string $status = null): array
    {
        $where = ["role IN ('user', 'student', 'subscriber')"];
        $params = [];

        if ($this->hasStatus && $status !== null && $status !== '' && $status !== 'all') {
            $where[] = "status = :status";
            $params[':status'] = $status;
        }

        if ($search !== null && trim($search) !== '') {
            if ($this->hasUsername) {
                $where[] = "(name LIKE :search OR email LIKE :search OR username LIKE :search)";
            } else {
                $where[] = "(name LIKE :search OR email LIKE :search)";
            }
            $params[':search'] = '%' . trim($search) . '%';
        }

        return ["WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where), $params];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoStudentCredentialRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\DTO\StudentCredential;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Implementação PDO do repositório de credenciais de alunos (DIP / SRP).
 */
class PdoStudentCredentialRepository implements StudentCredentialRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
    }

    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?StudentCredential
    {
        $normalized = strtolower(trim($email));
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$normalized]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!is_array($row)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->hydrate($row);
    }

    public function findByUsername(string $username): ?StudentCredential
    {
        $normalized = strtolower(trim($username));
        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE LOWER(username) = ? LIMIT 1");
            $stmt->execute([$normalized]);
            $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!is_array($row)) {
                return null;
            }

            return $this->hydrate($row);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Em caso de tabela sem a coluna username no ambiente
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function createStudent(string $name, ?string $username, string $email, string $passwordHash): int
    {
        $normalizedEmail = strtolower(trim($email));
        $normalizedUser = ($username !== null && trim($username) !== '') ? strtolower(trim($username)) : null;

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                INSERT INTO users (name, username, email, password, role, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'user', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$name, $normalizedUser, $normalizedEmail, $passwordHash]);
        } catch (\PDOException $e) {
            // Fallback se coluna username não existir no schema
            if (str_contains(strtolower($e->getMessage()), 'no such column') || str_contains(strtolower($e->getMessage()), 'unknown column')) {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO users (name, email, password, role, created_at, updated_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'user', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$name, $normalizedEmail, $passwordHash]);
            } else {
                throw $e;
            }
        }

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     */
    private function hydrate(array $row): StudentCredential
    {
        return new StudentCredential(
            id: (int)($row['id'] ?? 0),
            name: (string)($row['name'] ?? ''),
            email: (string)($row['email'] ?? ''),
            passwordHash: (string)($row['password'] ?? ''),
            username: isset($row['username']) && !empty($row['username']) ? (string)$row['username'] : null,
            status: (string)($row['status'] ?? 'active'),
            role: (string)($row['role'] ?? 'student')
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoStudentProgressRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência de progresso de aulas do aluno (ANSI SQL compatível com SQLite e MySQL).
 */
class PdoStudentProgressRepository implements StudentProgressRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tableEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTable();
        }
    }

    public function ensureTable(): void
    {
        if ($this->tableEnsured) {
            return;
        }
        $this->tableEnsured = true;

        $sql = "
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lesson_progress (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                lesson_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                completed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ";

        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        if ($driver === 'mysql') {
            $sql = "
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lesson_progress (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id INT NOT NULL,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    lesson_id INT NOT NULL,
                    completed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_lesson (user_id, lesson_id),
                    INDEX idx_user_course (user_id, course_id)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ";
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec($sql);
            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_progress_ul ON academy_lesson_progress(user_id, lesson_id)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_progress_uc ON academy_lesson_progress(user_id, course_id)");
            }
            $this->tableEnsured = true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia falha se já existir
        }
    }

    public function saveProgress(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        if ($this->hasCompleted($studentId, $lessonId)) {
            return true;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_lesson_progress (user_id, course_id, lesson_id, completed_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId, $lessonId, date('Y-m-d H:i:s')]);
    }

    public function deleteProgress(int $studentId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            DELETE FROM academy_lesson_progress 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND lesson_id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$studentId, $lessonId]);
    }

    public function hasCompleted(int $studentId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT id FROM academy_lesson_progress 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND lesson_id = ? 
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $lessonId]);
        return (bool)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function findCompletedLessonIds(int $studentId, int $courseId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT lesson_id FROM academy_lesson_progress 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY lesson_id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);

        $ids = [];
        if (is_array($rows)) {
            foreach ($rows as $val) {
                $ids[] = (int)$val;
            }
        }
        return $ids;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/AcademyCourseFulfillment.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\ProductFulfillmentInterface;

/**
 * Responsável por atender e liberar a matrícula de cursos vendidos pelo Commerce (SRP / DIP).
 */
class AcademyCourseFulfillment implements ProductFulfillmentInterface
{
    private CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService;

    public function __construct(CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService)
    {
        $this->enrollmentService = $enrollmentService;
    }

    public function supports(string $itemType): bool
    {
        return in_array($itemType, ['course', 'academy_course', 'bundle'], true);
    }

    public function fulfill(int $userId, int $itemId, string $orderRef, array $metadata = []): bool
    {
        if ($userId <= 0 || $itemId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        $expiresAt = isset($metadata['expires_at']) && $metadata['expires_at'] instanceof \DateTimeImmutable
            ? $metadata['expires_at']
            : null;

        return $this->enrollmentService->enroll($userId, $itemId, $expiresAt, $orderRef);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseCatalogRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;

class CourseCatalogRenderer implements CourseCatalogRendererInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attrs Atributos do shortcode [hub_de_cursos limit="6" status="published"]
     */
    public function render(array $attrs = []): string
    {
        $limit = isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        $status = $attrs['status'] ?? null;
        $filters = ['limit' => $limit];
        if (!empty($status) && in_array($status, ['published', 'soon', 'draft'], true)) {
            $filters['status'] = $status;
        }

        $courses = $this->repository->findPublished($filters);

        if (empty($courses)) {
            return "<div class='ds-academy-empty' style='text-align:center; padding:40px 20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.2); color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>
                <p style='margin:0; font-size:1.05rem;'>Nenhum curso disponível no momento.</p>
            </div>";
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $html = "<div class='academy-grid' style='display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; margin: 30px 0;'>";

        foreach ($courses as $course) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            
            // Resolução agnóstica de Link (Evita 404 em subpastas e suporta checkouts externos)
            $rawLink = trim((string)($course['link'] ?? ''));
            if ($rawLink !== '') {
                if (str_starts_with($rawLink, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawLink, 'https://')) {
                    $finalLink = $rawLink;
                } else {
                    if ($baseUrl !== '' && !str_starts_with($rawLink, $baseUrl)) {
                        $finalLink = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawLink, '/');
                    } else {
                        $finalLink = '/' . ltrim($rawLink, '/');
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $finalLink = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));
            }
            $link = htmlspecialchars($finalLink, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

            // Precificação e Parcelamento ("Quantas vezes")
            $price = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
            $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? false : (isset($course['is_free']) ? (bool)$course['is_free'] : true);
            $maxInstallments = isset($course['max_installments']) && (int)$course['max_installments'] > 0
                ? (int)$course['max_installments']
                : 12;

            $pricingHtml = '';
            if ($isFree || $price <= 0.0) {
                $pricingHtml = "<div class='course-pricing' style='margin-bottom:14px;'>
                    <span style='background:rgba(40,167,69,0.15); color:#2ecc71; font-weight:700; font-size:0.82rem; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);'>GRATUITO</span>
                </div>";
                $btnText = "Acessar Conteúdo &rarr;";
                $btnBg = "var(--primary, #45f3ff)";
            } else {
                $formattedTotal = 'R$ ' . number_format($price, 2, ',', '.');
                if ($maxInstallments > 1) {
                    $installmentValue = $price / $maxInstallments;
                    $formattedInstallment = 'R$ ' . number_format($installmentValue, 2, ',', '.');
                    $pricingHtml = "<div class='course-pricing' style='margin-bottom:14px;'>
                        <div style='font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; color:#00d284;'>{$formattedTotal}</div>
                        <div style='font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); margin-top:2px;'>ou em até <strong style='color:#45f3ff;'>{$maxInstallments}x de {$formattedInstallment}</strong></div>
                    </div>";
                } else {
                    $pricingHtml = "<div class='course-pricing' style='margin-bottom:14px;'>
                        <div style='font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; color:#00d284;'>{$formattedTotal} à vista</div>
                    </div>";
                }
                $btnText = "Comprar";
                $btnBg = "linear-gradient(135deg, #00d284, #00b370)";
            }

            if (!empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
                $rawThumb = (string)$course['thumbnail'];
                if ($this->storage !== null) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($this->storage->getPublicUrl($rawThumb), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } elseif (str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'data:')) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($rawThumb, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } else {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawThumb, '/'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } else {
                $thumbUrl = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="360" viewBox="0 0 640 360"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="%231e2327"/><text x="50%" y="50%" fill="%2345f3ff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">🎓 Academy</text></svg>';
            }

            $badge = '';
            if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon') {
                $badge = "<span style='position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; background:#f0ad4e; color:#0b0c10; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); text-transform:uppercase;'>EM BREVE</span>";
            }

            $html .= "
            <div class=\"course-card glass-panel\" style=\"background:var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); border:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;\">
                <div style=\"position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#0b0c10; overflow:hidden;\">
                    <img src=\"{$thumbUrl}\" alt=\"{$title}\" style=\"width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;\" loading=\"lazy\">
                    {$badge}
                </div>
                <div style=\"padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex-grow:1;\">
                    <h3 style=\"margin:0 0 10px 0; font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--text-main, #ffffff); line-height:1.4;\">{$title}</h3>
                    <p style=\"margin:0 0 18px 0; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.5; flex-grow:1;\">{$desc}</p>
                    {$pricingHtml}
                    <a href=\"{$link}\" style=\"display:inline-block; text-align:center; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:6px; background:{$btnBg}; color:#0b0c10; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; transition:opacity 0.2s;\" onmouseover=\"this.style.opacity='0.85'\" onmouseout=\"this.style.opacity='1'\">
                        {$btnText}
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        }

        $html .= "</div>";

        $html .= "
        <style>
            .course-card:hover {
                transform: translateY(-4px);
                box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 12px rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);
            }
        </style>";

        return $html;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseEnrollmentService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Serviço de Negócio de Matrículas e Autorização de Acesso (SRP / DIP).
 */
class CourseEnrollmentService implements CourseEnrollmentInterface
{
    private CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo;
    private ?CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;

    public function __construct(
        CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo,
        ?CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo = null
    ) {
        $this->enrollmentRepo = $enrollmentRepo;
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
    }

    public function hasActiveEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool
    {
        // 1. Validação estrita de entrada: IDs devem ser estritamente positivos
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        // 2. Se o curso existir e for explicitamente gratuito, libera para o aluno autenticado
        if ($this->courseRepo !== null) {
            $course = $this->courseRepo->findById($courseId);
            if ($course !== null) {
                $isFree = !empty($course['is_free']) || (isset($course['price']) && (float)$course['price'] <= 0.0);
                if ($isFree) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Verifica a existência de matrícula válida e ativa
        $enrollment = $this->enrollmentRepo->findByStudentAndCourse($studentId, $courseId);
        if (!$enrollment) {
            return false;
        }

        if (($enrollment['status'] ?? '') !== 'active') {
            return false;
        }

        // 4. Verificação de expiração: falhar fechado em caso de data inválida/corrompida
        if (!empty($enrollment['expires_at'])) {
            try {
                $now = new DateTimeImmutable();
                $expiresAt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('Y-m-d H:i:s', (string)$enrollment['expires_at']);
                if ($expiresAt === false) {
                    // Tenta parser genérico antes de invalidar
                    $expiresAt = new DateTimeImmutable((string)$enrollment['expires_at']);
                }

                if ($expiresAt <= $now) {
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Falha fechada: data malformada não concede acesso
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function enroll(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->saveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId, 'active', $expiresAt, $orderRef);
    }

    public function revoke(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->updateStatus($studentId, $courseId, 'cancelled');
    }

    public function getActiveCourseIds(int $studentId): array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return [];
        }

        $active = $this->enrollmentRepo->findActiveByStudent($studentId);
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($active as $en) {
            $cId = (int)($en['course_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($cId > 0 && !in_array($cId, $ids, true)) {
                $ids[] = $cId;
            }
        }
        return $ids;
    }

    public function getEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): ?array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->findByStudentAndCourse($studentId, $courseId);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseNavigationService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;

class CourseNavigationService implements CourseNavigationInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private string $baseUrl;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        ?string $baseUrl = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->baseUrl = $baseUrl ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '');
    }

    private function getBaseUrl(): string
    {
        if ($this->baseUrl !== '') {
            return $this->baseUrl;
        }
        return defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
    }

    private function resolveCourse(string|int $courseIdentifier): ?array
    {
        if (is_numeric($courseIdentifier)) {
            return $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$courseIdentifier);
        }
        return $this->courseRepo->findBySlug((string)$courseIdentifier);
    }

    public function getCourseTree(string|int $courseIdentifier): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return [];
        }

        $courseId = (int)$course['id'];
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];

        $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);

        // Agrupa apenas aulas publicadas por module_id
        $lessonsByModule = [];
        $standaloneLessons = [];

        foreach ($allLessons as $lesson) {
            if (($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $lessonSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
            $lesson['url'] = $this->getBaseUrl() . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($lessonSlug);

            $modId = $lesson['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$lesson['module_id'] : null;
            if ($modId !== null && $modId > 0) {
                $lessonsByModule[$modId][] = $lesson;
            } else {
                $standaloneLessons[] = $lesson;
            }
        }

        $tree = [];

        foreach ($modules as $mod) {
            $mId = (int)$mod['id'];
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => $mId,
                'title'    => (string)$mod['title'],
                'position' => (int)$mod['position'],
                'lessons'  => $lessonsByModule[$mId] ?? [],
            ];
        }

        // Se houver aulas sem módulo cadastrado, agrupa num módulo geral
        if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => 0,
                'title'    => 'Aulas Gerais',
                'position' => 999,
                'lessons'  => $standaloneLessons,
            ];
        }

        return $tree;
    }

    public function renderCourseNav(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug = '', array $options = []): string
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return '';
        }

        $tree = $this->getCourseTree($courseIdentifier);
        if (empty($tree)) {
            return '';
        }

        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $courseUrl = $this->getBaseUrl() . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);

        $html = '<nav class="course-nav ds-academy-nav" aria-label="Navegação do Curso ' . $courseTitle . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-header">';
        $html .= '<a href="' . $courseUrl . '" class="course-nav-home-link">🎓 ' . $courseTitle . '</a>';
        $html .= '</div>';

        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-body">';

        $globalLessonCounter = 1;

        foreach ($tree as $mod) {
            $modTitle = htmlspecialchars($mod['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $lessons = $mod['lessons'] ?? [];

            $html .= '<div class="course-nav-module">';
            $html .= '<h4 class="course-nav-module-title">' . $modTitle . '</h4>';
            $html .= '<ul class="course-nav-lessons">';

            foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                $lTitle = htmlspecialchars($lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $lSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
                $lUrl = htmlspecialchars($lesson['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $isActive = ($lSlug === $currentLessonSlug);

                $activeClass = $isActive ? ' is-active current-lesson' : '';
                $ariaCurrent = $isActive ? ' aria-current="page"' : '';

                $html .= '<li class="course-nav-lesson-item' . $activeClass . '">';
                $html .= '<a href="' . $lUrl . '"' . $ariaCurrent . ' class="course-nav-lesson-link">';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-index">' . sprintf('%02d', $globalLessonCounter++) . '</span> ';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-title">' . $lTitle . '</span>';
                $html .= '</a>';
                $html .= '</li>';
            }

            $html .= '</ul>';
            $html .= '</div>';
        }

        $html .= '</div>';
        $html .= '</nav>';

        return $html;
    }

    public function getAdjacentLessons(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);

        if (empty($allLessons)) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        // Filtra apenas aulas publicadas e normaliza
        $flat = [];
        foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
            if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $slug = (string)$l['slug'];
            $flat[] = [
                'id'    => (int)$l['id'],
                'title' => (string)$l['title'],
                'slug'  => $slug,
                'url'   => $this->getBaseUrl() . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($slug),
            ];
        }

        $currentIndex = -1;
        foreach ($flat as $index => $item) {
            if ($item['slug'] === $currentLessonSlug) {
                $currentIndex = $index;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($currentIndex === -1) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $prev = ($currentIndex > 0) ? $flat[$currentIndex - 1] : null;
        $next = ($currentIndex < count($flat) - 1) ? $flat[$currentIndex + 1] : null;

        return ['prev' => $prev, 'next' => $next];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CoursePackageService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CoursePackageServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use FilesystemIterator;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use ZipArchive;

class CoursePackageService implements CoursePackageServiceInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver;
    private CourseService $courseService;
    private ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder;

    /**
     * Extensões de arquivos permitidas para extração segura (Anti-RCE / Anti-ZipSlip).
     */
    private const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = [
        'php', 'html', 'css', 'js', 'json', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'svg', 'pdf'
    ];

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver,
        CourseService $courseService,
        ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver;
        $this->courseService = $courseService;
        $this->scaffolder = $scaffolder;
    }

    public function exportCourseZip(int $courseId): string
    {
        if (!class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("A extensão PHP ZipArchive é necessária para compactar cursos.");
        }

        $course = $this->courseRepo->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Curso ID {$courseId} não encontrado para exportação.");
        }

        $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);

        // Agrupa aulas por módulo
        $lessonsByMod = [];
        $standaloneLessons = [];
        foreach ($allLessons as $les) {
            $mId = $les['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$les['module_id'] : null;
            if ($mId !== null && $mId > 0) {
                $lessonsByMod[$mId][] = $les;
            } else {
                $standaloneLessons[] = $les;
            }
        }

        $structure = [];
        foreach ($modules as $m) {
            $mId = (int)$m['id'];
            $structure[] = [
                'title'       => (string)$m['title'],
                'folder_slug' => (string)($m['folder_slug'] ?? ''),
                'position'    => (int)$m['position'],
                'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $l): array {
                    return [
                        'title'          => (string)$l['title'],
                        'slug'           => (string)$l['slug'],
                        'source_type'    => (string)$l['source_type'],
                        'source'         => (string)($l['source'] ?? ''),
                        'content'        => (string)($l['content'] ?? ''),
                        'mobile_profile' => (string)($l['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                        'status'         => (string)($l['status'] ?? 'published'),
                    ];
                }, $lessonsByMod[$mId] ?? []),
            ];
        }

        if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
            $structure[] = [
                'title'       => 'Módulo Geral',
                'folder_slug' => '',
                'position'    => 999,
                'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $l): array {
                    return [
                        'title'          => (string)$l['title'],
                        'slug'           => (string)$l['slug'],
                        'source_type'    => (string)$l['source_type'],
                        'source'         => (string)($l['source'] ?? ''),
                        'content'        => (string)($l['content'] ?? ''),
                        'mobile_profile' => (string)($l['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                        'status'         => (string)($l['status'] ?? 'published'),
                    ];
                }, $standaloneLessons),
            ];
        }

        // Manifesto do Curso
        $manifest = [
            'schema_version' => '2.6.0',
            'generator'      => 'DomainSystem Academy LMS',
            'exported_at'    => date('c'),
            'course'         => [
                'title'       => (string)$course['title'],
                'slug'        => (string)$course['slug'],
                'description' => (string)($course['description'] ?? ''),
                'price'       => (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.00),
                'access_type' => (string)($course['access_type'] ?? 'free'),
                'category'    => (string)($course['category'] ?? ''),
                'status'      => (string)($course['status'] ?? 'published'),
            ],
            'structure'      => $structure,
        ];

        // Cria arquivo ZIP temporário
        $tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir();
        $safeSlug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '_', (string)$course['slug']) ?: 'curso';
        $zipFilePath = $tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'academy_export_' . $safeSlug . '_' . uniqid() . '.zip';

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipFilePath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Não foi possível criar o arquivo ZIP temporário em: {$zipFilePath}");
        }

        // Adiciona manifesto course.json
        $zip->addFromString('course.json', json_encode($manifest, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES));

        // Coleta os arquivos .php do curso no tema ativo
        $themePath = $this->themeResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $pagesDir = $themePath . '/pages';
        $filesAdded = [];

        // 1. Arquivos da pasta específica do curso: pages/{course_slug}/
        $coursePagesDir = $pagesDir . '/' . $course['slug'];
        if (is_dir($coursePagesDir)) {
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($coursePagesDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)
            );
            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                if ($file->isFile() && in_array(strtolower($file->getExtension()), self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS, true)) {
                    $fullPath = $file->getPathname();
                    $relInPages = substr($fullPath, strlen($pagesDir) + 1);
                    $zipEntryName = 'pages/' . str_replace('\\', '/', $relInPages);
                    $zip->addFile($fullPath, $zipEntryName);
                    $filesAdded[$zipEntryName] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Arquivos apontados nas aulas como source_type === 'theme_file'
        foreach ($allLessons as $les) {
            $source = trim((string)($les['source'] ?? ''));
            if ($source === '' || str_starts_with($source, 'http://') || str_starts_with($source, 'https://')) {
                continue;
            }

            // Converte "pages/solid/aula.php" para o arquivo físico no tema
            $cleanSource = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $source), '/');
            $fullPath = $themePath . '/' . $cleanSource;

            if (is_file($fullPath)) {
                $zipEntryName = $cleanSource;
                if (!isset($filesAdded[$zipEntryName])) {
                    $zip->addFile($fullPath, $zipEntryName);
                    $filesAdded[$zipEntryName] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        $zip->close();

        return $zipFilePath;
    }

    public function importCourseZip(string $zipFilePath, ?string $overrideThemePath = null): array
    {
        if (!class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("A extensão PHP ZipArchive é necessária para descompactar cursos.");
        }

        if (!is_file($zipFilePath) || filesize($zipFilePath) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo ZIP de curso informado é inválido ou está vazio.");
        }

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipFilePath) !== true) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao abrir o arquivo ZIP para descompactação.");
        }

        $manifestContent = $zip->getFromName('course.json');
        if ($manifestContent === false) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo ZIP não contém o manifesto obrigatório 'course.json'.");
        }

        $manifest = json_decode($manifestContent, true);
        if (!is_array($manifest) || empty($manifest['course']['title'])) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O manifesto 'course.json' possui estrutura corrompida ou título ausente.");
        }

        $courseData = $manifest['course'];
        $courseTitle = trim((string)$courseData['title']);
        $rawCourseSlug = trim((string)($courseData['slug'] ?? ''));

        // Resolve caminho seguro de destino para as páginas no tema ativo
        $targetThemePath = $overrideThemePath ?? $this->themeResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $targetPagesDir = $targetThemePath . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'pages';

        if (!is_dir($targetPagesDir)) {
            if (!@mkdir($targetPagesDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetPagesDir)) {
                $zip->close();
                throw new RuntimeException("Não foi possível criar o diretório de destino em: {$targetPagesDir}");
            }
        }

        $realTargetPagesDir = realpath($targetPagesDir);
        if ($realTargetPagesDir === false) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao resolver caminho real de pages do tema ativo.");
        }

        // Extrai arquivos de forma segura com proteção Anti-ZipSlip
        $extractedFiles = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $entryName = (string)$zip->getNameIndex($i);

            // Ignora arquivos do sistema operacional e o próprio manifesto
            if ($entryName === 'course.json' ||
                str_starts_with($entryName, '__MACOSX') ||
                str_contains($entryName, '.DS_Store') ||
                str_ends_with($entryName, '/')
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            // Proteção contra path traversal (Zip-Slip)
            if (str_contains($entryName, '..') || str_starts_with($entryName, '/') || str_starts_with($entryName, '\\')) {
                continue;
            }

            // Valida extensão permitida
            $ext = strtolower((string)pathinfo($entryName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            if (!in_array($ext, self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS, true)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Normaliza caminho de destino: se começa com "pages/", remove o prefixo relativo
            $cleanRelative = str_starts_with($entryName, 'pages/') ? substr($entryName, 6) : $entryName;
            $destPath = $realTargetPagesDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanRelative);

            // Garante criação da subpasta de destino
            $destDir = dirname($destPath);
            if (!is_dir($destDir)) {
                @mkdir($destDir, 0755, true);
            }

            // Valida se o destino final permanece estritamente dentro de $realTargetPagesDir
            $realDestDir = realpath($destDir);
            if ($realDestDir === false || !str_starts_with($realDestDir, $realTargetPagesDir)) {
                continue; // Violação de escopo ignorada com segurança
            }

            $content = $zip->getFromIndex($i);
            if ($content !== false) {
                file_put_contents($destPath, $content);
                $extractedFiles[] = 'pages/' . str_replace('\\', '/', $cleanRelative);
            }
        }

        $zip->close();

        // Preserva o slug original do manifesto se não colidir com um curso existente; caso colida, gera slug único
        $targetSlug = $rawCourseSlug !== '' ? $rawCourseSlug : $this->courseService->generateUniqueSlug($courseTitle);
        if ($this->courseRepo->findBySlug($targetSlug) !== null) {
            $uniqueSlug = $this->courseService->generateUniqueSlug($courseTitle);
        } else {
            $uniqueSlug = $targetSlug;
        }

        // Cria o curso no banco/repositório
        $newCourseId = $this->courseRepo->create([
            'title'       => $courseTitle,
            'slug'        => $uniqueSlug,
            'description' => (string)($courseData['description'] ?? ''),
            'price'       => (float)($courseData['price'] ?? 0.00),
            'access_type' => (string)($courseData['access_type'] ?? 'free'),
            'category'    => (string)($courseData['category'] ?? ''),
            'status'      => (string)($courseData['status'] ?? 'published'),
        ]);

        // Restaura estrutura de módulos e aulas
        $rawStructure = $manifest['structure'] ?? [];
        $sanitizedStructure = [];
        $totalLessons = 0;

        foreach ($rawStructure as $modIdx => $mod) {
            $modTitle = trim((string)($mod['title'] ?? 'Módulo ' . ($modIdx + 1)));
            $modFolderSlug = trim((string)($mod['folder_slug'] ?? ''));
            $modPosition = isset($mod['position']) ? (int)$mod['position'] : ($modIdx + 1);

            $lessons = [];
            if (!empty($mod['lessons']) && is_array($mod['lessons'])) {
                foreach ($mod['lessons'] as $les) {
                    $lTitle = trim((string)($les['title'] ?? 'Nova Aula'));
                    $lSlug = trim((string)($les['slug'] ?? ''));
                    $lSourceType = (string)($les['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                    $lSource = (string)($les['source'] ?? '');

                    // Se a aula for do tipo theme_file e o slug mudou, atualiza referências
                    if ($rawCourseSlug !== '' && $uniqueSlug !== $rawCourseSlug && str_contains($lSource, 'pages/' . $rawCourseSlug . '/')) {
                        $lSource = str_replace('pages/' . $rawCourseSlug . '/', 'pages/' . $uniqueSlug . '/', $lSource);
                    }

                    $lessons[] = [
                        'title'          => $lTitle,
                        'slug'           => $lSlug,
                        'source_type'    => $lSourceType,
                        'source'         => $lSource,
                        'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                        'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                        'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                    ];
                    $totalLessons++;
                }
            }

            $sanitizedStructure[] = [
                'title'       => $modTitle,
                'folder_slug' => $modFolderSlug,
                'position'    => $modPosition,
                'lessons'     => $lessons,
            ];
        }

        if (!empty($sanitizedStructure)) {
            $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($newCourseId, $sanitizedStructure);
        }

        return [
            'course_id'       => $newCourseId,
            'title'           => $courseTitle,
            'slug'            => $uniqueSlug,
            'modules_count'   => count($sanitizedStructure),
            'lessons_count'   => $totalLessons,
            'extracted_files' => $extractedFiles,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\SlugHelper;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

class CourseService
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private CourseImageStorageInterface $storage;

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, CourseImageStorageInterface $storage)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    public function createCourse(array $data, ?array $uploadedFile = null): int
    {
        $this->validateData($data);

        $slug = $this->generateUniqueSlug((string)$data['title']);
        $thumbnail = null;

        if (!empty($uploadedFile['tmp_name'])) {
            $thumbnail = $this->storage->storeUpload($uploadedFile);
        }

        $price = max(0.0, (float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0));
        $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? 0 : (isset($data['is_free']) ? (int)(bool)$data['is_free'] : 1);

        try {
            $courseId = $this->repository->create([
                'title'                 => trim((string)$data['title']),
                'slug'                  => $slug,
                'description'           => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
                'thumbnail'             => $thumbnail,
                'status'                => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
                'link'                  => trim((string)($data['link'] ?? '')),
                'price'                 => $price,
                'is_free'               => $isFree,
                'max_installments'      => isset($data['max_installments']) && (int)$data['max_installments'] > 0 ? (int)$data['max_installments'] : 12,
                'external_platform'     => !empty($data['external_platform']) ? trim((string)$data['external_platform']) : null,
                'external_product_id'   => !empty($data['external_product_id']) ? trim((string)$data['external_product_id']) : null,
                'external_checkout_url' => !empty($data['external_checkout_url']) ? trim((string)$data['external_checkout_url']) : null,
            ]);
            if ($courseId <= 0 && $thumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($thumbnail);
            }
            return $courseId;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($thumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($thumbnail);
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function updateCourse(int $id, array $data, ?array $uploadedFile = null): bool
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById($id);
        if (!$course) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Curso #{$id} não encontrado.");
        }

        $this->validateData($data);

        $slug = $course['slug'];
        if (trim((string)$data['title']) !== (string)$course['title']) {
            $slug = $this->generateUniqueSlug((string)$data['title'], $id);
        }

        $oldThumbnail = $course['thumbnail'] ?? null;
        $newThumbnail = null;
        if (!empty($uploadedFile['tmp_name'])) {
            $newThumbnail = $this->storage->storeUpload($uploadedFile);
        }

        $effectiveThumbnail = $newThumbnail ?? $oldThumbnail;

        $price = max(0.0, (float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0));
        $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? 0 : (isset($data['is_free']) ? (int)(bool)$data['is_free'] : 1);

        try {
            $updated = $this->repository->update($id, [
                'title'                 => trim((string)$data['title']),
                'slug'                  => $slug,
                'description'           => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
                'thumbnail'             => $effectiveThumbnail,
                'status'                => $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
                'link'                  => trim((string)($data['link'] ?? '')),
                'price'                 => $price,
                'is_free'               => $isFree,
                'max_installments'      => isset($data['max_installments']) && (int)$data['max_installments'] > 0 ? (int)$data['max_installments'] : 12,
                'external_platform'     => !empty($data['external_platform']) ? trim((string)$data['external_platform']) : null,
                'external_product_id'   => !empty($data['external_product_id']) ? trim((string)$data['external_product_id']) : null,
                'external_checkout_url' => !empty($data['external_checkout_url']) ? trim((string)$data['external_checkout_url']) : null,
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($newThumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($newThumbnail);
            }
            throw $e;
        }

        if (!$updated) {
            if ($newThumbnail !== null) {
                $this->storage->deleteFile($newThumbnail);
            }
            return false;
        }

        if ($newThumbnail !== null && !empty($oldThumbnail) && $oldThumbnail !== $newThumbnail) {
            $this->storage->deleteFile((string)$oldThumbnail);
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function deleteCourse(int $id): bool
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById($id);
        $deleted = $this->repository->delete($id);

        if ($deleted && $course && !empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
            $this->storage->deleteFile((string)$course['thumbnail']);
        }

        return $deleted;
    }

    public function generateUniqueSlug(string $title, ?int $ignoreId = null): string
    {
        $slug = SlugHelper::slugify($title, 'curso');
        $base = $slug;
        $counter = 1;

        while ($existing = $this->repository->findBySlug($slug)) {
            if ($ignoreId !== null && (int)$existing['id'] === $ignoreId) {
                break;
            }
            $slug = "{$base}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }

        return $slug;
    }

    private function validateData(array $data): void
    {
        if (empty(trim((string)($data['title'] ?? '')))) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O título do curso é obrigatório.");
        }

        $validStatuses = ['draft', 'soon', 'published'];
        if (!in_array($data['status'] ?? 'draft', $validStatuses, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status inválido.");
        }

        if (!empty($data['link'])) {
            $link = (string)$data['link'];
            if (!filter_var($link, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) && !str_starts_with($link, '/') && !str_starts_with($link, '#')) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O link informado deve ser uma URL válida ou um caminho relativo.");
            }
        }
    }
}
