// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/LessonBlockRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonPdfStorageInterface;

/**
 * Renderizador de Conteúdo em Blocos para Aulas do Academy (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 *
 * Converte estruturas de blocos JSON (estilo Gutenberg / Notion / Editor.js)
 * em HTML semântico, responsivo, seguro (anti-XSS) e perfeitamente integrado
 * ao design Dark/Cyberpunk do sistema.
 */
class LessonBlockRenderer implements LessonBlockRendererInterface
{
    private const ALLOWED_INLINE_TAGS = '<strong><b><em><i><code><a><mark><kbd><br><small><u><del>';

    private ?LessonPdfStorageInterface $pdfStorage;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $sanitizer;
    private bool $pdfRuntimeInjected = false;

    public function __construct(
        ?LessonPdfStorageInterface $pdfStorage = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $sanitizer = null
    ) {
        $this->pdfStorage = $pdfStorage;
        $this->sanitizer = $sanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
    }

    /**
     * Renderiza o conteúdo da aula.
     * Se for um JSON de blocos, renderiza cada bloco em HTML semântico.
     * Se for uma string comum/legada, retorna diretamente.
     */
    public function render(?string $content): string
    {
        if ($content === null || trim($content) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $trimmed = trim($content);

        // Detecta se é JSON de blocos
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '{') || str_starts_with($trimmed, '[')) {
            $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $blocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : null);
                if (is_array($blocks)) {
                    return $this->renderBlocks($blocks);
                }
            }
        }

        // Conteúdo legado / HTML cru
        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $blocks
     */
    public function renderBlocks(array $blocks): string
    {
        $html = [];
        $html[] = '<div class="ds-lesson-blocks" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px;">';

        foreach ($blocks as $block) {
            $type = (string)($block['type'] ?? '');
            $data = is_array($block['data'] ?? null) ? $block['data'] : [];

            switch ($type) {
                case 'header':
                case 'heading':
                    $html[] = $this->renderHeader($data);
                    break;

                case 'paragraph':
                case 'text':
                    $html[] = $this->renderParagraph($data);
                    break;

                case 'video':
                case 'embed':
                    $html[] = $this->renderVideo($data);
                    break;

                case 'code':
                    $html[] = $this->renderCode($data);
                    break;

                case 'callout':
                case 'alert':
                    $html[] = $this->renderCallout($data);
                    break;

                case 'list':
                    $html[] = $this->renderList($data);
                    break;

                case 'image':
                    $html[] = $this->renderImage($data);
                    break;

                case 'pdf':
                case 'pdf_viewer':
                    $html[] = $this->renderPdf($data);
                    break;

                case 'delimiter':
                case 'divider':
                    $html[] = $this->renderDelimiter($data);
                    break;

                default:
                    // Bloco desconhecido: se houver texto, renderiza parágrafo seguro
                    if (!empty($data['text'])) {
                        $html[] = $this->renderParagraph($data);
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        $html[] = '</div>';
        return implode("\n", $html);
    }

    public function renderHeader(array $data): string
    {
        $rawLevel = (int)($data['level'] ?? 2);
        $level = in_array($rawLevel, [1, 2, 3, 4], true) ? $rawLevel : 2;
        $text = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['text'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        $fontSizes = [
            1 => '2rem',
            2 => '1.6rem',
            3 => '1.3rem',
            4 => '1.1rem',
        ];
        $fontSize = $fontSizes[$level];

        return "<h{$level} class=\"ds-block-heading ds-heading-h{$level}\" style=\"margin: 25px 0 10px 0; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: {$fontSize}; letter-spacing: -0.5px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-bottom: 8px;\">{$text}</h{$level}>";
    }

    public function renderParagraph(array $data): string
    {
        $raw = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $safeHtml = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($raw);

        return "<p class=\"ds-block-paragraph\" style=\"margin: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main, #c5c6c7); font-size: 1.05rem;\">{$safeHtml}</p>";
    }

    public function renderVideo(array $data): string
    {
        $url = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['source'] ?? ''));
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $caption = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['caption'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $captionHtml = $caption !== '' 
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>" 
            : '';

        $embedUrl = $this->convertVideoUrlToEmbed($url);

        if ($embedUrl !== null) {
            return "
            <figure class=\"ds-block-video\" style=\"margin: 24px 0;\">
                <div style=\"position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);\">
                    <iframe src=\"{$embedUrl}\" style=\"position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture\" allowfullscreen loading=\"lazy\"></iframe>
                </div>
                {$captionHtml}
            </figure>";
        }

        // Vídeo direto MP4/WEBM
        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        return "
        <figure class=\"ds-block-video\" style=\"margin: 24px 0;\">
            <div style=\"border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);\">
                <video controls style=\"width: 100%; display: block; max-height: 550px;\">
                    <source src=\"{$safeUrl}\">
                    Seu navegador não suporta a tag de vídeo.
                </video>
            </div>
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    public function renderCode(array $data): string
    {
        $code = (string)($data['code'] ?? '');
        $lang = htmlspecialchars(trim((string)($data['language'] ?? 'php')), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $escapedCode = htmlspecialchars($code, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $displayLang = strtoupper($lang ?: 'CODE');

        return "
        <div class=\"ds-block-code\" style=\"margin: 24px 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0c10; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);\">
            <div style=\"display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #14191c; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px;\">
                <span style=\"color: var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); font-weight: bold;\">{$displayLang}</span>
                <button type=\"button\" onclick=\"navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.closest('.ds-block-code').querySelector('code').innerText); var b=this; b.innerText='Copiado!'; setTimeout(function(){b.innerText='Copiar';}, 2000);\" style=\"background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #8c8f94; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;\">
                    Copiar
                </button>
            </div>
            <pre style=\"margin: 0; padding: 18px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'Fira Code', Consolas, Monaco, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: #e6edf3;\"><code class=\"language-{$lang}\">{$escapedCode}</code></pre>
        </div>";
    }

    public function renderCallout(array $data): string
    {
        $type = (string)($data['type'] ?? 'info');
        $raw = (string)($data['text'] ?? '');
        $safeHtml = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($raw);

        $styles = [
            'info' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '💡',
                'title'  => 'Nota Didática',
            ],
            'success' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-green, #00d284)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '✅',
                'title'  => 'Boas Práticas & SOLID',
            ],
            'warning' => [
                'border' => 'var(--accent-orange, #f56e28)',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(245, 110, 40, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '⚠️',
                'title'  => 'Atenção',
            ],
            'danger' => [
                'border' => '#ff4d4f',
                'bg'     => 'rgba(255, 77, 79, 0.08)',
                'icon'   => '🛑',
                'title'  => 'Cuidado / Erro Comum',
            ],
        ];

        $current = $styles[$type] ?? $styles['info'];

        return "
        <div class=\"ds-block-callout ds-callout-{$type}\" style=\"margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 6px; border-left: 4px solid {$current['border']}; background: {$current['bg']}; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;\">
            <div style=\"font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1;\">{$current['icon']}</div>
            <div style=\"flex: 1; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--text-main, #fff);\">
                {$safeHtml}
            </div>
        </div>";
    }

    public function renderList(array $data): string
    {
        $style = (string)($data['style'] ?? 'unordered');
        $rawItems = is_array($data['items'] ?? null) ? $data['items'] : [];

        if (empty($rawItems)) {
            return '';
        }

        $tag = ($style === 'ordered') ? 'ol' : 'ul';
        $itemsHtml = [];

        foreach ($rawItems as $item) {
            $itemText = is_string($item) ? $item : (string)($item['content'] ?? '');
            $safe = $this->sanitizeInlineHtml($itemText);
            $itemsHtml[] = "<li style=\"margin-bottom: 8px;\">{$safe}</li>";
        }

        $inner = implode("\n", $itemsHtml);
        return "<{$tag} class=\"ds-block-list\" style=\"margin: 16px 0 16px 24px; padding: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main, #c5c6c7); font-size: 1.05rem;\">\n{$inner}\n</{$tag}>";
    }

    public function renderImage(array $data): string
    {
        $url = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['file']['url'] ?? ''));
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $caption = htmlspecialchars((string)($data['caption'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $captionHtml = $caption !== '' 
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>" 
            : '';

        return "
        <figure class=\"ds-block-figure\" style=\"margin: 28px 0; text-align: center;\">
            <img src=\"{$safeUrl}\" alt=\"{$caption}\" style=\"max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);\" loading=\"lazy\">
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    public function renderDelimiter(array $data): string
    {
        return '<hr class="ds-block-delimiter" style="margin: 35px 0; border: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.4), transparent);">';
    }

    /**
     * Renderiza um Leitor de PDF Híbrido (Nuvem HTTP/HTTPS, Google Drive ou Pasta Local na Hostinger).
     * Suporta renderização preguiçosa por página via PDF.js (<canvas>) com recorte de páginas (start_page / end_page),
     * modo iframe nativo e modo cartão compacto expansível.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function renderPdf(array $data): string
    {
        $rawUrl = trim((string)($data['url'] ?? $data['source'] ?? $data['file']['url'] ?? ''));
        if ($rawUrl === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Caso o usuário tenha colado o código HTML <iframe src="..."> do OneDrive/Google Drive, extrai apenas o src
        if (stripos($rawUrl, '<iframe') !== false && preg_match('/\bsrc=["\']([^"\']+)["\']/i', $rawUrl, $iframeSrcMatch)) {
            $rawUrl = html_entity_decode(trim($iframeSrcMatch[1]), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        }

        // Bloqueia esquemas maliciosos
        if (preg_match('/^\s*(?:javascript|data|vbscript|file):/i', $rawUrl)) {
            return '';
        }

        $resolvedUrl = $this->pdfStorage !== null
            ? $this->pdfStorage->resolvePublicUrl($rawUrl)
            : $rawUrl;

        if ($resolvedUrl === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $title = htmlspecialchars(trim((string)($data['title'] ?? 'Documento PDF da Aula')), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        if ($title === '') {
            $title = 'Documento PDF da Aula';
        }
        $caption = htmlspecialchars(trim((string)($data['caption'] ?? '')), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $mode = (string)($data['mode'] ?? 'pdfjs_canvas');
        if (!in_array($mode, ['pdfjs_canvas', 'native_embed', 'card_modal'], true)) {
            $mode = 'pdfjs_canvas';
        }

        $startPage = max(1, (int)($data['start_page'] ?? 1));
        $endPage = max(0, (int)($data['end_page'] ?? 0));
        if ($endPage > 0 && $endPage < $startPage) {
            $endPage = $startPage;
        }

        $rawHeight = trim((string)($data['height'] ?? '620px'));
        $height = preg_match('/^\d+(?:px|vh|rem)$/', $rawHeight) ? $rawHeight : '620px';
        $allowDownload = !array_key_exists('allow_download', $data) || !empty($data['allow_download']);

        // Detecta links de nuvem (Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive / SharePoint, Dropbox) e converte para URL de embed
        [$isCloudEmbedOnly, $iframeUrl] = $this->resolveCloudOrDirectIframeUrl($resolvedUrl, $startPage, $allowDownload);

        $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($resolvedUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeIframeUrl = htmlspecialchars($iframeUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $uid = 'ds_pdf_' . substr(md5($resolvedUrl . '_' . $startPage . '_' . $endPage . '_' . uniqid('', true)), 0, 10);

        $rangeBadge = $endPage > 0
            ? "<span style=\"background:rgba(69,243,255,0.14); color:#45f3ff; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:12px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;\">Págs. {$startPage}&ndash;{$endPage}</span>"
            : ($startPage > 1
                ? "<span style=\"background:rgba(69,243,255,0.14); color:#45f3ff; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:12px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;\">Inicia na Pág. {$startPage}</span>"
                : '');

        $downloadActionsHtml = '';
        if ($allowDownload) {
            $downloadActionsHtml = "
                <a href=\"{$safeUrl}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" title=\"Abrir PDF em nova guia\" style=\"text-decoration:none;\">↗ Abrir</a>
                <a href=\"{$safeUrl}\" download class=\"ds-pdf-btn ds-pdf-btn-accent\" title=\"Baixar arquivo PDF\" style=\"text-decoration:none;\">⬇ Baixar</a>";
        }

        $captionHtml = $caption !== ''
            ? "<figcaption style=\"margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); text-align: center;\">{$caption}</figcaption>"
            : '';

        $runtimeScript = $this->getPdfViewerRuntimeOnce();

        // Se for link de nuvem (Google Drive / OneDrive / SharePoint) ou modo native_embed, renderiza o container com Iframe otimizado
        if ($mode === 'native_embed' || $isCloudEmbedOnly) {
            return "{$runtimeScript}
            <figure class=\"ds-block-pdf ds-pdf-mode-native\" id=\"{$uid}\" style=\"margin: 26px 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0e14; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.25); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);\">
                <div class=\"ds-pdf-toolbar\" style=\"display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; padding:10px 16px; background:#141920; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);\">
                    <div style=\"display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-width:0;\">
                        <span style=\"font-size:1.15rem;\">📄</span>
                        <strong style=\"color:#fff; font-size:0.92rem; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;\">{$title}</strong>
                        {$rangeBadge}
                    </div>
                    <div style=\"display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap;\">
                        <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" onclick=\"window.dsTogglePdfFullscreen('{$uid}')\" title=\"Tela Cheia\">⛶ Tela Cheia</button>
                        {$downloadActionsHtml}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class=\"ds-pdf-viewport\" style=\"position:relative; width:100%; height:{$height}; background:#1a1d24;\">
                    <iframe src=\"{$safeIframeUrl}\" style=\"width:100%; height:100%; border:0; display:block;\" loading=\"lazy\" allowfullscreen></iframe>
                </div>
                {$captionHtml}
            </figure>";
        }

        // Modo Cartão Compacto com Leitor Expansível Sob Demanda (Ideal para não poluir a aula até o clique)
        $isCardModal = ($mode === 'card_modal');
        $bodyDisplay = $isCardModal ? 'none' : 'block';
        $toggleCardBtn = $isCardModal
            ? "<button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn ds-pdf-btn-accent\" onclick=\"window.dsTogglePdfCollapse('{$uid}')\" data-pdf-toggle-btn=\"{$uid}\">📖 Abrir Leitor Online</button>"
            : '';

        $contextMenuGuard = !$allowDownload ? ' oncontextmenu="return false;"' : '';

        return "{$runtimeScript}
        <figure class=\"ds-block-pdf ds-pdf-mode-{$mode}\" id=\"{$uid}\"
            data-pdf-url=\"{$safeUrl}\"
            data-pdf-iframe-url=\"{$safeIframeUrl}\"
            data-start-page=\"{$startPage}\"
            data-end-page=\"{$endPage}\"
            data-allow-download=\"" . ($allowDownload ? '1' : '0') . "\"
            data-lazy-collapsed=\"" . ($isCardModal ? '1' : '0') . "\"
            style=\"margin: 26px 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0e14; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.25); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);\">{$contextMenuGuard}
            <div class=\"ds-pdf-toolbar\" style=\"display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; padding:10px 16px; background:#141920; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);\">
                <div style=\"display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-width:0;\">
                    <span style=\"font-size:1.15rem;\">📄</span>
                    <strong style=\"color:#fff; font-size:0.92rem; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;\">{$title}</strong>
                    {$rangeBadge}
                </div>
                <div class=\"ds-pdf-controls\" style=\"display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap;\">
                    {$toggleCardBtn}
                    <div class=\"ds-pdf-nav-group\" style=\"display:" . ($isCardModal ? 'none' : 'inline-flex') . "; align-items:center; gap:5px; background:#0b0e14; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);\">
                        <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" data-pdf-prev title=\"Página Anterior\">◀</button>
                        <span style=\"font-size:12px; color:#cbd5e1; font-family:monospace;\">
                            Pág <input type=\"number\" data-pdf-page-input value=\"{$startPage}\" min=\"{$startPage}\" style=\"width:46px; background:#141920; color:#45f3ff; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:4px; padding:2px 4px; text-align:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:700;\">
                            de <span data-pdf-page-count>...</span>
                        </span>
                        <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" data-pdf-next title=\"Próxima Página\">▶</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class=\"ds-pdf-zoom-group\" style=\"display:" . ($isCardModal ? 'none' : 'inline-flex') . "; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:#0b0e14; padding:3px 6px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);\">
                        <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" data-pdf-zoom-out title=\"Diminuir Zoom\">&minus;</button>
                        <span data-pdf-zoom-label style=\"font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; font-family:monospace; min-width:42px; text-align:center;\">100%</span>
                        <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" data-pdf-zoom-in title=\"Aumentar Zoom\">+</button>
                        <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" data-pdf-zoom-fit title=\"Ajustar à Largura\">↔</button>
                    </div>
                    <button type=\"button\" class=\"ds-pdf-btn\" onclick=\"window.dsTogglePdfFullscreen('{$uid}')\" title=\"Tela Cheia\">⛶</button>
                    {$downloadActionsHtml}
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class=\"ds-pdf-body\" style=\"display:{$bodyDisplay}; position:relative; width:100%; height:{$height}; overflow:auto; background:#161922; text-align:center; padding:16px; box-sizing:border-box;\">
                <div data-pdf-status style=\"color:#45f3ff; font-size:13px; padding:24px;\">⏳ Carregando página {$startPage} sob demanda...</div>
                <canvas data-pdf-canvas style=\"max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:4px; box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); display:none; margin:0 auto;\"></canvas>
                <iframe data-pdf-fallback-frame style=\"width:100%; height:100%; border:0; display:none; border-radius:4px;\"></iframe>
            </div>
            {$captionHtml}
        </figure>";
    }

    /**
     * Normaliza links de provedores de nuvem (Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint, Dropbox)
     * ou URLs diretas de PDF para exibição embutida no leitor.
     *
     * @return array{0: bool, 1: string} [isCloudEmbedOnly, iframeUrl]
     */
    private function resolveCloudOrDirectIframeUrl(string $resolvedUrl, int $startPage, bool $allowDownload): array
    {
        // 1. Google Drive: /file/d/{ID}/view ou /open?id={ID} -> /file/d/{ID}/preview
        if (preg_match('~drive\.google\.com/file/d/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)~i', $resolvedUrl, $gdMatches)) {
            return [true, 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' . $gdMatches[1] . '/preview'];
        }
        if (preg_match('~drive\.google\.com/(?:open|uc)\?(?:[^#]*&)?id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)~i', $resolvedUrl, $gdOpenMatches)) {
            return [true, 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' . $gdOpenMatches[1] . '/preview'];
        }

        // 2. Microsoft OneDrive Pessoal (onedrive.live.com / 1drv.ms)
        if (preg_match('~onedrive\.live\.com/embed~i', $resolvedUrl)) {
            return [true, $resolvedUrl];
        }
        if (preg_match('~onedrive\.live\.com/(?:view\.aspx|redir)\?(.+)$~i', $resolvedUrl, $odMatches)) {
            return [true, 'https://onedrive.live.com/embed?' . $odMatches[1]];
        }
        if (preg_match('~1drv\.ms/~i', $resolvedUrl)) {
            return [true, $resolvedUrl];
        }

        // 3. Microsoft SharePoint / OneDrive for Business (*.sharepoint.com)
        if (preg_match('~\.sharepoint\.com/~i', $resolvedUrl)) {
            $spUrl = $resolvedUrl;
            if (!str_contains(strtolower($spUrl), 'action=embedview') && !str_contains(strtolower($spUrl), '/embed')) {
                $spUrl .= (str_contains($spUrl, '?') ? '&' : '?') . 'action=embedview';
            }
            return [true, $spUrl];
        }

        // 4. Dropbox: converte ?dl=0 para ?raw=1 para streaming direto do PDF
        if (preg_match('~dropbox\.com/~i', $resolvedUrl)) {
            $dbxUrl = preg_replace('/([?&])dl=0\b/i', '$1raw=1', $resolvedUrl) ?? $resolvedUrl;
            if (!str_contains($dbxUrl, 'raw=1')) {
                $dbxUrl .= (str_contains($dbxUrl, '?') ? '&' : '?') . 'raw=1';
            }
            return [true, $dbxUrl];
        }

        // 5. URL direta de arquivo .pdf (Local ou CDN)
        $hashParams = ["page={$startPage}", 'zoom=page-width'];
        if (!$allowDownload) {
            $hashParams[] = 'toolbar=0';
            $hashParams[] = 'navpanes=0';
        }
        $fragment = implode('&', $hashParams);
        $iframeUrl = str_contains($resolvedUrl, '#')
            ? $resolvedUrl . '&' . $fragment
            : $resolvedUrl . '#' . $fragment;

        return [false, $iframeUrl];
    }

    function initSinglePdfViewer(container) {
        if (!container || container.dataset.pdfInitialized === '1') return;
        var url = container.getAttribute('data-pdf-url');
        if (!url) return;
        container.dataset.pdfInitialized = '1';

        var startPage = Math.max(1, parseInt(container.getAttribute('data-start-page') || '1', 10));
        var endPage = Math.max(0, parseInt(container.getAttribute('data-end-page') || '0', 10));
        var currentPage = startPage;
        var scale = 1.25;
        var pdfDoc = null;
        var rendering = false;
        var pendingPage = null;

        var statusEl = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-status]');
        var canvas = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-canvas]');
        var pageInput = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-page-input]');
        var pageCountEl = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-page-count]');
        var zoomLabel = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-zoom-label]');
        var btnPrev = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-prev]');
        var btnNext = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-next]');
        var btnZoomIn = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-zoom-in]');
        var btnZoomOut = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-zoom-out]');
        var btnZoomFit = container.querySelector('[data-pdf-zoom-fit]');

        function getMaxAllowedPage() {
            if (!pdfDoc) return endPage > 0 ? endPage : 1;
            return endPage > 0 ? Math.min(endPage, pdfDoc.numPages) : pdfDoc.numPages;
        }

        function renderPage(num) {
            if (!pdfDoc || !canvas) return;
            rendering = true;
            if (statusEl) {
                statusEl.textContent = '⏳ Renderizando página ' + num + '...';
                statusEl.style.display = 'block';
            }

            pdfDoc.getPage(num).then(function(page) {
                var viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: scale });
                var outputScale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
                canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
                canvas.style.width = Math.floor(viewport.width) + 'px';
                canvas.style.height = Math.floor(viewport.height) + 'px';

                var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                var transform = outputScale !== 1 ? [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0] : null;

                return page.render({
                    canvasContext: ctx,
                    transform: transform,
                    viewport: viewport
                }).promise;
            }).then(function() {
                rendering = false;
                if (statusEl) statusEl.style.display = 'none';
                canvas.style.display = 'block';
                if (pageInput) pageInput.value = String(currentPage);
                if (zoomLabel) zoomLabel.textContent = Math.round((scale / 1.25) * 100) + '%';
                if (pendingPage !== null) {
                    var next = pendingPage;
                    pendingPage = null;
                    renderPage(next);
                }
            }).catch(function() {
                rendering = false;
                activateIframeFallback(container);
            });
        }

        function queueRenderPage(num) {
            var maxP = getMaxAllowedPage();
            num = Math.max(startPage, Math.min(maxP, num));
            currentPage = num;
            if (rendering) {
                pendingPage = num;
            } else {
                renderPage(num);
            }
        }

        if (btnPrev) btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function() { if (currentPage > startPage) queueRenderPage(currentPage - 1); });
        if (btnNext) btnNext.addEventListener('click', function() { if (currentPage < getMaxAllowedPage()) queueRenderPage(currentPage + 1); });
        if (pageInput) pageInput.addEventListener('change', function() { queueRenderPage(parseInt(this.value || String(startPage), 10)); });
        if (btnZoomIn) btnZoomIn.addEventListener('click', function() { scale = Math.min(3.0, scale + 0.2); queueRenderPage(currentPage); });
        if (btnZoomOut) btnZoomOut.addEventListener('click', function() { scale = Math.max(0.6, scale - 0.2); queueRenderPage(currentPage); });
        if (btnZoomFit) btnZoomFit.addEventListener('click', function() { scale = 1.25; queueRenderPage(currentPage); });

        loadPdfJs().then(function(pdfjsLib) {
            return pdfjsLib.getDocument({
                url: url,
                disableAutoFetch: true,
                disableStream: false
            }).promise;
        }).then(function(doc) {
            pdfDoc = doc;
            var maxP = getMaxAllowedPage();
            if (startPage > doc.numPages) startPage = 1;
            currentPage = startPage;
            if (pageCountEl) pageCountEl.textContent = String(maxP);
            if (pageInput) {
                pageInput.min = String(startPage);
                pageInput.max = String(maxP);
            }
            renderPage(currentPage);
        }).catch(function() {
            activateIframeFallback(container);
        });
    }

    window.dsInitAcademyPdfViewers = function() {
        var viewers = document.querySelectorAll('.ds-block-pdf[data-pdf-url]');
        viewers.forEach(function(el) {
            if (el.getAttribute('data-lazy-collapsed') === '1') return;
            initSinglePdfViewer(el);
        });
    };

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.dsInitAcademyPdfViewers);
    } else {
        window.dsInitAcademyPdfViewers();
    }
})();
</script>
HTML;
    }

    public function convertVideoUrlToEmbed(string $url): ?string
    {
        // YouTube: youtube.com/watch?v=ID ou youtu.be/ID ou youtube.com/embed/ID
        if (preg_match('/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/i', $url, $matches)) {
            return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' . $matches[1];
        }

        // Vimeo: vimeo.com/ID
        if (preg_match('/vimeo\.com\/(?:channels\/(?:\w+\/)?|groups\/(?:[^\/]*)\/videos\/|album\/(?:\d+)\/video\/|video\/|)(\d+)/i', $url, $matches)) {
            return 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' . $matches[1];
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Extrai texto puro de um conteúdo (seja JSON de blocos ou HTML legado) para uso em SEO / resumos.
     */
    public function extractPlainText(?string $content): string
    {
        if ($content === null || trim($content) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $trimmed = trim($content);
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, '{') || str_starts_with($trimmed, '[')) {
            $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $blocks = $decoded['blocks'] ?? (isset($decoded[0]['type']) ? $decoded : null);
                if (is_array($blocks)) {
                    $parts = [];
                    foreach ($blocks as $block) {
                        $data = is_array($block['data'] ?? null) ? $block['data'] : [];
                        if (!empty($data['text'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['text']);
                        } elseif (!empty($data['title'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['title']);
                        } elseif (!empty($data['caption'])) {
                            $parts[] = strip_tags((string)$data['caption']);
                        }
                    }
                    return trim(implode(' ', $parts));
                }
            }
        }

        return trim(strip_tags($content));
    }

    private function sanitizeInlineHtml(string $html): string
    {
        return $this->sanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($html);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/LocalCourseImageStorage.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface;

class LocalCourseImageStorage implements CourseImageStorageInterface
{
    private PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private const MAX_BYTES = 2097152; // 2 MB
    private const ALLOWED_MIMES = [
        'image/jpeg' => 'jpg',
        'image/png'  => 'png',
        'image/webp' => 'webp',
    ];

    /**
     * @param PublicStorageInterface|string $storage Instância do PublicStorage do Core ou caminho para retrocompatibilidade
     */
    public function __construct(PublicStorageInterface|string $storage)
    {
        if (is_string($storage)) {
            $this->storage = new LocalPublicStorage($storage);
        } else {
            $this->storage = $storage;
        }
    }

    public function storeUpload(array $fileInfo): string
    {
        if (empty($fileInfo['tmp_name']) || !file_exists($fileInfo['tmp_name'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Nenhum arquivo válido enviado.");
        }

        $size = (int)($fileInfo['size'] ?? filesize($fileInfo['tmp_name']));
        if ($size > self::MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("A imagem deve ter no máximo 2MB.");
        }

        // Validação estrita de MIME type real (finfo com fallbacks resilientes)
        $realMime = null;
        if (class_exists('\finfo')) {
            try {
                $finfo = new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                $realMime = $finfo->file($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $realMime = null;
            }
        }
        if (empty($realMime) && function_exists('mime_content_type')) {
            $realMime = @mime_content_type($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
        }

        // Validação de dimensões e aspect ratio
        $imageSize = @getimagesize($fileInfo['tmp_name']);
        if (!$imageSize) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo enviado não é uma imagem válida.");
        }

        if (empty($realMime) && !empty($imageSize['mime'])) {
            $realMime = $imageSize['mime'];
        }

        if (empty($realMime) || !isset(self::ALLOWED_MIMES[$realMime])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Formato inválido. Apenas JPG, PNG ou WEBP são aceitos.");
        }

        $width = (int)$imageSize[0];
        $height = (int)$imageSize[1];
        if ($width < 640 || $height < 360) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Dimensão mínima exigida: 640x360 pixels (enviado: {$width}x{$height}).");
        }

        $aspectRatio = $width / $height;
        $expectedRatio = 16.0 / 9.0; // ~1.777
        if (abs($aspectRatio - $expectedRatio) > 0.10) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("A imagem do card deve respeitar a proporção 16:9 (horizontal).");
        }

        $extension = self::ALLOWED_MIMES[$realMime];
        $safeName = 'course_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(10)) . '.' . $extension;
        $destination = $this->storage->getUploadPath('academy/' . $safeName);

        $destDir = dirname($destination);
        if (!is_dir($destDir)) {
            @mkdir($destDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $moved = false;
        if (is_uploaded_file($fileInfo['tmp_name'])) {
            $moved = @move_uploaded_file($fileInfo['tmp_name'], $destination);
        }
        if (!$moved) {
            $moved = @copy($fileInfo['tmp_name'], $destination);
        }

        if (!$moved) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha ao salvar a imagem no diretório de destino ('{$destination}'). Verifique as permissões de escrita na pasta 'uploads/academy'.");
        }

        return 'uploads/academy/' . $safeName;
    }

    public function deleteFile(string $relativePath): void
    {
        $this->storage->delete($relativePath);
    }

    public function getUploadDir(): string
    {
        return $this->storage->getUploadPath('academy');
    }

    public function getStorage(): PublicStorageInterface
    {
        return $this->storage;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/LocalLessonPdfStorage.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonPdfStorageInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Implementação de armazenamento local e resolução híbrida (Local Hostinger + Nuvem HTTP/HTTPS)
 * de documentos PDF para o Academy LMS (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 */
class LocalLessonPdfStorage implements LessonPdfStorageInterface
{
    private PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private const MAX_BYTES = 134217728; // 128 MB para apostilas, livros e gráficos pesados

    public function __construct(PublicStorageInterface|string $storage)
    {
        if (is_string($storage)) {
            $this->storage = new LocalPublicStorage($storage);
        } else {
            $this->storage = $storage;
        }
    }

    public function storePdfUpload(array $fileInfo): array
    {
        $error = (int)($fileInfo['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK);
        if ($error !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            if ($error === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $error === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
                $maxIni = (string)ini_get('upload_max_filesize');
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo PDF excede o limite máximo de upload configurado no PHP ({$maxIni}).");
            }
            if ($error === UPLOAD_ERR_PARTIAL) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O envio do arquivo PDF foi interrompido antes de concluir.');
            }
            if ($error === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Nenhum arquivo PDF foi selecionado.');
            }
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Erro no envio do arquivo PDF (código: ' . $error . ').');
        }

        $tmpName = (string)($fileInfo['tmp_name'] ?? '');
        if ($tmpName === '' || !is_file($tmpName)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Nenhum arquivo PDF válido foi recebido.');
        }

        $size = (int)($fileInfo['size'] ?? filesize($tmpName));
        if ($size <= 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O arquivo PDF enviado está vazio.');
        }
        if ($size > self::MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O arquivo PDF excede o limite máximo de 128 MB.');
        }

        $originalName = (string)($fileInfo['name'] ?? 'documento.pdf');
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($originalName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if ($ext !== 'pdf') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Formato inválido. Apenas arquivos com extensão .pdf são permitidos.');
        }

        // Validação de assinatura mágica (%PDF-) nos primeiros bytes para impedir upload de scripts disfarçados
        $handle = @fopen($tmpName, 'rb');
        $headerBytes = $handle !== false ? (string)@fread($handle, 8) : '';
        if ($handle !== false) {
            @fclose($handle);
        }

        if (!str_starts_with($headerBytes, '%PDF-')) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O arquivo enviado não possui cabeçalho binário PDF válido (%PDF-).');
        }

        // Validação adicional de MIME quando finfo estiver disponível
        if (class_exists('\finfo')) {
            try {
                $finfo = new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                $mime = (string)$finfo->file($tmpName);
                if ($mime !== '' && !in_array($mime, ['application/pdf', 'application/x-pdf', 'application/octet-stream'], true)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo MIME incompatível com PDF: {$mime}");
                }
            } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                throw $e;
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Prossegue se finfo falhar no ambiente mas %PDF- já foi validado
            }
        }

        $baseSlug = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', pathinfo($originalName, PATHINFO_FILENAME));
        $baseSlug = preg_replace('/-+/', '-', (string)$baseSlug);
        $baseSlug = trim((string)$baseSlug, '-');
        if ($baseSlug === '') {
            $baseSlug = 'aula';
        }
        $baseSlug = substr(strtolower($baseSlug), 0, 48);

        $safeName = 'pdf_' . $baseSlug . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6)) . '.pdf';
        $relativeSubpath = 'academy/pdfs/' . $safeName;
        $destination = $this->storage->getUploadPath($relativeSubpath);

        $destDir = dirname($destination);
        if (!is_dir($destDir)) {
            @mkdir($destDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $moved = false;
        if (is_uploaded_file($tmpName)) {
            $moved = @move_uploaded_file($tmpName, $destination);
        }
        if (!$moved) {
            $moved = @copy($tmpName, $destination);
        }

        if (!$moved) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao gravar o arquivo PDF no diretório público de armazenamento.');
        }

        $relativePath = 'uploads/' . $relativeSubpath;
        $publicUrl = $this->storage->getPublicUrl($relativePath);

        return [
            'url'           => $publicUrl,
            'relative_path' => $relativePath,
            'file_name'     => $safeName,
            'size'          => $size,
        ];
    }

    public function resolvePublicUrl(string $rawUrl): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($rawUrl);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Bloqueia esquemas perigosos (XSS)
        if (preg_match('/^\s*(?:javascript|data|vbscript|file):/i', $trimmed)) {
            return '';
        }

        // URLs externas na nuvem (HTTP / HTTPS)
        if (preg_match('#^https?://#i', $trimmed)) {
            return $trimmed;
        }

        // Caminhos relativos locais (ex: uploads/academy/pdfs/arquivo.pdf ou /storage/...)
        if (str_starts_with($trimmed, 'uploads/')) {
            return $this->storage->getPublicUrl($trimmed);
        }

        return $trimmed;
    }

    public function deletePdf(string $relativePath): void
    {
        $this->storage->delete($relativePath);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/LocalStudentStorage.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentStorageInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Implementação Local Segura do Armazenamento de Arquivos e Anotações do Aluno (SRP / LGPD).
 */
class LocalStudentStorage implements StudentStorageInterface
{
    private string $baseStudentsDir;

    public function __construct(?string $baseStudentsDir = null)
    {
        if ($baseStudentsDir !== null) {
            $this->baseStudentsDir = rtrim($baseStudentsDir, '/\\');
        } elseif (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT')) {
            $this->baseStudentsDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/storage/students';
        } else {
            $this->baseStudentsDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/domain_system_students';
        }

        if (!is_dir($this->baseStudentsDir)) {
            @mkdir($this->baseStudentsDir, 0755, true);
        }
    }

    public function getStudentDirectory(int $studentId): string
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('ID de aluno inválido.');
        }

        $dir = $this->baseStudentsDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $studentId;
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        return $dir;
    }

    public function saveStudentNote(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId, string $content): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        $studentDir = $this->getStudentDirectory($studentId);
        $notesDir = $studentDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'notes';
        if (!is_dir($notesDir)) {
            @mkdir($notesDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $noteFile = $notesDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "note_c{$courseId}_l{$lessonId}.txt";
        return file_put_contents($noteFile, $content, LOCK_EX) !== false;
    }

    public function getStudentNote(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): string
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return '';
        }

        $studentDir = $this->getStudentDirectory($studentId);
        $noteFile = $studentDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'notes' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "note_c{$courseId}_l{$lessonId}.txt";

        if (is_file($noteFile)) {
            $content = file_get_contents($noteFile);
            return is_string($content) ? $content : '';
        }

        return '';
    }

    public function listStudentFiles(int $studentId): array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return [];
        }

        $studentDir = $this->getStudentDirectory($studentId);
        $filesDir = $studentDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'files';
        if (!is_dir($filesDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $results = [];
        $items = scandir($filesDir) ?: [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $fullPath = $filesDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item;
            if (is_file($fullPath)) {
                $results[] = [
                    'name'        => $item,
                    'size'        => (int)filesize($fullPath),
                    'modified_at' => (int)filemtime($fullPath),
                ];
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

    public function deleteStudentFile(int $studentId, string $filename): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        // Blindagem contra Path Traversal: extrai estritamente o basename
        $safeName = basename($filename);
        if ($safeName === '' || $safeName === '.' || $safeName === '..') {
            return false;
        }

        $studentDir = $this->getStudentDirectory($studentId);
        $filePath = $studentDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'files' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeName;

        if (is_file($filePath)) {
            return @unlink($filePath);
        }

        return false;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/StudentAdminService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAdminRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAdminServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

class StudentAdminService implements StudentAdminServiceInterface
{
    private StudentAdminRepositoryInterface $studentRepo;
    private CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo;
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private ?StudentProgressRepositoryInterface $progressRepo;

    public function __construct(
        StudentAdminRepositoryInterface $studentRepo,
        CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo,
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        ?StudentProgressRepositoryInterface $progressRepo = null,
        DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO|null $db = null
    ) {
        $this->studentRepo = $studentRepo;
        $this->enrollmentRepo = $enrollmentRepo;
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->progressRepo = $progressRepo;
    }

    public function listStudents(
        int $page = 1,
        int $perPage = 20,
        ?string $search = null,
        ?string $status = null
    ): array {
        $page = max(1, $page);
        $perPage = max(1, min(100, $perPage));

        $total = $this->studentRepo->countStudents($search, $status);
        $rawUsers = $this->studentRepo->getPaginatedStudents($page, $perPage, $search, $status);

        // Mapeia cursos disponíveis para exibição de nomes
        $courses = $this->courseRepo->findAll();
        $courseMap = [];
        foreach ($courses as $c) {
            $courseMap[(int)$c['id']] = (string)$c['title'];
        }

        $items = [];
        foreach ($rawUsers as $user) {
            $studentId = (int)$user['id'];
            $activeEnrollments = $this->enrollmentRepo->findActiveByStudent($studentId);

            $enrolledCourses = [];
            foreach ($activeEnrollments as $enr) {
                $cId = (int)$enr['course_id'];
                $enrolledCourses[] = [
                    'course_id' => $cId,
                    'title' => $courseMap[$cId] ?? "Curso #{$cId}",
                    'expires_at' => $enr['expires_at'] ?? null,
                    'order_ref' => $enr['order_ref'] ?? null,
                ];
            }

            $items[] = [
                'id' => $studentId,
                'name' => (string)$user['name'],
                'email' => (string)$user['email'],
                'username' => (string)($user['username'] ?? ''),
                'status' => (string)($user['status'] ?? 'active'),
                'role' => (string)($user['role'] ?? 'user'),
                'courses_count' => count($enrolledCourses),
                'enrolled_courses' => $enrolledCourses,
                'created_at' => (string)($user['created_at'] ?? ''),
            ];
        }

        return [
            'items' => $items,
            'total' => $total,
            'page' => $page,
            'per_page' => $perPage,
        ];
    }

    public function getStudentMetrics(): array
    {
        $totalStudents = $this->studentRepo->countStudents(null, null);
        $activeStudents = $this->studentRepo->countStudents(null, 'active');
        $suspendedStudents = $this->studentRepo->countStudents(null, 'suspended')
            + $this->studentRepo->countStudents(null, 'banned');

        $totalEnrollments = $this->enrollmentRepo->countActiveEnrollments();

        return [
            'total_students' => $totalStudents,
            'active_students' => $activeStudents,
            'suspended_students' => $suspendedStudents,
            'total_enrollments' => $totalEnrollments,
        ];
    }

    public function enrollStudent(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->saveEnrollment(
            $studentId,
            $courseId,
            'active',
            $expiresAt,
            $orderRef ?? 'MANUAL_ADMIN'
        );
    }

    public function revokeEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->updateStatus($studentId, $courseId, 'cancelled');
    }

    public function setStudentStatus(int $studentId, string $status): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        $valid = ['active', 'suspended', 'banned'];
        if (!in_array($status, $valid, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $this->studentRepo->updateStatus($studentId, $status);
        return true;
    }

    public function resetStudentPassword(int $studentId, string $newPassword): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || trim($newPassword) === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $this->studentRepo->updatePassword($studentId, password_hash($newPassword, PASSWORD_DEFAULT));
        return true;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/StudentAuthService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAuthServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço de Gerenciamento da Sessão e Identidade do Aluno (SRP / DIP).
 * Armazena a identidade do aluno em chaves escopadas ('academy_student_*'),
 * garantindo zero acoplamento e zero colisão com a sessão administrativa do núcleo.
 */
class StudentAuthService implements StudentAuthServiceInterface
{
    public const SESSION_STUDENT_ID       = 'academy_student_id';
    public const SESSION_STUDENT_NAME     = 'academy_student_name';
    public const SESSION_STUDENT_USERNAME = 'academy_student_username';
    public const SESSION_STUDENT_EMAIL    = 'academy_student_email';
    public const SESSION_STUDENT_FLASH    = 'academy_student_flash';

    private SessionManagerInterface $session;

    public function __construct(SessionManagerInterface $session)
    {
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    public function isLoggedIn(): bool
    {
        $id = $this->getStudentId();
        return $id !== null && $id > 0;
    }

    public function getStudentId(): ?int
    {
        if ((bool)$this->session->get('academy_logged_out', false)) {
            return null;
        }

        $id = filter_var($this->session->get(self::SESSION_STUDENT_ID), FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        return ($id !== false && $id > 0) ? $id : null;
    }

    public function getStudentName(): ?string
    {
        if ((bool)$this->session->get('academy_logged_out', false)) {
            return null;
        }

        $name = trim((string)$this->session->get(self::SESSION_STUDENT_NAME, ''));
        return $name !== '' ? $name : null;
    }

    public function getStudentUsername(): ?string
    {
        if ((bool)$this->session->get('academy_logged_out', false)) {
            return null;
        }

        $user = trim((string)$this->session->get(self::SESSION_STUDENT_USERNAME, ''));
        return $user !== '' ? $user : null;
    }

    public function getStudentEmail(): ?string
    {
        if ((bool)$this->session->get('academy_logged_out', false)) {
            return null;
        }

        $email = trim((string)$this->session->get(self::SESSION_STUDENT_EMAIL, ''));
        return $email !== '' ? $email : null;
    }

    public function login(int $studentId, string $name, string $email, ?string $username = null): void
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('ID de aluno inválido.');
        }

        $this->session->remove('academy_logged_out');
        $this->session->set(self::SESSION_STUDENT_ID, $studentId);
        $this->session->set(self::SESSION_STUDENT_NAME, trim($name));
        $this->session->set(self::SESSION_STUDENT_EMAIL, strtolower(trim($email)));

        if ($username !== null && trim($username) !== '') {
            $this->session->set(self::SESSION_STUDENT_USERNAME, trim($username));
        } else {
            $this->session->remove(self::SESSION_STUDENT_USERNAME);
        }
    }

    public function logout(): void
    {
        $keys = [
            self::SESSION_STUDENT_ID,
            self::SESSION_STUDENT_NAME,
            self::SESSION_STUDENT_USERNAME,
            self::SESSION_STUDENT_EMAIL,
            self::SESSION_STUDENT_FLASH,
            'academy_student_role',
        ];

        // Isola completamente: remove EXCLUSIVAMENTE chaves de aluno
        foreach ($keys as $k) {
            $this->session->remove($k);
        }

        $this->session->set('academy_logged_out', true);
        $this->session->regenerate(false);
    }

    public function setFlash(string $type, string $message): void
    {
        $payload = ['type' => $type, 'msg' => $message];
        $this->session->set(self::SESSION_STUDENT_FLASH, $payload);
    }

    public function getFlash(?string $type = null): array|string|null
    {
        $flash = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_STUDENT_FLASH);

        if (!is_array($flash)) {
            return null;
        }

        if ($type !== null) {
            if (($flash['type'] ?? '') === $type) {
                $this->session->remove(self::SESSION_STUDENT_FLASH);
                return (string)($flash['msg'] ?? '');
            }
            return null;
        }

        $this->session->remove(self::SESSION_STUDENT_FLASH);
        return $flash;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/StudentProgressService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Serviço de Cálculo de Progresso de Cursos e Conclusão de Aulas (SRP / DIP).
 */
class StudentProgressService implements StudentProgressInterface
{
    private StudentProgressRepositoryInterface $progressRepo;
    private ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;

    public function __construct(
        StudentProgressRepositoryInterface $progressRepo,
        ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo = null
    ) {
        $this->progressRepo = $progressRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
    }

    public function markLessonCompleted(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->saveProgress($studentId, $courseId, $lessonId);
    }

    public function markLessonIncomplete(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->deleteProgress($studentId, $lessonId);
    }

    public function isLessonCompleted(int $studentId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->hasCompleted($studentId, $lessonId);
    }

    public function getCompletedLessonIds(int $studentId, int $courseId): array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return [];
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->findCompletedLessonIds($studentId, $courseId);
    }

    public function getCourseProgressPercentage(int $studentId, int $courseId): float
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0 || $this->structureRepo === null) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);
        $publishedCount = 0;
        foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
            if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') === 'published') {
                $publishedCount++;
            }
        }

        if ($publishedCount === 0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $completedIds = $this->progressRepo->findCompletedLessonIds($studentId, $courseId);
        $completedCount = count($completedIds);

        $pct = ($completedCount / $publishedCount) * 100.0;
        return round(min(100.0, max(0.0, $pct)), 1);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/StudentViewRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentViewRendererInterface;

/**
 * Renderizador Oficial de Telas Públicas do Aluno.
 * Produz respostas HTTP independentes, isoladas de qualquer casca ou middleware administrativo.
 */
class StudentViewRenderer implements StudentViewRendererInterface
{
    private string $viewsPath;

    public function __construct(?string $viewsPath = null)
    {
        $this->viewsPath = $viewsPath ?? dirname(__DIR__) . '/views';
    }

    public function render(string $viewName, array $data = []): ResponseInterface
    {
        $viewFile = rtrim($this->viewsPath, '/\\') . '/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return new Response("<h1>Página não encontrada</h1>", 404, [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
            ]);
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return new Response($content, 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
        ]);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/ThemeLessonFileScaffolder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\SlugHelper;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Fábrica Automática de Pastas (Módulos) e Arquivos PHP Pré-Configurados de Aulas.
 *
 * Cria fisicamente diretórios e arquivos `.php` dentro de `pages/` do tema ativo,
 * pré-configurados com CSS e JS padrão para resoluções Desktop, Mobile e Tablet,
 * prontos para edição via Blocos.
 *
 * Exemplo:
 *   Título: "Estrutura de Dados"
 *   Arquivo gerado: `estrutura-de-dados.php`
 *   Slug relativo: `pages/estrutura-de-dados.php`
 *   URL pública: `http://localhost/domain-system/cursos/estrutura-de-dados`
 */
class ThemeLessonFileScaffolder implements LessonFileScaffolderInterface
{
    private ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver;
    private LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer;
    private ?string $overridePagesRoot;

    public function __construct(
        ?ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver = null,
        ?LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer = null,
        ?string $overridePagesRoot = null
    ) {
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver ?? new ThemePageResolver();
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
        $this->overridePagesRoot = $overridePagesRoot;
    }

    public function slugify(string $title): string
    {
        return SlugHelper::slugify($title, 'aula-sem-titulo');
    }

    public function createFolder(string $folderTitle): array
    {
        $trimmed = trim($folderTitle);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O nome da pasta ou módulo não pode estar vazio.");
        }

        // Suporta subpastas seguras ex: "tutoriais/python" ou título simples "Estrutura de Dados"
        $parts = array_filter(explode('/', str_replace('\\', '/', $trimmed)), fn($p) => trim($p) !== '' && $p !== '.' && $p !== '..');
        $slugParts = array_map(fn($p) => $this->slugify($p), $parts);
        if (empty($slugParts)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Nome de pasta inválido.");
        }

        $folderSlug = implode('/', $slugParts);
        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $targetDir = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $folderSlug);

        if (!is_dir($targetDir)) {
            if (!@mkdir($targetDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetDir)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Não foi possível criar a pasta física em: pages/{$folderSlug}");
            }
        }

        $realPagesRoot = realpath($pagesRoot);
        $realTargetDir = realpath($targetDir);
        if ($realPagesRoot === false || $realTargetDir === false || !str_starts_with($realTargetDir, $realPagesRoot)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Violação de segurança ao validar diretório da pasta criada.");
        }

        return [
            'slug'          => $folderSlug,
            'relative_path' => 'pages/' . $folderSlug,
            'full_path'     => $realTargetDir,
        ];
    }

    public function fabricateLessonFile(
        string $title,
        ?string $folder = null,
        ?string $blocksJson = null,
        string $mobileProfile = 'drawer'
    ): array {
        $trimmedTitle = trim($title);
        if ($trimmedTitle === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O título da aula/página é obrigatório para fabricar o arquivo PHP.");
        }

        $slug = $this->slugify($trimmedTitle);
        $fileName = $slug . '.php';
        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();

        $cleanFolder = '';
        if ($folder !== null && trim($folder) !== '') {
            $normalizedFolder = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $folder), '/');
            if (str_starts_with($normalizedFolder, 'pages/')) {
                $normalizedFolder = substr($normalizedFolder, 6);
            }
            if ($normalizedFolder !== '') {
                $folderInfo = $this->createFolder($normalizedFolder);
                $cleanFolder = $folderInfo['slug'];
            }
        }

        $relativePath = $cleanFolder !== ''
            ? 'pages/' . $cleanFolder . '/' . $fileName
            : 'pages/' . $fileName;

        $targetDir = $cleanFolder !== ''
            ? $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanFolder)
            : $pagesRoot;

        $fullPath = $targetDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $fileName;

        $phpTemplate = $this->buildPreconfiguredPhpTemplate(
            $trimmedTitle,
            $slug,
            $relativePath,
            $blocksJson,
            $mobileProfile
        );

        if (@file_put_contents($fullPath, $phpTemplate, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao gravar o arquivo pré-configurado em: {$relativePath}");
        }

        $realPagesRoot = realpath($pagesRoot);
        $realFile = realpath($fullPath);
        if ($realPagesRoot === false || $realFile === false || !str_starts_with($realFile, $realPagesRoot)) {
            @unlink($fullPath);
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Caminho de arquivo fora do diretório permitido.");
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $publicUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . $slug;

        return [
            'title'         => $trimmedTitle,
            'slug'          => $slug,
            'file_name'     => $fileName,
            'relative_path' => $relativePath,
            'full_path'     => $realFile,
            'public_url'    => $publicUrl,
        ];
    }

    private function resolvePagesDirectory(): string
    {
        if ($this->overridePagesRoot !== null && $this->overridePagesRoot !== '') {
            if (!is_dir($this->overridePagesRoot)) {
                @mkdir($this->overridePagesRoot, 0755, true);
            }
            return rtrim($this->overridePagesRoot, '/\\');
        }

        $themePath = $this->themeResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $pagesDir = rtrim($themePath, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'pages';
        if (!is_dir($pagesDir)) {
            @mkdir($pagesDir, 0755, true);
        }
        return $pagesDir;
    }

    private function buildPreconfiguredPhpTemplate(
        string $title,
        string $slug,
        string $relativePath,
        ?string $blocksJson,
        string $mobileProfile
    ): string {
        $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars($title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeProfile = in_array($mobileProfile, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true) ? $mobileProfile : 'drawer';

        if ($blocksJson === null || trim($blocksJson) === '') {
            $defaultBlocks = [
                'time' => time(),
                'blocks' => [
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_head_1',
                        'type' => 'header',
                        'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => $title],
                    ],
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_par_1',
                        'type' => 'paragraph',
                        'data' => ['text' => 'Conteúdo inicial da aula <strong>' . $safeTitle . '</strong>. Edite este arquivo pelo <code>Editor em Blocos</code> do painel Academy para atualizar automaticamente Desktop e Mobile.'],
                    ],
                ],
            ];
            $blocksJson = (string)json_encode($defaultBlocks, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        }

        $renderedBlocksHtml = $this->blockRenderer->render($blocksJson);
        $encodedJsonComment = base64_encode($blocksJson);

        return <<<PHP
<?php
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * ARQUIVO GERADO PELA FÁBRICA DE AULAS DO ACADEMY (Domain-System v2.4)
 * ============================================================================
 * Título: {$safeTitle}
 * Slug: {$slug}
 * Caminho: {$relativePath}
 * Perfil Mobile: {$safeProfile}
 * DS_BLOCKS_B64: {$encodedJsonComment}
 * ============================================================================
 */
?>
<article class="ds-fabricated-lesson" data-lesson-slug="{$slug}" data-mobile-profile="{$safeProfile}">
    <style>
        /* CSS Padrão Pré-Configurado: Resoluções Desktop, Tablet e Mobile */
        .ds-fabricated-lesson {
            color: var(--text-main, #e2e8f0);
            line-height: 1.75;
            font-size: 1.04rem;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson .ds-lesson-blocks {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson pre {
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow-x: auto;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson img,
        .ds-fabricated-lesson iframe,
        .ds-fabricated-lesson video {
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        /* Responsividade Tablet (<= 1024px) */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .ds-fabricated-lesson {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
        }

        /* Responsividade Mobile (<= 768px) */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .ds-fabricated-lesson {
                font-size: 0.96rem;
                line-height: 1.65;
            }
            .ds-fabricated-lesson[data-mobile-profile="cinema"] .ds-block-video {
                position: sticky;
                top: 8px;
                z-index: 30;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <div class="ds-fabricated-lesson-body">
        {$renderedBlocksHtml}
    </div>

    <script>
        /* JS Padrão Pré-Configurado (Desktop & Mobile) */
        (function() {
            const article = document.querySelector('.ds-fabricated-lesson[data-lesson-slug="{$slug}"]');
            if (!article) return;
            article.querySelectorAll('pre code').forEach(function(codeBlock) {
                codeBlock.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            });
        })();
    </script>
</article>
PHP;
    }

    public function extractBlocksFromFile(string $relativePath): ?string
    {
        $cleanRel = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($cleanRel, 'pages/')) {
            $cleanRel = substr($cleanRel, 6);
        }

        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $fullPath = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanRel);
        if (!is_file($fullPath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $content = (string)@file_get_contents($fullPath);
        if (preg_match('/DS_BLOCKS_B64:\s*([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)/', $content, $matches)) {
            $decoded = base64_decode($matches[1], true);
            return $decoded !== false ? $decoded : null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function inspectLessonFile(string $relativePath): array
    {
        $cleanRel = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($cleanRel, 'pages/')) {
            $cleanRel = substr($cleanRel, 6);
        }

        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $fullPath = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanRel);

        $fileName = basename($cleanRel);
        $fallbackTitle = ucwords(str_replace(['-', '_'], ' ', preg_replace('/\.(php|html)$/i', '', $fileName)));

        if (!is_file($fullPath)) {
            return [
                'title'          => $fallbackTitle,
                'slug'           => $this->slugify($fallbackTitle),
                'mobile_profile' => 'drawer',
                'has_blocks'     => false,
                'blocks_json'    => null,
            ];
        }

        // Lê até 8KB iniciais para extração rápida de cabeçalho e <h1>
        $handle = @fopen($fullPath, 'r');
        $content = $handle ? (string)@fread($handle, 8192) : (string)@file_get_contents($fullPath);
        if ($handle) {
            @fclose($handle);
        }

        $title = null;
        // 1. Tenta extrair do cabeçalho docblock: * Título: ... ou * Title: ...
        if (preg_match('/(?:\*|\/\/)\s*(?:T[íi]tulo|Title)\s*:\s*([^\r\n*]+)/iu', $content, $m)) {
            $candidate = trim($m[1]);
            if ($candidate !== '') {
                $title = $candidate;
            }
        }

        // 2. Se não encontrou, tenta extrair da primeira tag <h1>...</h1>
        if ($title === null && preg_match('/<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/is', $content, $m)) {
            $candidate = trim(strip_tags($m[1]));
            if ($candidate !== '') {
                $title = $candidate;
            }
        }

        if ($title === null || $title === '') {
            $title = $fallbackTitle;
        }

        // 3. Perfil Mobile
        $mobileProfile = 'drawer';
        if (preg_match('/(?:\*|\/\/)\s*(?:Perfil\s*Mobile|Mobile\s*Profile)\s*:\s*([a-z_]+)/iu', $content, $m)) {
            $p = strtolower(trim($m[1]));
            if (in_array($p, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true)) {
                $mobileProfile = $p;
            }
        }

        // 4. Blocos em Base64
        $blocksJson = null;
        $hasBlocks = false;
        if (preg_match('/DS_BLOCKS_B64:\s*([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)/', $content, $m)) {
            $decoded = base64_decode($m[1], true);
            if ($decoded !== false && trim($decoded) !== '') {
                $blocksJson = $decoded;
                $hasBlocks = true;
            }
        }

        return [
            'title'          => $title,
            'slug'           => $this->slugify($title),
            'mobile_profile' => $mobileProfile,
            'has_blocks'     => $hasBlocks,
            'blocks_json'    => $blocksJson,
        ];
    }
}
