// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/ThemePageResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemePathResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use FilesystemIterator;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

class ThemePageResolver implements ThemePageResolverInterface
{
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private ?ThemePathResolverInterface $themeResolver;
    private ?SiteStateInterface $siteState;
    private string $baseRoot;

    public function __construct(
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?ThemePathResolverInterface $themeResolver = null,
        ?SiteStateInterface $siteState = null,
        ?string $baseRoot = null
    ) {
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->baseRoot = $baseRoot ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver ?? new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->baseRoot . '/themes',
            $this->baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes',
        ]);
        $this->siteState = $siteState ?? new EnvSiteState();
    }

    public function resolveActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $activePath = $this->themeManager->getActiveThemePath();
            if (!empty($activePath) && is_dir($activePath)) {
                return $activePath;
            }
        }

        $activeTheme = $this->siteState !== null ? $this->siteState->getActiveTheme() : '';
        if ($activeTheme !== '' && $this->themeResolver !== null && $this->themeResolver->themeExists($activeTheme)) {
            return $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($activeTheme);
        }

        $candidates = ['default'];
        if ($this->themeResolver !== null) {
            foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
                if ($this->themeResolver->themeExists($candidate)) {
                    return $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($candidate);
                }
            }
        }

        return $this->themeResolver !== null
            ? $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($activeTheme)
            : $this->baseRoot . '/themes/default';
    }

    public function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        $pages = [];

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages();
        }

        if (empty($pages)) {
            $activePublicTheme = $this->siteState !== null ? $this->siteState->getActiveTheme() : '';

            if ($this->themeManager !== null && $activePublicTheme !== '') {
                $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages($activePublicTheme);
            }

            if (empty($pages) && $this->themeResolver !== null) {
                $candidateThemes = array_unique(array_filter([$activePublicTheme, 'default']));
                foreach ($candidateThemes as $themeName) {
                    if ($this->themeResolver->themeExists($themeName)) {
                        $pagesDir = $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($themeName) . '/pages';
                        if (is_dir($pagesDir)) {
                            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pagesDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)
                            );
                            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                                if ($file->isFile() && in_array(strtolower($file->getExtension()), ['php', 'html'], true)) {
                                    $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file->getPathname(), strlen($pagesDir) + 1));
                                    $pages[] = 'pages/' . ltrim($rel, '/');
                                }
                            }
                            if (!empty($pages)) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
        natsort($pages);
        return array_values($pages);
    }

    /**
     * Alias retrocompatível para resolvePublicThemePages().
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getAvailablePages(): array
    {
        return $this->resolvePublicThemePages();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoInc = $driver === 'sqlite' ? 'INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT' : 'INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY';

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_courses (
                id {$autoInc},
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                thumbnail VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                description TEXT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
                link VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
                is_free INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                max_installments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12,
                external_platform VARCHAR(50) NULL,
                external_product_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
                external_checkout_url VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_courses");
    },
];

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/migrations/2026_10_15_000002_create_academy_structure.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoInc = $driver === 'sqlite' ? 'INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT' : 'INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY';

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_modules (
                id {$autoInc},
                course_id INT NOT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                folder_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lessons (
                id {$autoInc},
                course_id INT NOT NULL,
                module_id INT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                source_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'theme_file',
                source VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                content TEXT NULL,
                mobile_profile VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drawer',
                position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                UNIQUE(course_id, slug)
            )
        ");

        // Garante colunas mobile_profile e folder_slug via SQL ANSI padrão (independente de ERRMODE ou driver)
        $hasMobileCol = false;
        try {
            $stmtMob = @$db->query("SELECT mobile_profile FROM academy_lessons LIMIT 1");
            $hasMobileCol = ($stmtMob !== false);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $hasMobileCol = false;
        }
        if (!$hasMobileCol) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_lessons ADD COLUMN mobile_profile VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drawer'");
            } catch (\Throwable $inner) {
                // Coluna já existe ou não aplicável
            }
        }

        $hasFolderCol = false;
        try {
            $stmtFold = @$db->query("SELECT folder_slug FROM academy_modules LIMIT 1");
            $hasFolderCol = ($stmtFold !== false);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $hasFolderCol = false;
        }
        if (!$hasFolderCol) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_modules ADD COLUMN folder_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL");
            } catch (\Throwable $inner) {
                // Coluna já existe ou não aplicável
            }
        }
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_lessons");
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_modules");
    },
];


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/migrations/2026_11_08_000003_add_student_columns_to_users.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);

        $colNames = [];
        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            $stmt = $db->query("PRAGMA table_info(users)");
            if ($stmt) {
                $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'name'));
            }
        } else {
            $stmt = $db->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users");
            if ($stmt) {
                $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'Field'));
            }
        }

        if (!in_array('username', $colNames, true)) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN username VARCHAR(100) NULL");
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }

        if (!in_array('status', $colNames, true)) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'");
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        // Regra de integridade aditiva: colunas de dados não são dropadas em rollback
    },
];


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/migrations/2026_11_09_000004_create_academy_enrollments_and_progress.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);

        if ($driver === 'mysql') {
            $db->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_enrollments (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id INT NOT NULL,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                    expires_at DATETIME NULL,
                    order_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_course (user_id, course_id),
                    INDEX idx_status (status)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ");

            $db->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_progress (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    student_id INT NOT NULL,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    lesson_slug VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
                    completed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    notes_encrypted TEXT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uq_student_lesson (student_id, course_id, lesson_slug),
                    INDEX idx_student_course (student_id, course_id)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ");
        } else {
            $db->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_enrollments (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                    expires_at DATETIME NULL,
                    order_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            ");
            $db->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_academy_enrollments_uc ON academy_enrollments(user_id, course_id)");
            $db->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_enrollments_st ON academy_enrollments(status)");

            $db->exec("
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_progress (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    student_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    lesson_slug VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
                    completed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    notes_encrypted TEXT NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            ");
            $db->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_academy_prog_st_cs_ls ON academy_progress(student_id, course_id, lesson_slug)");
            $db->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_prog_st_cs ON academy_progress(student_id, course_id)");
        }
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        // Política de integridade: tabelas com dados de alunos não são dropadas em rollback simples
    },
];

            <script>
                function toggleCoursePricingMode(val) {
                    const isFree = (val === '1' || val === 1);
                    const priceBox = document.getElementById('box_edit_course_price');
                    const instBox = document.getElementById('box_edit_course_installments');
                    const freeNotice = document.getElementById('box_free_notice');
                    const payWrapper = document.getElementById('box_payment_options_wrapper');
                    const priceInput = document.getElementById('edit_course_price');

                    if (isFree) {
                        if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'none';
                        if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'none';
                        if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'block';
                        if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'none';
                        if (priceInput) priceInput.value = '0.00';
                    } else {
                        if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'block';
                        if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'block';
                        if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'none';
                        if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'block';
                        if (priceInput && (parseFloat(priceInput.value) <= 0 || priceInput.value === '')) {
                            priceInput.value = '10.00';
                        }
                    }
                }

                function toggleExternalPlatformFields(val) {
                    const isExternal = ['hotmart', 'eduzz', 'monetizze', 'clickbank'].includes(val);
                    const isPp = (val === 'paypal');
                    const isStripe = (val === 'stripe');

                    const idBox = document.getElementById('box_external_product_id');
                    const urlBox = document.getElementById('box_external_checkout_url');
                    const tipBox = document.getElementById('box_native_gateway_tip');
                    const ppBox = document.getElementById('box_paypal_settings');
                    const stripeBox = document.getElementById('box_stripe_settings');

                    if (idBox) idBox.style.display = isExternal ? 'block' : 'none';
                    if (urlBox) urlBox.style.display = isExternal ? 'block' : 'none';
                    if (ppBox) ppBox.style.display = isPp ? 'block' : 'none';
                    if (stripeBox) stripeBox.style.display = isStripe ? 'block' : 'none';

                    if (tipBox) {
                        tipBox.style.display = isExternal ? 'none' : 'block';
                        if (val === 'stripe') {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Stripe Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará via Cartão de Crédito Global / Apple Pay diretamente pelo Stripe Checkout. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        } else if (val === 'paypal') {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>PayPal Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Saldo PayPal ou Cartão Internacional via API oficial v2 do PayPal. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        } else if (val === 'mercadopago') {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Mercado Pago Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Pix Instantâneo (QR Code na tela), Cartão até 12x ou Boleto via Mercado Pago Oficial. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        } else {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Checkout Multigateway:</strong> O aluno terá na tela de compra as opções ativas: Pix Instantâneo, Mercado Pago, Stripe e PayPal. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        }
                    }
                }
            </script>

            <script>
                document.getElementById('course_edit_thumbnail')?.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
                    const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
                    const previewBox = document.getElementById('course_edit_thumb_preview');
                    const previewImg = document.getElementById('course_edit_thumb_preview_img');
                    if (file && previewBox && previewImg) {
                        const reader = new FileReader();
                        reader.onload = function(ev) {
                            previewImg.src = ev.target.result;
                            previewBox.style.display = 'flex';
                        };
                        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                    }
                });
            </script>

    <script>
    (function() {
        var baseUrl = <?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?>;
        var courseSlug = <?= json_encode((string)$course['slug']) ?>;
        var structure = <?= json_encode($initialStructure, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || [];
        var availablePages = <?= json_encode($availablePages, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || [];
        var availablePagesMeta = <?= json_encode($availablePagesMeta ?? [], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?> || {};

        var foldersMap = {};
        availablePages.forEach(function(pagePath) {
            var lastSlash = pagePath.lastIndexOf('/');
            var dir = lastSlash > 0 ? pagePath.substring(0, lastSlash) : 'pages';
            if (!foldersMap[dir]) {
                foldersMap[dir] = [];
            }
            foldersMap[dir].push(pagePath);
        });

        function slugifyText(raw) {
            var map = {'á':'a','à':'a','ã':'a','â':'a','ä':'a','é':'e','è':'e','ê':'e','ë':'e','í':'i','ì':'i','î':'i','ï':'i','ó':'o','ò':'o','õ':'o','ô':'o','ö':'o','ú':'u','ù':'u','û':'u','ü':'u','ç':'c','ñ':'n'};
            var str = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[áàãâäéèêëíìîïóòõôöúùûüçñ]/g, function(c) { return map[c] || c; });
            return str.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'aula';
        }

        window.openCreateFolderModal = function() {
            var prefix = courseSlug ? ('pages/' + courseSlug + '/') : 'pages/';
            var input = document.getElementById('new_folder_name_input');
            if (input) {
                var s = input.value ? slugifyText(input.value) : 'modulo-01';
                document.getElementById('new_folder_slug_preview').textContent = prefix + s;
            }
            document.getElementById('modalCreateFolder').style.display = 'flex';
        };
        window.closeCreateFolderModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('modalCreateFolder').style.display = 'none';
        };
        window.updateNewFolderSlugPreview = function(val) {
            var s = slugifyText(val);
            var prefix = courseSlug ? ('pages/' + courseSlug + '/') : 'pages/';
            document.getElementById('new_folder_slug_preview').textContent = prefix + (s || 'modulo-01');
        };

        function renderModules() {
            var container = document.getElementById('modulesContainer');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (structure.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px; text-align:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius:6px; color:#8c8f94; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">Nenhum módulo criado ainda. Clique em "Adicionar Módulo" ou "📁 Criar Pasta (ou Módulo)" para começar.</div>';
                return;
            }

            structure.forEach(function(mod, modIdx) {
                var modCard = document.createElement('div');
                modCard.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:6px; padding:18px; width:100%; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; overflow:hidden;';

                var modFolderSlug = mod.folder_slug || '';
                var modHeader = document.createElement('div');
                modHeader.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:14px; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; width:100%; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;';
                modHeader.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="flex:1; min-width:260px; max-width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; box-sizing:border-box;">
                        <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; color:var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); text-transform:uppercase; flex-shrink:0;">Módulo ` + (modIdx + 1) + `</span>
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(mod.title || '') + `" placeholder="Título do Módulo" onchange="updateModTitle(` + modIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:2; min-width:160px; max-width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #4a545a; background:#14191c; color:#fff; font-weight:600; box-sizing:border-box;">
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(modFolderSlug) + `" placeholder="Pasta opcional (ex: modulo-1)" onchange="updateModFolderSlug(` + modIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:1; min-width:130px; max-width:100%; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#00d284; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;" title="Subpasta dentro de pages/ onde novos arquivos .php deste módulo serão fabricados">
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <button type="button" onclick="openImportFolderModal(` + modIdx + `)" style="padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.35); background:rgba(69,243,255,0.08); color:#45f3ff; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; box-sizing:border-box;" title="Importar todas as aulas de uma pasta do tema">
                            📂 Importar Pasta do Tema
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onclick="removeModule(` + modIdx + `)" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#e06c75; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; padding:4px 8px;" title="Excluir Módulo">
                            <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `;
                modCard.appendChild(modHeader);

                var lessonsList = document.createElement('div');
                lessonsList.style.cssText = 'display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; margin-left:15px; border-left:2px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2); padding-left:15px; width:calc(100% - 15px); max-width:calc(100% - 15px); box-sizing:border-box; min-width:0;';

                (mod.lessons || []).forEach(function(lesson, lesIdx) {
                    var lesRow = document.createElement('div');
                    lesRow.style.cssText = 'background:#14191c; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:6px; padding:12px 14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; width:100%; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; overflow:hidden;';

                    var srcType = lesson.source_type || (lesson.source ? 'theme_file' : 'content');
                    var statusVal = lesson.status || 'published';
                    var mobProfile = lesson.mobile_profile || 'drawer';
                    var computedSlug = lesson.slug || slugifyText(lesson.title || ('aula-' + (lesIdx + 1)));
                    var targetFile = lesson.source || ('pages/' + (modFolderSlug ? (modFolderSlug + '/') : '') + computedSlug + '.php');

                    var optionsHtml = '<option value="">-- Auto-Fabricar (' + escapeHtml(targetFile) + ') ou Selecione (.php) --</option>';
                    availablePages.forEach(function(p) {
                        var selected = (lesson.source === p) ? 'selected' : '';
                        optionsHtml += '<option value="' + escapeHtml(p) + '" ' + selected + '>' + escapeHtml(p) + '</option>';
                    });
                    if (lesson.source && availablePages.indexOf(lesson.source) === -1) {
                        optionsHtml += '<option value="' + escapeHtml(lesson.source) + '" selected>' + escapeHtml(lesson.source) + ' (Fabricado)</option>';
                    }

                    var editorActionHtml = '';
                    if (lesson.id && parseInt(lesson.id) > 0) {
                        editorActionHtml = `<a href="` + baseUrl + `/admin/academy/lessons/` + parseInt(lesson.id) + `/editor" style="padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(0,210,132,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(0,210,132,0.4); color:#00d284; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;" title="Abrir Editor Visual em Blocos desta aula">⚡ Editor de Blocos</a>`;
                    } else {
                        editorActionHtml = `<span style="font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; padding:4px 8px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-radius:4px; white-space:nowrap;" title="Salve a estrutura abaixo para habilitar o Editor de Blocos desta nova aula">💾 Salve p/ Editar Blocos</span>`;
                    }

                    var themeSelectDisplay = (srcType === 'theme_file') ? 'flex' : 'none';

                    lesRow.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; width:100%; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            <div style="flex:1; min-width:240px; max-width:100%; display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; box-sizing:border-box;">
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(lesson.title || '') + `" placeholder="Título da Aula (ex: Estrutura de Dados)" onchange="updateLessonTitleAndAutoSlug(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, this.value)" style="flex:2; min-width:140px; max-width:100%; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:13px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(lesson.slug || '') + `" placeholder="slug-da-aula" onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'slug', this.value)" style="flex:1; min-width:110px; max-width:100%; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            </div>
                            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                                <select onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'mobile_profile', this.value)" style="padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;" title="Perfil de Layout Mobile desta aula">
                                    <option value="drawer" ` + (mobProfile === 'drawer' ? 'selected' : '') + `>📱 Mobile: Gaveta</option>
                                    <option value="bottom_bar" ` + (mobProfile === 'bottom_bar' ? 'selected' : '') + `>📲 Mobile: Barra Fixa</option>
                                    <option value="cinema" ` + (mobProfile === 'cinema' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🎬 Mobile: Cinema 16:9</option>
                                </select>
                                <select onchange="updateLessonField(` + modIdx + `, ` + lesIdx + `, 'status', this.value)" style="padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                                    <option value="published" ` + (statusVal === 'published' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🟢 Publicada</option>

                            </div>

                            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; overflow:hidden; font-size:11px; color:#64748b; font-family:monospace;">
                                <span style="white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; max-width:100%;" title="Rota: /cursos/` + escapeHtml(computedSlug) + ` | Arquivo: ` + escapeHtml(targetFile) + `">
                                    🔗 <strong>/cursos/` + escapeHtml(computedSlug) + `</strong> &bull; 📄 ` + escapeHtml(targetFile) + `
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    lessonsList.appendChild(lesRow);
                });

                var addLessonBtn = document.createElement('button');
                addLessonBtn.type = 'button';
                addLessonBtn.className = 'btn btn-outline';
                addLessonBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 12px; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; background:transparent; align-self:flex-start; margin-top:4px;';
                addLessonBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Adicionar Aula';
                addLessonBtn.onclick = function() { addLesson(modIdx); };
                lessonsList.appendChild(addLessonBtn);

                modCard.appendChild(lessonsList);
                container.appendChild(modCard);
            });
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return String(str).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
        }

        function formatFilenameToTitle(filePath) {
            var fileName = filePath.split('/').pop().replace(/\.(php|html)$/i, '');
            var match = fileName.match(/^(\d+)[-_]+(.*)$/);
            if (match) {
                var num = match[1];
                var rest = match[2].replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(l) { return l.toUpperCase(); });
                return num + ' - ' + rest;
            }
            return fileName.replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(l) { return l.toUpperCase(); });
        }

        function formatFilenameToSlug(filePath) {
            var fileName = filePath.split('/').pop().replace(/\.(php|html)$/i, '');
            return fileName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
        }

        window.openImportFolderModal = function(modIdx) {
            document.getElementById('import_target_mod_idx').value = modIdx;
            var select = document.getElementById('import_folder_select');
            select.innerHTML = '';

            var courseSlug = '<?= htmlspecialchars((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?>';
            var defaultCourseFolder = 'pages/' + courseSlug;

            var folderKeys = Object.keys(foldersMap);
            var courseFolders = [];
            var otherFolders = [];
            var hasRootPages = false;

            folderKeys.forEach(function(folder) {
                if (folder === 'pages') {
                    hasRootPages = true;
                } else if (folder === defaultCourseFolder || folder.indexOf(defaultCourseFolder + '/') === 0) {
                    courseFolders.push(folder);
                } else {
                    otherFolders.push(folder);
                }
            });

            var hasAny = (courseFolders.length > 0 || otherFolders.length > 0 || hasRootPages);
            if (!hasAny) {
                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Nenhuma pasta de aulas encontrada em pages/</option>';
                document.getElementById('import_folder_preview').innerHTML = 'Nenhum arquivo .php encontrado na pasta pages/ do tema.';
            } else {
                var firstSelectable = null;

                // 1. Grupo prioritário: Workspace do Curso
                if (courseFolders.length > 0) {
                    var grpCourse = document.createElement('optgroup');
                    grpCourse.label = '🎯 Workspace deste Curso (' + defaultCourseFolder + '/)';
                    courseFolders.forEach(function(folder) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = folder;
                        opt.textContent = folder + '/ (' + foldersMap[folder].length + ' aulas)';
                        grpCourse.appendChild(opt);
                        if (!firstSelectable) firstSelectable = folder;
                    });
                    select.appendChild(grpCourse);
                }

                // 2. Grupo: Outras Pastas de Módulos/Cursos
                if (otherFolders.length > 0) {
                    var grpOther = document.createElement('optgroup');
                    grpOther.label = '📁 Outras Pastas de Aulas no Tema';
                    otherFolders.forEach(function(folder) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = folder;
                        opt.textContent = folder + '/ (' + foldersMap[folder].length + ' arquivos)';
                        grpOther.appendChild(opt);
                        if (!firstSelectable) firstSelectable = folder;
                    });
                    select.appendChild(grpOther);
                }

                // 3. Grupo: Raiz pages/ (Arquivos Globais)
                if (hasRootPages && foldersMap['pages'] && foldersMap['pages'].length > 0) {
                    var grpRoot = document.createElement('optgroup');
                    grpRoot.label = '⚠️ Raiz pages/ (Páginas Globais do Tema - Não Recomendado)';
                    var optRoot = document.createElement('option');
                    optRoot.value = 'pages';
                    optRoot.textContent = 'pages/ (' + foldersMap['pages'].length + ' páginas do site)';
                    grpRoot.appendChild(optRoot);
                    select.appendChild(grpRoot);
                    if (!firstSelectable) firstSelectable = 'pages';
                }

                if (firstSelectable) {
                    select.value = firstSelectable;
                }
                updateImportFolderPreview();
            }

            select.onchange = updateImportFolderPreview;
            document.getElementById('modalImportFolder').style.display = 'flex';
        };

        function updateImportFolderPreview() {
            var folder = document.getElementById('import_folder_select').value;
            var preview = document.getElementById('import_folder_preview');
            var files = foldersMap[folder] || [];
            if (files.length === 0) {
                preview.innerHTML = 'Nenhum arquivo nesta pasta.';
                return;
            }

            var html = '';
            if (folder === 'pages') {
                html += '<div style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fca5a5; font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.4;">' +
                        '⚠️ <strong>Atenção:</strong> Estes arquivos estão soltos na raiz de <code>pages/</code> e incluem páginas do site (ex: index, contato). Recomenda-se criar e importar a partir da pasta dedicada do curso: <code>pages/<?= htmlspecialchars((string)($course['slug'] ?? '')) ?>/</code>.' +
                        '</div>';
            }

            html += files.map(function(f) {
                var meta = availablePagesMeta[f] || {};
                var title = meta.title || formatFilenameToTitle(f);
                var badge = meta.has_blocks 
                    ? '<span style="font-size:10px; background:rgba(69,243,255,0.15); color:#45f3ff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600;">⚡ Blocos</span>' 
                    : '<span style="font-size:10px; background:rgba(168,85,247,0.15); color:#a855f7; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600;">🐘 PHP Puro</span>';
                return '<div style="padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">' +
                       '<span>📄 ' + escapeHtml(f) + ' &rarr; <strong style="color:#45f3ff;">' + escapeHtml(title) + '</strong></span>' +
                       badge +
                       '</div>';
            }).join('');

            preview.innerHTML = html;
        }

        window.closeImportFolderModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('modalImportFolder').style.display = 'none';
        };

        window.confirmImportFolder = function() {
            var modIdx = parseInt(document.getElementById('import_target_mod_idx').value, 10);
            var folder = document.getElementById('import_folder_select').value;
            var files = foldersMap[folder] || [];

            if (!structure[modIdx] || files.length === 0) {
                closeImportFolderModal();
                return;
            }

            if (!Array.isArray(structure[modIdx].lessons)) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons = [];
            }

            var existingSources = {};
            structure[modIdx].lessons.forEach(function(l) {
                if (l.source) existingSources[l.source] = true;
            });

            files.forEach(function(filePath) {
                if (!existingSources[filePath]) {
                    var meta = availablePagesMeta[filePath] || {};
                    var lessonTitle = meta.title || formatFilenameToTitle(filePath);
                    var lessonSlug = meta.slug || formatFilenameToSlug(filePath);
                    var mobileProfile = meta.mobile_profile || 'drawer';
                    var content = meta.blocks_json || '';

                    structure[modIdx].lessons.push({
                        title: lessonTitle,
                        slug: lessonSlug,
                        source_type: 'theme_file',
                        source: filePath,
                        content: content,
                        mobile_profile: mobileProfile,
                        status: 'published'
                    });
                }
            });

            closeImportFolderModal();
            renderModules();
        };

        window.addModule = function() {
            structure.push({
                title: 'Novo Módulo',
                folder_slug: '',
                position: structure.length + 1,
                lessons: []
            });
            renderModules();
        };

        window.removeModule = function(modIdx) {
            if (confirm('Deseja excluir este módulo e todas as suas aulas?')) {
                structure.splice(modIdx, 1);
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateModTitle = function(modIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].title = val;
            }
        };

        window.updateModFolderSlug = function(modIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].folder_slug = val ? slugifyText(val) : '';
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.addLesson = function(modIdx) {
            if (structure[modIdx]) {
                var lesCount = (structure[modIdx].lessons || []).length + 1;
                structure[modIdx].lessons.push({
                    title: 'Aula ' + lesCount,
                    slug: 'aula-' + lesCount,
                    source_type: 'content',
                    source: '',
                    content: '',
                    mobile_profile: 'drawer',
                    status: 'published'
                });
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.removeLesson = function(modIdx, lesIdx) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons.splice(lesIdx, 1);
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateLessonTitleAndAutoSlug = function(modIdx, lesIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                var les = structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx];
                les.title = val;
                var newSlug = slugifyText(val);
                if (!les.slug || /^aula-\d+$/.test(les.slug)) {
                    les.slug = newSlug;
                }
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateLessonField = function(modIdx, lesIdx, field, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx][field] = val;
                if (field === 'source' && val !== '') {
                    structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source_type = 'theme_file';
                }
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateLessonSourceType = function(modIdx, lesIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source_type = val;
                if (val === 'content') {
                    structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source = '';
                }
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.prepareStructureJson = function() {
            document.getElementById('structure_json_input').value = JSON.stringify(structure);
            return true;
        };

        renderModules();
    })();
    </script>
<?php endif; ?>

                <script>
                    function toggleNewCoursePricingMode(val) {
                        const isFree = (val === '1' || val === 1);
                        const priceBox = document.getElementById('new_box_price');
                        const instBox = document.getElementById('new_box_installments');
                        const freeNotice = document.getElementById('new_box_free_notice');
                        const payWrapper = document.getElementById('new_box_payment_options_wrapper');
                        const priceInput = document.getElementById('new_course_price');

                        if (isFree) {
                            if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'none';
                            if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'none';
                            if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'block';
                            if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'none';
                            if (priceInput) priceInput.value = '0.00';
                        } else {
                            if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'block';
                            if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'block';
                            if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'none';
                            if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'block';
                            if (priceInput && (parseFloat(priceInput.value) <= 0 || priceInput.value === '')) {
                                priceInput.value = '10.00';
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    function toggleNewCoursePlatform(val) {
                        const isExt = ['hotmart', 'eduzz', 'monetizze', 'clickbank'].includes(val);
                        const isPp = (val === 'paypal');
                        const isStripe = (val === 'stripe');

                        const idB = document.getElementById('new_box_external_product_id');
                        const urlB = document.getElementById('new_box_external_checkout_url');
                        const tipB = document.getElementById('new_box_native_tip');
                        const ppBox = document.getElementById('new_box_paypal_settings');
                        const stripeBox = document.getElementById('new_box_stripe_settings');

                        if (idB) idB.style.display = isExt ? 'block' : 'none';
                        if (urlB) urlB.style.display = isExt ? 'block' : 'none';
                        if (ppBox) ppBox.style.display = isPp ? 'block' : 'none';
                        if (stripeBox) stripeBox.style.display = isStripe ? 'block' : 'none';

                        if (tipB) {
                            tipB.style.display = isExt ? 'none' : 'block';
                            if (val === 'stripe') {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Stripe Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará via Cartão de Crédito Global / Apple Pay diretamente pelo Stripe Checkout. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            } else if (val === 'paypal') {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>PayPal Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Saldo PayPal ou Cartão Internacional via API oficial v2 do PayPal. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            } else if (val === 'mercadopago') {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Mercado Pago Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Pix Instantâneo (QR Code na tela), Cartão até 12x ou Boleto via Mercado Pago Oficial. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            } else {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Checkout Multigateway:</strong> O aluno terá na tela de compra as opções ativas: Pix Instantâneo, Mercado Pago, Stripe e PayPal. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                </script>
            </div>

                <script>
                    document.getElementById('course_new_thumbnail')?.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
                        const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
                        const previewBox = document.getElementById('course_new_thumb_preview');
                        const previewImg = document.getElementById('course_new_thumb_preview_img');
                        if (file && previewBox && previewImg) {
                            const reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = function(ev) {
                                previewImg.src = ev.target.result;
                                previewBox.style.display = 'flex';
                            };
                            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                        }
                    });
                </script>

        el.style.display = (el.style.display === 'none' || el.style.display === '') ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (target === 'lessons' && el.style.display === 'flex') {
            el.style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

        if (currentDevice === 'mobile') {
            var profile = MOBILE_PROFILES[currentMobileProfile] || MOBILE_PROFILES.standard;

            viewport.style.minHeight = '480px';

            if (homebar) homebar.style.display = 'flex';
            if (lessonTitle) lessonTitle.style.fontSize = profile.titleSize;
        } else {
            btnDesktop.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnDesktop.style.color = '#45f3ff';
            btnMobile.style.background = 'transparent';
            btnMobile.style.color = '#8c8f94';
            if (profileSelect) profileSelect.style.display = 'none';
            if (dimBadge) dimBadge.style.display = 'none';

            stage.style.maxWidth = '100%';
            stage.style.margin = '0';
            stage.style.background = 'transparent';
            stage.style.border = 'none';
            stage.style.borderRadius = '0';
            stage.style.boxShadow = 'none';

            viewport.style.padding = '8px 4px';
            viewport.style.minHeight = 'auto';
            if (statusbar) statusbar.style.display = 'none';
            if (siteHeader) siteHeader.style.display = 'none';
            if (drawerBar) drawerBar.style.display = 'none';
            if (footerZone) footerZone.style.display = 'none';
            if (homebar) homebar.style.display = 'none';

    window.setEditorViewMode = function(mode) {

        [btnEdit, btnSplit, btnPrev].forEach(function(b) {

        if (mode === 'edit') {

            colPrev.style.display = 'none';
            btnEdit.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnEdit.style.color = '#45f3ff';
        } else if (mode === 'preview') {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
            colEdit.style.display = 'none';
            colPrev.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.maxHeight = 'none';
            btnPrev.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnPrev.style.color = '#45f3ff';
        } else {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr';
            colEdit.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.maxHeight = 'calc(100vh - 115px)';
            btnSplit.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnSplit.style.color = '#45f3ff';
        }
        refreshLivePreview();
    };

    function resolveVideoEmbedHtml(rawUrl) {
        rawUrl = String(rawUrl || '').trim();
        if (!rawUrl) return '';

        var ytMatch = rawUrl.match(/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
        if (ytMatch && ytMatch[1]) {
            var ytUrl = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + ytMatch[1] + '?rel=0';
            return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);"><iframe src="' + ytUrl + '" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe></div>';
        }

        var vimeoMatch = rawUrl.match(/vimeo\.com\/(?:video\/)?(\d+)/);
        if (vimeoMatch && vimeoMatch[1]) {
            var vmUrl = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' + vimeoMatch[1];
            return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);"><iframe src="' + vmUrl + '" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe></div>';
        }

        if (/\.(mp4|webm|ogg)(\?.*)?$/i.test(rawUrl)) {
            return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000;"><video controls style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;"><source src="' + escapeHtml(rawUrl) + '"></video></div>';
        }

        return '';
    }

    window.refreshLivePreview = function() {
        var titleInput = document.getElementById('lesson_title_input');
        var previewTitle = document.getElementById('live_preview_lesson_title');
        if (titleInput && previewTitle) {
            previewTitle.textContent = titleInput.value || 'Aula sem título';
        }

        var previewBody = document.getElementById('live_preview_body');
        if (!previewBody) return;

        if (!blocks || blocks.length === 0) {
            previewBody.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#64748b; text-align:center; padding:30px 0;">Adicione blocos à esquerda para visualizar a aula aqui em tempo real.</p>';
            return;
        }

        var isMobile = (currentDevice === 'mobile');
        var mProfile = MOBILE_PROFILES[currentMobileProfile] || MOBILE_PROFILES.standard;
        var bodyFontSize = isMobile ? mProfile.fontSize : '1.03rem';
        var hSizes = isMobile ? mProfile.hSizes : {1: '2rem', 2: '1.6rem', 3: '1.3rem', 4: '1.1rem'};

        var htmlParts = [];
        blocks.forEach(function(b) {
            var d = b.data || {};
            switch(b.type) {
                case 'header':
                    var lvl = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, parseInt(d.level || 2)));
                    htmlParts.push('<h' + lvl + ' style="color:#fff; font-size:' + (hSizes[lvl] || '1.4rem') + '; font-weight:800; margin:1.4rem 0 0.7rem 0; line-height:1.3;">' + escapeHtml(d.text || '') + '</h' + lvl + '>');
                    break;

                case 'paragraph':
                    var pText = escapeHtml(d.text || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
                    htmlParts.push('<p style="margin:0 0 1.1rem 0; line-height:1.75; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + '; word-break:break-word;">' + pText + '</p>');
                    break;

                case 'video':
                    var vUrl = d.url || d.source || '';
                    var vCap = d.caption || '';
                    var embed = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(vUrl);
                    if (embed) {
                        htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.3rem 0;">' + embed + (vCap ? '<div style="margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:#8c8f94; text-align:center;">' + escapeHtml(vCap) + '</div>' : '') + '</div>');
                    } else if (vUrl) {
                        htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.1rem 0; padding:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; word-break:break-all;">🔗 Vídeo: ' + escapeHtml(vUrl) + '</div>');
                    }
                    break;

                case 'code':
                    var lang = (d.language || 'code').toUpperCase();
                    var codePad = isMobile ? '12px' : '16px';
                    var codeFont = isMobile ? '0.8rem' : '0.9rem';
                    htmlParts.push(
                        '<div style="margin:1.3rem 0; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#0d1117; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);">' +
                            '<div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding:6px 12px; font-size:0.72rem; font-family:monospace; color:#45f3ff; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">' + escapeHtml(lang) + '</div>' +
                            '<pre style="margin:0; padding:' + codePad + '; overflow-x:auto; font-family:Consolas,Monaco,monospace; font-size:' + codeFont + '; line-height:1.55; color:#e6edf3;"><code>' + escapeHtml(d.code || '') + '</code></pre>' +
                        '</div>'
                    );
                    break;

                case 'callout':
                    var ctype = d.type || 'info';
                    var styles = {
                        info: { border: '#45f3ff', bg: 'rgba(69,243,255,0.07)', icon: '💡' },
                        success: { border: '#00d284', bg: 'rgba(0,210,132,0.08)', icon: '✅' },
                        warning: { border: '#f5a623', bg: 'rgba(245,166,35,0.08)', icon: '⚠️' },
                        danger: { border: '#e06c75', bg: 'rgba(224,108,117,0.08)', icon: '🛑' }
                    };
                    var st = styles[ctype] || styles.info;
                    var calloutPad = isMobile ? '12px 14px' : '16px 20px';
                    htmlParts.push(
                        '<div style="margin:1.2rem 0; padding:' + calloutPad + '; border-left:4px solid ' + st.border + '; background:' + st.bg + '; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + ';">' +
                            '<span style="font-size:1.1rem;">' + st.icon + '</span>' +
                            '<div style="color:#fff; line-height:1.6; flex:1; word-break:break-word;">' + escapeHtml(d.text || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</div>' +
                        '</div>'
                    );
                    break;

                case 'list':
                    var items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
                    var tag = (d.style === 'ordered') ? 'ol' : 'ul';
                    var lis = items.map(function(it) {
                        var txt = typeof it === 'string' ? it : (it.content || '');
                        return '<li style="margin-bottom:6px;">' + escapeHtml(txt) + '</li>';
                    }).join('');
                    htmlParts.push('<' + tag + ' style="margin:0 0 1.2rem 1.25rem; color:#c5c6c7; line-height:1.7; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + ';">' + lis + '</' + tag + '>');
                    break;

                case 'image':
                    var iUrl = d.url || (d.file ? d.file.url : '') || '';
                    var iCap = d.caption || '';
                    if (iUrl) {
                        htmlParts.push(
                            '<figure style="margin:1.4rem 0; text-align:center;">' +
                                '<img src="' + escapeHtml(iUrl) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(iCap) + '" style="max-width:100%; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">' +
                                (iCap ? '<figcaption style="margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:#8c8f94;">' + escapeHtml(iCap) + '</figcaption>' : '') +
                            '</figure>'
                        );
                    }
                    break;

                case 'pdf':
                case 'pdf_viewer':
                    var pdfUrl = String(d.url || d.source || '').trim();
                    var pdfTitle = d.title || 'Documento PDF da Aula';
                    var pdfCap = d.caption || '';
                    var pdfMode = d.mode || 'pdfjs_canvas';
                    var startPg = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.start_page || 1, 10));
                    var endPg = Math.max(0, parseInt(d.end_page || 0, 10));
                    var pdfHeight = isMobile ? '360px' : (d.height || '520px');
                    var allowDl = (d.allow_download === undefined || d.allow_download === true || d.allow_download === 1 || d.allow_download === '1');
                    var rangeText = endPg > 0 ? ('Págs. ' + startPg + '–' + endPg) : ('Pág. inicial ' + startPg);
                    var modeLabel = pdfMode === 'card_modal' ? 'Cartão Expansível' : (pdfMode === 'native_embed' ? 'Iframe Nativo' : 'PDF.js Lazy Canvas');

                    if (pdfUrl) {
                        if (pdfUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf('<iframe') !== -1) {
                            var srcM = pdfUrl.match(/\bsrc=["']([^"']+)["']/i);
                            if (srcM && srcM[1]) {
                                pdfUrl = srcM[1].replace(/&amp;/g, '&');
                            }
                        }
                        var previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl;
                        var gdMatch = pdfUrl.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i) || pdfUrl.match(/drive\.google\.com\/(?:open|uc)\?(?:[^#]*&)?id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
                        var odMatch = pdfUrl.match(/onedrive\.live\.com\/(?:view\.aspx|redir)\?(.+)$/i);
                        if (gdMatch && gdMatch[1]) {
                            previewFrameUrl = 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' + gdMatch[1] + '/preview';
                        } else if (/onedrive\.live\.com\/embed/i.test(pdfUrl) || /1drv\.ms\//i.test(pdfUrl)) {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl;
                        } else if (odMatch && odMatch[1]) {
                            previewFrameUrl = 'https://onedrive.live.com/embed?' + odMatch[1];
                        } else if (/\.sharepoint\.com\//i.test(pdfUrl)) {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl;
                            if (previewFrameUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf('action=embedview') === -1 && previewFrameUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf('/embed') === -1) {
                                previewFrameUrl += (previewFrameUrl.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'action=embedview';
                            }
                        } else if (/dropbox\.com\//i.test(pdfUrl)) {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl.replace(/([?&])dl=0\b/i, '$1raw=1');
                            if (previewFrameUrl.indexOf('raw=1') === -1) {
                                previewFrameUrl += (previewFrameUrl.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'raw=1';
                            }
                        } else {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl + (pdfUrl.indexOf('#') !== -1 ? '&' : '#') + 'page=' + startPg + '&zoom=page-width' + (!allowDl ? '&toolbar=0&navpanes=0' : '');
                        }
                        htmlParts.push(
                            '<figure style="margin:1.4rem 0; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; background:#0b0e14; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.28); box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);">' +
                                '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px; background:#141920; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">' +
                                    '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-width:0;">' +
                                        '<span>📄</span>' +
                                        '<strong style="color:#fff; font-size:0.86rem; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">' + escapeHtml(pdfTitle) + '</strong>' +
                                        '<span style="background:rgba(69,243,255,0.14); color:#45f3ff; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); padding:1px 7px; border-radius:10px; font-size:10px; font-weight:700;">' + escapeHtml(rangeText) + '</span>' +
                                    '</div>' +
                                    '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:10px; color:#94a3b8;">' +
                                        '<span style="padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">' + escapeHtml(modeLabel) + '</span>' +
                                        (allowDl ? '<a href="' + escapeHtml(pdfUrl) + '" target="_blank" style="color:#45f3ff; text-decoration:none; font-weight:700;">⬇ Abrir/Baixar</a>' : '<span style="color:#f5a623;">🔒 Download Bloqueado</span>') +
                                    '</div>' +
                                '</div>' +
                                (pdfMode === 'card_modal'
                                    ? '<div style="padding:22px; text-align:center; background:#12161f; color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">🗂️ Modo Cartão Compacto: o aluno verá o botão <strong>"📖 Abrir Leitor Online"</strong> para expandir o PDF sob demanda.</div>'
                                    : '<div style="width:100%; height:' + escapeHtml(pdfHeight) + '; background:#161922;"><iframe src="' + escapeHtml(previewFrameUrl) + '" style="width:100%; height:100%; border:0; display:block;" loading="lazy"></iframe></div>'
                                ) +
                                (pdfCap ? '<figcaption style="padding:8px 12px; font-size:0.78rem; color:#8c8f94; text-align:center; background:#0b0e14;">' + escapeHtml(pdfCap) + '</figcaption>' : '') +
                            '</figure>'
                        );
                    } else {
                        htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.2rem 0; padding:16px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.35); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; text-align:center;">📄 Informe a URL (Nuvem / CDN / Google Drive) ou envie um arquivo PDF local para pré-visualizar o leitor aqui.</div>');
                    }
                    break;

                case 'delimiter':
                    htmlParts.push('<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2); margin:1.6rem 0;">');
                    break;
            }
        });

        previewBody.innerHTML = htmlParts.join('');
    };

    function renderCanvas() {
        var container = document.getElementById('blocks_canvas');
        container.innerHTML = '';

        if (blocks.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:30px; text-align:center; color:#8c8f94; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:6px;">Nenhum bloco ainda. Clique nos botões abaixo para começar a estruturar sua aula.</div>';
            refreshLivePreview();
            return;
        }

        blocks.forEach(function(b, idx) {
            var card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'ds-block-card';

            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding-bottom:8px;';
            
            var badgeTitle = getBlockBadge(b.type);
            header.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                    <span style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px;">` + badgeTitle + `</span>
                    <span style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">#` + (idx + 1) + `</span>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="moveBlock(` + idx + `, -1)" title="Mover para Cima">▲</button>
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="moveBlock(` + idx + `, 1)" title="Mover para Baixo">▼</button>
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="duplicateBlock(` + idx + `)" title="Duplicar">📋</button>
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="removeBlock(` + idx + `)" style="color:#e06c75;" title="Excluir Bloco">✕</button>
                </div>
            `;
            card.appendChild(header);

            var body = document.createElement('div');
            body.innerHTML = renderBlockInputs(b, idx);
            card.appendChild(body);

            container.appendChild(card);
        });

        refreshLivePreview();
    }

    function getBlockBadge(type) {
        switch(type) {
            case 'header': return '📌 Título';
            case 'paragraph': return '📝 Parágrafo';
            case 'video': return '🎬 Vídeo Embed (16:9)';
            case 'code': return '💻 Bloco de Código';
            case 'callout': return '💡 Dica / Alerta';
            case 'list': return '📋 Lista';
            case 'image': return '🖼️ Imagem';
            case 'pdf':
            case 'pdf_viewer': return '📄 Leitor de PDF (Nuvem / Local)';
            case 'delimiter': return '➖ Divisor';
            default: return 'Bloco';
        }
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

    function notifyEditor(message, type) {
        type = type || 'info';
        if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
            window.OS.notify(message, type);
            return;
        }
        var container = document.getElementById('ds-editor-toast-fallback');
        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement('div');
            container.id = 'ds-editor-toast-fallback';
            container.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:20px; right:20px; z-index:99999; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }
        var color = type === 'success' ? '#10b981' : (type === 'error' ? '#ef4444' : (type === 'warning' ? '#f59e0b' : '#3b82f6'));
        var icon = type === 'success' ? '✅' : (type === 'error' ? '🚨' : (type === 'warning' ? '⚠️' : 'ℹ️'));
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.style.cssText = 'background:#0f172a; color:#f8fafc; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); font-weight:600; font-size:13.5px; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; border:1px solid #334155; border-left:5px solid ' + color + '; max-width:430px; line-height:1.45;';
        toast.innerHTML = '<span>' + icon + '</span><span style="flex:1;">' + escapeHtml(message) + '</span>';
        container.appendChild(toast);
        setTimeout(function() { if (toast.parentElement) toast.remove(); }, type === 'error' ? 10000 : 4500);
    }

    function parseJsonResponse(res) {
        return res.text().then(function(rawText) {
            var trimmed = String(rawText || '').trim();
            if (!trimmed) {
                return { success: false, message: 'Resposta vazia do servidor (HTTP ' + res.status + ').' };
            }
            try {
                return JSON.parse(trimmed);
            } catch (e) {
                if (/POST Content-Length of (\d+) bytes exceeds the limit of (\d+) bytes/i.test(trimmed)) {
                    var m = trimmed.match(/POST Content-Length of (\d+) bytes exceeds the limit of (\d+) bytes/i);
                    var sentMb = (parseInt(m[1], 10) / 1048576).toFixed(1);
                    var limitMb = (parseInt(m[2], 10) / 1048576).toFixed(1);
                    return {
                        success: false,
                        message: 'O arquivo enviado (' + sentMb + ' MB) excede o limite do servidor PHP (' + limitMb + ' MB). Use um PDF menor ou hospede na nuvem.'
                    };
                }
                var jsonStart = trimmed.indexOf('{');
                var jsonEnd = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
                if (jsonStart !== -1 && jsonEnd > jsonStart) {
                    try {
                        return JSON.parse(trimmed.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd + 1));
                    } catch (innerErr) {}
                }
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'O servidor retornou uma resposta inesperada (HTTP ' + res.status + ').'
                };
            }
        });
    }
