    window.addBlock = function(type) {
        var newBlock = {
            id: 'b_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
            type: type,
            data: {}
        };

        switch(type) {
            case 'header': newBlock.data = { level: 2, text: '' }; break;
            case 'paragraph': newBlock.data = { text: '' }; break;
            case 'video': newBlock.data = { url: '', caption: '' }; break;
            case 'code': newBlock.data = { language: 'php', code: '' }; break;
            case 'callout': newBlock.data = { type: 'info', text: '' }; break;
            case 'list': newBlock.data = { style: 'unordered', items: [] }; break;
            case 'image': newBlock.data = { url: '', caption: '' }; break;
            case 'pdf': newBlock.data = { url: '', title: 'Material Complementar (PDF)', mode: 'pdfjs_canvas', start_page: 1, end_page: 0, height: '620px', allow_download: true, caption: '' }; break;
            case 'delimiter': newBlock.data = {}; break;
        }

        blocks.push(newBlock);
        renderCanvas();
    };

    window.removeBlock = function(idx) {
        if (confirm('Deseja excluir este bloco?')) {
            blocks.splice(idx, 1);
            renderCanvas();
        }
    };

    window.moveBlock = function(idx, dir) {
        var target = idx + dir;
        if (target >= 0 && target < blocks.length) {
            var item = blocks.splice(idx, 1)[0];
            blocks.splice(target, 0, item);
            renderCanvas();
        }
    };

    window.duplicateBlock = function(idx) {
        var item = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(blocks[idx]));
        item.id = 'b_' + Date.now();
        blocks.splice(idx + 1, 0, item);
        renderCanvas();
    };

    window.updateBlockData = function(idx, key, val) {
        if (blocks[idx]) {
            if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
            blocks[idx].data[key] = val;
            refreshLivePreview();
        }
    };

    window.updateVideoBlockUrl = function(idx, val) {
        if (blocks[idx]) {
            if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
            blocks[idx].data.url = val;
            var inlineBox = document.getElementById('inline_video_preview_' + idx);
            if (inlineBox) {
                inlineBox.innerHTML = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(val);
            }
            refreshLivePreview();
        }
    };

    window.updateListItems = function(idx, text) {
        if (blocks[idx]) {
            var lines = text.split("\n").map(function(s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });
            blocks[idx].data.items = lines;
            refreshLivePreview();
        }
    };

    window.uploadLessonPdfFile = function(idx, fileInput) {
        if (!fileInput || !fileInput.files || !fileInput.files[0]) return;
        var file = fileInput.files[0];

        var maxBytes = 128 * 1024 * 1024;
        if (file.size > maxBytes) {
            var fileMb = (file.size / 1048576).toFixed(1);
            notifyEditor('O arquivo PDF (' + fileMb + ' MB) excede o limite máximo de 128 MB para upload local. Para arquivos maiores, utilize uma URL na nuvem.', 'warning');
            fileInput.value = '';
            return;
        }

        var labelSpan = document.getElementById('pdf_upload_label_' + idx);
        var originalText = labelSpan ? labelSpan.textContent : '📤 Enviar PDF Local';
        if (labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = '⏳ Enviando...';

        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('csrf_token', csrfToken);
        formData.append('pdf', file);

        fetch(baseUrl + '/admin/academy/lessons/' + lessonId + '/upload-pdf', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken,
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            },
            body: formData
        })
        .then(parseJsonResponse)
        .then(function(data) {
            if (labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = originalText;
            fileInput.value = '';
            if (data && data.success && data.url) {
                if (blocks[idx]) {
                    if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
                    blocks[idx].data.url = data.url;
                    if (!blocks[idx].data.title || blocks[idx].data.title === 'Material Complementar (PDF)') {
                        blocks[idx].data.title = file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, '');
                    }
                    renderCanvas();
                }
                notifyEditor(data.message || 'Arquivo PDF enviado com sucesso!', 'success');
            } else {
                notifyEditor((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Erro ao enviar o arquivo PDF.', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            if (labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = originalText;
            fileInput.value = '';
            notifyEditor('Falha na comunicação durante o envio do PDF: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err), 'error');
        });
    };

    window.saveLessonBlocks = function() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_save_lesson');
        var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_save_text');
        var indicator = document.getElementById('save_indicator');
        var title = document.getElementById('lesson_title_input').value;
        var status = document.getElementById('lesson_status_select').value;
        var mobileProfileEl = document.getElementById('lesson_mobile_layout_profile');
        var mobileProfile = mobileProfileEl ? mobileProfileEl.value : 'drawer';
        var fabEl = document.getElementById('fabricate_php_checkbox');
        var fabricatePhp = fabEl ? fabEl.checked : false;

        btn.disabled = true;
        btnText.textContent = 'Salvando...';

        var payload = {
            csrf_token: csrfToken,
            title: title,
            status: status,
            mobile_profile: mobileProfile,
            fabricate_php: fabricatePhp,
            blocks: blocks
        };

        fetch(baseUrl + '/admin/academy/lessons/' + lessonId + '/update-content', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken,
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        })
        .then(parseJsonResponse)
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btnText.textContent = 'Salvar Aula';
            if (data && data.success) {
                indicator.style.display = 'inline';
                setTimeout(function() { indicator.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
                notifyEditor(data.message || 'Aula salva com sucesso!', 'success');
            } else {
                notifyEditor((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Erro ao salvar aula.', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btnText.textContent = 'Salvar Aula';
            notifyEditor('Erro na comunicação com o servidor: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err), 'error');
        });
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 's') {
            e.preventDefault();
            saveLessonBlocks();
        }
    });

    renderCanvas();
})();
</script>

 */
?>
<div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 15px;">
    <div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
            <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy" style="color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">

<script>
function openEnrollModal(studentId, studentName) {
    document.getElementById('modalEnrollStudentName').textContent = studentName;
    document.getElementById('formEnroll').action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/students/' + studentId + '/enroll';
    document.getElementById('modalEnroll').style.display = 'flex';
}

function openStatusModal(studentId, studentName, currentStatus) {
    document.getElementById('modalStatusStudentName').textContent = studentName;
    document.getElementById('modalStatusSelect').value = currentStatus;
    document.getElementById('formStatus').action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/students/' + studentId + '/status';
    document.getElementById('modalStatus').style.display = 'flex';
}

function openPasswordModal(studentId, studentName) {
    document.getElementById('modalPasswordStudentName').textContent = studentName;
    document.getElementById('inputNewPassword').value = '';
    document.getElementById('formPassword').action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/students/' + studentId + '/reset-password';
    document.getElementById('modalPassword').style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeModal(modalId) {
    const el = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
}

// Fechar ao clicar fora
window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    ['modalEnroll', 'modalStatus', 'modalPassword'].forEach(id => {
        const modal = document.getElementById(id);
        if (modal && e.target === modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
});
</script>

$isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? false : (isset($course['is_free']) ? (bool)$course['is_free'] : true);

    ? (int)$course['max_installments']
    : 12;

if (!empty($thumb)) {
    if (str_starts_with($thumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'data:')) {
        $thumbUrl = $thumb;
    } else {
        $thumbUrl = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($thumb, '/');
    }
} else {
    $thumbUrl = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="360" viewBox="0 0 640 360"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="%23141a23"/><text x="50%" y="50%" fill="%2345f3ff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">🎓 ' . rawurlencode((string)$title) . '</text></svg>';
}
?>
<section class='ds-academy-course-overview' style='padding: 60px 20px; min-height: 75vh;'>
    <div class='container' style='max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto;'>

            <div class='ds-course-hero-grid' style='display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.95fr; gap: 36px; align-items: center;'>
                <!-- Coluna de Apresentação e Ação -->
                <div>
                    <div style='display: inline-block; background: rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.1); color: var(--primary, #45f3ff); padding: 0.35rem 1rem; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.25); margin-bottom: 14px;'>
                        Curso Academy
                    </div>

                    <h1 style='color: #fff; font-size: 2.3rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 14px;'><?= $title ?></h1>
                    <p style='color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 24px;'><?= $desc ?></p>
                    
                    <div style='margin-top: 10px;'>
                        <?= $ctaButton ?>

                </div>

                <!-- Coluna do Card Visual com Capa e Precificação -->
                <div style='background: #090d14; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);'>
                    <div style='position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #000; overflow: hidden;'>
                        <img src='<?= htmlspecialchars($thumbUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?>' alt='<?= htmlspecialchars((string)$title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?>' style='width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;'>
                    </div>
                    <div style='padding: 22px;'>
                        <?php if ($isFree && $price <= 0.0): ?>
                            <div style='display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;'>
                                <span style='background: rgba(40,167,69,0.15); color: #2ecc71; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);'>
                                    ACESSO GRATUITO
                                </span>

                                <div style='font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #00d284;'>
                                    R$ <?= number_format($price, 2, ',', '.') ?>
                                </div>

                                        em até <strong style='color: #45f3ff;'><?= $maxInstallments ?>x de R$ <?= number_format($instVal, 2, ',', '.') ?></strong>

<div id="ds-student-notes-drawer" style="display:none; position:fixed; top:0; right:0; bottom:0; width:440px; max-width:92vw; background:#0b0e14; border-left:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); z-index:1510; box-shadow:-10px 0 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); flex-direction:column; padding:24px; box-sizing:border-box;">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:16px;">
        <h3 style="color:#fff; margin:0; font-size:1.15rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
            <span>📝</span> Minhas Anotações
        </h3>
        <button type="button" onclick="window.toggleStudentNotes(false)" style="background:none; border:none; color:#94a3b8; font-size:1.3rem; cursor:pointer;" aria-label="Fechar">✕</button>
    </div>
    <p style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:0.82rem; margin:0 0 14px 0; line-height:1.5;">
        Suas anotações são pessoais, salvas automaticamente em seu armazenamento isolado e privado.
    </p>
    <textarea id="ds-student-notes-textarea" placeholder="Digite aqui suas observações, dúvidas e códigos desta aula..." style="flex:1; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:#121824; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius:8px; padding:14px; color:#fff; font-size:0.9rem; font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; resize:none; line-height:1.6;"></textarea>
    <div style="margin-top:14px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
        <span id="ds-notes-status" style="font-size:0.8rem; color:#64748b;">Pronto</span>
        <button type="button" id="ds-btn-save-notes" onclick="window.saveStudentNotes()" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00d284, #00b370); color:#000; border:none; padding:10px 20px; border-radius:6px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.88rem; cursor:pointer;">
            💾 Salvar Anotação
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    var dsLessonId = <?= (int)($lessonId ?? 0) ?>;
    var dsCsrfToken = <?= json_encode((string)($csrfToken ?? '')) ?>;
    var dsBaseUrl = <?= json_encode((defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '')) ?>;
    var dsNotesLoaded = false;

    window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer = function(open) {
        var sidebar = document.getElementById('ds-academy-sidebar');
        var backdrop = document.getElementById('ds-academy-drawer-backdrop');
        if (!sidebar || !backdrop) return;
        if (open) {
            sidebar.classList.add('is-open');
            backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        } else {
            sidebar.classList.remove('is-open');
            backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
    };

    window.toggleStudentNotes = function(open) {
        var drawer = document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-drawer');
        var backdrop = document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-backdrop');
        if (!drawer || !backdrop) return;
        if (open) {
            drawer.style.display = 'flex';
            backdrop.style.display = 'block';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

            if (!dsNotesLoaded && dsLessonId > 0) {
                document.getElementById('ds-notes-status').textContent = 'Carregando anotações...';
                fetch(dsBaseUrl + '/aluno/aulas/' + dsLessonId + '/notes', {
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
                })
                .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
                .then(function(data) {
                    if (data && data.success) {
                        document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-textarea').value = data.content || '';
                        document.getElementById('ds-notes-status').textContent = 'Anotações carregadas.';
                        dsNotesLoaded = true;
                    }
                })
                .catch(function() {
                    document.getElementById('ds-notes-status').textContent = 'Nova anotação.';
                });
            }
        } else {
            drawer.style.display = 'none';
            backdrop.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
    };

    window.saveStudentNotes = function() {
        if (dsLessonId <= 0) return;
        var btn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-save-notes');
        var status = document.getElementById('ds-notes-status');
        var content = document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-textarea').value;

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Salvando...';
        status.textContent = 'Salvando no seu workspace privado...';

        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('content', content);
        fd.append('csrf_token', dsCsrfToken);

        fetch(dsBaseUrl + '/aluno/aulas/' + dsLessonId + '/notes', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': dsCsrfToken },
            body: fd
        })
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar Anotação';
            if (data && data.success) {
                status.textContent = '✓ Anotação salva com sucesso!';
                setTimeout(function() { status.textContent = 'Pronto'; }, 3000);
            } else {
                status.textContent = 'Erro ao salvar anotação.';
            }
        })
        .catch(function() {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar Anotação';
            status.textContent = 'Erro de conexão.';
        });
    };

    window.toggleLessonComplete = function() {
        if (dsLessonId <= 0) return;
        var btn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-toggle-complete');
        var icon = document.getElementById('ds-complete-icon');
        var text = document.getElementById('ds-complete-text');

        btn.style.opacity = '0.6';

        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('csrf_token', dsCsrfToken);

        fetch(dsBaseUrl + '/aluno/aulas/' + dsLessonId + '/toggle-complete', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': dsCsrfToken },
            body: fd
        })
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.style.opacity = '1';
            if (data && data.success) {
                if (data.completed) {
                    btn.classList.add('is-completed');
                    icon.textContent = '✓';
                    text.textContent = 'Aula Concluída';
                } else {
                    btn.classList.remove('is-completed');
                    icon.textContent = '○';
                    text.textContent = 'Marcar como Concluída';
                }
            }
        })
        .catch(function() {
            btn.style.opacity = '1';
        });
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer(false);
            window.toggleStudentNotes(false);
        }
    });
</script>

<style>
    .ds-btn-complete {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        color: #cbd5e1;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);

    .ds-btn-complete:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);

    }

    .ds-academy-mobile-bar {
        display: none;

    }
    .ds-academy-bottom-action-bar {
        display: none;
    }
    .ds-academy-drawer-toggle {
        width: 100%;

    <script>
        function togglePassVisibility(inputId, btn) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            if (!input) return;
            const isPassword = input.type === 'password';
            input.type = isPassword ? 'text' : 'password';
            const icon = btn.querySelector('.ds-eye-icon');
            if (icon) {
                icon.textContent = isPassword ? '🙈' : '👁️';
            }
            btn.title = isPassword ? 'Ocultar senha' : 'Ver senha';
            btn.setAttribute('aria-label', isPassword ? 'Ocultar senha' : 'Ver senha');
            btn.style.color = isPassword ? '#00d284' : '#94a3b8';
        }

        // Sugestão automática de username a partir do Nome Completo
        const nameInput = document.getElementById('student-name');
        const usernameInput = document.getElementById('student-username');
        let usernameManuallyEdited = false;

        if (usernameInput) {
            usernameInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
                usernameManuallyEdited = this.value.trim().length > 0;
            });
        }

        if (nameInput && usernameInput) {
            nameInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
                if (!usernameManuallyEdited) {
                    const clean = this.value
                        .normalize('NFD')
                        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
                    usernameInput.value = clean;
                }
            });
        }
    </script>

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/analytics/Controllers/TrackerController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;

class TrackerController
{
    private \PDO $db;

    public function __construct(\DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection $connection)
    {
        $this->db = $connection->getPdo();
    }

    public function track(Request $request)
    {
        // Pega corpo JSON
        $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        
        $type = $input['type'] ?? 'unknown';
        $source = $input['source'] ?? 'unknown';
        
        // Hash de sessão simples (IP + UserAgent) para filtrar views únicos
        $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
        $ua = $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? '';
        $hash = hash('sha256', $ip . $ua . date('Y-m-d')); // Único por dia
        
        try {
            
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO analytics_events (event_type, event_source, session_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
            $stmt->execute([$type, $source, $hash]);
            
            return Response::json(['status' => 'ok']);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return Response::json(['error' => $e->getMessage()], 500);
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/analytics/Plugin.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.dashboard.widgets');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('dashboard.register_widgets');
        $os->listenHook('seo.after_render');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // 1. Injeta o tracker no final do HTML
        $runtime->onHook('seo.after_render', function(string &$html) {
            $trackerScript = "
            <script>
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                // Registrar visualização de página
                fetch('" . BASE_URL . "/api/analytics/track', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'pageview', source: window.location.pathname })
                });

                // Registrar cliques em botões trackeados
                document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(function(btn) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                        let sourceName = this.getAttribute('data-track');
                        fetch('" . BASE_URL . "/api/analytics/track', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'click', source: sourceName })
                        });
                    });
                });
            });
            </script>";
            
            // Injeta antes de fechar o body
            $html = str_replace('</body>', $trackerScript . "\n</body>", $html);
        });

        // 2. Registrar rota da API
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/api/analytics/track', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Controllers\TrackerController::class, 'track']);
        });

        // 3. Adicionar Widgets no Dashboard
        try {
            
            $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db')->getPdo();
            $runtime->onHook('dashboard.register_widgets', function($registry) use ($db) {
                $registry->registerProvider(new \DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Widgets\AnalyticsWidgetProvider($db));
            });
        } catch (\Exception $e) {}
    }

    public function activate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        try {
            $schema = $runtime->getLink('core.db.schema');
            $schema->create('analytics_events', function ($table) {
                $table->id();
                $table->string('event_type', 50); // pageview, click
                $table->string('event_source', 100); // url or button name
                $table->string('session_hash', 64); // to count unique visitors
                $table->datetime('created_at')->default('CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');
            });
        } catch (\Exception $e) {}
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/analytics/Widgets/AnalyticsWidgetProvider.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Widgets;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DashboardWidgetProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;

class AnalyticsWidgetProvider implements DashboardWidgetProviderInterface
{
    private \PDO $db;

    public function __construct(\PDO $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function getProviderName(): string
    {
        return "RachidD Analytics (Monitor)";
    }

    public function getAvailableWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            'anl_pageviews_month' => [
                'title' => 'Visitas no Mês',
                'description' => 'Acessos únicos e totais no mês atual.'
            ],
            'anl_clicks_month' => [
                'title' => 'Cliques de Conversão',
                'description' => 'Acessos a botões de venda e WhatsApp.'
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function renderWidget(string $widgetId): string
    {
        try {
            $startOfMonth = date('Y-m-01 00:00:00');
            $endOfMonth = date('Y-m-t 23:59:59');

            if ($widgetId === 'anl_pageviews_month') {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(DISTINCT session_hash) as unique_visits FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type = 'pageview' AND created_at BETWEEN ? AND ?");
                $stmt->execute([$startOfMonth, $endOfMonth]);
                $row = $stmt->fetch();
                $total = $row['total'] ?? 0;
                $unique = $row['unique_visits'] ?? 0;

                return "
                <div style='text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%;'>
                    <h1 style='font-size: 46px; margin: 0; color: var(--accent-blue);'>{$total}</h1>
                    <p style='color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 5px;'>Visualizações Totais</p>
                    
                    <div style='margin-top: 15px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;'>
                        <span style='font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--accent-green);'>{$unique}</span>
                        <span style='font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);'> Visitantes Únicos</span>
                    </div>
                </div>";
            }

            if ($widgetId === 'anl_clicks_month') {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT event_source, COUNT(*) as cliq FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type = 'click' AND created_at BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY event_source ORDER BY cliq DESC LIMIT 5");
                $stmt->execute([$startOfMonth, $endOfMonth]);
                $clicks = $stmt->fetchAll();

                $html = "<ul style='list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;'>";
                
                if (empty($clicks)) {
                    $html .= "<li style='color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 20px;'>Nenhum clique registrado ainda.</li>";
                } else {
                    foreach ($clicks as $c) {
                        $source = htmlspecialchars($c['event_source']);
                        $qtd = $c['cliq'];
                        
                        $iconColor = 'var(--text-muted)';
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($source), 'amazon')) $iconColor = '#FF9900';
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($source), 'hotmart')) $iconColor = '#F04E23';
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($source), 'whatsapp')) $iconColor = '#25D366';

                        $html .= "
                        <li style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 8px;'>
                            <span style='display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px;'>
                                <span style='display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: {$iconColor};'></span>
                                {$source}
                            </span>
                            <span style='font-weight: bold; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 11px;'>{$qtd}</span>
                        </li>";
                    }
                }
                $html .= "</ul>";
                return $html;
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return "<div>Erro no DB: " . $e->getMessage() . "</div>";
        }
        return "";
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/clock_widget/ClockWidgetProvider.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\clock_widget;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DashboardWidgetProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\IdentityManager;

class ClockWidgetProvider implements DashboardWidgetProviderInterface
{
    private IdentityManager $identity;

    public function __construct(IdentityManager $identity)
    {
        $this->identity = $identity;
    }

    public function getProviderName(): string
    {
        return 'App Relógio Mundial';
    }

    public function getAvailableWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            'world_clock' => [
                'title' => 'Relógio Mundial Seguro',
                'description' => 'Exibe o horário mundial protegido por ACL'
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function renderWidget(string $widgetId): string
    {
        if ($widgetId !== 'world_clock') {
            return '';
        }

        $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0;
        
        if ($this->identity->userCan($userId, 'clock.view')) {
            $html = '<div id="clock-widget-container" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #0f172a); color: #10b981; padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-family: monospace; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">';
            
            // Combobox (Select) for Timezones
            $html .= '<div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">';
            $html .= '<select id="clock-timezone-select" style="background: #0f172a; color: #10b981; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; outline: none; cursor: pointer;">';
            $html .= '<option value="system">Relógio Local (Sistema)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="America/Sao_Paulo">Brasil (Brasília)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="America/New_York">EUA (Nova Iorque)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="Europe/London">Reino Unido (Londres)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="Asia/Tokyo">Japão (Tóquio)</option>';
            $html .= '</select>';
            $html .= '</div>';

            $html .= '<div style="font-size: 28px;">';
            $html .= '<i class="far fa-clock" style="color: #4ade80; margin-right: 10px;"></i>';
            $html .= '<span id="live-clock-text">--:--:--</span>';
            $html .= '</div>';
            
            $html .= '<div style="font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 10px;">Protegido por ACL (clock.view)</div>';
            $html .= '</div>';
            
            // The magic to make it ALIVE (Client-side JS)
            $html .= '<script>
                (function() {
                    let el = document.getElementById("live-clock-text");
                    let select = document.getElementById("clock-timezone-select");
                    if(el && select) {
                        setInterval(() => {
                            let now = new Date();
                            let tz = select.value;
                            
                            let options = { hour12: false };
                            if (tz !== "system") {
                                options.timeZone = tz;
                            }
                            
                            try {
                                el.innerHTML = now.toLocaleTimeString("pt-BR", options);
                            } catch (e) {
                                el.innerHTML = "Erro de Fuso";
                            }
                        }, 1000);
                    }
                })();
            </script>';
            
            return $html;
        }

        $html = '<div style="background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; padding: 15px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #f87171;">';
        $html .= '<i class="fas fa-lock"></i> Você não tem o Privilégio (Capability) <strong>clock.view</strong> para ver as horas.';
        $html .= '</div>';
        return $html;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/clock_widget/Plugin.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\clock_widget;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    // Fase de Negociação
    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        // O Plugin pede permissão para injetar Widgets no Dashboard Admin usando o evento correto
        $os->listenHook('dashboard.register_widgets');
        
        // Exige o IdentityManager para testar se o usuário tem a permissão
        $os->requireLink('core.identity');
    }

    // Fase de Execução
    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $identity = $runtime->getLink('core.identity');
        $provider = new ClockWidgetProvider($identity);

        $runtime->onHook('dashboard.register_widgets', function($registry) use ($provider) {
            $registry->registerProvider($provider);
        });
    }

    // Ocorre APENAS quando o SysAdmin clica em "Ativar/Instalar"
    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // Aqui o Plugin injeta silenciosamente as Capabilities no SO!
        $runtime->registerCapability('clock.view', 'App Relógio Mundial');
        $runtime->registerCapability('clock.configure', 'App Relógio Mundial');
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Contracts/OrderRepositoryInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de Repositório de Pedidos Financeiros (DIP / SOLID).
 */
interface OrderRepositoryInterface
{
    /**
     * Cria a tabela de pedidos de forma segura e idempotente.
     */
    public function ensureTable(): void;

    /**
     * Cria um novo pedido no banco de dados e retorna o ID inserido.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function createOrder(array $data): int;

    /**
     * Busca um pedido pelo ID numérico.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findById(int $orderId): ?array;

    /**
     * Busca um pedido pelo código de referência único (ex: 'ORD_2026_ABCD12').
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): ?array;

    /**
     * Atualiza o status do pedido (ex: 'paid', 'cancelled', 'refunded').
     */
    public function updateStatus(int $orderId, string $status, ?string $transactionId = null): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna o histórico de pedidos de um usuário/aluno.
     *
     * @return array<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function getUserOrders(int $userId): array;

    /**
     * Retorna a lista geral de pedidos para administração com filtro opcional por período (YYYY-MM).
     *
     * @return array<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function getAllOrders(int $limit = 100, int $offset = 0, ?string $period = null): array;

    /**
     * Retorna métricas financeiras consolidadas (faturamento total, pedidos pagos, etc.) com filtro opcional de período.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getMetrics(?string $period = null): array;

    /**
     * Retorna os períodos mensais (YYYY-MM) disponíveis com histórico de pedidos.
     *
     * @return array<string>
     */
    public function getAvailablePeriods(): array;

    /**
     * Retorna a linha do tempo de faturamento (dias do mês ou meses do ano) para plotagem de gráficos.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed> ['labels' => [...], 'totals' => [...], 'counts' => [...], 'mode' => 'days'|'months']
     */
    public function getSalesTimeline(?string $period = null): array;

    /**
     * Retorna a distribuição de faturamento por método de pagamento (Pix, Cartão, Boleto, etc.).
     *
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function getPaymentMethodBreakdown(?string $period = null): array;

    /**
     * Retorna os pedidos filtrados para exportação contábil / balanço anual (CSV / Excel).
     *
     * @return array<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function getOrdersForExport(?string $period = null, ?string $year = null): array;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Contracts/PaymentGatewayInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;

/**
 * Contrato Fundamental de Provedores de Pagamento (DIP / SOLID).
 * 
 * Permite que Mercado Pago, PayPal ou outros gateways funcionem de forma intercambiável,
 * sem nenhum acoplamento do sistema a APIs bancárias específicas.
 */
interface PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    /**
     * Identificador único do gateway (ex: 'mercadopago', 'paypal').
     */
    public function getId(): string;

    /**
     * Título exibido na interface pública de pagamento.
     */
    public function getTitle(): string;

    /**
     * Verifica se as credenciais de API do gateway estão configuradas no sistema (.env ou settings).
     */
    public function isConfigured(): bool;

    /**
     * Processa a cobrança (Pix, Cartão, Boleto ou redirecionamento).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $orderData Dados do pedido (order_ref, total, description, student_name, student_email)
     * @param array<string, mixed> $paymentInput Dados da forma de pagamento (method, card_token, installments)
     */
    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult;

    /**
     * Trata o webhook enviado assincronamente pelo gateway.
     * Retorna array com ['order_ref' => ..., 'status' => 'approved'|'refunded'|'pending', 'transaction_id' => ...] ou null se inválido.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array;
}

    public function get(string $gatewayId): ?PaymentGatewayInterface;

    /**

    public function getAll(): array;

     * @return bool True se a entrega/matrícula foi concluída com sucesso
     */
    public function fulfill(int $userId, int $itemId, string $orderRef, array $metadata = []): bool;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Contracts/WebhookSignatureVerifierInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts;

interface WebhookSignatureVerifierInterface
{
    /**
     * @param array<string,string> $headers Cabeçalhos relevantes normalizados
     */
    public function verify(string $rawBody, array $headers): bool;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Controllers/CheckoutController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemResolverInterface;

/**
 * Controlador de Checkout e Finalização de Matrículas (SRP / DIP / Sem Superglobais).
 */
class CheckoutController
{
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private OrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo;
    private PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface $gatewayRegistry;
    private ?CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher;
    private ?PurchasableItemResolverInterface $itemResolver;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        OrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo,
        PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface $gatewayRegistry,
        ?CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo = null,
        ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null,
        ?PurchasableItemResolverInterface $itemResolver = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->orderRepo = $orderRepo;
        $this->gatewayRegistry = $gatewayRegistry;
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->dispatcher = $dispatcher;
        $this->itemResolver = $itemResolver;
        $this->settings = $settings;
    }

    private function isDemoModeEnabled(): bool
    {
        return $this->settings !== null && (bool)$this->settings->get('commerce_demo_mode', false);
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Checkout: GET /checkout/curso/{id}
     */
    public function showCheckout(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        $course = null;
        $sellerInfo = null;
        if ($this->courseRepo !== null) {
            $c = $this->courseRepo->findById($courseId);
            if ($c && ($c['status'] ?? '') === 'published') {
                $course = $c;
            }
        }

        if ($course === null && $this->itemResolver !== null) {
            $item = $this->itemResolver->resolve('course', $courseId)
                 ?? $this->itemResolver->resolve('dropship_product', $courseId)
                 ?? $this->itemResolver->resolve('product', $courseId);
            if ($item && $item->isAvailable()) {
                $course = [
                    'id'          => $item->getId(),
                    'title'       => $item->getTitle(),
                    'price'       => $item->getPrice(),
                    'status'      => 'published',
                    'description' => $item->getDescription(),
                    'image'       => $item->getThumbnailUrl(),
                    'type'        => $item->getItemType(),
                ];
                if (method_exists($item, 'getProduct')) {
                    $innerProduct = $item->getProduct();
                    if (is_object($innerProduct) && method_exists($innerProduct, 'getSellerInfo')) {
                        $sellerInfo = $innerProduct->getSellerInfo();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!$course) {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Item não encontrado</h1>", 404);
        }

        $isPhysicalOrDropship = (($course['type'] ?? '') === 'dropship_product')
            || (($course['type'] ?? '') === 'product')
            || (str_contains($request->server['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '', '/checkout/produto/'));

        $userId = (int)$this->session->get('academy_student_id', 0);
        if ($userId <= 0) {
            $userId = (int)$this->session->get('user_id', 0);
        }

        // Cursos digitais exigem login prévio; produtos de loja/dropshipping permitem Guest Checkout
        if ($userId <= 0 && !$isPhysicalOrDropship) {
            $checkoutUri = $baseUrl . '/checkout/curso/' . $courseId;
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/login?redirect=' . urlencode($checkoutUri));
        }

        // REGRA DE INJEÇÃO E DISPONIBILIDADE:
        // Só disponibiliza gateways que possuem credenciais/chaves REALMENTE configuradas.
        $allConfiguredGateways = array_values(array_filter(
            $this->gatewayRegistry->getAll(),
            function ($g) {
                $id = $g->getId();
                // Exclui webhooks de afiliados externos (Hotmart, Eduzz, etc.)
                if (in_array($id, ['hotmart', 'eduzz', 'monetizze', 'clickbank'], true)) {
                    return false;
                }
                // REGRA CRÍTICA: Se não há chave/credencial configurada, não pode ficar disponível
                if (!$g->isConfigured()) {
                    return false;
                }
                if ($this->settings !== null) {
                    $enabledKey = $id . '_enabled';
                    $isEnabled = (bool)$this->settings->get($enabledKey, $id === 'mercadopago');
                    if (!$isEnabled) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        ));

        // Modalidade configurada especificamente para este curso (ex: 'paypal', 'mercadopago', 'stripe')
        $coursePlatform = strtolower(trim((string)($course['external_platform'] ?? '')));
        $gateways = $allConfiguredGateways;

        if ($coursePlatform !== '' && in_array($coursePlatform, ['paypal', 'stripe', 'mercadopago'], true)) {
            $specificGateways = array_values(array_filter($allConfiguredGateways, function ($g) use ($coursePlatform) {
                return $g->getId() === $coursePlatform;
            }));
            // Se o gateway específico escolhido para o curso estiver configurado com chave, usa ele exclusivamente!
            if (!empty($specificGateways)) {
                $gateways = $specificGateways;
            }
        }
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $userEmail = (string)$this->session->get('academy_student_email', (string)$this->session->get('user_email', (string)$this->session->get('customer_email', '')));
        $userName = (string)$this->session->get('academy_student_name', (string)$this->session->get('user_name', (string)$this->session->get('customer_name', $isPhysicalOrDropship ? '' : 'Aluno')));
        $userCpf = (string)$this->session->get('user_cpf', (string)$this->session->get('academy_student_cpf', (string)$this->session->get('customer_cpf', '')));

        $courseImage = '';
        if (!empty($course['image'])) {
            $courseImage = (string)$course['image'];
        } elseif (!empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
            $thumb = (string)$course['thumbnail'];
            if (str_starts_with($thumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'data:')) {
                $courseImage = $thumb;
            } else {
                $courseImage = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($thumb, '/');
            }
        }

        $unitPrice = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
        $quantity = $isPhysicalOrDropship ? max(1, min(99, (int)$request->input('qty', 1))) : 1;
        $total = round($unitPrice * $quantity, 2);

        $html = $this->renderView('front/checkout', [
            'baseUrl'              => $baseUrl,
            'course'               => $course,
            'courseImage'          => $courseImage,
            'gateways'             => $gateways,
            'coursePlatform'       => $coursePlatform,
            'csrfToken'            => $csrfToken,
            'userEmail'            => $userEmail,
            'userName'             => $userName,
            'userCpf'              => $userCpf,
            'unitPrice'            => $unitPrice,
            'quantity'             => $quantity,
            'total'                => $total,
            'sellerInfo'           => $sellerInfo,
            'isPhysicalOrDropship' => $isPhysicalOrDropship,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Checkout de Produtos Físicos / Dropshipping: GET /checkout/produto/{id}
     */
    public function showProductCheckout(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        return $this->showCheckout($request, $id);
    }

    /**
     * Processamento de Cobrança: POST /checkout/process
     */
    public function process(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''));
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        $courseId = (int)($request->input('item_id') ?? $request->input('course_id'));
        $itemType = (string)($request->input('item_type') ?? '');
        $course = null;
        $sellerInfo = null;

        if ($this->itemResolver !== null) {
            $resolvedType = $itemType !== '' ? $itemType : 'course';
            $item = $this->itemResolver->resolve($resolvedType, $courseId)
                 ?? $this->itemResolver->resolve('dropship_product', $courseId)
                 ?? $this->itemResolver->resolve('course', $courseId);
            if ($item && $item->isAvailable()) {
                $course = [
                    'id'    => $item->getId(),
                    'title' => $item->getTitle(),
                    'price' => $item->getPrice(),
                    'type'  => $item->getItemType(),
                ];
                $itemType = $item->getItemType();
                if (method_exists($item, 'getProduct')) {
                    $innerProduct = $item->getProduct();
                    if (is_object($innerProduct) && method_exists($innerProduct, 'getSellerInfo')) {
                        $sellerInfo = $innerProduct->getSellerInfo();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if ($course === null && $this->courseRepo !== null) {
            $c = $this->courseRepo->findById($courseId);
            if ($c) {
                $course = $c;
                $itemType = 'course';
            }
        }

        if (!$course) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Item não encontrado.'], 404);
        }

        if ($itemType === '') {
            $itemType = 'course';
        }

        $isPhysicalOrDropship = in_array($itemType, ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true);

        $userId = (int)$this->session->get('academy_student_id', 0);
        if ($userId <= 0) {
            $userId = (int)$this->session->get('user_id', 0);
        }

        if ($userId <= 0 && !$isPhysicalOrDropship) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Faça login para concluir o pagamento.'], 401);
        }

        $unitPrice = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
        $quantity = $isPhysicalOrDropship ? max(1, min(99, (int)$request->input('quantity', 1))) : 1;
        $total = round($unitPrice * $quantity, 2);
        $gatewayId = (string)($request->input('gateway') ?? 'mercadopago');
        $paymentMethod = (string)($request->input('payment_method') ?? 'pix');
        $payerCpf = preg_replace('/\D/', '', (string)($request->input('payer_cpf') ?? $this->session->get('user_cpf', '')));

        if ($payerCpf !== '') {
            $this->session->set('user_cpf', $payerCpf);
            $this->session->set('academy_student_cpf', $payerCpf);
        }

        $gateway = $this->gatewayRegistry->get($gatewayId);
        if (!$gateway) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Meio de pagamento inválido.'], 422);
        }

        // Só cobra por gateway com credenciais reais. Modo demonstração exige flag explícita.
        if (!$gateway->isConfigured() && !$this->isDemoModeEnabled()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Este meio de pagamento não está disponível no momento.'], 409);
        }

        // Para Pix e Boleto em ambiente real do Mercado Pago, CPF com 11 dígitos é obrigatório
        if (in_array($paymentMethod, ['pix', 'boleto'], true) && strlen($payerCpf) !== 11 && $gateway->getId() === 'mercadopago') {
            if ($gateway instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway && !$gateway->isSandbox() && !$this->isDemoModeEnabled()) {
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Por favor, informe seu CPF (11 dígitos) para emitir o ' . ($paymentMethod === 'pix' ? 'Pix' : 'Boleto Bancário') . '.',
                ], 422);
            }
        }

        $orderRef = 'ORD_' . date('YmdHis') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3));
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => $userId,
            'item_type'      => $itemType,
            'item_id'        => $courseId,
            'total'          => $total,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => $gateway->getId(),
            'payment_method' => $paymentMethod,
            'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
        ]);

        $studentName = trim((string)($request->input('customer_name') ?? $request->input('payer_name') ?? $this->session->get('academy_student_name', (string)$this->session->get('user_name', $isPhysicalOrDropship ? 'Cliente' : 'Aluno'))));
        $studentEmail = trim((string)($request->input('customer_email') ?? $request->input('payer_email') ?? $this->session->get('academy_student_email', (string)$this->session->get('user_email', 'cliente@exemplo.com'))));

        $qtySuffix = ($isPhysicalOrDropship && $quantity > 1) ? " ({$quantity}x)" : '';
        $orderData = [
            'order_ref'     => $orderRef,
            'total'         => $total,
            'description'   => $isPhysicalOrDropship ? ("Compra{$qtySuffix}: " . $course['title']) : ("Matrícula no Curso: " . $course['title']),
            'student_name'  => $studentName,
            'student_email' => $studentEmail,
            'payer_cpf'     => $payerCpf,
        ];

        $paymentResult = $gateway->processPayment($orderData, [
            'method'            => $paymentMethod,
            'card_token'        => $request->input('card_token'),
            'installments'      => $request->input('installments', 1),
            'payment_method_id' => $request->input('payment_method_id'),
            'payer_cpf'         => $payerCpf,
        ]);

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if ($paymentResult->status === 'approved') {
            $this->orderRepo->updateStatus($orderId, 'paid', $paymentResult->transactionId);

            // Dispara evento reativo do Kernel para liberar a matrícula no Academy ou registrar pedido no DomainDrop
            if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                    'user_id'           => $userId,
                    'course_id'         => $courseId,
                    'item_id'           => $courseId,
                    'item_type'         => $itemType,
                    'order_ref'         => $orderRef,
                    'quantity'          => $quantity,
                    'unit_price'        => $unitPrice,
                    'total'             => $total,
                    'seller_info'       => $sellerInfo,
                    'customer_name'     => $studentName,
                    'customer_email'    => $studentEmail,
                    'customer_document' => $payerCpf,
                    'shipping_address'  => [
                        'zip'          => $request->input('shipping_zip'),
                        'street'       => $request->input('shipping_street') ?? $request->input('shipping_address'),
                        'number'       => $request->input('shipping_number'),
                        'complement'   => $request->input('shipping_complement'),
                        'neighborhood' => $request->input('shipping_neighborhood'),
                        'city'         => $request->input('shipping_city'),
                        'state'        => $request->input('shipping_state'),
                    ],
                ]);
            }

            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'      => true,
                'status'       => 'approved',
                'order_ref'    => $orderRef,
                'redirect_url' => $isPhysicalOrDropship
                    ? ($baseUrl . '/checkout/sucesso/' . urlencode($orderRef))
                    : ($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel'),
                'message'      => $isPhysicalOrDropship
                    ? 'Pagamento aprovado com sucesso! Pedido enviado ao fornecedor.'
                    : 'Pagamento aprovado com sucesso! Sua matrícula foi liberada.',
            ]);
        }

        if ($paymentResult->status === 'pending') {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'           => true,
                'status'            => 'pending',
                'order_ref'         => $orderRef,
                'payment_method'    => $paymentResult->paymentMethod,
                'pix_copia_e_cola'  => $paymentResult->pixCopiaECola,
                'pix_qr_code'       => $paymentResult->pixQrCode,
                'boleto_url'        => $paymentResult->boletoUrl,
                'redirect_url'      => $paymentResult->redirectUrl,
                'message'           => $paymentResult->message,
            ]);
        }

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success' => false,
            'status'  => 'failed',
            'message' => $paymentResult->message ?: 'Falha ao processar o pagamento.',
        ], 422);
    }

    /**
     * Consulta status do pedido para polling do Pix em tempo real: GET /checkout/status/{orderRef}
     */
    public function checkStatus(Request $request, string $orderRef): ResponseInterface
    {
        $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        if (!$order) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'paid' => false, 'message' => 'Pedido não encontrado.'], 404);
        }

        $status = (string)($order['status'] ?? 'pending');
        $isPaid = $status === 'paid';
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isPhysicalOrder = in_array((string)($order['item_type'] ?? ''), ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success'      => true,
            'status'       => $status,
            'paid'         => $isPaid,
            'order_ref'    => $orderRef,
            'redirect_url' => $isPhysicalOrder
                ? ($baseUrl . '/checkout/sucesso/' . urlencode($orderRef))
                : ($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel'),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Retorno após checkout no Stripe: GET /checkout/stripe/success
     */
    public function stripeSuccess(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $sessionId = (string)($request->input('session_id') ?? '');
        $orderRef = (string)($request->input('order_ref') ?? '');

        $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        if (!$order) {
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=error&message=' . urlencode('Pedido não localizado.'));
        }

        $gateway = $this->gatewayRegistry->get('stripe');
        if ($gateway instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway && !empty($sessionId)) {
            $verified = $gateway->verifySession($sessionId);
            if ($verified && ($verified['status'] ?? '') === 'approved') {
                $this->orderRepo->updateStatus((int)$order['id'], 'paid', (string)($verified['transaction_id'] ?? $sessionId));

                if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                    $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                        'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                        'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                        'item_id'   => (int)$order['item_id'],
                        'item_type' => (string)($order['item_type'] ?? 'course'),
                        'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                    ]);
                }

                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=approved&gateway=stripe&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
            }
        }

        if ($this->isDemoModeEnabled()) {
            $this->orderRepo->updateStatus((int)$order['id'], 'paid', 'STRIPE_DEMO_' . time());
            if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                    'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                    'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                    'item_id'   => (int)$order['item_id'],
                    'item_type' => (string)($order['item_type'] ?? 'course'),
                    'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                ]);
            }
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=approved&gateway=stripe&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=pending&gateway=stripe&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
    }

    /**
     * Retorno após aprovação no PayPal: GET /checkout/paypal/success
     */
    public function paypalSuccess(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $token = (string)($request->input('token') ?? ''); // PayPal order ID
        $orderRef = (string)($request->input('order_ref') ?? '');

        $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        if (!$order) {
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=error&message=' . urlencode('Pedido não localizado.'));
        }

        $gateway = $this->gatewayRegistry->get('paypal');
        if ($gateway instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway && !empty($token)) {
            $captured = $gateway->captureOrder($token);
            if ($captured && ($captured['status'] ?? '') === 'approved') {
                $this->orderRepo->updateStatus((int)$order['id'], 'paid', (string)($captured['transaction_id'] ?? $token));

                if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                    $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                        'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                        'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                        'item_id'   => (int)$order['item_id'],
                        'item_type' => (string)($order['item_type'] ?? 'course'),
                        'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                    ]);
                }

                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=approved&gateway=paypal&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
            }
        }

        if ($this->isDemoModeEnabled()) {
            $this->orderRepo->updateStatus((int)$order['id'], 'paid', 'PAYPAL_DEMO_' . time());
            if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                    'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                    'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                    'item_id'   => (int)$order['item_id'],
                    'item_type' => (string)($order['item_type'] ?? 'course'),
                    'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                ]);
            }
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=approved&gateway=paypal&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=pending&gateway=paypal&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Confirmação de Pedido: GET /checkout/sucesso/{orderRef}
     */
    public function orderSuccess(Request $request, string $orderRef): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);

        if (!$order) {
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/');
        }

        $itemId = (int)($order['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $itemType = (string)($order['item_type'] ?? 'course');
        $itemData = null;

        if ($this->itemResolver !== null) {
            $resolved = $this->itemResolver->resolve($itemType, $itemId)
                     ?? $this->itemResolver->resolve('dropship_product', $itemId)
                     ?? $this->itemResolver->resolve('product', $itemId);
            if ($resolved) {
                $itemData = [
                    'title' => $resolved->getTitle(),
                    'image' => $resolved->getThumbnailUrl(),
                    'price' => $resolved->getPrice(),
                ];
            }
        }

        if ($itemData === null && $this->courseRepo !== null) {
            $c = $this->courseRepo->findById($itemId);
            if ($c) {
                $itemData = [
                    'title' => $c['title'] ?? 'Curso',
                    'image' => $c['thumbnail'] ?? '',
                    'price' => $c['price'] ?? 0.0,
                ];
            }
        }

        // Tenta obter os dados do pedido de dropshipping se houver
        $dropshipOrder = null;
        try {
            $connection = \DomainSystem\Core\Database\Connection::getInstance();
            if ($connection) {
                $dropRepo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipOrderRepository($connection);
                $dropshipOrder = $dropRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            // Silencioso
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('front/success', [
            'baseUrl'       => $baseUrl,
            'order'         => $order,
            'item'          => $itemData,
            'dropshipOrder' => $dropshipOrder,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return "<h1>Checkout</h1><p>Visualização em configuração.</p>";
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;

/**
 * Painel Administrativo do DomainCommerce (SRP / DIP / Sem Superglobais).
 */
class OrdersAdminController
{
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private OrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo;
    private PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface $gatewayRegistry;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;
    private ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher;

    public function __construct(
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        OrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo,
        PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface $gatewayRegistry,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null,
        ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null
    ) {
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->orderRepo = $orderRepo;
        $this->gatewayRegistry = $gatewayRegistry;
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->dispatcher = $dispatcher;
    }

    /**
     * Dashboard de Vendas e Pedidos: GET /admin/commerce
     */
    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $gateways = $this->gatewayRegistry->getAll();

        $rawPeriod = trim((string)$request->input('period', ''));
        $filterPeriod = (preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $rawPeriod)) ? $rawPeriod : null;

        $availablePeriods = $this->orderRepo->getAvailablePeriods();
        $orders = $this->orderRepo->getAllOrders(100, 0, $filterPeriod);
        $metrics = $this->orderRepo->getMetrics($filterPeriod);
        $salesTimeline = $this->orderRepo->getSalesTimeline($filterPeriod);
        $paymentBreakdown = $this->orderRepo->getPaymentMethodBreakdown($filterPeriod);

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/dashboard', [
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'gateways'         => $gateways,
            'orders'           => $orders,
            'metrics'          => $metrics,
            'salesTimeline'    => $salesTimeline,
            'paymentBreakdown' => $paymentBreakdown,
            'csrfToken'        => (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken(),
            'flash'            => $this->session->getFlash('success'),
            'error'            => $this->session->getFlash('error'),
            'settings'         => $this->settings ? $this->settings->all() : [],
            'selectedPeriod'   => $filterPeriod,
            'availablePeriods' => $availablePeriods,
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    /**
     * Tela de Configurações de Gateways: GET /admin/commerce/settings
     */
    public function settings(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $gateways = $this->gatewayRegistry->getAll();
        $currentSettings = $this->settings ? $this->settings->all() : [];

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/settings', [
            'baseUrl'   => $baseUrl,
            'gateways'  => $gateways,
            'settings'  => $currentSettings,
            'csrfToken' => (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken(),
            'flash'     => $this->session->getFlash('success'),
            'error'     => $this->session->getFlash('error'),
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    /**
     * Salva as Configurações de Gateways: POST /admin/commerce/settings
     */
    public function saveSettings(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token');
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token CSRF inválido.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/commerce/settings');
        }

        if ($this->settings !== null) {
            $data = [
                'mercadopago_enabled'      => (bool)$request->input('mercadopago_enabled'),
                'mercadopago_access_token' => trim((string)$request->input('mercadopago_access_token', '')),
                'mercadopago_public_key'   => trim((string)$request->input('mercadopago_public_key', '')),
                'mercadopago_sandbox'      => (bool)$request->input('mercadopago_sandbox'),
                'paypal_enabled'           => (bool)$request->input('paypal_enabled'),
                'paypal_client_id'         => trim((string)$request->input('paypal_client_id', '')),
                'paypal_client_secret'     => trim((string)$request->input('paypal_client_secret', '')),
                'paypal_sandbox'           => (bool)$request->input('paypal_sandbox'),
                'stripe_enabled'           => (bool)$request->input('stripe_enabled'),
                'stripe_secret_key'        => trim((string)$request->input('stripe_secret_key', '')),
                'stripe_publishable_key'   => trim((string)$request->input('stripe_publishable_key', '')),
                'stripe_webhook_secret'    => trim((string)$request->input('stripe_webhook_secret', '')),
                'hotmart_enabled'          => (bool)$request->input('hotmart_enabled'),
                'hotmart_hottok'           => trim((string)$request->input('hotmart_hottok', '')),
                'eduzz_enabled'            => (bool)$request->input('eduzz_enabled'),
                'eduzz_token'              => trim((string)$request->input('eduzz_token', '')),
                'monetizze_enabled'        => (bool)$request->input('monetizze_enabled'),
                'monetizze_chave_unica'    => trim((string)$request->input('monetizze_chave_unica', '')),
                'clickbank_enabled'        => (bool)$request->input('clickbank_enabled'),
                'clickbank_secret'         => trim((string)$request->input('clickbank_secret', '')),
                'active_currency'          => (string)($request->input('active_currency') ?: 'BRL'),
            ];

            $this->settings->save($data);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Configurações do DomainCommerce salvas com sucesso!');
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/commerce/settings');
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do Mercado Pago: POST /admin/commerce/test-mercadopago
     */
    public function testMercadoPago(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''));
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        $accessToken = trim((string)$request->input('access_token', ''));
        $publicKey = trim((string)$request->input('public_key', ''));

        /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway|null $mpGateway */
        $mpGateway = $this->gatewayRegistry->get('mercadopago');
        if (!($mpGateway instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway)) {
            $mpGateway = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway($accessToken, $publicKey, $this->settings);
        }

        $results = $mpGateway->testCredentials($accessToken, $publicKey);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success'      => true,
            'access_token' => $results['access_token'],
            'public_key'   => $results['public_key'],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do Stripe: POST /admin/commerce/test-stripe
     */
    public function testStripe(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''));
