        /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway|null $stripeGateway */
        $stripeGateway = $this->gatewayRegistry->get('stripe');
        if (!($stripeGateway instanceof \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway)) {
            $stripeGateway = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway($secretKey, null, $this->settings);
        }

        $result = $stripeGateway->testCredentials($secretKey);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success' => true,
            'result'  => $result,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do PayPal: POST /admin/commerce/test-paypal

    public function testPayPal(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''));

    /**
     * Altera o Status de um Pedido Manualmente: POST /admin/commerce/orders/{id}/status
     */
    public function updateOrderStatus(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $orderId = (int)$id;
        $status = (string)$request->input('status', 'paid');
        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token');
        $expectedToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || !hash_equals($expectedToken, $token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        $order = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        if (!$order) {
            return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pedido não encontrado.'], 404);
        }

        $updated = $this->orderRepo->updateStatus($orderId, $status);
        if ($updated && $status === 'paid' && $this->dispatcher !== null) {
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                'order_ref' => (string)$order['order_ref'],
            ]);
        } elseif ($updated && $status === 'refunded' && $this->dispatcher !== null) {
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.refunded', [
                'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                'order_ref' => (string)$order['order_ref'],
            ]);
        }

        return new JsonResponse([
            'success'   => $updated,
            'message'   => 'Status do pedido alterado para ' . $status,
            'order_id'  => $orderId,
            'status'    => $status,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Exporta os Pedidos para Planilha CSV compatível com Microsoft Excel: GET /admin/commerce/export
     */
    public function export(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $rawPeriod = trim((string)$request->input('period', ''));
        $rawYear = trim((string)$request->input('year', ''));

        $period = (preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $rawPeriod)) ? $rawPeriod : null;
        $year = (preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $rawYear)) ? $rawYear : null;

        $orders = $this->orderRepo->getOrdersForExport($period, $year);

        if ($period) {
            $filename = "balanco-vendas-{$period}.csv";
        } elseif ($year) {
            $filename = "balanco-anual-vendas-{$year}.csv";
        } else {
            $filename = "balanco-geral-vendas-" . date('Y-m-d') . ".csv";
        }

        // Gera arquivo CSV com UTF-8 BOM para garantir acentuação correta no Excel
        $output = "\xEF\xBB\xBF";
        $handle = fopen('php://temp', 'r+');

        fputcsv($handle, [
            'ID Pedido',
            'Referência',
            'Data / Hora',
            'ID Aluno',
            'Nome do Aluno',
            'E-mail do Aluno',
            'Item',
            'Valor (R$)',
            'Gateway',
            'Forma de Pagamento',
            'Status da Venda',
            'ID Transação Gateway',
            'Última Atualização',
        ], ';');

        $statusLabels = [
            'paid'      => 'Pago / Aprovado',
            'pending'   => 'Aguardando Pagamento',
            'refunded'  => 'Reembolsado',
            'cancelled' => 'Cancelado',
        ];

        $methodLabels = [
            'pix'          => 'Pix Instantâneo',
            'credit_card'  => 'Cartão de Crédito',
            'boleto'       => 'Boleto Bancário',
            'checkout_pro' => 'Checkout Pro',
        ];

        foreach ($orders as $o) {
            $st = (string)($o['status'] ?? 'pending');
            $pm = (string)($o['payment_method'] ?? '');
            
            fputcsv($handle, [
                (int)$o['id'],
                (string)$o['order_ref'],
                (string)$o['created_at'],
                (int)$o['user_id'],
                (string)($o['user_name'] ?? ('Aluno #' . $o['user_id'])),
                (string)($o['user_email'] ?? ''),
                ucfirst((string)$o['item_type']) . ' #' . (int)$o['item_id'],
                number_format((float)$o['total'], 2, ',', '.'),
                ucfirst((string)$o['gateway']),
                $methodLabels[$pm] ?? ucfirst($pm),
                $statusLabels[$st] ?? ucfirst($st),
                (string)($o['transaction_id'] ?? ''),
                (string)($o['updated_at'] ?? ''),
            ], ';');
        }

        rewind($handle);
        $csvContent = stream_get_contents($handle);
        fclose($handle);

        $output .= $csvContent;

        return new Response(
            $output,
            200,
            [
                'Content-Type'        => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
                'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"',
                'Cache-Control'       => 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate',
                'Pragma'              => 'no-cache',
                'Expires'             => '0',
            ]
        );
    }

    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return "<div style='padding:20px; color:#fff;'><h1>DomainCommerce</h1><p>Visualização não encontrada.</p></div>";
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Controllers/WebhookController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Controlador de Webhooks e Notificações de Bancos/Gateways e Afiliados (SRP / DIP / Sem Superglobais).
 * Suporta Hotmart, Eduzz, Monetizze, ClickBank, Mercado Pago, PayPal e Stripe.
 */
class WebhookController
{
    private OrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo;
    private PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface $gatewayRegistry;
    private ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher;
    private ?PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(
        OrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo,
        PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface $gatewayRegistry,
        ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null,
        DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO|null $db = null
    ) {
        $this->orderRepo = $orderRepo;
        $this->gatewayRegistry = $gatewayRegistry;
        $this->dispatcher = $dispatcher;
        $this->pdo = $db instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $db->getPdo() : $db;
    }

    /**
     * Endpoint do Webhook de liquidação: POST /webhook/payment/{gateway}
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, $gateway): ResponseInterface
    {
        $gatewayId = strtolower(trim((string)$gateway));
        $paymentGateway = $this->gatewayRegistry->get($gatewayId);

        if (!$paymentGateway) {
            return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => "Gateway '{$gatewayId}' desconhecido."], 404);
        }

        $result = $paymentGateway->handleWebhook($request);
        if (!$result || empty($result['order_ref'])) {
            return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'ignored'], 200);
        }

        $orderRef = (string)$result['order_ref'];
        $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);

        // Cenário de Reembolso (T13): Pedido previamente pago que foi estornado/reembolsado
        if ($order && ($result['status'] ?? '') === 'refunded') {
            if (($order['status'] ?? '') === 'refunded') {
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'duplicate'], 200);
            }
            if (($order['status'] ?? '') === 'paid') {
                try {
                    $updated = $this->orderRepo->updateStatus((int)$order['id'], 'refunded');
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[commerce] Erro ao registrar reembolso order=' . $orderRef . ': ' . $e->getMessage());
                    return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'order_update_failed'], 500);
                }
                if (!$updated) {
                    error_log('[commerce] Falha ao atualizar status para refunded order=' . $orderRef);
                    return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'order_update_failed'], 500);
                }
                if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                    $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.refunded', [
                        'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                        'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                        'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                    ]);
                }
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'order_status' => 'refunded'], 200);
            }
        }

        // Cenário 1: Pedido pré-existente (ex: criado no checkout interno do DomainCommerce)
        if ($order && ($order['status'] ?? '') === 'paid') {
            return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'duplicate'], 200);
        }

        if ($order && ($order['status'] ?? '') === 'pending' && ($result['status'] ?? '') === 'approved') {
            $paid = (float)($result['total'] ?? 0.0);
            $expected = (float)($order['total'] ?? 0.0);
            if ($paid > 0.0 && $paid + 0.01 < $expected) {
                error_log("[commerce] Valor divergente order={$orderRef} pago={$paid} esperado={$expected}");
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'amount_mismatch'], 200);
            }

            $txId = (string)($result['transaction_id'] ?? '');
            try {
                $updated = $this->orderRepo->updateStatus((int)$order['id'], 'paid', $txId);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                error_log('[commerce] Erro ao atualizar pedido pendente para pago order=' . $orderRef . ': ' . $e->getMessage());
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'order_update_failed'], 500);
            }
            if (!$updated) {
                error_log('[commerce] Falha ao atualizar pedido pendente para pago order=' . $orderRef);
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'order_update_failed'], 500);
            }

            if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                    'user_id'   => (int)$order['user_id'],
                    'course_id' => (int)$order['item_id'],
                    'item_id'   => (int)$order['item_id'],
                    'item_type' => (string)($order['item_type'] ?? 'course'),
                    'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                    'total'     => (float)($order['total'] ?? 0.0),
                ]);
            }

            return new JsonResponse([
                'received'     => true,
                'order_status' => 'paid',
                'order_ref'    => $orderRef,
                'user_id'      => (int)$order['user_id'],
                'course_id'    => (int)$order['item_id'],
            ], 200);
        }

        // Cenário 2: Compra vinda de Plataforma de Afiliados Externa (Hotmart, Eduzz, Monetizze, ClickBank)
        if (!$order && ($result['status'] ?? '') === 'approved' && !empty($result['student_email'])) {
            $existing = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
            if ($existing && ($existing['status'] ?? '') === 'paid') {
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'duplicate'], 200);
            }

            if ($this->pdo === null) {
                error_log("[commerce] Banco de dados indisponível ao processar webhook de afiliado gateway={$gatewayId} order={$orderRef}");
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'database_unavailable'], 500);
            }

            $productId = (string)($result['product_id'] ?? '');
            try {
                $courseId = $this->resolveCourseByProduct($productId, (string)$gatewayId);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                error_log("[commerce] Falha temporária ao consultar produto de afiliado gateway={$gatewayId} product={$productId} order={$orderRef}: " . $e->getMessage());
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'course_lookup_failed'], 500);
            }

            if ($courseId <= 0) {
                error_log("[commerce] Produto de afiliado sem curso vinculado: gateway={$gatewayId} product={$productId} order={$orderRef}");
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'orphan'], 200);
            }

            try {
                $userId = $this->resolveOrCreateUser(
                    (string)$result['student_email'],
                    (string)($result['student_name'] ?? 'Aluno')
                );
            } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                error_log("[commerce] Payload de webhook com e-mail inválido gateway={$gatewayId} order={$orderRef}: " . $e->getMessage());
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'invalid_student_email'], 422);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                error_log("[commerce] Falha ao provisionar usuário no webhook gateway={$gatewayId} order={$orderRef}: " . $e->getMessage());
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'user_provisioning_failed'], 500);
            }

            try {
                $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
                    'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
                    'user_id'        => $userId,
                    'item_type'      => 'course',
                    'item_id'        => $courseId,
                    'total'          => (float)($result['total'] ?? 0.0),
                    'currency'       => $gatewayId === 'clickbank' ? 'USD' : 'BRL',
                    'gateway'        => $gatewayId,
                    'payment_method' => 'external_checkout',
                    'status'         => 'paid',
                    'transaction_id' => (string)($result['transaction_id'] ?? $orderRef),
                ]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Em caso de corrida/duplicidade na constraint UNIQUE(order_ref), trata de forma idempotente sem reenviar matrícula
                try {
                    $existingAfterConflict = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                    if ($existingAfterConflict !== null && ($existingAfterConflict['status'] ?? '') === 'paid') {
                        return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'duplicate'], 200);
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
                }

                error_log('[commerce] Falha ao gravar pedido de afiliado: ' . $e->getMessage());
                return new JsonResponse(['received' => false, 'error' => 'order_persist_failed'], 500);
            }

            if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
                $this->dispatcher->dispatch('payment.approved', [
                    'user_id'   => $userId,
                    'course_id' => $courseId,
                    'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                ]);
            }

            return new JsonResponse([
                'received'     => true,
                'order_status' => 'paid',
                'provisioned'  => true,
                'user_id'      => $userId,
                'course_id'    => $courseId,
                'order_ref'    => $orderRef,
            ], 200);
        }

        return new JsonResponse(['received' => true, 'action' => 'processed'], 200);
    }

    /**
     * Resolve usuário existente por e-mail ou provisiona novo aluno com proteção contra duplicidade e falhas silenciosas.
     *
     * @throws InvalidArgumentException Quando o e-mail informado é inválido (erro definitivo do payload).
     * @throws RuntimeException Quando há falha de infraestrutura/banco no provisionamento (erro temporário elegível para retry).
     */
    private function resolveOrCreateUser(string $email, string $name): int
    {
        if ($this->pdo === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Conexão PDO indisponível para provisionamento de usuário.');
        }

        $email = strtolower(trim($email));
        if ($email === '' || !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('E-mail do comprador ausente ou inválido.');
        }

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1");
            $stmt->execute([$email]);
            $existingId = $stmt->fetchColumn();

            if ($existingId) {
                return (int)$existingId;
            }

            $randomPass = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
            $hash = password_hash($randomPass, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
            $cleanName = trim($name) !== '' ? trim($name) : 'Aluno';
            $baseUsername = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_.]/', '', strtolower(str_replace(' ', '', $cleanName))) ?: 'aluno';
            $cleanUsername = substr($baseUsername, 0, 24) . '_' . substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), 0, 6);

            try {
                $insertStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO users (name, username, email, password, role, created_at, updated_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'user', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                ");
                $insertStmt->execute([$cleanName, $cleanUsername, $email, $hash]);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Reconsulta por e-mail primeiro para capturar condição de corrida antes de tentar schema legado sem username
                $stmtRace = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1");
                $stmtRace->execute([$email]);
                $raceId = $stmtRace->fetchColumn();
                if ($raceId) {
                    return (int)$raceId;
                }

                $insertStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO users (name, email, password, role, created_at, updated_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'user', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                ");
                $insertStmt->execute([$cleanName, $email, $hash]);
            }

            $createdId = (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
            if ($createdId <= 0) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Banco não retornou ID do usuário recém-criado.');
            }

            return $createdId;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Última verificação de idempotência para e-mail concorrente antes de sinalizar erro 500
            try {
                $stmtRace = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1");
                $stmtRace->execute([$email]);
                $raceId = $stmtRace->fetchColumn();
                if ($raceId) {
                    return (int)$raceId;
                }
            } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
            }

            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao resolver ou criar usuário: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    private function resolveCourseByProduct(string $productId, string $gatewayId): int
    {
        if ($this->pdo === null) {
            return 0;
        }

        $productId = trim($productId);
        if ($productId === '') {
            return 0;
        }

        // 1. Busca estrita por external_product_id vinculado à plataforma informada (ou genérica)
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT id FROM academy_courses 
             WHERE external_product_id = ? 
               AND (external_platform = ? OR external_platform IS NULL OR external_platform = '') 
             LIMIT 1"
        );
        $stmt->execute([$productId, $gatewayId]);
        $cId = $stmt->fetchColumn();
        if ($cId) {
            return (int)$cId;
        }

        // 2. Busca secundária por slug exato
        $stmtSlug = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM academy_courses WHERE slug = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmtSlug->execute([$productId]);
        $cId = $stmtSlug->fetchColumn();
        return $cId ? (int)$cId : 0;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/DTO/PaymentResult.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO;

/**
 * DTO que encapsula o resultado de qualquer operação de liquidação financeira (SRP / DIP).
 */
class PaymentResult
{
    public bool $success;
    public string $orderRef;
    public string $status; // 'approved', 'pending', 'rejected', 'failed'
    public string $paymentMethod; // 'pix', 'credit_card', 'boleto', 'paypal'
    public ?string $pixQrCode;
    public ?string $pixCopiaECola;
    public ?string $boletoUrl;
    public ?string $redirectUrl;
    public ?string $transactionId;
    public string $message;
    public array $rawPayload;

    public function __construct(
        bool $success,
        string $orderRef,
        string $status,
        string $paymentMethod = 'pix',
        ?string $pixQrCode = null,
        ?string $pixCopiaECola = null,
        ?string $boletoUrl = null,
        ?string $redirectUrl = null,
        ?string $transactionId = null,
        string $message = '',
        array $rawPayload = []
    ) {
        $this->success = $success;
        $this->orderRef = $orderRef;
        $this->status = $status;
        $this->paymentMethod = $paymentMethod;
        $this->pixQrCode = $pixQrCode;
        $this->pixCopiaECola = $pixCopiaECola;
        $this->boletoUrl = $boletoUrl;
        $this->redirectUrl = $redirectUrl;
        $this->transactionId = $transactionId;
        $this->message = $message;
        $this->rawPayload = $rawPayload;
    }

    public static function approved(string $orderRef, string $paymentMethod, ?string $transactionId = null, string $message = 'Pagamento aprovado com sucesso!'): self
    {
        return new self(true, $orderRef, 'approved', $paymentMethod, null, null, null, null, $transactionId, $message);
    }

    public static function pendingPix(string $orderRef, string $pixCopiaECola, ?string $pixQrCode = null, ?string $transactionId = null, string $message = 'Aguardando pagamento via Pix.'): self
    {
        return new self(true, $orderRef, 'pending', 'pix', $pixQrCode, $pixCopiaECola, null, null, $transactionId, $message);
    }

    public static function pendingBoleto(string $orderRef, string $boletoUrl, ?string $transactionId = null, string $message = 'Boleto bancário gerado com sucesso.'): self
    {
        return new self(true, $orderRef, 'pending', 'boleto', null, null, $boletoUrl, null, $transactionId, $message);
    }

    public static function redirect(string $orderRef, string $redirectUrl, string $paymentMethod = 'paypal', string $message = 'Redirecionando para conclusão segura do pagamento.'): self
    {
        return new self(true, $orderRef, 'pending', $paymentMethod, null, null, null, $redirectUrl, null, $message);
    }

    public static function failure(string $orderRef, string $message, string $paymentMethod = 'unknown'): self
    {
        return new self(false, $orderRef, 'failed', $paymentMethod, null, null, null, null, null, $message);
    }

    public function isApproved(): bool
    {
        return $this->success && $this->status === 'approved';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Plugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\CheckoutController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\OrdersAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\WebhookController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\ClickBankGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\EduzzGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\HotmartGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MonetizzeGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PurchasableItemResolver;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->requireLink('core.events');
        $os->requireLink('core.session');
        $os->provideHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers');
        $os->provideHook('commerce.register_gateways');
        $os->provideHook('payment.approved');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // 1. Configurações do DomainCommerce (DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(CommerceSettingsInterface::class, function () {
            return new JsonCommerceSettings();
        });

        // 2. Repositório de Pedidos Financeiros (DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(OrderRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoOrderRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        // 3. Registro e Resolução de Gateways de Pagamento (Mercado Pago, PayPal, Stripe e Extensíveis)
        $runtime->singleton(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            /** @var CommerceSettingsInterface $settings */
            $settings = $runtime->make(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);

            $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
            $registry->register(new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $settings));
            $registry->register(new PayPalGateway(settings: $settings));
            $registry->register(new StripeGateway(settings: $settings));
            $registry->register(new HotmartGateway(settings: $settings));
            $registry->register(new EduzzGateway(settings: $settings));
            $registry->register(new MonetizzeGateway(settings: $settings));
            $registry->register(new ClickBankGateway(settings: $settings));

            // Permite que outros plugins registrem gateways adicionais via Hook (ex: Asaas, PagSeguro)
            try {
                $dispatcher = $runtime->getLink('core.events');
                if ($dispatcher instanceof EventDispatcherInterface) {
                    $dispatcher->dispatch('commerce.register_gateways', $registry);
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Silencia se não houver listeners externos
            }

            return $registry;
        });

        // 4. Resolvedor Desacoplado de Itens Vendíveis (SOLID / DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(PurchasableItemResolverInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $resolver = new PurchasableItemResolver();
            try {
                $dispatcher = null;
                try {
                    $dispatcher = $runtime->getLink('core.events');
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    $dispatcher = $runtime->make(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
                }

                if ($dispatcher instanceof EventDispatcherInterface) {
                    $dispatcher->dispatch('commerce.register_item_resolvers', $resolver);
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Silencia se não houver listeners externos
            }
            return $resolver;
        });

        // 5. Fábrica Controladora do Checkout
        $runtime->singleton(CheckoutController::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $courseRepo = null;
            try {
                $courseRepo = $runtime->make(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            }

            $dispatcher = null;
            try {
                $dispatcher = $runtime->getLink('core.events');
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                try {
                    $dispatcher = $runtime->make(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
                } catch (\Throwable $e2) {
                }
            }

            return new CheckoutController(
                session: $runtime->getLink('core.session'),
                orderRepo: $runtime->make(OrderRepositoryInterface::class),
                gatewayRegistry: $runtime->make(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class),
                courseRepo: $courseRepo,
                dispatcher: $dispatcher,
                itemResolver: $runtime->make(PurchasableItemResolverInterface::class),
                settings: $runtime->make(CommerceSettingsInterface::class)
            );
        });

        // 5. Menu Administrativo do DomainCommerce
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role = 'guest') {
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title' => 'DomainCommerce',
                    'url'   => '/admin/commerce',
                    'icon'  => '🛒',
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // 6. Rotas Públicas e Administrativas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function (Router $router) {
            // Front / Checkout & Webhooks
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/checkout/curso/{id}', [CheckoutController::class, 'showCheckout'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/checkout/produto/{id}', [CheckoutController::class, 'showProductCheckout'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/checkout/sucesso/{orderRef}', [CheckoutController::class, 'orderSuccess'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/checkout/process', [CheckoutController::class, 'process'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/checkout/status/{orderRef}', [CheckoutController::class, 'checkStatus'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/checkout/stripe/success', [CheckoutController::class, 'stripeSuccess'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/checkout/paypal/success', [CheckoutController::class, 'paypalSuccess'], 'commerce');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/webhook/payment/{gateway}', [WebhookController::class, 'handle'], 'commerce');

            // Admin / Painel de Vendas e Configuração de Gateways
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/commerce', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'index'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/commerce/export', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'export'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/commerce/settings', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'settings'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/commerce/settings', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'saveSettings'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/commerce/test-mercadopago', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'testMercadoPago'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/commerce/test-stripe', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'testStripe'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/commerce/test-paypal', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'testPayPal'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/commerce/orders/{id}/status', [OrdersAdminController::class, 'updateOrderStatus'], 'commerce', ['admin']);
        });
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db');
        $orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($db);
        $orderRepo->ensureTable();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Repositories/PdoOrderRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência de pedidos financeiros (ANSI SQL compatível com SQLite e MySQL).
 */
class PdoOrderRepository implements OrderRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tableEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTable();
        }
    }

    public function ensureTable(): void
    {
        if ($this->tableEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $sql = "
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commerce_orders (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                item_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'course',
                item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                total DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                gateway VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                payment_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                order_ref VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                transaction_id VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ";

        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        if ($driver === 'mysql') {
            $sql = "
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commerce_orders (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id INT NOT NULL,
                    item_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'course',
                    item_id INT NOT NULL,
                    total DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                    gateway VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                    payment_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                    order_ref VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    transaction_id VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    INDEX idx_commerce_user (user_id),
                    INDEX idx_commerce_status (status),
                    INDEX idx_commerce_created (created_at)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ";
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec($sql);
            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commerce_order_ref ON commerce_orders(order_ref)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commerce_user ON commerce_orders(user_id)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commerce_status ON commerce_orders(status)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commerce_created ON commerce_orders(created_at)");
            }
            $this->tableEnsured = true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia falha se já existir
        }
    }

    public function createOrder(array $data): int
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $orderRef = (string)($data['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . date('YmdHis') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3))));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO commerce_orders (
                user_id, item_type, item_id, total, status, gateway, payment_method, order_ref, transaction_id, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            (int)($data['user_id'] ?? 0),
            (string)($data['item_type'] ?? 'course'),
            (int)($data['item_id'] ?? 0),
            (float)($data['total'] ?? 0.0),
            (string)($data['status'] ?? 'pending'),
            (string)($data['gateway'] ?? 'mercadopago'),
            (string)($data['payment_method'] ?? 'pix'),
            $orderRef,
            isset($data['transaction_id']) ? (string)$data['transaction_id'] : null,
            $now,
            $now,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $orderId): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM commerce_orders WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$orderId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM commerce_orders WHERE order_ref = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$orderRef]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $orderId, string $status, ?string $transactionId = null): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        if ($transactionId !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE commerce_orders 
                SET status = ?, transaction_id = ?, updated_at = ? 
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            return $stmt->execute([$status, $transactionId, $now, $orderId]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE commerce_orders 
            SET status = ?, updated_at = ? 
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$status, $now, $orderId]);
    }

    public function getUserOrders(int $userId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM commerce_orders 
            WHERE user_id = ? 
            ORDER BY id DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function getAllOrders(int $limit = 100, int $offset = 0, ?string $period = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $hasPeriod = ($period !== null && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $period));
        $whereSql = $hasPeriod ? "WHERE o.created_at LIKE :periodPattern" : "";

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT o.*, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email
                FROM commerce_orders o
                LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
                {$whereSql}
                ORDER BY o.id DESC 
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
            ");
            if ($hasPeriod) {
                $stmt->bindValue(':periodPattern', $period . '%', PDO::PARAM_STR);
            }
            $stmt->bindValue(':limit', max(1, $limit), PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->bindValue(':offset', max(0, $offset), PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();
            return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $fallbackWhere = $hasPeriod ? "WHERE created_at LIKE :periodPattern" : "";
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM commerce_orders 
                {$fallbackWhere}
                ORDER BY id DESC 
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
            ");
            if ($hasPeriod) {
                $stmt->bindValue(':periodPattern', $period . '%', PDO::PARAM_STR);
            }
            $stmt->bindValue(':limit', max(1, $limit), PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->bindValue(':offset', max(0, $offset), PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();
            return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
        }
    }

    public function getMetrics(?string $period = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $metrics = [
            'total_sales'   => 0.0,
            'paid_count'    => 0,
            'pending_count' => 0,
            'total_orders'  => 0,
        ];

        $hasPeriod = ($period !== null && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $period));
        $whereSql = $hasPeriod ? "WHERE created_at LIKE :periodPattern" : "";

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT 
                    COUNT(*) as total_orders,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total ELSE 0 END) as total_sales,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid_count,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_count
                FROM commerce_orders
                {$whereSql}
            ");
            if ($hasPeriod) {
                $stmt->bindValue(':periodPattern', $period . '%', PDO::PARAM_STR);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (is_array($row)) {
                $metrics['total_orders']  = (int)($row['total_orders'] ?? 0);
                $metrics['total_sales']   = (float)($row['total_sales'] ?? 0.0);
                $metrics['paid_count']    = (int)($row['paid_count'] ?? 0);
                $metrics['pending_count'] = (int)($row['pending_count'] ?? 0);
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {}

        return $metrics;
    }

    public function getAvailablePeriods(): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->query("
                SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(created_at, 1, 7) AS period 
                FROM commerce_orders 
                WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at != ''
                ORDER BY period DESC
            ");
            $results = $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN) : [];
            $current = date('Y-m');
            if (!in_array($current, $results, true)) {
                array_unshift($results, $current);
            }
            return array_values(array_filter($results));
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [date('Y-m')];
        }
    }

    public function getSalesTimeline(?string $period = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $hasPeriod = ($period !== null && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $period));

        if ($hasPeriod) {
            $daysInMonth = (int)date('t', (int)strtotime($period . '-01'));
            $labels = [];
            $totals = [];
            $counts = [];

            for ($d = 1; $d <= $daysInMonth; $d++) {
                $dayStr = str_pad((string)$d, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $labels[] = $dayStr;
                $totals[$dayStr] = 0.0;
                $counts[$dayStr] = 0;
            }

            try {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                    SELECT 
                        SUBSTR(created_at, 9, 2) as day_key,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total ELSE 0 END) as day_total,
                        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) as day_count
                    FROM commerce_orders
                    WHERE created_at LIKE :periodPattern
                    GROUP BY day_key
                ");
                $stmt->execute([':periodPattern' => $period . '%']);
                while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
                    $k = (string)($row['day_key'] ?? '');
                    if (isset($totals[$k])) {
                        $totals[$k] = (float)($row['day_total'] ?? 0.0);
                        $counts[$k] = (int)($row['day_count'] ?? 0);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {}

            return [
                'labels' => $labels,
                'totals' => array_values($totals),
                'counts' => array_values($counts),
                'mode'   => 'days',
            ];
        }

        // Modo geral: agrupa por meses (últimos 12 meses)
        $monthNamesMap = [
            '01' => 'Jan', '02' => 'Fev', '03' => 'Mar', '04' => 'Abr',
            '05' => 'Mai', '06' => 'Jun', '07' => 'Jul', '08' => 'Ago',
            '09' => 'Set', '10' => 'Out', '11' => 'Nov', '12' => 'Dez'
        ];

        $labels = [];
        $totals = [];
        $counts = [];

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->query("
                SELECT 
                    SUBSTR(created_at, 1, 7) as month_key,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total ELSE 0 END) as month_total,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) as month_count
                FROM commerce_orders
                WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at != ''
                GROUP BY month_key
                ORDER BY month_key ASC
                LIMIT 12
            ");
            if ($stmt) {
                while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
                    $k = (string)($row['month_key'] ?? '');
                    $parts = explode('-', $k);
                    $label = (count($parts) === 2 && isset($monthNamesMap[$parts[1]]))
                        ? ($monthNamesMap[$parts[1]] . '/' . substr($parts[0], 2))
                        : $k;

                    $labels[] = $label;
                    $totals[] = (float)($row['month_total'] ?? 0.0);
                    $counts[] = (int)($row['month_count'] ?? 0);
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {}

        if (empty($labels)) {
            $cur = date('Y-m');
            $parts = explode('-', $cur);
            $curLabel = (count($parts) === 2 && isset($monthNamesMap[$parts[1]]))
                ? ($monthNamesMap[$parts[1]] . '/' . substr($parts[0], 2))
                : $cur;
            $labels = [$curLabel];
            $totals = [0.0];
            $counts = [0];
        }

        return [
            'labels' => $labels,
            'totals' => $totals,
            'counts' => $counts,
            'mode'   => 'months',
        ];
    }

    public function getPaymentMethodBreakdown(?string $period = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $hasPeriod = ($period !== null && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $period));
        $whereSql = $hasPeriod ? "AND created_at LIKE :periodPattern" : "";

        $breakdown = [];
        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT 
                    payment_method,
                    SUM(total) as method_total,
                    COUNT(*) as method_count
                FROM commerce_orders
                WHERE status = 'paid' {$whereSql}
                GROUP BY payment_method
            ");
            if ($hasPeriod) {
                $stmt->bindValue(':periodPattern', $period . '%', PDO::PARAM_STR);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            while ($row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
                $method = (string)($row['payment_method'] ?? 'outros');
                $meta = match($method) {
                    'pix'          => ['name' => 'Pix Instantâneo', 'color' => '#00d284'],
                    'credit_card'  => ['name' => 'Cartão de Crédito', 'color' => '#45f3ff'],
                    'boleto'       => ['name' => 'Boleto Bancário', 'color' => '#94a3b8'],
                    'checkout_pro' => ['name' => 'Checkout Pro', 'color' => '#c084fc'],
                    default        => ['name' => ucfirst($method), 'color' => '#f59e0b'],
                };
                $breakdown[$method] = [
                    'label' => $meta['name'],
                    'color' => $meta['color'],
                    'total' => (float)($row['method_total'] ?? 0.0),
                    'count' => (int)($row['method_count'] ?? 0),
                ];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {}

        return $breakdown;
    }

    public function getOrdersForExport(?string $period = null, ?string $year = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $whereSql = "";
        $params = [];

        if ($period !== null && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $period)) {
            $whereSql = "WHERE o.created_at LIKE :pattern";
            $params[':pattern'] = $period . '%';
        } elseif ($year !== null && preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $year)) {
            $whereSql = "WHERE o.created_at LIKE :pattern";
            $params[':pattern'] = $year . '%';
        }

        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT o.*, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email
                FROM commerce_orders o
                LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
                {$whereSql}
                ORDER BY o.id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute($params);
            return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $fallbackWhere = str_replace('o.', '', $whereSql);
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM commerce_orders 
                {$fallbackWhere}
                ORDER BY id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute($params);
            return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/Gateways/ClickBankGateway.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com ClickBank (Instant Notification Service - INS) (SRP / DIP).
 */
class ClickBankGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $secretKey;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $secretKey = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('clickbank_secret')
                ?: (getenv('CLICKBANK_SECRET') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'clickbank';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'ClickBank (Plataforma Global de Afiliados)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->secretKey);
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        return PaymentResult::pendingPix(
            $orderRef,
            '',
            null,
            null,
            'O pagamento deste curso é processado diretamente na página de checkout da ClickBank.'
        );
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        if (empty($payload)) {
            $payload = $request->all();
        }

        // Validação de Secret Key ClickBank
        $receivedSecret = (string)(
            $payload['secret']
            ?? ($payload['verification_key']
            ?? ($request->header('X-ClickBank-Verification') ?? ''))
        );

        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            if ($receivedSecret === '' || !hash_equals((string)$this->secretKey, $receivedSecret)) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // ClickBank INS: transactionType = 'SALE' ou 'TEST_SALE'
        $txType = strtoupper((string)($payload['transactionType'] ?? ($payload['type'] ?? '')));
        $isApproved = in_array($txType, ['SALE', 'TEST_SALE', 'BILL', 'APPROVED'], true);
        $isRefunded = in_array($txType, ['RFND', 'CGBK', 'REFUND'], true);

        if (!$isApproved && !$isRefunded) {
            return null;
        }

        $customer = isset($payload['customer']) && is_array($payload['customer']) ? $payload['customer'] : [];
        $billing = isset($customer['billing']) && is_array($customer['billing']) ? $customer['billing'] : [];

        $studentEmail = (string)(
            $billing['email']
            ?? ($payload['email']
            ?? ($customer['email'] ?? ''))
        );

        $studentName = (string)(
            $billing['fullName']
            ?? ($billing['firstName']
            ?? ($payload['name'] ?? 'Aluno ClickBank'))
        );

        $lineItems = isset($payload['lineItems']) && is_array($payload['lineItems']) ? $payload['lineItems'] : [];
        $firstItem = !empty($lineItems[0]) && is_array($lineItems[0]) ? $lineItems[0] : [];

        $productId = (string)(
            $firstItem['itemNo']
            ?? ($payload['item']
            ?? ($payload['product_id'] ?? ''))
        );

        $receipt = (string)(
            $payload['receipt']
            ?? ($payload['transaction'] ?? uniqid('CBK_', true))
        );

        $total = (float)(
            $payload['totalOrderAmount']
            ?? ($payload['total'] ?? 0.0)
        );

        return [
            'order_ref'      => 'CLICKBANK_' . $receipt,
            'status'         => $isApproved ? 'approved' : 'refunded',
            'transaction_id' => $receipt,
            'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
            'student_email'  => strtolower(trim($studentEmail)),
            'student_name'   => trim($studentName),
            'product_id'     => $productId,
            'total'          => $total,
        ];
    }
}

/**

class EduzzGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $token;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $token = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->token = $token
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('eduzz_token')
                ?: (getenv('EDUZZ_TOKEN') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'eduzz';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'Eduzz (Plataforma de Afiliados)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->token);
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        return PaymentResult::pendingPix(
            $orderRef,
            '',
            null,
            null,
            'O pagamento deste curso é processado diretamente na página de checkout da Eduzz.'
        );
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        if (empty($payload)) {
            $payload = $request->all();
        }

        // Validação de Segurança da Eduzz (api_key ou token)
        $receivedToken = (string)(
            $payload['api_key']
            ?? ($payload['token']
            ?? ($payload['secret']
            ?? ($request->header('X-Eduzz-Token') ?? '')))
        );

        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            if ($receivedToken === '' || !hash_equals((string)$this->token, $receivedToken)) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // Eduzz: trans_status = 3 (Paga) ou 4 (Disponível) ou 'pago' / 'approved'
        $rawStatus = (string)($payload['trans_status'] ?? ($payload['status'] ?? ''));
        $isApproved = in_array($rawStatus, ['3', '4', 'pago', 'paid', 'approved'], true);
        $isRefunded = in_array($rawStatus, ['6', '7', 'reembolsado', 'refunded'], true);

        if (!$isApproved && !$isRefunded) {
            return null;
        }

        $studentEmail = (string)(
            $payload['cus_email']
            ?? ($payload['email']
            ?? ($payload['cliente_email'] ?? ''))
        );

        $studentName = (string)(
            $payload['cus_name']
            ?? ($payload['name']
            ?? ($payload['cliente_nome'] ?? 'Aluno Eduzz'))
        );

        $productId = (string)(
            $payload['pro_id']
            ?? ($payload['pro_cod']
            ?? ($payload['product_id'] ?? ''))
        );

        $txId = (string)(
            $payload['trans_id']
            ?? ($payload['trans_cod']
            ?? ($payload['transaction'] ?? uniqid('EDZ_', true)))
        );

        $total = (float)(
            $payload['val_liquid']
            ?? ($payload['val_total']
            ?? ($payload['value'] ?? 0.0))
        );

        return [
            'order_ref'      => 'EDUZZ_' . $txId,
            'status'         => $isApproved ? 'approved' : 'refunded',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
            'student_email'  => strtolower(trim($studentEmail)),
            'student_name'   => trim($studentName),
            'product_id'     => $productId,
            'total'          => $total,
        ];
    }
}
