<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com Hotmart (Webhooks e Provisionamento de Alunos) (SRP / DIP).
 */
class HotmartGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $hottok;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $hottok = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->hottok = $hottok
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('hotmart_hottok')
                ?: (getenv('HOTMART_HOTTOK') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'hotmart';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'Hotmart (Plataforma de Afiliados)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->hottok);
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        return PaymentResult::pendingPix(
            $orderRef,
            '',
            null,
            null,
            'O pagamento deste curso é processado diretamente na página de checkout da Hotmart.'
        );
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        if (empty($payload)) {
            $payload = $request->all();
        }

        // Validação de Segurança (Hottok)
        $receivedHottok = (string)(
            $payload['hottok']
            ?? ($payload['data']['hottok']
            ?? ($request->header('X-Hotmart-Hottok')
            ?? ($request->header('x-hotmart-hottok') ?? '')))
        );

        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            if ($receivedHottok === '' || !hash_equals((string)$this->hottok, $receivedHottok)) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // Suporte aos formatos v2 e v1 da Hotmart
        $event = (string)($payload['event'] ?? ($payload['status'] ?? ''));
        $isApproved = in_array(strtoupper($event), ['PURCHASE_APPROVED', 'PURCHASE_COMPLETE', 'APPROVED', 'COMPLETE'], true);
        $isRefunded = in_array(strtoupper($event), ['PURCHASE_REFUNDED', 'PURCHASE_CANCELED', 'REFUNDED'], true);

        if (!$isApproved && !$isRefunded) {
            return null;
        }

        $data = isset($payload['data']) && is_array($payload['data']) ? $payload['data'] : $payload;

        $studentEmail = (string)(
            $data['buyer']['email']
            ?? ($data['email']
            ?? ($payload['email'] ?? ''))
        );

        $studentName = (string)(
            $data['buyer']['name']
            ?? ($data['name']
            ?? ($data['first_name']
            ?? ($payload['name'] ?? 'Aluno Hotmart')))
        );

        $productId = (string)(
            $data['product']['id']
            ?? ($data['product']['ucode']
            ?? ($data['prod']
            ?? ($payload['prod'] ?? '')))
        );

        $txId = (string)(
            $data['purchase']['transaction']
            ?? ($data['transaction']
            ?? ($payload['transaction'] ?? uniqid('HTM_', true)))
        );

        $total = (float)(
            $data['purchase']['price']['value']
            ?? ($data['price']
            ?? ($payload['price'] ?? 0.0))
        );

        return [
            'order_ref'      => 'HOTMART_' . $txId,
            'status'         => $isApproved ? 'approved' : 'refunded',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
            'student_email'  => strtolower(trim($studentEmail)),
            'student_name'   => trim($studentName),
            'product_id'     => $productId,
            'total'          => $total,
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/Gateways/MercadoPagoGateway.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com o Mercado Pago (Mercado Livre) - Pix, Cartão e Boleto (SRP / DIP).
 */
class MercadoPagoGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $accessToken;
    private ?string $publicKey;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;
    private string $apiBaseUrl = 'https://api.mercadopago.com';

    public function __construct(
        ?string $accessToken = null,
        ?string $publicKey = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->accessToken = $accessToken 
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('mercadopago_access_token')
                ?: (getenv('MERCADOPAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN') ?: (getenv('MP_ACCESS_TOKEN') ?: null)));
        $this->publicKey = $publicKey 
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('mercadopago_public_key')
                ?: (getenv('MERCADOPAGO_PUBLIC_KEY') ?: (getenv('MP_PUBLIC_KEY') ?: null)));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'mercadopago';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'Mercado Pago (Pix Instantâneo, Cartão até 12x, Boleto & Checkout Pro Oficial)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->accessToken);
    }

    public function isSandbox(): bool
    {
        if ($this->settings && (bool)$this->settings->get('mercadopago_sandbox', false)) {
            return true;
        }
        return str_starts_with((string)$this->accessToken, 'TEST-');
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        $total = (float)($orderData['total'] ?? 0.0);
        $method = (string)($paymentInput['method'] ?? 'pix');
        $studentEmail = (string)($orderData['student_email'] ?? 'aluno@exemplo.com');
        $studentName = (string)($orderData['student_name'] ?? 'Aluno');
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if ($total <= 0.0) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Valor do pedido inválido para cobrança.', $method);
        }

        // Se o token de acesso estiver configurado, envia a requisição oficial para a API REST do Mercado Pago
        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                // Caso 1: Checkout Pro (Preferências) ou Fallback para aplicação de Orders/Checkout Pro
                if ($method === 'checkout_pro' || ($method === 'credit_card' && empty($paymentInput['card_token']))) {
                    $prefResult = $this->createPreferenceRedirect($orderData, $orderRef, $total, $studentName, $studentEmail, $baseUrl);
                    if ($prefResult !== null) {
                        return $prefResult;
                    }
                }

                // Caso 2: API de Pagamentos Diretos (/v1/payments) - Pix, Boleto ou Cartão com token
                $endpoint = $this->apiBaseUrl . '/v1/payments';

                $payerCpf = preg_replace('/\D/', '', (string)($paymentInput['payer_cpf'] ?? $orderData['payer_cpf'] ?? $orderData['customer_cpf'] ?? ''));
                if (strlen($payerCpf) !== 11 && !$this->isSandbox()) {
                    return PaymentResult::failure(
                        $orderRef,
                        'CPF do pagador obrigatório e deve conter 11 dígitos para emissão do pagamento.',
                        $method
                    );
                }

                $rawEmail = (string)($orderData['student_email'] ?? $paymentInput['payer_email'] ?? '');
                $validatedEmail = filter_var($rawEmail, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
                if (!$validatedEmail && !$this->isSandbox()) {
                    return PaymentResult::failure(
                        $orderRef,
                        'E-mail válido do pagador é obrigatório para emissão do pagamento.',
                        $method
                    );
                }

                $payerEmail = (string)$validatedEmail;
                $payerFirstName = $studentName ?: 'Aluno';
                $payerLastName = 'Academy';

                if ($this->isSandbox()) {
                    if (strlen($payerCpf) !== 11) {
                        $payerCpf = '19119119100'; // CPF fictício válido apenas para o sandbox do Mercado Pago
                    }
                    if (!$payerEmail || !str_ends_with(strtolower($payerEmail), '@testuser.com')) {
                        $payerEmail = 'test_user_sandbox@testuser.com';
                    }
                }

                $payload = [
                    'transaction_amount' => $total,
                    'description'        => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Curso Academy - Pedido {$orderRef}"),
                    'external_reference' => $orderRef,
                    'payer'              => [
                        'email'          => $payerEmail,
                        'first_name'     => $payerFirstName,
                        'last_name'      => $payerLastName,
                        'identification' => [
                            'type'   => 'CPF',
                            'number' => $payerCpf,
                        ],
                    ],
                ];

                $webhookUrl = $baseUrl . '/webhook/payment/mercadopago';
                if (filter_var($webhookUrl, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) && !str_contains($webhookUrl, 'localhost') && !str_contains($webhookUrl, '127.0.0.1')) {
                    $payload['notification_url'] = $webhookUrl;
                }

                if ($method === 'pix') {
                    $payload['payment_method_id'] = 'pix';
                } elseif ($method === 'boleto') {
                    $payload['payment_method_id'] = 'bolbradesco';
                } elseif ($method === 'credit_card') {
                    $payload['token'] = (string)($paymentInput['card_token'] ?? '');
                    $payload['installments'] = max(1, (int)($paymentInput['installments'] ?? 1));
                    $payload['payment_method_id'] = (string)($paymentInput['payment_method_id'] ?? 'visa');
                }

                $response = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', $endpoint, $payload);
                $status = (string)($response['status'] ?? 'pending');
                $txId = isset($response['id']) ? (string)$response['id'] : null;

                if ($status === 'approved') {
                    return PaymentResult::approved($orderRef, $method, $txId, 'Pagamento aprovado instantaneamente pelo Mercado Pago!');
                }

                if ($method === 'pix') {
                    $pixData = $response['point_of_interaction']['transaction_data'] ?? [];
                    $qrCodeText = (string)($pixData['qr_code'] ?? '');
                    $qrCodeBase64 = isset($pixData['qr_code_base64']) ? 'data:image/png;base64,' . $pixData['qr_code_base64'] : null;

                    if ($qrCodeText !== '') {
                        return PaymentResult::pendingPix($orderRef, $qrCodeText, $qrCodeBase64, $txId);
                    }

                    $statusDetail = (string)($response['status_detail'] ?? ($response['message'] ?? 'A API do Mercado Pago não retornou o código Pix para pagamento.'));
                    return PaymentResult::failure(
                        $orderRef,
                        'Não foi possível gerar a cobrança Pix no Mercado Pago: ' . $statusDetail,
                        'pix'
                    );
                }

                if ($method === 'boleto') {
                    $boletoUrl = (string)($response['transaction_details']['external_resource_url'] ?? '');
                    if ($boletoUrl !== '') {
                        return PaymentResult::pendingBoleto($orderRef, $boletoUrl, $txId);
                    }

                    // Para boleto que exige endereço completo do pagador na FEBRABAN, redireciona para a preferência oficial
                    $prefResult = $this->createPreferenceRedirect($orderData, $orderRef, $total, $studentName, $studentEmail, $baseUrl);
                    if ($prefResult !== null) {
                        return $prefResult;
                    }
                }

                // Se outro método direto falhou, tenta preferência oficial do Mercado Pago
                if ($method !== 'pix' && (isset($response['error']) || isset($response['message']) || empty($txId))) {
                    $prefResult = $this->createPreferenceRedirect($orderData, $orderRef, $total, $studentName, $studentEmail, $baseUrl);
                    if ($prefResult !== null) {
                        return $prefResult;
                    }
                }

                if ($status === 'in_process' || $status === 'pending') {
                    return new PaymentResult(true, $orderRef, 'pending', $method, null, null, null, null, $txId, 'Pagamento em análise pelo Mercado Pago.');
                }

                $statusDetail = (string)($response['status_detail'] ?? ($response['message'] ?? 'Transação não autorizada.'));
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, "Pagamento rejeitado: {$statusDetail}", $method);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($method === 'pix') {
                    return PaymentResult::failure(
                        $orderRef,
                        'Erro de comunicação ao gerar cobrança Pix no Mercado Pago: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                        'pix'
                    );
                }
                // Em caso de falha de conexão com /v1/payments, tenta fallback para /checkout/preferences
                $prefResult = $this->createPreferenceRedirect($orderData, $orderRef, $total, $studentName, $studentEmail, $baseUrl);
                if ($prefResult !== null) {
                    return $prefResult;
                }
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Erro de comunicação com o Mercado Pago: ' . $e->getMessage(), $method);
            }
        }

        // Modo Simulação / Sandbox Local (somente quando commerce_demo_mode=true)
        if (!$this->isDemoModeEnabled()) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Gateway Mercado Pago não configurado.', $method);
        }

        if ($method === 'pix') {
            return $this->generatePixResult($orderRef, $total, $studentName);
        }

        if ($method === 'checkout_pro' || $method === 'credit_card') {
            $mockUrl = $baseUrl . '/aluno/painel?payment_status=approved&mock=1&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef);
            return PaymentResult::redirect($orderRef, $mockUrl, 'mercadopago', 'Modo Demonstração: Redirecionando para aprovação simulada do Mercado Pago.');
        }

        return PaymentResult::approved($orderRef, $method, 'MP_DEMO_' . time(), 'Modo Demonstração: Pagamento aprovado com sucesso!');
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        $query = $request->all();

        // Mercado Pago envia notificações via data.id ou id na query string
        $paymentId = $payload['data']['id'] ?? ($query['data_id'] ?? ($query['id'] ?? null));
        $type = $payload['type'] ?? ($query['topic'] ?? ($query['type'] ?? null));

        if ($type !== null && !in_array($type, ['payment', 'payment.updated', 'order', 'merchant_order'], true)) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!$paymentId) {
            return null;
        }

        // Se tiver token configurado, faz a checagem no endpoint oficial para validar a autenticidade
        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                if ($type === 'order') {
                    $orderEndpoint = $this->apiBaseUrl . '/v1/orders/' . urlencode((string)$paymentId);
                    $orderInfo = $this->sendHttpRequest('GET', $orderEndpoint);
                    $orderRef = (string)($orderInfo['external_reference'] ?? '');
                    $status = (string)($orderInfo['status'] ?? '');
                    if ($orderRef !== '') {
                        return [
                            'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
                            'status'         => in_array($status, ['closed', 'paid', 'approved'], true) ? 'approved' : ($status === 'refunded' ? 'refunded' : 'pending'),
                            'transaction_id' => (string)$paymentId,
                            'total'          => (float)($orderInfo['total_amount'] ?? ($orderInfo['total_paid_amount'] ?? ($orderInfo['transaction_amount'] ?? 0.0))),
                            'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                        ];
                    }
                }

                $endpoint = $this->apiBaseUrl . '/v1/payments/' . urlencode((string)$paymentId);
                $paymentInfo = $this->sendHttpRequest('GET', $endpoint);

                $orderRef = (string)($paymentInfo['external_reference'] ?? '');
                $status = (string)($paymentInfo['status'] ?? '');

                if ($orderRef === '') {
                    return null;
                }

                return [
                    'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
                    'status'         => $status === 'approved' ? 'approved' : ($status === 'refunded' ? 'refunded' : 'pending'),
                    'transaction_id' => (string)$paymentId,
                    'total'          => (float)($paymentInfo['transaction_amount'] ?? 0.0),
                    'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                ];
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // Sem credenciais não há como validar a notificação: ignora (a menos que o modo demo esteja expressamente ligado).
        if ($this->isDemoModeEnabled()) {
            $orderRef = (string)($payload['order_ref'] ?? ($query['order_ref'] ?? ''));
            if ($orderRef !== '') {
                return [
                    'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
                    'status'         => 'approved',
                    'transaction_id' => (string)$paymentId,
                    'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                ];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Valida as credenciais do Mercado Pago diretamente contra a API oficial.
     * Retorna status individual para Access Token e Public Key com ícones e mensagens.
     *
     * @return array{access_token: array{ok: bool, message: string}, public_key: array{ok: bool, message: string}}
     */
    public function testCredentials(?string $accessToken = null, ?string $publicKey = null): array
    {
        $token = trim((string)($accessToken ?: $this->accessToken));
        $pubKey = trim((string)($publicKey ?: $this->publicKey));

        $tokenResult = ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nenhum Access Token informado para validação.'];
        if ($token !== '') {
            try {
                $ch = curl_init($this->apiBaseUrl . '/users/me');
                curl_setopt_array($ch, [
                    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
                        'Authorization: Bearer ' . $token,
                        'Accept: application/json',
                    ],
                    CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 8,
                ]);
                $res = curl_exec($ch);
                $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
                curl_close($ch);

                $data = json_decode((string)$res, true);
                if ($code === 200 && is_array($data) && isset($data['id'])) {
                    $nickname = (string)($data['nickname'] ?? 'Conta Mercado Pago');
                    $site = (string)($data['site_id'] ?? 'MLB');
                    $env = str_starts_with($token, 'TEST-') ? 'Sandbox (Testes)' : 'Produção';
                    $tokenResult = [
                        'ok'      => true,
                        'message' => "Access Token Válido! Conectado a '{$nickname}' ({$site}) em Modo {$env}.",
                    ];
                } else {
                    $detail = is_array($data) ? (string)($data['message'] ?? 'Credencial não autorizada') : "HTTP {$code}";
                    $tokenResult = [
                        'ok'      => false,
                        'message' => "Falha no Access Token: {$detail} (Código HTTP {$code}).",
                    ];
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $tokenResult = [
                    'ok'      => false,
                    'message' => 'Erro ao comunicar com o Mercado Pago: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                ];
            }
        }

        $pubKeyResult = ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nenhuma Public Key informada para validação.'];
        if ($pubKey !== '') {
            try {
                $ch = curl_init($this->apiBaseUrl . '/v1/payment_methods?public_key=' . urlencode($pubKey));
                curl_setopt_array($ch, [
                    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Accept: application/json'],
                    CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 8,
                ]);
                $res = curl_exec($ch);
                $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
                curl_close($ch);

                $data = json_decode((string)$res, true);
                if ($code === 200 && is_array($data) && count($data) > 0) {
                    $count = count($data);
                    $pubKeyResult = [
                        'ok'      => true,
                        'message' => "Public Key Válida! Reconhecidos {$count} métodos de pagamento no catálogo.",
                    ];
                } else {
                    $pubKeyResult = [
                        'ok'      => false,
                        'message' => "Public Key inválida ou rejeitada pelo Mercado Pago (Código HTTP {$code}).",
                    ];
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $pubKeyResult = [
                    'ok'      => false,
                    'message' => 'Erro ao validar Public Key: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                ];
            }
        }

        return [
            'access_token' => $tokenResult,
            'public_key'   => $pubKeyResult,
        ];
    }

    private function createPreferenceRedirect(
        array $orderData,
        string $orderRef,
        float $total,
        string $studentName,
        string $studentEmail,
        string $baseUrl
    ): ?PaymentResult {
        $endpoint = $this->apiBaseUrl . '/checkout/preferences';
        $backUrl = $baseUrl . '/aluno/painel';

        $prefPayload = [
            'items' => [
                [
                    'id'          => (string)($orderData['item_id'] ?? $orderRef),
                    'title'       => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Curso Academy - Pedido {$orderRef}"),
                    'description' => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Matrícula no Curso Academy"),
                    'quantity'    => 1,
                    'currency_id' => 'BRL',
                    'unit_price'  => $total,
                ]
            ],
            'payer' => [
                'name'  => $studentName,
                'email' => $studentEmail,
            ],
            'back_urls' => [
                'success' => $backUrl . '?payment_status=approved&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef),
                'failure' => $backUrl . '?payment_status=failure&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef),
                'pending' => $backUrl . '?payment_status=pending&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef),
            ],
            'auto_return'          => 'approved',
            'external_reference'   => $orderRef,
            'notification_url'     => $baseUrl . '/webhook/payment/mercadopago',
            'statement_descriptor' => 'ACADEMY',
        ];

        try {
            $response = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', $endpoint, $prefPayload);
            $redirectUrl = $this->isSandbox()
                ? ($response['sandbox_init_point'] ?? ($response['init_point'] ?? ''))
                : ($response['init_point'] ?? ($response['sandbox_init_point'] ?? ''));

            if (!empty($redirectUrl)) {
                return PaymentResult::redirect(
                    $orderRef,
                    $redirectUrl,
                    'mercadopago',
                    'Redirecionando para o ambiente seguro do Mercado Pago...'
                );
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            // Em caso de falha de conexão, retorna null para o chamador tratar
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function isDemoModeEnabled(): bool
    {
        return (bool)($this->settings?->get('commerce_demo_mode', false));
    }

    protected function sendHttpRequest(string $method, string $url, array $data = []): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        $headers = [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->accessToken,
            'Content-Type: application/json',
            'Accept: application/json',
            'X-Idempotency-Key: ' . bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),
        ];

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 15);

        if ($method === 'POST') {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, (string)json_encode($data));
        }

        $res = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($res === false || $httpCode >= 500) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha de conexão com a API do Mercado Pago (HTTP {$httpCode}).");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$res, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }

    /**
     * Gera o QR Code Pix e o código Copia-e-Cola (padrão EMV BR Code do Banco Central).
     * Em produção sem chave configurada, retorna falha controlada sem inventar chave sintética.
     */
    public function generatePixResult(string $orderRef, float $total, string $studentName = 'Aluno'): PaymentResult
    {
        $pixKey = trim((string)($this->settings?->get('mercadopago_pix_key')
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('pix_key')
            ?: '')));

        $isDemo = $this->isDemoModeEnabled();

        if ($pixKey === '') {
            if (!$isDemo) {
                error_log("[MercadoPagoGateway] Tentativa de gerar Pix sem chave/API válida em produção (order_ref={$orderRef}).");
                return PaymentResult::failure(
                    $orderRef,
                    'Pix indisponível: configure as credenciais da API ou uma chave Pix válida em Admin > Commerce > Configurações.',
                    'pix'
                );
            }

            // Apenas em modo demonstração explícito: prefixo inequívoco DEMO-PIX para nunca simular cobrança real
            $pixKey = 'DEMO-PIX-' . substr(md5($orderRef . 'ACADEMY_PIX'), 0, 23);
        }

        $emvPayload = $this->buildPixEmvPayload($pixKey, $total, $orderRef, 'Academy Cursos', 'SAO PAULO');
        $qrCodeUrl = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=220x220&margin=8&data=' . rawurlencode($emvPayload);

        if ($isDemo) {
            return new PaymentResult(
                true,
                $orderRef,
                'pending',
                'pix',
                $qrCodeUrl,
                $emvPayload,
                null,
                null,
                'MP_DEMO_PIX_' . time(),
                'MODO DEMONSTRAÇÃO (SIMULADO): QR Code Pix fictício gerado apenas para testes — NÃO realize pagamento real.',
                ['demo_mode' => true, 'simulated' => true]
            );
        }

        return new PaymentResult(
            true,
            $orderRef,
            'pending',
            'pix',
            $qrCodeUrl,
            $emvPayload,
            null,
            null,
            'MP_PIX_STATIC_' . time(),
            'QR Code Pix gerado com sucesso! Escaneie pelo aplicativo do seu banco ou utilize o Copia-e-Cola.',
            ['demo_mode' => false, 'simulated' => false, 'static_pix' => true]
        );
    }

    /**
     * Constrói a payload EMV BR Code padrão Banco Central do Brasil.
     */
    public function buildPixEmvPayload(
        string $pixKey,
        float $amount,
        string $orderRef,
        string $merchantName = 'Academy Cursos',
        string $merchantCity = 'SAO PAULO'
    ): string {
        $cleanKey = trim($pixKey);
        // Tag 26: 0014BR.GOV.BCB.PIX + chave pix formatada (garante compatibilidade com o formato EMV)
        $cleanKeyFormatted = str_pad($cleanKey, 36, '0', STR_PAD_RIGHT);
        $tag26Value = $this->formatEmvTag('00', 'BR.GOV.BCB.PIX') . $this->formatEmvTag('01', $cleanKeyFormatted);
        $amountStr = number_format($amount, 2, '.', '');
        $txId = substr(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', $orderRef) ?: 'PEDIDO', 0, 25);
        $tag62Value = $this->formatEmvTag('05', $txId);

        $payload = $this->formatEmvTag('00', '01')
            . $this->formatEmvTag('26', $tag26Value)
            . $this->formatEmvTag('52', '0000')
            . $this->formatEmvTag('53', '986')
            . $this->formatEmvTag('54', $amountStr)
            . $this->formatEmvTag('58', 'BR')
            . $this->formatEmvTag('59', substr($merchantName, 0, 25))
            . $this->formatEmvTag('60', substr($merchantCity, 0, 15))
            . $this->formatEmvTag('62', $tag62Value);

        $crc = $this->calculateCrc16($payload);
        return $payload . '6304' . $crc;
    }

    private function formatEmvTag(string $id, string $value): string
    {
        return sprintf('%02s%02d%s', $id, strlen($value), $value);
    }

    private function calculateCrc16(string $payload): string
    {
        $payloadWithTag = $payload . '6304';
        $polynomial = 0x1021;
        $crc = 0xFFFF;
        $len = strlen($payloadWithTag);

        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $crc ^= (ord($payloadWithTag[$i]) << 8);
            for ($j = 0; $j < 8; $j++) {
                if (($crc & 0x8000) !== 0) {
                    $crc = (($crc << 1) ^ $polynomial) & 0xFFFF;
                } else {
                    $crc = ($crc << 1) & 0xFFFF;
                }
            }
        }

        return strtoupper(str_pad(dechex($crc), 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/Gateways/MonetizzeGateway.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com a Monetizze (Webhooks e Provisionamento de Alunos) (SRP / DIP).
 */
class MonetizzeGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $chaveUnica;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $chaveUnica = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->chaveUnica = $chaveUnica
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('monetizze_chave_unica')
                ?: (getenv('MONETIZZE_CHAVE_UNICA') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'monetizze';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'Monetizze (Plataforma de Afiliados)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->chaveUnica);
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        return PaymentResult::pendingPix(
            $orderRef,
            '',
            null,
            null,
            'O pagamento deste curso é processado diretamente na página de checkout da Monetizze.'
        );
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        if (empty($payload)) {
            $payload = $request->all();
        }

        // Validação de Chave Única da Monetizze
        $receivedChave = (string)(
            $payload['chave_unica']
            ?? ($payload['token']
            ?? ($request->header('X-Monetizze-Token') ?? ''))
        );

        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            if ($receivedChave === '' || !hash_equals((string)$this->chaveUnica, $receivedChave)) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // Monetizze: tipoEvento ou status = 'Finalizada' ou 'Completa'
        $statusStr = (string)(
            $payload['tipoEvento']
            ?? ($payload['status']
            ?? ($payload['dados']['status'] ?? ''))
        );

        $isApproved = in_array(strtolower($statusStr), ['finalizada', 'completa', 'aprovada', 'approved'], true);
        $isRefunded = in_array(strtolower($statusStr), ['reembolsada', 'cancelada', 'refunded'], true);

        if (!$isApproved && !$isRefunded) {
            return null;
        }

        $comprador = isset($payload['comprador']) && is_array($payload['comprador'])
            ? $payload['comprador']
            : ($payload['dados']['comprador'] ?? $payload);

        $studentEmail = (string)(
            $comprador['email']
            ?? ($payload['email'] ?? '')
        );

        $studentName = (string)(
            $comprador['nome']
            ?? ($payload['nome'] ?? 'Aluno Monetizze')
        );

        $produto = isset($payload['produto']) && is_array($payload['produto'])
            ? $payload['produto']
            : ($payload['dados']['produto'] ?? []);

        $productId = (string)(
            $produto['codigo']
            ?? ($produto['id']
            ?? ($payload['cod_produto'] ?? ''))
        );

        $transacao = isset($payload['transacao']) && is_array($payload['transacao'])
            ? $payload['transacao']
            : ($payload['dados']['transacao'] ?? []);

        $txId = (string)(
            $transacao['codigo']
            ?? ($payload['cod_transacao']
            ?? ($payload['chave_unica'] ?? uniqid('MNZ_', true)))
        );

        $total = (float)(
            $transacao['valor']
            ?? ($payload['valor'] ?? 0.0)
        );

        return [
            'order_ref'      => 'MONETIZZE_' . $txId,
            'status'         => $isApproved ? 'approved' : 'refunded',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
            'student_email'  => strtolower(trim($studentEmail)),
            'student_name'   => trim($studentName),
            'product_id'     => $productId,
            'total'          => $total,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/Gateways/PayPalGateway.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com o PayPal (Vendas Globais / Moeda Estrangeira e Checkout Oficial v2).
 * Compatível com SOLID / DIP.
 */
class PayPalGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $clientId;
    private ?string $clientSecret;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $clientId = null,
        ?string $clientSecret = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->clientId = $clientId 
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('paypal_client_id')
                ?: (getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID') ?: null));
        $this->clientSecret = $clientSecret 
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('paypal_client_secret')
                ?: (getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'paypal';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'PayPal (Cartões Globais & Saldo PayPal)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->clientId) && !empty($this->clientSecret);
    }

    public function isSandbox(): bool
    {
        if ($this->settings && $this->settings->get('paypal_sandbox') !== null) {
            return (bool)$this->settings->get('paypal_sandbox');
        }
        return true; // Padrão seguro é Sandbox a menos que explicitamente desligado
    }

    private function getApiBaseUrl(): string
    {
        return $this->isSandbox() ? 'https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com' : 'https://api-m.paypal.com';
    }

    private function resolveAbsoluteUrl(string $path): string
    {
        if (str_starts_with($path, 'http://') || str_starts_with($path, 'https://')) {
            return $path;
        }

        $scheme = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') ? 'https' : 'http';
        $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? ($_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ?? 'localhost');
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'https://')) {
            return rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }

        return $scheme . '://' . $host . $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        $total = (float)($orderData['total'] ?? 0.0);
        $currency = strtoupper((string)($this->settings?->get('active_currency', 'BRL') ?: 'BRL'));

        if ($total <= 0.0) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Valor do pedido inválido para cobrança no PayPal.', 'paypal');
        }

        // Se estiver configurado, cria ordem oficial via API REST v2 do PayPal
        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                $token = $this->getAccessToken();
                if (!$token) {
                    return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Falha de autenticação com o PayPal. Verifique o Client ID e Client Secret.', 'paypal');
                }

                $returnUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/paypal/success?order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
                $cancelUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/curso/' . (int)($orderData['item_id'] ?? 0) . '?cancelled=1');

                $orderPayload = [
                    'intent'         => 'CAPTURE',
                    'purchase_units' => [
                        [
                            'reference_id' => $orderRef,
                            'description'  => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Curso Academy - Pedido {$orderRef}"),
                            'amount'       => [
                                'currency_code' => $currency,
                                'value'         => number_format($total, 2, '.', ''),
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                    'application_context' => [
                        'brand_name'          => 'Academy',
                        'landing_page'        => 'BILLING',
                        'user_action'         => 'PAY_NOW',
                        'return_url'          => $returnUrl,
                        'cancel_url'          => $cancelUrl,
                    ],
                ];

                $response = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', '/v2/checkout/orders', $orderPayload, $token);
                $links = $response['links'] ?? [];
                $approveUrl = null;

                foreach ($links as $link) {
                    if (($link['rel'] ?? '') === 'approve') {
                        $approveUrl = (string)($link['href'] ?? '');
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!empty($approveUrl)) {
                    return PaymentResult::redirect(
                        $orderRef,
                        $approveUrl,
                        'paypal',
                        'Redirecionando para o ambiente seguro do PayPal...'
                    );
                }

                $errMsg = (string)($response['message'] ?? 'Não foi possível gerar o link de pagamento do PayPal.');
                if (!empty($response['details']) && is_array($response['details'])) {
                    $details = [];
                    foreach ($response['details'] as $detail) {
                        if (!empty($detail['description'])) {
                            $details[] = $detail['description'];
                        }
                    }
                    if (!empty($details)) {
                        $errMsg .= ' (' . implode('; ', $details) . ')';
                    }
                }
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'PayPal: ' . $errMsg, 'paypal');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Erro de comunicação com o PayPal: ' . $e->getMessage(), 'paypal');
            }
        }

        // Modo Simulação Local (somente com commerce_demo_mode=true)
        if (!(bool)($this->settings?->get('commerce_demo_mode', false))) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Gateway PayPal não configurado.', 'paypal');
        }

        return PaymentResult::approved(
            $orderRef,
            'paypal',
            'PAYPAL_DEMO_' . time(),
            'Modo Demonstração: Pagamento PayPal aprovado!'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Captura o pagamento após o aluno retornar do PayPal aprovado.
     */
    public function captureOrder(string $paypalOrderId): ?array
    {
        if (!$this->isConfigured() || empty($paypalOrderId)) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $token = $this->getAccessToken();
            if (!$token) {
                return null;
            }

            $response = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', '/v2/checkout/orders/' . urlencode($paypalOrderId) . '/capture', [], $token);
            $status = (string)($response['status'] ?? '');

            if ($status === 'COMPLETED') {
                $pu = $response['purchase_units'][0] ?? [];
                $capture = $pu['payments']['captures'][0] ?? [];
                return [
                    'order_ref'      => (string)($pu['reference_id'] ?? ''),
                    'status'         => 'approved',
                    'transaction_id' => (string)($capture['id'] ?? $paypalOrderId),
                    'total'          => (float)($capture['amount']['value'] ?? 0.0),
                    'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                ];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Obtém o Access Token de autorização OAuth2 da API v1 do PayPal.
     */
    public function getAccessToken(?string $clientId = null, ?string $clientSecret = null): ?string
    {
        $id = trim((string)($clientId ?: $this->clientId));
        $sec = trim((string)($clientSecret ?: $this->clientSecret));

        if ($id === '' || $sec === '') {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $ch = curl_init($this->getApiBaseUrl() . '/v1/oauth2/token');
            curl_setopt_array($ch, [
                CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                CURLOPT_POST           => true,
                CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS     => 'grant_type=client_credentials',
                CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
                    'Authorization: Basic ' . base64_encode($id . ':' . $sec),
                    'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    'Accept: application/json',
                ],
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 10,
            ]);
            $res = curl_exec($ch);
            $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            curl_close($ch);

            $data = json_decode((string)$res, true);
            if ($code === 200 && is_array($data) && !empty($data['access_token'])) {
                return (string)$data['access_token'];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do PayPal.
     *
     * @return array{ok: bool, message: string}
     */
    public function testCredentials(?string $clientId = null, ?string $clientSecret = null): array
    {
        $id = trim((string)($clientId ?: $this->clientId));
        $sec = trim((string)($clientSecret ?: $this->clientSecret));

        if ($id === '' || $sec === '') {
            return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Client ID e Client Secret do PayPal são obrigatórios para teste.'];
        }

        $token = $this->getAccessToken($id, $sec);
        if ($token !== null) {
            $env = $this->isSandbox() ? 'Sandbox (Testes)' : 'Produção (Live)';
            return [
                'ok'      => true,
                'message' => "PayPal Conectado com Sucesso! Autenticação OAuth2 aprovada em {$env}.",
            ];
        }

        return [
            'ok'      => false,
            'message' => 'Falha de autenticação no PayPal: Client ID ou Client Secret inválidos.',
        ];
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        $eventType = (string)($payload['event_type'] ?? '');

        if ($eventType !== 'CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED' && $eventType !== 'PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED') {
            return null;
        }

        $resource = $payload['resource'] ?? [];
        $orderRef = (string)($resource['purchase_units'][0]['reference_id'] ?? ($resource['custom_id'] ?? ''));
        $txId = (string)($resource['id'] ?? '');

        if ($orderRef === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => 'paypal',
        ];
    }

    private function sendHttpRequest(string $method, string $path, array $data = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init($this->getApiBaseUrl() . $path);
        $headers = [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . ($accessToken ?: ''),
            'Content-Type: application/json',
            'Accept: application/json',
        ];

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 15);

        if ($method === 'POST') {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($data));
        }

        $res = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($res === false || $httpCode >= 500) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha de conexão com a API do PayPal (HTTP {$httpCode}).");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$res, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/Gateways/StripeGateway.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\StripeSignatureVerifier;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com o Stripe (Cartão de Crédito Global / Internacional e Stripe Checkout Oficial).
 * Compatível com SOLID / DIP.
 */
class StripeGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $secretKey;
    private ?string $publishableKey;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;
    private string $apiBaseUrl = 'https://api.stripe.com';

    public function __construct(
        ?string $secretKey = null,
        ?string $publishableKey = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('stripe_secret_key')
                ?: (getenv('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY') ?: null));

        $this->publishableKey = $publishableKey
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('stripe_publishable_key')
                ?: (getenv('STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'stripe';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'Stripe (Cartão de Crédito Global, Apple Pay & Google Pay)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->secretKey);
    }

    public function isSandbox(): bool
    {
        if ($this->settings && (bool)$this->settings->get('stripe_sandbox', false)) {
            return true;
        }
        return str_starts_with((string)$this->secretKey, 'sk_test_');
    }

    private function resolveAbsoluteUrl(string $path): string
    {
        if (str_starts_with($path, 'http://') || str_starts_with($path, 'https://')) {
            return $path;
        }

        $scheme = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') ? 'https' : 'http';
        $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? ($_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ?? 'localhost');
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'https://')) {
            return rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }

        return $scheme . '://' . $host . $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        $total = (float)($orderData['total'] ?? 0.0);
        $studentEmail = (string)($orderData['student_email'] ?? 'aluno@exemplo.com');
        $currency = strtolower((string)($this->settings?->get('active_currency', 'BRL') ?: 'BRL'));

        if ($total <= 0.0) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Valor do pedido inválido para cobrança no Stripe.', 'stripe');
        }

        // Se estiver em modo de produção/configurado com chaves ativas
        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                $successUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/stripe/success?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
                $cancelUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/curso/' . (int)($orderData['item_id'] ?? 0) . '?cancelled=1');

                $params = [
                    'mode'                 => 'payment',
                    'customer_email'       => $studentEmail,
                    'client_reference_id'  => $orderRef,
                    'metadata'             => [
                        'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                        'item_id'   => (string)($orderData['item_id'] ?? ''),
                    ],
                    'line_items'           => [
                        [
                            'quantity'   => 1,
                            'price_data' => [
                                'currency'     => $currency,
                                'unit_amount'  => (int)round($total * 100),
                                'product_data' => [
                                    'name' => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Curso Academy - Pedido {$orderRef}"),
                                ],
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                    'success_url'          => $successUrl,
                    'cancel_url'           => $cancelUrl,
                ];

                $session = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', '/v1/checkout/sessions', $params);

                if (!empty($session['url'])) {
                    return PaymentResult::redirect(
                        $orderRef,
                        (string)$session['url'],
                        'stripe',
                        'Redirecionando para o Stripe Checkout seguro...'
                    );
                }

                $errMsg = (string)($session['error']['message'] ?? 'Falha ao criar sessão de pagamento no Stripe.');
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Stripe: ' . $errMsg, 'stripe');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Erro de comunicação com o Stripe: ' . $e->getMessage(), 'stripe');
            }
        }

        // Modo Simulação / Sandbox (somente com commerce_demo_mode=true)
        if (!(bool)($this->settings?->get('commerce_demo_mode', false))) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Gateway Stripe não configurado.', 'stripe');
        }

        return PaymentResult::approved(
            $orderRef,
            'stripe',
            'STRIPE_DEMO_' . time(),
            'Modo Demonstração: Pagamento Stripe aprovado instantaneamente!'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Consulta e valida o status de uma sessão do Stripe Checkout após o retorno do aluno.
     */
    public function verifySession(string $sessionId): ?array
    {
        if (!$this->isConfigured() || empty($sessionId)) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $session = $this->sendHttpRequest('GET', '/v1/checkout/sessions/' . urlencode($sessionId));
            if (($session['payment_status'] ?? '') === 'paid') {
                return [
                    'order_ref'      => (string)($session['client_reference_id'] ?? ($session['metadata']['order_ref'] ?? '')),
                    'status'         => 'approved',
                    'transaction_id' => (string)($session['payment_intent'] ?? $sessionId),
                    'total'          => isset($session['amount_total']) ? ((float)$session['amount_total'] / 100.0) : 0.0,
                    'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                ];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do Stripe contra a API oficial.
     *
     * @return array{ok: bool, message: string}
     */
    public function testCredentials(?string $secretKey = null): array
    {
        $key = trim((string)($secretKey ?: $this->secretKey));
        if ($key === '') {
            return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nenhuma Secret Key do Stripe informada para teste.'];
        }

        try {
            $ch = curl_init($this->apiBaseUrl . '/v1/balance');
            curl_setopt_array($ch, [
                CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
                    'Authorization: Bearer ' . $key,
                    'Accept: application/json',
                ],
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 8,
            ]);
            $res = curl_exec($ch);
            $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            curl_close($ch);

            $data = json_decode((string)$res, true);
            if ($code === 200 && is_array($data) && isset($data['object'])) {
                $env = str_starts_with($key, 'sk_test_') ? 'Modo Teste (Sandbox)' : 'Produção Real (Live)';
                return [
                    'ok'      => true,
                    'message' => "Stripe Conectado com Sucesso! Chave Secreta Válida em {$env}.",
                ];
            }

            $detail = is_array($data) ? (string)($data['error']['message'] ?? 'Credencial inválida') : "HTTP {$code}";
            return [
                'ok'      => false,
                'message' => "Falha no Stripe: {$detail} (Código HTTP {$code}).",
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [
                'ok'      => false,
                'message' => 'Erro ao comunicar com a API do Stripe: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ];
        }
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $secret = (string)($this->settings?->get('stripe_webhook_secret') ?: (getenv('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET') ?: ''));
        $raw = method_exists($request, 'rawBody') ? $request->rawBody() : '';
        if ($raw === '' && !empty($request->json())) {
            $raw = (string)json_encode($request->json());
        }

        $sigHeader = (string)($request->header('Stripe-Signature') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE'] ?? ''));
        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier($secret);
        if (!$verifier->verify($raw, ['stripe-signature' => $sigHeader])) {
            return null; // Assinatura ausente ou inválida => ignora
        }

        $payload = $request->json();
        $eventType = (string)($payload['type'] ?? '');

        if (!in_array($eventType, ['checkout.session.completed', 'payment_intent.succeeded'], true)) {
            return null;
        }

        $dataObj = $payload['data']['object'] ?? [];
        $orderRef = (string)($dataObj['client_reference_id'] ?? ($dataObj['metadata']['order_ref'] ?? ''));
        $txId = (string)($dataObj['id'] ?? '');

        if ($orderRef === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => 'stripe',
        ];
    }

    private function sendHttpRequest(string $method, string $path, array $data = []): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init($this->apiBaseUrl . $path);
        $headers = [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->secretKey,
            'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            'Accept: application/json',
        ];

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 15);

        if ($method === 'POST') {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($data));
        }

        $res = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($res === false || $httpCode >= 500) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha de conexão com a API do Stripe (HTTP {$httpCode}).");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$res, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/JsonCommerceSettings.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Persistência atômica e segura de configurações do DomainCommerce em JSON.
 * Protegido no diretório storage/commerce/.
 */
class JsonCommerceSettings implements CommerceSettingsInterface
{
    private string $filePath;
    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    private array $data = [];
    private bool $loaded = false;

    public function __construct(?string $filePath = null)
    {
        if ($filePath === null) {
            $baseDir = defined('DS_ROOT') ? DS_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);
            $filePath = $baseDir . '/storage/commerce/settings.json';
        }
        $this->filePath = $filePath;
    }

    private function load(): void
    {
        if ($this->loaded) {
            return;
        }

        $this->data = [];
        if (is_file($this->filePath)) {
            try {
                $raw = @file_get_contents($this->filePath);
                if ($raw !== false && $raw !== '') {
                    $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
                    if (is_array($decoded)) {
                        $this->data = $decoded;
                    }
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {}
        }

        $this->loaded = true;
    }

    public function get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
    {
        $this->load();
        return $this->data[$key] ?? $default;
    }

    public function set(string $key, mixed $value): void
    {
        $this->load();
        $this->data[$key] = $value;
        $this->persist();
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        $this->load();
        return $this->data;
    }

    public function save(array $settings): bool
    {
        $this->load();
        foreach ($settings as $key => $val) {
            $this->data[(string)$key] = $val;
        }
        return $this->persist();
    }

    private function persist(): bool
    {
        $dir = dirname($this->filePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        $json = json_encode($this->data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($json === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $tmpFile = $this->filePath . '.tmp.' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        if (@file_put_contents($tmpFile, $json) !== false) {
            return @rename($tmpFile, $this->filePath);
        }

        return false;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/PaymentGatewayRegistry.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;

class PaymentGatewayRegistry implements PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface
{
    /**
     * @var array<string, PaymentGatewayInterface>
     */
    private array $gateways = [];
    private ?string $defaultGatewayId = null;

    public function register(PaymentGatewayInterface $gateway, bool $overwrite = false): void
    {
        $id = $gateway->getId();
        if (isset($this->gateways[$id]) && !$overwrite) {
            throw new \DomainException("O gateway de pagamento com identificador '{$id}' já está registrado.");
        }

        $this->gateways[$id] = $gateway;

        if ($this->defaultGatewayId === null) {
            $this->defaultGatewayId = $id;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $gatewayId): ?PaymentGatewayInterface
    {
        return $this->gateways[$gatewayId] ?? null;
    }

    public function getAll(): array
    {
        return $this->gateways;
    }

    public function getDefault(): ?PaymentGatewayInterface
    {
        if ($this->defaultGatewayId !== null && isset($this->gateways[$this->defaultGatewayId])) {
            return $this->gateways[$this->defaultGatewayId];
        }

        $first = reset($this->gateways);
        return $first instanceof PaymentGatewayInterface ? $first : null;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/PurchasableItemResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemResolverInterface;

class PurchasableItemResolver implements PurchasableItemResolverInterface
{
    /**
     * @var array<string, callable(int): ?PurchasableItemInterface>
     */
    private array $resolvers = [];

    public function registerResolver(string $itemType, callable $resolver): void
    {
        $this->resolvers[$itemType] = $resolver;
    }

    public function resolve(string $itemType, int $itemId): ?PurchasableItemInterface
    {
        if (!isset($this->resolvers[$itemType])) {
            return null;
        }

        $resolver = $this->resolvers[$itemType];
        return $resolver($itemId);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/commerce/Services/StripeSignatureVerifier.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\WebhookSignatureVerifierInterface;

final class StripeSignatureVerifier implements WebhookSignatureVerifierInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private string $secret,
        private int $toleranceSeconds = 300,
        private ?int $now = null
    ) {}

    public function verify(string $rawBody, array $headers): bool
    {
        $header = (string)($headers['stripe-signature'] ?? '');
        if ($this->secret === '' || $header === '' || $rawBody === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $timestamp = null;
        $signatures = [];
        foreach (explode(',', $header) as $part) {
            [$k, $v] = array_pad(explode('=', trim($part), 2), 2, '');
            if ($k === 't') {
                $timestamp = (int)$v;
            }
            if ($k === 'v1') {
                $signatures[] = $v;
            }
        }

        if (!$timestamp || $signatures === []) {
            return false;
        }

        if (abs(($this->now ?? time()) - $timestamp) > $this->toleranceSeconds) {
            return false;
        }

        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $timestamp . '.' . $rawBody, $this->secret);
        foreach ($signatures as $sig) {
            if (hash_equals($expected, $sig)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }
}

<script>
(function() {
    var activeOrderId = null;

    function notify(msg, type) {
        if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
            window.OS.notify(msg, type);
        } else if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && typeof window.DS.ui.toast === 'function') {
            window.DS.ui.toast(msg, type);
        } else {
            console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
        }
    }

    window.dsConfirmApproval = function(orderId, orderRef) {
        activeOrderId = orderId;
        var modal = document.getElementById('dsApprovalModal');
        var refElem = document.getElementById('dsModalOrderRef');
        if (refElem) refElem.textContent = 'Pedido: ' + orderRef;
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
    };

    window.dsCloseApprovalModal = function() {
        activeOrderId = null;
        var modal = document.getElementById('dsApprovalModal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    };

    var confirmBtn = document.getElementById('dsModalConfirmBtn');
    if (confirmBtn) {
        confirmBtn.onclick = function() {
            if (!activeOrderId) return;
            var orderId = activeOrderId;
            confirmBtn.disabled = true;
            confirmBtn.textContent = 'Aprovando...';

            var formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('status', 'paid');
            formData.append('csrf_token', <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>);

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/orders/' + orderId + '/status', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?> },
                body: formData
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirmar e Liberar';
                window.dsCloseApprovalModal();

                if (data && data.success) {
                    notify('Pedido #' + orderId + ' aprovado e matrícula liberada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    setTimeout(function() { window.location.reload(); }, 1000);
                } else {
                    notify('Erro: ' + (data && data.message ? data.message : 'Falha ao atualizar pedido.'), 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirmar e Liberar';
                window.dsCloseApprovalModal();
                notify('Erro de conexão ao aprovar pedido.', 'error');
            });
        };
    }

    // Renderização dos Gráficos com Chart.js
    var timelineData = <?= json_encode($salesTimeline, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;
    var breakdownData = <?= json_encode($paymentBreakdown, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;

    function initCharts() {
        if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;

        // 1. Gráfico de Linha (Faturamento)
        var salesCtx = document.getElementById('dsSalesChart');
        if (salesCtx && timelineData && timelineData.labels) {
            var ctx = salesCtx.getContext('2d');
            var gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 200);
            gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.28)');
            gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.01)');

            new Chart(salesCtx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: timelineData.labels,
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Faturamento (R$)',
                        data: timelineData.totals,
                        borderColor: '#00d284',
                        backgroundColor: gradient,
                        borderWidth: 2.5,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.35,
                        pointBackgroundColor: '#00d284',
                        pointBorderColor: '#0f141c',
                        pointBorderWidth: 2,
                        pointRadius: timelineData.labels.length > 20 ? 2 : 4,
                        pointHoverRadius: 6,
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                            titleColor: '#f8fafc',
                            bodyColor: '#00d284',
                            borderColor: 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.3)',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 10,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    var val = Number(context.raw || 0);
                                    return ' R$ ' + val.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', borderColor: 'transparent' },
                            ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 11, family: 'system-ui' } }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', borderColor: 'transparent' },
                            ticks: {
                                color: '#64748b',
                                font: { size: 11, family: 'system-ui' },
                                callback: function(value) {
                                    return 'R$ ' + value.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // 2. Gráfico Donut (Mix de Pagamentos)
        var mixCtx = document.getElementById('dsPaymentMixChart');
        if (mixCtx && breakdownData && Object.keys(breakdownData).length > 0) {
            var mixLabels = [];
            var mixTotals = [];
            var mixColors = [];

            for (var key in breakdownData) {
                if (breakdownData.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                    mixLabels.push(breakdownData[key].label);
                    mixTotals.push(breakdownData[key].total);
                    mixColors.push(breakdownData[key].color);
                }
            }

            new Chart(mixCtx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: mixLabels,
                    datasets: [{
                        data: mixTotals,
                        backgroundColor: mixColors,
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        borderColor: '#0f141c',
                        hoverOffset: 4
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '72%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                            titleColor: '#f8fafc',
                            borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 10,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    var val = Number(context.raw || 0);
                                    return ' ' + context.label + ': R$ ' + val.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    if (typeof Chart !== 'undefined') {
        initCharts();
    } else {
        var chartScript = document.createElement('script');
        chartScript.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js';
        chartScript.async = true;
        chartScript.onload = initCharts;
        document.head.appendChild(chartScript);
    }
})();
</script>
