// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/DTO/DropshipProductDto.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO;

/**
 * DTO Imutável com a representação canônica de um produto minerado do Dropshipping.
 */
final class DropshipProductDto
{
    /**
     * @param array<int, string> $images Lista de URLs de imagens do produto
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes Especificações técnicas e variações
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $aliexpressId,
        public readonly string $title,
        public readonly string $slug,
        public readonly float $costPriceUsd,
        public readonly float $salePriceBrl,
        public readonly string $mainImageUrl,
        public readonly array $images = [],
        public readonly string $category = 'Geral',
        public readonly string $description = '',
        public readonly float $rating = 4.8,
        public readonly int $ordersCount = 0,
        public readonly array $attributes = [],
        public readonly string $status = 'published',
        public readonly ?int $id = null
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Retorna identificação estruturada do vendedor / entreposto responsável por este produto.
     *
     * @return array{seller_id: string, store_name: string, warehouse: string, aliexpress_id: string}
     */
    public function getSellerInfo(): array
    {
        $cleanAe = preg_replace('/\W+/', '', $this->aliexpressId) ?: '';
        $codeSeed = $cleanAe !== '' ? substr($cleanAe, -6) : str_pad((string)($this->id ?? 0), 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $shortSeed = substr($codeSeed, -4);
        $isNational = !empty($this->attributes['origem_brasil'])
            || (($this->attributes['ship_from'] ?? '') === 'BR');

        $sellerId = trim((string)($this->attributes['seller_id'] ?? ($this->attributes['shop_id'] ?? '')));
        if ($sellerId === '') {
            $sellerId = 'VND-' . strtoupper($codeSeed);
        }

        $storeName = trim((string)($this->attributes['seller_name'] ?? ($this->attributes['store_name'] ?? '')));
        if ($storeName === '') {
            $storeName = $isNational
                ? 'Distribuidor Oficial BR #' . $shortSeed
                : 'Fornecedor Oficial Global #' . $shortSeed;
        }

        return [
            'seller_id'     => $sellerId,
            'store_name'    => $storeName,
            'warehouse'     => $isNational ? 'Entreposto Nacional (Brasil)' : 'Centro Internacional',
            'aliexpress_id' => $this->aliexpressId,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'id'               => $this->id,
            'aliexpress_id'    => $this->aliexpressId,
            'title'            => $this->title,
            'slug'             => $this->slug,
            'cost_price_usd'   => $this->costPriceUsd,
            'sale_price_brl'   => $this->salePriceBrl,
            'main_image_url'   => $this->mainImageUrl,
            'images'           => json_encode($this->images, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'category'         => $this->category,
            'description'      => $this->description,
            'rating'           => $this->rating,
            'orders_count'     => $this->ordersCount,
            'attributes'       => json_encode($this->attributes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'status'           => $this->status,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/DTO/ScrapedProductDto.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO;

use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * DTO Imutável com Garantia Contratual de Integridade de Mídia e Origem (Clean Architecture / Value Object).
 * 
 * Garante por invariante que:
 * 1. O produto possui um ID e URL de origem válidos.
 * 2. A imagem principal (mainImageUrl) é obrigatoriamente vinculada ao produto.
 * 3. Todas as imagens da galeria (galleryImages) pertencem à mesma origem do produto.
 */
final class ScrapedProductDto
{
    /**
     * @param array<int, string> $galleryImages
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $sourceId,
        public readonly string $sourceUrl,
        public readonly string $rawTitle,
        public readonly string $mainImageUrl,
        public readonly array $galleryImages = [],
        public readonly float $costPriceUsd = 10.0,
        public readonly string $category = 'Geral',
        public readonly float $rating = 4.8,
        public readonly int $ordersCount = 0,
        public readonly array $attributes = []
    ) {
        if (trim($this->sourceId) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O identificador de origem do produto (sourceId) não pode ser vazio.');
        }

        if (trim($this->mainImageUrl) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("A imagem principal do produto {$this->sourceId} não pode ser vazia.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a lista completa e normalizada de imagens (garantindo a principal na 1ª posição).
     * 
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getAllImages(): array
    {
        $all = [];
        if (!empty($this->mainImageUrl)) {
            $all[] = $this->mainImageUrl;
        }

        foreach ($this->galleryImages as $img) {
            $img = trim($img);
            if ($img !== '' && !in_array($img, $all, true)) {
                $all[] = $img;
            }
        }

        return $all;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'source_id'      => $this->sourceId,
            'source_url'     => $this->sourceUrl,
            'raw_title'      => $this->rawTitle,
            'main_image_url' => $this->mainImageUrl,
            'gallery_images' => $this->galleryImages,
            'cost_price_usd' => $this->costPriceUsd,
            'category'       => $this->category,
            'rating'         => $this->rating,
            'orders_count'   => $this->ordersCount,
            'attributes'     => $this->attributes,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Plugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Adapters\DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AiProductEnricherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CurrencyConverterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMediaSyncInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipCatalogRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AiProductEnricherService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressLinkScraperService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\CurrencyConverterService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\ProductMediaSyncService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\ProductMiningService;
use Throwable;

/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PLUGIN: DomainDrop (Motor Autônomo de Dropshipping & Mineração E-commerce)
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Responsável pelo Hub central de dropshipping, integração direta com a API
 * AliExpress Open Platform (App ISV Drop Shipping 558628), conversão cambial
 * em tempo real, enriquecimento de produtos com IA e orquestração de catálogo.
 */
class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void
    {
    }

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->requireLink('core.session');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers');
        $os->listenHook('payment.approved');
        $os->listenHook('theme.blocks.register');
        $os->listenHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $root = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $configFile = $root . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';

        // 1. Injeção de Dependências no Container via Contratos (SOLID / DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(CurrencyConverterInterface::class, function () use ($root, $configFile) {
            $markup = 100.0;
            $minMargin = 30.0;
            if (file_exists($configFile)) {
                $data = @json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
                if (is_array($data)) {
                    $markup = (float)($data['default_markup_percent'] ?? $markup);
                    $minMargin = (float)($data['min_profit_margin_brl'] ?? $minMargin);
                }
            }

            return new CurrencyConverterService(
                cacheDirOrFile: $root . '/storage/cache/exchange_rates.json',
                defaultMarkupPercent: $markup,
                minProfitBrl: $minMargin
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class, function () use ($configFile) {
            $appKey = '558628';
            $appSecret = '';
            $accessToken = null;

            if (file_exists($configFile)) {
                $data = @json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
                if (is_array($data)) {
                    $appKey = (string)($data['app_key'] ?? $appKey);
                    $appSecret = (string)($data['app_secret'] ?? '');
                    $accessToken = !empty($data['access_token']) ? (string)$data['access_token'] : null;
                }
            }

            return new AliExpressApiClient(
                appKey: $appKey,
                appSecret: $appSecret,
                gatewayUrl: 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync',
                timeout: 15,
                accessToken: $accessToken
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(AiProductEnricherInterface::class, function () {
            return new AiProductEnricherService();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoDropshipOrderRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProductLinkScraperInterface::class, function () {
            return new AliExpressLinkScraperService();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProductMediaSyncInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new ProductMediaSyncService(
                repository: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                scraper: $runtime->make(ProductLinkScraperInterface::class),
                aiEnricher: $runtime->make(AiProductEnricherInterface::class),
                currencyConverter: $runtime->make(CurrencyConverterInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProductMiningServiceInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new ProductMiningService(
                apiClient: $runtime->make(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class),
                currencyConverter: $runtime->make(CurrencyConverterInterface::class),
                aiEnricher: $runtime->make(AiProductEnricherInterface::class),
                repository: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                linkScraper: $runtime->make(ProductLinkScraperInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipAdminController::class, function () use ($runtime, $root) {
            return new DropshipAdminController(
                catalogRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                miningService: $runtime->make(ProductMiningServiceInterface::class),
                currencyConverter: $runtime->make(CurrencyConverterInterface::class),
                session: $runtime->getLink('core.session'),
                orderRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class),
                mediaSync: $runtime->make(ProductMediaSyncInterface::class),
                basePath: $root
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $themeManager = null;
            try {
                $themeManager = $runtime->getLink('core.theme');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
            }

            return new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController(
                catalogRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                themeManager: $themeManager,
                miningService: $runtime->make(ProductMiningServiceInterface::class),
                orderRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class),
                apiClient: $runtime->make(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class)
            );
        });

        // 2. Menu Administrativo
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role = 'guest') {
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title'   => 'DomainDrop',
                    'url'     => '#',
                    'icon'    => '📦',
                    'submenu' => [
                        [
                            'title' => 'Catálogo & Mineração',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship',
                            'icon'  => '🛰️',
                        ],
                        [
                            'title' => 'Pedidos Dropshipping',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship/orders',
                            'icon'  => '🛍️',
                        ],
                        [
                            'title' => 'Configurações & API',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship/settings',
                            'icon'  => '⚙️',
                        ],
                    ],
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // 3. Rotas Administrativas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function (Router $router) {
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'index'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/mine', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'mine'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/import-url', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'importUrl'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/import-browser-source', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'importBrowserSource'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship/orders', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'orders'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/orders/{id}/fulfillment', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'updateFulfillment'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship/settings', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'settings'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/settings', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'saveSettings'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/test-connection', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'testConnection'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/product/{id}/sync-images', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'syncImages'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/product/{id}/price', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'updatePrice'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/run-daily-cycle', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'runDailyCycle'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/sync-all-images', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'syncAllImages'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/delete/{id}', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'delete'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);

            // 4. Rotas Públicas da Loja Virtual & Vitrine de Produtos
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/loja', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'storefront'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/produto/{slug}', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'singleProduct'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/rastrear', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'trackOrder'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/politica-de-envio', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'shippingPolicy'], 'domain_drop');
        });

        // 4. Integração com DomainCommerce (Resolução de Itens Vendáveis no Checkout)
        $runtime->onHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers', function ($resolver) use ($runtime) {
            if ($resolver instanceof PurchasableItemResolverInterface) {
                $resolveDropshipItem = function (int $id) use ($runtime) {
                    try {
                        /** @var DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $repo */
                        $repo = $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $product = $repo->findById($id);
                        return $product !== null ? new DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter($product) : null;
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                };

                $resolver->registerResolver('dropship_product', $resolveDropshipItem);
                $resolver->registerResolver('dropship', $resolveDropshipItem);
                $resolver->registerResolver('product', $resolveDropshipItem);
            }
        });

        // 5. Integração com Pagamentos Aprovados (Criação de Pedido de Dropshipping)
        $runtime->onHook('payment.approved', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $itemType = (string)($payload['item_type'] ?? '');
            $itemId = (int)($payload['item_id'] ?? ($payload['course_id'] ?? 0));
            $orderRef = (string)($payload['order_ref'] ?? '');

            if (in_array($itemType, ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true) && $orderRef !== '') {
                try {
                    /** @var DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo */
                    $orderRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class);
                    $existing = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                    if ($existing === null) {
                        $orderRepo->create([
                            'order_ref'          => $orderRef,
                            'customer_name'      => (string)($payload['customer_name'] ?? 'Cliente'),
                            'customer_email'     => (string)($payload['customer_email'] ?? ''),
                            'customer_document'  => isset($payload['customer_document']) ? (string)$payload['customer_document'] : null,
                            'shipping_address'    => isset($payload['shipping_address']) ? $payload['shipping_address'] : null,
                            'status'             => 'paid',
                            'total_paid_brl'     => (float)($payload['total'] ?? 0.0),
                        ]);
                    } else {
                        $orderRepo->updateFulfillment($orderRef, 'paid');
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento de falha
                }
            }
        });

        // 6. Registro de Blocos Semânticos no Flex Builder via Contrato (SOLID - OCP / DIP)
        $registerDropshipBlocks = function ($registry) use ($runtime) {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'has') && !$registry->has('dropship_showcase')) {
                try {
                    $provider = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipBlockProvider(
                        $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
                    );
                    $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento gracioso
                }
            }
        };

        $runtime->onHook('theme.blocks.register', $registerDropshipBlocks);
        $runtime->onHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks', $registerDropshipBlocks);

        // 7. Shortcode para Vitrine de Dropshipping: [dropship_vitrine limit="8" cols="4" category=""]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('dropship_vitrine', function ($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    $block = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipShowcaseBlock(
                        $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
                    );
                    $attributes = [
                        'limit'    => isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 8,
                        'columns'  => isset($attrs['cols']) ? (int)$attrs['cols'] : (isset($attrs['columns']) ? (int)$attrs['columns'] : 4),
                        'category' => isset($attrs['category']) ? (string)$attrs['category'] : '',
                        'title'    => isset($attrs['title']) ? (string)$attrs['title'] : 'Tendências em Alta & Mais Vendidos',
                    ];
                    return $block->render($attributes);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94;'>Vitrine Dropshipping em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Repositories/PdoDropshipCatalogRepository.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para o Catálogo de Produtos Minerados do DomainDrop (DIP / SRP).
 */
class PdoDropshipCatalogRepository implements DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
    }

    public function save(DropshipProductDto $product): int
    {
        $existing = $this->findByAliExpressId($product->aliexpressId);
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $imagesJson = json_encode($product->images, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        $attrJson = json_encode($product->attributes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        if ($existing !== null && $existing->id !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
                SET title = ?, slug = ?, cost_price_usd = ?, sale_price_brl = ?,
                    main_image_url = ?, images = ?, category = ?, description = ?,
                    rating = ?, orders_count = ?, attributes = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");

            $stmt->execute([
                $product->title,
                $product->slug,
                $product->costPriceUsd,
                $product->salePriceBrl,
                $product->mainImageUrl,
                $imagesJson,
                $product->category,
                $product->description,
                $product->rating,
                $product->ordersCount,
                $attrJson,
                $product->status,
                $now,
                $existing->id,
            ]);

            return $existing->id;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_catalog
                (aliexpress_id, title, slug, cost_price_usd, sale_price_brl, main_image_url, images, category, description, rating, orders_count, attributes, status, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $product->aliexpressId,
            $product->title,
            $product->slug,
            $product->costPriceUsd,
            $product->salePriceBrl,
            $product->mainImageUrl,
            $imagesJson,
            $product->category,
            $product->description,
            $product->rating,
            $product->ordersCount,
            $attrJson,
            $product->status,
            $now,
            $now,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function findByAliExpressId(string $aliexpressId): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE aliexpress_id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$aliexpressId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE slug = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function list(array $criteria = [], int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($criteria['category'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildCategoryClause((string)$criteria['category'], $params);
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['slug'])) {
            $where[] = "slug = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['slug'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['search'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildSearchClause((string)$criteria['search'], $params);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where);
        }

        $orderBy = "id DESC";
        if (!empty($criteria['sort'])) {
            $sortVal = (string)$criteria['sort'];
            if ($sortVal === 'sales' || $sortVal === 'best_sellers' || $sortVal === 'volume_desc') {
                $orderBy = "orders_count DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'price_asc') {
                $orderBy = "sale_price_brl ASC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'price_desc') {
                $orderBy = "sale_price_brl DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'rating') {
                $orderBy = "rating DESC, id DESC";
            }
        }

        $sql .= " ORDER BY {$orderBy} LIMIT {$limit} OFFSET {$offset}";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'hydrate'], $rows);
    }

    public function count(array $criteria = []): int
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($criteria['category'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildCategoryClause((string)$criteria['category'], $params);
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['slug'])) {
            $where[] = "slug = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['slug'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['search'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildSearchClause((string)$criteria['search'], $params);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_catalog";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    /**
     * Constrói cláusula SQL inteligente para busca textual tolerante a tokens, plural/singular,
     * remoção de preposições (stop words) e sinônimos frequentes de mercado.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    public function buildSearchClause(string $search, array &$params): string
    {
        $search = trim($search);
        if ($search === '') {
            return '1=1';
        }

        $stopWords = ['de', 'da', 'do', 'das', 'dos', 'em', 'na', 'no', 'nas', 'nos', 'com', 'por', 'para', 'pra', 'um', 'uma', 'uns', 'umas', 'e', 'ou', 'a', 'o', 'as', 'os', 'ao', 'aos', 'que', 'se'];

        // Separa em palavras/tokens limpos
        $rawTokens = preg_split('/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u', mb_strtolower($search, 'UTF-8'), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) ?: [];

        // Filtra stop words se sobrarem outros termos significativos
        $filtered = array_values(array_filter($rawTokens, fn($t) => !in_array($t, $stopWords, true)));
        $tokens = !empty($filtered) ? $filtered : $rawTokens;

        if (empty($tokens)) {
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            return "(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?)";
        }

        $tokenClauses = [];
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            $variants = [$token];

            // 1. Versão sem acentos
            $unaccented = preg_replace(
                ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u'],
                ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c'],
                $token
            );
            if ($unaccented !== $token) {
                $variants[] = $unaccented;
            }

            // 2. Singular / Plural inteligente em português
            if (mb_strlen($token, 'UTF-8') > 3 && str_ends_with($token, 's')) {
                $variants[] = mb_substr($token, 0, -1, 'UTF-8');
                if (str_ends_with($token, 'es')) {
                    $variants[] = mb_substr($token, 0, -2, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } elseif (mb_strlen($token, 'UTF-8') >= 3) {
                $variants[] = $token . 's';
            }

            // 3. Normalização das variantes geradas
            foreach ($variants as $v) {
                $unacc = preg_replace(
                    ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u'],
                    ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c'],
                    $v
                );
                if ($unacc !== $v) {
                    $variants[] = $unacc;
                }
            }

            // 4. Sinônimos de mercado comuns
            if (in_array($unaccented, ['relogio', 'relogios', 'smartwatch', 'smartwatches', 'watch'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'relogio';
                $variants[] = 'relógio';
                $variants[] = 'smartwatch';
                $variants[] = 'watch';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['fone', 'fones', 'ouvido', 'tws', 'headset'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'fone';
                $variants[] = 'tws';
                $variants[] = 'ouvido';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['lampada', 'lampadas', 'luminaria', 'luminarias'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'lampada';
                $variants[] = 'lâmpada';
                $variants[] = 'luminaria';
                $variants[] = 'luminária';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['secador', 'secadora', 'secadores', 'escova', 'escovas'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'secador';
                $variants[] = 'secadora';
                $variants[] = 'escova';
            }

            $variants = array_unique(array_filter($variants, fn($v) => mb_strlen($v, 'UTF-8') >= 2));

            $subClauses = [];
            foreach ($variants as $v) {
                $subClauses[] = "(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?)";
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
            }

            $tokenClauses[] = '(' . implode(' OR ', $subClauses) . ')';
        }

        return '(' . implode(' AND ', $tokenClauses) . ')';
    }

    /**
     * Constrói cláusula SQL inteligente para categoria com tolerância a apelidos e termos semânticos.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    private function buildCategoryClause(string $category, array &$params): string
    {
        $raw = trim($category);
        $lower = mb_strtolower($raw, 'UTF-8');

        return match ($lower) {
            'tecnologia', 'tecnologia & gadgets', 'gadgets', 'eletrônicos', 'eletrônicos & gadget', 'eletronicos', 'eletronicos & gadget' =>
                "(category IN ('Tecnologia & Gadgets', 'Eletrônicos & Gadget', 'Eletrônicos') OR category LIKE '%Tecnologia%' OR category LIKE '%Eletrônicos%' OR category LIKE '%Eletronicos%' OR category LIKE '%Gadget%')",

            'smartwatches', 'smartwatch', 'smartwatches & áudio', 'smartwatches & audio', 'áudio', 'audio' =>
                "(category IN ('Smartwatches & Áudio', 'Smartwatches & Audio') OR category LIKE '%Smartwatch%' OR category LIKE '%Áudio%' OR category LIKE '%Audio%' OR title LIKE '%Smartwatch%' OR title LIKE '%Relógio%' OR title LIKE '%Watch%' OR title LIKE '%Fone%' OR title LIKE '%Tws%')",

            'casa', 'casa inteligente', 'casa inteligente & organização', 'casa inteligente & organizacao', 'casa & organização' =>
                "(category IN ('Casa Inteligente', 'Casa Inteligente & Organização') OR category LIKE '%Casa%')",

            'acessorios', 'acessórios', 'acessórios virais', 'acessorios virais', 'ferramentas', 'ferramentas & utilidades' =>
                "(category IN ('Acessórios Virais', 'Ferramentas & Utilidades', 'Acessórios para Veículos') OR category LIKE '%Acessório%' OR category LIKE '%Acessorio%' OR category LIKE '%Ferramenta%')",

            'beleza', 'saúde', 'saude', 'saúde & cuidados', 'saude & cuidados', 'beleza, cuidados & estilo', 'estilo' =>
                "(category IN ('Saúde & Cuidados', 'Beleza, Cuidados & Estilo') OR category LIKE '%Beleza%' OR category LIKE '%Saúde%' OR category LIKE '%Saude%' OR category LIKE '%Cuidado%')",

            'moda', 'roupas', 'vestuário', 'vestuario', 'moda, roupas & vestuário', 'moda, roupas & vestuario', 'moda & vestuário' =>
                "(category IN ('Moda, Roupas & Vestuário', 'Roupas', 'Vestuário') OR category LIKE '%Moda%' OR category LIKE '%Roupa%' OR category LIKE '%Vestuário%' OR category LIKE '%Vestuario%')",

            'lingerie', 'lingeries', 'moda íntima', 'moda intima', 'moda íntima, lingeries & pijamas', 'moda intima, lingeries & pijamas', 'pijamas' =>
                "(category IN ('Moda Íntima, Lingeries & Pijamas', 'Lingeries') OR category LIKE '%Lingerie%' OR category LIKE '%Íntima%' OR category LIKE '%Intima%')",

            'sex shop', 'sexshop', 'adulto', 'adultos', 'produtos adultos', 'sex shop & produtos adultos (+18)', '+18' =>
                "(category IN ('Sex Shop & Produtos Adultos (+18)', 'Sex Shop') OR category LIKE '%Sex Shop%' OR category LIKE '%Adulto%' OR category LIKE '%+18%')",

            'pets', 'pet shop', 'pet shop & pets virais' =>
                "(category IN ('Pet Shop & Pets Virais', 'Pet Shop') OR category LIKE '%Pet%')",

            'veiculos', 'veículos', 'acessórios para veículos', 'acessorios para veiculos', 'automotivo' =>
                "(category IN ('Acessórios para Veículos') OR category LIKE '%Veículo%' OR category LIKE '%Veiculo%' OR category LIKE '%Auto%')",

            default => (function() use ($raw, &$params) {
                $params[] = $raw;
                $params[] = '%' . $raw . '%';
                return "(category = ? OR category LIKE ?)";
            })()
        };
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function updatePrice(int $id, float $salePriceBrl, ?float $costPriceUsd = null): bool
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        if ($costPriceUsd !== null && $costPriceUsd >= 0) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
                SET sale_price_brl = ?, cost_price_usd = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            return $stmt->execute([$salePriceBrl, $costPriceUsd, $now, $id]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
            SET sale_price_brl = ?, updated_at = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$salePriceBrl, $now, $id]);
    }

    public function getCategories(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT DISTINCT category FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE category != '' ORDER BY category ASC");
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN) : [];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     */
    private function hydrate(array $row): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $images = [];
        if (!empty($row['images'])) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['images'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $images = $decoded;
            }
        }

        $attributes = [];
        if (!empty($row['attributes'])) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['attributes'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $attributes = $decoded;
            }
        }

        return new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: (string)$row['aliexpress_id'],
            title: (string)$row['title'],
            slug: (string)$row['slug'],
            costPriceUsd: (float)($row['cost_price_usd'] ?? 0.0),
            salePriceBrl: (float)($row['sale_price_brl'] ?? 0.0),
            mainImageUrl: (string)$row['main_image_url'],
            images: $images,
            category: (string)($row['category'] ?? 'Geral'),
            description: (string)($row['description'] ?? ''),
            rating: (float)($row['rating'] ?? 4.8),
            ordersCount: (int)($row['orders_count'] ?? 0),
            attributes: $attributes,
            status: (string)($row['status'] ?? 'published'),
            id: (int)$row['id']
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Repositories/PdoDropshipOrderRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para Ordens de Dropshipping (SRP / DIP).
 */
class PdoDropshipOrderRepository implements DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $sql = "INSERT INTO domain_drop_orders (
            order_ref, customer_name, customer_email, customer_document,
            shipping_address, aliexpress_order_id, tracking_code, status,
            total_paid_brl, created_at, updated_at
        ) VALUES (
            :order_ref, :customer_name, :customer_email, :customer_document,
            :shipping_address, :aliexpress_order_id, :tracking_code, :status,
            :total_paid_brl, :created_at, :updated_at
        )";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        $stmt->execute([
            ':order_ref'           => (string)($data['order_ref'] ?? uniqid('ORD_DROP_')),
            ':customer_name'        => (string)($data['customer_name'] ?? 'Cliente'),
            ':customer_email'       => (string)($data['customer_email'] ?? ''),
            ':customer_document'    => isset($data['customer_document']) ? (string)$data['customer_document'] : null,
            ':shipping_address'     => isset($data['shipping_address']) ? (is_array($data['shipping_address']) ? json_encode($data['shipping_address'], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) : (string)$data['shipping_address']) : null,
            ':aliexpress_order_id'  => isset($data['aliexpress_order_id']) ? (string)$data['aliexpress_order_id'] : null,
            ':tracking_code'        => isset($data['tracking_code']) ? (string)$data['tracking_code'] : null,
            ':status'               => (string)($data['status'] ?? 'pending'),
            ':total_paid_brl'       => (float)($data['total_paid_brl'] ?? 0.0),
            ':created_at'           => $now,
            ':updated_at'           => $now,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders WHERE order_ref = :ref LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':ref' => $orderRef]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function updateFulfillment(string $orderRef, string $status, ?string $aliExpressOrderId = null, ?string $trackingCode = null): bool
    {
        $fields = ['status = :status', 'updated_at = :updated_at'];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':status'     => $status,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if ($aliExpressOrderId !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'aliexpress_order_id = :ae_id';
            $params[':ae_id'] = $aliExpressOrderId;
        }

        if ($trackingCode !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'tracking_code = :track';
            $params[':track'] = $trackingCode;
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function list(array $filters = [], int $limit = 50, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($filters['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = :st";
            $params[':st'] = (string)$filters['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($filters['search'])) {
            $term = '%' . (string)$filters['search'] . '%';
            $where[] = "(order_ref LIKE :q1 OR customer_name LIKE :q2 OR customer_email LIKE :q3 OR tracking_code LIKE :q4)";
            $params[':q1'] = $term;
            $params[':q2'] = $term;
            $params[':q3'] = $term;
            $params[':q4'] = $term;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(' AND ', $where);
        }
        $sql .= " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT " . (int)$limit . " OFFSET " . (int)$offset;

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Services/AiProductEnricherService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AiProductEnricherInterface;

/**
 * Motor de Higienização de Títulos e Copywriting de Produtos (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Transforma os textos poluídos e genéricos do AliExpress em páginas de produtos
 * profissionais, com títulos concisos e descrições orientadas à conversão (AIDA).
 */
class AiProductEnricherService implements AiProductEnricherInterface
{
    /**
     * Palavras e termos de spam frequentemente encontrados em anúncios brutos da China.
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    private array $spamKeywords = [
        '2024', '2025', '2026', 'novo', 'nova', 'novos', 'novas',
        'quente', 'venda', 'promoção', 'barato', 'frete grátis',
        'alta qualidade', 'top', 'luxo', 'moda', 'marca', 'original',
        'atacado', 'china', 'direto da fábrica', 'melhor preço', 'aliexpress',
        'hot sale', 'new', 'luxury', 'free shipping', 'drop shipping', 'dropshipping', 'dropship',
    ];

    public function polishTitle(string $rawTitle, ?string $category = null): string
    {
        $clean = trim($rawTitle);

        // 1. Remove termos de spam comuns
        foreach ($this->spamKeywords as $spam) {
            $pattern = '/\b' . preg_quote($spam, '/') . '\b/iu';
            $clean = (string)preg_replace($pattern, '', $clean);
        }

        // 2. Remove caracteres estranhos repetidos (ex: |||, ***, ---, [ ])
        $clean = (string)preg_replace('/[\[\]\|\*\#\_]+/', ' ', $clean);
        $clean = (string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $clean);
        $clean = trim($clean, " -.,:;\t\n\r\0\x0B");

        // 3. Limita o tamanho do título para 65-80 caracteres (ideal para SEO e e-commerce)
        $words = explode(' ', $clean);
        if (count($words) > 10) {
            $words = array_slice($words, 0, 10);
            $clean = implode(' ', $words);
        }

        // 4. Formata com inicial maiúscula elegante
        $clean = mb_convert_case($clean, MB_CASE_TITLE, 'UTF-8');

        if ($clean === '' && $category !== null) {
            return "Produto Premium - {$category}";
        }

        return $clean !== '' ? $clean : 'Produto Importado Exclusivo';
    }

    public function generateSalesCopy(string $rawDescription, array $attributes = []): string
    {
        $cleanText = strip_tags($rawDescription);
        $cleanText = (string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $cleanText);
        $summary = mb_substr(trim($cleanText), 0, 320);

        $specsHtml = '';
        if (!empty($attributes)) {
            $specsHtml .= '<div style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">';
            $specsHtml .= '<h4 style="margin-top:0; color:#45f3ff; font-size:14px; text-transform:uppercase;">📐 Especificações Técnicas</h4>';
            $specsHtml .= '<ul style="margin:0; padding-left:20px; font-size:13px; color:#cbd5e1; line-height:1.7;">';
            foreach ($attributes as $k => $v) {
                if (is_scalar($v) && trim((string)$v) !== '') {
                    $specsHtml .= '<li><strong>' . htmlspecialchars((string)$k) . ':</strong> ' . htmlspecialchars((string)$v) . '</li>';
                }
            }
            $specsHtml .= '</ul></div>';
        }

        return <<<HTML
<div class="domain-drop-product-description" style="font-size:14px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--text-main, #cbd5e1);">
    <p style="font-size:15px; font-weight:500; color:#fff; margin-bottom:16px;">
        {$summary}...
    </p>

    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap:12px; margin:20px 0;">
        <div style="background:rgba(0,210,132,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(0,210,132,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:12px;">
            <strong style="color:#00d284; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">✨ Qualidade Comprovada</strong>
            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Item selecionado entre os mais bem avaliados do catálogo internacional.</span>
        </div>
        <div style="background:rgba(69,243,255,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:12px;">
            <strong style="color:#45f3ff; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">🚚 Envio com Rastreio</strong>
            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Código de rastreamento enviado automaticamente no seu WhatsApp e E-mail.</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    {$specsHtml}
</div>
HTML;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Services/AliExpressApiClient.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Cliente Oficial de Comunicação com a AliExpress Open Platform API (DIP / SOLID).
 * 
 * Implementa o protocolo de assinatura criptográfica oficial HMAC-SHA256 (IOP Protocol),
 * compatível com o gateway internacional: https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync.
 */
class AliExpressApiClient implements AliExpressApiClientInterface
{
    private string $appKey;
    private string $appSecret;
    private string $gatewayUrl;
    private int $timeout;
    private string $sdkVersion = 'iop-sdk-php-20220608';

    public function __construct(
        string $appKey,
        string $appSecret,
        string $gatewayUrl = 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync',
        int $timeout = 15,
        private ?string $accessToken = null
    ) {
        $this->appKey = trim($appKey);
        $this->appSecret = trim($appSecret);
        $this->gatewayUrl = rtrim($gatewayUrl, '/');
        $this->timeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function execute(string $apiMethod, array $params = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array
    {
        if ($this->appKey === '' || $this->appSecret === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('[AliExpressApiClient] AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados no DomainDrop.');
        }

        $token = $accessToken ?? $this->accessToken;

        $sysParams = [
            'app_key'     => $this->appKey,
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'timestamp'   => $this->getMillisecondTimestamp(),
            'method'      => $apiMethod,
            'partner_id'  => $this->sdkVersion,
            'format'      => 'json',
            'simplify'    => 'true',
        ];

        if ($token !== null && $token !== '') {
            $sysParams['session'] = $token;
        }

        // Combina parâmetros de sistema e de API para cálculo da assinatura
        $allParams = array_merge($params, $sysParams);
        $sysParams['sign'] = $this->generateSignature($apiMethod, $allParams);

        // Monta a Query String dos parâmetros de sistema
        $requestUrl = $this->gatewayUrl . '?' . http_build_query($sysParams);

        return $this->sendHttpRequest($requestUrl, $params);
    }

    public function getProductDetails(string|int $productId, string $targetLanguage = 'pt', string $targetCurrency = 'USD'): array
    {
        $numericId = (string)$productId;
        // Se for URL completa do AliExpress, extrai o ID numérico
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/', $numericId, $matches)) {
            $numericId = $matches[1];
        }

        $params = [
            'product_id'      => $numericId,
            'target_language' => $targetLanguage,
            'target_currency' => $targetCurrency,
            'ship_to_country' => 'BR',
        ];

        return $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.product.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
    }

    public function searchProducts(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $sort = (string)($filters['sort'] ?? 'volume_desc');
        $mappedSort = match ($sort) {
            'evaluate_rate_desc' => 'LAST_VOLUME_DESC',
            'choice_desc'        => 'SALE_PRICE_ASC',
            default              => 'LAST_VOLUME_DESC',
        };

        $params = [
            'category_id'       => (string)($filters['category_id'] ?? ''),
            'keywords'          => (string)($filters['keywords'] ?? 'trending'),
            'page_size'         => (string)($filters['page_size'] ?? '20'),
            'page_no'           => (string)($filters['page_no'] ?? '1'),
            'sort'              => $mappedSort,
            'feed_name'         => (string)($filters['feed_name'] ?? 'DS bestseller'),
            'target_language'   => 'pt',
            'target_currency'   => 'USD',
            'ship_to_country'   => (string)($filters['ship_to_country'] ?? 'BR'),
            'ship_from_country' => (string)($filters['ship_from_country'] ?? 'BR'),
        ];

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.recommend.feed.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [];
        }

        // Normaliza diferentes formatos de payload do IOP SDK (feed ou busca de produtos)
        $products = $response['result']['products']['traffic_product_d_t_o']
            ?? ($response['result']['products']['product'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_recommend_feed_get_response']['result']['products']['traffic_product_d_t_o'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_recommend_feed_get_response']['result']['products'] ?? []);

        return is_array($products) ? $products : [];
    }

    public function queryTrackingInfo(
        string $logisticsNo,
        string $origin = 'ESCROW',
        string $outRef = '',
        string $serviceName = 'CAINIAO',
        string $toArea = 'BR'
    ): array {
        $logisticsNo = trim($logisticsNo);
        if ($logisticsNo === '' && trim($outRef) === '') {
            return [];
        }

        $params = [
            'logistics_no' => $logisticsNo,
            'origin'       => $origin !== '' ? $origin : 'ESCROW',
            'out_ref'      => trim($outRef),
            'service_name' => $serviceName !== '' ? $serviceName : 'CAINIAO',
            'to_area'      => $toArea !== '' ? strtoupper($toArea) : 'BR',
        ];

        $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.logistics.ds.trackinginfo.query', $params, $this->accessToken);

        $details = $response['result']['details']['details']
            ?? ($response['result']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['details']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['result']['details']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['result']['details'] ?? []);

        return [
            'official_website' => (string)($response['result']['official_website'] ?? $response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['official_website'] ?? ''),
            'details'          => is_array($details) ? $details : [],
            'raw'              => $response,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Algoritmo Oficial de Assinatura IOP da AliExpress Open Platform.
     * 1. Ordena parâmetros alfabeticamente por chave (ksort).
     * 2. Concatena chave e valor em string corrida.
     * 3. Calcula HMAC-SHA256 em maiúsculas usando o AppSecret.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $params
     */
    public function generateSignature(string $apiMethod, array $params): string
    {
        ksort($params);

        $stringToBeSigned = '';
        if (str_contains($apiMethod, '/')) {
            $stringToBeSigned .= $apiMethod;
        }

        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $stringToBeSigned .= "$k$v";
            }
        }

        return strtoupper(hash_hmac('sha256', $stringToBeSigned, $this->appSecret));
    }

    /**
     * Retorna o timestamp em milissegundos exigido pela AliExpress API.
     */
    private function getMillisecondTimestamp(): string
    {
        return (string)(int)(microtime(true) * 1000);
    }

    /**
     * Executa requisição HTTP segura via cURL com POST.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $postData
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function sendHttpRequest(string $url, array $postData = []): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($postData));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $this->timeout);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, $this->sdkVersion);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);

        $rawResponse = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $error = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($rawResponse === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("[AliExpressApiClient] Falha na conexão com o gateway do AliExpress: {$error}");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);

        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            // Se vier XML ou erro de gateway
            return [
                'raw_response' => (string)$rawResponse,
                'http_code'    => $httpCode,
            ];
        }

        // Se o AliExpress retornar erro formal na resposta
        if (isset($decoded['code']) && (int)$decoded['code'] !== 0 && !isset($decoded['result'])) {
            $msg = $decoded['message'] ?? ($decoded['sub_msg'] ?? 'Erro desconhecido da AliExpress API');
            throw new RuntimeException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$decoded['code']}] {$msg}");
        }

        return $decoded;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Services/AliExpressLinkScraperService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Motor de Scraping em Tempo Real para Links Oficiais do AliExpress (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Extrai diretamente do HTML da página pública:
 * - Imagem de capa oficial (og:image) em alta resolução
 * - Galeria completa de imagens Full HD (imagePathList)
 * - Título original do fornecedor
 * - Preço promocional em vigor (pdp_npi)
 */
class AliExpressLinkScraperService implements ProductLinkScraperInterface
{
    public function canHandle(string $urlOrId): bool
    {
        $trim = trim($urlOrId);
        if (str_contains($trim, 'aliexpress.com') || str_contains($trim, 'aliexpress-media.com')) {
            return true;
        }

        // Verifica se é um ID numérico típico do AliExpress (10 a 20 dígitos)
        return (bool)preg_match('/^\d{10,20}$/', $trim);
    }

    public function scrape(string $urlOrId): ?ScrapedProductDto
    {
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($urlOrId);
        if ($productId === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html?country=BR&locale=pt_BR&currency=BRL";
        $targetUrl = str_starts_with($urlOrId, 'http') ? $urlOrId : $canonicalUrl;

        try {
            $html = $this->fetchHtml($targetUrl);
            if ($html === null || strlen($html) < 200) {
                return null;
            }

            return $this->parseRawHtml($html, $targetUrl);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function parseRawHtml(string $rawSource, string $sourceUrl = ''): ?ScrapedProductDto
    {
        if (trim($rawSource) === '') {
            return null;
        }

        // 1. Filtro de Link Morto / 404 / Página Desativada / Desafio Anti-Robô (Slider Captcha)
        if (stripos($rawSource, 'Página não encontrada') !== false 
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Page Not Found') !== false 
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Item no longer available') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Não conseguimos encontrar esta página') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Arraste o controle deslizante') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'controle deslizante para verificar') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'verificação garante acesso normal') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'sec.aliexpress.com') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'slide to verify') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'rgv587_flag') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // 2. Extração do Product ID
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($sourceUrl);
        if ($productId === '') {
            if (preg_match('/(?:productId|itemId)["\']?\s*:\s*["\']?(\d{10,20})["\']?/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            } elseif (preg_match('/item\/(\d{10,20})\.html/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            } elseif (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            }
        }

        if ($productId === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html";

        // 3. Extração do Título
        $title = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:title" content="([^"]+)"/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        } elseif (preg_match('/<title>([^<]+)<\/title>/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        } elseif (preg_match('/["\'](?:subject|title|productTitle)["\']\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode($m[1]);
        }

        if (empty($title) 
            || stripos($title, 'Página não encontrada') !== false 
            || stripos($title, 'Page Not Found') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // 4. Extração da Imagem Principal
        $mainImage = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:image" content="([^"]+)"/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $mainImage = $this->cleanImageUrl($m[1]);
        }

        // 5. Extração da Galeria Completa (imagePathList ou regex de CDN)
        $gallery = [];
        if (preg_match('/"imagePathList":(\[[^\]]+\])/', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($m[1], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                foreach ($decoded as $img) {
                    $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl((string)$img);
                    if ($clean !== '' && !in_array($clean, $gallery, true)) {
                        $gallery[] = $clean;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Se imagePathList não veio ou veio vazio, busca todas as imagens do CDN no código
        if (empty($gallery)) {
            preg_match_all('/https?:\/\/(?:ae-pic-[a-z0-9\-]+\.aliexpress-media\.com|[a-z0-9\-]+\.alicdn\.com)\/kf\/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp)/i', $rawSource, $allCdnImgs);
            if (!empty($allCdnImgs[0])) {
                foreach ($allCdnImgs[0] as $cdnImg) {
                    $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl($cdnImg);
                    if ($clean !== '' && !in_array($clean, $gallery, true)) {
                        $gallery[] = $clean;
                    }
                    if (count($gallery) >= 8) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($gallery) && !empty($mainImage)) {
            $gallery[] = $mainImage;
        }

        if (empty($mainImage) && !empty($gallery)) {
            $mainImage = $gallery[0];
        }

        if (empty($mainImage)) {
            return null;
        }

        // 6. Preço Promocional
        $costPriceUsd = 12.0;
        $decodedFull = urldecode($sourceUrl . ' ' . $rawSource);
        if (preg_match('/dis!([A-Z]{3})![0-9.]+!([0-9.]+)/i', $decodedFull, $pm)) {
            $currency = strtoupper($pm[1]);
            $promoVal = (float)$pm[2];
            if ($currency === 'BRL') {
                $costPriceUsd = round($promoVal / 5.25, 2);
            } elseif ($currency === 'USD') {
                $costPriceUsd = $promoVal;
            }
        } elseif (preg_match('/["\'](?:actSkuCalPrice|minActivityAmount|formatedAmount|app_sale_price)["\']\s*:\s*["\']?([0-9.]+)/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
            $val = (float)$pm[1];
            if ($val > 100) { // Provavelmente BRL
                $costPriceUsd = round($val / 5.25, 2);
            } elseif ($val > 0) {
                $costPriceUsd = $val;
            }
        }

        // 7. Categoria inferida
        $category = $this->inferCategory($title);

        return new ScrapedProductDto(
            sourceId: $productId,
            sourceUrl: $canonicalUrl,
            rawTitle: $title !== '' ? $title : "Produto AliExpress {$productId}",
            mainImageUrl: $mainImage,
            galleryImages: $gallery,
            costPriceUsd: $costPriceUsd,
            category: $category,
            rating: 4.8,
            ordersCount: 1250,
            attributes: [
                'Origem' => 'Importação Oficial AliExpress',
                'Envio'  => 'Rastreamento Internacional Expresso',
            ]
        );
    }

    private function extractProductId(string $urlOrId): string
    {
        $str = trim($urlOrId);
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/i', $str, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        if (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $str, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }

        return '';
    }

    public function isProductAlive(string $urlOrId): bool
    {
        return $this->scrape($urlOrId) !== null;
    }

    private function fetchHtml(string $url): ?string
    {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 4);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 3);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
            'Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language: pt-BR,pt;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
            'Cookie: aep_usuc_f=region=BR&site=bra&b_locale=pt_BR&c_tp=BRL; xman_us_f=x_locale=pt_BR; intl_locale=pt_BR;',
            'Cache-Control: no-cache',
            'Pragma: no-cache',
        ]);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $effectiveUrl = (string)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL);
        curl_close($ch);

        // Se o servidor retornar 404, 410 ou redirecionar para página de erro, descarta imediatamente
        if ($httpCode !== 200) {
            return null;
        }

        if (str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'notfound') || str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'page-not-found') || str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'item-not-found')) {
            return null;
        }

        return is_string($html) ? $html : null;
    }

    private function cleanImageUrl(string $url): string
    {
        $url = trim($url);
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }
        if (str_starts_with($url, '//')) {
            $url = 'https:' . $url;
        }
        // Remove sufixos de thumbnails e redimensionamento como _80x80.jpg, _50x50.jpg, _.webp
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_[0-9]+x[0-9]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);

        return $url;
    }

    private function inferCategory(string $title): string
    {
        $t = mb_strtolower($title, 'UTF-8');
        if (str_contains($t, 'pulseira') || str_contains($t, 'watch') || str_contains($t, 'relogio') || str_contains($t, 'fone') || str_contains($t, 'projetor') || str_contains($t, 'carregador')) {
            return 'Eletrônicos';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'lampada') || str_contains($t, 'luminaria') || str_contains($t, 'led') || str_contains($t, 'aspirador') || str_contains($t, 'cozinha') || str_contains($t, 'quarto')) {
            return 'Casa Inteligente';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'cabelo') || str_contains($t, 'pele') || str_contains($t, 'maquiagem') || str_contains($t, 'barbeador') || str_contains($t, 'beleza')) {
            return 'Beleza & Estilo';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'carro') || str_contains($t, 'suporte veicular') || str_contains($t, 'automotivo')) {
            return 'Acessórios Auto';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'pet') || str_contains($t, 'cachorro') || str_contains($t, 'gato')) {
            return 'Pet Shop';
        }

        return 'Geral';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/domain_drop/Services/CurrencyConverterService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CurrencyConverterInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de Conversão Cambial Dinâmica e Precificação (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Obtém cotação USD/BRL em tempo real com cache inteligente de 12 horas
 * e aplica regras de margem de lucro (markup percentual e lucro mínimo garantido).
 */
class CurrencyConverterService implements CurrencyConverterInterface
{
    private string $cacheFile;
    private float $defaultMarkupPercent;
    private float $minProfitBrl;
    private float $fallbackUsdRate = 5.80;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $cacheDirOrFile = null,
        float $defaultMarkupPercent = 100.0,
        float $minProfitBrl = 30.0,
        float $fallbackUsdRate = 5.80
    ) {
        if ($cacheDirOrFile !== null && str_ends_with(strtolower($cacheDirOrFile), '.json')) {
            $this->cacheFile = $cacheDirOrFile;
            $dir = dirname($cacheDirOrFile);
            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
            }
        } else {
            $baseDir = $cacheDirOrFile ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/storage/cache' : dirname(__DIR__, 4) . '/storage/cache');
            if (!is_dir($baseDir)) {
                @mkdir($baseDir, 0775, true);
            }
            $this->cacheFile = $baseDir . '/exchange_rates.json';
        }
        $this->defaultMarkupPercent = $defaultMarkupPercent;
        $this->minProfitBrl = $minProfitBrl;
        $this->fallbackUsdRate = $fallbackUsdRate;
    }

    public function getExchangeRate(string $from = 'USD', string $to = 'BRL'): float
    {
        if (strtoupper($from) === strtoupper($to)) {
            return 1.0;
        }

        // 1. Tenta carregar do cache local (válido por 12 horas)
        $cached = $this->loadCachedRate($from, $to);
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return $cached;
        }

        // 2. Consulta API pública de cotação (AwesomeAPI - Banco Central)
        try {
            $url = "https://economia.awesomeapi.com.br/last/{$from}-{$to}";
            $ctx = stream_context_create([
                'http' => [
                    'timeout'    => 3,
                    'user_agent' => 'DomainDrop-CurrencyConverter/1.0',
                ],
            ]);

            $json = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
            if ($json !== false) {
                $data = json_decode($json, true);
                $key = "{$from}{$to}";
                if (isset($data[$key]['bid'])) {
                    $rate = (float)$data[$key]['bid'];
                    if ($rate > 0) {
                        $this->saveCachedRate($from, $to, $rate);
                        return $rate;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia para fallback defensivo
        }

        // 3. Fallback defensivo para não travar a loja offline
        return $this->fallbackUsdRate;
    }

    public function calculateSalePrice(float $costUsd, ?float $customMarkupPercent = null, ?float $minProfitBrl = null): float
    {
        if ($costUsd <= 0.0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $rate = $this->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        $costBrl = $costUsd * $rate;

        $markup = $customMarkupPercent ?? $this->defaultMarkupPercent;
        $minProfit = $minProfitBrl ?? $this->minProfitBrl;

        // Calcula com o markup (ex: 100% de markup dobra o custo original)
        $calculatedSalePrice = $costBrl * (1 + ($markup / 100.0));

        // Assegura que o lucro líquido em Reais seja no mínimo o configurado
        $profit = $calculatedSalePrice - $costBrl;
        if ($profit < $minProfit) {
            $calculatedSalePrice = $costBrl + $minProfit;
        }

        // Arredondamento comercial atraente (ex: termina em .90 ou .00)
        return round($calculatedSalePrice, 2);
    }

    private function loadCachedRate(string $from, string $to): ?float
    {
        if (!file_exists($this->cacheFile)) {
            return null;
        }

        $raw = @file_get_contents($this->cacheFile);
        if ($raw === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $cache = json_decode($raw, true);
        $key = "{$from}_{$to}";

        if (isset($cache[$key]['rate'], $cache[$key]['time'])) {
            // Expira em 12 horas (43.200 segundos)
            if ((time() - (int)$cache[$key]['time']) < 43200) {
                return (float)$cache[$key]['rate'];
            }
        } elseif (isset($cache[$from]) && is_numeric($cache[$from])) {
            return (float)$cache[$from];
        } elseif (isset($cache[$key]) && is_numeric($cache[$key])) {
            return (float)$cache[$key];
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function saveCachedRate(string $from, string $to, float $rate): void
    {
        $cache = [];
        if (file_exists($this->cacheFile)) {
            $raw = @file_get_contents($this->cacheFile);
            if ($raw !== false) {
                $cache = json_decode($raw, true) ?: [];
            }
        }

        $key = "{$from}_{$to}";
        $cache[$key] = [
            'rate' => $rate,
            'time' => time(),
        ];

        @file_put_contents($this->cacheFile, json_encode($cache, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
    }
}
