        <!-- TAB 1 -->
        <div id="tab1" class="tab-content active">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab1_h2">The End of Global Mess</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p1">If you come from WordPress, you are used to creating a <code class="highlight">functions.php</code> and using global functions. In Domain-System OS, this is strictly prohibited.</p>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p2">Every Extension (Plugin or Theme) is a Class that must sign a contract called <code class="highlight">OsExtensionInterface</code>. This contract divides your plugin's lifecycle into two isolated security phases.</p>
            
            <h3 data-i18n="tab1_h3">Dependency Injection (The Waiter)</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p3">Here, you don't hunt for system resources by instantiating random variables globally. The system works on a "Waiter" model: you sit down, ask for what you want (Phase 1), and the Operating System <strong class="highlight">injects</strong> the ready tool right into your hands (Phase 2).</p>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 2 -->
        <div id="tab2" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab2_h2">Phase 1: Negotiation (osRegister)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab2_p1">Before running any business logic, you use the <code class="highlight">OsConnector</code> object to notify the Operating System what you will need to use. If you do not request permission here, you will be blocked in Phase 2.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// 1. LINKS (Tools/Services)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// 2. SLOTS (Visual injection)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>);

    <span class="c">// 3. HOOKS (Events/Triggers)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>);
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 3 -->
        <div id="tab3" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab3_h2">Phase 2: Execution (osBoot)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab3_p1">After approving your contract, the OS hands you the <code class="highlight">OsRuntime</code>. This is where you actually work, receiving the requested resources strictly via Dependency Injection.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// 1. GETTING TOOLS</span>
    <span class="v">$db</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// 2. INJECTING VISUALS</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
        <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'Plugin successfully booted!'</span>
    ]);

    <span class="c">// 3. LISTENING TO EVENTS</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$patientId</span>) <span class="k">use</span> (<span class="v">$db</span>) {
        <span class="c">// Safe to execute logic here!</span>
    });
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 4 -->
        <div id="tab4" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab4_h2">Complete Extension Structure</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab4_p1">Every extension needs two files to exist: the Manifest (JSON) and the Contract (PHP Class).</p>
            
            <h3 style="color: var(--accent-purple);" data-i18n="tab4_json_title">1. The Manifest (plugin.json or theme.json)</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab4_json_desc">This file acts as the passport for your extension. It tells the OS who you are before any PHP code runs.</p>
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre>{
    <span class="s">"name"</span>: <span class="s">"test_os"</span>,
    <span class="s">"version"</span>: <span class="s">"1.0.0"</span>,
    <span class="s">"description"</span>: <span class="s">"Plugin de Teste para o novo Sistema Operacional Web"</span>,
    <span class="s">"core"</span>: <span class="v">false</span>,
    <span class="s">"dependencies"</span>: []
}</pre>
            </div>

            <h3 style="color: var(--accent-blue);" data-i18n="tab4_php_title">2. The Contract (Plugin.php)</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab4_php_desc">Just create your class implementing the Interface. The Kernel will automatically handle the rest.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">namespace</span> DomainSystem\Plugins\meu_plugin;

<span class="c">// 1. Importação Obrigatória dos Módulos do OS</span>
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime;

<span class="k">class</span> <span class="f">Plugin</span> <span class="k">extends</span> AbstractPlugin <span class="k">implements</span> OsExtensionInterface
{
    <span class="c">// Método legado (Ignorado pelo OS Novo, mas exigido pela classe Abstrata)</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">register</span>(): <span class="k">void</span> {}

    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="c">// FASE 1: NEGOCIAÇÃO</span>
    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>);
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>);
    }

    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="c">// FASE 2: EXECUÇÃO</span>
    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="v">$db</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
        
        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
            <span class="s">'type'</span> => <span class="s">'success'</span>,
            <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'O novo Sistema Operacional Web está operante!'</span>
        ]);

        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$patientId</span>) <span class="k">use</span> (<span class="v">$db</span>) {
            <span class="v">$db</span>-><span class="f">query</span>(<span class="s">"INSERT INTO log..."</span>);
        });
    }
}</pre>
            </div>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            // Update buttons
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
            
            // Update copy buttons text
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.innerText = lang === 'en' ? 'Copy' : 'Copiar';
            });
        }

        function openTab(tabId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function copyCode(btn) {
            const code = btn.nextElementSibling.innerText;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                const originalText = btn.innerText;
                const isEnglish = document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.contains('active');
                btn.innerText = isEnglish ? 'Copied!' : 'Copiado!';
                btn.style.color = '#10b981';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.color = '';
                    btn.style.borderColor = '';
                }, 2000);
            });
        }
        
        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const privacyNotice = document.getElementById('privacyNotice');
    if (!privacyNotice) return;

    const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('acceptPrivacy');
    const rejectBtn = document.getElementById('rejectPrivacy');

    function hideNotice() {
        privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
        setTimeout(() => { privacyNotice.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
    }

    if (acceptBtn) {
        acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            localStorage.setItem('rachidd_privacy_accepted', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    if (rejectBtn) {
        rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            sessionStorage.setItem('rachidd_privacy_rejected', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    const privacyAccepted = localStorage.getItem('rachidd_privacy_accepted');
    const privacyRejected = sessionStorage.getItem('rachidd_privacy_rejected');
    
    if (privacyAccepted !== 'true' && privacyRejected !== 'true') {
        setTimeout(() => {
            privacyNotice.style.display = 'block';
            // Force reflow
            void privacyNotice.offsetWidth;
            privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }, 1000);
    }
});
</script>

<script>
(function() {
    var btnToggle = document.getElementById('btnToggleCatDrawer');
    var btnClose = document.getElementById('btnCloseCatDrawer');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('catDrawerOverlay');
    var panel = document.getElementById('catDrawerPanel');

    function openDrawer() {
        if (overlay && panel) {
            overlay.classList.add('active');
            panel.classList.add('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            if (btnToggle) btnToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
    }

    function closeDrawer() {
        if (overlay && panel) {
            overlay.classList.remove('active');
            panel.classList.remove('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            if (btnToggle) btnToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }
    }

    window.closeCatDrawer = closeDrawer;

    function normalizeText(str) {
        return String(str || '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .normalize('NFD')
            .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
            .trim();
    }

    function matchesCategoryFilter(linkCat, currentCat) {
        var a = normalizeText(linkCat);
        var b = normalizeText(currentCat);
        if (!a || !b) return false;
        if (a === b) return true;
        if (a === 'tecnologia' && (b.indexOf('tecnologia') !== -1 || b.indexOf('eletronic') !== -1 || b.indexOf('gadget') !== -1)) return true;
        if (a === 'smartwatches' && (b.indexOf('smartwatch') !== -1 || b.indexOf('audio') !== -1)) return true;
        if (a === 'casa' && b.indexOf('casa') !== -1) return true;
        if (a === 'acessorios' && (b.indexOf('acessorio') !== -1 || b.indexOf('ferramenta') !== -1)) return true;
        if (a === 'beleza' && (b.indexOf('beleza') !== -1 || b.indexOf('saude') !== -1 || b.indexOf('cuidado') !== -1)) return true;
        return b.indexOf(a) !== -1 || a.indexOf(b) !== -1;
    }

    window.syncHeaderFilterActiveState = function(selectedCat, selectedSort, searchVal) {
        var cat = String(selectedCat || '').trim();
        var sort = String(selectedSort || '').trim();

        var searchInput = document.querySelector('.header-search-input');
        if (searchInput && typeof searchVal === 'string') {
            searchInput.value = searchVal;
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.cat-drawer-item, .header-quick-chips a').forEach(function(el) {
            var isMatch = false;
            try {
                var parsed = new URL(el.href, window.location.origin);
                var linkCat = (parsed.searchParams.get('cat') || '').trim();
                var linkSort = (parsed.searchParams.get('sort') || '').trim();

                if (cat !== '') {
                    isMatch = matchesCategoryFilter(linkCat, cat);
                } else if (sort === 'sales') {
                    isMatch = (linkSort === 'sales' && linkCat === '');
                } else if (linkCat === '' && linkSort === '') {
                    isMatch = true;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                isMatch = false;
            }
            el.classList.toggle('active', isMatch);
        });
    };

    function smoothScrollToProducts() {
        var target = document.getElementById('produtos') || document.getElementById('storeDynamicStage') || document.querySelector('.store-combobox-toolbar');
        if (!target) return;
        var header = document.querySelector('.site-header');
        var headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 80;
        var targetTop = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - (headerHeight + 15);
        window.scrollTo({
            top: Math.max(0, targetTop),
            behavior: 'smooth'
        });
    }

    window.smoothScrollToProducts = smoothScrollToProducts;

    if (btnToggle) btnToggle.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
    if (btnClose) btnClose.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
    if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer();
    });

    // Busca dinâmica instantânea no Palco quando já estiver na /loja
    var searchForm = document.querySelector('.header-search-form');
    if (searchForm) {
        searchForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            var stage = document.getElementById('storeDynamicStage');
            if (stage && window.filterCatalogDynamically) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var input = searchForm.querySelector('input[name="q"]');
                var qVal = input ? input.value.trim() : '';
                var targetUrl = searchForm.action + (qVal !== '' ? '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(qVal) : '') + '#produtos';
                window.filterCatalogDynamically(targetUrl, true, true);
            }
        });
    }

    // Filtragem dinâmica instantânea no Palco + Rolagem suave até os produtos
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var link = e.target.closest('.cat-drawer-item, .header-quick-chips a');
        if (link && link.href) {
            var stage = document.getElementById('storeDynamicStage');
            if (stage && window.filterCatalogDynamically) {
                e.preventDefault();
                closeDrawer();
                window.filterCatalogDynamically(link.href, true, true);
            }
        }
    });
})();
</script>

        <script>
            // Timer regressivo dinâmico para urgência e conversão
            function updateTimer() {
                const now = new Date();
                const midnight = new Date();
                midnight.setHours(24, 0, 0, 0);
                const diff = midnight - now;
                const h = String(Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24)).padStart(2, '0');
                const m = String(Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60)) % 60)).padStart(2, '0');
                const s = String(Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60)).padStart(2, '0');
                const el = document.getElementById('flash-timer');
                if (el) el.innerText = `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
            }
            setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
            updateTimer();
        </script>

    function getSelectedBlock() {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return null;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return null;
        return sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx] || null;
    }

    function getResponsivePropKey(key, dev) {
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        return (dev === 'desktop') ? key : (key + '_' + dev);
    }

    function getBlockResponsiveValue(block, key, dev) {
        if (!block || !block.data) return '';
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        var d = block.data;
        if (dev === 'mobile') {
            if (d[key + '_mobile'] !== undefined && d[key + '_mobile'] !== '') return d[key + '_mobile'];
            if (d[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && d[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return d[key + '_tablet'];
            if (d[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && d[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return d[key + '_laptop'];
            return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
        }
        if (dev === 'tablet') {
            if (d[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && d[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return d[key + '_tablet'];
            if (d[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && d[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return d[key + '_laptop'];
            return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
        }
        if (dev === 'laptop') {
            if (d[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && d[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return d[key + '_laptop'];
            return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
        }
        return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
    }

    function isPropOverriddenInDevice(block, key, dev) {
        if (!block || !block.data) return false;
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        if (dev === 'desktop') return (block.data[key] !== undefined && block.data[key] !== '');
        return (block.data[key + '_' + dev] !== undefined && block.data[key + '_' + dev] !== '');
    }

    function updateBlockPropResponsive(key, val) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        if (!block.data) block.data = {};

        var targetKey = getResponsivePropKey(key, currentDeviceKey);
        if (val === '' || val === null || val === undefined) {
            if (currentDeviceKey !== 'desktop') {
                delete block.data[targetKey];
            } else {
                block.data[key] = '';
            }
        } else {
            block.data[targetKey] = val;
        }

        renderCanvas();
    }

    function renderResponsiveControlHeader(label, baseKey, block) {

        var isOverridden = isPropOverriddenInDevice(block, baseKey, dev);

        var badgeBg = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,0.1)';
        var badgeText = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') ? (devIcon + ' (Custom)') : devIcon;
        var clearBtn = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') 
            ? '<button type="button" onclick="updateBlockPropResponsive(\'' + baseKey + '\', \'\'); renderInspector(); renderCanvas();" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#ef4444; font-size:10px; cursor:pointer; padding:0 2px;" title="Redefinir para herdar da resolução superior">✕ Limpar</button>'
            : '';

        return '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label" style="margin-bottom:0;">' + label + '</label>' +
               '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">' +
               '<span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:' + badgeColor + '; background:' + badgeBg + '; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:3px;" title="Editando na resolução: ' + dev + '">' + badgeText + '</span>' +
               clearBtn +
               '</div>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function getSecResponsiveValue(sec, key, dev) {
        if (!sec || !sec.container_settings) return '';
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        var s = sec.container_settings;
        if (dev === 'mobile') {
            if (s[key + '_mobile'] !== undefined && s[key + '_mobile'] !== '') return s[key + '_mobile'];
            if (s[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && s[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return s[key + '_tablet'];
            if (s[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && s[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return s[key + '_laptop'];
            return s[key] !== undefined ? s[key] : '';

    }

    function updateActiveSecSettingResponsive(key, val) {

    var blocksCatalog = <?= json_encode($catalogItems, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?>;

    function getMaxSectionsForType(type) {
        if (type === 'header') return 3; // Topbar, Principal, Sub-header
        if (type === 'footer') return 3; // Newsletter, Principal, Copyright
        return 6; // Seções centrais livres
    }

    var selectionType = 'none'; // 'none' | 'section' | 'block' | 'column'
    var selectedSecIdx = 0;

    function initStudio() {
        initDraggableNavigator();
        initSidebarResizer();
        if (state.container_settings) {
            delete state.container_settings.hide_desktop;
            delete state.container_settings.hide_laptop;
            delete state.container_settings.hide_tablet;
            delete state.container_settings.hide_mobile;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(state.sections)) {
            state.sections.forEach(function(sec) {
                if (sec && sec.container_settings) {
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_desktop;
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_laptop;
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_tablet;
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_mobile;
                }
            });
        }
        state.mobile_toggle_style = state.mobile_toggle_style || '<?= $part->getMobileToggleStyle() ?>';
        state.mobile_toggle_align = state.mobile_toggle_align || '<?= $part->getMobileToggleAlign() ?>';
        var alignSel = document.getElementById('setting_mobile_toggle_align');
        if (alignSel && state.mobile_toggle_align) {
            alignSel.value = state.mobile_toggle_align;
        }
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderBlocksCatalog();
        renderLayersTree();
        renderCanvas();
    }

    function switchSidebarTab(tab) {
        currentSidebarTab = tab;
        ['layout', 'layers', 'blocks', 'inspector', 'settings'].forEach(function(t) {
            var el = document.getElementById('sidebar_tab_' + t);
            if (el) el.style.display = (t === tab) ? 'block' : 'none';
            var btn = document.getElementById('tab_btn_' + t);
            if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);
        });
        if (tab === 'layers') {
            renderLayersTree();
        }
    }

    // NAVEGADOR FLUTUANTE DE CAMADAS (ELEMENTOR-STYLE FLOATING POPUP)
    function toggleFloatingLayers(forceState) {
        var panel = document.getElementById('floating_layers_panel');
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_toggle_floating_layers');
        if (!panel) return;
        var willOpen = (typeof forceState === 'boolean') ? forceState : (panel.style.display === 'none');
        panel.style.display = willOpen ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (btn) {
            btn.classList.toggle('active', willOpen);
            btn.style.borderColor = willOpen ? 'var(--primary)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
        }
        if (willOpen) {
            renderLayersTree();
        }
    }

    function toggleFloatingLayersMinimize() {
        var content = document.getElementById('floating_layers_content');
        if (!content) return;
        content.style.display = (content.style.display === 'none') ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    function initDraggableNavigator() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('floating_layers_panel');
        var handle = document.getElementById('floating_layers_drag_handle');
        if (!panel || !handle) return;

        var isDragging = false;
        var startX, startY, initialLeft, initialTop;

        handle.onmousedown = function(e) {
            if (e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') return;
            isDragging = true;
            startX = e.clientX;
            startY = e.clientY;
            
            var rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
            initialLeft = rect.left;
            initialTop = rect.top;

            // Transfere o posicionamento de bottom/right para top/left para arraste suave
            panel.style.bottom = 'auto';
            panel.style.right = 'auto';
            panel.style.left = initialLeft + 'px';
            panel.style.top = initialTop + 'px';
            
            document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        };

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            var dx = e.clientX - startX;
            var dy = e.clientY - startY;

            var newLeft = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - panel.offsetWidth - 10, initialLeft + dx));
            var newTop = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerHeight - panel.offsetHeight - 10, initialTop + dy));

            panel.style.left = newLeft + 'px';
            panel.style.top = newTop + 'px';
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
            if (isDragging) {
                isDragging = false;
                document.body.style.userSelect = '';
            }
        });
    }

    function initSidebarResizer() {
        var sidebar = document.getElementById('studio-sidebar');
        var resizer = document.getElementById('studio-sidebar-resizer');
        if (!sidebar || !resizer) return;

        // Restaura largura salva no localStorage (entre 260px e 750px)
        var savedWidth = localStorage.getItem('studio_sidebar_width');
        if (savedWidth) {
            var parsed = parseInt(savedWidth, 10);
            if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= 260 && parsed <= 750) {
                sidebar.style.width = parsed + 'px';
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--studio-sidebar-width', parsed + 'px');
            }
        }

        var isDragging = false;
        var startX = 0;
        var startWidth = 0;

        resizer.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            isDragging = true;
            startX = e.clientX;
            startWidth = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width;

            resizer.classList.add('is-dragging');
            document.body.classList.add('is-resizing-sidebar');
        });

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            var delta = e.clientX - startX;
            var newWidth = Math.max(260, Math.min(startWidth + delta, 750));
            sidebar.style.width = newWidth + 'px';
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--studio-sidebar-width', newWidth + 'px');
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            isDragging = false;
            resizer.classList.remove('is-dragging');
            document.body.classList.remove('is-resizing-sidebar');
            var curWidth = parseInt(sidebar.style.width, 10);
            if (!isNaN(curWidth)) {
                localStorage.setItem('studio_sidebar_width', curWidth + 'px');
            }
        });

        // Duplo-clique restaura a largura padrão de 360px
        resizer.addEventListener('dblclick', function() {
            sidebar.style.width = '360px';
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--studio-sidebar-width', '360px');
            localStorage.removeItem('studio_sidebar_width');
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                showToast('Largura do menu redefinida para o padrão (360px)');
            }
        });
    }

    var currentLiveHeightPreset = 'auto';

    function setLiveViewportHeight(h) {
        currentLiveHeightPreset = h;
        ['850', '1200', 'full', 'auto'].forEach(function(k) {
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_vh_' + k);
            if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
        });

        var activeKey = (h === '850px') ? '850' : ((h === '1200px') ? '1200' : ((h === 'auto') ? 'auto' : 'full'));
        var activeBtn = document.getElementById('btn_vh_' + activeKey);
        if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

        adjustLiveStageIframeHeight();
    }

    function adjustLiveStageIframeHeight() {
        var iframe = document.getElementById('live_stage_iframe');
        var container = document.getElementById('live-stage-container');
        var viewport = document.getElementById('device-viewport');
        var canvas = document.getElementById('canvas-content');
        if (!viewport) return;

        var isSection = (state.type === 'section');
        var minBase = isSection ? 850 : 480;

        if (currentLiveHeightPreset === 'auto') {
            viewport.style.minHeight = minBase + 'px';
            viewport.style.height = 'auto';
            if (canvas) {
                canvas.style.minHeight = 'auto';
                canvas.style.height = 'auto';
                canvas.style.overflowY = 'visible';
            }
            if (iframe) {
                try {
                    var doc = iframe.contentDocument || (iframe.contentWindow && iframe.contentWindow.document);
                    if (doc && doc.body) {
                        var scrollH = Math.max(doc.body.scrollHeight, doc.documentElement.scrollHeight);
                        var finalH = Math.max(minBase, scrollH + 40);
                        iframe.style.height = finalH + 'px';
                        if (container) {
                            container.style.height = finalH + 'px';
                            container.style.minHeight = finalH + 'px';
                        }
                        viewport.style.minHeight = finalH + 'px';
                        return;
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
                iframe.style.height = minBase + 'px';
            }
            if (container) {
                container.style.height = minBase + 'px';
                container.style.minHeight = minBase + 'px';
            }
        } else {
            var targetH = currentLiveHeightPreset;
            viewport.style.minHeight = targetH;
            viewport.style.height = targetH;
            if (canvas) {
                var offset = (targetH === 'calc(100vh - 160px)') ? 'calc(100vh - 210px)' : (parseInt(targetH) - 50) + 'px';
                canvas.style.minHeight = offset;
                canvas.style.height = offset;
                canvas.style.overflowY = 'auto';
            }
            if (iframe) {
                iframe.style.height = targetH;
            }
            if (container) {
                container.style.height = targetH;
                container.style.minHeight = targetH;
            }
        }
    }

    function setStudioMode(mode) {
        studioMode = mode;
        document.getElementById('btn_mode_structure').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'structure');
        document.getElementById('btn_mode_live').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'live');

        var canvasContent = document.getElementById('canvas-content');
        var liveStage = document.getElementById('live-stage-container');

        if (mode === 'live') {
            canvasContent.style.display = 'none';
            liveStage.style.display = 'flex';
            loadLiveStageContent();
            setTimeout(adjustLiveStageIframeHeight, 150);
        } else {
            canvasContent.style.display = 'block';
            liveStage.style.display = 'none';
            renderCanvas();
        }
    }

    function getPreviewGuardScript() {
        return '<script>' +
            'document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {' +
                'var link = e.target.closest("a, area");' +
                'if (link) {' +
                    'e.preventDefault();' +
                    'e.stopPropagation();' +
                    'var href = link.getAttribute("href") || "#";' +
                    'try {' +
                        'if (window.parent && typeof window.parent.showToast === "function") {' +
                            'var msg = (window.parent.__ ? window.parent.__("link_disabled_live", "Links estão desativados no modo Ao Vivo para não sair da edição.") : "Links estão desativados no modo Ao Vivo para não sair da edição.");' +
                            'window.parent.showToast("🔗 " + msg + " (" + href + ")");' +
                        '}' +
                    '} catch(err) {}' +
                    'return false;' +
                '}' +
            '}, true);' +
            'document.addEventListener("submit", function(e) {' +
                'e.preventDefault();' +
                'e.stopPropagation();' +
                'try {' +
                    'if (window.parent && typeof window.parent.showToast === "function") {' +
                        'window.parent.showToast("⚠️ Formulários desativados no modo Ao Vivo.");' +
                    '}' +
                '} catch(err) {}' +
                'return false;' +
            '}, true);' +
        '</' + 'script>';
    }

    var liveStageDebounceTimer = null;
    function loadLiveStageContent() {
        if (liveStageDebounceTimer) {
            clearTimeout(liveStageDebounceTimer);
        }
        liveStageDebounceTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            var iframe = document.getElementById('live_stage_iframe');
            if (!iframe) return;
            var payload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
            payload.csrf_token = csrfToken;

            if (!payload.mobile_toggle_style && state.mobile_toggle_style) {
                payload.mobile_toggle_style = state.mobile_toggle_style;
            }
            if (!payload.mobile_toggle_align && state.mobile_toggle_align) {
                payload.mobile_toggle_align = state.mobile_toggle_align;
            }

            fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/preview', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.text(); })
            .then(function(html) {
                var bodyClass = 'ds-live-preview';
                if (currentDevice === '375px') {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-mobile-mode ds-device-375';
                } else if (currentDevice === '768px') {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-tablet-mode ds-device-768';
                } else if (currentDevice === '1024px') {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-laptop-mode ds-device-1024';
                } else {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-desktop-mode ds-device-desktop ds-device-1440';
                }

                iframe.onload = function() {
                    adjustLiveStageIframeHeight();
                };

                var liveStyles = '<style>' +
                    'body { margin:0; padding:0; background:#06090e; color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-primary, sans-serif); min-height:100vh; box-sizing:border-box; }' +
                    'a { cursor:pointer !important; }' +
                    (state.type === 'section' ? '.ds-part-wrapper, .ds-theme-section { min-height: 80vh; }' : '') +
                    '</style>';

                iframe.srcdoc = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">' + liveStyles + '</head><body class="' + bodyClass + '">' + html + getPreviewGuardScript() + '</body></html>';

                setTimeout(adjustLiveStageIframeHeight, 150);
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                console.error('[LiveStage] Erro ao renderizar preview ao vivo:', err);
            });
        }, 50);
    }

    function setDevice(width) {
        currentDevice = width;
        var viewport = document.getElementById('device-viewport');
        viewport.style.maxWidth = width;
        var pxEl = document.getElementById('cur_device_px');
        if (pxEl) pxEl.textContent = width;
        
        ['desktop', 'laptop', 'tablet', 'mobile'].forEach(function(d) {
            var b1 = document.getElementById('btn_dev_' + d);
            if (b1) b1.classList.remove('active');
            var b2 = document.getElementById('bar_dev_' + d);
            if (b2) b2.classList.remove('active');
        });

        viewport.classList.remove('ds-desktop-mode', 'ds-laptop-mode', 'ds-mobile-mode', 'ds-tablet-mode', 'ds-device-desktop', 'ds-device-1024', 'ds-device-375', 'ds-device-768');

        var activeKey = 'desktop';
        var devName = 'Desktop (100%)';
        if (width === '100%') {
            activeKey = 'desktop';
            devName = 'Desktop (100%)';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-desktop-mode', 'ds-device-desktop');
        } else if (width === '1024px') {
            activeKey = 'laptop';
            devName = 'Laptop (1024px)';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-laptop-mode', 'ds-device-1024');
        } else if (width === '768px') {
            activeKey = 'tablet';
            devName = 'Tablet (768px) - 📱 Hamburguer Ativo';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-tablet-mode', 'ds-device-768');
        } else if (width === '375px') {
            activeKey = 'mobile';
            devName = 'Mobile (375px) - 📱 Hamburguer Ativo';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-mobile-mode', 'ds-device-375');
        }

        currentDeviceKey = activeKey;

        var b1 = document.getElementById('btn_dev_' + activeKey);
        if (b1) b1.classList.add('active');
        var b2 = document.getElementById('bar_dev_' + activeKey);
        if (b2) b2.classList.add('active');

        var nameEl = document.getElementById('cur_device_name');
        if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = devName;

        var curSec = getSelectedSection();
        if (curSec) {
            renderSectionStyleControls(curSec);
        }
        if (selectedBlockCoord) {
            renderInspector();
        }

        if (studioMode === 'live') {
            loadLiveStageContent();
        } else {
            renderCanvas();
        }
    }

    var currentCanvasZoom = 1;
    function setCanvasZoom(scale) {
        currentCanvasZoom = scale;
        var stage = document.getElementById('canvas-content');
        if (stage) {
            if (scale === 1) {
                stage.style.transform = '';
                stage.style.transformOrigin = '';
                stage.style.width = '';
            } else {
                stage.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ')';
                stage.style.transformOrigin = 'top center';
                stage.style.width = (100 / scale) + '%';
            }
        }
        [1, 0.85, 0.75].forEach(function(s) {
            var key = Math.round(s * 100);
            var b = document.getElementById('btn_zoom_' + key);
            if (b) b.classList.toggle('active', s === scale);
        });
    }

    function updateSectionsCountBadge() {

        if (el) {
            var count = state.sections.length;
            var max = getMaxSectionsForType(state.type);
            el.textContent = count + ' de ' + max + ' Seções';
        }

    // GESTÃO DE SEÇÕES (ELEMENTOR STYLE)
    function toggleAddSectionPicker() {
        showStructurePicker = !showStructurePicker;
        renderCanvas();
    }

    function addSection(presetKey) {
        var maxSec = getMaxSectionsForType(state.type);
        if (state.sections.length >= maxSec) {
            alert('Limite máximo de ' + maxSec + ' seções atingido para ' + state.type + '.');
            return;
        }

        var p = presets[presetKey] || presets['1_col'];
        var cols = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < p.columns; i++) {
            cols[i] = [];
        }

        var newSec = {
            id: 'sec_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 8),
            title: 'Seção ' + (state.sections.length + 1),
            layout_preset: presetKey,
            container_settings: {
                max_width: '1280px',
                gap: '24px',
                padding: '16px 24px',
                margin: '0px 0px 16px 0px',
                align_items: 'center',
                background: 'transparent'
            },
            columns_data: cols
        };

        state.sections.push(newSec);
        activeSecIdx = state.sections.length - 1;
        activeColIdx = 0;
        selectedBlockCoord = null;
        showStructurePicker = false;
        
        renderCanvas();
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderBlocksCatalog();
        showToast('Nova Seção com ' + p.columns + ' divisões criada!');
    }

    function moveSection(secIdx, dir, e) {
        if (e) e.stopPropagation();
        var targetIdx = secIdx + dir;
        if (targetIdx >= 0 && targetIdx < state.sections.length) {
            var sec = state.sections.splice(secIdx, 1)[0];
            state.sections.splice(targetIdx, 0, sec);
            activeSecIdx = targetIdx;
            renderCanvas();
            renderSidebarLayoutTab();
            showToast('Seção reordenada!');
        }
    }

    function duplicateSection(secIdx, e) {
        if (e) e.stopPropagation();
        var maxSec = getMaxSectionsForType(state.type);
        if (state.sections.length >= maxSec) {
            alert('Não é possível duplicar: limite de ' + maxSec + ' seções atingido.');
            return;
        }

        var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.sections[secIdx]));
        copy.id = 'sec_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 8);
        copy.title = (copy.title || 'Seção') + ' (Cópia)';
        state.sections.splice(secIdx + 1, 0, copy);
        activeSecIdx = secIdx + 1;
        renderCanvas();
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        showToast('Seção duplicada!');
    }

    var lastDeletedSectionBackup = null;

    function deleteSection(secIdx, e) {
        if (e) {
            if (typeof e.stopPropagation === 'function') e.stopPropagation();
            if (typeof e.preventDefault === 'function') e.preventDefault();
        }

        var sec = state.sections[secIdx];
        if (!sec) return;

        // Salva backup para permitir desfazer imediatamente
        lastDeletedSectionBackup = {
            sec: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sec)),
            index: secIdx
        };

        // Exclui a seção imediatamente sem bloqueio de janela confirm()
        state.sections.splice(secIdx, 1);

        if (state.sections.length === 0) {
            activeSecIdx = 0;
            activeColIdx = 0;
            selectedBlockCoord = null;
            selectionType = 'none';
            showStructurePicker = true;
            showToast('✓ Seção excluída! <button type="button" onclick="undoDeleteSection()" style="margin-left:8px; background:#000; color:#fff; border:none; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700;">Desfazer</button>');
        } else {
            if (activeSecIdx >= state.sections.length) {
                activeSecIdx = Math.max(0, state.sections.length - 1);
            }
            activeColIdx = 0;
            selectedBlockCoord = null;
            selectionType = 'none';
            showToast('✓ Seção excluída com sucesso! <button type="button" onclick="undoDeleteSection()" style="margin-left:8px; background:#000; color:#fff; border:none; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700;">Desfazer</button>');
        }

        renderCanvas();
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderLayersTree();
    }

    function undoDeleteSection() {
        if (!lastDeletedSectionBackup) return;
        state.sections.splice(lastDeletedSectionBackup.index, 0, lastDeletedSectionBackup.sec);
        activeSecIdx = lastDeletedSectionBackup.index;
        lastDeletedSectionBackup = null;
        renderCanvas();
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderLayersTree();
        showToast('✓ Seção restaurada com sucesso!');
    }

    function selectSectionForConfig(secIdx, e) {
        if (e && typeof e.stopPropagation === 'function') e.stopPropagation();
        selectionType = 'section';
        selectedSecIdx = secIdx;
        activeSecIdx = secIdx;
        activeColIdx = 0;
        selectedBlockCoord = null;
        renderCanvas();
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderLayersTree();

        var floatingPanel = document.getElementById('floating_layers_panel');
        var isFloatingOpen = floatingPanel && floatingPanel.style.display !== 'none';
        if (isFloatingOpen || currentSidebarTab !== 'layers') {
            switchSidebarTab('layout');
        }
    }

    function changeSectionPreset(presetKey) {
        var curSec = state.sections[activeSecIdx];
        if (!curSec) return;
        curSec.layout_preset = presetKey;
        var p = presets[presetKey];
        if (!curSec.columns_data) curSec.columns_data = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < p.columns; i++) {
            if (!curSec.columns_data[i]) curSec.columns_data[i] = [];
        }
        if (activeColIdx >= p.columns) {
            activeColIdx = 0;
        }
        renderCanvas();
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderBlocksCatalog();
    }

    function updateActiveSecTitle(val) {
        var curSec = state.sections[activeSecIdx];
        if (!curSec) return;
        curSec.title = val;
        renderCanvas();
    }

    function updateActiveSecSetting(key, val) {
        var curSec = state.sections[activeSecIdx];
        if (!curSec) return;
        if (!curSec.container_settings) curSec.container_settings = {};
        curSec.container_settings[key] = val;
        renderCanvas();
        if (typeof studioMode !== 'undefined' && studioMode === 'live') {
            loadLiveStageContent();
        }
    }

    function renderSidebarLayoutTab() {
        var bar = document.getElementById('sidebar_sec_selector_bar');
        if (bar) bar.innerHTML = '';
        var maxSec = getMaxSectionsForType(state.type);

        if (!state.sections || state.sections.length === 0) {
            var titleInput = document.getElementById('sec_title_input');
            if (titleInput) titleInput.value = '';
            var container = document.getElementById('presets_list');
            if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:12px; padding:20px; text-align:center;">Nenhuma seção criada. Clique em "+ Nova Seção" para adicionar.</div>';
            return;
        }

        var curSec = state.sections[activeSecIdx] || state.sections[0];
        if (!curSec) return;

        // Seletor de pílulas das seções

        state.sections.forEach(function(s, idx) {
            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.className = 'col-sel-btn' + (activeSecIdx === idx ? ' active' : '');
            btn.textContent = s.title || ('Seção ' + (idx + 1));
            btn.onclick = function() {
                activeSecIdx = idx;
                activeColIdx = 0;
                renderCanvas();
                renderSidebarLayoutTab();
                renderBlocksCatalog();
            };
            bar.appendChild(btn);
        });

        if (state.sections.length < maxSec) {
            var addBtn = document.createElement('button');
            addBtn.type = 'button';
            addBtn.className = 'header-btn';
            addBtn.style.fontSize = '11px';
            addBtn.style.padding = '4px 8px';
            addBtn.textContent = '+ Nova Seção';
            addBtn.onclick = function() {
                showStructurePicker = true;
                renderCanvas();
                var el = document.getElementById('elementor-structure-picker');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            };
            bar.appendChild(addBtn);
        }

        // Título da seção
        var titleInput = document.getElementById('sec_title_input');
        if (titleInput) titleInput.value = curSec.title || ('Seção ' + (activeSecIdx + 1));

        // Lista de presets para a seção ativa
        var container = document.getElementById('presets_list');
        container.innerHTML = '';
        for (var key in presets) {
            var p = presets[key];
            var card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'preset-card' + (curSec.layout_preset === key ? ' active' : '');
            card.onclick = (function(presetKey) {
                return function() { changeSectionPreset(presetKey); };
            })(key);

            var title = document.createElement('div');
            title.style.fontSize = '12px';
            title.style.fontWeight = '600';
            title.textContent = p.name;

            var bars = document.createElement('div');
            bars.className = 'preset-grid-bars';
            for (var c = 0; c < p.columns; c++) {
                var col = document.createElement('div');
                col.className = 'preset-grid-col';
                col.style.flex = '1';
                bars.appendChild(col);
            }

            card.appendChild(title);
            card.appendChild(bars);
            container.appendChild(card);
        }

        // Espaçamentos e dimensões da seção sincronizados com a UI de Steppers
        var cs = curSec.container_settings || {};
        var marginVals = parse4Values(cs.margin || '0px 0px 16px 0px');
        var paddingVals = parse4Values(cs.padding || '16px 24px');

        ['mar_top', 'mar_right', 'mar_bottom', 'mar_left'].forEach(function(id, idx) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.value = marginVals[idx];
        });

        ['pad_top', 'pad_right', 'pad_bottom', 'pad_left'].forEach(function(id, idx) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.value = paddingVals[idx];
        });

        var gapNum = parseFloat(cs.gap || '24px') || 24;
        var gapEl = document.getElementById('setting_gap_num');
        if (gapEl) gapEl.value = gapNum;
        var gapDisp = document.getElementById('gap_display_val');
        if (gapDisp) gapDisp.textContent = gapNum + 'px';

        var maxWidthStr = cs.max_width || '1280px';
        var maxWidthNum = parseFloat(maxWidthStr) || 1280;
        var maxWidthEl = document.getElementById('setting_max_width_num');
        if (maxWidthEl) maxWidthEl.value = maxWidthNum;

        renderSectionStyleControls(curSec);
        var alignEl = document.getElementById('setting_align_items');
        if (alignEl) alignEl.value = cs.align_items || 'center';
        var justifyEl = document.getElementById('setting_justify_content');
        if (justifyEl) justifyEl.value = cs.justify_content || 'space-between';

        updateSpacingLinkUI('margin');
        updateSpacingLinkUI('padding');
    }

        html += '<div style="margin-top:12px; background:rgba(15,23,42,0.45); padding:10px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.2);">' +

                renderSectionTokenColorPicker('Cor dos Links Internos (Link Color)', 'link_color', cs.link_color || '', 'primary') +
                renderSectionTokenColorPicker('Cor dos Links no Hover (Link Hover)', 'link_hover_color', cs.link_hover_color || '', 'tertiary') +
                renderSectionFontSelector('Família de Fonte Padrão da Seção', 'font_family', cs.font_family || '') +
                '<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px;">' +
                '<div class="inspector-field" style="margin-bottom:0;"><label class="inspector-label">Alinhamento Texto</label>' +

                '<option value=""' + (!cs.text_align ? ' selected' : '') + '>Herdar / Padrão</option>' +
                '<option value="left"' + (cs.text_align === 'left' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Esquerda (left)</option>' +
                '<option value="center"' + (cs.text_align === 'center' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Centro (center)</option>' +

                '<select class="inspector-select" onchange="updateActiveSecSetting(\'text_transform\', this.value); renderCanvas(); renderSidebarLayoutTab();">' +
                '<option value=""' + (!cs.text_transform ? ' selected' : '') + '>Nenhuma</option>' +
                '<option value="uppercase"' + (cs.text_transform === 'uppercase' ? ' selected' : '') + '>MAIÚSCULAS</option>' +
                '<option value="lowercase"' + (cs.text_transform === 'lowercase' ? ' selected' : '') + '>minúsculas</option>' +
                '<option value="capitalize"' + (cs.text_transform === 'capitalize' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Capitalizar</option>' +
                '</select></div>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</div>';

        // 2. Arredondamento de Borda da Seção (Border Radius)
        var curRadiusNum = parseFloat(cs.border_radius || '0') || 0;
        html += '<div class="inspector-field" style="margin-top:12px;">' +
                '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;">' +
                '<label class="inspector-label" style="margin-bottom:0;">Arredondamento da Seção (Border Radius)</label>' +
                '<span style="font-size:11px; color:var(--primary); font-weight:700;">' + (cs.border_radius || '0px') + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="stepper-single-wrap">' +
                '<button type="button" class="step-btn" onclick="stepSecSingleValue(\'border_radius\', -2, 0, 100)">-</button>' +
                '<input type="number" id="sec_border_radius_num" class="step-input-single" value="' + curRadiusNum + '" min="0" max="100" oninput="onSecSingleNumChange(\'border_radius\', this.value)">' +
                '<button type="button" class="step-btn" onclick="stepSecSingleValue(\'border_radius\', 2, 0, 100)">+</button>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</div>';

        // 3. Borda da Seção (Border)
        html += '<div class="inspector-field">' +
                '<label class="inspector-label">Borda da Seção (Border)</label>' +

                '<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;">' +
                '<label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:11px; color:#cbd5e1; cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" ' + (cs.hide_desktop ? 'checked' : '') + ' onchange="updateActiveSecSetting(\'hide_desktop\', this.checked); renderCanvas();"> 🖥️ Ocultar Seção no Desktop</label>' +
                '<label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:11px; color:#cbd5e1; cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" ' + (cs.hide_laptop ? 'checked' : '') + ' onchange="updateActiveSecSetting(\'hide_laptop\', this.checked); renderCanvas();"> 💻 Ocultar Seção em 1024px (Laptop)</label>' +
                '<label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:11px; color:#cbd5e1; cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" ' + (cs.hide_tablet ? 'checked' : '') + ' onchange="updateActiveSecSetting(\'hide_tablet\', this.checked); renderCanvas();"> 📱 Ocultar Seção em 768px (Tablet)</label>' +
                '<label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:11px; color:#cbd5e1; cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" ' + (cs.hide_mobile ? 'checked' : '') + ' onchange="updateActiveSecSetting(\'hide_mobile\', this.checked); renderCanvas();"> 📲 Ocultar Seção em 375px (Mobile)</label>' +
                '</div></div>';

        container.innerHTML = html;
