// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Support/UnresolvedClassScanner.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Support;

/**
 * Detector estático de "Class not found" por falta de `use`.
 *
 * Para cada nome de classe NÃO qualificado usado em `new X`, `X::`, `instanceof X`
 * ou como tipo antes de uma variável (`X $param`), verifica se ele é resolvível:
 *   1. está importado por `use`;
 *   2. é declarado no próprio arquivo;
 *   3. existe um arquivo X.php no mesmo namespace (PSR-4 sob src/).
 * Caso contrário o PHP procuraria "Namespace\X" e falharia em tempo de execução.
 */
final class UnresolvedClassScanner
{
    private const BUILTIN_TYPES = [
        'int', 'float', 'string', 'bool', 'array', 'callable', 'iterable', 'object',
        'mixed', 'void', 'null', 'never', 'false', 'true', 'self', 'static', 'parent',
    ];

    /** @var array<string, array<string, true>> cache: dir => [nome minúsculo => true] */
    private static array $dirCache = [];

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{line:int, name:string}>
     */
    public static function scan(string $code, string $srcRoot): array
    {
        $tokens = [];
        foreach (token_get_all($code) as $tok) {
            if (is_array($tok)) {
                if (in_array($tok[0], [T_WHITESPACE, T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT, T_OPEN_TAG], true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $tokens[] = ['id' => $tok[0], 'text' => $tok[1], 'line' => $tok[2]];
            } else {
                $tokens[] = ['id' => $tok, 'text' => $tok, 'line' => $tokens ? end($tokens)['line'] : 1];
            }
        }

        $n = count($tokens);
        $namespace = null;
        $imports = [];   // alias minúsculo => true
        $declared = [];  // nomes declarados no arquivo (minúsculo)
        $inImport = [];  // índices que pertencem a instruções use de topo
        $depth = 0;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $id = $tokens[$i]['id'];

            if ($id === T_NAMESPACE && isset($tokens[$i + 1]) && in_array($tokens[$i + 1]['id'], [T_STRING, T_NAME_QUALIFIED], true)) {
                $namespace = $tokens[$i + 1]['text'];
            }

            if ($id === '{' || $id === T_CURLY_OPEN || $id === T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES) {
                $depth++;
            } elseif ($id === '}') {
                $depth--;
            }

            if ($id === T_USE && $depth === 0) {
                $isFnOrConst = isset($tokens[$i + 1]) && in_array($tokens[$i + 1]['id'], [T_FUNCTION, T_CONST], true);
                for ($k = $i; $k < $n && $tokens[$k]['id'] !== ';'; $k++) {
                    $inImport[$k] = true;
                    if ($isFnOrConst) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (in_array($tokens[$k]['id'], [T_STRING, T_NAME_QUALIFIED, T_NAME_FULLY_QUALIFIED], true)) {
                        $parts = explode('\\', $tokens[$k]['text']);
                        $imports[strtolower(end($parts))] = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (in_array($id, [T_CLASS, T_INTERFACE, T_TRAIT], true) || (defined('T_ENUM') && $id === T_ENUM)) {
                $prev = $tokens[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null;
                if ($prev !== T_NEW && $prev !== T_DOUBLE_COLON && ($tokens[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null) === T_STRING) {
                    $declared[strtolower($tokens[$i + 1]['text'])] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($namespace === null) {
            return []; // sem namespace: nomes resolvem no global
        }

        $findings = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if (isset($inImport[$i]) || $tokens[$i]['id'] !== T_STRING) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = $tokens[$i]['text'];
            $prev = $tokens[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null;
            $next = $tokens[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null;

            $isClassRef =
                $prev === T_NEW
                || $prev === T_INSTANCEOF
                || ($next === T_DOUBLE_COLON && !in_array($prev, [T_OBJECT_OPERATOR, T_DOUBLE_COLON, T_NS_SEPARATOR, T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR], true))
                || ($next === T_VARIABLE && !in_array($prev, [T_OBJECT_OPERATOR, T_DOUBLE_COLON], true))
                || ($next === '&' && ($tokens[$i + 2]['id'] ?? null) === T_VARIABLE)
                || ($next === T_ELLIPSIS && ($tokens[$i + 2]['id'] ?? null) === T_VARIABLE);

            if (!$isClassRef) {
                continue;
            }
            $lower = strtolower($name);
            if (in_array($lower, self::BUILTIN_TYPES, true) || isset($imports[$lower]) || isset($declared[$lower])) {
                continue;
            }
            if (self::existsInNamespace($namespace, $name, $srcRoot)) {
                continue;
            }
            $findings[] = ['line' => $tokens[$i]['line'], 'name' => $name];
        }

        return $findings;
    }

    private static function existsInNamespace(string $namespace, string $name, string $srcRoot): bool
    {
        if (!str_starts_with($namespace, 'DomainSystem\\') && $namespace !== 'DomainSystem') {
            return false;
        }
        $relative = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($namespace, strlen('DomainSystem')));
        $dir = rtrim($srcRoot . $relative, '/');

        if (!isset(self::$dirCache[$dir])) {
            self::$dirCache[$dir] = [];
            if (is_dir($dir)) {
                foreach (scandir($dir) as $entry) {
                    if (str_ends_with($entry, '.php')) {
                        self::$dirCache[$dir][strtolower(substr($entry, 0, -4))] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return isset(self::$dirCache[$dir][strtolower($name)]);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/TDD_CYCLE_RECIPE.md
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

# Receita de Desenvolvimento Incremental & TDD

Este roteiro **DEVE** ser seguido rigorosamente pelo Antigravity (ou qualquer engenheiro) durante a evolução do Web OS. É a garantia de que não haverá quebras arquiteturais ou esquecimento de testes.

## Ciclo de Produção

### 1. 📋 Planejamento & Contrato (Design)
- Entender a necessidade de negócio.
- Se for criar uma classe nova, desenhar primeiro a Interface (Contrato).
- Identificar quais componentes (Ring 0 ou Ring 3) serão afetados.

### 2. 🔴 O Teste Vem Primeiro (Red)
- **Antes** (ou imediatamente junto) da codificação principal, escrever o teste unitário ou arquitetural (`tests/Unit/`, `tests/Architecture/`).
- O teste DEVE falhar primeiramente (vermelho). Isso prova que a proteção está ativa e que estamos cobrindo um buraco real.

### 3. 🟢 Implementação (Green)
- Codificar a refatoração ou a feature no core/plugin correspondente.
- Rodar o teste isolado que acabou de ser criado (`php phpunit.phar tests/.../NomeDoTeste.php`).
- Ajustar até a barra ficar **Verde**.

### 4. 🛠️ Limpeza & SOLID (Refactor)
- O código funciona? Ótimo. Agora limpe.
- Existem variáveis soltas? Acoplamento? Classes com dupla responsabilidade (SRP quebrado)? 
- Corrija e mantenha o teste passando.

### 5. 🛡️ Bateria de Regressão
- Rodar a bateria **INTEIRA** de testes (`php phpunit.phar`).
- Garantir que a refatoração atual não causou Efeito Dominó ou disparou o *No-Break Shield* acidentalmente em outros módulos.

### 6. ✍️ Checkpoint & Documentação
- Atualizar `.md` caso regras de negócio mudem.
- Só então pedir autorização para ir ao próximo passo.

> *"Devagar, sem pressa, desde que façamos os testes após a refatoração ou correção."* - Regra de Ouro.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\DefaultBlockRegistryFactory;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Blocks\AcademyBlockProvider;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Plugin as AcademyPlugin;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class AcademyBlockDecouplingTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCoreBlockRegistryDoesNotIncludeUserAuthByDefault(): void
    {
        $registry = DefaultBlockRegistryFactory::create();

        $this->assertCount(14, $registry->all());
        $this->assertFalse($registry->has('user_auth'));
        $this->assertNull($registry->get('user_auth'));
    }

    public function testAcademyBlockProviderInjectsUserAuthBlock(): void
    {
        $registry = DefaultBlockRegistryFactory::create();
        $this->assertFalse($registry->has('user_auth'));

        $provider = new AcademyBlockProvider();
        $provider->registerBlocks($registry);

        $this->assertTrue($registry->has('user_auth'));
        $this->assertCount(15, $registry->all());
        $block = $registry->get('user_auth');
        $this->assertNotNull($block);
        $this->assertSame('Área de Login / Aluno', $block->getName());
        $this->assertSame('👤', $block->getIcon());
        $this->assertSame('navigation', $block->getCategory());
    }

    public function testAcademyPluginRegistersUserAuthViaEventHook(): void
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        $connector = new OsConnector('academy');

        $plugin = new AcademyPlugin(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/src/Plugins/academy');
        $plugin->osRegister($connector);

        $runtime = new OsRuntime($container, $connector, new LinkRegistry($container), $dispatcher, 'academy');

        $registry = DefaultBlockRegistryFactory::create();
        $this->assertFalse($registry->has('user_auth'));

        // Simula boot do plugin Academy
        $plugin->osBoot($runtime);

        // Dispara o hook de registro de blocos
        $dispatcher->dispatch('theme.blocks.register', $registry);

        $this->assertTrue($registry->has('user_auth'));
        $this->assertCount(15, $registry->all());
        $this->assertSame('Área de Login / Aluno', $registry->get('user_auth')->getName());
    }
}

    public function testLessonAdminControllerEditorAndUpdateContent(): void
    {
        $courseId = $this->courseRepo->create([
            'title'       => 'Curso PHP Avançado',
            'slug'        => 'curso-php-avancado',
            'description' => 'Descrição do curso',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        $moduleId = $this->structureRepo->createModule($courseId, 'Módulo 1', 1);
        $lessonId = $this->structureRepo->createLesson([
            'course_id'   => $courseId,
            'module_id'   => $moduleId,
            'title'       => 'Aula Inicial',
            'slug'        => 'aula-inicial',
            'source_type' => 'content',
            'content'     => '',
            'position'    => 1,
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf_token');

        $controller = new LessonAdminController(
            $this->courseRepo,
            $this->structureRepo,
            $session
        );

        // 1. Testa abertura do editor visual
        $editorResp = $controller->editor(new Request(), $lessonId);
        $this->assertSame(200, $editorResp->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Editor em Blocos da Aula', $editorResp->getContent());

        // 2. Testa salvamento de blocos via updateContent (AJAX)

    public function testLessonFileScaffolderFabricatesPhpFileAndDirectCourseSlugRoute(): void
    {
        $tempThemeDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_academy_theme_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($tempThemeDir . '/pages', 0775, true);

        try {
            $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
            $themeManager->method('getActiveThemePath')->willReturn($tempThemeDir);

            $pageResolver = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\ThemePageResolver($themeManager);
            $scaffolder = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\ThemeLessonFileScaffolder(
                $pageResolver,
                $this->renderer,
                $tempThemeDir . '/pages'
            );

            // 1. Fabrica arquivo PHP na raiz de pages/ a partir do título "Estrutura de Dados"
            $blocksJson = json_encode([
                'blocks' => [
                    ['type' => 'header', 'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => 'Árvores Binárias e Grafos']],
                    ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Conteúdo pré-configurado para Mobile e Desktop.']],
                ]
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

            $res = $scaffolder->fabricateLessonFile(
                'Estrutura de Dados',
                '',
                (string)$blocksJson,
                'cinema'
            );

            $this->assertSame('estrutura-de-dados', $res['slug']);
            $this->assertSame('estrutura-de-dados.php', $res['file_name']);
            $this->assertSame('pages/estrutura-de-dados.php', $res['relative_path']);
            $this->assertFileExists($res['full_path']);

            // Verifica se o arquivo PHP fabricado contém o CSS/JS responsivo e pode extrair os blocos de volta
            $extractedJson = $scaffolder->extractBlocksFromFile('pages/estrutura-de-dados.php');
            $this->assertNotNull($extractedJson);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Árvores Binárias e Grafos', $extractedJson);

            // Inspeciona metadados inteligentes do arquivo fabricado
            $meta = $scaffolder->inspectLessonFile('pages/estrutura-de-dados.php');
            $this->assertSame('Estrutura de Dados', $meta['title']);
            $this->assertSame('estrutura-de-dados', $meta['slug']);
            $this->assertSame('cinema', $meta['mobile_profile']);
            $this->assertTrue($meta['has_blocks']);
            $this->assertNotNull($meta['blocks_json']);

            // Inspeciona arquivo em PHP puro com docblock e <h1>
            file_put_contents($tempThemeDir . '/pages/aula-pura.php', "<?php\n/**\n * Título: Minha Aula Pura PHP\n * Perfil Mobile: bottom_bar\n */\n?>\n<h1>Minha Aula Pura PHP</h1>");
            $metaPura = $scaffolder->inspectLessonFile('pages/aula-pura.php');
            $this->assertSame('Minha Aula Pura PHP', $metaPura['title']);
            $this->assertSame('minha-aula-pura-php', $metaPura['slug']);
            $this->assertSame('bottom_bar', $metaPura['mobile_profile']);
            $this->assertFalse($metaPura['has_blocks']);

            // 2. Cria curso e aula vinculada ao arquivo fabricado e testa a rota direta /cursos/estrutura-de-dados
            $courseId = $this->courseRepo->create([
                'title'          => 'Ciência da Computação',
                'slug'           => 'ciencia-da-computacao',
                'description'    => 'Curso completo',
                'status'         => 'published',
                'mobile_profile' => 'cinema',
            ]);

            $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, [
                [
                    'title'       => 'Módulo 1',
                    'folder_slug' => '',
                    'position'    => 1,
                    'lessons'     => [
                        [
                            'title'          => 'Estrutura de Dados',
                            'slug'           => $res['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => 'theme_file',
                            'file_path'      => $res['relative_path'],
                            'content'        => $blocksJson,
                            'mobile_profile' => 'cinema',
                            'status'         => 'published',

            $frontController = new CourseFrontController(

            $directResponse = $frontController->showCourse('estrutura-de-dados');

    public function testAtomicJsonStoreAndRouteCircuitBreakerThreshold(): void
    {
        $tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_atomic_test_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($tempDir, 0775, true);

        try {
            $store = new \DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore();
            $filePath = $tempDir . '/state.json';

            $this->assertTrue($store->write($filePath, ['count' => 1]));
            $this->assertSame(['count' => 1], $store->read($filePath));

            $updated = $store->update($filePath, function (array $current): array {
                $current['count'] = ($current['count'] ?? 0) + 1;
                return $current;
            });
            $this->assertSame(2, $updated['count']);
            $this->assertSame(2, $store->read($filePath)['count']);

            // Testa CircuitBreaker por rota com limiar 3
            $configPath = $tempDir . '/plugins.json';
            $disarmedPath = $tempDir . '/disarmed.json';
            $store->write($configPath, ['rogue_plugin' => true]);
            $store->write($disarmedPath, []);

            $breaker = new \DomainSystem\Core\Error\CircuitBreaker($configPath, $disarmedPath, $store);
            $ex = new \RuntimeException('Falha simulada em src/Plugins/rogue_plugin/Controller.php');

            $this->assertNull($breaker->recordRouteException($ex, 3));
            $this->assertSame(1, $breaker->getRouteFailureCount('rogue_plugin'));
            $this->assertTrue($store->read($configPath)['rogue_plugin']);

            $this->assertNull($breaker->recordRouteException($ex, 3));
            $this->assertSame(2, $breaker->getRouteFailureCount('rogue_plugin'));
            $this->assertTrue($store->read($configPath)['rogue_plugin']);

            // Na 3ª falha consecutiva, desarma!
            $this->assertSame('rogue_plugin', $breaker->recordRouteException($ex, 3));
            $this->assertFalse($store->read($configPath)['rogue_plugin']);
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('rogue_plugin', $store->read($disarmedPath));
        } finally {
            $this->removeDirectory($tempDir);
        }
    }

    public function testPluginMigrationScannerAndStateSnapshotManager(): void
    {
        $rootDir = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $scanner = new \DomainSystem\Core\Database\PluginMigrationScanner($rootDir);

        $discovered = $scanner->discover();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('academy', $discovered);
        $this->assertCount(4, $discovered['academy']['files']);

        $runner = new \DomainSystem\Core\Database\MigrationRunner($this->pdo);
        $healResult = $scanner->healAll($runner);
        $this->assertEmpty($healResult['errors']);

        $statusReport = $scanner->inspectStatus($runner);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($statusReport);
        $this->assertSame('ok', $statusReport['academy']['status']);
        $this->assertCount(4, $statusReport['academy']['executed']);

        // Testa StateSnapshotManager
        $tempRoot = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_snap_test_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($tempRoot . '/config', 0775, true);
        mkdir($tempRoot . '/storage', 0775, true);

        try {
            $store = new \DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore();
            $store->write($tempRoot . '/config/plugins.json', ['academy' => true, 'seo' => true]);

            $snapshotMgr = new \DomainSystem\Core\Storage\StateSnapshotManager($tempRoot, $store);
            $snap = $snapshotMgr->createSnapshot('before-change');

            $this->assertNotEmpty($snap['id']);
            $this->assertCount(1, $snapshotMgr->listSnapshots());

            // Modifica estado atual e restaura snapshot
            $store->write($tempRoot . '/config/plugins.json', ['academy' => false]);
            $this->assertFalse($store->read($tempRoot . '/config/plugins.json')['academy']);

            $this->assertTrue($snapshotMgr->restoreSnapshot($snap['id']));
            $this->assertTrue($store->read($tempRoot . '/config/plugins.json')['academy']);
        } finally {
            $this->removeDirectory($tempRoot);
        }
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $items = scandir($dir) ?: [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/AcademyCourseEnrollmentTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseEnrollmentService;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class AcademyCourseEnrollmentTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository $repository;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->repository = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($this->pdo);
    }

    public function testEnrollmentLifecycleActiveExpireAndRevoke(): void
    {
        $service = new CourseEnrollmentService($this->repository);

        $studentId = 42;
        $courseId = 10;

        // 1. Sem matrícula inicial
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId));

        // 2. Efetiva matrícula vitalícia
        $enrolled = $service->enroll($studentId, $courseId, null, 'PED_1001');
        $this->assertTrue($enrolled);
        $this->assertTrue($service->hasActiveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId));
        $this->assertContains($courseId, $service->getActiveCourseIds($studentId));

        // 3. Matrícula com data expirada
        $yesterday = (new DateTimeImmutable())->modify('-1 day');
        $service->enroll($studentId, $courseId, $yesterday);
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId));

        // 4. Renova com data futura
        $nextMonth = (new DateTimeImmutable())->modify('+30 days');
        $service->enroll($studentId, $courseId, $nextMonth);
        $this->assertTrue($service->hasActiveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId));

        // 5. Revoga matrícula (cancelamento / estorno)
        $revoked = $service->revoke($studentId, $courseId);
        $this->assertTrue($revoked);
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId));
    }

    public function testFreeCourseGrantsActiveEnrollmentRegardlessOfDatabase(): void
    {
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(99)->willReturn([
            'id'      => 99,
            'title'   => 'Curso Introdutório Gratuito',
            'is_free' => 1,
            'price'   => 0.00,
        ]);

        $service = new CourseEnrollmentService($this->repository, $courseRepo);

        // Aluno nunca matriculado tem acesso liberado por ser curso gratuito
        $this->assertTrue($service->hasActiveEnrollment(77, 99));
    }

    public function testCountEnrolledInCourse(): void
    {
        $service = new CourseEnrollmentService($this->repository);
        $courseId = 5;

        $service->enroll(1, $courseId);
        $service->enroll(2, $courseId);
        $service->enroll(3, $courseId);

        $this->assertSame(3, $this->repository->countEnrolledInCourse($courseId));

        $service->revoke(2, $courseId);
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->repository->countEnrolledInCourse($courseId));
    }

    public function testCourseFrontControllerBlocksPaidLessonWithoutEnrollmentAndUnlocksWhenEnrolled(): void
    {
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findBySlug')->with('curso-pago')->willReturn([
            'id'          => 12,
            'title'       => 'Curso de Especialização',
            'slug'        => 'curso-pago',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'price'       => 197.00,
            'is_free'     => 0,
            'description' => 'Descrição do curso',
        ]);

        $structureRepo = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureRepo->method('getPublishedLessonBySlug')->with(12, 'aula-01')->willReturn([
            'id'          => 101,
            'course_id'   => 12,
            'title'       => 'Aula 01 — Fundamentos',
            'slug'        => 'aula-01',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'is_free'     => 0,
            'content'     => json_encode(['blocks' => [['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Conteúdo Secreto da Aula 01']]]]),
        ]);

        $navService = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface::class);
        $navService->method('renderCourseNav')->willReturn('<nav>menu</nav>');
        $navService->method('getAdjacentLessons')->willReturn(['prev' => null, 'next' => null]);

        $catalogRenderer = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k) {
            return $k === 'user_id' ? 42 : ($k === 'user_role' ? 'student' : null);
        });

        $enrollmentService = new CourseEnrollmentService($this->repository, $courseRepo);

        $controller = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseFrontController(
            $courseRepo,
            $structureRepo,
            $navService,
            $catalogRenderer,
            null,
            null,
            new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer(),
            null,
            $enrollmentService,
            $session
        );

        // 1. Aluno 42 NÃO está matriculado no curso 12 -> Conteúdo secreto é bloqueado
        $responseBlocked = $controller->showLesson('curso-pago', 'aula-01');
        $htmlBlocked = $responseBlocked->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Conteúdo Exclusivo para Alunos Matriculados', $htmlBlocked);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Matricular-se por R$ 197,00', $htmlBlocked);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Conteúdo Secreto da Aula 01', $htmlBlocked);

        // 2. Aluno 42 É matriculado no curso 12 -> Conteúdo secreto é liberado
        $enrollmentService->enroll(42, 12);
        $responseUnlocked = $controller->showLesson('curso-pago', 'aula-01');
        $htmlUnlocked = $responseUnlocked->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Conteúdo Exclusivo para Alunos Matriculados', $htmlUnlocked);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Conteúdo Secreto da Aula 01', $htmlUnlocked);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/AcademyCoursePackageTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CoursePackageService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LocalCourseImageStorage;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use ZipArchive;

class AcademyCoursePackageTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoCourseRepository $courseRepo;
    private PdoCourseStructureRepository $structureRepo;
    private CourseService $courseService;
    private string $tempThemeDir;
    private string $tempTargetDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        if (!class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Extensão ZipArchive não disponível no ambiente.');
        }

        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $this->courseRepo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $this->structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $this->structureRepo->ensureTables();

        $storage = new class implements \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseImageStorageInterface {
            public function storeUpload(array $fileInfo): string { return ''; }
            public function deleteFile(string $relativePath): void {}
        };

        $this->courseService = new CourseService($this->courseRepo, $storage);

        $this->tempThemeDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_test_theme_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        mkdir($this->tempThemeDir . '/pages/solid/modulo-1', 0755, true);

        $this->tempTargetDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_test_target_theme_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        mkdir($this->tempTargetDir . '/pages', 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->cleanupDirectory($this->tempThemeDir);
        $this->cleanupDirectory($this->tempTargetDir);
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    private function cleanupDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir), ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->cleanupDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testExportCourseZipCreatesValidArchiveWithManifestAndPhpFiles(): void
    {
        // 1. Cria Curso SOLID
        $courseId = $this->courseRepo->create([
            'title'       => 'Curso Completo de SOLID',
            'slug'        => 'solid',
            'description' => 'Domine os 5 princípios de design orientado a objetos.',
            'price'       => 197.00,
            'access_type' => 'paid',
            'category'    => 'Desenvolvimento',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        // 2. Cria arquivo de aula no tema
        $lessonFile1 = $this->tempThemeDir . '/pages/solid/01-introducao.php';
        file_put_contents($lessonFile1, "<?php\n/**\n * Título: Introdução ao SOLID\n */\necho '<h1>Introdução ao SOLID</h1>';\n");

        $lessonFile2 = $this->tempThemeDir . '/pages/solid/modulo-1/02-srp.php';
        file_put_contents($lessonFile2, "<?php\n/**\n * Título: Princípio da Responsabilidade Única (SRP)\n */\necho '<h1>SRP</h1>';\n");

        // 3. Cadastra estrutura do curso
        $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, [
            [
                'title'       => 'Módulo 1 - Fundamentos',
                'folder_slug' => 'solid',
                'position'    => 1,
                'lessons'     => [
                    [
                        'title'          => 'Introdução ao SOLID',
                        'slug'           => '01-introducao',
                        'source_type'    => 'theme_file',
                        'source'         => 'pages/solid/01-introducao.php',
                        'mobile_profile' => 'drawer',
                        'status'         => 'published',
                    ],
                    [
                        'title'          => 'Princípio da Responsabilidade Única (SRP)',
                        'slug'           => '02-srp',
                        'source_type'    => 'theme_file',
                        'source'         => 'pages/solid/modulo-1/02-srp.php',
                        'mobile_profile' => 'drawer',
                        'status'         => 'published',
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        // Mock do ThemePageResolver apontando para $this->tempThemeDir
        $themeResolver = $this->createMock(ThemePageResolverInterface::class);
        $themeResolver->method('resolveActiveThemePath')->willReturn($this->tempThemeDir);

        $packageService = new CoursePackageService(
            $this->courseRepo,
            $this->structureRepo,
            $themeResolver,
            $this->courseService
        );

        // Exporta ZIP
        $zipPath = $packageService->exportCourseZip($courseId);

        $this->assertFileExists($zipPath);

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($zipPath));

        // Verifica manifesto
        $manifestJson = $zip->getFromName('course.json');
        $this->assertNotEmpty($manifestJson);

        $manifest = json_decode($manifestJson, true);
        $this->assertSame('Curso Completo de SOLID', $manifest['course']['title']);
        $this->assertSame('solid', $manifest['course']['slug']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $manifest['structure']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $manifest['structure'][0]['lessons']);

        // Verifica se os arquivos PHP foram incluídos no ZIP
        $this->assertNotFalse($zip->getFromName('pages/solid/01-introducao.php'));
        $this->assertNotFalse($zip->getFromName('pages/solid/modulo-1/02-srp.php'));

        $zip->close();
        @unlink($zipPath);
    }

    public function testImportCourseZipRestoresCourseAndExtractsPhpFiles(): void
    {
        // 1. Prepara um ZIP válido de curso
        $zipPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/test_import_course_' . uniqid() . '.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE);

        $manifest = [
            'schema_version' => '2.6.0',
            'generator'      => 'DomainSystem Academy LMS',
            'course'         => [
                'title'       => 'Curso Avançado de Python',
                'slug'        => 'python-avancado',
                'description' => 'Aprenda decoradores, geradores e metaprogramação.',
                'price'       => 0.00,
                'access_type' => 'free',
                'category'    => 'Programação',
                'status'      => 'published',
            ],
            'structure'      => [
                [
                    'title'       => 'Módulo 1 - Metaprogramação',
                    'folder_slug' => 'python-avancado/m1',
                    'position'    => 1,
                    'lessons'     => [
                        [
                            'title'          => 'Decoradores na Prática',
                            'slug'           => 'decoradores',
                            'source_type'    => 'theme_file',
                            'source'         => 'pages/python-avancado/m1/decoradores.php',
                            'mobile_profile' => 'bottom_sheet',
                            'status'         => 'published',
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $zip->addFromString('course.json', json_encode($manifest));
        $zip->addFromString('pages/python-avancado/m1/decoradores.php', "<?php echo 'Decoradores Python'; ?>");
        $zip->close();

        // 2. Importa o ZIP no tema de destino
        $themeResolver = $this->createMock(ThemePageResolverInterface::class);
        $themeResolver->method('resolveActiveThemePath')->willReturn($this->tempTargetDir);

        $packageService = new CoursePackageService(
            $this->courseRepo,
            $this->structureRepo,
            $themeResolver,
            $this->courseService
        );

        $result = $packageService->importCourseZip($zipPath, $this->tempTargetDir);

        // 3. Valida resultado retornado
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('course_id', $result);
        $this->assertSame('Curso Avançado de Python', $result['title']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $result['modules_count']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $result['lessons_count']);

        // 4. Valida se o arquivo PHP foi extraído fisicamente
        $extractedFile = $this->tempTargetDir . '/pages/python-avancado/m1/decoradores.php';
        $this->assertFileExists($extractedFile);
        $this->assertSame("<?php echo 'Decoradores Python'; ?>", file_get_contents($extractedFile));

        // 5. Valida se o curso e as aulas foram gravados no banco
        $importedCourse = $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$result['course_id']);
        $this->assertNotNull($importedCourse);
        $this->assertSame('Curso Avançado de Python', $importedCourse['title']);

        $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$result['course_id']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $modules);
        $this->assertSame('Módulo 1 - Metaprogramação', $modules[0]['title']);

        $lessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$result['course_id']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $lessons);
        $this->assertSame('Decoradores na Prática', $lessons[0]['title']);
        $this->assertSame('pages/python-avancado/m1/decoradores.php', $lessons[0]['source']);

        @unlink($zipPath);
    }

    public function testImportCourseZipBlocksPathTraversalZipSlip(): void
    {
        $zipPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/test_slip_course_' . uniqid() . '.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE);

        $manifest = [
            'course'    => ['title' => 'Malicious Course', 'slug' => 'malicious'],
            'structure' => [],
        ];

        $zip->addFromString('course.json', json_encode($manifest));
        $zip->addFromString('../../../evil.php', "<?php // hack");
        $zip->addFromString('pages/../../evil2.php', "<?php // hack");
        $zip->close();

        $themeResolver = $this->createMock(ThemePageResolverInterface::class);
        $themeResolver->method('resolveActiveThemePath')->willReturn($this->tempTargetDir);

        $packageService = new CoursePackageService(
            $this->courseRepo,
            $this->structureRepo,
            $themeResolver,
            $this->courseService
        );

        $result = $packageService->importCourseZip($zipPath, $this->tempTargetDir);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($result['course_id']);
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($this->tempTargetDir . '/evil.php');
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($this->tempTargetDir . '/evil2.php');
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist(dirname($this->tempTargetDir) . '/evil.php');

        @unlink($zipPath);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseCatalogRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LocalCourseImageStorage;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class AcademyCourseTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private string $tempUploadDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $this->tempUploadDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/academy_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        if (!is_dir($this->tempUploadDir)) {
            mkdir($this->tempUploadDir, 0755, true);
        }
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->cleanupDirectory($this->tempUploadDir);
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    private function cleanupDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir), ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->cleanupDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    /**
     * Gera um arquivo PNG binário válido com largura/altura específicas, sem depender da extensão GD.
     */
    private function createDummyImage(int $width, int $height): string
    {
        $filePath = $this->tempUploadDir . '/dummy_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.png';
        $sig = "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n";
        $ihdrData = pack('NN', $width, $height) . "\x08\x02\x00\x00\x00";
        $ihdrChunk = pack('N', 13) . 'IHDR' . $ihdrData . pack('N', crc32('IHDR' . $ihdrData));
        $iendChunk = pack('N', 0) . 'IEND' . pack('N', crc32('IEND'));

        file_put_contents($filePath, $sig . $ihdrChunk . $iendChunk);
        return $filePath;
    }

    public function testRepositoryCrudOperations(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);

        $this->assertEmpty($repo->findAll());

        $id = $repo->create([
            'title'       => 'Curso de Arquitetura Limpa',
            'slug'        => 'curso-de-arquitetura-limpa',
            'thumbnail'   => 'uploads/academy/clean.png',
            'description' => 'Domine SOLID e Micro-Kernels em PHP.',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'link'        => 'https://exemplo.com/curso',
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $id);

        $found = $repo->findById($id);
        $this->assertNotNull($found);
        $this->assertSame('Curso de Arquitetura Limpa', $found['title']);
        $this->assertSame('curso-de-arquitetura-limpa', $found['slug']);
        $this->assertSame('published', $found['status']);

        $bySlug = $repo->findBySlug('curso-de-arquitetura-limpa');
        $this->assertNotNull($bySlug);
        $this->assertSame($id, (int)$bySlug['id']);

        $published = $repo->findPublished();
        $this->assertCount(1, $published);

        // Update
        $updated = $repo->update($id, [
            'title'       => 'Curso Avançado de Arquitetura Limpa',
            'slug'        => 'curso-avancado-de-arquitetura-limpa',
            'thumbnail'   => 'uploads/academy/clean-v2.png',
            'description' => 'Versão 2.0 revisada.',
            'status'      => 'soon',
            'link'        => 'https://exemplo.com/curso-v2',
        ]);
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $foundUpdated = $repo->findById($id);
        $this->assertSame('Curso Avançado de Arquitetura Limpa', $foundUpdated['title']);
        $this->assertSame('soon', $foundUpdated['status']);

        // Delete
        $deleted = $repo->delete($id);
        $this->assertTrue($deleted);
        $this->assertNull($repo->findById($id));
    }

    public function testAccentSafeSlugGenerationAndCollisionHandling(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);
        $service = new CourseService($repo, $storage);

        // 1. Slugs com acentos devem ser transliterados
        $id1 = $service->createCourse([

        ]);
        $course1 = $repo->findById($id1);

    public function testImageStorageValidates16By9AspectRatio(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);

        // 1. Imagem quadrada (1:1 -> 640x640) deve ser rejeitada
        $squareImg = $this->createDummyImage(640, 640);
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('proporção 16:9');
        $storage->storeUpload([
            'tmp_name' => $squareImg,
            'size'     => filesize($squareImg),
        ]);
    }

    public function testImageStorageRejectsImagesSmallerThanMinimum(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);

        // Imagem 16:9 mas menor que 640x360 (ex: 320x180) deve ser rejeitada
        $smallImg = $this->createDummyImage(320, 180);
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Dimensão mínima exigida: 640x360 pixels');
        $storage->storeUpload([
            'tmp_name' => $smallImg,
            'size'     => filesize($smallImg),
        ]);
    }

    public function testImageStorageAcceptsCompliant16By9Image(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);

        // Imagem 640x360 (16:9 perfeito)
        $validImg = $this->createDummyImage(640, 360);
        $savedPath = $storage->storeUpload([
            'tmp_name' => $validImg,
            'size'     => filesize($validImg),
        ]);

        $this->assertStringStartsWith('uploads/academy/course_', $savedPath);
        $this->assertStringEndsWith('.png', $savedPath);

        // Verifica que o arquivo físico existe no diretório
        $fullPath = $storage->getUploadDir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . basename($savedPath);
        $this->assertFileExists($fullPath);

        // Remove
        $storage->deleteFile($savedPath);
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($fullPath);
    }

    public function testCourseAdminControllerWorkflow(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);
        $service = new CourseService($repo, $storage);

        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf_token');
        $sessionMock->method('getFlash')->willReturn(null);

        $controller = new CourseAdminController($repo, $service, $sessionMock);

        // 1. Index
        $req = new Request();
        $indexResponse = $controller->index($req);
        $this->assertSame(200, $indexResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Academy (Cursos)', $indexResponse->getContent());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('[hub_de_cursos]', $indexResponse->getContent());

        // 2. Store via POST
        $storeReq = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'  => 'valid_csrf_token',
            'title'       => 'Dominando TDD no PHP',
            'description' => 'Testes automatizados com PHPUnit.',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'link'        => 'https://rachidd.com/cursos/tdd',
        ]);
        $storeResponse = $controller->store($storeReq);
        $this->assertSame(302, $storeResponse->getStatusCode());

        $courses = $repo->findAll();
        $this->assertCount(1, $courses);
        $courseId = (int)$courses[0]['id'];
        $this->assertSame('Dominando TDD no PHP', $courses[0]['title']);

        // 3. Edit view
        $editResponse = $controller->edit($req, $courseId);
        $this->assertSame(200, $editResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Editar Curso #' . $courseId, $editResponse->getContent());

        // 4. Update
        $updateReq = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'  => 'valid_csrf_token',
            'title'       => 'Dominando TDD no PHP 8.2',
            'description' => 'Testes automatizados atualizados.',
            'status'      => 'soon',
            'link'        => 'https://rachidd.com/cursos/tdd-v2',
        ]);
        $updateResponse = $controller->update($updateReq, $courseId);
        $this->assertSame(302, $updateResponse->getStatusCode());

        $updated = $repo->findById($courseId);
        $this->assertSame('Dominando TDD no PHP 8.2', $updated['title']);
        $this->assertSame('soon', $updated['status']);

        // 5. Delete
        $deleteReq = new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'valid_csrf_token']);
        $deleteResponse = $controller->delete($deleteReq, $courseId);
        $this->assertSame(302, $deleteResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertNull($repo->findById($courseId));
    }

    public function testCourseAdminControllerCanManageCourseStructure(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);
        $service = new CourseService($repo, $storage);
        $structureRepo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $themeMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $themeMock->method('getAvailablePages')->willReturn(['pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php']);

        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf_token');

        $controller = new CourseAdminController($repo, $service, $sessionMock, $structureRepo, $themeMock);

        $courseId = $repo->create([
            'title'       => 'Curso Arquitetura de Microsserviços',
            'slug'        => 'curso-microsservicos',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        // 1. Edit exibe a seção de estrutura e os arquivos de tema disponíveis
        $editResponse = $controller->edit(new Request(), $courseId);
        $this->assertSame(200, $editResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Estrutura do Curso (Módulos &amp; Aulas)', $editResponse->getContent());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php', $editResponse->getContent());

        // 2. Salva estrutura via updateStructure
        $structurePayload = [
            [
                'title'   => 'Módulo 1: Setup do Ambiente',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'title'       => '01 - Instalação do Ambiente',
                        'slug'        => '01-instalacao',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source'      => 'pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php',
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $updateReq = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'     => 'valid_csrf_token',
            'structure_json' => json_encode($structurePayload),
        ]);

        $response = $controller->updateStructure($updateReq, $courseId);
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());

        $modules = $structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $this->assertCount(1, $modules);
        $this->assertSame('Módulo 1: Setup do Ambiente', $modules[0]['title']);

        $lessons = $structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);
        $this->assertCount(1, $lessons);
        $this->assertSame('01 - Instalação do Ambiente', $lessons[0]['title']);
        $this->assertSame('01-instalacao', $lessons[0]['slug']);
        $this->assertSame('pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php', $lessons[0]['source']);
    }

    public function testStorageWithPublicStorageInterface(): void
    {
        $publicStorage = new \DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage($this->tempUploadDir, '/base-site');
        $courseStorage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($publicStorage);

        $imgPath = $this->createDummyImage(1280, 720);
        $fileInfo = [
            'name'     => 'test.png',
            'type'     => 'image/png',
            'tmp_name' => $imgPath,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => filesize($imgPath),
        ];

        $this->assertStringStartsWith('uploads/academy/course_', $relativePath);

    public function testDraftAndSoonLessonsOrCoursesAreBlockedPublicly(): void
    {
        $courseRepo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $structureRepo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $navService = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseNavigationService($courseRepo, $structureRepo, '');
        $catalogRenderer = new CourseCatalogRenderer($courseRepo);
        $frontController = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseFrontController(
            $courseRepo,
            $structureRepo,
            $navService,
            $catalogRenderer
        );

        $courseId = $courseRepo->create([
            'title'       => 'Curso de Segurança Web',
            'slug'        => 'curso-seguranca-web',
            'description' => 'Segurança em aplicações PHP.',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        $modId = $structureRepo->createModule($courseId, 'Módulo 1', 1);
        $structureRepo->createLesson([
            'course_id'   => $courseId,
            'module_id'   => $modId,
            'title'       => 'Aula 01 Publicada',
            'slug'        => 'aula-01-publicada',
            'source_type' => 'content',
            'content'     => '<p>Conteúdo publicado</p>',
            'position'    => 1,
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);
        $structureRepo->createLesson([
            'course_id'   => $courseId,
            'module_id'   => $modId,
            'title'       => 'Aula 02 Secreta em Rascunho',
            'slug'        => 'aula-02-rascunho',
            'source_type' => 'content',
            'content'     => '<p>Conteúdo confidencial não publicado</p>',
            'position'    => 2,
            'status'      => 'draft',
        ]);

        // 1. Aula publicada em curso publicado retorna 200
        $resPublished = $frontController->showLesson('curso-seguranca-web', 'aula-01-publicada');
        $this->assertSame(200, $resPublished->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Conteúdo publicado', $resPublished->getContent());

        // 2. Aula em rascunho NUNCA deve abrir no front público (deve retornar 404)
        $resDraft = $frontController->showLesson('curso-seguranca-web', 'aula-02-rascunho');
        $this->assertSame(404, $resDraft->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Conteúdo confidencial não publicado', $resDraft->getContent());

        // 3. Navegação lateral e adjacência não devem listar a aula em rascunho
        $navHtml = $navService->renderCourseNav('curso-seguranca-web', 'aula-01-publicada');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Aula 01 Publicada', $navHtml);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Aula 02 Secreta em Rascunho', $navHtml);

        $adjacent = $navService->getAdjacentLessons('curso-seguranca-web', 'aula-01-publicada');
        $this->assertNull($adjacent['next']);

        // 4. Se o curso estiver 'soon' (Em breve), as aulas não devem abrir no front público
        $courseRepo->update($courseId, [
            'title'       => 'Curso de Segurança Web',
            'slug'        => 'curso-seguranca-web',
            'description' => 'Segurança em aplicações PHP.',
            'thumbnail'   => null,
            'status'      => 'soon',
            'link'        => null,
        ]);

        $resSoonLesson = $frontController->showLesson('curso-seguranca-web', 'aula-01-publicada');
        $this->assertSame(404, $resSoonLesson->getStatusCode());

        $resSoonCourse = $frontController->showCourse('curso-seguranca-web');
        $this->assertSame(200, $resSoonCourse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Começar Agora', $resSoonCourse->getContent());
    }

    public function testUpdateCoursePreservesOldThumbnailAndCleansNewWhenDbFails(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);

        $oldImg = $this->createDummyImage(640, 360);
        $oldThumbnailRel = $storage->storeUpload([
            'tmp_name' => $oldImg,
            'size'     => filesize($oldImg),
        ]);
        $oldFullPath = $storage->getUploadDir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . basename($oldThumbnailRel);
        $this->assertFileExists($oldFullPath);

        $repoMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $repoMock->method('findById')->willReturn([
            'id'          => 10,
            'title'       => 'Curso Original',
            'slug'        => 'curso-original',
            'description' => 'Desc',
            'thumbnail'   => $oldThumbnailRel,
            'status'      => 'published',
            'link'        => '',
        ]);
        $repoMock->method('update')->willReturn(false);

        $service = new CourseService($repoMock, $storage);

        $newImg = $this->createDummyImage(1280, 720);
        $updated = $service->updateCourse(10, [
            'title'  => 'Curso Original',
            'status' => 'published',
        ], [
            'tmp_name' => $newImg,
            'size'     => filesize($newImg),
        ]);

        $this->assertFalse($updated);
        // A imagem antiga NÃO pode ter sido apagada quando o banco falhou
        $this->assertFileExists($oldFullPath);
        // E não deve sobrar a imagem nova órfã no diretório de uploads
        $filesInUploadDir = array_values(array_diff(scandir($storage->getUploadDir()), ['.', '..']));
        $this->assertSame([basename($oldThumbnailRel)], $filesInUploadDir);
    }

    public function testCreateCourseCleansUpThumbnailWhenDbThrowsException(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);
        $repoMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $repoMock->method('findBySlug')->willReturn(null);

                'tmp_name' => $newImg,
                'size'     => filesize($newImg),
            ]);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado RuntimeException');
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('DB insert failed', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $filesInUploadDir = array_values(array_diff(scandir($storage->getUploadDir()), ['.', '..']));
        $this->assertEmpty($filesInUploadDir, 'Arquivo de upload órfão deve ser removido se create() falhar');
    }

    public function testDeleteCourseDoesNotDeleteThumbnailIfDbDeleteFails(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);

        $repoMock->method('findById')->willReturn([

            'thumbnail' => $thumbRel,
        ]);

        $service = new CourseService($repoMock, $storage);

    public function testCoursePricingAndFreeToggleWorkflow(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir);
        $service = new CourseService($repo, $storage);

        // 1. Cadastra curso pago
        $paidId = $service->createCourse([
            'title'       => 'Curso Pro de PHP 8.2',
            'description' => 'Curso com precificação ativa',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'price'       => 197.50,
            'is_free'     => 0,
        ]);

        $paidCourse = $repo->findById($paidId);
        $this->assertNotNull($paidCourse);
        $this->assertEquals(197.50, (float)$paidCourse['price']);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int)$paidCourse['is_free']);

        // 2. Atualiza para gratuito
        $service->updateCourse($paidId, [
            'title'       => 'Curso Pro de PHP 8.2 (Gratuito)',
            'description' => 'Liberado para todos',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'price'       => 0.00,
            'is_free'     => 1,
        ]);

        $updatedCourse = $repo->findById($paidId);
        $this->assertEquals(0.00, (float)$updatedCourse['price']);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int)$updatedCourse['is_free']);

        // 3. Cadastra com preço > 0 mas com is_free = 1 (simulação de conflito no formulário)
        $autoPaidId = $service->createCourse([
            'title'       => 'Curso Com Preço e Flag Conflitante',
            'description' => 'Preço deve prevalecer',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'price'       => 10.00,
            'is_free'     => 1,
        ]);

        $autoPaidCourse = $repo->findById($autoPaidId);
        $this->assertNotNull($autoPaidCourse);
        $this->assertEquals(10.00, (float)$autoPaidCourse['price']);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int)$autoPaidCourse['is_free'], 'Preço maior que zero deve forçar is_free = 0');

        // 4. Update com preço > 0 mas is_free = 1
        $service->updateCourse($autoPaidId, [
            'title'       => 'Curso Com Preço e Flag Conflitante Atualizado',
            'description' => 'Preço deve prevalecer no update',
            'status'      => 'published',
            'price'       => 25.00,
            'is_free'     => 1,
        ]);

        $updatedAutoPaid = $repo->findById($autoPaidId);
        $this->assertEquals(25.00, (float)$updatedAutoPaid['price']);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int)$updatedAutoPaid['is_free'], 'Update com preço > 0 deve forçar is_free = 0');
    }

    public function testStoreRejectsPaidCourseWithZeroPrice(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $storage = new LocalCourseImageStorage($this->tempUploadDir, 'uploads/academy');
        $service = new CourseService($repo, $storage);

        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf_token');
        $sessionMock->expects($this->once())
            ->method('setFlash')
            ->with('error', 'Informe um preço maior que zero para cursos pagos ou marque o curso como gratuito.');

        $controller = new CourseAdminController($repo, $service, $sessionMock);

        // Post com is_free = 0 mas price = 0
        $request = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'valid_csrf_token',
            'title' => 'Curso Pago Sem Preço',
            'is_free' => '0',
            'price' => '0.00',
        ]);

        $response = $controller->store($request);

        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertEmpty($repo->findAll(), 'Nenhum curso deve ter sido gravado no banco');
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/AcademyPdfViewerBlockTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\LessonAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LocalLessonPdfStorage;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class AcademyPdfViewerBlockTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_pdf_test_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/public', 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDir($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDir(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']) as $item) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDir($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testLocalLessonPdfStorageValidatesMagicHeaderAndStoresValidPdf(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, fn() => 'https://meusite.com');
        $pdfStorage = new LocalLessonPdfStorage($storage);

        $validPdfPath = $this->tempDir . '/sample.pdf';
        file_put_contents($validPdfPath, "%PDF-1.7\n1 0 obj << /Type /Catalog >> endobj\n%%EOF");

        $result = $pdfStorage->storePdfUpload([
            'name'     => 'Apostila Cap 3 - Gráficos.pdf',
            'tmp_name' => $validPdfPath,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => filesize($validPdfPath),
        ]);

        $this->assertStringStartsWith('https://meusite.com/uploads/academy/pdfs/pdf_apostila-cap-3-gr-ficos_', $result['url']);
        $this->assertStringEndsWith('.pdf', $result['file_name']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(10, $result['size']);
    }

    public function testLocalLessonPdfStorageRejectsDisguisedNonPdfFile(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, fn() => 'https://meusite.com');
        $pdfStorage = new LocalLessonPdfStorage($storage);

        $fakePdfPath = $this->tempDir . '/evil.pdf';
        file_put_contents($fakePdfPath, "<script>alert('xss')</script>");

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('%PDF-');

        $pdfStorage->storePdfUpload([
            'name'     => 'evil.pdf',
            'tmp_name' => $fakePdfPath,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => filesize($fakePdfPath),
        ]);
    }

    public function testLessonBlockRendererRendersPdfCanvasModeWithPageSliceAndDownloadLock(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, fn() => 'https://cdn.rachidd.com');
        $pdfStorage = new LocalLessonPdfStorage($storage);
        $renderer = new LessonBlockRenderer($pdfStorage);

        $json = json_encode([
            'blocks' => [
                [
                    'id'   => 'b_pdf_1',
                    'type' => 'pdf',
                    'data' => [
                        'url'            => 'https://cdn.rachidd.com/cursos/diagramas-pesados.pdf',
                        'title'          => 'Figura 4.2 — Fluxograma e Gráficos',
                        'mode'           => 'pdfjs_canvas',
                        'start_page'     => 12,
                        'end_page'       => 15,
                        'height'         => '620px',
                        'allow_download' => false,
                        'caption'        => 'Navegue pelas páginas 12 a 15 para inspecionar os vetores.',
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        $html = $renderer->render((string)$json);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-block-pdf ds-pdf-mode-pdfjs_canvas', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Figura 4.2 — Fluxograma e Gráficos', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Págs. 12&ndash;15', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-start-page="12"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-end-page="15"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-allow-download="0"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('oncontextmenu="return false;"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('⬇ Baixar', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Navegue pelas páginas 12 a 15 para inspecionar os vetores.', $html);
    }

    public function testLessonBlockRendererConvertsGoogleDriveLinkAndBlocksMaliciousSchemes(): void
    {
        $renderer = new LessonBlockRenderer();

        // 1. Link do Google Drive convertido automaticamente para /preview
        $gdHtml = $renderer->renderPdf([
            'url'   => 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz/view?usp=sharing',
            'title' => 'Slides na Nuvem',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz/preview', $gdHtml);

        $gdOpenHtml = $renderer->renderPdf([
            'url'   => 'https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz&usp=sharing',
            'title' => 'Slides Open Link',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz/preview', $gdOpenHtml);

        // 2. Link do Microsoft OneDrive / SharePoint e tag <iframe> colada diretamente
        $odHtml = $renderer->renderPdf([
            'url'   => '<iframe src="https://onedrive.live.com/embed?resid=12345&amp;authkey=ABC" width="476" height="288"></iframe>',
            'title' => 'Apostila OneDrive',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://onedrive.live.com/embed?resid=12345&amp;authkey=ABC', $odHtml);

        $spHtml = $renderer->renderPdf([
            'url'   => 'https://empresa-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/doc_pdf',
            'title' => 'PDF SharePoint',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('action=embedview', $spHtml);

        // 3. Dropbox com conversão de ?dl=0 para ?raw=1
        $dbxHtml = $renderer->renderPdf([
            'url'   => 'https://www.dropbox.com/s/123456/apostila.pdf?dl=0',
            'title' => 'PDF Dropbox',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('raw=1', $dbxHtml);

        // 4. Esquema javascript: bloqueado
        $xssHtml = $renderer->renderPdf([
            'url'   => 'javascript:alert(document.cookie)',
            'title' => 'Malicioso',
        ]);
        $this->assertSame('', $xssHtml);
    }

    public function testLessonAdminControllerUploadPdfEndpoint(): void
    {
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureRepo = $this->createMock(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf_token');

        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, fn() => 'http://localhost');
        $pdfStorage = new LocalLessonPdfStorage($storage);

        $controller = new LessonAdminController(
            $courseRepo,
            $structureRepo,
            $session,
            null,
            $pdfStorage
        );

        $validPdfPath = $this->tempDir . '/upload_test.pdf';
        file_put_contents($validPdfPath, "%PDF-1.4\n%Test PDF\n%%EOF");

        $request = new Request(
            [],
            ['csrf_token' => 'valid_csrf_token'],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST', 'HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH' => 'XMLHttpRequest'],
            [],
            [
                'pdf' => [
                    'name'     => 'graficos-aula-01.pdf',
                    'type'     => 'application/pdf',
                    'tmp_name' => $validPdfPath,
                    'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
                    'size'     => filesize($validPdfPath),
                ],
            ]
        );

        $response = $controller->uploadPdf($request, 10);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $payload = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($payload['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/uploads/academy/pdfs/pdf_graficos-aula-01_', $payload['url']);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/AcademyStudentWorkspaceTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\StudentDashboardController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoStudentProgressRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LocalStudentStorage;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentProgressService;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class AcademyStudentWorkspaceTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_student_test_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);

        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDir($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDir(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        foreach (array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']) as $item) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDir($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testStudentStorageIsolatesDirectoryAndSavesNotesSecurely(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalStudentStorage($this->tempDir);

        $studentId = 88;
        $courseId = 10;
        $lessonId = 5;

        $dir = $storage->getStudentDirectory($studentId);
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($dir);
        $this->assertStringContainsString((string)$studentId, $dir);

        // 1. Salvar e recuperar anotação privada da aula
        $noteText = 'Importante: revisar o conceito de DIP na aula 5.';
        $saved = $storage->saveStudentNote($studentId, $courseId, $lessonId, $noteText);
        $this->assertTrue($saved);

        $retrieved = $storage->getStudentNote($studentId, $courseId, $lessonId);
        $this->assertSame($noteText, $retrieved);

        // 2. Outro aluno não deve acessar a anotação
        $otherStudentNote = $storage->getStudentNote(99, $courseId, $lessonId);
        $this->assertSame('', $otherStudentNote);

        // 3. Blindagem anti-Path Traversal no delete
        $maliciousTraversal = $storage->deleteStudentFile($studentId, '../../config/database.php');
        $this->assertFalse($maliciousTraversal);
    }

    public function testStudentProgressLifecycleAndPercentageCalculation(): void
    {
        $progressRepo = new PdoStudentProgressRepository($this->pdo);

        $structureRepo = $this->createMock(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureRepo->method('getLessons')->with(1)->willReturn([
            ['id' => 101, 'status' => 'published'],
            ['id' => 102, 'status' => 'published'],
            ['id' => 103, 'status' => 'published'],
            ['id' => 104, 'status' => 'published'],
        ]);

        $service = new StudentProgressService($progressRepo, $structureRepo);
        $studentId = 50;
        $courseId = 1;

        // 1. Progresso inicial 0%
        $this->assertSame(0.0, $service->getCourseProgressPercentage($studentId, $courseId));
        $this->assertFalse($service->isLessonCompleted($studentId, 101));

        // 2. Conclui 1 aula (25%)
        $service->markLessonCompleted($studentId, $courseId, 101);
        $this->assertTrue($service->isLessonCompleted($studentId, 101));
        $this->assertSame(25.0, $service->getCourseProgressPercentage($studentId, $courseId));

        // 3. Conclui mais 1 aula (50%)
        $service->markLessonCompleted($studentId, $courseId, 102);
        $this->assertSame(50.0, $service->getCourseProgressPercentage($studentId, $courseId));

        // 4. Desmarca aula 101 (volta para 25%)
        $service->markLessonIncomplete($studentId, $courseId, 101);
        $this->assertFalse($service->isLessonCompleted($studentId, 101));
        $this->assertSame(25.0, $service->getCourseProgressPercentage($studentId, $courseId));
    }

    public function testStudentDashboardControllerRedirectsGuestAndRendersForAuthenticatedStudent(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $enrollment = $this->createMock(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class);
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureRepo = $this->createMock(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class);
        $progress = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface::class);
        $storage = new LocalStudentStorage($this->tempDir);

        $controller = new StudentDashboardController(
            $session,
            $enrollment,
            $courseRepo,
            $structureRepo,
            $progress,
            $storage
        );

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET']);

        // 1. Visitante não autenticado (user_id = 0) -> Redireciona para /login
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k, $def = 0) {
            return in_array($k, ['academy_student_id', 'user_id'], true) ? 0 : $def;
        });
        $response = $controller->index($request);
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/login', (string)$response->getHeader('Location'));
    }

    public function testStudentDashboardControllerToggleLessonProgressWithValidCsrf(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k, $def = 0) {
            return in_array($k, ['academy_student_id', 'user_id'], true) ? 77 : $def;
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_valido_csrf');

        $enrollment = $this->createMock(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class);
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureRepo = $this->createMock(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureRepo->method('getLessonById')->with(200)->willReturn([
            'id'        => 200,
            'course_id' => 15,
            'title'     => 'Aula de Teste',
        ]);

        $progressRepo = new PdoStudentProgressRepository($this->pdo);
        $progress = new StudentProgressService($progressRepo, $structureRepo);
        $storage = new LocalStudentStorage($this->tempDir);

        $controller = new StudentDashboardController(
            $session,
            $enrollment,
            $courseRepo,
            $structureRepo,
            $progress,
            $storage
        );

        $request = new Request(
            [],
            ['csrf_token' => 'token_valido_csrf'],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        // Marca aula como concluída
        $response = $controller->toggleLessonProgress($request, 200);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data['success']);
        $this->assertTrue($data['completed']);

        // Alterna novamente (desmarca)
        $response2 = $controller->toggleLessonProgress($request, 200);
        $data2 = json_decode($response2->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data2['success']);
        $this->assertFalse($data2['completed']);
    }

    public function testStudentDashboardControllerGrantsAdminMasterAccessToAllCourses(): void
