// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CommercePaymentGatewayTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\CheckoutController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\WebhookController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CommercePaymentGatewayTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoOrderRepository $orderRepo;
    private CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);

        $this->settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $this->settings->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k, $def = null) {
            if ($k === 'commerce_demo_mode') {
                return true;
            }
            return $def;
        });
    }

    public function testOrderRepositoryLifecycleCreateFindUpdate(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 10,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 5,
            'total'          => 150.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_TEST_1001',
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $orderId);

        // Busca por ID
        $order = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertNotNull($order);
        $this->assertSame('ORD_TEST_1001', $order['order_ref']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $order['status']);
        $this->assertEquals(150.00, (float)$order['total']);

        // Busca por Ref
        $orderRef = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef('ORD_TEST_1001');
        $this->assertNotNull($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame($orderId, (int)$orderRef['id']);

        // Atualiza status para pago
        $updated = $this->orderRepo->updateStatus($orderId, 'paid', 'TX_MP_999');
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $orderPaid = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $orderPaid['status']);
        $this->assertSame('TX_MP_999', $orderPaid['transaction_id']);

        // Histórico de pedidos do aluno
        $userOrders = $this->orderRepo->getUserOrders(10);
        $this->assertCount(1, $userOrders);
    }

    public function testPaymentGatewayRegistryResolvesGateways(): void
    {
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway();
        $pp = new PayPalGateway();

        $registry->register($mp);
        $registry->register($pp);

        $this->assertSame($mp, $registry->get('mercadopago'));
        $this->assertSame($pp, $registry->get('paypal'));
        $this->assertSame($mp, $registry->getDefault());
        $this->assertCount(2, $registry->getAll());
    }

    public function testMercadoPagoGatewayGeneratesPixPayload(): void
    {
        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $this->settings);

        $result = $mp->processPayment(
            [
                'order_ref'     => 'ORD_PIX_555',
                'total'         => 97.00,
                'description'   => 'Curso Academy',
                'student_name'  => 'Maria Silva',
                'student_email' => 'maria@teste.com',
            ],
            ['method' => 'pix']
        );

        $this->assertTrue($result->success);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $result->status);
        $this->assertSame('pix', $result->paymentMethod);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($result->pixCopiaECola);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('00020126580014BR.GOV.BCB.PIX', $result->pixCopiaECola);
    }

    public function testMercadoPagoGatewayCheckoutProPreferenceGenerationInDemoMode(): void
    {
        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $this->settings);

        $result = $mp->processPayment(
            [
                'order_ref'     => 'ORD_PRO_888',
                'total'         => 149.90,
                'description'   => 'Curso Avançado',
                'student_name'  => 'Hadel Rachid',
                'student_email' => 'hadel@teste.com',
            ],
            ['method' => 'checkout_pro']
        );

        $this->assertTrue($result->success);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $result->status);
        $this->assertSame('mercadopago', $result->paymentMethod);
        $this->assertNotNull($result->redirectUrl);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('aluno/painel', $result->redirectUrl);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('payment_status=approved', $result->redirectUrl);
    }

    public function testPayPalGatewayGeneratesApprovedDemoPayment(): void
    {
        $pp = new PayPalGateway(settings: $this->settings);

        $result = $pp->processPayment(
            [
                'order_ref' => 'ORD_PP_777',
                'total'     => 120.00,
            ],
            ['method' => 'paypal']
        );

        $this->assertTrue($result->success);
        $this->assertSame('approved', $result->status);
        $this->assertSame('paypal', $result->paymentMethod);
    }

    public function testCheckoutControllerAndWebhookDispatchesPaymentApprovedEvent(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k) {
            return match ($k) {
                'user_id'    => 25,
                'user_name'  => 'Carlos Aluno',
                'user_email' => 'carlos@aluno.com',
                default      => null,
            };
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_checkout_valido');

        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(8)->willReturn([
            'id'     => 8,
            'title'  => 'Curso de Arquitetura PHP',
            'price'  => 297.00,
            'status' => 'published',
        ]);

        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $this->settings);
        $registry->register($mp);

        $dispatchedEvents = [];
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->method('dispatch')->willReturnCallback(function ($event, $payload = null) use (&$dispatchedEvents) {
            $dispatchedEvents[] = ['event' => $event, 'payload' => $payload];
            return null;
        });

        $checkoutController = new CheckoutController(
            $session,
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $courseRepo,
            $dispatcher,
            null,
            $this->settings
        );

        // 1. Processa pedido Pix via Checkout
        $requestCheckout = new Request(
            [],
            [
                'csrf_token'     => 'token_checkout_valido',
                'course_id'      => 8,
                'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
                'payment_method' => 'pix',
            ],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        $checkoutResponse = $checkoutController->process($requestCheckout);
        $this->assertSame(200, $checkoutResponse->getStatusCode());
        $checkoutData = json_decode($checkoutResponse->getContent(), true);

        $this->assertTrue($checkoutData['success']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $checkoutData['status']);
        $orderRef = $checkoutData['order_ref'];
        $this->assertNotEmpty($orderRef);

        // Pedido criado com status 'pending'
        $orderInDb = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $orderInDb['status']);

        // 2. Banco confirma o Pix e envia Webhook oficial para o Domain System
        $webhookController = new WebhookController(
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $dispatcher
        );

        $requestWebhook = new Request(
            [],
            [
                'id'        => '123456789',
                'type'      => 'payment',
                'order_ref' => $orderRef,
            ],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        $webhookResponse = $webhookController->handle($requestWebhook, 'mercadopago');
        $this->assertSame(200, $webhookResponse->getStatusCode());

        // 3. O pedido foi atualizado para 'paid'
        $orderPaid = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $orderPaid['status']);

        // 4. O evento 'payment.approved' foi disparado no Kernel para matricular o aluno no Academy
        $this->assertCount(1, $dispatchedEvents);
        $this->assertSame('payment.approved', $dispatchedEvents[0]['event']);
        $this->assertSame(25, $dispatchedEvents[0]['payload']['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame(8, $dispatchedEvents[0]['payload']['course_id']);
        $this->assertSame($orderRef, $dispatchedEvents[0]['payload']['order_ref']);
    }

    public function testMercadoPagoTestCredentialsMethodReturnsStructuredResults(): void
    {
        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway();

        // Sem credenciais
        $resEmpty = $mp->testCredentials('', '');
        $this->assertFalse($resEmpty['access_token']['ok']);
        $this->assertFalse($resEmpty['public_key']['ok']);

        // Com credencial fictícia de teste (falha na API externa)
        $resFake = $mp->testCredentials('TEST-invalid-token', 'TEST-invalid-key');
        $this->assertFalse($resFake['access_token']['ok']);
        $this->assertFalse($resFake['public_key']['ok']);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($resFake['access_token']['message']);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($resFake['public_key']['message']);
    }

    public function testCheckoutControllerResolvesCourseImageAndRendersCleanView(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k, $def = null) {
            return match ($k) {
                'academy_student_id'   => 10,
                'user_id'              => 10,
                'academy_student_name' => 'Hadel Rachid',
                'academy_student_email'=> 'hadel@teste.com',
                default                => $def,
            };
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_csrf_checkout');

        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(7)->willReturn([
            'id'          => 7,
            'title'       => 'Curso de PHP Completo',
            'slug'        => 'curso-de-php-completo',
            'price'       => 10.00,
            'status'      => 'published',
            'thumbnail'   => 'uploads/academy/course_test.png',
        ]);

        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $registry->register(new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $this->settings));

        $controller = new CheckoutController(
            $session,
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $courseRepo,
            null,
            null,
            $this->settings
        );

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET']);
        $response = $controller->showCheckout($request, 7);

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $html = $response->getContent();

        // 1. Resumo da Compra e Capa Ilustrativa
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Resumo da Compra', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Curso de PHP Completo', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('course_test.png', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('10,00', $html);

        // 2. Notificações Toast do core e zero alert()
        $this->assertStringContainsString('assets/js/core/toast.js', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString("alert(", $html);
    }

    public function testRegistryPreventsSilentOverwriteUnlessExplicit(): void
    {
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $g1 = new MercadoPagoGateway();
        $g2 = new MercadoPagoGateway();

        $registry->register($g1);

        $this->expectException(\DomainException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage("O gateway de pagamento com identificador 'mercadopago' já está registrado.");

        // Segunda tentativa sem overwrite => exceção
        $registry->register($g2);
    }

    public function testRegistryAllowsOverwriteWhenExplicitlyEnabled(): void
    {
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $g1 = new MercadoPagoGateway();
        $g2 = new MercadoPagoGateway();

        $registry->register($g1);
        $registry->register($g2, overwrite: true);

        $this->assertSame($g2, $registry->get('mercadopago'));
    }

    public function testMercadoPagoRequiresCpfAndEmailInProduction(): void
    {
        // Gateway com access_token de produção (sem prefixo TEST-) e sandbox desativado
        $prodSettings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $prodSettings->method('get')->willReturnMap([
            ['mercadopago_access_token', '', 'APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-TOKEN'],
            ['mercadopago_public_key', '', 'APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-KEY'],
            ['mercadopago_sandbox', false, false],
        ]);

        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway('APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-TOKEN', 'APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-KEY', $prodSettings);
        $this->assertFalse($mp->isSandbox());

        // 1. Falha sem CPF informado
        $resultNoCpf = $mp->processPayment(
            ['order_ref' => 'ORD_PROD_1', 'total' => 50.00, 'student_email' => 'cliente@real.com', 'student_name' => 'Cliente Real'],
            ['method' => 'pix']
        );
        $this->assertFalse($resultNoCpf->success);
        $this->assertSame('failed', $resultNoCpf->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('CPF do pagador obrigatório', $resultNoCpf->message);

        // 2. Falha sem e-mail válido
        $resultNoEmail = $mp->processPayment(
            ['order_ref' => 'ORD_PROD_2', 'total' => 50.00, 'student_name' => 'Cliente Real'],
            ['method' => 'pix', 'payer_cpf' => '12345678901']
        );
        $this->assertFalse($resultNoEmail->success);
        $this->assertSame('failed', $resultNoEmail->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('E-mail válido do pagador é obrigatório', $resultNoEmail->message);
    }

    public function testCheckoutControllerCheckStatusReturnsPendingAndPaidStatus(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 55,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 1,
            'total'          => 100.0,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_POLL_123',
        ]);

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $controller = new CheckoutController($session, $this->orderRepo, $registry, $courseRepo);

        // 1. Consulta pedido pendente
        $request = new Request([], [], [], [], [], []);
        $respPending = $controller->checkStatus($request, 'ORD_POLL_123');
        $this->assertSame(200, $respPending->getStatusCode());
        $dataPending = json_decode((string)$respPending->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($dataPending['success']);
        $this->assertFalse($dataPending['paid']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $dataPending['status']);

        // 2. Atualiza status para pago
        $this->orderRepo->updateStatus($orderId, 'paid', 'TX_PIX_777');
        $respPaid = $controller->checkStatus($request, 'ORD_POLL_123');
        $this->assertSame(200, $respPaid->getStatusCode());
        $dataPaid = json_decode((string)$respPaid->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($dataPaid['success']);
        $this->assertTrue($dataPaid['paid']);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $dataPaid['status']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/painel', $dataPaid['redirect_url']);
    }

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CommerceSettingsAndStripeGatewayTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\OrdersAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CommerceSettingsAndStripeGatewayTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempSettingsFile;
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoOrderRepository $orderRepo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempSettingsFile = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_test_settings_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.json';
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if (is_file($this->tempSettingsFile)) {
            @unlink($this->tempSettingsFile);
        }
    }

    public function testJsonCommerceSettingsCanSaveAndRetrieveSettings(): void
    {
        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $this->assertNull($settings->get('non_existent'));
        $this->assertSame('default_val', $settings->get('non_existent', 'default_val'));

        $settings->set('mercadopago_enabled', true);
        $settings->set('active_currency', 'BRL');

        $this->assertTrue($settings->get('mercadopago_enabled'));
        $this->assertSame('BRL', $settings->get('active_currency'));

        // Salvar em lote
        $saved = $settings->save([
            'mercadopago_access_token' => 'TEST_TOKEN_123',
            'paypal_client_id'         => 'PAYPAL_CLIENT_999',
        ]);
        $this->assertTrue($saved);

        // Recarrega instância separada apontando para o mesmo arquivo
        $fresh = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $this->assertSame('TEST_TOKEN_123', $fresh->get('mercadopago_access_token'));
        $this->assertSame('PAYPAL_CLIENT_999', $fresh->get('paypal_client_id'));
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->get('mercadopago_enabled'));
    }

    public function testStripeGatewaySimulationAndWebhook(): void
    {
        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $settings->set('commerce_demo_mode', true);
        $stripe = new StripeGateway(settings: $settings);

        $this->assertSame('stripe', $stripe->getId());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Stripe', $stripe->getTitle());
        $this->assertFalse($stripe->isConfigured());

        // Processa pagamento em modo sandbox / simulação
        $result = $stripe->processPayment([
            'order_ref'     => 'ORD_STRIPE_1',
            'total'         => 199.90,
            'student_name'  => 'Maria Aluna',
            'student_email' => 'maria@teste.com',
        ], ['method' => 'credit_card']);

        $this->assertTrue($result->isApproved());
        $this->assertSame('ORD_STRIPE_1', $result->orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('stripe', $result->paymentMethod);

        // Webhook do Stripe com assinatura válida (checkout.session.completed)
        $secret = 'whsec_test_secret';
        $settings->set('stripe_webhook_secret', $secret);

        $webhookPayload = [
            'type' => 'checkout.session.completed',
            'data' => [
                'object' => [
                    'id'                  => 'cs_test_123456',
                    'client_reference_id' => 'ORD_STRIPE_1',
                ],
            ],
        ];
        $rawJson = (string)json_encode($webhookPayload);
        $ts = time();
        $sig = 't=' . $ts . ',v1=' . hash_hmac('sha256', $ts . '.' . $rawJson, $secret);

        $requestWebhook = new Request([], $webhookPayload, ['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE' => $sig], [], [], $webhookPayload, $rawJson);

        $webhookResult = $stripe->handleWebhook($requestWebhook);
        $this->assertNotNull($webhookResult);
        $this->assertSame('ORD_STRIPE_1', $webhookResult['order_ref']);
        $this->assertSame('approved', $webhookResult['status']);
        $this->assertSame('cs_test_123456', $webhookResult['transaction_id']);

        // Webhook ignorado para eventos desconhecidos
        $requestIgnore = new Request([], ['type' => 'customer.created'], ['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE' => $sig], [], [], ['type' => 'customer.created'], (string)json_encode(['type' => 'customer.created']));
        $this->assertNull($stripe->handleWebhook($requestIgnore));
    }

    public function testOrderRepositoryGetAllOrdersAndMetrics(): void
    {
        // Cria 3 pedidos: 2 pagos e 1 pendente
        $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 1,

            'total'          => 100.00,
            'status'         => 'paid',

            'payment_method' => 'pix',

            'status'         => 'paid',
            'gateway'        => 'stripe',
            'payment_method' => 'credit_card',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_B',
        ]);

        $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 3,
            'item_id'        => 12,
            'total'          => 50.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',

    public function testOrdersAdminControllerDashboardAndSettingsWorkflow(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_admin_csrf_123');

        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $registry->register(new MercadoPagoGateway());
        $registry->register(new PayPalGateway());
        $registry->register(new StripeGateway());

        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);

        $controller = new OrdersAdminController(
            $session,
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $settings,
            $dispatcher
        );

        $request = new Request();

        // 1. Renderiza Dashboard
        $indexResponse = $controller->index($request);
        $this->assertSame(200, $indexResponse->getStatusCode());
        $indexContent = $indexResponse->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DomainCommerce', $indexContent);

        // 2. Renderiza Configurações
        $settingsResponse = $controller->settings($request);
        $this->assertSame(200, $settingsResponse->getStatusCode());
        $settingsContent = $settingsResponse->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Configurações de Pagamentos', $settingsContent);

        // 3. Salva Configurações via POST
        $saveRequest = new Request(request: [
            'csrf_token'               => 'token_admin_csrf_123',
            'mercadopago_enabled'      => '1',
            'mercadopago_access_token' => 'TOKEN_MP_LIVE_ABC',
            'paypal_enabled'           => '1',
            'active_currency'          => 'BRL',
        ]);

        $saveResponse = $controller->saveSettings($saveRequest);
        $this->assertSame(302, $saveResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame('TOKEN_MP_LIVE_ABC', $settings->get('mercadopago_access_token'));
        $this->assertTrue($settings->get('mercadopago_enabled'));

        // 4. Cria pedido pendente e aprova manualmente via Admin
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 55,
            'item_id'        => 22,
            'total'          => 250.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_MANUAL_APPROVE',
        ]);

        $dispatcher->expects($this->once())
            ->method('dispatch')
            ->with('payment.approved', [
                'user_id'   => 55,
                'course_id' => 22,
                'order_ref' => 'ORD_MANUAL_APPROVE',
            ]);

        $approveRequest = new Request(request: [
            'csrf_token' => 'token_admin_csrf_123',
            'status'     => 'paid',
        ]);

        $approveResponse = $controller->updateOrderStatus($approveRequest, $orderId);
        $this->assertSame(200, $approveResponse->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($approveResponse->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data['success']);

        $updatedOrder = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $updatedOrder['status']);
    }

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ContainerTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use Exception;

class DummyDependency {}
class DummyService {
    public DummyDependency $dep;
    public function __construct(DummyDependency $dep) {
        $this->dep = $dep;
    }
}

class DummyWithUnionType {
    public DummyDependency|string $dep;
    public function __construct(DummyDependency|string $dep) {
        $this->dep = $dep;
    }
}

class ContainerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testAutoWiringWithUnionType()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $service = $container->make(DummyWithUnionType::class);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyWithUnionType::class, $service);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyDependency::class, $service->dep);
    }

    public function testBindAndMake()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $container->bind('foo', function() {
            return 'bar';
        });

        $this->assertEquals('bar', $container->make('foo'));
    }

    public function testSingleton()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $container->singleton('random', function() {
            return rand(1, 1000);
        });

        $val1 = $container->make('random');
        $val2 = $container->make('random');

        $this->assertEquals($val1, $val2, "Singleton should return the exact same instance/value.");
    }

    public function testAutoWiring()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        
        // Should automatically instantiate DummyDependency and inject it into DummyService
        $service = $container->make(DummyService::class);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyService::class, $service);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyDependency::class, $service->dep);
    }

    public function testThrowsExceptionOnUnresolvable()
    {
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $container = new Container();
        $container->make('NonExistentInterface');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Core;

use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\SlugHelper;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class SlugHelperTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSlugifyConvertsAccentsAndSpecialCharacters(): void
    {
        $input = 'Programação Avançada em PHP & SOLID: Boas Práticas!';
        $expected = 'programacao-avancada-em-php-solid-boas-praticas';

        $this->assertSame($expected, SlugHelper::slugify($input));
    }

    public function testSlugifyReturnsFallbackWhenEmpty(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('item', SlugHelper::slugify(''));
        $this->assertSame('pagina', SlugHelper::slugify('   ', 'pagina'));
        $this->assertSame('aula-sem-titulo', SlugHelper::slugify('???@@@###', 'aula-sem-titulo'));
    }

    public function testSlugifyTrimsHyphens(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('modulo-1', SlugHelper::slugify('--modulo--1--'));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseEnrollmentService;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class CourseEnrollmentValidationTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository $repo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->repo = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($this->pdo, true);
    }

    public function testNonPositiveIdsNeverGrantAccessEvenIfCourseIsFree(): void
    {
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(10)->willReturn([
            'id'      => 10,
            'title'   => 'Curso 100% Gratuito',
            'is_free' => 1,
            'price'   => 0.00,
        ]);

        $service = new CourseEnrollmentService($this->repo, $courseRepo);

        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment(0, 10), 'ID de aluno 0 não deve ter acesso');
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment(-1, 10), 'ID de aluno negativo não deve ter acesso');
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment(5, 0), 'ID de curso 0 não deve ter acesso');
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment(5, -10), 'ID de curso negativo não deve ter acesso');

        // Aluno válido e positivo tem acesso ao curso gratuito
        $this->assertTrue($service->hasActiveEnrollment(5, 10));
    }

    public function testCorruptedExpirationFailsClosed(): void
    {
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(20)->willReturn([
            'id'      => 20,
            'title'   => 'Curso Pago',
            'is_free' => 0,
            'price'   => 197.00,
        ]);

        // Insere diretamente registro com data malformada
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_enrollments (user_id, course_id, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, 'active', 'DATA_CORROMPIDA_INVALIDA', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([12, 20]);

        $service = new CourseEnrollmentService($this->repo, $courseRepo);

        // Deve falhar fechado e retornar false
        $this->assertFalse($service->hasActiveEnrollment(12, 20));
    }

    public function testEnrollmentUniquenessAndConcurrencyFallback(): void
    {
        $this->repo->saveEnrollment(8, 50, 'active');
        $this->repo->saveEnrollment(8, 50, 'cancelled');

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM academy_enrollments WHERE user_id = 8 AND course_id = 50");
        $stmt->execute();
        $count = (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();

        $this->assertSame(1, $count, 'Deve existir exatamente 1 registro para o mesmo aluno e curso');

        $enrollment = $this->repo->findByStudentAndCourse(8, 50);
        $this->assertSame('cancelled', $enrollment['status']);
    }

    public function testSaveEnrollmentThrowsOnInvalidIds(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(\InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->repo->saveEnrollment(0, 10);
    }

    public function testSaveEnrollmentUpdatesAllFieldsOnExistingRecord(): void
    {
        $expires = new \DateTimeImmutable('2026-12-31 23:59:59');
        $this->repo->saveEnrollment(15, 30, 'pending', null, 'ORD_001');

        $this->repo->saveEnrollment(15, 30, 'active', $expires, 'ORD_002_PAID');

        $record = $this->repo->findByStudentAndCourse(15, 30);
        $this->assertNotNull($record);
        $this->assertSame('active', $record['status']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-12-31 23:59:59', $record['expires_at']);
        $this->assertSame('ORD_002_PAID', $record['order_ref']);
    }

    public function testSaveEnrollmentPropagatesNonUniquePdoExceptions(): void
    {
        // Cria conexão simulando erro crítico (ex: tabela corrompida / query inválida)
        $pdoMock = $this->createMock(PDO::class);
        $pdoMock->method('getAttribute')->willReturn('sqlite');
        $pdoMock->method('prepare')->willThrowException(new \PDOException('Disk I/O error or broken connection', 500));

        $repo = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($pdoMock, false);

        $this->expectException(\PDOException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Disk I/O error');
        $repo->saveEnrollment(1, 1, 'active');
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CourseNavigationTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseNavigationService;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class CourseNavigationTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoCourseRepository $courseRepo;
    private PdoCourseStructureRepository $structureRepo;
    private CourseNavigationService $navService;
    private int $courseId;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $this->courseRepo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $this->structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);

        $this->courseId = $this->courseRepo->create([
            'title'       => 'Mastering OS 2.0',
            'slug'        => 'mastering-os-2-0',
            'description' => 'Aprenda o ciclo de vida do micro-kernel.',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($this->courseId, [
            [
                'title' => 'Módulo 1: Setup',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'title' => '01 - Instalação',
                        'slug'  => '01-instalacao',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source' => 'pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php',
                    ],
                    [
                        'title' => '02 - Escotilha de Emergência',
                        'slug'  => '02-emergencia',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source' => 'pages/tutoriais/02-a-escotilha-de-emergencia.php',
                    ]
                ]
            ],
            [
                'title' => 'Módulo 2: Extensões',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'title' => '03 - Pacotes de Plugins',
                        'slug'  => '03-pacotes',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source' => 'pages/tutoriais/03-pacotes-de-plugins.php',
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ]);

        $this->navService = new CourseNavigationService($this->courseRepo, $this->structureRepo);
    }

    public function testImplementsCourseNavigationInterface(): void
    {
        $this->assertInstanceOf(CourseNavigationInterface::class, $this->navService);
    }

    public function testGetCourseTreeReturnsStructuredTree(): void
    {
        $tree = $this->navService->getCourseTree('mastering-os-2-0');

        $this->assertCount(2, $tree);
        $this->assertSame('Módulo 1: Setup', $tree[0]['title']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $tree[0]['lessons']);
        $this->assertSame('01 - Instalação', $tree[0]['lessons'][0]['title']);
        $this->assertSame('01-instalacao', $tree[0]['lessons'][0]['slug']);

        $this->assertSame('Módulo 2: Extensões', $tree[1]['title']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $tree[1]['lessons']);
        $this->assertSame('03 - Pacotes de Plugins', $tree[1]['lessons'][0]['title']);
    }

    public function testRenderCourseNavOutputsAccessibleNav(): void
    {
        $html = $this->navService->renderCourseNav('mastering-os-2-0', '02-emergencia');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<nav', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('class="course-nav', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Módulo 1: Setup', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('01 - Instalação', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('02 - Escotilha de Emergência', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('is-active', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/cursos/mastering-os-2-0/02-emergencia', $html);
    }

    public function testGetAdjacentLessonsReturnsPrevAndNext(): void
    {
        // Aula 1 (primeira): prev null, next aula 2
        $adj1 = $this->navService->getAdjacentLessons('mastering-os-2-0', '01-instalacao');
        $this->assertNull($adj1['prev']);
        $this->assertNotNull($adj1['next']);
        $this->assertSame('02-emergencia', $adj1['next']['slug']);

        // Aula 2 (meio): prev aula 1, next aula 3 (do próximo módulo!)
        $adj2 = $this->navService->getAdjacentLessons('mastering-os-2-0', '02-emergencia');
        $this->assertNotNull($adj2['prev']);
        $this->assertSame('01-instalacao', $adj2['prev']['slug']);
        $this->assertNotNull($adj2['next']);
        $this->assertSame('03-pacotes', $adj2['next']['slug']);

        // Aula 3 (última): prev aula 2, next null
        $adj3 = $this->navService->getAdjacentLessons('mastering-os-2-0', '03-pacotes');
        $this->assertNotNull($adj3['prev']);
        $this->assertSame('02-emergencia', $adj3['prev']['slug']);
        $this->assertNull($adj3['next']);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CourseStructureRepositoryTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseStructureRepository;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class CourseStructureRepositoryTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private int $courseId;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        // Cria tabela de cursos
        $courseRepo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo);
        $this->courseId = $courseRepo->create([
            'title'       => 'Curso de Arquitetura de Software',
            'slug'        => 'curso-de-arquitetura-de-software',
            'description' => 'Aprenda SOLID e micro-kernels na prática.',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);
    }

    public function testEnsureTablesCreatesModulesAndLessons(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $repo->ensureTables();

        $modules = $repo->getModules($this->courseId);
        $this->assertIsArray($modules);
        $this->assertEmpty($modules);

        $lessons = $repo->getLessons($this->courseId);
        $this->assertIsArray($lessons);
        $this->assertEmpty($lessons);
    }

    public function testModulesCrud(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $repo->ensureTables();

        $modId1 = $repo->createModule($this->courseId, 'Módulo 1: Fundamentos', 1);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $modId1);

        $modId2 = $repo->createModule($this->courseId, 'Módulo 2: Arquitetura SOLID', 2);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $modId2);

        $modules = $repo->getModules($this->courseId);
        $this->assertCount(2, $modules);
        $this->assertSame('Módulo 1: Fundamentos', $modules[0]['title']);

        // Update
        $updated = $repo->updateModule($modId1, ['title' => 'Módulo 1: Introdução ao Kernel']);
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $modulesAfter = $repo->getModules($this->courseId);
        $this->assertSame('Módulo 1: Introdução ao Kernel', $modulesAfter[0]['title']);

        // Delete
        $deleted = $repo->deleteModule($modId2);
        $this->assertTrue($deleted);
        $this->assertCount(1, $repo->getModules($this->courseId));
    }

    public function testLessonsCrud(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $repo->ensureTables();

        $modId = $repo->createModule($this->courseId, 'Módulo 1: Instalação', 1);

        $lessonId = $repo->createLesson([
            'course_id'   => $this->courseId,
            'module_id'   => $modId,
            'title'       => '01 - Instalação do Sistema',
            'slug'        => '01-instalacao',
            'source_type' => 'theme_file',
            'source'      => 'pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php',
            'position'    => 1,
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $lessonId);

        $lesson = $repo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        $this->assertNotNull($lesson);
        $this->assertSame('01 - Instalação do Sistema', $lesson['title']);
        $this->assertSame('01-instalacao', $lesson['slug']);
        $this->assertSame('pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php', $lesson['source']);

        $bySlug = $repo->getLessonBySlug($this->courseId, '01-instalacao');
        $this->assertNotNull($bySlug);
        $this->assertSame($lessonId, (int)$bySlug['id']);

        // Update
        $updated = $repo->updateLesson($lessonId, ['title' => '01 - Instalação Rápida']);
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $updatedLesson = $repo->getLessonById($lessonId);
        $this->assertSame('01 - Instalação Rápida', $updatedLesson['title']);

        // Delete
        $this->assertTrue($repo->deleteLesson($lessonId));
        $this->assertNull($repo->getLessonById($lessonId));
    }

    public function testReplaceCourseStructureIsAtomic(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($this->pdo);
        $repo->ensureTables();

        $structure = [
            [
                'title' => 'Módulo 1: Setup',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'title' => 'Aula 1: Baixando o Repo',
                        'slug' => 'aula-1-baixando-repo',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source' => 'pages/tutoriais/01-instalacao.php',
                    ],
                    [
                        'title' => 'Aula 2: Escotilha de Emergência',
                        'slug' => 'aula-2-escotilha',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source' => 'pages/tutoriais/02-a-escotilha-de-emergencia.php',
                    ]
                ]
            ],
            [
                'title' => 'Módulo 2: Plugins',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'title' => 'Aula 3: Pacotes de Plugins',
                        'slug' => 'aula-3-pacotes',
                        'source_type' => 'theme_file',
                        'source' => 'pages/tutoriais/03-pacotes-de-plugins.php',
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ];

        $result = $repo->replaceCourseStructure($this->courseId, $structure);
        $this->assertTrue($result);

        $modules = $repo->getModules($this->courseId);
        $this->assertCount(2, $modules);

        $lessons = $repo->getLessons($this->courseId);
        $this->assertCount(3, $lessons);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CsrfMiddlewareTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Middlewares\CsrfMiddleware;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\SessionManager;

class CsrfMiddlewareTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $logFile = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp/csrf_debug.log';
        if (file_exists($logFile)) {
            unlink($logFile);
        }
    }

    public function testCsrfFailureDoesNotLogActualToken()
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManager::class);
        $sessionMock->method('validateCsrfToken')->willReturn(false);
        $sessionMock->method('get')->willReturn('SECRET_REAL_TOKEN_123');

        $middleware = new CsrfMiddleware($sessionMock);
        
        $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'POST';
        $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] = '/admin/test';
        $_POST['csrf_token'] = 'BAD_TOKEN_456';
        
        $request = Request::capture();
        
        // This will block and set a 403, maybe die or output.
        // The current middleware might send a view or die if not ajax.
        // Let's just catch the output or execution.
        $response = $middleware->handle($request, function($req) { return true; }, ['capabilities' => ['admin']]);
        
        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface::class, $response);
        $this->assertEquals(403, $response->getStatusCode());

        $logFile = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp/csrf_debug.log';
        $this->assertFileExists($logFile);
        
        $logContent = file_get_contents($logFile);
        
        // Must NOT contain the real token or the bad token
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('SECRET_REAL_TOKEN_123', $logContent, 'O token real vazou no log!');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('BAD_TOKEN_456', $logContent, 'O token injetado vazou no log!');
        
        // Must contain safe metadata
        $this->assertStringContainsString('token_present=yes', $logContent);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('route=/admin/test', $logContent);
    }

    public function testCsrfFailureOnAjaxReturnsJsonResponse()
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManager::class);
        $sessionMock->method('validateCsrfToken')->willReturn(false);

        $middleware = new CsrfMiddleware($sessionMock);
        
        $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'POST';
        $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] = '/api/save';
        $_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'] = 'xmlhttprequest';
        $_POST = [];
        
        $request = Request::capture();
        
        $response = $middleware->handle($request, function($req) { return true; }, ['capabilities' => ['admin']]);
        
        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse::class, $response);
        $this->assertEquals(403, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('"csrf"', $response->getContent());
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CsrfWebhookExemptionTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Middlewares\CsrfMiddleware;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CsrfWebhookExemptionTest extends TestCase
{
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private CsrfMiddleware $middleware;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $this->session->method('validateCsrfToken')->willReturn(false);
        $this->middleware = new CsrfMiddleware($this->session);
    }

    public function testWebhookRouteWithoutCsrfTokenPassesToNextHandler(): void
    {
        $request = new Request([], [], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',
            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/webhook/payment/hotmart',
        ]);

        $nextCalled = false;
        $next = function ($req) use (&$nextCalled) {
            $nextCalled = true;
            return new Response('ok', 200);
        };

        $response = $this->middleware->handle($request, $next, ['capabilities' => []]);
        $this->assertTrue($nextCalled);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
    }

    public function testCheckoutProcessRouteWithoutCsrfTokenIsBlocked(): void
    {
        $request = new Request([], [], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',
            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/checkout/process',
        ]);

        $nextCalled = false;
        $next = function ($req) use (&$nextCalled) {
            $nextCalled = true;
            return new Response('ok', 200);
        };

        $response = $this->middleware->handle($request, $next, []);
        $this->assertFalse($nextCalled);
        $this->assertSame(403, $response->getStatusCode());
    }

    public function testAdminCommerceSettingsWithoutCsrfTokenIsBlocked(): void
    {
        $request = new Request([], [], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',
            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/admin/commerce/settings',
        ]);

        $nextCalled = false;
        $next = function ($req) use (&$nextCalled) {
            $nextCalled = true;
            return new Response('ok', 200);
        };

        $response = $this->middleware->handle($request, $next, ['capabilities' => ['admin']]);
        $this->assertFalse($nextCalled);
        $this->assertSame(403, $response->getStatusCode());
    }
}

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use PDO;

class DatabaseConnectionTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testConnectionUsesPdoAndSingleton()
    {
        // Using in-memory sqlite for tests
        $dsn = 'sqlite::memory:';
        
        $connection1 = new Connection($dsn);
        $connection2 = new Connection($dsn);

        $pdo1 = $connection1->getPdo();
        $pdo2 = $connection2->getPdo();

        $this->assertInstanceOf(PDO::class, $pdo1);
        
        // Ensure same instance is not guaranteed strictly by new Connection(), 
        // but by the Container. Connection class itself is just a wrapper.
        // Let's test the PDO connection works.
        $stmt = $pdo1->query("SELECT 1 as val");
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        $this->assertEquals(1, $result['val']);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/DatabasePluginTest.php

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Plugin;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\QueryBuilder;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;

class DatabasePluginTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPluginRegistrationBindsToContainer()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        // Mock environment variables for test
        putenv('DB_DSN=sqlite::memory:');
        
        $plugin = new Plugin(__DIR__ . '/../../src/SystemApps/Database');
        
        $this->assertEquals('database', $plugin->getName());
        $plugin->setActive(true);
        $this->assertTrue($plugin->isActive());
        $this->assertEmpty($plugin->getDependencies());

        // Emulando o ciclo do OS 2.0
                $runtime = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface::class);
        $runtime->method('bind')->willReturnCallback(function($abstract, $concrete) use ($container) {
            $container->bind($abstract, $concrete);
        });
        $runtime->method('singleton')->willReturnCallback(function($abstract, $concrete) use ($container) {
            $container->singleton($abstract, $concrete);
        });
        $plugin->osBoot($runtime);

        $connection = $container->make(Connection::class);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(Connection::class, $connection);

        $qb = $container->make(QueryBuilder::class);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(QueryBuilder::class, $qb);
    }
}

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemAdmin\Controllers\DevModeController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\UserRepositoryInterface;

class DevModeControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempThemesPath;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        if (!defined('BASE_URL')) define('BASE_URL', '');
        $this->tempThemesPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/domain_system_devmode_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($this->tempThemesPath);
        mkdir($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        
        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/layout.php', 
            '<html><?= $content ?? "" ?></html>'
        );

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/dev_mode_prompt.php', 
            '<?php ob_start(); ?><h1>Prompt Dev Mode</h1><?php $content = ob_get_clean(); require __DIR__ . "/layout.php"; ?>'
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        unlink($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/layout.php');
        unlink($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/dev_mode_prompt.php');
        rmdir($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        rmdir($this->tempThemesPath);
    }

    public function testPromptRendersCorrectly()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $userRepoMock = $this->createMock(UserRepositoryInterface::class);

        $request = $this->createMock(Request::class);
        $request->expects($this->any())->method('input')->willReturn('http://redirect.test');

        $controller = new DevModeController($themeManager, $sessionMock, $userRepoMock);
        $response = $controller->prompt($request);
        
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Prompt Dev Mode', $response->getContent());
    }

    public function testAuthenticateFailsWithoutUserId()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $userRepoMock = $this->createMock(UserRepositoryInterface::class);

        $sessionMock->expects($this->any())->method('get')->with('user_id')->willReturn(null);

        $request = $this->createMock(Request::class);

        $controller = new DevModeController($themeManager, $sessionMock, $userRepoMock);
        $response = $controller->authenticate($request);
        
        $this->assertEquals(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/admin/login', $response->getHeader('Location'));
    }

    public function testAuthenticateFailsWithWrongPassword()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $userRepoMock = $this->createMock(UserRepositoryInterface::class);

        $sessionMock->expects($this->any())->method('get')->with('user_id')->willReturn(1);
        $userRepoMock->expects($this->any())->method('findById')->with(1)->willReturn([
            'id' => 1,
            'password' => password_hash('correct_password', PASSWORD_DEFAULT)
        ]);

        $request = $this->createMock(Request::class);
        $request->expects($this->any())->method('input')->willReturnCallback(function($key, $default) {
            if ($key === 'password') return 'wrong_password';
            if ($key === 'redirect') return '/admin/test';
            return $default;
        });

        // Expect setFlash to be called with error
        $sessionMock->expects($this->once())->method('setFlash')->with('error', 'Senha incorreta.');

        $controller = new DevModeController($themeManager, $sessionMock, $userRepoMock);
        $response = $controller->authenticate($request);
        
        $this->assertEquals(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/admin/dev-mode?redirect=', $response->getHeader('Location'));
    }

    public function testAuthenticateSucceedsWithCorrectPassword()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $userRepoMock = $this->createMock(UserRepositoryInterface::class);

        $sessionMock->expects($this->any())->method('get')->with('user_id')->willReturn(1);
        $userRepoMock->expects($this->any())->method('findById')->with(1)->willReturn([
            'id' => 1,
            'password' => password_hash('correct_password', PASSWORD_DEFAULT)
        ]);

        $request = $this->createMock(Request::class);
        $request->expects($this->any())->method('input')->willReturnCallback(function($key, $default) {
            if ($key === 'password') return 'correct_password';
            if ($key === 'redirect') return '/admin/test';
            return $default;
        });

        $sessionMock->expects($this->any())->method('set');
        $sessionMock->expects($this->once())->method('setFlash')->with('success', 'Modo Desenvolvedor ativado com sucesso.');

        $controller = new DevModeController($themeManager, $sessionMock, $userRepoMock);
        $response = $controller->authenticate($request);
        
        $this->assertEquals(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertEquals('/admin/test', $response->getHeader('Location'));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipCatalogRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AiProductEnricherService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\CurrencyConverterService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\ProductMiningService;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Suíte de Testes Unitários do Hub DomainDrop (SOLID / Clean Architecture).
 */
class DomainDropHubTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        // Executa a migração do DomainDrop em memória SQLite
        $migration = require dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/src/Plugins/domain_drop/migrations/2026_11_10_000001_create_domain_drop_tables.php';
        if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up'])) {
            ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
        }
    }

    public function testAliExpressSignatureGenerationFollowsOfficialProtocol(): void
    {
        $client = new AliExpressApiClient('test_app_key', 'test_secret');

        $params = [
            'app_key'     => 'test_app_key',
            'timestamp'   => '1700000000000',
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'method'      => 'aliexpress.ds.product.get',
            'product_id'  => '1005001234567890',
        ];

        $signature = $client->generateSignature('aliexpress.ds.product.get', $params);

        // Verifica ordenação lexicográfica e concatenação
        ksort($params);
        $expectedQuery = '';
        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            $expectedQuery .= $k . $v;
        }
        $expectedSignature = strtoupper(hash_hmac('sha256', $expectedQuery, 'test_secret'));

        $this->assertSame($expectedSignature, $signature);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^[A-F0-9]{64}$/', $signature);
    }

    public function testCurrencyConverterCalculatesMarkupAndEnforcesMinimumMargin(): void
    {
        $tmpCache = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/test_exchange_rate_' . uniqid() . '.json';
        file_put_contents($tmpCache, json_encode(['USD' => 6.00]));

        $converter = new CurrencyConverterService($tmpCache, 3600);

        // Taxa de câmbio
        $rate = $converter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(6.00, $rate, 0.01);

        // Custo $10.00 USD -> BRL R$ 60,00
        $costBrl = 10.00 * $rate;
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(60.00, $costBrl, 0.01);

        // Preço de venda com 100% markup -> R$ 120,00 (lucro R$ 60,00 >= R$ 30,00 min)
        $salePrice = $converter->calculateSalePrice(10.00, 100.0, 30.0);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(120.00, $salePrice, 0.01);

        // Preço de venda para produto barato ($1.00 USD = R$ 6.00 BRL)
        // Com markup 50% daria R$ 9,00 (lucro R$ 3,00), mas minMargin é R$ 25,00 -> venda deve ser no mínimo R$ 31,00
        $cheapSalePrice = $converter->calculateSalePrice(1.00, 50.0, 25.0);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(31.00, $cheapSalePrice, 0.01);

        @unlink($tmpCache);
    }

    public function testAiProductEnricherCleansSpamAndFormatsCopy(): void
    {
        $enricher = new AiProductEnricherService();

        $spamTitle = "2026 Hot Sale Dropship 100% New Free Shipping Best Quality Earphone TWS Wireless Bluetooth";
        $cleaned = $enricher->polishTitle($spamTitle);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsStringIgnoringCase('Hot Sale', $cleaned);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsStringIgnoringCase('Dropship', $cleaned);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsStringIgnoringCase('Free Shipping', $cleaned);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Earphone', $cleaned);

        $copy = $enricher->generateSalesCopy("Fones sem fio ergonômicos com bateria de longa duração.", ['Bluetooth' => '5.3']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Qualidade Comprovada', $copy);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Envio com Rastreio', $copy);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Especificações Técnicas', $copy);
    }

    public function testPdoDropshipCatalogRepositoryCrudOperations(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($this->pdo);

        $product = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: '100500999888777',
            title: 'Smartwatch Ultra Pro Max 2026',
            slug: 'smartwatch-ultra-pro-max-2026',
            costPriceUsd: 15.50,
            salePriceBrl: 189.90,
            mainImageUrl: 'https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/test_smartwatch.jpg',
            images: ['https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/img1.jpg'],
            category: 'Eletrônicos',
            description: 'Relógio inteligente de alta precisão',
            rating: 4.8,
            ordersCount: 1500,
            attributes: ['cor' => 'preto'],
            status: 'published'
        );

        $savedId = $repo->save($product);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $savedId);

        // Busca por ID
        $found = $repo->findById($savedId);
        $this->assertNotNull($found);
        $this->assertSame('Smartwatch Ultra Pro Max 2026', $found->title);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(189.90, $found->salePriceBrl, 0.01);
        $this->assertSame(4.8, $found->rating);

        // Busca por AliExpress ID
        $foundByAe = $repo->findByAliExpressId('100500999888777');
        $this->assertNotNull($foundByAe);
        $this->assertSame($savedId, $foundByAe->id);

        // Listagem & Contagem
        $list = $repo->list(['category' => 'Eletrônicos']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $list);
        $this->assertSame(1, $repo->count(['category' => 'Eletrônicos']));

        $categories = $repo->getCategories();
        $this->assertContains('Eletrônicos', $categories);

        // Deletar
        $this->assertTrue($repo->delete($savedId));
        $this->assertNull($repo->findById($savedId));
        $this->assertSame(0, $repo->count());
    }

    public function testDropshipProductPurchasableAdapterIntegratesWithCommerce(): void
    {
        $product = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: '100500123987',
            title: 'Lâmpada Inteligente RGB Wi-Fi',
            slug: 'lampada-inteligente-rgb-wifi',
            costPriceUsd: 5.00,
            salePriceBrl: 49.90,
            mainImageUrl: 'https://ae01.alicdn.com/lampada.jpg',
            images: [],
            category: 'Casa Inteligente',
            description: 'Controle de iluminação por voz e app.',
            rating: 4.9,
            ordersCount: 850,
            attributes: [],
            status: 'published',
            id: 42
        );

        $adapter = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Adapters\DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter($product);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemInterface::class, $adapter);
        $this->assertSame(42, $adapter->getId());
        $this->assertSame('dropship_product', $adapter->getItemType());
        $this->assertSame('Lâmpada Inteligente RGB Wi-Fi', $adapter->getTitle());

    public function testPdoDropshipOrderRepositoryLifecycleAndFulfillment(): void
    {
        $repo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipOrderRepository($this->pdo);

        $orderData = [
            'order_ref'          => 'ORD_DROP_TEST_2026',
            'customer_name'      => 'João da Silva',
            'customer_email'     => 'joao@exemplo.com',
            'customer_document'  => '12345678901',
            'shipping_address'    => ['cidade' => 'São Paulo', 'uf' => 'SP', 'cep' => '01001-000'],
            'status'             => 'paid',
            'total_paid_brl'     => 149.90,
        ];

        $orderId = $repo->create($orderData);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $orderId);

        // Busca por referência
        $found = $repo->findByOrderRef('ORD_DROP_TEST_2026');
        $this->assertNotNull($found);
        $this->assertSame('João da Silva', $found['customer_name']);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $found['status']);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(149.90, (float)$found['total_paid_brl'], 0.01);

        // Atualização de Fulfillment (AliExpress Order ID e Código de Rastreamento)
        $updated = $repo->updateFulfillment('ORD_DROP_TEST_2026', 'shipped', 'AE_ORDER_88776655', 'NL123456789BR');
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $shipped = $repo->findByOrderRef('ORD_DROP_TEST_2026');
        $this->assertNotNull($shipped);
        $this->assertSame('shipped', $shipped['status']);
        $this->assertSame('AE_ORDER_88776655', $shipped['aliexpress_order_id']);
        $this->assertSame('NL123456789BR', $shipped['tracking_code']);

        // Listagem com filtro
        $list = $repo->list(['status' => 'shipped']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $list);
        $this->assertSame('ORD_DROP_TEST_2026', $list[0]['order_ref']);
    }

    public function testDropshipAdminControllerSettingsAndOrders(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($this->pdo);
        $orderRepo = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipOrderRepository($this->pdo);

        $mockApi = $this->createMock(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class);
        $tmpCache = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/test_admin_settings_' . uniqid() . '.json';
        file_put_contents($tmpCache, json_encode(['USD' => 5.50]));
        $converter = new CurrencyConverterService($tmpCache);
        $enricher = new AiProductEnricherService();
        $miningService = new ProductMiningService($mockApi, $converter, $enricher, $repo);

        $session = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf');

        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_test_settings_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($tmpDir . '/config/plugins', 0777, true);

        $controller = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipAdminController(
            catalogRepo: $repo,
            miningService: $miningService,
            currencyConverter: $converter,
            session: $session,
            orderRepo: $orderRepo,
            basePath: $tmpDir
        );

        // 1. Settings view
        $settingsResp = $controller->settings(new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request());
        $this->assertSame(200, $settingsResp->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Configurações da API', $settingsResp->getContent());

        // 2. Save settings
        $saveReq = new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request([], [
            'csrf_token'             => 'valid_csrf',
            'app_key'                => '558628_test',
            'app_secret'             => 'secret_12345',
            'access_token'           => 'token_oauth_xyz',
            'default_markup_percent' => '120.0',
            'min_profit_margin_brl'  => '45.0',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame(302, $saveResp->getStatusCode());

        $this->assertSame('558628_test', $savedConfig['app_key']);

        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(120.0, (float)$savedConfig['default_markup_percent'], 0.01);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(45.0, (float)$savedConfig['min_profit_margin_brl'], 0.01);

        @unlink($tmpDir . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json');

    public function testDropshipAdminControllerUpdatePriceAndRepositoryPriceUpdate(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($this->pdo);

        $product = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: '100500888999111',
            title: 'Alicate Desencapador de Fios Automático',
            slug: 'alicate-desencapador-de-fios-automatico',
            costPriceUsd: 12.00,
            salePriceBrl: 134.15,
            mainImageUrl: 'https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/desencapador.jpg',
            images: ['https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/desencapador.jpg'],
            category: 'Ferramentas',
            description: 'Alicate multifuncional para desencapar fios',
            rating: 4.9,
            ordersCount: 850,
            attributes: [],
            status: 'published'
        );
        $savedId = $repo->save($product);

        // 1. Testa método do repositório diretamente
        $this->assertTrue($repo->updatePrice($savedId, 79.90, 8.50));
        $updated = $repo->findById($savedId);
        $this->assertNotNull($updated);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(79.90, $updated->salePriceBrl, 0.01);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(8.50, $updated->costPriceUsd, 0.01);

        // 2. Testa endpoint do Controller via requisição AJAX/JSON
        $mockApi = $this->createMock(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class);
        $tmpCache = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/test_admin_price_' . uniqid() . '.json';
        file_put_contents($tmpCache, json_encode(['USD' => 5.50]));
        $converter = new CurrencyConverterService($tmpCache);
        $enricher = new AiProductEnricherService();
        $miningService = new ProductMiningService($mockApi, $converter, $enricher, $repo);

        $session = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('csrf_token_valid');

        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_test_price_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($tmpDir . '/config/plugins', 0777, true);

        $controller = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipAdminController(
            catalogRepo: $repo,
            miningService: $miningService,
            currencyConverter: $converter,
            session: $session,
            orderRepo: new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipOrderRepository($this->pdo),
            basePath: $tmpDir
        );

        // Teste com Custo informado em BRL (R$ 46,78) e Venda em BRL (R$ 79,90)
        $req = new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request(
            query: [],
            request: [
                'csrf_token'      => 'csrf_token_valid',
                'cost_price_brl'  => '46.78',
                'sale_price_brl'  => '79.90',
                'ajax'            => '1',
            ],
            server: [
                'HTTP_ACCEPT' => 'application/json',
            ]
        );

        $resp = $controller->updatePrice($req, (string)$savedId);
        $this->assertSame(200, $resp->getStatusCode());

        $payload = json_decode((string)$resp->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($payload['success']);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(79.90, (float)$payload['sale_price_brl'], 0.01);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(46.78, (float)$payload['cost_price_brl'], 0.1);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, (float)$payload['profit_brl']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, (float)$payload['margin_percent']);

        // Verifica no banco
        $reloaded = $repo->findById($savedId);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(79.90, $reloaded->salePriceBrl, 0.01);

        @unlink($tmpCache);
        @unlink($tmpDir . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json');
        @rmdir($tmpDir . '/config/plugins');
        @rmdir($tmpDir . '/config');
        @rmdir($tmpDir);
    }

    public function testDailyAutomatedRotationAndCycleInfoMetadata(): void
    {
        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/drop_test_cycle_' . uniqid();
        @mkdir($tmpDir . '/config/plugins', 0777, true);
        $tmpConfigFile = $tmpDir . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';

        $apiClient = new class implements AliExpressApiClientInterface {
            public function execute(string $apiMethod, array $params = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array { return []; }
            public function searchProducts(array $params = []): array { return []; }
            public function getProductDetails(string|int $productId, string $targetLanguage = 'pt', string $targetCurrency = 'USD'): array { return []; }
            public function queryTrackingInfo(string $logisticsNo, string $origin = 'ESCROW', string $outRef = '', string $serviceName = 'CAINIAO', string $toArea = 'BR'): array { return []; }
            public function generateSignature(string $method, array $params): string { return ''; }
        };

        $converter = new CurrencyConverterService(defaultMarkupPercent: 100.0, minProfitBrl: 30.0);
        $enricher = new AiProductEnricherService();
        $repo = new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($this->pdo);

        $scraper = new class implements \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface {
            public function canHandle(string $urlOrId): bool { return false; }
            public function scrape(string $urlOrId): ?\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto { return null; }
            public function parseRawHtml(string $rawSource, string $sourceUrl = ''): ?\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto { return null; }
            public function isProductAlive(string $urlOrId): bool { return true; }
        };

        $mining = new ProductMiningService(
            apiClient: $apiClient,
            currencyConverter: $converter,
            aiEnricher: $enricher,
            repository: $repo,
            linkScraper: $scraper,
            configFilePath: $tmpConfigFile
        );

        // 1. Antes da primeira execução
        $infoBefore = $mining->getDailyCycleInfo();
        $this->assertTrue($infoBefore['is_due']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $infoBefore['last_cycle_at']);
        $officialCount = count(ProductMiningService::OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES);
        $this->assertCount($officialCount, $infoBefore['official_categories']);

        // 2. Executa ciclo diário com 2 produtos por categoria
        $result = $mining->runDailyAutomatedRotation(2);
        $this->assertTrue($result['success']);
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual($officialCount * 2, $result['total_mined']);
        $this->assertCount($officialCount, $result['category_counts']);

        // 3. Após a execução, o ciclo deve estar ativo com ~24h restantes
        $infoAfter = $mining->getDailyCycleInfo();
        $this->assertFalse($infoAfter['is_due']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $infoAfter['last_cycle_at']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(86300, $infoAfter['seconds_remaining']);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^(23|24):[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$/', $infoAfter['formatted_remaining']);

        // 4. Todas as 6 categorias devem estar presentes no catálogo do repositório
        $dbCategories = $repo->getCategories();
        foreach (ProductMiningService::OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES as $officialCat) {
            $this->assertContains($officialCat, $dbCategories);
        }

        @unlink($tmpConfigFile);
        @rmdir($tmpDir . '/config/plugins');
        @rmdir($tmpDir . '/config');
        @rmdir($tmpDir);
    }

    public function testDropshipAdminControllerRunDailyCycle(): void
    {
        $tmpDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/drop_test_admin_cycle_' . uniqid();
        @mkdir($tmpDir . '/config/plugins', 0777, true);
        $tmpConfigFile = $tmpDir . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';

        $apiClient = new class implements AliExpressApiClientInterface {
            public function execute(string $apiMethod, array $params = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array { return []; }
            public function searchProducts(array $params = []): array { return []; }
            public function getProductDetails(string|int $productId, string $targetLanguage = 'pt', string $targetCurrency = 'USD'): array { return []; }
            public function queryTrackingInfo(string $logisticsNo, string $origin = 'ESCROW', string $outRef = '', string $serviceName = 'CAINIAO', string $toArea = 'BR'): array { return []; }
            public function generateSignature(string $method, array $params): string { return ''; }
        };

        $converter = new CurrencyConverterService(defaultMarkupPercent: 100.0, minProfitBrl: 30.0);
        $enricher = new AiProductEnricherService();
        $repo = new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($this->pdo);

        $scraper = new class implements \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface {
