// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/HelpersTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class HelpersTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // Define APP_KEY válida de 32 bytes para o teste
        putenv('APP_KEY=12345678901234567890123456789012');
        $_ENV['APP_KEY'] = '12345678901234567890123456789012';
        $_SERVER['APP_KEY'] = '12345678901234567890123456789012';
        
        // Garante que os helpers estão carregados
        require_once __DIR__ . '/../../src/Core/helpers.php';
    }

    public function testEncryptAndDecryptGCM()
    {
        $plaintext = "Dados muito secretos para o ring 0";
        $encrypted = encrypt_string($plaintext);
        
        $this->assertNotEmpty($encrypted);
        $this->assertNotEquals($plaintext, $encrypted);
        
        $decrypted = decrypt_string($encrypted);
        $this->assertEquals($plaintext, $decrypted);
    }

    public function testGcmDetectsTampering()
    {
        $plaintext = "Dados originais";
        $encrypted = encrypt_string($plaintext);
        
        // Decodifica, altera um byte do ciphertext e re-encoda
        $raw = base64_decode($encrypted);
        $raw[strlen($raw) - 1] = chr(ord($raw[strlen($raw) - 1]) ^ 1); // Flip last bit
        $tampered = base64_encode($raw);
        
        // Com GCM, deve falhar a autenticação e retornar string vazia
        $decrypted = decrypt_string($tampered);
        $this->assertEquals('', $decrypted);
    }

    public function testBackwardCompatibilityCbc()
    {
        $key = getenv('APP_KEY') ?: '12345678901234567890123456789012';
        $plaintext = "Dados legado em CBC";
        
        // Simula a criação de um payload legado em AES-256-CBC
        $ivLen = openssl_cipher_iv_length('AES-256-CBC');
        $iv = openssl_random_pseudo_bytes($ivLen);
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($plaintext, 'AES-256-CBC', $key, 0, $iv);
        $legacyPayload = base64_encode($iv . '::' . $ciphertext);
        
        // Deve decifrar com sucesso usando a lógica de fallback
        $decrypted = decrypt_string($legacyPayload);
        $this->assertEquals($plaintext, $decrypted);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/IdentityManagerTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\IdentityManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;

class IdentityManagerTest extends TestCase
{
    private $dbMock;
    private $container;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // Mock do PDO e Connection
        $this->dbMock = $this->createMock(\PDO::class);
        $connMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection::class);
        $connMock->method('getPdo')->willReturn($this->dbMock);

        $this->container = new Container();
        $this->container->singleton(\DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection::class, function() use ($connMock) {
            return $connMock;
        });
    }

    public function testUserCanReturnsTrueForExistingCapability()
    {
        $stmtMock = $this->createMock(\PDOStatement::class);
        $stmtMock->method('execute')->willReturn(true);
        $stmtMock->method('fetchAll')->willReturn(['ler_arquivos', 'core.plugin.install']);

        // Mock para verificação do hasRole('admin') (retorna falso neste caso)
        $stmtAdminMock = $this->createMock(\PDOStatement::class);
        $stmtAdminMock->method('execute')->willReturn(true);
        $stmtAdminMock->method('fetch')->willReturn(false);

        // Map PDO prepare arguments to specific statement mocks
        $this->dbMock->method('prepare')->willReturnCallback(function($sql) use ($stmtMock, $stmtAdminMock) {
            if (strpos($sql, 'SELECT DISTINCT c.slug') !== false) {
                return $stmtMock;
            }
            return $stmtAdminMock;
        });

        $identity = new IdentityManager($this->container);
        
        $this->assertTrue($identity->userCan(1, 'core.plugin.install'));
        $this->assertFalse($identity->userCan(1, 'core.tema.delete'));
    }

    public function testUserCanReturnsTrueForAdminWildcard()
    {
        $stmtMock = $this->createMock(\PDOStatement::class);
        $stmtMock->method('execute')->willReturn(true);
        $stmtMock->method('fetchAll')->willReturn(['apenas_uma_permissao']);

        $stmtAdminMock = $this->createMock(\PDOStatement::class);
        $stmtAdminMock->method('execute')->willReturn(true);
        $stmtAdminMock->method('fetch')->willReturn(true); // O usuário é Admin

        $this->dbMock->method('prepare')->willReturnCallback(function($sql) use ($stmtMock, $stmtAdminMock) {
            if (strpos($sql, 'SELECT DISTINCT c.slug') !== false) {
                return $stmtMock;
            }
            return $stmtAdminMock;
        });

        $identity = new IdentityManager($this->container);
        
        // Se é admin, deve poder fazer TUDO, inclusive o que não está explicitamente no array
        $this->assertTrue($identity->userCan(99, 'uma_capability_qualquer'));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Services\InstallerService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class InstallerServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $testTokenDir;
    private string $testTokenFile;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->testTokenDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/token';
        $this->testTokenFile = $this->testTokenDir . '/setup.token';
    }

    public function testGetOrCreateAndRegenerateSetupToken(): void
    {
        $service = new InstallerService();

        // 1. Gera ou recupera token
        $token1 = $service->getOrCreateSetupToken();
        $this->assertNotEmpty($token1);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^[A-F0-9]{4}-[A-F0-9]{4}$/', $token1);
        $this->assertFileExists($this->testTokenFile);
        $this->assertFileExists($this->testTokenDir . '/.htaccess');

        // 2. Segunda chamada retorna o mesmo token sem alterar o arquivo
        $token2 = $service->getOrCreateSetupToken();
        $this->assertSame($token1, $token2);

        // 3. Validação com sucesso e com falha
        $this->assertTrue($service->validateSetupToken($token1));
        $this->assertTrue($service->validateSetupToken(strtolower($token1))); // Case-insensitive
        $this->assertFalse($service->validateSetupToken('WRONG-TOKEN'));

        // 4. Regenerar token cria um novo código
        $token3 = $service->regenerateSetupToken();
        $this->assertNotEmpty($token3);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^[A-F0-9]{4}-[A-F0-9]{4}$/', $token3);
        $this->assertTrue($service->validateSetupToken($token3));
    }
}

class LayoutPresetsAndOcpTest extends TestCase

    public function testLayoutGridRendererAdheresToOpenClosedPrinciple(): void

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/LocalPublicStorageTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\LocalPublicStorage;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class LocalPublicStorageTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'ds_storage_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testGetUploadPathResolvesPublicFolderWhenPresent(): void
    {
        $publicDir = $this->tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'public';
        mkdir($publicDir, 0755, true);

        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, '/domain-system');
        $uploadPath = $storage->getUploadPath('academy/test.png');

        $expected = $publicDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'uploads' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'academy' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'test.png';
        $this->assertSame($expected, $uploadPath);
        $this->assertDirectoryExists(dirname($uploadPath));
    }

    public function testGetUploadPathResolvesRootUploadsWhenNoPublicFolder(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, '');
        $uploadPath = $storage->getUploadPath('test.png');

        $expected = $this->tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'uploads' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'test.png';
        $this->assertSame($expected, $uploadPath);
        $this->assertDirectoryExists(dirname($uploadPath));
    }

    public function testGetUploadPathNormalizesUploadsPrefix(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir);
        $path1 = $storage->getUploadPath('uploads/academy/photo.png');
        $path2 = $storage->getUploadPath('academy/photo.png');

        $this->assertSame($path1, $path2);
    }

    public function testDirectoryTraversalThrowsException(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir);

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Tentativa de travessia');
        $storage->getUploadPath('../secret.env');
    }

    public function testGetPublicUrlFormatsCorrectly(): void
    {
        // 1. Com BaseUrl (ex: XAMPP)
        $storageWithBase = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, '/domain-system');
        $url1 = $storageWithBase->getPublicUrl('uploads/academy/card.png');
        $this->assertSame('/domain-system/uploads/academy/card.png', $url1);

        // Subpath sem 'uploads/'
        $url2 = $storageWithBase->getPublicUrl('academy/card.png');
        $this->assertSame('/domain-system/uploads/academy/card.png', $url2);

        // 2. Sem BaseUrl (ex: Hostinger / Produção)
        $storageNoBase = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, '');
        $url3 = $storageNoBase->getPublicUrl('uploads/academy/card.png');
        $this->assertSame('/uploads/academy/card.png', $url3);

        // 3. URLs externas
        $externalHttp = 'http://example.com/images/foto.jpg';
        $this->assertSame($externalHttp, $storageWithBase->getPublicUrl($externalHttp));

        $externalHttps = 'https://cdn.site.com/foto.webp';
        $this->assertSame($externalHttps, $storageWithBase->getPublicUrl($externalHttps));

        $dataUri = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2Zz4=';
        $this->assertSame($dataUri, $storageWithBase->getPublicUrl($dataUri));
    }

    public function testGetPublicUrlSupportsDynamicCallableBaseUrl(): void
    {
        $currentBase = '';
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir, function() use (&$currentBase) {
            return $currentBase;
        });

        $this->assertSame('/uploads/photo.jpg', $storage->getPublicUrl('uploads/photo.jpg'));

        $currentBase = '/subfolder';
        $this->assertSame('/subfolder/uploads/photo.jpg', $storage->getPublicUrl('uploads/photo.jpg'));
    }

    public function testPutExistsAndDeleteOperations(): void
    {
        $storage = new LocalPublicStorage($this->tempDir);

        $this->assertFalse($storage->exists('academy/document.txt'));

        $relativePath = $storage->put('academy/document.txt', 'Conteudo de teste');
        $this->assertSame('uploads/academy/document.txt', $relativePath);
        $this->assertTrue($storage->exists('academy/document.txt'));
        $this->assertTrue($storage->exists('uploads/academy/document.txt'));

        $deleted = $storage->delete('uploads/academy/document.txt');
        $this->assertTrue($deleted);
        $this->assertFalse($storage->exists('academy/document.txt'));
    }

    public function testContainerAndLinkRegistryResolvePublicStorage(): void
    {
        $container = new \DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container();
        $dispatcher = new \DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher();
        $provider = new \DomainSystem\Core\Providers\CoreServiceProvider();
        $provider->register($container, $dispatcher, $this->tempDir);

        $storageFromContainer = $container->make(PublicStorageInterface::class);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(PublicStorageInterface::class, $storageFromContainer);

        $linkRegistry = new \DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry($container);
        $storageFromLink = $linkRegistry->resolve('core.storage');
        $this->assertInstanceOf(PublicStorageInterface::class, $storageFromLink);
        $this->assertSame($storageFromContainer, $storageFromLink);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/MediaUploadServiceTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\MediaUploadService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class MediaUploadServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_upload_test_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/public/uploads/builder', 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . '/' . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testUploadRejectsWhenNoFileOrUploadError(): void
    {
        $service = new MediaUploadService($this->tempDir, '/domain-system/public');
        $result = $service->upload(['error' => UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE]);

        $this->assertFalse($result['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Nenhum arquivo', $result['message']);
    }

    public function testUploadRejectsDisallowedExtension(): void
    {
        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'test_php_');
        file_put_contents($tmp, '<?php phpinfo();');

        $service = new MediaUploadService($this->tempDir, '/domain-system/public');
        $result = $service->upload([
            'name'     => 'malicious.php',
            'type'     => 'application/x-php',
            'tmp_name' => $tmp,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => filesize($tmp),
        ]);

        @unlink($tmp);
        $this->assertFalse($result['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Extensão não permitida', $result['message']);
    }

    public function testUploadSucceedsForValidPngImage(): void
    {
        // 1x1 transparent PNG bytes
        $pngBytes = base64_decode('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==');
        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'test_png_');
        file_put_contents($tmp, $pngBytes);

        $service = new MediaUploadService($this->tempDir, '/domain-system/public');
        $result = $service->upload([
            'name'     => 'logo.png',
            'type'     => 'image/png',
            'tmp_name' => $tmp,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => strlen($pngBytes),
        ]);

        @unlink($tmp);
        $this->assertTrue($result['success']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('url', $result);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('/domain-system/public/uploads/builder/', $result['url']);
        $this->assertFileExists($this->tempDir . '/public/uploads/builder/' . $result['filename']);
    }

    public function testUploadSucceedsForValidMp4Video(): void
    {
        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'test_mp4_');
        // Cabeçalho binário mínimo ftypisom de container MP4
        $mp4Dummy = hex2bin('000000186674797069736f6d000002006d70343169736f6d');
        file_put_contents($tmp, $mp4Dummy);

        $service = new MediaUploadService($this->tempDir, '/domain-system/public');
        $result = $service->upload([
            'name'     => 'demo.mp4',
            'type'     => 'video/mp4',
            'tmp_name' => $tmp,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => strlen($mp4Dummy),
        ]);

        @unlink($tmp);
        $this->assertTrue($result['success']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('url', $result);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('/domain-system/public/uploads/builder/', $result['url']);
        $this->assertStringEndsWith('.mp4', $result['url']);
        $this->assertFileExists($this->tempDir . '/public/uploads/builder/' . $result['filename']);
    }

    public function testUploadRejectsFileExceedingMaxSize(): void
    {
        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'test_big_');
        file_put_contents($tmp, 'small');

        // Cria serviço com limite de 10 bytes
        $service = new MediaUploadService($this->tempDir, '/domain-system/public', 10);
        $result = $service->upload([
            'name'     => 'big.png',
            'type'     => 'image/png',
            'tmp_name' => $tmp,
            'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
            'size'     => 1024, // 1KB > 10 bytes
        ]);

        @unlink($tmp);
        $this->assertFalse($result['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('limite máximo permitido', $result['message']);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use PDO;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Repositories\PdoMenuRepository;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\MenuRenderer;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Controllers\MenuAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;

class MenuManagementTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoMenuRepository $menuRepo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->menuRepo = new PdoMenuRepository($this->pdo);
    }

    public function testEnsureTablesCreatesTablesAndSeedsDefaultHeaderAndFooter(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();

        $menus = $this->menuRepo->getMenus();
        $this->assertCount(2, $menus, "Deve ter 2 menus criados no auto-seed (header e footer).");
        $this->assertEquals('header', $menus[0]['location'], "O primeiro menu da lista deve ser sempre o Menu Principal (header).");
        $this->assertEquals('Menu Principal', $menus[0]['name']);

        $headerMenu = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation('header');
        $this->assertNotNull($headerMenu);
        $this->assertEquals('Menu Principal', $headerMenu['name']);

        $footerMenu = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation('footer');
        $this->assertNotNull($footerMenu);
        $this->assertEquals('Menu do Rodapé', $footerMenu['name']);
    }

    public function testSaveMenuCreatesAndRejectsDuplicateLocation(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();

        // Tenta criar outro menu com location 'header'
        $result = $this->menuRepo->saveMenu('Outro Header', 'header');
        $this->assertFalse($result['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Já existe um menu atribuído a esta localização', $result['message']);

        // Cria um menu com nova localização
        $resultCustom = $this->menuRepo->saveMenu('Menu Lateral', 'sidebar');
        $this->assertTrue($resultCustom['success']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('id', $resultCustom);

        // Atualiza o menu
        $updateResult = $this->menuRepo->saveMenu('Sidebar Principal', 'sidebar', $resultCustom['id']);
        $this->assertTrue($updateResult['success']);

        $saved = $this->menuRepo->getMenuById($resultCustom['id']);
        $this->assertEquals('Sidebar Principal', $saved['name']);
    }

    public function testReplaceMenuItemsIsTransactional(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();
        $header = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation('header');
        $this->assertNotNull($header);
        $menuId = (int)$header['id'];

        $initialItems = [
            ['title' => 'Início', 'url' => '/', 'page_id' => null],
            ['title' => 'Blog', 'url' => null, 'page_id' => 10],
            ['title' => 'Sobre', 'url' => null, 'page_id' => 11],
        ];

        $saved = $this->menuRepo->replaceMenuItems($menuId, $initialItems);
        $this->assertTrue($saved);

        $items = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems($menuId);
        $this->assertCount(3, $items);
        $this->assertEquals('Início', $items[0]['title']);
        $this->assertEquals('Blog', $items[1]['title']);
        $this->assertEquals('Sobre', $items[2]['title']);

        // Substituição atômica com novos itens
        $updatedItems = [
            ['title' => 'Home', 'url' => '/', 'page_id' => null],
            ['title' => 'Contato', 'url' => '/contato', 'page_id' => null],
        ];

        $savedUpdated = $this->menuRepo->replaceMenuItems($menuId, $updatedItems);
        $this->assertTrue($savedUpdated);

        $itemsAfter = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems($menuId);
        $this->assertCount(2, $itemsAfter);
        $this->assertEquals('Home', $itemsAfter[0]['title']);
        $this->assertEquals('Contato', $itemsAfter[1]['title']);
    }

    public function testMenuRendererRendersHtmlWithDynamicPageSlugs(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();
        $header = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation('header');
        $menuId = (int)$header['id'];

        // Mock do PageLookupInterface
        $pageLookup = new class implements PageLookupInterface {
            public function getSelectablePages(): array
            {
                return [
                    ['id' => 1, 'title' => 'Início', 'slug' => 'inicio'],
                    ['id' => 2, 'title' => 'Blog', 'slug' => 'blog'],
                    ['id' => 3, 'title' => 'Sobre', 'slug' => 'sobre'],
                ];
            }
        };

        $this->menuRepo->replaceMenuItems($menuId, [
            ['title' => 'Página Inicial', 'url' => '/', 'page_id' => 1],
            ['title' => 'Nosso Blog', 'url' => null, 'page_id' => 2],
            ['title' => 'Link Externo', 'url' => 'https://externo.com', 'page_id' => null],
        ]);

        $renderer = new MenuRenderer($this->menuRepo, $pageLookup);
        $html = $renderer->render('header');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Página Inicial', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/inicio', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Nosso Blog', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/blog', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://externo.com', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Link Externo', $html);
    }

    public function testMenuAdminControllerUsesPageLookupWithoutSqlDirectCoupling(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();

        $pageLookup = new class implements PageLookupInterface {
            public function getSelectablePages(): array
            {
                return [
                    ['id' => 1, 'title' => 'Início', 'slug' => 'inicio'],
                    ['id' => 2, 'title' => 'Blog', 'slug' => 'blog'],
                    ['id' => 3, 'title' => 'Sobre', 'slug' => 'sobre'],
                    ['id' => 4, 'title' => 'Privacidade', 'slug' => 'privacidade'],
                    ['id' => 5, 'title' => 'Termos e Usos', 'slug' => 'termos'],
                ];
            }
        };

        $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $themeManager->method('render')->willReturnCallback(function($view, $data) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('pages', $data);
            // 5 páginas dinâmicas + 1 Home sintética = 6 páginas
            $this->assertCount(6, $data['pages']);
            $this->assertEquals('Início (Home)', $data['pages'][0]['title']);
            $this->assertEquals('Início', $data['pages'][1]['title']);
            return '<html>Menus Rendered</html>';
        });

        $controller = new MenuAdminController($this->menuRepo, $themeManager, $pageLookup);
        $request = new Request();
        $response = $controller->index($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse::class, $response);
        $this->assertEquals('<html>Menus Rendered</html>', $response->getContent());
    }

    public function testMenuAdminControllerWorksGracefullyWhenPageLookupIsNull(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();

        $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $themeManager->method('render')->willReturnCallback(function($view, $data) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('pages', $data);
            // Apenas a Home sintética
            $this->assertCount(1, $data['pages']);
            $this->assertEquals('Início (Home)', $data['pages'][0]['title']);
            return '<html>OK</html>';
        });

        $controller = new MenuAdminController($this->menuRepo, $themeManager, null);
        $request = new Request();
        $response = $controller->index($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse::class, $response);
    }

    public function testHierarchicalSubmenusInRepositoryAndRenderer(): void
    {
        $this->menuRepo->ensureTables();
        $header = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation('header');
        $menuId = (int)$header['id'];

        // Simula o envio do Gerenciador de Menus (wpNavMenu drag-and-drop com depth 0, 1, 2)
        $saved = $this->menuRepo->replaceMenuItems($menuId, [
            ['id' => 'item_1', 'depth' => 0, 'title' => 'Especialidades', 'url' => '#', 'target' => '_self'],
            ['id' => 'item_2', 'depth' => 1, 'title' => 'Cirurgia Plástica', 'url' => '/cirurgia-plastica', 'target' => '_self'],
            ['id' => 'item_3', 'depth' => 2, 'title' => 'Rinoplastia', 'url' => '/rinoplastia', 'target' => '_blank', 'css_classes' => 'destaque-sub'],
            ['id' => 'item_4', 'depth' => 0, 'title' => 'Contato', 'url' => '/contato', 'target' => '_self'],
        ]);

        $this->assertTrue($saved);

        $items = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems($menuId);
        $this->assertCount(4, $items);
        $this->assertNull($items[0]['parent_id']);
        $this->assertEquals((int)$items[0]['id'], (int)$items[1]['parent_id']);
        $this->assertEquals((int)$items[1]['id'], (int)$items[2]['parent_id']);
        $this->assertEquals(2, (int)$items[2]['depth']);
        $this->assertEquals('_blank', $items[2]['target']);
        $this->assertNull($items[3]['parent_id']);

        $renderer = new MenuRenderer($this->menuRepo);
        $html = $renderer->render('header');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('menu-item-has-children', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('class="sub-menu"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Cirurgia Plástica', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Rinoplastia', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('target="_blank"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('destaque-sub', $html);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/MigrationRunnerStopsOnFirstFailureTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Database\MigrationRunner;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\PluginMigrationScanner;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class MigrationRunnerStopsOnFirstFailureTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_mig_stop_test_' . uniqid('', true);
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0777, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testStopsOnFirstFailureAndDoesNotRunOrRecordSubsequentMigrations(): void
    {
        $conn = new Connection('sqlite::memory:');
        $runner = new MigrationRunner($conn);

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempDir . '/2026_10_19_000001_first_ok.php',
            <<<'PHP'
<?php
return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $pdo): void {
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE mig_test_one (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, label TEXT)');
    },
];
PHP
        );

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempDir . '/2026_10_19_000002_second_fails.php',
            <<<'PHP'
<?php
return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $pdo): void {
        throw new \RuntimeException('Erro simulado na segunda migration');
    },
];
PHP
        );

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempDir . '/2026_10_19_000003_third_must_not_run.php',
            <<<'PHP'
<?php
return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $pdo): void {
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE mig_test_three (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)');
    },
];
PHP
        );

        $result = $runner->runForPlugin('test_plugin', $this->tempDir);

        $this->assertSame(['2026_10_19_000001_first_ok'], $result['executed']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $result['errors']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('2026_10_19_000002_second_fails', $result['errors'][0]);
        $this->assertSame('2026_10_19_000002_second_fails', $result['stopped_at']);

        // Verifica que apenas a primeira migration foi registrada em kernel_migrations
        $executedRows = $runner->getExecutedMigrations('test_plugin');
        $this->assertCount(1, $executedRows);
        $this->assertSame('2026_10_19_000001_first_ok', $executedRows[0]['migration']);

        // Verifica que a terceira tabela NÃO foi criada
        $pdo = $conn->getPdo();
        $stmt = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mig_test_three'");
        $this->assertFalse($stmt !== false ? $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : false);
    }

    public function testStopsOnInvalidMigrationFormat(): void
    {
        $conn = new Connection('sqlite::memory:');
        $runner = new MigrationRunner($conn);

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempDir . '/2026_10_19_000001_invalid_format.php',
            "<?php\nreturn ['invalid' => true];\n"
        );

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempDir . '/2026_10_19_000002_after_invalid.php',
            <<<'PHP'
<?php
return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $pdo): void {
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE after_invalid (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)');
    },
];
PHP
        );

        $result = $runner->runForPlugin('test_plugin', $this->tempDir);

        $this->assertSame([], $result['executed']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $result['errors']);
        $this->assertSame('2026_10_19_000001_invalid_format', $result['stopped_at']);
        $this->assertCount(0, $runner->getExecutedMigrations('test_plugin'));
    }

    public function testAllSucceededReturnsStoppedAtNullAndPropagatesInScanner(): void
    {
        $conn = new Connection('sqlite::memory:');
        $runner = new MigrationRunner($conn);

        $pluginMigrationsDir = $this->tempDir . '/src/Plugins/alpha/migrations';
        mkdir($pluginMigrationsDir, 0777, true);

        file_put_contents(
            $pluginMigrationsDir . '/2026_10_19_000001_alpha_ok.php',
            <<<'PHP'
<?php
return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $pdo): void {
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE alpha_tbl (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)');
    },
];
PHP
        );

        $scanner = new PluginMigrationScanner($this->tempDir, $conn);
        $healResult = $scanner->healAll($runner);

        $this->assertSame(['alpha' => ['2026_10_19_000001_alpha_ok']], $healResult['executed']);
        $this->assertSame([], $healResult['errors']);
        $this->assertSame([], $healResult['stopped_at']);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $items = scandir($dir) ?: [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\OrdersAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class OrdersAdminControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoOrderRepository $orderRepo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        // Cria tabelas de teste
        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
                email VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,
                password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user'
            );
        ");

        $this->orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo, true);
    }

    public function testDashboardRendersPolishedKpiAndGatewayCards(): void
    {
        // 1. Cadastra usuário e pedido de teste
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, password, role)
            VALUES (1, 'Mônica Medeiros', 'monica@teste.com', 'hash', 'user');
        ");

        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 1,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 10,
            'total'          => 150.00,
            'status'         => 'paid',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_TEST_9999',
            'transaction_id' => 'TX_PIX_123',
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $orderId);

        // 2. Mocks de Sessão e Settings
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('csrf_token_abc');
        $session->method('getFlash')->willReturn(null);

        $settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settings->method('all')->willReturn([
            'mercadopago_enabled'      => true,
            'mercadopago_access_token' => 'APP_USR-test-token',
            'mercadopago_public_key'   => 'APP_USR-pub-key',
            'mercadopago_sandbox'      => false,
            'paypal_enabled'           => false,
            'stripe_enabled'           => true,
            'stripe_secret_key'        => 'sk_test_123',
        ]);
        $settings->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($key, $def = null) {
            $data = [
                'mercadopago_enabled'      => true,
                'mercadopago_access_token' => 'APP_USR-test-token',
                'mercadopago_public_key'   => 'APP_USR-pub-key',
                'mercadopago_sandbox'      => false,
                'paypal_enabled'           => false,
                'stripe_enabled'           => true,
                'stripe_secret_key'        => 'sk_test_123',
            ];
            return $data[$key] ?? $def;
        });

        // 3. Registry de Gateways
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $registry->register(new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $settings));
        $registry->register(new PayPalGateway(settings: $settings));

    public function testMonthlyPeriodFilterUpdatesMetricsAndOrdersAccurately(): void
    {
        // 1. Cadastra usuário
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, password, role)
            VALUES (2, 'Aluno Teste', 'aluno@teste.com', 'hash', 'user');
        ");

        // 2. Insere pedido de Outubro/2026
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO commerce_orders (user_id, item_type, item_id, total, status, gateway, payment_method, order_ref, created_at)
            VALUES (2, 'course', 1, 200.00, 'paid', 'mercadopago', 'pix', 'ORD_OCT_1', '2026-10-15 14:00:00');
        ");

        // 3. Insere pedido de Novembro/2026
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO commerce_orders (user_id, item_type, item_id, total, status, gateway, payment_method, order_ref, created_at)
            VALUES (2, 'course', 1, 300.00, 'paid', 'mercadopago', 'pix', 'ORD_NOV_1', '2026-11-05 10:00:00');
        ");

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_123');
        $session->method('getFlash')->willReturn(null);

        $settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settings->method('all')->willReturn(['mercadopago_enabled' => true]);

        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $controller = new OrdersAdminController($session, $this->orderRepo, $registry, $settings);

        // A. Filtro para Outubro/2026 (?period=2026-10)
        $reqOct = new Request(['period' => '2026-10'], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/commerce?period=2026-10']);
        $respOct = $controller->index($reqOct);
        $htmlOct = $respOct->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ORD_OCT_1', $htmlOct);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('ORD_NOV_1', $htmlOct);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('R$ 200,00', $htmlOct);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('value="2026-10" selected', $htmlOct);

        // B. Filtro para Novembro/2026 (?period=2026-11)
        $reqNov = new Request(['period' => '2026-11'], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/commerce?period=2026-11']);
        $respNov = $controller->index($reqNov);
        $htmlNov = $respNov->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ORD_NOV_1', $htmlNov);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('ORD_OCT_1', $htmlNov);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('R$ 300,00', $htmlNov);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('value="2026-11" selected', $htmlNov);

        // C. Sem filtro (Geral / Todo o Histórico)
        $reqAll = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/commerce']);
        $respAll = $controller->index($reqAll);
        $htmlAll = $respAll->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ORD_OCT_1', $htmlAll);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ORD_NOV_1', $htmlAll);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('R$ 500,00', $htmlAll); // 200 + 300
    }

    public function testExportGeneratesValidExcelCompatibleCsv(): void
    {
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, password, role)
            VALUES (3, 'Carlos Contador', 'carlos@contabil.com', 'hash', 'user');
        ");

        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO commerce_orders (user_id, item_type, item_id, total, status, gateway, payment_method, order_ref, created_at)
            VALUES (3, 'course', 5, 450.50, 'paid', 'mercadopago', 'pix', 'ORD_FISCAL_2026', '2026-11-05 18:00:00');
        ");

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $controller = new OrdersAdminController($session, $this->orderRepo, $registry, $settings);

        // 1. Export Geral
        $reqExport = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/commerce/export']);
        $respExport = $controller->export($reqExport);

        $this->assertSame(200, $respExport->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('text/csv', (string)$respExport->getHeader('Content-Type'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('attachment; filename="balanco-geral-vendas-', (string)$respExport->getHeader('Content-Disposition'));

        $csv = $respExport->getContent();
        // UTF-8 BOM
        $this->assertStringStartsWith("\xEF\xBB\xBF", $csv);
        // Cabeçalhos em português com delimitador ;
        $this->assertStringContainsString('"ID Pedido"', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Referência', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Nome do Aluno', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Carlos Contador', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('carlos@contabil.com', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('450,50', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Pix Instantâneo', $csv);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Pago / Aprovado', $csv);

        // 2. Export Anual (?year=2026)
        $reqYear = new Request(['year' => '2026'], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/commerce/export?year=2026']);
        $respYear = $controller->export($reqYear);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('filename="balanco-anual-vendas-2026.csv"', (string)$respYear->getHeader('Content-Disposition'));

        // 3. Export Mensal (?period=2026-11)
        $reqMonth = new Request(['period' => '2026-11'], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/commerce/export?period=2026-11']);
        $respMonth = $controller->export($reqMonth);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('filename="balanco-vendas-2026-11.csv"', (string)$respMonth->getHeader('Content-Disposition'));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/OsRuntimeTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\CapabilityRepositoryInterface;

class OsRuntimeTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRegisterCapabilityDelegatesToRepository()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $repoMock = $this->createMock(CapabilityRepositoryInterface::class);
        $repoMock->expects($this->once())
                 ->method('registerCapability')
                 ->with('test.cap', 'Test Context');
                 
        $container->singleton(CapabilityRepositoryInterface::class, function() use ($repoMock) {
            return $repoMock;
        });

        $connectorMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector::class);
        $linkRegistryMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry::class);
        $dispatcherMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher::class);
        
        $runtime = new OsRuntime($container, $connectorMock, $linkRegistryMock, $dispatcherMock, 'DomainSystem\\TestPlugin');
        $runtime->registerCapability('test.cap', 'Test Context');
    }

    public function testRegisterCapabilityFailsGracefullyIfNoAuthPlugin()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $connectorMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector::class);
        $linkRegistryMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry::class);
        $dispatcherMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher::class);
        
        $runtime = new OsRuntime($container, $connectorMock, $linkRegistryMock, $dispatcherMock, 'DomainSystem\\TestPlugin');
        
        // This should not throw an exception (it catches silently)
        $runtime->registerCapability('test.cap', 'Test Context');
        
        $this->assertTrue(true, 'Executed silently without throwing exceptions');
    }

    public function testHasDelegatesToContainer(): void
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $container->bind('sample.service', fn() => 'sample');

        $connectorMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector::class);
        $linkRegistryMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry::class);
        $dispatcherMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher::class);

        $runtime = new OsRuntime($container, $connectorMock, $linkRegistryMock, $dispatcherMock, 'DomainSystem\\TestPlugin');

        $this->assertTrue($runtime->has('sample.service'));
        $this->assertFalse($runtime->has('unregistered.service'));
    }

    public function testHasLinkDelegatesToLinkRegistry(): void
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $connectorMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector::class);
        $linkRegistryMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry::class);
        $dispatcherMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher::class);

        $linkRegistryMock->method('hasLink')
            ->willReturnCallback(fn($name) => $name === 'core.theme_parts');

        $runtime = new OsRuntime($container, $connectorMock, $linkRegistryMock, $dispatcherMock, 'DomainSystem\\TestPlugin');

        $this->assertTrue($runtime->hasLink('core.theme_parts'));
        $this->assertFalse($runtime->hasLink('unknown.link'));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/PageServiceTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use PDO;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Services\PageSlugHelper;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Services\DefaultPagesSeeder;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Repositories\PageRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Controllers\PageFrontController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\seo\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface;

class PageServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE pages (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                content TEXT,
                theme TEXT,
                template_file TEXT,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");
    }

    public function testPortugueseSlugGenerationTransliteratesAccents(): void
    {
        $testCases = [
            'Início' => 'inicio',
            'Sobre Nós' => 'sobre-nos',
            'Termos e Usos' => 'termos-e-usos',
            'Política de Privacidade' => 'politica-de-privacidade',
            'Programação & Design' => 'programacao-design',
        ];

        foreach ($testCases as $title => $expectedSlug) {
            $slug = PageSlugHelper::slugify($title);
            $this->assertEquals($expectedSlug, $slug, "Falha na geração do slug para '{$title}'");
        }
    }

    public function testDefaultThemeSatisfiesContractAndExposesTemplates(): void
    {
        $themesDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes';
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($themesDir . '/default');

        $themes = $themeManager->getAvailableThemes();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('default', $themes, "O tema 'default' deve ser reconhecido como tema válido pelo contrato.");

        $templates = $themeManager->getAvailableTemplates('default');
        $this->assertContains('home.php', $templates, "O tema 'default' deve possuir o template home.php");
        $this->assertContains('blog.php', $templates, "O tema 'default' deve possuir o template blog.php");
        $this->assertContains('sobre.php', $templates, "O tema 'default' deve possuir o template sobre.php");
        $this->assertContains('termos.php', $templates, "O tema 'default' deve possuir o template termos.php");
        $this->assertContains('privacidade.php', $templates, "O tema 'default' deve possuir o template privacidade.php");
        $this->assertContains('academy.php', $templates, "O tema 'default' deve possuir o template academy.php");
    }

    public function testDefaultPagesSeederCreatesAllRequiredPagesWithTemplates(): void
    {
        $inserted = DefaultPagesSeeder::seed($this->pdo);
        $this->assertEquals(6, $inserted, "Deve semear exatamente 6 páginas padrão.");

        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT slug, title, theme, template_file FROM pages ORDER BY slug ASC");
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $pagesBySlug = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $pagesBySlug[$r['slug']] = $r;
        }

        $expectedPages = [
            'inicio' => ['title' => 'Início', 'template' => 'templates/home.php'],
            'blog' => ['title' => 'Blog', 'template' => 'templates/blog.php'],
            'sobre' => ['title' => 'Sobre', 'template' => 'templates/sobre.php'],
            'termos' => ['title' => 'Termos e Usos', 'template' => 'templates/termos.php'],
            'privacidade' => ['title' => 'Privacidade', 'template' => 'templates/privacidade.php'],
            'tutoriais' => ['title' => 'Tutoriais', 'template' => 'templates/academy.php'],
        ];

        foreach ($expectedPages as $slug => $expected) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey($slug, $pagesBySlug, "A página '{$slug}' deve existir no banco.");
            $this->assertEquals($expected['title'], $pagesBySlug[$slug]['title']);
            $this->assertEquals('default', $pagesBySlug[$slug]['theme']);
            $this->assertEquals($expected['template'], $pagesBySlug[$slug]['template_file']);
        }
    }

    public function testDefaultPagesSeederIsIdempotent(): void
    {
        $firstRun = DefaultPagesSeeder::seed($this->pdo);
        $this->assertEquals(6, $firstRun);

        $secondRun = DefaultPagesSeeder::seed($this->pdo);
        $this->assertEquals(0, $secondRun, "Segunda execução do seeder não deve duplicar registros.");

        $count = (int)$this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pages")->fetchColumn();
        $this->assertEquals(6, $count);
    }

    public function testPageRepositoryImplementsPageLookupInterface(): void
    {
        DefaultPagesSeeder::seed($this->pdo);
        $repo = new PageRepository($this->pdo);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(PageLookupInterface::class, $repo);

        $selectable = $repo->getSelectablePages();
        $this->assertCount(6, $selectable);

        $first = $selectable[0];
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('id', $first);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('title', $first);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('slug', $first);
    }

    public function testPageFrontControllerFallsBackSafelyWhenThemeIsNonexistent(): void
    {
        // Cria uma página apontando para tema inexistente 'rachidd'
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO pages (slug, title, content, theme, template_file)
            VALUES ('sobre-teste', 'Sobre Nós', 'Conteúdo alternativo', 'rachidd', 'templates/sobre.php')
        ");

        $repo = new PageRepository($this->pdo);
        $shortcodes = new ShortcodeManager();
        $seo = $this->createMock(SeoManagerInterface::class);
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/default');

        $controller = new PageFrontController($repo, $shortcodes, $seo, $themeManager);

        $response = $controller->show('sobre-teste');

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::class, $response);
        $this->assertEquals(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        // Deve renderizar com sucesso via fallback do SafeThemeResolver para 'default'
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sobre', $response->getContent());
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/PluginBootstrapperTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\Services\PluginBootstrapper;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\Services\PluginStateManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;
use DomainSystem\Tests\Support\FakePlugin;

class PluginBootstrapperTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempPath;
    private Container $container;
    private EventDispatcher $dispatcher;
    private PluginStateManager $stateManager;
    private PluginBootstrapper $bootstrapper;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/domain_system_test_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($this->tempPath . '/config', 0777, true);
        mkdir($this->tempPath . '/temp', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents($this->tempPath . '/config/plugins.json', '[]');
        
        $this->container = new Container();
        $this->dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        $this->stateManager = new PluginStateManager($this->tempPath);
        
        $this->bootstrapper = new PluginBootstrapper(
            $this->container,
            $this->dispatcher,
            $this->stateManager,
            $this->tempPath
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        unlink($this->tempPath . '/config/plugins.json');
        rmdir($this->tempPath . '/config');
        @unlink($this->tempPath . '/temp/process_stack.json');
        @rmdir($this->tempPath . '/temp');
        rmdir($this->tempPath);
    }

    public function testBootLifecycle()
    {
        $sysPlugin = new FakePlugin('core_auth', [], true, true);
        $userPlugin = new FakePlugin('user_blog', [], true, false);

        $this->bootstrapper->bootPlugins(['core_auth' => $sysPlugin], ['user_blog' => $userPlugin]);

        $this->assertTrue($sysPlugin->osRegistered, "System app should be registered");
        $this->assertTrue($sysPlugin->booted, "System app should be booted");
        
        $this->assertTrue($userPlugin->osRegistered, "User plugin should be registered");
        $this->assertTrue($userPlugin->booted, "User plugin should be booted");
    }

    public function testMissingArgumentThrowsArgumentCountError()
    {
        $this->expectException(\ArgumentCountError::class);

        // Intentionally omitting the second argument to reproduce the bug
        $sysPlugin = new FakePlugin('core_auth', [], true, true);
        
        // This should throw because userPlugins is strictly required
        $this->bootstrapper->bootPlugins(['core_auth' => $sysPlugin]);
    }

    public function testFailingPluginDoesNotCrashOthers()
    {
        $crashingPlugin = new class('crashing_plugin', [], true, false) extends FakePlugin {
            public function osBoot(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void { throw new \Exception("Boom!"); }
        };
        
        $goodPlugin = new FakePlugin('good_plugin', [], true, false);

        $this->bootstrapper->bootPlugins([], [
            'crashing_plugin' => $crashingPlugin,
            'good_plugin' => $goodPlugin
        ]);

        $this->assertFalse($crashingPlugin->booted, "Crashing plugin should not boot");
        $this->assertTrue($goodPlugin->osRegistered, "Good plugin should still register");
        $this->assertTrue($goodPlugin->booted, "Good plugin should still boot");
    }

    public function testDependencyResolutionOrder()
    {
        $pluginA = new FakePlugin('pluginA', ['pluginB'], true, true);
        $pluginB = new FakePlugin('pluginB', [], true, true);

        // Provide them in reverse order
        $this->bootstrapper->bootPlugins(['pluginA' => $pluginA, 'pluginB' => $pluginB], []);

        // With the current bootstrapper, it creates a boot stack. 
        // We can hook into events to assert order, but FakePlugin doesn't fire events directly.
        // For now, let's just ensure they both boot.
        $this->assertTrue($pluginA->booted);
        $this->assertTrue($pluginB->booted);
    }

    public function testMissingDependencyIsIgnoredAndBootsAnyway()
    {
        $pluginA = new FakePlugin('pluginA', ['missing_dependency'], true, true);
        $this->bootstrapper->bootPlugins(['pluginA' => $pluginA], []);
        $this->assertTrue($pluginA->booted, "Currently, missing dependencies are skipped and the plugin boots anyway");
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\Services\PluginDiscoverer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\Services\PluginStateManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;

class PluginDiscovererTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempPluginsPath;
    private string $tempConfigPath;
    private PluginDiscoverer $discoverer;
    private PluginStateManager $stateManager;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempPluginsPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/domain_system_plugins_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($this->tempPluginsPath . '/config', 0777, true);
        mkdir($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin', 0777, true);
        
        $this->tempConfigPath = $this->tempPluginsPath . '/config/plugins.json';
        
        $pluginPhp = <<<PHP
<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\TestPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin {
    public function register(): void {}
}
PHP;
        file_put_contents($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin/Plugin.php', $pluginPhp);
        
        $pluginJson = json_encode([
            'name' => 'test-plugin',
            'version' => '2.0.0'
        ]);
        file_put_contents($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin/plugin.json', $pluginJson);
        
        $configJson = json_encode([
            'test-plugin' => true
        ]);
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigPath, $configJson);
        
        // Autoload the temp class for the test
        require_once $this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin/Plugin.php';
        
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        $this->stateManager = new PluginStateManager($this->tempPluginsPath);
        
        $this->discoverer = new PluginDiscoverer($container, $dispatcher, $this->stateManager);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        unlink($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin/Plugin.php');
        unlink($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin/plugin.json');
        rmdir($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins/TestPlugin');
        rmdir($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins');
        rmdir($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src');
        unlink($this->tempConfigPath);
        rmdir($this->tempPluginsPath . '/config');
        rmdir($this->tempPluginsPath);
    }

    public function testPluginDiscoveryAndState()
    {
        $plugins = $this->discoverer->discover($this->tempPluginsPath . '/src/Plugins');
        
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('test-plugin', $plugins);
        $plugin = $plugins['test-plugin'];
        
        $this->assertEquals('test-plugin', $plugin->getName());
        $this->assertEquals('2.0.0', $plugin->getVersion());
        $this->assertTrue($plugin->isActive());
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ManualModuleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Manual\PluginManualScanner;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\manual\AcademyManualModule;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\manual\CommerceManualModule;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class PluginManualModulesDiscoveryTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPluginManualScannerDiscoversAcademyAndCommerceModules(): void
    {
        $rootDir = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $scanner = new PluginManualScanner($rootDir);
        $modules = $scanner->discover();

        $this->assertNotEmpty($modules, 'O scanner deve descobrir módulos de manual na árvore do projeto.');

        // 1. Verifica Módulo Academy
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('academy', $modules, 'O módulo manual da Academy deve ser auto-descoberto.');
        $academy = $modules['academy'];
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ManualModuleInterface::class, $academy);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(AcademyManualModule::class, $academy);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Academy', $academy->getTitle());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/admin/academy', (string)$academy->getAdminUrl());

        $academyChecklist = $academy->getChecklistItems();
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(10, count($academyChecklist));

        $renderedAcademy = $academy->renderContent('http://localhost');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Visualizador de PDF', $renderedAcademy);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Cockpit do Aluno', $renderedAcademy);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DomainCommerce', $renderedAcademy);

        // 2. Verifica Módulo DomainCommerce
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('commerce', $modules, 'O módulo manual do DomainCommerce deve ser auto-descoberto.');
        $commerce = $modules['commerce'];
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ManualModuleInterface::class, $commerce);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(CommerceManualModule::class, $commerce);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DomainCommerce', $commerce->getTitle());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/admin/commerce', (string)$commerce->getAdminUrl());
        $this->assertSame('#00d284', $commerce->getAccentColor());

        $commerceChecklist = $commerce->getChecklistItems();
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(7, count($commerceChecklist));

        $renderedCommerce = $commerce->renderContent('http://localhost');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Mercado Pago', $renderedCommerce);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('PayPal', $renderedCommerce);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Stripe', $renderedCommerce);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('payment.approved', $renderedCommerce);

        // 3. Verifica Módulo Flex Builder (flextheme)
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('flextheme', $modules, 'O módulo manual do Flex Builder deve ser auto-descoberto.');
        $flextheme = $modules['flextheme'];
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ManualModuleInterface::class, $flextheme);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Flex Builder', $flextheme->getTitle());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/admin/builder', (string)$flextheme->getAdminUrl());
        $this->assertSame('#38bdf8', $flextheme->getAccentColor());

        $flexChecklist = $flextheme->getChecklistItems();
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(12, count($flexChecklist));

        $renderedFlex = $flextheme->renderContent('http://localhost');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Auto-Reflow', $renderedFlex);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('375px', $renderedFlex);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Design Tokens', $renderedFlex);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Vídeo', $renderedFlex);
    }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ProcessRegistryTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\Services\ProcessRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ProcessRegistryTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'proc_reg_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        mkdir($this->tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'temp', 0755, true);
        ProcessRegistry::killSingleton($this->tempDir);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        ProcessRegistry::killSingleton($this->tempDir);
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testProcessIdsAreStableDuringSingletonLifetime(): void
    {
        $registry1 = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pidAcademy1 = $registry1->startProcess('academy', false);
        $pidDatabase1 = $registry1->startProcess('database', true);

        $singletonId1 = $registry1->getSingletonId();

        $registry2 = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pidAcademy2 = $registry2->startProcess('academy', false);
        $pidDatabase2 = $registry2->startProcess('database', true);

        // Enquanto o Singleton estiver vivo, os PIDs devem ser 100% estáveis e específicos
        $this->assertSame($pidAcademy1, $pidAcademy2);
        $this->assertSame($pidDatabase1, $pidDatabase2);
        $this->assertSame($singletonId1, $registry2->getSingletonId());

        // Módulos diferentes devem receber PIDs diferentes
        $this->assertNotSame($pidAcademy1, $pidDatabase1);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('PID-', $pidAcademy1);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('PID-', $pidDatabase1);
    }

    public function testProcessIdsRegenerateRandomlyWhenSingletonDies(): void
    {
        $registry1 = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pidAcademy1 = $registry1->startProcess('academy', false);
        $singletonId1 = $registry1->getSingletonId();

        // Mata o Singleton
        ProcessRegistry::killSingleton($this->tempDir);

        // Ao nascer um novo Singleton, um novo ciclo de vida é gerado
        $registry2 = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pidAcademy2 = $registry2->startProcess('academy', false);
        $singletonId2 = $registry2->getSingletonId();

        $this->assertNotSame($singletonId1, $singletonId2);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('PID-', $pidAcademy2);
        // O novo PID gerado aleatoriamente para o novo Singleton deve ser diferente do anterior
        $this->assertNotSame($pidAcademy1, $pidAcademy2);
    }

    public function testMemoryConsumptionAndLiberationTracking(): void
    {
        $registry = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pid = $registry->startProcess('academy', false);
        $registry->endProcess($pid, 'Running');

        // Simula consumo de memória (alocação de 500 KB)
        $registry->updateProcessMemory('academy', 500.0);
        $proc = $registry->getProcess($pid);
        $this->assertSame(500.0, $proc['memory_used_kb']);
        $this->assertSame(500.0, $proc['peak_memory_kb']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $proc['memory_delta_kb']);

        // Simula liberação de memória (garbage collection reduz para 200 KB)
        $registry->updateProcessMemory('academy', 200.0);
        $proc = $registry->getProcess($pid);
        $this->assertSame(200.0, $proc['memory_used_kb']);
        // O pico histórico deve ser mantido em 500 KB
        $this->assertSame(500.0, $proc['peak_memory_kb']);
        // O delta deve ser negativo (-300 KB), indicando liberação
        $this->assertSame(-300.0, $proc['memory_delta_kb']);
    }

    public function testEndProcessUpdatesStatusAndMetrics(): void
    {
        $registry = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pid = $registry->startProcess('academy', false);

        $registry->endProcess($pid, 'Running');

        $proc = $registry->getProcess($pid);
        $this->assertNotNull($proc);
        $this->assertSame('Running', $proc['status']);
        $this->assertSame('UserPlugin', $proc['type']);
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0, $proc['memory_used_kb']);
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0, $proc['duration_ms']);
    }

    public function testSaveAndLoadSnapshot(): void
    {
        $registry = new ProcessRegistry($this->tempDir);
        $pid = $registry->startProcess('database', true);
        $registry->endProcess($pid, 'Running');

        $registry->saveSnapshot($this->tempDir);

        $loaded = $registry->loadSnapshot($this->tempDir);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey($pid, $loaded);
        $this->assertSame('database', $loaded[$pid]['name']);
        $this->assertSame('SystemApp', $loaded[$pid]['type']);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/QueryBuilderTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\QueryBuilder;

class QueryBuilderTest extends TestCase
{
    private Connection $connection;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // Setup SQLite in memory connection
        $this->connection = new Connection('sqlite::memory:');
        
        // Create a dummy table for tests
        $pdo = $this->connection->getPdo();
        $pdo->exec("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT)");
    }

    public function testInsertAndSelect()
    {
        $qb = new QueryBuilder($this->connection);
        
        $id = $qb->table('users')->insert([
            'name' => 'John Doe',
            'email' => 'john@test.com'
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $id);

        // Fetch it back
        $user = $qb->table('users')->where('id', '=', $id)->first();
        
        $this->assertEquals('John Doe', $user['name']);
        $this->assertEquals('john@test.com', $user['email']);
    }

    public function testUpdate()
    {
        $qb = new QueryBuilder($this->connection);
        $id = $qb->table('users')->insert(['name' => 'Old Name', 'email' => 'old@test.com']);

        $affected = $qb->table('users')->where('id', '=', $id)->update(['name' => 'New Name']);
        
        $this->assertEquals(1, $affected);

        $user = $qb->table('users')->where('id', '=', $id)->first();
        $this->assertEquals('New Name', $user['name']);
        $this->assertEquals('old@test.com', $user['email']);
    }

    public function testDelete()
    {
        $qb = new QueryBuilder($this->connection);
        $id = $qb->table('users')->insert(['name' => 'Delete Me', 'email' => 'del@test.com']);

        $affected = $qb->table('users')->where('id', '=', $id)->delete();
        $this->assertEquals(1, $affected);

        $user = $qb->table('users')->where('id', '=', $id)->first();
        $this->assertNull($user);
    }

    public function testGetMultiple()
    {
        $qb = new QueryBuilder($this->connection);
        $qb->table('users')->insert(['name' => 'User 1']);
        $qb->table('users')->insert(['name' => 'User 2']);

        $users = $qb->table('users')->get();
        $this->assertCount(2, $users);
    }
}




/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ResponseEngineTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\RedirectResponse;

class ResponseEngineTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testViewResponseHandlesLayoutFlag()
    {
        $response = new ViewResponse("<h1>Hello</h1>", true);
        $this->assertTrue($response->shouldWrapLayout());
        $this->assertEquals("<h1>Hello</h1>", $response->getContent());
        $this->assertEquals(200, $response->getStatusCode());

        $noLayout = new ViewResponse("<p>Raw</p>", false);
        $this->assertFalse($noLayout->shouldWrapLayout());
    }

    public function testJsonResponseEncodesDataAndSetsHeaders()
    {
        $data = ['status' => 'ok', 'user_id' => 10];
        $response = new JsonResponse($data, 201);
        
        $this->assertEquals('{"status":"ok","user_id":10}', $response->getContent());
        $this->assertEquals(201, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertEquals('application/json', $response->getHeader('Content-Type'));
        // JsonResponse should never be wrapped in layout
        if (method_exists($response, 'shouldWrapLayout')) {
            $this->assertFalse($response->shouldWrapLayout());
        }
    }

    public function testRedirectResponseSetsLocationHeader()
    {
        $response = new RedirectResponse('/admin/dashboard', 301);
        
        $this->assertEquals('', $response->getContent());
        $this->assertEquals(301, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertEquals('/admin/dashboard', $response->getHeader('Location'));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/RouterTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use Exception;

class DummyController {
    public function index() {
        return "Hello World";
    }

    public function show($id) {
        return "Showing " . $id;
    }
}

class RouterTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testAddAndDispatchStaticRoute()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $router = new Router($container);

        $router->addRoute('GET', '/test', function() {
            return 'Static Route OK';
        });

        $result = $router->dispatch(new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/test']));
        $this->assertEquals('Static Route OK', $result);
    }

    public function testAddAndDispatchDynamicRoute()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $router = new Router($container);

        $router->addRoute('GET', '/users/{id}', function($id) {
            return "User: " . $id;
        });

        $result = $router->dispatch(new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/users/123']));
        $this->assertEquals('User: 123', $result);
    }

    public function testRouteToController()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $router = new Router($container);

        $router->addRoute('GET', '/ctrl', [DummyController::class, 'index']);
        $router->addRoute('GET', '/ctrl/{id}', [DummyController::class, 'show']);

        $result1 = $router->dispatch(new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/ctrl']));
        $result2 = $router->dispatch(new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/ctrl/999']));

        $this->assertEquals('Hello World', $result1);
        $this->assertEquals('Showing 999', $result2);
    }

    public function testRouteNotFound()
    {
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionCode(404);

        $container = new Container();
        $router = new Router($container);

        $router->dispatch(new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/does-not-exist']));
    }

    public function testMethodNotAllowedButRouteExistsIsConsideredNotFoundForNow()
    {
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionCode(404);

        $container = new Container();
        $router = new Router($container);

        $router->addRoute('POST', '/only-post', function() { return 'OK'; });

        $router->dispatch(new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/only-post']));
    }

    public function testRouteCollisionThrowsException()
    {
        $this->expectException(\DomainSystem\Core\Exceptions\RouteAlreadyRegisteredException::class);

        $container = new Container();
        $router = new Router($container);

        // Registro original (Simulando Ring 0 / App do Sistema)
        $router->addRoute('GET', '/login', function() { return 'Core Login'; }, 'core_auth');

        // Tentativa de sequestro da rota (Simulando Ring 3 / Plugin de Usuário)
        $router->addRoute('GET', '/login', function() { return 'Fake Login'; }, 'malicious_plugin');
    }
}
