// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/RuntimeDirectoriesTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Bootstrap\RuntimeDirectories;

class RuntimeDirectoriesTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $testRoot;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->testRoot = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_runtime_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        mkdir($this->testRoot, 0777, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->testRoot);
    }

    public function testEnsureCreatesRequiredDirectoriesAndSecurityHtaccess(): void
    {
        $this->assertDirectoryDoesNotExist($this->testRoot . '/temp');
        $this->assertDirectoryDoesNotExist($this->testRoot . '/storage');
        $this->assertDirectoryDoesNotExist($this->testRoot . '/public/uploads');

        RuntimeDirectories::ensure($this->testRoot);

        // Verifica diretórios essenciais
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/temp');
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/temp/cache');
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/temp/logs');
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/storage');
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/storage/state');
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/public/uploads');
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($this->testRoot . '/public/uploads/academy');

        // Verifica segurança .htaccess nas pastas internas
        $tempHtaccess = $this->testRoot . '/temp/.htaccess';
        $this->assertFileExists($tempHtaccess);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Deny from all', file_get_contents($tempHtaccess));

        $storageHtaccess = $this->testRoot . '/storage/.htaccess';
        $this->assertFileExists($storageHtaccess);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Deny from all', file_get_contents($storageHtaccess));
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir), ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : unlink($path);
        }
        rmdir($dir);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/SecurityHardeningTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Middlewares\AuthMiddleware;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\IdentityManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\SafeRedirectValidator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\SessionManager;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class SecurityHardeningTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSafeRedirectValidatorBlocksOpenRedirectAndPhishing(): void
    {
        $validator = new SafeRedirectValidator();

        // 1. Phishing externo com protocolo absoluto
        $this->assertSame('/fallback', $validator->sanitize('https://evil-phishing-site.com', '/fallback'));
        $this->assertFalse($validator->isSafe('https://evil-phishing-site.com'));

        // 2. Esquema relativo de protocolo //evil.com
        $this->assertSame('/fallback', $validator->sanitize('//evil.com/login', '/fallback'));
        $this->assertFalse($validator->isSafe('//evil.com/login'));

        // 3. Barra invertida \\evil.com
        $this->assertSame('/fallback', $validator->sanitize('\\\\evil.com/login', '/fallback'));
        $this->assertFalse($validator->isSafe('\\\\evil.com/login'));

        // 4. Esquemas perigosos javascript:, data:
        $this->assertSame('/fallback', $validator->sanitize('javascript:alert(1)', '/fallback'));
        $this->assertSame('/fallback', $validator->sanitize('data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>', '/fallback'));

        // 5. CRLF Injection
        $this->assertSame('/fallback', $validator->sanitize("/admin\r\nSet-Cookie: evil=1", '/fallback'));

        // 6. URLs relativas seguras locais
        $this->assertSame('/admin', $validator->sanitize('/admin', '/fallback'));
        $this->assertSame('/aluno/painel', $validator->sanitize('/aluno/painel', '/fallback'));
        $this->assertTrue($validator->isSafe('/aluno/painel'));
    }

    public function testAuthMiddlewareDefaultDenyOnAdminRoutesRedirectsUnauthenticated(): void
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManager::class);
        $sessionMock->method('get')->willReturn(null); // Deslogado

        $identityMock = $this->createMock(IdentityManager::class);

        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($sessionMock, $identityMock);

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/settings']);

        $nextCalled = false;
        $next = function () use (&$nextCalled) {
            $nextCalled = true;
            return new Response('passed');
        };

        // Rota sem capabilities explícitas (desenvolvedor esqueceu)
        $result = $middleware->handle($request, $next, ['capabilities' => []]);

        $this->assertFalse($nextCalled);
        $this->assertSame(302, $result->getStatusCode());
        $location = $result->getHeader('Location');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/login?redirect=', $location);
        $this->assertStringContainsString(urlencode('/admin/settings'), $location);
    }

    public function testAuthMiddlewareBlocksStudentAndUserRolesFromAdmin(): void
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManager::class);
        $sessionMock->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($key, $default = null) {
            if ($key === 'user_id') return 99;
            if ($key === 'user_role') return 'student'; // Aluno tentando invadir admin
            if ($key === 'user_name') return 'Aluno Invasor';
            return $default;
        });

        $identityMock = $this->createMock(IdentityManager::class);

        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($sessionMock, $identityMock);

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_URI' => '/admin']);

        $nextCalled = false;
        $next = function () use (&$nextCalled) {
            $nextCalled = true;
            return new Response('passed');
        };

        $result = $middleware->handle($request, $next, ['capabilities' => ['admin']]);

        $this->assertFalse($nextCalled);
        $this->assertSame(403, $result->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Acesso Negado', $result->getContent());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Usuários comuns e alunos não possuem permissão', $result->getContent());
    }

    public function testEmergencyRouteIsBypassedByAuthMiddleware(): void
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManager::class);
        $sessionMock->method('get')->willReturn(null);

        $identityMock = $this->createMock(IdentityManager::class);

        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($sessionMock, $identityMock);

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/emergency']);

        $nextCalled = false;
        $next = function () use (&$nextCalled) {
            $nextCalled = true;
            return new Response('emergency_view');
        };

        $result = $middleware->handle($request, $next, []);

        $this->assertTrue($nextCalled);
        $this->assertSame('emergency_view', $result->getContent());
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\SessionManager;

class SessionManagerDestroyTest extends TestCase
{
    private array $originalServer;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->originalServer = $_SERVER;
        $_SESSION = [];
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $_SERVER = $this->originalServer;
        $_SESSION = [];
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            @session_destroy();
        }
    }

    public function testDestroyClearsSessionArrayInCurrentRequest(): void
    {
        $session = new SessionManager();
        $_SESSION['user_id'] = 42;
        $_SESSION['role'] = 'admin';

        $session->destroy();

        $this->assertEmpty($_SESSION, 'O array $_SESSION deve ser esvaziado no destroy().');
        $this->assertNull($session->get('user_id'));
    }

    public function testIsSecureRequestDetectsForwardedHeaders(): void
    {
        $session = new SessionManager();

        $_SERVER['HTTPS'] = 'off';
        $_SERVER['SERVER_PORT'] = '80';
        $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] = 'https';

        $this->assertTrue(
            $session->isSecureRequest(),
            'Deve identificar HTTPS quando HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO for https (Hostinger / CDN).'
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/SessionManagerTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\SessionManager;

class SessionManagerTest extends TestCase
{
    /**
     * @runInSeparateProcess
     */
    public function testSessionInitializationSetsSecureCookieParams()
    {
        $manager = new SessionManager();
        $manager->start();

        $params = session_get_cookie_params();
        
        $this->assertTrue($params['httponly'], 'A sessão deve ter a flag HttpOnly habilitada');
        $this->assertEquals('Strict', $params['samesite'], 'A sessão deve ter o SameSite=Strict');
        
        // Verifica se a flag strict_mode foi setada no INI
        $this->assertEquals('1', ini_get('session.use_strict_mode'), 'O session.use_strict_mode deve estar ativado');
    }

    /**
     * @runInSeparateProcess
     */
    public function testSessionGeneratesCsrfToken()
    {
        $manager = new SessionManager();
        $manager->start();

        $token = $manager->getCsrfToken();
        $this->assertNotEmpty($token);
        $this->assertEquals(64, strlen($token)); // bin2hex of 32 bytes = 64 chars
    }

    /**
     * @runInSeparateProcess
     */
    public function testCsrfTokenValidation()
    {
        $manager = new SessionManager();
        $manager->start();
        $token = $manager->getCsrfToken();

        $this->assertTrue($manager->validateCsrfToken($token));
        $this->assertFalse($manager->validateCsrfToken('invalid_token'));
        $this->assertFalse($manager->validateCsrfToken(null));
        $this->assertFalse($manager->validateCsrfToken(''));
    }

    /**
     * @runInSeparateProcess
     */
    public function testFlashMessages()
    {
        $manager = new SessionManager();
        $manager->start();

        $manager->setFlash('success', 'Operação realizada');
        $this->assertTrue($manager->hasFlash());
        $this->assertTrue($manager->hasFlash('success'));
        $this->assertFalse($manager->hasFlash('error'));

        $flash = $manager->getFlash();

        $this->assertEquals(['type' => 'success', 'msg' => 'Operação realizada'], $flash);
        $this->assertNull($manager->getFlash(), 'O flash message deve ser removido após a primeira leitura');
        $this->assertFalse($manager->hasFlash());
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/SiteStateTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;

class SiteStateTest extends TestCase
{
    private array $originalEnv;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->originalEnv = [
            'SITE_STATUS' => getenv('SITE_STATUS') ?: null,
            'ACTIVE_THEME' => getenv('ACTIVE_THEME') ?: null,
        ];
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if ($this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS'] !== null) {
            putenv("SITE_STATUS={$this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS']}");
        } else {
            putenv('SITE_STATUS');
        }
        if ($this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME'] !== null) {
            putenv("ACTIVE_THEME={$this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME']}");
        } else {
            putenv('ACTIVE_THEME');
        }
    }

    public function testSiteStatusDefaultsToLiveWhenNotConfigured(): void
    {
        putenv('SITE_STATUS');
        unset($_ENV['SITE_STATUS']);

        $state = new EnvSiteState();

        $this->assertEquals(SiteStateInterface::STATUS_LIVE, $state->getStatus());
        $this->assertTrue($state->isLive());
        $this->assertFalse($state->isComingSoon());
    }

    public function testSiteStatusComingSoon(): void
    {
        putenv('SITE_STATUS=coming_soon');
        $_ENV['SITE_STATUS'] = 'coming_soon';

        $state = new EnvSiteState();

        $this->assertEquals(SiteStateInterface::STATUS_COMING_SOON, $state->getStatus());
        $this->assertTrue($state->isComingSoon());
        $this->assertFalse($state->isLive());
    }

    public function testSafeThemeResolverFallsBackWhenThemeIsMissing(): void
    {
        $tempThemes = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_themes_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(5));
        mkdir($tempThemes . '/default', 0777, true);

        try {
            $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver($tempThemes);

            // Tenta um tema inexistente (ex: 'rachidd' que estava no .gitignore)
            $resolved = $resolver->resolveThemePath('rachidd');

            // Deve cair com segurança no tema 'default'
            $this->assertDirectoryExists($resolved);
            $this->assertStringEndsWith('default', str_replace('\\', '/', $resolved));
        } finally {
            @rmdir($tempThemes . '/default');
            @rmdir($tempThemes);
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/StripeSignatureVerifierTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\StripeSignatureVerifier;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class StripeSignatureVerifierTest extends TestCase
{
    private function sign(string $body, string $secret, int $ts): string
    {
        return 't=' . $ts . ',v1=' . hash_hmac('sha256', $ts . '.' . $body, $secret);
    }

    public function testValidSignatureIsAccepted(): void
    {
        $secret = 'whsec_test_secret_123';
        $now = 1_700_000_000;
        $body = '{"id":"evt_123","type":"checkout.session.completed"}';
        $sigHeader = $this->sign($body, $secret, $now);

        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier($secret, 300, $now);
        $this->assertTrue($verifier->verify($body, ['stripe-signature' => $sigHeader]));
    }

    public function testTamperedBodyIsRejected(): void
    {
        $secret = 'whsec_test_secret_123';
        $now = 1_700_000_000;
        $originalBody = '{"amount":100}';
        $tamperedBody = '{"amount":10}';
        $sigHeader = $this->sign($originalBody, $secret, $now);

        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier($secret, 300, $now);
        $this->assertFalse($verifier->verify($tamperedBody, ['stripe-signature' => $sigHeader]));
    }

    public function testOldTimestampIsRejected(): void
    {
        $secret = 'whsec_test_secret_123';
        $now = 1_700_000_000;
        $oldTs = $now - 301; // Fora da tolerância de 300s
        $body = '{"event":"ok"}';
        $sigHeader = $this->sign($body, $secret, $oldTs);

        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier($secret, 300, $now);
        $this->assertFalse($verifier->verify($body, ['stripe-signature' => $sigHeader]));
    }

    public function testEmptySecretIsRejected(): void
    {
        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier('', 300, 1_000_000);
        $this->assertFalse($verifier->verify('{"a":1}', ['stripe-signature' => 't=1000000,v1=abc']));
    }

    public function testMissingHeaderIsRejected(): void
    {
        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier('whsec_xyz', 300, 1_000_000);
        $this->assertFalse($verifier->verify('{"a":1}', []));
        $this->assertFalse($verifier->verify('{"a":1}', ['stripe-signature' => '']));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/StudentAuthAndHeaderBlockTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\UserAuthBlock;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\StudentAuthController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\StudentDashboardController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentStorageInterface;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class StudentAuthAndHeaderBlockTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                username TEXT NULL UNIQUE,
                email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password TEXT NOT NULL,
                role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");
    }

    public function testUserAuthBlockRendersLoginAndRegisterButtonsWhenLoggedOut(): void
    {
        $block = new UserAuthBlock();
        $this->assertSame('user_auth', $block->getType());
        $this->assertSame('Área de Login / Aluno', $block->getName());

        $html = $block->render([], ['is_logged_in' => false]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-block-user-auth', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Entrar', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/login', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Cadastrar', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/cadastro', $html);
    }

    public function testUserAuthBlockRendersDashboardAndLogoutWhenLoggedIn(): void
    {
        $block = new UserAuthBlock();

        $html = $block->render([], [
            'is_logged_in' => true,
            'user_name'    => 'Carlos Dev',
        ]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-block-user-auth', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Área do Aluno', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/painel', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Carlos Dev', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sair', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/logout', $html);
    }

    public function testUserAuthBlockDoesNotTreatAdminSessionAsStudent(): void
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('has')->willReturnCallback(function ($key) {
            // Admin logado no painel geral, mas NÃO na academia
            return $key === 'user_id' || $key === 'user_role';
        });
        $sessionMock->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($key, $default = null) {
            if ($key === 'user_id') return 1;
            if ($key === 'user_role') return 'admin';
            return $default;
        });

        $block = new UserAuthBlock(null, null, null, $sessionMock);
        $html = $block->render([], []);

        // Deve exibir Entrar e Cadastrar, protegendo o isolamento de privilégios
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Entrar', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Cadastrar', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Área do Aluno', $html);
    }

    public function testStudentLogoutRedirectsToHome(): void
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->expects($this->atLeastOnce())->method('remove');
        $sessionMock->expects($this->once())->method('setFlash')->with('success', 'Você saiu da sua conta.');

        $controller = new StudentAuthController($sessionMock, $this->pdo);
        $response = $controller->logout(new Request());

        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $location = $response->getHeader('Location');
        $this->assertTrue($location === '/' || str_ends_with($location, '/'));
    }

    public function testStudentRegistrationCreatesUserAndAutoLogsIn(): void
    {
        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('VALID_CSRF_TOKEN');

        $sessionValues = [];
        $sessionMock->method('set')->willReturnCallback(function ($key, $val) use (&$sessionValues) {
            $sessionValues[$key] = $val;
        });

        $controller = new StudentAuthController($sessionMock, $this->pdo);

        $req = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'            => 'VALID_CSRF_TOKEN',
            'name'                  => 'HADEL RACHID DAHER JUNIOR',
            'username'              => 'hadelrachid',
            'email'                 => 'fernanda@aluna.com',
            'password'              => 'segredo123',
            'password_confirmation' => 'segredo123',
        ]);

        $response = $controller->register($req);

        // Deve redirecionar para o painel do aluno
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/painel', $response->getHeader('Location'));

        // Usuário deve ter sido gravado no banco de dados com hash seguro
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?");
        $stmt->execute(['fernanda@aluna.com']);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($user);
        $this->assertSame('HADEL RACHID DAHER JUNIOR', $user['name']);
        $this->assertSame('hadelrachid', $user['username']);
        $this->assertTrue(password_verify('segredo123', $user['password']));

        // Sessão do aluno deve ter sido preenchida no escopo isolado
        $this->assertSame((int)$user['id'], $sessionValues['academy_student_id']);
        $this->assertSame('HADEL RACHID DAHER JUNIOR', $sessionValues['academy_student_name']);
        $this->assertSame('hadelrachid', $sessionValues['academy_student_username']);
        $this->assertSame('fernanda@aluna.com', $sessionValues['academy_student_email']);
    }

    public function testStudentAuthenticationWithValidAndInvalidCredentials(): void
    {
        // 1. Cria usuário prévio
        $hash = password_hash('alunoSenha123', PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT INTO users (name, email, password, role)
            VALUES ('Marcos Aluno', 'marcos@teste.com', '{$hash}', 'user')
        ");

        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('VALID_CSRF_TOKEN');

        $sessionValues = [];
        $sessionMock->method('set')->willReturnCallback(function ($key, $val) use (&$sessionValues) {
            $sessionValues[$key] = $val;
        });

        $controller = new StudentAuthController($sessionMock, $this->pdo);

        // Tentativa inválida (senha errada)
        $invalidReq = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'VALID_CSRF_TOKEN',
            'email'      => 'marcos@teste.com',
            'password'   => 'senhaErrada',
        ]);
        $responseFail = $controller->authenticate($invalidReq);
        $this->assertSame(302, $responseFail->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/login', $responseFail->getHeader('Location'));
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('academy_student_id', $sessionValues);

        // Tentativa válida
        $validReq = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'VALID_CSRF_TOKEN',
            'email'      => 'marcos@teste.com',
            'password'   => 'alunoSenha123',
        ]);
        $responseSuccess = $controller->authenticate($validReq);
        $this->assertSame(302, $responseSuccess->getStatusCode());

    public function testRouteBoundaryGuardStrictlyRestrictsAdminWorkspace(): void
    {
        $guard = new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\RouteBoundaryGuard();
        $viewResponse = new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse('content', true);

        // Rotas administrativas autorizadas para envelope
        $this->assertTrue($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/admin', $viewResponse));
        $this->assertTrue($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/admin/settings', $viewResponse));
        $this->assertTrue($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/admin/academy', $viewResponse));

        // Rotas públicas e de alunos NUNCA podem ser envolvidas pelo admin workspace
        $this->assertFalse($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/aluno/login', $viewResponse));
        $this->assertFalse($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/aluno/cadastro', $viewResponse));
        $this->assertFalse($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/aluno/painel', $viewResponse));
        $this->assertFalse($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/cursos', $viewResponse));
        $this->assertFalse($guard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace('/', $viewResponse));
    }

    public function testStudentAuthFormsRenderAsStandaloneHtml5Documents(): void
    {

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/StudentAuthIsolationTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentAuthService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class StudentAuthIsolationTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testStudentLogoutDoesNotPurgeAdminGlobalSession(): void
    {
        $sessionData = [
            'user_id'            => 1,
            'user_name'          => 'Admin Master',
            'user_role'          => 'admin',
            'user_email'         => 'admin@master.com',
            'academy_student_id' => 77,
            'academy_student_name' => 'Aluno Teste',
        ];

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key, mixed $default = null) use (&$sessionData) {
            return $sessionData[$key] ?? $default;
        });
        $session->method('has')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key) use (&$sessionData) {
            return isset($sessionData[$key]);
        });
        $session->method('set')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key, mixed $val) use (&$sessionData) {
            $sessionData[$key] = $val;
        });
        $session->method('remove')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key) use (&$sessionData) {
            unset($sessionData[$key]);
        });
        $session->expects($this->once())->method('regenerate')->with(false);

        $auth = new StudentAuthService($session);

        $this->assertSame(77, $auth->getStudentId());

        $auth->logout();

        // As chaves de aluno devem ter sido removidas
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('academy_student_id', $sessionData);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('academy_student_name', $sessionData);
        $this->assertTrue($sessionData['academy_logged_out']);

        // A sessão do Administrador DEVE permanecer intacta!
        $this->assertSame(1, $sessionData['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame('Admin Master', $sessionData['user_name']);
        $this->assertSame('admin', $sessionData['user_role']);
        $this->assertSame('admin@master.com', $sessionData['user_email']);
    }

    public function testGlobalUserSessionDoesNotAuthenticateAcademyStudent(): void
    {
        $sessionData = [
            'user_id'    => 10,
            'user_role'  => 'user',
            'user_name'  => 'Usuário comum do OS',
            'user_email' => 'comum@dominio.com',
        ];

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key, mixed $default = null) use (&$sessionData) {
            return $sessionData[$key] ?? $default;
        });

        $auth = new StudentAuthService($session);

        $this->assertNull($auth->getStudentId());
        $this->assertNull($auth->getStudentName());
        $this->assertNull($auth->getStudentEmail());
        $this->assertFalse($auth->isLoggedIn());
    }

    public function testStudentLogoutPreservesGlobalUserSession(): void
    {
        $sessionData = [
            'academy_student_id'   => 45,
            'academy_student_name' => 'Aluno Ativo',
            'user_id'              => 88,
            'user_role'            => 'user',
            'user_name'            => 'Usuário Site',
            'is_authenticated'     => true,
        ];

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key, mixed $default = null) use (&$sessionData) {
            return $sessionData[$key] ?? $default;
        });
        $session->method('remove')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key) use (&$sessionData) {
            unset($sessionData[$key]);
        });
        $session->method('set')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key, mixed $val) use (&$sessionData) {
            $sessionData[$key] = $val;
        });

        $auth = new StudentAuthService($session);
        $auth->logout();

        // Aluno deslogado
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('academy_student_id', $sessionData);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('academy_student_name', $sessionData);
        $this->assertTrue($sessionData['academy_logged_out']);

        // Sessão do usuário comum preservada
        $this->assertSame(88, $sessionData['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame('user', $sessionData['user_role']);
        $this->assertSame('Usuário Site', $sessionData['user_name']);
        $this->assertTrue($sessionData['is_authenticated']);
    }

    public function testInvalidStudentIdThrowsExceptionOnLogin(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(\InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $auth = new StudentAuthService($session);
        $auth->login(0, 'Aluno', 'aluno@teste.com');
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/StudentCredentialRepositoryTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\DTO\StudentCredential;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoStudentCredentialRepository;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class StudentCredentialRepositoryTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoStudentCredentialRepository $repo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                username TEXT NULL UNIQUE,
                email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $this->repo = new PdoStudentCredentialRepository($this->pdo);
    }

    public function testCreateStudentAndFindByEmailAndUsername(): void
    {
        $hash = password_hash('segredo123', PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
        $id = $this->repo->createStudent('Ana Silva', 'anasilva', 'ana@silva.com', $hash);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $id);

        $byEmail = $this->repo->findByEmail('ANA@SILVA.COM');
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StudentCredential::class, $byEmail);
        $this->assertSame($id, $byEmail->id);
        $this->assertSame('Ana Silva', $byEmail->name);
        $this->assertSame('anasilva', $byEmail->username);
        $this->assertSame('active', $byEmail->status);
        $this->assertTrue(password_verify('segredo123', $byEmail->passwordHash));

        $byUsername = $this->repo->findByUsername('ANASILVA');
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StudentCredential::class, $byUsername);
        $this->assertSame($id, $byUsername->id);
    }

    public function testReturnsNullWhenNotFound(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($this->repo->findByEmail('inexistente@email.com'));
        $this->assertNull($this->repo->findByUsername('usuario_fantasma'));
    }
}

        $pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                username VARCHAR(100) NULL,
                email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

                profile_image VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                theme_color VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'default',
                dashboard_layout TEXT NULL,
                two_factor_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'none',
                two_factor_secret VARCHAR(255) NULL,

                email_2fa_expiry DATETIME NULL,

        ");

    public function testUserRepositoryPaginationFilteringAndStatus(): void
    {
        $repo = $this->createInMemoryUserRepository();

        $repo->createUser(['name' => 'Admin Boss', 'email' => 'admin@test.com', 'password' => 'secret', 'role' => 'admin', 'status' => 'active']);
        $repo->createUser(['name' => 'Aluno Carlos', 'email' => 'carlos@test.com', 'password' => 'secret', 'role' => 'user', 'status' => 'active']);
        $repo->createUser(['name' => 'Aluna Maria', 'email' => 'maria@test.com', 'password' => 'secret', 'role' => 'user', 'status' => 'suspended']);
        $repo->createUser(['name' => 'Troll Banido', 'email' => 'troll@test.com', 'password' => 'secret', 'role' => 'user', 'status' => 'banned']);

        // 1. Testa contagem total e por grupo
        $totalAll = $repo->countUsers();
        $this->assertSame(4, $totalAll);

        $totalStudents = $repo->countUsers('students_group');
        $this->assertSame(3, $totalStudents);

        $totalAdmins = $repo->countUsers('admins_group');
        $this->assertSame(1, $totalAdmins);

        // 2. Testa busca por termo
        $searchCarlos = $repo->getPaginatedUsers(1, 10, null, 'carlos');
        $this->assertCount(1, $searchCarlos);
        $this->assertSame('Aluno Carlos', $searchCarlos[0]['name']);

        // 3. Testa filtro por status
        $banned = $repo->getPaginatedUsers(1, 10, null, null, 'banned');
        $this->assertCount(1, $banned);
        $this->assertSame('Troll Banido', $banned[0]['name']);

        // 4. Testa alteração de status
        $repo->updateStatus((int)$searchCarlos[0]['id'], 'suspended');
        $updated = $repo->findById((int)$searchCarlos[0]['id']);
        $this->assertSame('suspended', $updated['status']);
    }

    public function testStudentAdminServiceConsolidatesEnrollmentsAndMetrics(): void

    public function testAcademyAdminMenuIncludesSubmenu(): void
    {
        $pluginPath = dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/src/Plugins/academy';
        $plugin = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Plugin($pluginPath);
        $runtime = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface::class);

        $hookCallback = null;
        $runtime->method('onHook')->willReturnCallback(function ($hook, $cb) use (&$hookCallback) {
            if ($hook === 'admin.menu') {
                $hookCallback = $cb;
            }
        });

        $plugin->osBoot($runtime);
        $this->assertNotNull($hookCallback);

        $menu = $hookCallback([], 'admin');
        $this->assertCount(1, $menu);
        $this->assertSame('Academy (Cursos)', $menu[0]['title']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('submenu', $menu[0]);
        $this->assertCount(2, $menu[0]['submenu']);
        $this->assertSame('Cursos & Aulas', $menu[0]['submenu'][0]['title']);
        $this->assertSame('Alunos & Matrículas', $menu[0]['submenu'][1]['title']);
        $this->assertSame('/admin/academy/students', $menu[0]['submenu'][1]['url']);
    }

    public function testStudentAdminRepositoryResilienceWithLegacyTableWithoutUsernameOrStatus(): void
    {
        $pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        // Cria tabela legada de users SEM username e SEM status
        $pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                role VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'student',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $pdo->exec("INSERT INTO users (name, email, password, role) VALUES ('Legacy Student', 'legacy@test.com', 'hash', 'student')");

        $repo = new PdoStudentAdminRepository($pdo);
        $students = $repo->getPaginatedStudents(1, 20);

        $this->assertCount(1, $students);
        $this->assertSame('Legacy Student', $students[0]['name']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('username', $students[0]);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('status', $students[0]);
        $this->assertSame(1, $repo->countStudents());

        // Testar busca
        $searchResult = $repo->getPaginatedStudents(1, 20, 'Legacy');
        $this->assertCount(1, $searchResult);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/StylableContractsFoundationTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\ColorContractInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\DimensionContractInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\ColorValue;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\CssUnit;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values\DimensionValue;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class StylableContractsFoundationTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCssUnitEnumSupportsAllModernUnits(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('px', CssUnit::PX->value);
        $this->assertSame('%', CssUnit::PERCENT->value);
        $this->assertSame('vh', CssUnit::VH->value);
        $this->assertSame('vw', CssUnit::VW->value);
        $this->assertSame('rem', CssUnit::REM->value);
        $this->assertSame('em', CssUnit::EM->value);
        $this->assertSame('cm', CssUnit::CM->value);
        $this->assertSame('mm', CssUnit::MM->value);
        $this->assertSame('pt', CssUnit::PT->value);
        $this->assertSame('auto', CssUnit::AUTO->value);
        $this->assertSame('fit-content', CssUnit::FIT_CONTENT->value);

        $this->assertTrue(CssUnit::PX->isNumeric());
        $this->assertTrue(CssUnit::PERCENT->isNumeric());
        $this->assertTrue(CssUnit::VH->isNumeric());
        $this->assertFalse(CssUnit::AUTO->isNumeric());
        $this->assertFalse(CssUnit::FIT_CONTENT->isNumeric());

        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::VH, CssUnit::tryFromString('vh'));
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::PERCENT, CssUnit::tryFromString('%'));
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::CM, CssUnit::tryFromString('CM'));
        $this->assertNull(CssUnit::tryFromString('invalid_unit'));
    }

    public function testDimensionValueCreationAndParsing(): void
    {
        // 1. Factory methods
        $d1 = DimensionValue::px(24);
        $this->assertSame(24.0, $d1->getAmount());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::PX, $d1->getUnit());
        $this->assertSame('24px', $d1->toCss());

        $d2 = DimensionValue::percent(50.5);
        $this->assertSame('50.5%', $d2->toCss());

        $d3 = DimensionValue::vh(100);
        $this->assertSame('100vh', $d3->toCss());

        $d4 = DimensionValue::cm(2.5);
        $this->assertSame('2.5cm', $d4->toCss());

        $d5 = DimensionValue::auto();
        $this->assertSame('auto', $d5->toCss());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::AUTO, $d5->getUnit());

        // 2. String parsing
        $p1 = DimensionValue::fromString('100vh');
        $this->assertSame(100.0, $p1->getAmount());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::VH, $p1->getUnit());
        $this->assertSame('100vh', (string)$p1);

        $p2 = DimensionValue::fromString('75%');
        $this->assertSame(75.0, $p2->getAmount());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::PERCENT, $p2->getUnit());

        $p3 = DimensionValue::fromString('3.2rem');
        $this->assertSame(3.2, $p3->getAmount());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::REM, $p3->getUnit());

        $p4 = DimensionValue::fromString('15cm');
        $this->assertSame(15.0, $p4->getAmount());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::CM, $p4->getUnit());

        $p5 = DimensionValue::fromString('auto');
        $this->assertSame('auto', $p5->toCss());

        $p6 = DimensionValue::fromString('fit-content');
        $this->assertSame('fit-content', $p6->toCss());

        // Sem unidade definida: assume px
        $p7 = DimensionValue::fromString('32');
        $this->assertSame('32px', $p7->toCss());
        $this->assertSame(CssUnit::PX, $p7->getUnit());

        // Vazio ou zero
        $p8 = DimensionValue::fromString('');
        $this->assertSame('0px', $p8->toCss());

        // Serialização JSON
        $json = json_encode($p1);
        $this->assertIsString($json);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('"amount":100', $json);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('"unit":"vh"', $json);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('"css":"100vh"', $json);
    }

    public function testDimensionValueThrowsOnInvalidString(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        DimensionValue::fromString('invalid_dimension_xyz');
    }

    public function testColorValueTokenFirstAndTypes(): void
    {
        // 1. Design Token
        $c1 = ColorValue::fromToken('primary');
        $this->assertTrue($c1->isToken());
        $this->assertSame('primary', $c1->getTokenName());
        $this->assertSame('var(--primary)', $c1->toCss());

        // Limpeza de var(--) se passado bruto
        $c1b = ColorValue::fromToken('var(--secondary)');
        $this->assertSame('secondary', $c1b->getTokenName());
        $this->assertSame('var(--secondary)', $c1b->toCss());

        // 2. Hexadecimal
        $c2 = ColorValue::fromHex('#45f3ff');
        $this->assertSame(ColorValue::TYPE_HEX, $c2->getType());
        $this->assertFalse($c2->isToken());
        $this->assertSame('#45f3ff', $c2->toCss());

        // 3. RGBA
        $c3 = ColorValue::fromRgba(69, 243, 255, 0.5);
        $this->assertSame(ColorValue::TYPE_RGB, $c3->getType());
        $this->assertSame('rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.5)', $c3->toCss());

        // 4. Transparente
        $c4 = ColorValue::transparent();
        $this->assertSame(ColorValue::TYPE_TRANSPARENT, $c4->getType());
        $this->assertSame('transparent', $c4->toCss());

        // 5. Gradiente
        $c5 = ColorValue::fromGradient('linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary))');
        $this->assertSame(ColorValue::TYPE_GRADIENT, $c5->getType());
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('linear-gradient(', $c5->toCss());

        // 6. Parse automático via fromString
        $autoToken = ColorValue::fromString('var(--tertiary)');
        $this->assertTrue($autoToken->isToken());
        $this->assertSame('tertiary', $autoToken->getTokenName());

        $autoTokenName = ColorValue::fromString('background');
        $this->assertTrue($autoTokenName->isToken());
        $this->assertSame('var(--background)', $autoTokenName->toCss());

        $autoHex = ColorValue::fromString('#0b0c10');
        $this->assertSame('#0b0c10', $autoHex->toCss());

        $autoTransparent = ColorValue::fromString('transparent');
        $this->assertSame('transparent', $autoTransparent->toCss());

        $autoRgba = ColorValue::fromString('rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)');
        $this->assertSame('rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', $autoRgba->toCss());
    }

    public function testColorValueThrowsOnInvalidInputs(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        ColorValue::fromString('invalid_color_value_alert()');
    }

    public function testStylableElementContractComposition(): void
    {
        // Criação de classe anônima mockando um elemento estilizável que implementa o contrato mestre
        $element = new class implements StylableElementInterface {
            public function getBackgroundColor(): ?ColorValue
            {
                return ColorValue::fromToken('primary');
            }

            public function getTextColor(): ?ColorValue
            {
                return ColorValue::fromToken('text_main');
            }

            public function getHeadingColor(): ?ColorValue
            {
                return ColorValue::fromToken('color-primary');
            }

            public function getLinkColor(): ?ColorValue
            {
                return ColorValue::fromToken('color-secondary');
            }

            public function getLinkHoverColor(): ?ColorValue
            {
                return ColorValue::fromToken('color-tertiary');
            }

            public function getBorderColor(): ?ColorValue
            {
                return ColorValue::fromHex('#ffffff');
            }

            public function getFontFamily(): ?string
            {
                return 'var(--font-primary)';
            }

            public function getFontSize(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::rem(1.2);
            }

            public function getFontWeight(): ?string
            {
                return '700';
            }

            public function getLineHeight(): ?string
            {
                return '1.5';
            }

            public function getLetterSpacing(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::px(0);
            }

            public function getTextTransform(): ?string
            {
                return 'none';
            }

            public function getTextAlign(): ?string
            {
                return 'left';
            }

            public function getWidth(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::percent(100);
            }

            public function getMaxWidth(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::px(1200);
            }

            public function getHeight(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::vh(80);
            }

            public function getMinHeight(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return null;
            }

            public function getBorderStyle(): ?string
            {
                return 'solid';
            }

            public function getBorderWidth(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::px(2);
            }

            public function getBorderRadius(): ?DimensionValue
            {
                return DimensionValue::px(8);
            }

            public function getShadowPreset(): string
            {
                return 'glow_primary';
            }

            public function getBoxShadowCss(): ?string
            {
                return '0 0 15px var(--primary)';
            }

            public function getHoverEffect(): ?string
            {
                return 'lift';
            }

            public function getEntranceAnimation(): ?string
            {
                return 'fadeIn';
            }

            public function getTransitionDuration(): ?string
            {
                return '0.3s';
            }

            public function getTimingFunction(): ?string
            {
                return 'ease';
            }

            public function getStyleProperties(): array
            {
                return [
                    'background' => $this->getBackgroundColor()?->toCss(),
                    'color'      => $this->getTextColor()?->toCss(),
                    'width'      => $this->getWidth()?->toCss(),
                    'max_width'  => $this->getMaxWidth()?->toCss(),
                    'height'     => $this->getHeight()?->toCss(),
                    'border'     => '2px solid #ffffff',
                    'box_shadow' => $this->getBoxShadowCss(),
                    'hover'      => $this->getHoverEffect(),
                ];
            }
        };

        $this->assertInstanceOf(StylableElementInterface::class, $element);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ColorContractInterface::class, $element);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DimensionContractInterface::class, $element);

        $styles = $element->getStyleProperties();
        $this->assertSame('var(--primary)', $styles['background']);
        $this->assertSame('var(--text_main)', $styles['color']);
        $this->assertSame('100%', $styles['width']);
        $this->assertSame('1200px', $styles['max_width']);
        $this->assertSame('80vh', $styles['height']);
        $this->assertSame('lift', $styles['hover']);
        $this->assertSame('var(--color-primary)', $element->getHeadingColor()?->toCss());
        $this->assertSame('var(--color-secondary)', $element->getLinkColor()?->toCss());
        $this->assertSame('var(--color-tertiary)', $element->getLinkHoverColor()?->toCss());
        $this->assertSame('var(--font-primary)', $element->getFontFamily());
        $this->assertSame('1.2rem', $element->getFontSize()?->toCss());
        $this->assertSame('700', $element->getFontWeight());
    }

    public function testGlobalColorTokensAndContainerTypographyCascading(): void
    {
        $styleRenderer = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer();
        $gridRenderer = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid\LayoutGridRenderer(null, $styleRenderer);
        $headingBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\HeadingBlock($styleRenderer);
        $paragraphBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\ParagraphBlock(null, $styleRenderer);
        $logoBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\LogoBlock(null, null, $styleRenderer);
        $copyrightBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\CopyrightBlock(null, $styleRenderer);
        $postCardsBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\PostCardsGridBlock(null, $styleRenderer);

        // 1. Verifica contrato StylableElementInterface em todos os blocos de texto
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StylableElementInterface::class, $headingBlock);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StylableElementInterface::class, $paragraphBlock);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StylableElementInterface::class, $logoBlock);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StylableElementInterface::class, $copyrightBlock);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(StylableElementInterface::class, $postCardsBlock);

        // 2. Verifica seleção de cores Primária, Secundária e Terciária nos blocos
        $hHtml = $headingBlock->render([
            'text'           => 'Título Terciário',
            'level'          => 'h2',
            'text_color'     => 'var(--color-tertiary)',
            'font_family'    => 'tertiary',
            'font_weight'    => '900',
            'letter_spacing' => '2px',
            'text_transform' => 'uppercase',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('color: var(--color-tertiary)', $hHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-family: var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)', $hHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-weight: 900', $hHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('letter-spacing: 2px', $hHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('text-transform: uppercase', $hHtml);
        $this->assertSame('var(--color-tertiary)', $headingBlock->getTextColor()?->toCss());

        $pHtml = $paragraphBlock->render([
            'text'       => 'Parágrafo com cor secundária',
            'text_color' => 'var(--color-secondary)',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('color: var(--color-secondary)', $pHtml);

        $logoHtml = $logoBlock->render([
            'brand_text' => 'MinhaMarca',
            'text_color' => 'var(--color-primary)',
            'font_size'  => '2rem',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('color: var(--color-primary)', $logoHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-size: 2rem', $logoHtml);

        $copyHtml = $copyrightBlock->render([
            'site_name'  => 'DomainSystem',
            'text_color' => 'var(--color-primary)',
            'link_color' => 'var(--color-tertiary)',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('color: var(--color-primary)', $copyHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('color: var(--color-tertiary)', $copyHtml);

        // 3. Verifica ElementStyleRenderer gerando variáveis locais de cascata para qualquer bloco
        $elemStyle = $styleRenderer->renderStyleString([
            'text_color'       => 'var(--color-primary)',
            'heading_color'    => 'var(--color-secondary)',
            'link_color'       => 'var(--color-tertiary)',
            'link_hover_color' => '#ffffff',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('color: var(--color-primary)', $elemStyle);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-text-color: var(--color-primary)', $elemStyle);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-heading-color: var(--color-secondary)', $elemStyle);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-link-color: var(--color-tertiary)', $elemStyle);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-link-hover-color: #ffffff', $elemStyle);

        // 4. Verifica cascata de cores tipográficas no Container / Seção (LayoutGridRenderer)
        $sectionHtml = $gridRenderer->renderSection('1_col', [$hHtml . $pHtml], [
            'text_color'       => 'var(--color-text-main)',
            'heading_color'    => 'var(--color-primary)',
            'link_color'       => 'var(--color-tertiary)',
            'link_hover_color' => 'var(--color-secondary)',
            'font_family'      => 'tertiary',
            'text_transform'   => 'capitalize',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-text-color: var(--color-text-main);', $sectionHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-heading-color: var(--color-primary);', $sectionHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--ds-local-link-color: var(--color-tertiary);', $sectionHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-family: var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif);', $sectionHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('text-transform: capitalize;', $sectionHtml);
    }
}

<?php

    public function testRegistryCanRegisterAndRetrieveSvgIcons(): void
    {
        $registry = new SvgIconRegistry();
        
        $this->assertFalse($registry->has('bluesky'));
        $this->assertNull($registry->getSvg('bluesky'));

        $registry->register(
            'bluesky',
            '0 0 24 24',
            '<path d="M12 10.8c-1.087-2.114-4.046-6.053-6.798-7.995C2.566 1.01 0 1.886 0 5.485c0 1.205.284 6.84 0.448 7.643.518 2.535 2.87 3.336 4.757 3.037-3.056 1.63-3.67 4.26-1.577 6.137 2.656 2.38 6.757-1.164 8.372-5.402 1.615 4.238 5.716 7.782 8.372 5.402 2.093-1.877 1.479-4.507-1.577-6.137 1.887.299 4.239-.502 4.757-3.037.164-.803.448-6.438.448-7.643 0-3.599-2.566-4.475-5.202-2.68C16.046 4.747 13.087 8.686 12 10.8z"/>',
            '#0085ff',
            'Bluesky'
        );

        $this->assertTrue($registry->has('bluesky'));
        $this->assertSame('Bluesky', $registry->getLabel('bluesky'));
        $this->assertSame('#0085ff', $registry->getBrandColor('bluesky'));

        $svg = $registry->getSvg('bluesky', [
            'width'  => '32',
            'height' => '32',
            'fill'   => '#0085ff',
        ]);

        $this->assertNotNull($svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<svg', $svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('width="32"', $svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('height="32"', $svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('fill="#0085ff"', $svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('viewBox="0 0 24 24"', $svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('aria-hidden="true"', $svg);
    }

    public function testSocialIconsBlockShapesAndHoverMicroInteractions(): void
    {
        $block = new SocialIconsBlock();

        // 1. Square shape + grow animation
        $htmlSquare = $block->render([
            'networks' => [
                ['network' => 'github', 'url' => 'https://github.com/empresa'],
            ],
            'shape'           => 'square',
            'hover_animation' => 'grow',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('border-radius: 0px', $htmlSquare);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-btn-grow', $htmlSquare);

        // 2. Minimal shape (no background, icon colored with brand color)
        $htmlMinimal = $block->render([
            'networks' => [
                ['network' => 'youtube', 'url' => 'https://youtube.com'],
            ],
            'shape'           => 'minimal',
            'color_mode'      => 'official',
            'hover_animation' => 'bounce',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('background: transparent', $htmlMinimal);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('fill="#FF0000"', $htmlMinimal); // YouTube red
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-btn-bounce', $htmlMinimal);

        // 3. Glow animation
        $htmlGlow = $block->render([
            'networks' => [
                ['network' => 'telegram', 'url' => 'https://t.me/empresa'],
            ],
            'hover_animation' => 'glow',
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-btn-glow', $htmlGlow);
    }

    public function testSocialIconsBlockHandlesLegacyArrayFormatAndEmptySafely(): void
    {
        $block = new SocialIconsBlock();

        // Legacy associative array format
        $htmlLegacy = $block->render([
            'networks' => [
                'github' => 'https://github.com/myuser',
                'x'      => 'https://x.com/myuser',
            ],
        ]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://github.com/myuser', $htmlLegacy);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://x.com/myuser', $htmlLegacy);

        // Empty returns empty string
        $htmlEmpty = $block->render([
            'networks' => [],
        ]);
        $this->assertSame('', $htmlEmpty);

        // Unknown network falls back to website icon
        $htmlUnknown = $block->render([
            'networks' => [
                ['network' => 'unknown_social_network', 'url' => 'https://unknown.com'],
            ],
        ]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<svg', $htmlUnknown);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://unknown.com', $htmlUnknown);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ThemeActivationTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeActivator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemAdmin\Controllers\AdminController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\PluginManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;

class ThemeActivationTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempConfigDir;
    private array $originalEnv;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->originalEnv = [
            'ACTIVE_THEME' => getenv('ACTIVE_THEME') ?: null,
            'SITE_STATUS'  => getenv('SITE_STATUS') ?: null,
        ];
        $this->tempConfigDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp/test_themes_' . uniqid();
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/config', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_alpha', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_beta', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/default', 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_alpha/theme.json', json_encode(['name' => 'Tema Alpha']));
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_beta/theme.json', json_encode(['name' => 'Tema Beta']));
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/default/theme.json', json_encode(['name' => 'Default']));
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if ($this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME'] !== null) {
            putenv("ACTIVE_THEME={$this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME']}");
            $_ENV['ACTIVE_THEME'] = $this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME'];
        } else {
            putenv('ACTIVE_THEME');
            unset($_ENV['ACTIVE_THEME']);
        }
        if ($this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS'] !== null) {
            putenv("SITE_STATUS={$this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS']}");
            $_ENV['SITE_STATUS'] = $this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS'];
        } else {
            putenv('SITE_STATUS');
            unset($_ENV['SITE_STATUS']);
        }
        $this->recursiveDelete($this->tempConfigDir);
    }

    private function recursiveDelete(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $p = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            is_dir($p) ? $this->recursiveDelete($p) : @unlink($p);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testSafeThemeResolverDiscoversThemesInMultipleRoots(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);

        $this->assertTrue($resolver->themeExists('tema_alpha'));
        $this->assertTrue($resolver->themeExists('tema_beta'));
        $this->assertTrue($resolver->themeExists('default'));
        $this->assertFalse($resolver->themeExists('tema_fantasma'));

        $pathAlpha = $resolver->resolveThemePath('tema_alpha');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('tema_alpha', $pathAlpha);

        $pathDefault = $resolver->resolveThemePath('default');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('default', $pathDefault);

        // Fallback resiliente quando solicitado tema inexistente
        $fallback = $resolver->resolveThemePath('inexistente');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('default', $fallback);
    }

    public function testThemeActivatorActivatesExistingThemeAndPersistsState(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);

        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);

        // Estado inicial
        $this->assertEquals('default', $activator->getActiveTheme());

        // Ativa tema_beta
        $result = $activator->activate('tema_beta');
        $this->assertTrue($result['success']);
        $this->assertEquals('tema_beta', $result['theme']);

        // Verifica persistência
        $this->assertEquals('tema_beta', $activator->getActiveTheme());

        $configFile = $this->tempConfigDir . '/config/active_theme.json';
        $this->assertFileExists($configFile);

        $saved = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
        $this->assertEquals('tema_beta', $saved['active_theme']);
        $this->assertEquals('live', $saved['status']);
    }

    public function testThemeActivatorRejectsNonexistentTheme(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);

        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);
        $result = $activator->activate('tema_fantasma');

        $this->assertFalse($result['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('não foi encontrado', $result['message']);
    }

    public function testEnvSiteStateReadsThemeFromActiveThemeJson(): void
    {
        $configFile = $this->tempConfigDir . '/config/active_theme.json';
        file_put_contents($configFile, json_encode([
            'active_theme' => 'tema_alpha',
            'status' => 'live'
        ]));

        $siteState = new EnvSiteState(null, null, $this->tempConfigDir);

        $this->assertEquals('tema_alpha', $siteState->getActiveTheme());
        $this->assertTrue($siteState->isLive());
        $this->assertFalse($siteState->isComingSoon());
    }

    public function testAdminControllerActivateThemeEndpoint(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);
        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);

        $pluginManager = $this->createMock(PluginManager::class);
        $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $shortcodes = $this->createMock(ShortcodeManager::class);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);

        $session->expects($this->once())
            ->method('setFlash')
            ->with('success', $this->stringContains('tema_alpha'));

        $controller = new AdminController($pluginManager, $themeManager, $shortcodes, $dispatcher, $session, $activator);

        $request = new Request([], ['theme_folder' => 'tema_alpha'], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']);
        $response = $controller->activateTheme($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::class, $response);
        $this->assertEquals('tema_alpha', $activator->getActiveTheme());
    }

    public function testAdminControllerPreviewThemeRendersRequestedTheme(): void
    {
        // 1. Cria index.php específico para tema_alpha e tema_beta
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_alpha/index.php', '<h1>Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Alpha</h1>');
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_beta/index.php', '<h1>Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Beta</h1>');

        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);
        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);
        
        // Define tema_beta como ATIVO
        $activator->activate('tema_beta');

        $pluginManager = $this->createMock(PluginManager::class);
        $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $shortcodes = $this->createMock(ShortcodeManager::class);
        $shortcodes->method('parse')->willReturnArgument(0);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_teste_123');

        $controller = new AdminController($pluginManager, $themeManager, $shortcodes, $dispatcher, $session, $activator);

        // 2. Solicita preview de tema_alpha (que NÃO está ativo)
        $request = new Request(['theme' => 'tema_alpha']);
        $response = $controller->previewTheme($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::class, $response);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        
        $body = $response->getContent();
        // Deve renderizar tema_alpha, NUNCA tema_beta
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Alpha', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Beta', $body);
        
        // Deve conter a barra de preview com o botão de ativação
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-preview-topbar', $body);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('tema_alpha', $body);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Ativar este Tema', $body);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemeDiscoveryService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ThemeDiscoveryServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_theme_discovery_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/themes/rachidd', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/themes/admin', 0755, true); // deve ser ignorado
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/config', 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($this->tempDir . '/themes/rachidd/theme.json', json_encode([
            'name' => 'Rachid Theme Pro',
        ]));

        file_put_contents($this->tempDir . '/config/active_theme.json', json_encode([
            'active' => 'rachidd',
        ]));
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . '/' . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testGetAvailableThemesDiscoversThemesAndSkipsAdmin(): void
    {
        $service = new ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $themes = $service->getAvailableThemes();

        $this->assertCount(1, $themes);
        $this->assertSame('rachidd', $themes[0]['folder']);
        $this->assertSame('Rachid Theme Pro', $themes[0]['name']);
    }

    public function testGetActiveThemeFolderResolvesConfiguredTheme(): void
    {
        $service = new ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $this->assertSame('rachidd', $service->getActiveThemeFolder());
    }

    public function testGetActiveThemeFolderReturnsDefaultWhenMissing(): void
    {
        @unlink($this->tempDir . '/config/active_theme.json');
        $service = new ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $this->assertSame('default', $service->getActiveThemeFolder());
    }
}

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use Exception;

class ThemeManagerTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $dummyThemePath = __DIR__ . '/../UI/dummy_theme';

    public function testRenderTemplate()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);

        // Rendering 'index' passing variables
        $html = $themeManager->render('index', [
            'title' => 'Test Title',
            'content' => 'Test Content'
        ]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<header>Header: Test Title</header>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<main>Content: Test Content</main>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<footer>Footer</footer>', $html);
    }

    public function testFallbackTemplate()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);

        // Try to render a non-existent template, it should look for index.php as fallback
        // Or throw exception depending on design. Let's make it throw exception if not found, 
        // but render has a strict mode and fallback mode. We'll stick to simple file inclusion for now.
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $themeManager->render('non_existent');
    }

    public function testGetHeaderFunction()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);
        
        ob_start();
        $themeManager->get_header(['title' => 'Header Only']);
        $html = ob_get_clean();
        
        $this->assertEquals('<header>Header: Header Only</header>', trim($html));
    }

    public function testGetFooterFunction()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);
        
        ob_start();
        $themeManager->get_footer();
        $html = ob_get_clean();
        
        $this->assertEquals('<footer>Footer</footer>', trim($html));
    }
}

    public function testSavePartPersistsAndUpdatesAssociations(): void
    {
        $payload = [
            'id'                  => 'header_novo_123',
            'type'                => 'header',
            'title'               => 'Header Teste Ajax',
            'layout_preset'       => '3_cols_header',
            'container_settings'  => ['max_width' => '1200px'],
            'columns_data'        => [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'DomainSystem']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Bem-vindo', 'level' => 'h2']]],
            ],
            'mobile_toggle_style' => MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_MINIMAL,
            'is_default'          => true,
            'assigned_theme'      => 'default',
        ];

        $request = new Request([], $payload, ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/builder/save-part']);
        $response = $this->controller->savePart($request);

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data['success']);
        $this->assertSame('header_novo_123', $data['id']);

        // Verifica se persistiu no repositório
        $saved = $this->partRepo->findById('header_novo_123');
        $this->assertNotNull($saved);
        $this->assertSame('Header Teste Ajax', $saved->getTitle());
        $this->assertSame(MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_MINIMAL, $saved->getMobileToggleStyle());

        // Verifica se associou como padrão global e ao tema default
        $this->assertSame('header_novo_123', $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault('header'));
        $this->assertSame('header_novo_123', $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId('default', 'header'));
    }

    public function testDeletePartRemovesFromRepository(): void

            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/admin/builder/delete-part',
            'HTTP_ACCEPT'    => 'application/json',

    }

    public function testAssignPartUpdatesThemeAndGlobal(): void
    {
        $request = new Request([], [
            'theme_folder' => 'default',
            'part_type'    => 'header',
            'part_id'      => 'h_assigned_1',
            'is_global'    => false,
        ], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',
            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/admin/builder/assign',
            'HTTP_ACCEPT'    => 'application/json',
        ]);

        $response = $this->controller->assign($request);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame('h_assigned_1', $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId('default', 'header'));

        // Testa definir como padrão global
        $requestGlobal = new Request([], [
            'part_type' => 'footer',
            'part_id'   => 'f_global_1',
            'is_global' => true,
        ], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',
            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/admin/builder/assign',
            'HTTP_ACCEPT'    => 'application/json',
        ]);

        $this->controller->assign($requestGlobal);
        $this->assertSame('f_global_1', $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault('footer'));
    }
