    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $overrides
     * @return array{updater: CoreUpdater, stateStore: UpdateStateStoreInterface, lock: UpdateLockInterface, maintenance: MaintenanceModeInterface, events: list<string>}
     */
    private function buildHarness(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        $failAtStep = $overrides['failAtStep'] ?? null;
        $autoRollback = $overrides['autoRollback'] ?? true;
        $rollbackFails = $overrides['rollbackFails'] ?? false;
        $dbSupported = $overrides['dbSupported'] ?? true;
        $destructivePlan = $overrides['destructivePlan'] ?? false;
        $preflightBlocks = $overrides['preflightBlocks'] ?? false;
        $initialMaintenance = $overrides['initialMaintenance'] ?? false;

        $stateStore = $overrides['stateStore'] ?? new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $lock = $overrides['lock'] ?? new FileUpdateLock($this->tempDir);
        $dispatchedEvents = [];

        $targetResolver = new class ($this->target) implements UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            public function __construct(private UpdateTarget $t) {}
            public function core(): UpdateTarget { return $this->t; }
            public function plugins(): array { return []; }
        };

        $checker = new class ($this->target, $this->release) implements UpdateCheckerInterface {
            public function __construct(private UpdateTarget $t, private ReleaseInfo $r) {}
            public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult
            {
                return new UpdateCheckResult(UpdateStatus::Available, $this->t, $this->r, [], '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z');
            }
        };

        $releaseSource = new class ($this, $this->release, $this->tempDir, $failAtStep) implements ReleaseSourceInterface {
            public function __construct(
                private CoreUpdaterTest $test,
                private ReleaseInfo $r,
                private string $dir,
                private ?string $failAt,
            ) {}
            public function latest(UpdateTarget $target, ?string $knownEtag = null): ?ReleaseInfo { return $this->r; }
            public function fetchPackage(ReleaseInfo $release, string $destinationDir): DownloadedPackage
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'download';
                if ($this->failAt === 'download') {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha simulada no download.');
                }
                return new DownloadedPackage($release, $this->dir . '/pkg.zip', 1024);
            }
        };

        $verifier = new class ($this, $this->release, $this->manifest, $this->tempDir, $failAtStep) implements UpdatePackageVerifierInterface {
            public function __construct(
                private CoreUpdaterTest $test,
                private ReleaseInfo $r,
                private UpdateManifest $m,
                private string $dir,
                private ?string $failAt,
            ) {}
            public function verify(DownloadedPackage $package): VerifiedPackage
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'verify';
                if ($this->failAt === 'verify') {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha simulada na verificação.');
                }
                return new VerifiedPackage($this->r, $this->m, $this->dir);
            }
        };

        $preflight = new class ($this, $failAtStep, $preflightBlocks) implements PreflightInterface {
            public function __construct(
                private CoreUpdaterTest $test,
                private ?string $failAt,
                private bool $blocks,
            ) {}
            public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): PreflightReport
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'preflight';
                if ($this->failAt === 'preflight' || $this->blocks) {
                    return new PreflightReport([
                        new PreflightCheck('downgrade', CheckLevel::Block, 'Bloqueado no preflight.'),
                    ]);
                }
                return new PreflightReport([
                    new PreflightCheck('ok', CheckLevel::Ok, 'Tudo certo.'),
                ]);
            }
        };

        $schemaPlanner = new class ($this, $destructivePlan) implements SchemaPlannerInterface {
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, private bool $destructive) {}
            public function plan(UpdateManifest $manifest, string $extractedPath): SchemaPlan
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'schema_plan';
                return new SchemaPlan(
                    scope: '__core__',
                    pending: [['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000001_add', 'sha256' => str_repeat('c', 64), 'type' => $this->destructive ? 'destructive' : 'additive']],
                    blocked: [],
                    destructive: $this->destructive,
                    requiresDatabaseBackup: $this->destructive,
                );
            }
        };

        $backup = new class ($this, $this->tempDir, $failAtStep) implements BackupInterface {
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, private string $dir, private ?string $failAt) {}
            public function create(BackupScope $scope, string $label): BackupRecord
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'backup_code';
                if ($this->failAt === 'backup') {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha simulada no backup.');
                }
                return new BackupRecord('bkp-1', $scope, $label, '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z', $this->dir . '/code.zip');
            }
            public function restore(BackupRecord $record): void
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'restore_code';
            }
            public function list(?BackupScope $scope = null): array { return []; }
            public function prune(BackupScope $scope, int $keep): int { return 0; }
        };

        $dbBackup = new class ($this, $this->tempDir, $dbSupported, $rollbackFails) implements DatabaseBackupInterface {
            public function __construct(
                private CoreUpdaterTest $test,
                private string $dir,
                private bool $supported,
                private bool $rbFails,
            ) {}
            public function isSupported(): bool { return $this->supported; }
            public function dump(string $destinationFile): DumpResult
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'backup_db';
                return new DumpResult($this->dir . '/db.dump', 512, 3);
            }
            public function restore(string $dumpFile): void
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'restore_db';
                if ($this->rbFails) {
                    throw new RollbackFailedException('Falha ao restaurar dump do banco.');
                }
            }
        };

        $maintenance = new class ($this, $initialMaintenance, $failAtStep) implements MaintenanceModeInterface {
            private bool $enabled;
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, bool $initial, private ?string $failAt)
            {
                $this->enabled = $initial;
            }
            public function enable(string $message = 'maintenance', ?string $adminBypassToken = null): void
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'maintenance_on';
                if ($this->failAt === 'maintenance') {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha simulada ao ativar manutenção.');
                }
                $this->enabled = true;
            }
            public function disable(): void
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'maintenance_off';
                $this->enabled = false;
            }
            public function isEnabled(): bool { return $this->enabled; }
        };

        $applier = new class ($this, $failAtStep, $rollbackFails) implements UpdateApplierInterface {
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, private ?string $failAt, private bool $rbFails) {}
            public function apply(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target, BackupRecord $backup): ApplyResult
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'apply';
                if ($this->failAt === 'apply') {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha simulada na aplicação de arquivos.');
                }
                return new ApplyResult($backup, ['src/Core/Foo.php'], [], []);
            }
            public function revert(ApplyResult $result): void
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'revert_code';
                if ($this->rbFails) {
                    throw new RollbackFailedException('Falha crítica ao reverter arquivos.');
                }
            }
        };

        $migrator = new class ($this, $failAtStep) implements SchemaMigratorInterface {
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, private ?string $failAt) {}
            public function migrate(SchemaPlan $plan): SchemaResult
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'migrate';
                if ($this->failAt === 'migrate') {
                    return new SchemaResult([], '2026_11_01_000001_add', 'Erro SQL na migration.');
                }
                return new SchemaResult(['2026_11_01_000001_add']);
            }
        };

        $schemaVerifier = new class ($this, $failAtStep) implements SchemaVerifierInterface {
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, private ?string $failAt) {}
            public function verify(UpdateManifest $manifest): SchemaVerification
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'verify_schema';
                if ($this->failAt === 'verify_schema') {
                    return new SchemaVerification(false, [], ['users.id'], []);
                }
                return new SchemaVerification(true);
            }
        };

        $healthCheck = new class ($this, $failAtStep) implements HealthCheckInterface {
            public function __construct(private CoreUpdaterTest $test, private ?string $failAt) {}
            public function run(UpdateTarget $target): HealthReport
            {
                $this->test->callLog[] = 'health_check';
                if ($this->failAt === 'health') {
                    return new HealthReport(false, [new PreflightCheck('core', CheckLevel::Block, 'Falha de saúde.')]);
                }
                return new HealthReport(true, [new PreflightCheck('core', CheckLevel::Ok, 'Saudável.')]);
            }
        };

        $events = new class ($dispatchedEvents) implements EventDispatcherInterface {
            /** @var list<string> */
            public array $names = [];
            public function __construct(array &$ref) { $this->names = &$ref; }
            public function addListener(string $eventName, callable $listener, int $priority = 10): void {}
            public function removeListener(string $eventName, callable $listener): void {}
            public function dispatch(string $eventName, ...$args): void { $this->names[] = $eventName; }
            public function applyFilters(string $filterName, mixed $value, ...$args): mixed { return $value; }
        };

        $notifications = new class implements NotificationManagerInterface {
            public function push(string $message, string $type = 'info', ?string $source = null, array $context = []): void {}
            public function getUnread(): array { return []; }
            public function markAsRead(): void {}
            public function getAll(): array { return []; }
            public function clear(): void {}
        };

        $updater = new CoreUpdater(
            targetResolver: $targetResolver,
            checker: $checker,
            releaseSource: $releaseSource,
            manifestParser: new JsonUpdateManifestParser(),
            packageVerifier: $verifier,
            preflight: $preflight,
            schemaPlanner: $schemaPlanner,
            backup: $backup,
            databaseBackup: $dbBackup,
            maintenanceMode: $maintenance,
            applier: $applier,
            schemaMigrator: $migrator,
            schemaVerifier: $schemaVerifier,
            healthCheck: $healthCheck,
            stateStore: $stateStore,
            lock: $lock,
            tempUpdatesDir: $this->tempDir . '/updates',
            autoRollback: $autoRollback,
            events: $events,
            notifications: $notifications,
        );

        return [
            'updater'     => $updater,
            'stateStore'  => $stateStore,
            'lock'        => $lock,
            'maintenance' => $maintenance,
            'events'      => &$dispatchedEvents,
        ];
    }

    public function testHappyPathExecutesExactStepSequenceAndTwoPhaseHealthCheck(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness();
        $updater = $h['updater'];
        $stateStore = $h['stateStore'];

        $state = $updater->begin($this->target);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Checked, $state->step);
        $id = $state->updateId;

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Downloaded, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Verified, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Preflighted, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::BackedUp, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::MaintenanceOn, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertTrue($h['maintenance']->isEnabled());

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Applied, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Migrated, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::SchemaVerified, $updater->advance($id)->step);

        // Sem health_report no estado, advance() devolve SchemaVerified com awaiting = health
        $awaitingState = $updater->advance($id);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::SchemaVerified, $awaitingState->step);
        $this->assertSame('health', $awaitingState->context['awaiting'] ?? null);

        // Simula requisição GET /admin/settings/updates/core/health gravando o relatório
        $withHealth = $awaitingState->withContext([
            'health_report' => (new HealthReport(true, [new PreflightCheck('core', CheckLevel::Ok, 'OK')]))->toArray(),
        ]);
        $stateStore->save($withHealth);

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::HealthChecked, $updater->advance($id)->step);
        $doneState = $updater->advance($id);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Done, $doneState->step);
        $this->assertFalse($h['maintenance']->isEnabled());

        $this->assertSame([
            'download',
            'verify',
            'preflight',
            'schema_plan',
            'backup_code',
            'backup_db',
            'maintenance_on',
            'apply',
            'migrate',
            'verify_schema',
            'maintenance_off',
        ], $this->callLog);

        $this->assertContains('update.started', $h['events']);
        $this->assertContains('update.step', $h['events']);
        $this->assertContains('update.completed', $h['events']);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $expectedRollbackCalls
     */
    #[DataProvider('failureStepsProvider')]
    public function testFailureInjectedAtEachStepProducesExpectedFinalStateAndRollbackCalls(
        string $failAtStep,
        UpdateStep $expectedFinalStep,
        array $expectedRollbackCalls,
    ): void {
        $h = $this->buildHarness(['failAtStep' => $failAtStep]);
        $updater = $h['updater'];

        $state = $updater->begin($this->target, ['inlineHealthCheck' => true]);
        $id = $state->updateId;

        for ($i = 0; $i < 12; $i++) {
            $state = $updater->advance($id);
            if (in_array($state->step, [UpdateStep::Done, UpdateStep::Failed, UpdateStep::RolledBack], true)) {
                break;
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame($expectedFinalStep, $state->step);
        foreach ($expectedRollbackCalls as $rbCall) {
            $this->assertContains($rbCall, $this->callLog);
        }
        if ($expectedRollbackCalls === []) {
            $this->assertNotContains('revert_code', $this->callLog);
            $this->assertNotContains('restore_db', $this->callLog);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: UpdateStep, 2: list<string>}>
     */
    public static function failureStepsProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            'fail_at_download'      => ['download', UpdateStep::Failed, []],
            'fail_at_verify'        => ['verify', UpdateStep::Failed, []],
            'fail_at_preflight'     => ['preflight', UpdateStep::Failed, []],
            'fail_at_backup'        => ['backup', UpdateStep::Failed, []],
            'fail_at_maintenance'   => ['maintenance', UpdateStep::RolledBack, ['revert_code']],
            'fail_at_apply'         => ['apply', UpdateStep::RolledBack, ['revert_code', 'maintenance_off']],
            'fail_at_migrate'       => ['migrate', UpdateStep::RolledBack, ['revert_code', 'restore_db', 'maintenance_off']],
            'fail_at_verify_schema' => ['verify_schema', UpdateStep::RolledBack, ['revert_code', 'restore_db', 'maintenance_off']],
            'fail_at_health'        => ['health', UpdateStep::RolledBack, ['revert_code', 'restore_db', 'maintenance_off']],
        ];
    }

    public function testAutoRollbackFalseEndsInFailedWithoutReverting(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness([
            'failAtStep'   => 'apply',
            'autoRollback' => false,
        ]);
        $updater = $h['updater'];

        $state = $updater->begin($this->target);
        $id = $state->updateId;

        while (!in_array($state->step, [UpdateStep::Done, UpdateStep::Failed, UpdateStep::RolledBack], true)) {
            $state = $updater->advance($id);
        }

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Failed, $state->step);
        $this->assertNotContains('revert_code', $this->callLog);
        $this->assertFalse($h['maintenance']->isEnabled());
    }

    public function testRollbackFailedExceptionKeepsMaintenanceOnAndTransitionsToFailed(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness([
            'failAtStep'    => 'migrate',
            'rollbackFails' => true,
        ]);
        $updater = $h['updater'];

        $state = $updater->begin($this->target);
        $id = $state->updateId;

        while (!in_array($state->step, [UpdateStep::Done, UpdateStep::Failed, UpdateStep::RolledBack], true)) {
            $state = $updater->advance($id);
        }

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Failed, $state->step);
        $this->assertTrue($h['maintenance']->isEnabled(), 'Manutenção deve permanecer ativa se o rollback falhar.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('php os-cli.php system:rollback', (string)$state->error);
    }

    public function testConcurrentBeginIsBlockedByLock(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness();
        $updater = $h['updater'];

        $updater->begin($this->target);

        $this->expectException(UpdateException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('lock ativo');
        $updater->begin($this->target);
    }

    public function testInterruptedSafeStepRepeatsWhileInterruptedAppliedRollsBack(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness();
        $updater = $h['updater'];
        $stateStore = $h['stateStore'];

        $state = $updater->begin($this->target);
        $id = $state->updateId;

        // 1. Simula queda durante Downloaded (etapa segura): deve repetir e avançar para Downloaded
        $stateStore->save($state->withContext(['in_progress_step' => UpdateStep::Downloaded->value]));
        $resumed = $updater->advance($id);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Downloaded, $resumed->step);

        // Avança até MaintenanceOn (com backup criado)
        $updater->advance($id); // Verified
        $updater->advance($id); // Preflighted
        $updater->advance($id); // BackedUp
        $maintState = $updater->advance($id); // MaintenanceOn

        // 2. Simula queda durante Applied (etapa crítica pós-backup): deve tratar como falha e fazer rollback
        $stateStore->save($maintState->withContext(['in_progress_step' => UpdateStep::Applied->value]));
        $afterCrash = $updater->advance($id);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::RolledBack, $afterCrash->step);
        $this->assertContains('revert_code', $this->callLog);
    }

    public function testUnsupportedDbBackupOrDestructiveMigrationRequiresExplicitConfirmation(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness(['dbSupported' => false]);
        $updater = $h['updater'];

        // Sem confirmNoDbBackup -> falha na etapa Preflighted
        $state = $updater->begin($this->target);
        $id = $state->updateId;
        $updater->advance($id); // Downloaded
        $updater->advance($id); // Verified
        $blockedState = $updater->advance($id); // Preflighted falha
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Failed, $blockedState->step);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('confirmNoDbBackup', (string)$blockedState->error);

        // Com confirmNoDbBackup => true -> passa pela etapa Preflighted
        $state2 = $updater->begin($this->target, ['confirmNoDbBackup' => true]);
        $id2 = $state2->updateId;
        $updater->advance($id2); // Downloaded
        $updater->advance($id2); // Verified
        $passedState = $updater->advance($id2); // Preflighted
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Preflighted, $passedState->step);
    }

    public function testPreexistingManualMaintenanceModeIsNotDisabledOnCompletion(): void
    {
        $h = $this->buildHarness(['initialMaintenance' => true]);
        $updater = $h['updater'];

        $state = $updater->begin($this->target, ['inlineHealthCheck' => true]);
        $id = $state->updateId;

        while (!in_array($state->step, [UpdateStep::Done, UpdateStep::Failed, UpdateStep::RolledBack], true)) {
            $state = $updater->advance($id);
        }

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Done, $state->step);
        $this->assertTrue($h['maintenance']->isEnabled(), 'Manutenção manual preexistente não deve ser desligada.');
        $this->assertNotContains('maintenance_off', $this->callLog);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/CurlHttpClientGuardsTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\TransportException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CurlHttpClient;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\HostAllowlist;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HttpResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CurlHttpClientGuardsTest extends TestCase
{
    #[DataProvider('blockedUrlsProvider')]
    public function testValidateUrlRejectsDisallowedUrlsWithoutMakingNetworkRequests(string $url): void
    {
        $client = new CurlHttpClient(new HostAllowlist());

        $this->expectException(TransportException::class);
        $client->get($url);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{0: string}>
     */
    public static function blockedUrlsProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            [''],
            ['http://api.github.com/repos/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/latest'],
            ['ftp://api.github.com/file.zip'],
            ['https://evil.example.com/releases/latest'],
            ['https://api.github.com@evil.example.com/releases/latest'],
            ['https://user:pass@api.github.com/repos/hadelrachid/domain-system'],
            ['https://api.github.com:8443/repos/hadelrachid/domain-system'],
            ['https://githubusercontent.com/file.zip'],
        ];
    }

    public function testRedirectToDisallowedHostIsBlockedBeforeSecondHop(): void
    {
        $calls = [];
        $client = new CurlHttpClient(
            new HostAllowlist(),
            static function (string $url) use (&$calls): HttpResponse {
                $calls[] = $url;
                return new HttpResponse(
                    statusCode: 302,
                    headers: ['location' => 'https://attacker.example.com/malicious.zip'],
                    body: '',
                );
            },
        );

        try {
            $client->get('https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/pkg.zip');
            $this->fail('Deveria ter bloqueado o redirecionamento para host fora da allowlist.');
        } catch (TransportException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('allowlist', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertCount(1, $calls, 'O segundo salto jamais deve ser executado.');
        }
    }

    public function testRedirectFollowsUpToThreeAllowedHopsAndBlocksFourthHop(): void
    {
        $hopCount = 0;
        $client = new CurlHttpClient(
            new HostAllowlist(),
            static function (string $url) use (&$hopCount): HttpResponse {
                $hopCount++;
                return new HttpResponse(
                    statusCode: 302,
                    headers: ['location' => "https://objects.githubusercontent.com/hop-{$hopCount}"],
                    body: '',
                );
            },
        );

        $this->expectException(TransportException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('redirecionamentos');
        $client->get('https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/pkg.zip');
    }

    public function testDownloadDeletesPartialFileWhenMaxBytesExceeded(): void
    {
        $tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_curl_guard_' . uniqid('', true);
        mkdir($tempDir, 0777, true);
        $destFile = $tempDir . '/oversized.zip';

        $client = new CurlHttpClient(
            new HostAllowlist(),
            static function (string $url, array $headers, int $timeout, ?string $dest): HttpResponse {
                if ($dest !== null) {
                    file_put_contents($dest, str_repeat('A', 200));
                }
                return new HttpResponse(200, [], '');
            },
        );

        try {
            $client->download(
                'https://objects.githubusercontent.com/pkg.zip',
                $destFile,
                maxBytes: 50,
            );
            $this->fail('Deveria ter abortado por exceder maxBytes.');
        } catch (TransportException $e) {
            $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($destFile, 'O arquivo parcial deve ser removido imediatamente.');
        } finally {
            @unlink($destFile);
            @rmdir($tempDir);
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/GitHubReleaseSourceAndCheckerTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SourceUnavailableException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\FilesystemInstalledState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\GitHubReleaseSource;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\JsonUpdateStateStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\UpdateConfig;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SemverComparator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateChecker;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateTargetResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HttpResponse;
use DomainSystem\Tests\Support\ArrayHttpClient;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class GitHubReleaseSourceAndCheckerTest extends TestCase
{
    private const API_URL = 'https://api.github.com/repos/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/latest';
    private const SHA_URL = 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip.sha256';
    private const ZIP_URL = 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip';
    private const VALID_HASH = 'a948904f2f0f479b8f8197694b30184b0d2ed1c1cd2a1ec0fb85d299a192a447';

    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = str_replace('\\', '/', sys_get_temp_dir()) . '/ds_github_check_' . uniqid('', true);
        mkdir($this->tempDir . '/config', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempDir . '/config/update.json',
            json_encode([
                'core_repository' => 'hadelrachid/domain-system',
                'channel'         => 'stable',
                'check_ttl_hours' => 12,
                'auto_rollback'   => true,
            ], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT),
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testUpdateConfigAndTargetResolverReadCoreTarget(): void
    {
        $config = new UpdateConfig($this->tempDir);
        $this->assertSame('hadelrachid/domain-system', $config->coreRepository());
        $this->assertSame('stable', $config->channel());
        $this->assertSame(12, $config->checkTtlHours());
        $this->assertTrue($config->autoRollback());

        $installed = new FilesystemInstalledState($this->tempDir, '2.3.0');
        $resolver = new UpdateTargetResolver($installed, $config->coreRepository(), $config->channel());
        $target = $resolver->core();

        $this->assertSame('core', $target->slug);
        $this->assertSame('2.3.0', $target->installedVersion);
    }

    public function testCheckerReturnsAvailableWhenNewerVersionExistsAndRespectsTtlAnd304(): void
    {
        $fixtureJson = (string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/Fixtures/github/releases_latest.json');
        $httpClient = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, ['etag' => 'W/"etag-v240"'], $fixtureJson, 'W/"etag-v240"'),
            self::SHA_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], self::VALID_HASH . "  domain-system-2.4.0.zip\n"),
        ]);

        $now = 1_700_000_000;
        $comparator = new SemverComparator();
        $source = new GitHubReleaseSource($httpClient, $comparator);
        $stateStore = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $checker = new UpdateChecker($source, $comparator, $stateStore, 12, static function () use (&$now): int {
            return $now;
        });

        $target = (new UpdateTargetResolver(new FilesystemInstalledState($this->tempDir, '2.3.0')))->core();

        // 1. Primeira verificação bate na API e devolve Available
        $res1 = $checker->check($target, false);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::Available, $res1->status);
        $this->assertNotNull($res1->release);
        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $res1->release->version);
        $this->assertSame(self::VALID_HASH, $res1->release->sha256);
        $this->assertCount(2, $httpClient->recordedRequests());

        // 2. Segunda verificação 1 hora depois (< 12h TTL) sem $force usa cache sem fazer novas chamadas HTTP
        $now += 3600;
        $res2 = $checker->check($target, false);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::Available, $res2->status);
        $this->assertCount(2, $httpClient->recordedRequests(), 'Não deve chamar a API dentro do TTL');

        // 3. Após expirar o TTL (13h depois), envia If-None-Match e recebe 304 -> mantém cache Available
        $now += 13 * 3600;
        $httpClient->when(self::API_URL, static function (string $url, array $headers): HttpResponse {
            self::assertSame('W/"etag-v240"', $headers['If-None-Match'] ?? '');
            return new HttpResponse(304, [], '', 'W/"etag-v240"');
        });
        $res3 = $checker->check($target, false);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::Available, $res3->status);
        $this->assertCount(3, $httpClient->recordedRequests());
    }

    public function testCheckerReturnsUpToDateWhenInstalledVersionEqualsOrExceedsRelease(): void
    {
        $fixtureJson = (string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/Fixtures/github/releases_latest.json');
        $httpClient = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], $fixtureJson),
            self::SHA_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], self::VALID_HASH),
        ]);

        $comparator = new SemverComparator();
        $source = new GitHubReleaseSource($httpClient, $comparator);
        $checker = new UpdateChecker($source, $comparator, new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir));

        $target = (new UpdateTargetResolver(new FilesystemInstalledState($this->tempDir, '2.4.0')))->core();
        $res = $checker->check($target, true);

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::UpToDate, $res->status);

        // E também quando a Release no GitHub (ex.: v2.3.0 legada com domain-system-core.zip) é igual à instalada (2.3.0)
        $noAssetJson = (string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/Fixtures/github/releases_latest_no_asset.json');
        $httpLegacySameVer = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], $noAssetJson),
        ]);
        $checkerLegacy = new UpdateChecker(
            new GitHubReleaseSource($httpLegacySameVer, $comparator),
            $comparator,
            new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir),
        );
        $resLegacy = $checkerLegacy->check($target, true);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::UpToDate, $resLegacy->status);
    }

    public function testCheckerNeverThrowsOnMalformedJsonMissingAssetOrInvalidSha256(): void
    {
        $comparator = new SemverComparator();
        $target = (new UpdateTargetResolver(new FilesystemInstalledState($this->tempDir, '2.3.0')))->core();

        // Caso 1: JSON malformado -> Unknown
        $httpBadJson = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], '{json-quebrado'),
        ]);
        $checker1 = new UpdateChecker(
            new GitHubReleaseSource($httpBadJson, $comparator),
            $comparator,
            new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir),
        );
        $res1 = $checker1->check($target, true);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::Unknown, $res1->status);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($res1->reasons);

        // Caso 2: Asset domain-system-2.4.0.zip ausente -> SourceUnavailableException na fonte e Unknown no checker
        $noAssetJson = (string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/Fixtures/github/releases_latest_no_asset.json');
        $httpNoAsset = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], $noAssetJson),
        ]);
        $sourceNoAsset = new GitHubReleaseSource($httpNoAsset, $comparator);
        try {
            $sourceNoAsset->latest($target);
            $this->fail('Deveria lançar SourceUnavailableException quando falta o asset.');
        } catch (SourceUnavailableException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('domain-system-2.4.0.zip', $e->getMessage());
        }

        // Caso 3: .sha256 inválido -> SourceUnavailableException na fonte e Unknown no checker
        $fixtureJson = (string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/Fixtures/github/releases_latest.json');
        $httpBadSha = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], $fixtureJson),
            self::SHA_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], 'nao-e-um-sha256-valido'),
        ]);
        $checker3 = new UpdateChecker(
            new GitHubReleaseSource($httpBadSha, $comparator),
            $comparator,
            new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir),
        );
        $res3 = $checker3->check($target, true);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::Unknown, $res3->status);
    }

    public function testFetchPackageDownloadsArchiveToDestinationDir(): void
    {
        $fixtureJson = (string)file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/Fixtures/github/releases_latest.json');
        $httpClient = new ArrayHttpClient([
            self::API_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], $fixtureJson),
            self::SHA_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], self::VALID_HASH),
            self::ZIP_URL => new HttpResponse(200, [], 'PK-DUMMY-ZIP-CONTENT'),
        ]);

        $source = new GitHubReleaseSource($httpClient, new SemverComparator());
        $target = (new UpdateTargetResolver(new FilesystemInstalledState($this->tempDir, '2.3.0')))->core();
        $release = $source->latest($target);
        $this->assertNotNull($release);

        $downloaded = $source->fetchPackage($release, $this->tempDir . '/temp/updates/2.4.0');
        $this->assertFileExists($downloaded->archivePath);
        $this->assertSame(20, $downloaded->sizeBytes);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (scandir($dir) ?: [] as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/HostAllowlistTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\HostAllowlist;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class HostAllowlistTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testDefaultAllowlistPermitsOfficialGitHubHostsAndWildcardSubdomains(): void
    {
        $allowlist = new HostAllowlist();

        $this->assertTrue($allowlist->isAllowed('api.github.com'));
        $this->assertTrue($allowlist->isAllowed('API.GITHUB.COM'));
        $this->assertTrue($allowlist->isAllowed('github.com'));
        $this->assertTrue($allowlist->isAllowed('objects.githubusercontent.com'));
        $this->assertTrue($allowlist->isAllowed('release-assets.githubusercontent.com'));
        $this->assertTrue($allowlist->isAllowed('codeload.Sub.githubusercontent.com'));
    }

    public function testDefaultAllowlistRejectsBareWildcardBaseDomainAndLookalikeHosts(): void
    {
        $allowlist = new HostAllowlist();

        $this->assertFalse($allowlist->isAllowed(''));
        $this->assertFalse($allowlist->isAllowed('githubusercontent.com'));
        $this->assertFalse($allowlist->isAllowed('evil-github.com'));
        $this->assertFalse($allowlist->isAllowed('api.github.com.evil.org'));
        $this->assertFalse($allowlist->isAllowed('evilgithubusercontent.com'));
        $this->assertFalse($allowlist->isAllowed('127.0.0.1'));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/MaintenanceAndApplierTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Http\MaintenancePolicy;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\ApplyException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CoreProtectedPaths;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\FileMaintenanceMode;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Sha256PackageVerifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\StagedUpdateApplier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipDirectoryBackup;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipPackageExtractor;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\JsonUpdateManifestParser;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Tests\Support\PackageBuilder;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

final class MaintenanceAndApplierTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;
    private string $rootDir;
    private string $quarantineDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'ds-apply-test-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        $this->rootDir = $this->tempDir . '/root';
        $this->quarantineDir = $this->tempDir . '/quarantine';

        mkdir($this->rootDir . '/src/Core', 0755, true);
        mkdir($this->rootDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd', 0755, true);
        mkdir($this->rootDir . '/public/uploads', 0755, true);
        mkdir($this->rootDir . '/config', 0755, true);
        mkdir($this->rootDir . '/vendor', 0755, true);
        mkdir($this->quarantineDir, 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testFileMaintenanceModeAndMaintenancePolicyExemptions(): void
    {
        $maint = new FileMaintenanceMode($this->rootDir);
        $this->assertFalse($maint->isEnabled());
        $this->assertFalse($maint->wasAlreadyEnabled());

        $maint->enable('Atualizando núcleo...');
        $this->assertTrue($maint->isEnabled());
        $this->assertFalse($maint->wasAlreadyEnabled());
        $this->assertFileExists($this->rootDir . '/.maintenance');

        // Se já estava ligado e enable() for chamado novamente, registra wasAlreadyEnabled = true
        $maint->enable('Segunda chamada');
        $this->assertTrue($maint->wasAlreadyEnabled());

        // Rotas do atualizador são isentas e visitante em '/' é bloqueado (503)
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath('/admin/settings/updates/core/advance'));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath('/admin/settings/updates/core/health'));
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock('/admin/settings/updates/core/advance', true, null, 'admin'));
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock('/admin/settings/updates/core/health', true, null, 'admin'));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock('/', true, null, 'guest'));

        $maint->disable();
        $this->assertFalse($maint->isEnabled());
    }

    public function testStagedUpdateApplierRespectsProtectedPathsDefaultIfMissingSkipsIdenticalAndOrdersStages(): void
    {
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/.env', 'APP_ENV=prod');
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/config/plugins.json', '{"custom":true}');
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd/style.css', '/* private */');
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Unchanged.php', "<?php // unchanged\n");
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Obsolete.php', "<?php // obsolete\n");
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/bootstrap.php', "<?php define('DS_VERSION', '2.3.0');\n");
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/public/index.php', "<?php // old index\n");

        $protectedPaths = new CoreProtectedPaths();
        $backupService = new ZipDirectoryBackup($this->rootDir);
        $backupRecord = $backupService->create(new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core'), 'before-2.4.0');

        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withVersion('2.4.0')
            ->withFile('bootstrap.php', "<?php define('DS_VERSION', '2.4.0');\n")
            ->withFile('public/index.php', "<?php // new index\n")
            ->withFile('vendor/autoload.php', "<?php // autoload\n")
            ->withFile('src/Core/Unchanged.php', "<?php // unchanged\n")
            ->withFile('src/Core/NewFeature.php', "<?php // new feature\n")
            ->withFile('src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd/style.css', '/* overwrite attempt */')
            ->withFile('config/plugins.json', '{"custom":false}', 'default_if_missing')
            ->withFile('config/update.json', '{"channel":"stable"}', 'default_if_missing')
            ->withRemoved(['src/Core/Obsolete.php'])
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        $verifier = new Sha256PackageVerifier(
            new JsonUpdateManifestParser(),
            $protectedPaths,
            new ZipPackageExtractor(),
            $this->quarantineDir,
        );
        $verified = $verifier->verify($package);

        $applier = new StagedUpdateApplier($this->rootDir, $protectedPaths, $backupService);
        $target = new UpdateTarget(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', 'hadelrachid/domain-system', '2.3.0');

        $result = $applier->apply($verified, $target, $backupRecord);

        // 1. Ordem: vendor/ primeiro, src/ depois, public/index.php e bootstrap.php por último
        $this->assertSame(
            ['vendor/autoload.php', 'src/Core/NewFeature.php', 'config/update.json', 'public/index.php', 'bootstrap.php'],
            $result->written
        );

        // 2. Arquivo idêntico (src/Core/Unchanged.php) foi pulado (não está em written)
        $this->assertNotContains('src/Core/Unchanged.php', $result->written);

        // 3. Protegidos (tema privado rachidd e config/plugins.json existente) foram pulados e intocados
        $this->assertContains('src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd/style.css', $result->skippedProtected);
        $this->assertContains('config/plugins.json', $result->skippedProtected);
        $this->assertSame('/* private */', file_get_contents($this->rootDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd/style.css'));
        $this->assertSame('{"custom":true}', file_get_contents($this->rootDir . '/config/plugins.json'));

        // 4. default_if_missing que não existia (config/update.json) foi criado
        $this->assertFileExists($this->rootDir . '/config/update.json');

        // 5. Obsolete foi removido
        $this->assertSame(['src/Core/Obsolete.php'], $result->removed);
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Obsolete.php');
    }

    public function testFailureMidApplyThrowsApplyExceptionAndRevertLeavesTreeIdentical(): void
    {
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/bootstrap.php', "<?php define('DS_VERSION', '2.3.0');\n");
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Kernel.php', "<?php // kernel v2.3.0\n");
        // Cria um arquivo onde o pacote tentará criar um subdiretório (src/Core/Blocker/Sub.php)
        file_put_contents($this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Blocker', 'i-am-a-file-not-a-dir');

        $protectedPaths = new CoreProtectedPaths();
        $backupService = new ZipDirectoryBackup($this->rootDir, $this->tempDir . '/backups');
        $backupRecord = $backupService->create(new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core'), 'before-fail');

        $hashesBefore = $this->snapshotTreeHashes($this->rootDir);

        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withVersion('2.4.0')
            ->withFile('vendor/new_lib.php', "<?php // written before failure\n")
            ->withFile('src/Core/Blocker/Sub.php', "<?php // will fail because Blocker is a file\n")
            ->withFile('bootstrap.php', "<?php define('DS_VERSION', '2.4.0');\n")
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        $verifier = new Sha256PackageVerifier(
            new JsonUpdateManifestParser(),
            $protectedPaths,
            new ZipPackageExtractor(),
            $this->quarantineDir,
        );
        $verified = $verifier->verify($package);

        $applier = new StagedUpdateApplier($this->rootDir, $protectedPaths, $backupService);
        $target = new UpdateTarget(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', 'hadelrachid/domain-system', '2.3.0');

        try {
            $applier->apply($verified, $target, $backupRecord);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado ApplyException quando o pai do destino é um arquivo.');
        } catch (ApplyException) {
            // Reverte usando o backupRecord (incluindo o arquivo vendor/new_lib.php que chegou a ser escrito)
            $partialResult = new \DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ApplyResult(
                backup: $backupRecord,
                written: ['vendor/new_lib.php'],
                removed: [],
                skippedProtected: [],
            );
            $applier->revert($partialResult);
        }

        $hashesAfter = $this->snapshotTreeHashes($this->rootDir);
        $this->assertSame($hashesBefore, $hashesAfter, 'A árvore deve ficar idêntica após revert.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function snapshotTreeHashes(string $dir): array
    {
        $map = [];
        $baseLen = strlen(rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $dir), '/')) + 1;

        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            if ($item->isFile()) {
                $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
                $map[$rel] = (string)hash_file('sha256', $item->getPathname());
            }
        }

        ksort($map);
        return $map;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\InvalidManifestException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CoreProtectedPaths;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Sha256PackageVerifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipPackageExtractor;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\JsonUpdateManifestParser;
use DomainSystem\Tests\Support\PackageBuilder;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class PackageVerificationTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;
    private string $quarantineBaseDir;
    private JsonUpdateManifestParser $parser;
    private CoreProtectedPaths $protectedPaths;
    private ZipPackageExtractor $extractor;
    private Sha256PackageVerifier $verifier;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'ds-pkg-test-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        $this->quarantineBaseDir = $this->tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'quarantine';
        mkdir($this->quarantineBaseDir, 0755, true);

        $this->parser = new JsonUpdateManifestParser();
        $this->protectedPaths = new CoreProtectedPaths();
        $this->extractor = new ZipPackageExtractor();
        $this->verifier = new Sha256PackageVerifier(
            manifestParser: $this->parser,
            protectedPaths: $this->protectedPaths,
            extractor: $this->extractor,
            quarantineBaseDir: $this->quarantineBaseDir,
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testValidPackagePassesVerificationAndExtractsFiles(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withVersion('2.4.0')
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', "<?php\nnamespace DomainSystem\\Core;\nfinal class Foo {}\n")
            ->withFile('bootstrap.php', "<?php\ndefine('DS_VERSION', '2.4.0');\n")
            ->withFile('config/new_feature.json', '{"enabled":true}', 'default_if_missing')
            ->withRemoved(['src/Core/OldClass.php'])
            ->withMigration(
                scope: '__core__',
                name: '2026_11_01_000001_add_col',
                content: "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function () {}];\n",
                type: 'additive'
            )
            ->withExpects(['academy_modules' => ['folder_slug']])
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        $verified = $this->verifier->verify($package);

        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $verified->manifest->version);
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($verified->extractedPath);
        $this->assertFileExists($verified->extractedPath . '/src/Core/Foo.php');
        $this->assertFileExists($verified->extractedPath . '/bootstrap.php');
        $this->assertCount(4, $verified->manifest->files);
        $this->assertSame(['src/Core/OldClass.php'], $verified->manifest->removed);
    }

    public function testWrongZipSha256IsRejectedAndQuarantineStaysEmpty(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // ok')
            ->build($this->tempDir, overrideReleaseSha256: str_repeat('0', 64));

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado PackageIntegrityException para hash do ZIP errado.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('diverge do esperado', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testWrongFileSha256InsidePackageIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile(
                path: 'src/Core/Foo.php',
                content: '<?php // conteudo adulterado',
                overrideSha256: str_repeat('b', 64)
            )
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado PackageIntegrityException para hash de arquivo divergente.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Hash SHA-256 do arquivo', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testExtraUnlistedFileInZipIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // ok')
            ->withExtraZipFile('src/Core/Backdoor.php', '<?php // extra nao listado')
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado PackageIntegrityException para arquivo extra fora do manifest.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Arquivo extra não declarado', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testMissingFileListedInManifestIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // ok')
            ->withMissingDiskFile('src/Core/Missing.php')
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado PackageIntegrityException para arquivo listado ausente.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('ausente no pacote extraído', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider unsafePathsProvider
     */
    public function testZipSlipAndUnsafePathsAreRejectedAndCleanedUp(string $unsafePath): void
    {
        try {
            $this->extractor->assertSafeRelativePath($unsafePath);
            $this->fail(sprintf('assertSafeRelativePath deveria ter rejeitado "%s".', $unsafePath));
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException) {
            $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
        }

        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // ok')
            ->withExtraZipFile($unsafePath, 'malicious')
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail(sprintf('Deveria ter rejeitado o caminho inseguro "%s".', $unsafePath));
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException) {
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: string}>
     */
    public static function unsafePathsProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            'traversal_root' => ['../evil.php'],
            'traversal_nested' => ['src/../../evil.php'],
            'absolute_slash' => ['/etc/passwd'],
            'backslash' => ['src\\Core\\Evil.php'],
            'drive_letter' => ['C:/Windows/win.ini'],
        ];
    }

    public function testSymlinkInsideZipIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // ok')
            ->withSymlink('src/Core/Link.php', '/etc/passwd')

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter rejeitado entrada simbólica no ZIP.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Link simbólico', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testCaseInsensitiveCollisionInZipIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // 1')
            ->withFile('src/Core/foo.php', '<?php // 2')
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter rejeitado colisão case-insensitive.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('case-insensitive', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testManifestWithProtocol2IsRejectedWithInvalidManifestException(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withProtocol(2, 2)
            ->withFile('src/Core/Foo.php', '<?php // ok')
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado InvalidManifestException para protocolo 2.');
        } catch (InvalidManifestException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Protocolo de manifest 2 não suportado', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testManifestMissingRequiredFieldIsRejectedWithInvalidManifestException(): void
    {
        $incompleteManifest = [
            'protocol' => 1,
            'minUpdaterProtocol' => 1,
            'kind' => 'core',
            'slug' => 'core',
            // 'version' ausente propositalmente
            'requires' => ['php' => '8.1', 'extensions' => ['pdo'], 'osVersion' => '2.3'],
            'files' => [],
            'removed' => [],
            'migrations' => [],
            'expects' => new \stdClass(),
        ];

        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withRawManifest($incompleteManifest)
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter lançado InvalidManifestException para campo obrigatório ausente.');
        } catch (InvalidManifestException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Campo obrigatório "version" ausente', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testFileOutsideAllowedRootsIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('storage/state/hack.php', '<?php // fora de allowedRoots')
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $this->verifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter rejeitado arquivo fora das raízes permitidas.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('fora das raízes permitidas', $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    public function testZipBombExceedingLimitsIsRejectedAndCleanedUp(): void
    {
        $strictExtractor = new ZipPackageExtractor(
            maxFiles: 10,
            maxTotalBytes: 2048,
            maxCompressionRatio: 20.0,
        );
        $strictVerifier = new Sha256PackageVerifier(
            manifestParser: $this->parser,
            protectedPaths: $this->protectedPaths,
            extractor: $strictExtractor,
            quarantineBaseDir: $this->quarantineBaseDir,
        );

        // 50 KB de zeros comprime para poucos bytes (razão > 100x e > 2048 bytes)
        $package = PackageBuilder::create()
            ->withFile('src/Core/Bomb.php', str_repeat("\0", 50000))
            ->build($this->tempDir);

        try {
            $strictVerifier->verify($package);
            $this->fail('Deveria ter rejeitado pacote que estoura razão de compressão / limite de bytes.');
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            $this->assertQuarantineIsClean();
        }
    }

    private function assertQuarantineIsClean(): void
    {
        $entries = array_values(array_diff(scandir($this->quarantineBaseDir) ?: [], ['.', '..']));
        $this->assertSame(
            [],
            $entries,
            'O diretório base de quarentena deve ficar vazio após qualquer falha na verificação.'
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\InstalledStateProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaPlannerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SchemaPlanException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CoreProtectedPaths;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\FilesystemInstalledState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\DiskSpaceCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\DowngradeCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\ExtensionsCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\PhpVersionCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\PluginCompatibilityCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\ProtocolCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\SchemaPlanCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\WritablePathsCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\JsonUpdateManifestParser;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\Preflight;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SemverComparator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\InstalledPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaPlan;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateManifest;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use RuntimeException;

final class PreflightTest extends TestCase
{
    private function makeVerifiedPackage(
        string $version = '2.4.0',
        int $minUpdaterProtocol = 1,
        string $phpRequires = '8.1',
        array $extensions = ['pdo', 'json'],
        array $files = [],
        int $sizeBytes = 1000,
    ): VerifiedPackage {
        $manifest = new UpdateManifest(
            protocol: 1,
            minUpdaterProtocol: $minUpdaterProtocol,
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            version: $version,
            requires: [
                'php' => $phpRequires,
                'extensions' => $extensions,
                'osVersion' => '2.3',
            ],
            files: $files,
            removed: [],
            migrations: [],
            expects: [],
        );

        $release = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: $version,
            tag: 'v' . $version,
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'Notes',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v' . $version . '/pkg.zip',
            assetName: 'pkg.zip',
            sizeBytes: $sizeBytes,
            sha256: str_repeat('a', 64),
        );

        return new VerifiedPackage(
            release: $release,
            manifest: $manifest,
            extractedPath: sys_get_temp_dir(),
        );
    }

    private function makeTarget(string $installedVersion = '2.3.0'): UpdateTarget
    {
        return new UpdateTarget(
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            repository: 'hadelrachid/domain-system',
            installedVersion: $installedVersion,
            channel: 'stable',
        );
    }

    public function testPhpVersionCheckPassAndFail(): void
    {
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(phpRequires: '8.2.0');
        $target = $this->makeTarget();

        $passCheck = new PhpVersionCheck('8.2.12');
        $resPass = $passCheck->run($pkg, $target);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, $resPass[0]->level);

        $failCheck = new PhpVersionCheck('8.1.9');
        $resFail = $failCheck->run($pkg, $target);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $resFail[0]->level);
    }

    public function testExtensionsCheckPassAndFail(): void
    {
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(extensions: ['pdo', 'mbstring', 'sodium']);
        $target = $this->makeTarget();

        $allLoaded = new ExtensionsCheck(static fn(string $ext): bool => true);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, $allLoaded->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);

        $missingSodium = new ExtensionsCheck(static fn(string $ext): bool => $ext !== 'sodium');
        $res = $missingSodium->run($pkg, $target);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $res[0]->level);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('sodium', $res[0]->message);
    }

    public function testDiskSpaceCheckPassAndFail(): void
    {
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(sizeBytes: 10000);
        $target = $this->makeTarget();

        $enough = new DiskSpaceCheck(sys_get_temp_dir(), freeBytesOverride: 30000);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, $enough->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);

        $insufficient = new DiskSpaceCheck(sys_get_temp_dir(), freeBytesOverride: 29999);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $insufficient->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);
    }

    public function testWritablePathsCheckPassAndFail(): void
    {
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage();
        $target = $this->makeTarget();
        $protectedPaths = new CoreProtectedPaths();

        $writable = new WritablePathsCheck(sys_get_temp_dir(), $protectedPaths, static fn(): bool => true);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, $writable->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);

        $readOnlyStorage = new WritablePathsCheck(
            '/fake/root',
            $protectedPaths,
            static fn(string $p): bool => !str_contains($p, 'storage')
        );
        $res = $readOnlyStorage->run($pkg, $target);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $res[0]->level);
    }

    public function testProtocolCheckPassAndFail(): void
    {
        $parser = new JsonUpdateManifestParser();
        $check = new ProtocolCheck($parser);
        $target = $this->makeTarget();

        $okPkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(minUpdaterProtocol: 1);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, $check->run($okPkg, $target)[0]->level);

        $futurePkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(minUpdaterProtocol: 2);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $check->run($futurePkg, $target)[0]->level);
    }

    public function testDowngradeCheckBlocksSameOrLowerVersionAndAllowsNewer(): void
    {
        $check = new DowngradeCheck(new SemverComparator());
        $target = $this->makeTarget('2.3.0');

        $newer = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(version: '2.4.0');
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, $check->run($newer, $target)[0]->level);

        $same = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(version: '2.3.0');
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $check->run($same, $target)[0]->level);

        $older = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(version: '2.2.9');
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, $check->run($older, $target)[0]->level);
    }

    public function testPluginCompatibilityCheckEmitsWarningForUnbundledPluginWithDifferentMajor(): void
    {
        $state = new class implements InstalledStateProviderInterface {
            public function coreVersion(): string
            {
                return '2.3.0';
            }

            public function plugins(): array
            {
                return [
                    'bundled_plugin' => new InstalledPlugin('bundled_plugin', '2.3.0', '2.3', true, true),
                    'legacy_third_party' => new InstalledPlugin('legacy_third_party', '1.0.0', '1.0', false, true),
                ];
            }
        };

        $check = new PluginCompatibilityCheck($state);
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage(
            version: '2.4.0',
            files: [
                ['path' => 'src/Plugins/bundled_plugin/Plugin.php', 'sha256' => str_repeat('a', 64), 'size' => 10, 'mode' => 'replace'],
            ],
        );

        $results = $check->run($pkg, $this->makeTarget());
        $this->assertCount(1, $results);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Warn, $results[0]->level);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('legacy_third_party', $results[0]->message);
    }

    public function testSchemaPlanCheckHandlesOkDestructiveBlockedAndException(): void
    {
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage();
        $target = $this->makeTarget();

        $okPlanner = new class implements SchemaPlannerInterface {
            public function plan(UpdateManifest $manifest, string $extractedPath): SchemaPlan
            {
                return new SchemaPlan('__core__', [], [], false, false);
            }
        };
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Ok, (new SchemaPlanCheck($okPlanner))->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);

        $destructivePlanner = new class implements SchemaPlannerInterface {
            public function plan(UpdateManifest $manifest, string $extractedPath): SchemaPlan
            {
                return new SchemaPlan(
                    '__core__',
                    [['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => 'm1', 'sha256' => str_repeat('a', 64), 'type' => 'destructive']],
                    [],
                    true,
                    true,
                );
            }
        };
        $destRes = (new SchemaPlanCheck($destructivePlanner))->run($pkg, $target);
        $this->assertCount(2, $destRes);
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Warn, $destRes[1]->level);

        $blockedPlanner = new class implements SchemaPlannerInterface {
            public function plan(UpdateManifest $manifest, string $extractedPath): SchemaPlan
            {
                return new SchemaPlan('__core__', [], ['2026_12_01_future_mig'], false, false);
            }
        };
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, (new SchemaPlanCheck($blockedPlanner))->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);

        $throwingPlanner = new class implements SchemaPlannerInterface {
            public function plan(UpdateManifest $manifest, string $extractedPath): SchemaPlan
            {
                throw new SchemaPlanException('Hash divergente na migration.');
            }
        };
        $this->assertSame(CheckLevel::Block, (new SchemaPlanCheck($throwingPlanner))->run($pkg, $target)[0]->level);
    }

    public function testPreflightCompositeAggregatesAndConvertsThrownExceptionIntoBlock(): void
    {
        $pkg = $this->makeVerifiedPackage();
        $target = $this->makeTarget();

        $throwingCheck = new class implements PreflightCheckInterface {
            public function id(): string
            {
                return 'exploding_check';
            }

            public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
            {
                throw new RuntimeException('Erro inesperado no check.');
            }
        };

        $composite = new Preflight([
            new PhpVersionCheck('8.2.12'),
            $throwingCheck,
        ]);

        $report = $composite->run($pkg, $target);
        $this->assertFalse($report->canProceed());
        $this->assertCount(1, $report->blocks());
        $this->assertSame('exploding_check', $report->blocks()[0]->id);
    }

    public function testFilesystemInstalledStateReadsRealProjectPlugins(): void
    {
        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $state = new FilesystemInstalledState($root);

        $this->assertSame(defined('DS_VERSION') ? DS_VERSION : '2.6.0', $state->coreVersion());
        $plugins = $state->plugins();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('settings', $plugins);
        $this->assertSame(defined('DS_VERSION') ? DS_VERSION : '2.6.0', $plugins['settings']->version);
        $this->assertSame(defined('DS_OS_VERSION') ? DS_OS_VERSION : '2.6', $plugins['settings']->osVersion);
    }
}
