<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Database\MigrationRunner;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update\PdoMigrationRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update\PdoSchemaProbe;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update\RunnerSchemaMigrator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SchemaPlanException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipPackageExtractor;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SchemaPlanner;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SchemaVerifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateManifest;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class SchemaUpdateTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'ds-schema-test-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function writeMigrationFile(string $scope, string $name, string $phpCode): string
    {
        $relDir = $scope === '__core__'
            ? 'src/Core/Database/migrations'
            : 'src/Plugins/' . $scope . '/migrations';

        $fullDir = $this->tempDir . '/' . $relDir;
        if (!is_dir($fullDir)) {
            mkdir($fullDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $filePath = $fullDir . '/' . $name . '.php';
        file_put_contents($filePath, $phpCode);

        return (string)hash_file('sha256', $filePath);
    }

    private function makeManifest(array $migrations = [], array $expects = []): UpdateManifest
    {
        return new UpdateManifest(
            protocol: 1,
            minUpdaterProtocol: 1,
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            version: '2.4.0',
            requires: [
                'php' => '8.1',
                'extensions' => ['pdo'],
                'osVersion' => '2.3',
            ],
            files: [],
            removed: [],
            migrations: $migrations,
            expects: $expects,
        );
    }

    public function testPdoMigrationRegistryReturnsEmptyWithoutCreatingTableWhenMissing(): void
    {
        $registry = new PdoMigrationRegistry($this->pdo);
        $probe = new PdoSchemaProbe($this->pdo);

        $this->assertSame([], $registry->executed('__core__'));
        $this->assertFalse($probe->hasTable('kernel_migrations'));
    }

    public function testSchemaPlannerPlansPendingAndDestructiveRequiresDbBackup(): void
    {
        $m1Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { \$pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE t1 (id INT)'); }];\n";
        $m2Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { \$pdo->exec('ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c2 TEXT'); }];\n";

        $sha1 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000001_create_t1', $m1Code);
        $sha2 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000002_alter_t1', $m2Code);

        // Registra a primeira como já executada
        $runner = new MigrationRunner($this->pdo);
        $this->pdo->exec("INSERT INTO kernel_migrations (plugin, migration) VALUES ('__core__', '2026_11_01_000001_create_t1')");

        $manifest = $this->makeManifest([
            ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000001_create_t1', 'sha256' => $sha1, 'type' => 'additive'],
            ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000002_alter_t1', 'sha256' => $sha2, 'type' => 'destructive'],
        ]);

        $planner = new SchemaPlanner(new PdoMigrationRegistry($this->pdo));
        $plan = $planner->plan($manifest, $this->tempDir);

        $this->assertCount(1, $plan->pending);
        $this->assertSame('2026_11_01_000002_alter_t1', $plan->pending[0]['name']);
        $this->assertSame([], $plan->blocked);
        $this->assertTrue($plan->destructive);
        $this->assertTrue($plan->requiresDatabaseBackup);
    }

    public function testSchemaPlannerThrowsExceptionOnDivergentHash(): void
    {
        $m1Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) {}];\n";
        $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000001_test', $m1Code);

        $manifest = $this->makeManifest([
            ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000001_test', 'sha256' => str_repeat('f', 64), 'type' => 'additive'],
        ]);

        $planner = new SchemaPlanner(new PdoMigrationRegistry($this->pdo));

        $this->expectException(SchemaPlanException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Hash SHA-256 da migration');
        $planner->plan($manifest, $this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testRunnerSchemaMigratorExecutesAllPendingMigrations(): void
    {
        $m1Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { \$pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE mod_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, folder_slug TEXT)'); }];\n";
        $m2Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { \$pdo->exec('ALTER TABLE mod_table ADD COLUMN extra_col TEXT'); }];\n";

        $sha1 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000001_create_mod', $m1Code);
        $sha2 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000002_add_extra', $m2Code);

        $manifest = $this->makeManifest(
            migrations: [
                ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000001_create_mod', 'sha256' => $sha1, 'type' => 'additive'],
                ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000002_add_extra', 'sha256' => $sha2, 'type' => 'additive'],
            ],
            expects: [
                'mod_table' => ['folder_slug', 'extra_col'],
            ],
        );

        $registry = new PdoMigrationRegistry($this->pdo);
        $planner = new SchemaPlanner($registry);
        $plan = $planner->plan($manifest, $this->tempDir);

        $migrator = new RunnerSchemaMigrator($this->pdo, $this->tempDir);
        $result = $migrator->migrate($plan);

        $this->assertTrue($result->isOk());
        $this->assertSame(['2026_11_01_000001_create_mod', '2026_11_01_000002_add_extra'], $result->executed);

        $verifier = new SchemaVerifier(new PdoSchemaProbe($this->pdo), $registry);
        $verification = $verifier->verify($manifest);
        $this->assertTrue($verification->ok);
    }

    public function testRunnerSchemaMigratorStopsAtSecondOfThreeAndDoesNotRecordFailure(): void
    {
        $m1Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { \$pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE step1 (id INT)'); }];\n";
        $m2Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { throw new \\RuntimeException('Boom na migration 2'); }];\n";
        $m3Code = "<?php\nreturn ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo) { \$pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE step3 (id INT)'); }];\n";

        $sha1 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000001_one', $m1Code);
        $sha2 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000002_two', $m2Code);
        $sha3 = $this->writeMigrationFile('__core__', '2026_11_01_000003_three', $m3Code);

        $manifest = $this->makeManifest([
            ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000001_one', 'sha256' => $sha1, 'type' => 'additive'],
            ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000002_two', 'sha256' => $sha2, 'type' => 'additive'],
            ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000003_three', 'sha256' => $sha3, 'type' => 'additive'],
        ]);

        $registry = new PdoMigrationRegistry($this->pdo);
        $plan = (new SchemaPlanner($registry))->plan($manifest, $this->tempDir);

        $migrator = new RunnerSchemaMigrator($this->pdo, $this->tempDir);
        $result = $migrator->migrate($plan);

        $this->assertFalse($result->isOk());
        $this->assertSame(['2026_11_01_000001_one'], $result->executed);
        $this->assertSame('2026_11_01_000002_two', $result->failed);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Boom na migration 2', (string)$result->error);

        $this->assertSame(['2026_11_01_000001_one'], $registry->executed('__core__'));
        $probe = new PdoSchemaProbe($this->pdo);
        $this->assertTrue($probe->hasTable('step1'));
        $this->assertFalse($probe->hasTable('step3'));
    }

    public function testSchemaVerifierDetectsMissingColumnEvenWhenMigrationIsRecorded(): void
    {
        $runner = new MigrationRunner($this->pdo);
        $this->pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE academy_modules (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT)');
        $this->pdo->exec("INSERT INTO kernel_migrations (plugin, migration) VALUES ('__core__', '2026_11_01_000001_fake')");

        $manifest = $this->makeManifest(
            migrations: [
                ['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_11_01_000001_fake', 'sha256' => str_repeat('a', 64), 'type' => 'additive'],
            ],
            expects: [
                'academy_modules' => ['title', 'folder_slug'],
            ],
        );

        $verifier = new SchemaVerifier(
            new PdoSchemaProbe($this->pdo),
            new PdoMigrationRegistry($this->pdo),
        );

        $verification = $verifier->verify($manifest);
        $this->assertFalse($verification->ok);
        $this->assertSame([], $verification->missingTables);
        $this->assertSame(['academy_modules.folder_slug'], $verification->missingColumns);
        $this->assertSame([], $verification->unrecorded);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/SemverComparatorTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SemverComparator;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class SemverComparatorTest extends TestCase
{
    #[DataProvider('validVersionsProvider')]
    public function testIsValidAcceptsStrictSemver(string $version): void
    {
        $comparator = new SemverComparator();
        $this->assertTrue($comparator->isValid($version));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{0: string}>
     */
    public static function validVersionsProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            ['0.0.1'],
            ['2.3.0'],
            ['2.10.15'],
            ['2.4.0-alpha'],
            ['2.4.0-beta.1'],
            ['2.4.0-rc.1.2'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('invalidVersionsProvider')]
    public function testIsValidRejectsInvalidSemver(string $version): void
    {
        $comparator = new SemverComparator();
        $this->assertFalse($comparator->isValid($version));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{0: string}>
     */
    public static function invalidVersionsProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            [''],
            ['2.3'],
            ['abc'],
            ['2.3.0.1'],
            ['v2.3.0'], // Prefixo 'v' só é aceito em normalize()
            ['02.3.0'],
            ['2.03.0'],
            ['2.3.0-'],
        ];
    }

    public function testNormalizeStripsLeadingVAndValidates(): void
    {
        $comparator = new SemverComparator();

        $this->assertSame('2.3.0', $comparator->normalize('v2.3.0'));
        $this->assertSame('2.4.0-beta.1', $comparator->normalize('V2.4.0-beta.1'));
        $this->assertSame('2.3.0', $comparator->normalize('2.3.0'));

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $comparator->normalize('v2.3');
    }

    #[DataProvider('comparisonsProvider')]
    public function testCompareAndIsNewer(string $a, string $b, int $expected): void
    {
        $comparator = new SemverComparator();

        $this->assertSame($expected, $comparator->compare($a, $b));
        $this->assertSame($expected === 1, $comparator->isNewer($a, $b));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{0: string, 1: string, 2: int}>
     */
    public static function comparisonsProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            ['2.3.0', '2.3.0', 0],
            ['2.4.0', '2.3.0', 1],
            ['2.3.0', '2.4.0', -1],
            ['2.10.0', '2.9.9', 1],
            ['2.4.0-beta.1', '2.4.0', -1],
            ['2.4.0', '2.4.0-beta.1', 1],
            ['2.4.0-beta.2', '2.4.0-beta.1', 1],
            ['2.4.0-beta.10', '2.4.0-beta.2', 1],
            ['2.4.0-alpha', '2.4.0-beta', -1],
            ['3.0.0-alpha.1', '2.9.9', 1],
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/StateAndLockTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStep;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\FileUpdateLock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\JsonUpdateStateStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class StateAndLockTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;
    private UpdateTarget $coreTarget;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = str_replace('\\', '/', sys_get_temp_dir()) . '/ds_state_lock_' . uniqid('', true);
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0777, true);
        $this->coreTarget = new UpdateTarget(
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            repository: 'hadelrachid/domain-system',
            installedVersion: '2.3.0',
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testLoadWithoutFileReturnsIdleState(): void
    {
        $store = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $state = $store->load($this->coreTarget);

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Idle, $state->step);
        $this->assertSame('idle', $state->updateId);
        $this->assertSame('core', $state->target->slug);
    }

    public function testSaveAndReloadPersistsStateAtomically(): void
    {
        $store = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $release = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'Melhorias de segurança',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            sizeBytes: 4096,
            sha256: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855',
            etag: 'W/"abc"',
        );

        $state = new UpdateState(
            updateId: 'upd-2026-01',
            target: $this->coreTarget,
            step: UpdateStep::BackedUp,
            release: $release,
            etag: 'W/"abc"',
            lastCheckAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            context: ['backup_id' => 'bkp-123'],
            error: null,
            updatedAt: '2026-10-19T12:05:00Z',
        );

        $store->save($state);
        $this->assertFileExists($this->tempDir . '/storage/state/update-core.json');

        $reloaded = $store->load($this->coreTarget);
        $this->assertSame('upd-2026-01', $reloaded->updateId);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::BackedUp, $reloaded->step);
        $this->assertNotNull($reloaded->release);
        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $reloaded->release->version);
        $this->assertSame(['backup_id' => 'bkp-123'], $reloaded->context);
    }

    public function testFileUpdateLockPreventsConcurrentAcquireRestoresOnExpiryAndReleases(): void
    {
        $now = 1_700_000_000;
        $lock = new FileUpdateLock($this->tempDir, static function () use (&$now): int {
            return $now;
        });

        // 1º acquire tem sucesso
        $this->assertTrue($lock->acquire($this->coreTarget, 300));
        $this->assertFileExists($this->tempDir . '/storage/state/update-core.lock');

        // 2º acquire seguido falha (não bloqueia)
        $this->assertFalse($lock->acquire($this->coreTarget, 300));

        // Avança o relógio além do TTL (300s) -> lock expirado pode ser reaproveitado
        $now += 301;
        $this->assertTrue($lock->acquire($this->coreTarget, 300));

        // Liberação explícita permite novo acquire imediato
        $lock->release($this->coreTarget);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->acquire($this->coreTarget, 300));
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (scandir($dir) ?: [] as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/SystemUpdaterM1Test.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\JsonUpdateStateStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateCheckResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Controllers\UpdateController;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Plugin;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Widgets\UpdateWidgetProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class SystemUpdaterM1Test extends TestCase
{
    private const VALID_HASH = 'a948904f2f0f479b8f8197694b30184b0d2ed1c1cd2a1ec0fb85d299a192a447';

    private string $tempDir;
    private UpdateTarget $coreTarget;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = str_replace('\\', '/', sys_get_temp_dir()) . '/ds_m1_updater_' . uniqid('', true);
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0777, true);
        $this->coreTarget = new UpdateTarget(
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            repository: 'hadelrachid/domain-system',
            installedVersion: '2.3.0',
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testControllerEscapesXssInChangelogAndRejectsInvalidCsrfAndNonAdmin(): void
    {
        $releaseWithXss = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: "Correção importante <script>alert('xss')</script>",
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            sizeBytes: 1000,
            sha256: self::VALID_HASH,
        );

        $checkResult = new UpdateCheckResult(
            status: UpdateStatus::Available,
            target: $this->coreTarget,
            release: $releaseWithXss,
            reasons: ['Nova versão 2.4.0 disponível.'],
            checkedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );

        $checker = new class ($checkResult) implements UpdateCheckerInterface {
            public bool $lastForce = false;
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateCheckResult $res) {}
            public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult
            {
                $this->lastForce = $force;
                return $this->res;
            }
        };

        $resolver = new class ($this->coreTarget) implements UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateTarget $target) {}
            public function core(): UpdateTarget
            {
                return $this->target;
            }
        };

        $theme = new class implements ThemeManagerInterface {
            public function setActiveThemePath(string $path): void {}
            public function getActiveThemePath(): string { return ''; }
            public function get_header(array $args = []): string { return ''; }
            public function get_footer(array $args = []): string { return ''; }
            public function getAvailableThemes(): array { return []; }
            public function getAvailableTemplates(?string $themeName = null): array { return []; }
            public function getAvailablePages(?string $themeName = null): array { return []; }
            public function render(string $template, array $args = [], ?string $pluginViewsDir = null): string
            {
                $viewFile = ($pluginViewsDir ?? '') . '/' . $template . '.php';
                extract($args, EXTR_SKIP);
                ob_start();
                include $viewFile;
                return (string)ob_get_clean();
            }
        };

        $adminSession = $this->createFakeSession('admin', 'csrf-secret-123');
        $stateStore = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);

        $controller = new UpdateController(
            theme: $theme,
            session: $adminSession,
            checker: $checker,
            targetResolver: $resolver,
            stateStore: $stateStore,
        );

        // 1. GET /admin/settings/updates renderiza ViewResponse (envelopado no layout Admin) com changelog escapado contra XSS
        $response = $controller->index(new Request(['checked' => '1']));
        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse::class, $response);
        $this->assertTrue($response->shouldWrapLayout());
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $html = $response->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('v2.3.0', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('v2.4.0', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString("<script>alert('xss')</script>", $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString("&lt;script&gt;alert(&#039;xss&#039;)&lt;/script&gt;", $html);

        // 2. POST /admin/settings/updates/core/check com CSRF inválido -> 403
        $badCsrfResponse = $controller->check(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'token-errado']));
        $this->assertSame(403, $badCsrfResponse->getStatusCode());

        // 3. POST /admin/settings/updates/core/check com CSRF válido -> 302 e $force = true
        $goodCsrfResponse = $controller->check(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-secret-123']));
        $this->assertSame(302, $goodCsrfResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertTrue($checker->lastForce);

        // 4. Papel não-admin -> 403
        $subscriberController = new UpdateController(
            theme: $theme,
            session: $this->createFakeSession('subscriber', 'csrf-secret-123'),
            checker: $checker,
            targetResolver: $resolver,
            stateStore: $stateStore,
        );
        $this->assertSame(403, $subscriberController->index()->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $subscriberController->check(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-secret-123']))->getStatusCode());
    }

    public function testWidgetRendersBadgeWhenUpdateAvailableAndCleanStatusWhenUpToDate(): void
    {
        $resolver = new class ($this->coreTarget) implements UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateTarget $target) {}
            public function core(): UpdateTarget { return $this->target; }
        };

        $release = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'Novidades',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            sizeBytes: 500,
            sha256: self::VALID_HASH,
        );

        $availableResult = new UpdateCheckResult(
            UpdateStatus::Available,
            $this->coreTarget,
            $release,
            [],
            '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );

        $availableWidget = new UpdateWidgetProvider(
            new class ($availableResult) implements UpdateCheckerInterface {
                public function __construct(private readonly UpdateCheckResult $r) {}
                public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult { return $this->r; }
            },
            $resolver,
        );

        $htmlAvailable = $availableWidget->renderWidget(UpdateWidgetProvider::WIDGET_ID);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Nova versão disponível', $htmlAvailable);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('v2.4.0', $htmlAvailable);

        $upToDateResult = new UpdateCheckResult(
            UpdateStatus::UpToDate,
            $this->coreTarget,
            $release,
            [],
            '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );

        $upToDateWidget = new UpdateWidgetProvider(
            new class ($upToDateResult) implements UpdateCheckerInterface {
                public function __construct(private readonly UpdateCheckResult $r) {}
                public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult { return $this->r; }
            },
            $resolver,
        );

        $htmlUpToDate = $upToDateWidget->renderWidget(UpdateWidgetProvider::WIDGET_ID);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sistema atualizado', $htmlUpToDate);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Nova versão disponível', $htmlUpToDate);
    }

    public function testNotificationPushesOnlyOncePerVersion(): void
    {
        $pushed = [];
        $notifications = new class ($pushed) implements NotificationManagerInterface {
            /** @var list<array{message: string, type: string, source: ?string, context: array<string, mixed>}> */
            public array $items = [];
            public function __construct(array &$ref)
            {
                $this->items = &$ref;
            }
            public function push(string $message, string $type = 'info', ?string $source = null, array $context = []): void
            {
                $this->items[] = ['message' => $message, 'type' => $type, 'source' => $source, 'context' => $context];
            }
            public function getUnread(): array { return $this->items; }
            public function markAsRead(): void {}
            public function getAll(): array { return $this->items; }
            public function clear(): void { $this->items = []; }
        };

        $release240 = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'OK',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            sizeBytes: 500,
            sha256: self::VALID_HASH,
        );

        $result240 = new UpdateCheckResult(
            UpdateStatus::Available,
            $this->coreTarget,
            $release240,
            [],
            '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );

        $stateStore = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $resolver = new class ($this->coreTarget) implements UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateTarget $target) {}
            public function core(): UpdateTarget { return $this->target; }
        };

        $widget = new UpdateWidgetProvider(
            new class ($result240) implements UpdateCheckerInterface {
                public function __construct(private readonly UpdateCheckResult $r) {}
                public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult { return $this->r; }
            },
            $resolver,
            $stateStore,
            null,
            $notifications,
        );

        // 1ª renderização detecta v2.4.0 e notifica
        $widget->renderWidget(UpdateWidgetProvider::WIDGET_ID);
        $this->assertCount(1, $notifications->items);
        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $notifications->items[0]['context']['version']);
        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $stateStore->load($this->coreTarget)->context['notified_version'] ?? null);

        // 2ª renderização com a mesma v2.4.0 NÃO repete a notificação
        $widget->renderWidget(UpdateWidgetProvider::WIDGET_ID);
        $this->assertCount(1, $notifications->items);
    }

    public function testPluginActivateRegistersSystemUpdateCapability(): void
    {
        $registered = [];
        $runtime = new class ($registered) implements OsRuntimeInterface {
            /** @var list<array{slug: string, context: string}> */
            public array $caps = [];
            public function __construct(array &$ref) { $this->caps = &$ref; }
            public function getLink(string $linkName) { return null; }
            public function contributeTo(string $slotName, mixed $payload): void {}
            public function onHook(string $hookName, callable $callback, int $priority = 0): void {}
            public function dispatchHook(string $hookName, mixed ...$payload): void {}
            public function applyFilter(string $filterName, mixed $value, mixed ...$args): mixed { return $value; }
            public function bind(string $abstract, callable|string $concrete): void {}
            public function singleton(string $abstract, callable|string $concrete): void {}
            public function make(string $class) { return null; }
            public function has(string $abstract): bool { return false; }
            public function hasLink(string $linkName): bool { return false; }
            public function registerCapability(string $slug, string $context = ''): void
            {

            }
        };

        $plugin = new Plugin(dirname(__DIR__, 3) . '/src/SystemApps/SystemUpdater');

    public function testPluginOsBootWithRealOsRuntimeRegistersWidgetWithoutSecurityAuditViolation(): void
    {
        $container = new \DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container();
        $dispatcher = new \DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher();
        $linkRegistry = new \DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry($container);
        $widgetRegistry = new \DomainSystem\Core\Registry\DashboardWidgetRegistry();

        $session = $this->createFakeSession('admin', 'csrf-123');
        $container->singleton(SessionManagerInterface::class, static fn() => $session);
        $container->singleton(\DomainSystem\Core\Security\SessionManager::class, static fn() => $session);
        $container->singleton(\DomainSystem\Core\Registry\DashboardWidgetRegistry::class, static fn() => $widgetRegistry);

        $connector = new \DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector();
        $plugin = new Plugin(dirname(__DIR__, 3) . '/src/SystemApps/SystemUpdater');
        $plugin->osRegister($connector);
        $linkRegistry->registerConnector('SystemUpdater', $connector);

        $osRuntime = new \DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime(
            $container,
            $connector,
            $linkRegistry,
            $dispatcher,
            'DomainSystem\\SystemApps\\SystemUpdater\\'
        );

        $plugin->osBoot($osRuntime);
        $dispatcher->dispatch('dashboard.register_widgets', $widgetRegistry);

        $this->assertNotNull($widgetRegistry->getProvider(UpdateWidgetProvider::class));
    }

    private function createFakeSession(string $role, string $csrfToken): SessionManagerInterface
    {
        return new class ($role, $csrfToken) implements SessionManagerInterface {
            public function __construct(
                private readonly string $role,
                private readonly string $csrf,
            ) {
            }
            public function start(): void {}
            public function getCsrfToken(): string { return $this->csrf; }
            public function validateCsrfToken(?string $token): bool
            {
                return $token !== null && hash_equals($this->csrf, $token);
            }
            public function get(string $key, $default = null)
            {
                if ($key === 'user_role') {
                    return $this->role;
                }
                return $default;
            }
            public function set(string $key, $value): void {}
            public function remove(string $key): void {}
            public function has(string $key): bool { return $key === 'user_role'; }
            public function destroy(): void {}
            public function setFlash(string $type, string $message): void {}
            public function getFlash(): ?array { return null; }
            public function regenerate(): void {}
        };
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (scandir($dir) ?: [] as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

    public function testControllerM2EndpointsEnforceAdminAndCsrfAndReturnJsonStates(): void
    {
        $stateStore = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $resolver = new class ($this->coreTarget) implements UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateTarget $target) {}
            public function core(): UpdateTarget { return $this->target; }
        };

        $checkResult = new UpdateCheckResult(
            status: UpdateStatus::Available,
            target: $this->coreTarget,
            release: $this->release240,
            reasons: [],
            checkedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );

        $checker = new class ($checkResult) implements UpdateCheckerInterface {
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateCheckResult $res) {}
            public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult { return $this->res; }
        };

        $fakeUpdater = $this->createFakeCoreUpdater($stateStore, $checkResult);
        $fakeBackup = $this->createFakeBackup();

        $theme = new class implements ThemeManagerInterface {
            public function setActiveThemePath(string $path): void {}
            public function getActiveThemePath(): string { return ''; }
            public function get_header(array $args = []): string { return ''; }
            public function get_footer(array $args = []): string { return ''; }
            public function getAvailableThemes(): array { return []; }
            public function getAvailableTemplates(?string $themeName = null): array { return []; }
            public function getAvailablePages(?string $themeName = null): array { return []; }
            public function render(string $template, array $args = [], ?string $pluginViewsDir = null): string
            {
                $viewFile = ($pluginViewsDir ?? '') . '/' . $template . '.php';
                extract($args, EXTR_SKIP);
                ob_start();
                include $viewFile;
                return (string)ob_get_clean();
            }
        };

        $adminController = new UpdateController(
            theme: $theme,
            session: $this->createFakeSession('admin', 'csrf-m2'),
            checker: $checker,
            targetResolver: $resolver,
            stateStore: $stateStore,
            coreUpdater: $fakeUpdater,
            backup: $fakeBackup,
        );

        // 1. View M2 renderiza botão de atualização, painel de progresso e backups
        $indexRes = $adminController->index(new Request());
        $this->assertSame(200, $indexRes->getStatusCode());
        $html = $indexRes->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Atualizar para v2.4.0', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-update-progress-panel', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('bkp-20261019-01', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Remover antigos', $html);

        // 2. CSRF inválido recusado em begin, advance, rollback e pruneBackups
        $this->assertSame(403, $adminController->begin(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'bad']))->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $adminController->advance(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'bad', 'update_id' => 'u1']))->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $adminController->rollback(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'bad']))->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $adminController->pruneBackups(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'bad']))->getStatusCode());

        // 3. Papel não-admin recusado em todas as rotas M2
        $guestController = new UpdateController(
            theme: $theme,
            session: $this->createFakeSession('subscriber', 'csrf-m2'),
            checker: $checker,
            targetResolver: $resolver,
            stateStore: $stateStore,
            coreUpdater: $fakeUpdater,
            backup: $fakeBackup,
        );
        $this->assertSame(403, $guestController->begin(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2']))->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $guestController->advance(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2', 'update_id' => 'u1']))->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $guestController->rollback(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2']))->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(403, $guestController->pruneBackups(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2']))->getStatusCode());

        // 4. Fluxo JSON válido: begin -> advance -> rollback -> pruneBackups
        $beginRes = $adminController->begin(new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'           => 'csrf-m2',
            'confirm_no_db_backup' => '1',
        ]));
        $this->assertSame(200, $beginRes->getStatusCode());
        $beginPayload = json_decode($beginRes->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($beginPayload['ok']);
        $this->assertSame('checked', $beginPayload['state']['step']);
        $this->assertTrue($fakeUpdater->lastConfirmNoDbBackup);

        $updateId = (string)$beginPayload['state']['updateId'];
        $advRes = $adminController->advance(new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2',
            'update_id'  => $updateId,
        ]));
        $this->assertSame(200, $advRes->getStatusCode());
        $advPayload = json_decode($advRes->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($advPayload['ok']);
        $this->assertSame('downloaded', $advPayload['state']['step']);

        // Rollback de backup específico
        $rbSpecific = $adminController->rollback(new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2',
            'backup_id'  => 'bkp-20261019-01',
        ]));
        $this->assertSame(200, $rbSpecific->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame('bkp-20261019-01', $fakeBackup->restoredId);

        // Prune de backups antigos
        $pruneRes = $adminController->pruneBackups(new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'csrf-m2']));
        $this->assertSame(200, $pruneRes->getStatusCode());
        $prunePayload = json_decode($pruneRes->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($prunePayload['ok']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $prunePayload['removed']);
    }

    public function testCliCommandHandlerExecutesCheckStatusUpdateRollbackAndHealthEndToEnd(): void
    {
        $stateStore = new JsonUpdateStateStore($this->tempDir);
        $resolver = new class ($this->coreTarget) implements UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            public function __construct(private readonly UpdateTarget $target) {}
            public function core(): UpdateTarget { return $this->target; }
        };

        $checkResult = new UpdateCheckResult(
            status: UpdateStatus::Available,
            target: $this->coreTarget,
            release: $this->release240,
            reasons: ['Nova versão 2.4.0 encontrada.'],
            checkedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );

        $fakeUpdater = $this->createFakeCoreUpdater($stateStore, $checkResult);
        $fakeBackup = $this->createFakeBackup();

        $healthCheck = new class implements HealthCheckInterface {
            public int $runs = 0;
            public function run(UpdateTarget $target): HealthReport
            {
                $this->runs++;
                return new HealthReport(true, [
                    ['id' => 'ds_version', 'ok' => true, 'message' => 'Versão carregada v2.4.0.'],
                ]);
            }
        };

        $cli = new UpdateCliCommandHandler(
            updater: $fakeUpdater,
            targetResolver: $resolver,
            stateStore: $stateStore,
            healthCheck: $healthCheck,
            backup: $fakeBackup,
        );

        // 1. system:check
        $checkOut = $cli->execute('system:check');
        $this->assertSame(0, $checkOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('v2.4.0', $checkOut['output']);

        // 2. system:update sem --yes deve recusar com instrução
        $noConfirmOut = $cli->execute('system:update', []);
        $this->assertSame(1, $noConfirmOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--yes', $noConfirmOut['output']);

        // 3. system:update --yes --confirm-no-db-backup percorre todas as etapas, inclusive awaiting=health, até Done
        $updateOut = $cli->execute('system:update', ['--yes', '--confirm-no-db-backup']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $updateOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertTrue($fakeUpdater->lastConfirmNoDbBackup);
        $this->assertSame(1, $healthCheck->runs);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Atualização concluída com sucesso para v2.4.0', $updateOut['output']);

        // 4. system:status após Done
        $statusOut = $cli->execute('system:status');
        $this->assertSame(0, $statusOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('done', $statusOut['output']);

        // 5. system:health
        $healthOut = $cli->execute('system:health');
        $this->assertSame(0, $healthOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Saúde do sistema: OK', $healthOut['output']);

        // 6. system:rollback com ID de backup específico
        $rbBackupOut = $cli->execute('system:rollback', ['bkp-20261019-02']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $rbBackupOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertSame('bkp-20261019-02', $fakeBackup->restoredId);

        // 7. system:rollback da atualização ativa
        $rbUpdateOut = $cli->execute('system:rollback');
        $this->assertSame(0, $rbUpdateOut['exitCode']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Rollback concluído', $rbUpdateOut['output']);
    }

    private function createFakeCoreUpdater(JsonUpdateStateStore $stateStore, UpdateCheckResult $checkResult): CoreUpdaterInterface
    {
        return new class ($stateStore, $checkResult, $this->coreTarget, $this->release240) implements CoreUpdaterInterface {
            public bool $lastConfirmNoDbBackup = false;

            /** @var list<UpdateStep> */
            private array $sequence = [
                UpdateStep::Downloaded,
                UpdateStep::Verified,
                UpdateStep::Preflighted,
                UpdateStep::BackedUp,
                UpdateStep::MaintenanceOn,
                UpdateStep::Applied,
                UpdateStep::Migrated,
                UpdateStep::SchemaVerified,
                UpdateStep::HealthChecked,
                UpdateStep::Done,
            ];
            private int $cursor = 0;

            public function __construct(
                private readonly JsonUpdateStateStore $store,
                private readonly UpdateCheckResult $checkResult,
                private readonly UpdateTarget $target,
                private readonly ReleaseInfo $release,
            ) {
            }

            public function kind(): UpdateKind
            {
                return UpdateKind::Core;
            }

            public function check(UpdateTarget $target, bool $force = false): UpdateCheckResult
            {
                return $this->checkResult;
            }

            public function begin(UpdateTarget $target, array $options = []): UpdateState
            {
                $this->lastConfirmNoDbBackup = !empty($options['confirmNoDbBackup']);
                $this->cursor = 0;
                $state = new UpdateState(
                    updateId: 'upd-m2-test',
                    target: $target,
                    step: UpdateStep::Checked,
                    release: $this->release,
                    etag: null,
                    lastCheckAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
                    context: [],
                    error: null,
                    updatedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
                );
                $this->store->save($state);
                return $state;
            }

            public function advance(string $updateId): UpdateState
            {
                $current = $this->store->load($this->target);
                $nextStep = $this->sequence[$this->cursor] ?? UpdateStep::Done;

                if ($nextStep === UpdateStep::HealthChecked && !isset($current->context['health_report'])) {
                    $ctx = $current->context;
                    $ctx['awaiting'] = 'health';
                    $waitingState = new UpdateState(
                        updateId: $updateId,
                        target: $this->target,
                        step: UpdateStep::SchemaVerified,
                        release: $this->release,
                        etag: null,
                        lastCheckAt: $current->lastCheckAt,
                        context: $ctx,
                        error: null,
                        updatedAt: '2026-10-19T12:01:00Z',
                    );
                    $this->store->save($waitingState);
                    return $waitingState;
                }

                $this->cursor++;
                $nextState = new UpdateState(
                    updateId: $updateId,
                    target: $this->target,
                    step: $nextStep,
                    release: $this->release,
                    etag: null,
                    lastCheckAt: $current->lastCheckAt,
                    context: $current->context,
                    error: null,
                    updatedAt: '2026-10-19T12:02:00Z',
                );
                $this->store->save($nextState);
                return $nextState;
            }

            public function rollback(string $updateId): UpdateState
            {
                $rbState = new UpdateState(
                    updateId: $updateId,
                    target: $this->target,
                    step: UpdateStep::RolledBack,
                    release: $this->release,
                    etag: null,
                    lastCheckAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
                    context: [],
                    error: null,
                    updatedAt: '2026-10-19T12:03:00Z',
                );
                $this->store->save($rbState);
                return $rbState;
            }

            public function status(string $updateId): UpdateState
            {
                return $this->store->load($this->target);
            }
        };
    }

    private function createFakeBackup(): BackupInterface
    {
        return new class implements BackupInterface {
            public ?string $restoredId = null;

            public function create(BackupScope $scope, string $label, ?string $dumpPath = null): BackupRecord
            {
                return new BackupRecord('bkp-new', $scope, $label, '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z', '/tmp/code.zip', $dumpPath);
            }

            public function restore(BackupRecord $record): void
            {
                $this->restoredId = $record->id;
            }

            public function list(?BackupScope $scope = null): array
            {
                $scope ??= new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core');
                return [
                    new BackupRecord('bkp-20261019-01', $scope, 'v2.3.0', '2026-10-19T10:00:00Z', '/tmp/1.zip', '/tmp/1.sql'),
                    new BackupRecord('bkp-20261019-02', $scope, 'v2.2.0', '2026-10-18T10:00:00Z', '/tmp/2.zip', null),
                    new BackupRecord('bkp-20261019-03', $scope, 'v2.1.0', '2026-10-17T10:00:00Z', '/tmp/3.zip', null),
                ];
            }

            public function prune(BackupScope $scope, int $keepLast = 2): int
            {
                return 1;
            }
        };
    }

    private function createFakeSession(string $role, string $csrfToken): SessionManagerInterface
    {
        return new class ($role, $csrfToken) implements SessionManagerInterface {
            public function __construct(
                private readonly string $role,
                private readonly string $csrf,
            ) {
            }
            public function start(): void {}
            public function getCsrfToken(): string { return $this->csrf; }
            public function validateCsrfToken(?string $token): bool
            {
                return $token !== null && hash_equals($this->csrf, $token);
            }
            public function get(string $key, $default = null)
            {
                if ($key === 'user_role') {
                    return $this->role;
                }
                return $default;
            }
            public function set(string $key, $value): void {}
            public function remove(string $key): void {}
            public function has(string $key): bool { return $key === 'user_role'; }
            public function destroy(): void {}
            public function setFlash(string $type, string $message): void {}
            public function getFlash(): ?array { return null; }
            public function regenerate(): void {}
        };
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (scandir($dir) ?: [] as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDirectory($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStep;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\ApplyException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\InvalidManifestException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PreflightFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\RollbackFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SchemaMigrationException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SchemaPlanException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SourceUnavailableException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\TransportException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\UpdateException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ApplyResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupRecord;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DownloadedPackage;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DumpResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HealthReport;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HttpResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\InstalledPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightReport;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaPlan;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaVerification;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateCheckResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateManifest;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use ReflectionClass;

final class ValueObjectsTest extends TestCase
{
    private const VALID_HASH = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855';

    public function testAllValueObjectsAreFinalReadonlyAndHaveNoSetters(): void
    {
        $classes = [
            UpdateTarget::class,
            ReleaseInfo::class,
            DownloadedPackage::class,
            VerifiedPackage::class,
            UpdateManifest::class,
            UpdateCheckResult::class,
            PreflightCheck::class,
            PreflightReport::class,
            SchemaPlan::class,
            SchemaResult::class,
            SchemaVerification::class,
            BackupScope::class,
            BackupRecord::class,
            DumpResult::class,
            ApplyResult::class,
            HealthReport::class,
            UpdateState::class,
            HttpResponse::class,
            InstalledPlugin::class,
        ];

        foreach ($classes as $class) {
            $ref = new ReflectionClass($class);
            $this->assertTrue($ref->isFinal(), "{$class} deve ser final");
            $this->assertTrue($ref->isReadOnly(), "{$class} deve ser readonly");

            foreach ($ref->getMethods() as $method) {
                $this->assertFalse(
                    str_starts_with($method->getName(), 'set'),
                    "{$class} não deve expor setters ({$method->getName()})"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    public function testAllExceptionsInheritFromUpdateException(): void
    {
        $exceptions = [
            TransportException::class,
            SourceUnavailableException::class,
            InvalidManifestException::class,
            PackageIntegrityException::class,
            PreflightFailedException::class,
            SchemaPlanException::class,
            SchemaMigrationException::class,
            ApplyException::class,
            RollbackFailedException::class,
        ];

        foreach ($exceptions as $exceptionClass) {
            $instance = new $exceptionClass('Falha de teste');
            $this->assertInstanceOf(UpdateException::class, $instance);
            $this->assertSame('Falha de teste', $instance->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function testUpdateTargetValidation(): void
    {
        $target = new UpdateTarget(
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            repository: 'hadelrachid/domain-system',
            installedVersion: '2.3.0',
        );
        $this->assertSame('stable', $target->channel);
        $this->assertSame($target->toArray(), UpdateTarget::fromArray($target->toArray())->toArray());

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        new UpdateTarget(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', 'repo-invalido', '2.3.0');
    }

    public function testReleaseInfoValidatesSha256(): void
    {
        $release = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'Novidades v2.4.0',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            sizeBytes: 1024,
            sha256: self::VALID_HASH,
            etag: 'W/"123"',
        );

        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $release->version);
        $this->assertSame($release->toArray(), ReleaseInfo::fromArray($release->toArray())->toArray());

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: '',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/x.zip',
            assetName: 'x.zip',
            sizeBytes: 10,
            sha256: 'hash-curto',
        );
    }

    public function testUpdateManifestValidatesFilesAndMigrationsWithAmendments(): void
    {
        $manifest = new UpdateManifest(
            protocol: 1,
            minUpdaterProtocol: 1,
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            version: '2.4.0',
            requires: [
                'php'        => '8.1',
                'extensions' => ['pdo', 'zip', 'curl'],
                'osVersion'  => '2.3',
            ],
            files: [
                [
                    'path'   => 'src/Core/Application.php',
                    'sha256' => self::VALID_HASH,
                    'size'   => 512,
                    'mode'   => 'replace',
                ],
                [
                    'path'   => 'config/update.json',
                    'sha256' => self::VALID_HASH,
                    'size'   => 128,
                    'mode'   => 'default_if_missing',
                ],
            ],
            removed: ['src/Core/Obsolete.php'],
            migrations: [
                [
                    'scope'  => '__core__',
                    'name'   => '2026_11_01_000001_init',
                    'sha256' => self::VALID_HASH,
                    'type'   => 'additive',
                ],
            ],
            expects: [
                'academy_modules' => ['folder_slug'],
            ],
        );

        $this->assertCount(2, $manifest->files);
        $this->assertSame('default_if_missing', $manifest->files[1]['mode']);
        $this->assertSame('__core__', $manifest->migrations[0]['scope']);

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        new UpdateManifest(
            protocol: 1,
            minUpdaterProtocol: 1,
            kind: UpdateKind::Core,
            slug: 'core',
            version: '2.4.0',
            requires: ['php' => '8.1', 'extensions' => ['pdo'], 'osVersion' => '2.3'],
            files: [['path' => 'src/Foo.php', 'sha256' => self::VALID_HASH, 'size' => 10, 'mode' => 'modo_invalido']],
            removed: [],
            migrations: [],
            expects: [],
        );
    }

    public function testPreflightReportCanProceedIsFalseOnlyWhenBlockExists(): void
    {
        $okAndWarn = new PreflightReport([
            new PreflightCheck('php', CheckLevel::Ok, 'PHP 8.2 OK'),
            new PreflightCheck('plugin_compat', CheckLevel::Warn, 'Plugin custom com os_version antigo'),
        ]);
        $this->assertTrue($okAndWarn->canProceed());
        $this->assertCount(1, $okAndWarn->warnings());
        $this->assertCount(0, $okAndWarn->blocks());

        $withBlock = new PreflightReport([
            new PreflightCheck('php', CheckLevel::Ok, 'PHP 8.2 OK'),
            new PreflightCheck('disk', CheckLevel::Block, 'Espaço insuficiente'),
        ]);
        $this->assertFalse($withBlock->canProceed());
        $this->assertCount(1, $withBlock->blocks());
    }

    public function testUpdateStateImmutableTransitions(): void
    {
        $target = new UpdateTarget(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', 'hadelrachid/domain-system', '2.3.0');
        $state0 = UpdateState::idle($target, '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z');

        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Idle, $state0->step);
        $this->assertNull($state0->error);

        $state1 = $state0->withStep(UpdateStep::Downloaded, '2026-10-19T12:01:00Z');
        $this->assertNotSame($state0, $state1);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Idle, $state0->step);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Downloaded, $state1->step);

        $state2 = $state1->withContext(['backup_id' => 'bkp-01'], '2026-10-19T12:02:00Z');
        $this->assertSame([], $state1->context);
        $this->assertSame(['backup_id' => 'bkp-01'], $state2->context);

        $state3 = $state2->withError('Falha ao migrar', UpdateStep::Failed, '2026-10-19T12:03:00Z');
        $this->assertNull($state2->error);
        $this->assertSame('Falha ao migrar', $state3->error);
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStep::Failed, $state3->step);

        $rehydrated = UpdateState::fromArray($state3->toArray(), $target);
        $this->assertSame($state3->toArray(), $rehydrated->toArray());
    }

    public function testOtherValueObjectsConstructAndValidateProperly(): void
    {
        $target = new UpdateTarget(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', 'hadelrachid/domain-system', '2.3.0');
        $release = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'OK',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/x.zip',
            assetName: 'x.zip',
            sizeBytes: 100,
            sha256: self::VALID_HASH,
        );

        $downloaded = new DownloadedPackage($release, '/tmp/x.zip', 100);
        $this->assertSame('/tmp/x.zip', $downloaded->archivePath);

        $manifest = new UpdateManifest(
            1,
            1,
            UpdateKind::Core,
            'core',
            '2.4.0',
            ['php' => '8.1', 'extensions' => ['pdo'], 'osVersion' => '2.3'],
            [],
            [],
            [],
            [],
        );
        $verified = new VerifiedPackage($release, $manifest, '/tmp/extracted');
        $this->assertSame('/tmp/extracted', $verified->extractedPath);

        $checkResult = new UpdateCheckResult(
            UpdateStatus::Available,
            $target,
            $release,
            ['Nova versão disponível'],
            '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
        );
        $this->assertSame(UpdateStatus::Available, $checkResult->status);

        $plan = new SchemaPlan(
            scope: 'core',
            pending: [['scope' => '__core__', 'name' => '2026_10_19_000001_a', 'sha256' => self::VALID_HASH, 'type' => 'additive']],
            blocked: [],
            destructive: false,
            requiresDatabaseBackup: false,
        );
        $this->assertCount(1, $plan->pending);

        $schemaRes = new SchemaResult(['2026_10_19_000001_a']);
        $this->assertTrue($schemaRes->isOk());

        $verification = new SchemaVerification(true);
        $this->assertTrue($verification->ok);

        $scope = new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core');
        $record = new BackupRecord('bkp-1', $scope, 'Pre-update', '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z', '/tmp/code.zip', '/tmp/db.sql');
        $this->assertSame($record->toArray(), BackupRecord::fromArray($record->toArray())->toArray());

        $dump = new DumpResult('/tmp/db.sql', 2048, 5);
        $this->assertSame(5, $dump->tablesCount);

        $apply = new ApplyResult($record, ['src/Core/Foo.php'], ['src/Core/Old.php'], ['.env']);
        $this->assertSame(['.env'], $apply->skippedProtected);

        $health = new HealthReport(true, [['id' => 'version', 'ok' => true, 'message' => 'v2.4.0 ativa']]);
        $this->assertTrue(HealthReport::fromArray($health->toArray())->ok);

        $resp304 = new HttpResponse(304, ['etag' => 'W/"1"'], '', 'W/"1"');
        $this->assertTrue($resp304->isNotModified());

        $plugin = new InstalledPlugin('academy', '1.0.0', '2.3', false, true);
        $this->assertTrue($plugin->isActive);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/VersionConsistencyTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class VersionConsistencyTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testDsVersionInBootstrapMatchesComposerJsonVersion(): void
    {
        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $bootstrapPath = $root . '/bootstrap.php';
        $composerPath = $root . '/composer.json';

        $this->assertFileExists($bootstrapPath);
        $this->assertFileExists($composerPath);

        $bootstrapSource = (string)file_get_contents($bootstrapPath);
        $matched = preg_match(
            "/define\\(\\s*['\"]DS_VERSION['\"]\\s*,\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]\\s*\\)\\s*;/",
            $bootstrapSource,
            $matches
        );

        $this->assertSame(1, $matched, 'Constante DS_VERSION deve estar definida literalmente em bootstrap.php');
        $dsVersion = $matches[1];

        $composerData = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($composerPath), true);
        $this->assertIsArray($composerData, 'composer.json deve conter JSON válido');
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('version', $composerData, 'composer.json deve declarar o campo version');

        $this->assertSame(
            (string)$composerData['version'],
            $dsVersion,
            'DS_VERSION em bootstrap.php deve ser idêntica ao campo version em composer.json'
        );
    }

    public function testAllOfficialPluginManifestsMatchCoreVersion(): void
    {
        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $composerData = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($root . '/composer.json'), true);
        $this->assertIsArray($composerData);
        $expectedVersion = (string)$composerData['version'];
        $versionParts = explode('.', $expectedVersion);
        $expectedOsVersion = $versionParts[0] . '.' . ($versionParts[1] ?? '0');

        $manifestFiles = array_merge(
            glob($root . '/src/Plugins/*/plugin.json') ?: [],
            glob($root . '/src/Plugins/*/*/plugin.json') ?: [],
            glob($root . '/src/SystemApps/*/plugin.json') ?: []
        );

        $this->assertNotEmpty($manifestFiles, 'Devem existir manifestos plugin.json em src/Plugins e src/SystemApps');

        foreach ($manifestFiles as $file) {
            $relPath = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file, strlen($root) + 1));
            $data = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($file), true);
            $this->assertIsArray($data, "JSON inválido em {$relPath}");
            $this->assertSame(
                $expectedVersion,
                $data['version'] ?? null,
                "Campo 'version' em {$relPath} deve estar padronizado em {$expectedVersion}"
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                $expectedOsVersion,
                $data['os_version'] ?? null,
                "Campo 'os_version' em {$relPath} deve estar padronizado em {$expectedOsVersion}"
            );
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/VideoBlockTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\VideoBlock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class VideoBlockTest extends TestCase
{
    private VideoBlock $block;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->block = new VideoBlock();
    }

    public function testBlockAttributesAndRestrictions(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('video', $this->block->getType());
        $this->assertSame('Vídeo', $this->block->getName());
        $this->assertSame('media', $this->block->getCategory());
        $this->assertSame([ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION], $this->block->getAllowedPartTypes());
    }

    public function testRenderEmptyWhenUrlMissing(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('', $this->block->render([]));
        $this->assertSame('', $this->block->render(['url' => '']));
        $this->assertSame('', $this->block->render(['url' => '   ']));
    }

    public function testRenderYouTubeWatchUrl(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderYouTubeWatchWithExtraQueryParams(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=shared&si=abc123xyz&v=dQw4w9WgXcQ&t=42s']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderYouTubeShorts(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dQw4w9WgXcQ']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderYouTubeLive(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://www.youtube.com/live/dQw4w9WgXcQ']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderYoutuBeShortUrl(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ?t=10']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderPastedIframeSnippet(): void
    {
        $snippet = '<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>';
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => $snippet]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderVimeoUrl(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://vimeo.com/76979871']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://player.vimeo.com/video/76979871', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderFallbackToResponsiveKeys(): void
    {
        $htmlTablet = $this->block->render(['url_tablet' => 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $htmlTablet);

        $htmlMobile = $this->block->render(['url_mobile' => 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ', $htmlMobile);
    }

    public function testRenderDirectMp4Video(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => 'https://example.com/videos/hero.mp4']);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<video', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('src="https://example.com/videos/hero.mp4"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('controls', $html);
    }

    public function testRenderUploadedLocalMp4Video(): void
    {
        $html = $this->block->render(['url' => '/uploads/builder/media_12345_abcde.mp4']);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('iframe', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<video', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('src="/uploads/builder/media_12345_abcde.mp4"', $html);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/WebhookSecurityAndIdempotencyTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\WebhookController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class WebhookSecurityAndIdempotencyTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoOrderRepository $orderRepo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);
        $this->orderRepo->ensureTable();
    }

    public function testAmountMismatchLeavesOrderPending(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_MISMATCH_100',
            'user_id'        => 5,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 10,
            'total'          => 100.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
        ]);

        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('mercadopago');
        $gateway->method('handleWebhook')->willReturn([
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_MISMATCH_100',
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => 'TX_UNDERPAID',
            'total'          => 10.00, // Pagou apenas 10 em vez de 100
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
        ]);

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('mercadopago')->willReturn($gateway);

        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->expects($this->never())->method('dispatch');

        $controller = new WebhookController($this->orderRepo, $registry, $dispatcher, $this->pdo);

        $request = new Request([], ['order_ref' => 'ORD_MISMATCH_100']);
        $response = $controller->handle($request, 'mercadopago');

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $body = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertSame('amount_mismatch', $body['action'] ?? null);

        // O pedido continua pendente
        $order = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $order['status']);
    }

    public function testDuplicateWebhookReturnsDuplicateActionAndDoesNotRedispatch(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_DUP_200',
            'user_id'        => 7,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 12,
            'total'          => 80.00,
            'status'         => 'paid', // Já liquidado anteriormente
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
        ]);

        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('mercadopago');
        $gateway->method('handleWebhook')->willReturn([
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_DUP_200',
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => 'TX_DUP',
            'total'          => 80.00,
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
        ]);

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('mercadopago')->willReturn($gateway);

        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->expects($this->never())->method('dispatch');

        $controller = new WebhookController($this->orderRepo, $registry, $dispatcher, $this->pdo);

        $request = new Request([], ['order_ref' => 'ORD_DUP_200']);
        $response = $controller->handle($request, 'mercadopago');

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $body = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertSame('duplicate', $body['action'] ?? null);
    }

    public function testRefundWebhookDispatchesPaymentRefundedAndUpdateOrderStatus(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_REFUND_300',
            'user_id'        => 9,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 15,
            'total'          => 150.00,
            'status'         => 'paid',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'credit_card',
        ]);

        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('mercadopago');
        $gateway->method('handleWebhook')->willReturn([
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_REFUND_300',
            'status'         => 'refunded',
            'transaction_id' => 'TX_REFUND',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
        ]);

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('mercadopago')->willReturn($gateway);

        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->expects($this->once())
            ->method('dispatch')
            ->with('payment.refunded', [
                'user_id'   => 9,
                'course_id' => 15,
                'order_ref' => 'ORD_REFUND_300',
            ]);

        $controller = new WebhookController($this->orderRepo, $registry, $dispatcher, $this->pdo);

        $request = new Request([], ['order_ref' => 'ORD_REFUND_300']);
        $response = $controller->handle($request, 'mercadopago');

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $body = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertSame('refunded', $body['order_status'] ?? null);

        $order = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertSame('refunded', $order['status']);
    }
