    public function testAffiliateWebhookReturns500WhenUserProvisioningFailsTemporarilyAndIsIdempotentOnRetry(): void
    {
        $this->createAffiliateSupportTables();

        // Simula falha temporária de escrita na tabela users durante a 1ª entrega do webhook
        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TRIGGER trg_fail_user_insert
            BEFORE INSERT ON users
            BEGIN
                SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Temporary DB lock during provisioning');
            END;
        ");

        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('hotmart');
        $gateway->method('handleWebhook')->willReturn([
            'order_ref'      => 'HOT_RETRY_001',
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => 'HP_RETRY_001',
            'product_id'     => 'PROD_CURSO_01',
            'student_email'  => 'retry.aluno@exemplo.com',
            'student_name'   => 'Aluno Retry',
            'total'          => 197.00,
            'gateway'        => 'hotmart',
        ]);

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('hotmart')->willReturn($gateway);

        $dispatchCount = 0;
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->method('dispatch')->willReturnCallback(function () use (&$dispatchCount) {
            $dispatchCount++;
            return null;
        });

        $controller = new WebhookController($this->orderRepo, $registry, $dispatcher, $this->pdo);

        // 1ª tentativa (falha temporária -> HTTP 500 para o gateway reenviar, zero pedido/matrícula)
        $resFail = $controller->handle(new Request([], ['transaction' => 'HP_RETRY_001']), 'hotmart');
        $this->assertSame(500, $resFail->getStatusCode());
        $bodyFail = json_decode((string)$resFail->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertFalse($bodyFail['received'] ?? true);
        $this->assertSame('user_provisioning_failed', $bodyFail['error'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(0, $dispatchCount);
        $this->assertNull($this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef('HOT_RETRY_001'));

        // Falha temporária sanada -> gateway executa retry
        $this->pdo->exec("DROP TRIGGER trg_fail_user_insert");

        $resRetryOk = $controller->handle(new Request([], ['transaction' => 'HP_RETRY_001']), 'hotmart');
        $this->assertSame(200, $resRetryOk->getStatusCode());
        $bodyOk = json_decode((string)$resRetryOk->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($bodyOk['provisioned'] ?? false);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $bodyOk['order_status'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(1, $dispatchCount);

        // Retry duplicado subsequente -> idempotente, sem duplicar usuário, pedido nem matrícula
        $resDup = $controller->handle(new Request([], ['transaction' => 'HP_RETRY_001']), 'hotmart');
        $this->assertSame(200, $resDup->getStatusCode());
        $bodyDup = json_decode((string)$resDup->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertSame('duplicate', $bodyDup['action'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(1, $dispatchCount);

        $userCount = (int)$this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = 'retry.aluno@exemplo.com'")->fetchColumn();
        $this->assertSame(1, $userCount);
    }

    public function testAffiliateWebhookHandlesConcurrentOrderInsertRaceIdempotently(): void
    {
        $this->createAffiliateSupportTables();

        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('hotmart');
        $gateway->method('handleWebhook')->willReturn([
            'order_ref'      => 'HOT_RACE_001',
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => 'HP_RACE_001',
            'product_id'     => 'PROD_CURSO_01',
            'student_email'  => 'race@exemplo.com',
            'student_name'   => 'Comprador Concorrente',
            'total'          => 97.00,
            'gateway'        => 'hotmart',
        ]);

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('hotmart')->willReturn($gateway);

        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->expects($this->never())->method('dispatch');

        // Simula corrida: findByOrderRef retorna null antes de createOrder(), outra thread insere na corrida,
        // createOrder() falha por UNIQUE e findByOrderRef seguinte enxerga o pedido 'paid'.
        $orderRepoMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface::class);
        $orderRepoMock->method('findByOrderRef')
            ->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(
                null,
                null,
                ['id' => 99, 'order_ref' => 'HOT_RACE_001', 'status' => 'paid']
            );
        $orderRepoMock->method('createOrder')
            ->willThrowException(new \PDOException('SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: UNIQUE constraint failed'));

        $controller = new WebhookController($orderRepoMock, $registry, $dispatcher, $this->pdo);
        $res = $controller->handle(new Request([], ['transaction' => 'HP_RACE_001']), 'hotmart');

        $this->assertSame(200, $res->getStatusCode());
        $body = json_decode((string)$res->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($body['received'] ?? false);
        $this->assertSame('duplicate', $body['action'] ?? null);
    }

    public function testHomonymAffiliateBuyersDoNotCollideOnUniqueUsername(): void
    {
        $this->createAffiliateSupportTables();

        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('eduzz');
        $gateway->method('handleWebhook')->willReturnOnConsecutiveCalls(
            [
                'order_ref'      => 'EDUZZ_HOM_1',
                'status'         => 'approved',
                'transaction_id' => 'ED_1',
                'product_id'     => 'PROD_CURSO_01',
                'student_email'  => 'maria1@exemplo.com',
                'student_name'   => 'Maria Silva',
                'total'          => 100.00,
                'gateway'        => 'eduzz',
            ],
            [
                'order_ref'      => 'EDUZZ_HOM_2',
                'status'         => 'approved',
                'transaction_id' => 'ED_2',
                'product_id'     => 'PROD_CURSO_01',
                'student_email'  => 'maria2@exemplo.com',
                'student_name'   => 'Maria Silva',
                'total'          => 100.00,
                'gateway'        => 'eduzz',
            ]
        );

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('eduzz')->willReturn($gateway);

        $controller = new WebhookController($this->orderRepo, $registry, null, $this->pdo);

        $r1 = $controller->handle(new Request([], []), 'eduzz');
        $r2 = $controller->handle(new Request([], []), 'eduzz');

        $this->assertSame(200, $r1->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(200, $r2->getStatusCode());

        $b1 = json_decode((string)$r1->getContent(), true);
        $b2 = json_decode((string)$r2->getContent(), true);

        $this->assertTrue($b1['provisioned'] ?? false);
        $this->assertTrue($b2['provisioned'] ?? false);
        $this->assertNotSame($b1['user_id'], $b2['user_id']);
    }

    private function createAffiliateSupportTables(): void
    {
        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password TEXT NOT NULL,
                role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_courses (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                external_product_id TEXT NULL,
                external_platform TEXT NULL
            )
        ");

        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO academy_courses (id, title, slug, external_product_id, external_platform)
            VALUES (1, 'Curso Teste Webhook', 'curso-teste-webhook', 'PROD_CURSO_01', 'hotmart')
        ");
        $this->pdo->exec("
            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO academy_courses (id, title, slug, external_product_id, external_platform)
            VALUES (2, 'Curso Teste Eduzz', 'curso-teste-eduzz', 'PROD_CURSO_01', 'eduzz')
        ");
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ZipArchiveExtractorSecurityTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive\ZipArchiveExtractor;
use Exception;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use ZipArchive;

class ZipArchiveExtractorSecurityTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempWorkDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->tempWorkDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_zip_sec_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        @mkdir($this->tempWorkDir, 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDir($this->tempWorkDir);
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function testBlocksRelativePathTraversalZipSlip(): void
    {
        $zipPath = $this->tempWorkDir . '/rel_slip.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE));
        $zip->addFromString('evil_plugin/plugin.json', json_encode(['name' => 'evil_plugin']));
        $zip->addFromString('evil_plugin/../../shell.php', '<?php echo "pwned";');
        $zip->close();

        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Zip-Slip');
        $extractor->extract($zipPath, $this->tempWorkDir . '/dest');
    }

    public function testBlocksAbsoluteUnixPathInZip(): void
    {
        $zipPath = $this->tempWorkDir . '/abs_unix.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE));
        $zip->addFromString('evil_plugin/plugin.json', json_encode(['name' => 'evil_plugin']));
        // ZipArchive strips leading slash on addFromString in some PHP builds unless renamed or raw,
        // so we add and renameIndex to force a leading slash '/home/anyuser/.bashrc' inside the central directory.
        $zip->addFromString('placeholder_bashrc', '# malicious bashrc');
        $zip->renameName('placeholder_bashrc', '/home/anyuser/.bashrc');
        $zip->close();

        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Zip-Slip');
        $extractor->extract($zipPath, $this->tempWorkDir . '/dest');
    }

    public function testBlocksWindowsDriveAndUncPathsInZip(): void
    {
        $zipPath = $this->tempWorkDir . '/abs_win.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE));
        $zip->addFromString('evil_plugin/plugin.json', json_encode(['name' => 'evil_plugin']));
        $zip->addFromString('placeholder_win', 'malicious');
        $zip->renameName('placeholder_win', 'C:/Windows/win.ini');
        $zip->close();

        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Zip-Slip');
        $extractor->extract($zipPath, $this->tempWorkDir . '/dest');
    }

    public function testBlocksUnixSymlinkInZip(): void
    {
        $zipPath = $this->tempWorkDir . '/symlink.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE));
        $zip->addFromString('evil_plugin/plugin.json', json_encode(['name' => 'evil_plugin']));
        $zip->addFromString('evil_plugin/link_to_passwd', '/etc/passwd');
        // Set UNIX symlink mode (0120777 << 16)
        $zip->setExternalAttributesName(
            'evil_plugin/link_to_passwd',
            ZipArchive::OPSYS_UNIX,
            (0120777 << 16)
        );
        $zip->close();

        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('symlinks');
        $extractor->extract($zipPath, $this->tempWorkDir . '/dest');
    }

    public function testExtractsValidPluginZipSafelyViaStream(): void
    {
        $zipPath = $this->tempWorkDir . '/valid_plugin.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE));
        $zip->addFromString('hello_world/plugin.json', json_encode([
            'name' => 'hello_world',
            'version' => '2.5.0',
            'os_version' => '2.5'
        ]));
        $zip->addFromString('hello_world/Plugin.php', "<?php\nnamespace DomainSystem\\Plugins\\hello_world;\nclass Plugin {}");
        $zip->close();

        $destDir = $this->tempWorkDir . '/dest';
        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $folder = $extractor->extract($zipPath, $destDir);

        $this->assertSame('hello_world', $folder);
        $this->assertFileExists($destDir . '/hello_world/plugin.json');
        $this->assertFileExists($destDir . '/hello_world/Plugin.php');
    }

    private function removeDir(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $items = scandir($dir) ?: [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->removeDir($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ZipArchiveExtractorTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive\ZipArchiveExtractor;
use Exception;
use ZipArchive;

class ZipArchiveExtractorTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;
    private string $maliciousZip;
    private string $safeZip;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        if (!extension_loaded('zip') || !class_exists(\ZipArchive::class)) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Extensão PHP ZipArchive não habilitada neste ambiente.');
        }

        $this->tempDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp/test_zips';
        if (!is_dir($this->tempDir)) {
            mkdir($this->tempDir, 0777, true);
        }

        // Criando ZIP malicioso
        $this->maliciousZip = $this->tempDir . '/malicious.zip';
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($this->maliciousZip, ZipArchive::CREATE) === TRUE) {
            $zip->addFromString('plugin.json', json_encode(['name' => 'BadPlugin']));
            $zip->addFromString('../../malicious_shell.php', '<?php echo "Hacked"; ?>');
            $zip->close();
        }

        // Criando ZIP seguro
        $this->safeZip = $this->tempDir . '/safe.zip';
        $zip2 = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip2->open($this->safeZip, ZipArchive::CREATE) === TRUE) {
            $zip2->addFromString('safe-plugin/plugin.json', json_encode(['name' => 'SafePlugin']));
            $zip2->addFromString('safe-plugin/index.php', '<?php echo "Safe"; ?>');
            $zip2->close();
        }
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if (file_exists($this->maliciousZip)) unlink($this->maliciousZip);
        if (file_exists($this->safeZip)) unlink($this->safeZip);
        
        $this->deleteDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function deleteDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir), ['.','..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            is_dir("$dir/$file") ? $this->deleteDirectory("$dir/$file") : unlink("$dir/$file");
        }
        rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testMaliciousZipIsBlockedAndThrowsException()
    {
        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('caminhos maliciosos'); // Da defesa 1
        
        $extractor->extract($this->maliciousZip, $this->tempDir . '/plugins');
    }

    public function testSafeZipIsExtractedCorrectly()
    {
        $extractor = new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        $dirName = $extractor->extract($this->safeZip, $this->tempDir . '/plugins');
        
        $this->assertEquals('safe-plugin', $dirName);
        $this->assertFileExists($this->tempDir . '/plugins/safe-plugin/plugin.json');
        
        $this->deleteDirectory($this->tempDir . '/plugins/safe-plugin');
    }
}

<script>
// Mantém o JSON do catálogo no JS para popular o segundo combobox dinamicamente
const catalog = <?= json_encode($catalog) ?>;
const currentUserWidgets = <?= json_encode($userWidgets) ?>;

const addWidgetBtn = document.getElementById('addWidgetBtn');
const widgetModal = document.getElementById('widgetModal');
const closeModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeModalBtn');
const providerSelect = document.getElementById('providerSelect');
const widgetSelect = document.getElementById('widgetSelect');
const addWidgetForm = document.getElementById('addWidgetForm');

addWidgetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    widgetModal.style.display = 'flex';
});

closeModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    widgetModal.style.display = 'none';
});

// Popula os widgets quando o provedor muda
providerSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const providerClass = this.value;
    widgetSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Escolha --</option>';
    
    if (!providerClass) {
        widgetSelect.disabled = true;
        return;
    }

    const providerData = catalog.find(p => p.provider_class === providerClass);
    if (providerData && providerData.widgets) {
        Object.entries(providerData.widgets).forEach(([id, meta]) => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = id;
            opt.textContent = meta.title + ' (' + meta.description + ')';
            widgetSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
        widgetSelect.disabled = false;
    }
});

// Ao submeter, envia a nova array de widgets via form dinâmico
addWidgetForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pClass = providerSelect.value;
    const wId = widgetSelect.value;
    
    if(!pClass || !wId) {
        alert("Selecione um módulo e um widget!");
        return;
    }

    // Adiciona na array
    currentUserWidgets.push({provider: pClass, id: wId});
    
    // Cria form invisível e submete para save-layout
    const form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/dashboard/save-layout';
    
    // INJETANDO O CSRF TOKEN TAMBÉM NO FORM INVISÍVEL PARA NÃO DAR ERRO DE CSRF DEPOIS!
    const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    currentUserWidgets.forEach(w => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'widgets[]';
        input.value = JSON.stringify(w);
        form.appendChild(input);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
});

// Remove um widget da array pelo index e salva o layout
function removeWidget(index) {
    // Remove o widget do index específico
    currentUserWidgets.splice(index, 1);
    
    // Cria o form para salvar
    const form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/dashboard/save-layout';
    
    const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    currentUserWidgets.forEach(w => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'widgets[]';
        input.value = JSON.stringify(w);
        form.appendChild(input);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
}
</script>

    <script>
        function toggleAdminSubmenu(el, event) {
            if (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
            }
            const li = el.closest(".has-submenu");
            if (!li) return;
            const ul = li.querySelector("ul");
            if (!ul) return;
            const menuId = li.getAttribute("data-menu-id") || "menu-default";
            
            const isVisible = ul.style.display === "block" || (ul.style.display !== "none" && window.getComputedStyle(ul).display === "block");
            if (isVisible) {
                ul.style.display = "none";
                li.classList.add("menu-closed");
                localStorage.setItem("adminMenu_" + menuId, "closed");
            } else {
                ul.style.display = "block";
                li.classList.remove("menu-closed");
                localStorage.setItem("adminMenu_" + menuId, "open");
            }
        }

        function saveSubmenuClick(menuId) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem("adminMenu_" + menuId, "open");
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            // 1. Aplica o estado persistido no localStorage (open/closed) para cada submenu
            document.querySelectorAll(".has-submenu").forEach(function(li) {
                const menuId = li.getAttribute("data-menu-id") || "menu-default";
                const ul = li.querySelector("ul");
                if (!ul) return;
                
                const state = localStorage.getItem("adminMenu_" + menuId);
                if (state === "open") {
                    ul.style.display = "block";
                    li.classList.remove("menu-closed");
                } else if (state === "closed") {
                    ul.style.display = "none";
                    li.classList.add("menu-closed");
                }
            });

            // 2. Destaca o link ativo na URL atual e assegura que seu submenu pai esteja expandido
            try {
                const currentPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");
                document.querySelectorAll("#adminmenu a").forEach(function(link) {
                    const rawHref = link.getAttribute("href");
                    if (!rawHref || rawHref === "#" || rawHref.startsWith("javascript:")) return;
                    
                    let fullHref = rawHref.startsWith("http") ? rawHref : ("<?= BASE_URL ?>/" + rawHref);
                    let linkPath = new URL(fullHref, window.location.origin).pathname.replace(/\/$/, "");
                    
                    if (linkPath === currentPath) {
                        link.parentElement.classList.add("current");
                        const parentUl = link.parentElement.closest("ul");
                        if (parentUl && parentUl.id !== "adminmenu") {
                            parentUl.style.display = "block";
                            const parentLi = parentUl.closest(".has-submenu");
                            if (parentLi) {
                                parentLi.classList.remove("menu-closed");
                                const menuId = parentLi.getAttribute("data-menu-id");
                                if (menuId && localStorage.getItem("adminMenu_" + menuId) !== "closed") {
                                    localStorage.setItem("adminMenu_" + menuId, "open");
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("[Cockpit Menu] Erro ao sincronizar link ativo:", err);
            }
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        window.OS = window.OS || {};
        
        window.OS.confirm = function(message, onConfirm) {
            const overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.style = 'position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); z-index: 999999; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s;';
            
            const box = document.createElement('div');
            box.style = 'background: #1e1e2d; border: 1px solid #323248; border-radius: 8px; padding: 25px; max-width: 400px; width: 90%; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform: scale(0.9); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);';
            
            const text = document.createElement('p');
            text.style = 'color: #fff; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 25px; line-height: 1.5;';
            text.innerText = message;
            
            const btnGroup = document.createElement('div');
            btnGroup.style = 'display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 15px;';
            
            const btnCancel = document.createElement('button');
            btnCancel.innerText = 'Cancelar';
            btnCancel.style = 'background: transparent; border: 1px solid #4a4a6a; color: #a1a1b5; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold;';
            btnCancel.onclick = function() {
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                box.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
                setTimeout(() => overlay.remove(), 200);
            };
            
            const btnConfirm = document.createElement('button');
            btnConfirm.innerText = 'Confirmar';
            btnConfirm.style = 'background: #45f3ff; border: none; color: #0b0c10; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold;';
            btnConfirm.onclick = function() {
                overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                box.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    overlay.remove();
                    if(onConfirm) onConfirm();
                }, 200);
            };
            
            btnGroup.appendChild(btnCancel);
            btnGroup.appendChild(btnConfirm);
            box.appendChild(text);
            box.appendChild(btnGroup);
            overlay.appendChild(box);
            document.body.appendChild(overlay);
            
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                overlay.style.opacity = '1';
                box.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        };
        
        let notifQueue = [];
        let unreadCount = <?= !empty($unreadNotifs) ? count($unreadNotifs) : 0 ?>;
        
        // Exibe a badge no load inicial se houver não lidas e abre o painel
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            if (unreadCount > 0) {
                const b = document.getElementById('os-notif-badge');
                b.innerText = unreadCount;
                b.style.display = 'block';

            }
        });

        // Toggles the flyout panel
        window.OS.toggleHub = function() {
            const panel = document.getElementById('os-notif-panel');
            if (panel.classList.contains('open')) {
                panel.classList.remove('open');
                setTimeout(() => panel.style.display = 'none', 200); // Wait for transition
            } else {
                panel.style.display = 'flex';
                // Reset unread count when opening
                unreadCount = 0;
                document.getElementById('os-notif-badge').style.display = 'none';
                
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    panel.classList.add('open');
                });
            }
        };

        window.OS.clearHub = function() {
            document.getElementById('os-notif-list').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; padding: 20px; color: #64748b;">Nenhuma notificação na fila.</div>';
            notifQueue = [];
            unreadCount = 0;
            document.getElementById('os-notif-badge').style.display = 'none';
            
            // Apaga de verdade no backend
            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('csrf_token', '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>');
            fetch('<?= BASE_URL ?>/api/os/notifications/clear', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>' },
                body: fd
            });
        };

        // Adds to hub history
        window.OS.addToHub = function(message, type) {
            const list = document.getElementById('os-notif-list');
            
            // Remove empty state text if present
            if (notifQueue.length === 0) {
                list.innerHTML = '';
            }

            const item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'os-notif-item ' + type;
            item.innerHTML = `<strong>${type.toUpperCase()}</strong><br><span class="os-msg-content"></span><span class="os-notif-time">Agora mesmo</span>`;
            item.querySelector('.os-msg-content').textContent = message;
            
            // Add to top
            list.prepend(item);
            notifQueue.unshift({message, type});
            
            // Limit to 50 items in DOM
            if (list.children.length > 50) {
                list.lastChild.remove();
            }

            // Increment badge se não for carga histórica
            if (!arguments[2]) {
                const panel = document.getElementById('os-notif-panel');
                if (!panel.classList.contains('open')) {
                    unreadCount++;
                    const badge = document.getElementById('os-notif-badge');
                    badge.innerText = unreadCount;
                    badge.style.display = 'block';
                    
                    // Anima o sino!
                    const bell = document.getElementById('os-notif-bell');
                    bell.classList.remove('os-ringing');
                    void bell.offsetWidth; // trigger reflow
                    bell.classList.add('os-ringing');
                }
            }
        };

        window.OS.notify = function(message, type = 'success', skipHub = false) {
            const container = document.getElementById('os-toast-container');
            if (!container) return;
            
            // Add to Notification Hub History
            if (!skipHub) {
                window.OS.addToHub(message, type);
            }

            // Render temporary Toast (Auto-hides)
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            let color = '#3b82f6';
            let icon = 'ℹ️';
            if (type === 'success') { color = '#10b981'; icon = '✅'; }
            if (type === 'error') { color = '#ef4444'; icon = '🚨'; }
            if (type === 'warning') { color = '#f59e0b'; icon = '⚠️'; }
            
            toast.style = `background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); opacity: 0; transform: translateX(50px); transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 15px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-left: 6px solid ${color}; letter-spacing: 0.3px; max-width: 450px; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer;`;
            
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <span style="font-size: 18px; margin-top: -2px;">${icon}</span> 
                <span class="os-msg-content" style="flex-grow: 1;"></span>
                <button style="background:none; border:none; color:#94a3b8; cursor:pointer; padding:0; font-size:16px; margin-top:-2px;" onclick="this.parentElement.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>this.parentElement.remove(), 300);">✖</button>
            `;
            toast.querySelector('.os-msg-content').textContent = message;
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                toast.style.opacity = '1';
                toast.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
            });
            
            // Se for erro, fica 15 segundos ou até clicar. Se for sucesso, 5 segundos.
            const delay = (type === 'success') ? 5000 : 15000;
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                if(toast.parentElement) {
                    toast.style.opacity = '0';
                    toast.style.transform = 'translateX(50px)';
                    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 400);
                }
            }, delay);
        };
    </script>

                        var codeInput = document.getElementById('twofa_code');
                        var btnSubmit = document.getElementById('btn_submit');
                        
                        var countdown = setInterval(function() {
                            timeLeft--;
                            if (timeLeft < 0) return;
                            
                            var m = Math.floor(timeLeft / 60);
                            var s = timeLeft % 60;
                            timerEl.innerText = (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;

                                clearInterval(countdown);

                <script>
                    function togglePassword(inputId, btn) {
                        var input = document.getElementById(inputId);
                        var svg = btn.querySelector('svg');
                        if (input.type === 'password') {
                            input.type = 'text';
                            svg.innerHTML = '<path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"></path><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"></line>';
                        } else {
                            input.type = 'password';
                            svg.innerHTML = '<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle>';
                        }
                    }
                </script>
            <?php endif; ?>

<script>
    const ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY = 'ds_manual_checklist_state';

    function loadAdminChecklist() {
        try {
            const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY)) || {};
            const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][data-test-id]');
            let checked = 0;

            checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                const id = cb.getAttribute('data-test-id');
                if (saved[id] === true) {
                    cb.checked = true;
                    checked++;
                } else {
                    cb.checked = false;
                }
            });

            updateAdminBar(checked, checkboxes.length);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    function saveAdminChecklist() {
        try {
            const state = {};
            const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][data-test-id]');
            let checked = 0;

            checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                const id = cb.getAttribute('data-test-id');
                state[id] = cb.checked;
                if (cb.checked) checked++;
            });

            localStorage.setItem(ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
            updateAdminBar(checked, checkboxes.length);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    function updateAdminBar(checked, total) {
        if (total === 0) return;
        const pct = Math.round((checked / total) * 100);
        const fill = document.getElementById('adminProgressBar');
        const txt = document.getElementById('adminProgressText');
        if (fill) fill.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (txt) txt.textContent = pct + '% (' + checked + '/' + total + ' itens validados)';
    }

    function resetAdminChecklist() {
        if (confirm('Deseja reiniciar as validações do checklist?')) {
            localStorage.removeItem(ADMIN_CHECKLIST_KEY);
            loadAdminChecklist();
        }
    }

    function copyAiMasterPrompt(btn) {
        const el = document.getElementById('ds-ai-master-prompt');
        if (!el) return;
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.value).then(() => {
            const orig = btn.textContent;
            btn.textContent = '✓ Prompt Mestre Copiado!';
            setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = orig; }, 2200);
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        loadAdminChecklist();
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][data-test-id]').forEach(cb => {
            cb.addEventListener('change', saveAdminChecklist);
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
function copyShortcode(tag) {
    var text = '[' + tag + ']';
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() {
        if(typeof DS !== 'undefined' && DS.toast) {
            DS.toast.success('Copiado', 'Shortcode ' + text + ' copiado com sucesso!');
        } else {
            alert('Shortcode ' + text + ' copiado para a área de transferência!');
        }
    }, function(err) {
        if(typeof DS !== 'undefined' && DS.toast) {
            DS.toast.error('Erro', 'Não foi possível copiar o shortcode.');
        } else {
            alert('Erro ao copiar shortcode.');
        }
    });
}
</script>

                                <?php if (!$t['is_core'] && !$t['is_bundled']): ?>
                                    <form method="POST" action="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/themes/delete" onsubmit="return confirm('Tem certeza que deseja EXCLUIR este tema? Esta ação apagará a pasta permanentemente do disco!');" style="margin: 0;">
                                        <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>">

                                    </form>
                                <?php endif; ?>
                            <?php endif; ?>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            <?php endif; ?>
        <?php endforeach; ?>
    </div>
</div>

    exit(0);

// Arquivo: domain-system/tools/mine-daily-cron.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

/**
 * CLI Runner para o Ciclo de Rotação Diária 24h do DomainDrop.
 * 
 * Uso:
 *   php tools/mine-daily-cron.php
 *   php tools/mine-daily-cron.php --force
 *   php tools/mine-daily-cron.php --items=5
 * 
 * Agendamento Crontab / Windows Task Scheduler:
 *   0 0 * * * php /caminho/tools/mine-daily-cron.php > /dev/null 2>&1
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo "Acesso proibido via web. Execute este script apenas via linha de comando (CLI).\n";
    exit(1);
}

$rootDir = dirname(__DIR__);
require_once $rootDir . '/vendor/autoload.php';

/** @var \DomainSystem\Core\Application $app */
$app = require_once $rootDir . '/bootstrap.php';
$app->boot();

$options = getopt('', ['force', 'items::', 'category::']);
$force = isset($options['force']);
$items = isset($options['items']) ? max(1, min(15, (int)$options['items'])) : 4;
$categoryFilter = $options['category'] ?? null;

echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n";
echo "  DOMAINDROP • ROBÔ AUTÔNOMO DE ROTAÇÃO DIÁRIA 24H               \n";
echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n";
echo " Horário: " . date('d/m/Y H:i:s') . "\n";
echo " Itens por Categoria: {$items}\n";
echo " Modo: " . ($force ? "FORÇADO (--force)" : "AUTOMÁTICO (Baseado em Tempo 24h)") . "\n";
echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n";

try {
    /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface $miningService */
    $miningService = $app->make(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface::class);

    $cycleInfo = $miningService->getDailyCycleInfo();

    if (!$force && !$cycleInfo['is_due']) {
        echo "[INFO] O ciclo diário de 24 horas ainda está vigente.\n";
        echo "       Tempo restante até o próximo ciclo: {$cycleInfo['formatted_remaining']}\n";
        echo "       Próxima rotação prevista em: {$cycleInfo['next_cycle_date']}\n";
        echo "       (Para forçar a execução imediata, use: php tools/mine-daily-cron.php --force)\n\n";
        exit(0);
    }

    echo "[+] Iniciando mineração inteligente em todas as 9 categorias oficiais...\n\n";
    $start = microtime(true);

    $result = $miningService->runDailyAutomatedRotation($items);
    $elapsed = round(microtime(true) - $start, 2);

    echo "[OK] Ciclo de Rotação 24h Finalizado em {$elapsed}s!\n";
    echo "     Total de Produtos Minerados/Atualizados: {$result['total_mined']}\n\n";

    echo " Detalhamento por Categoria:\n";
    foreach ($result['category_counts'] as $cat => $count) {
        echo "   • {$cat}: {$count} produtos sincronizados\n";
    }

    $updatedInfo = $miningService->getDailyCycleInfo();
    echo "\n Próximo ciclo agendado para: {$updatedInfo['next_cycle_date']}\n";
    echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n";

    exit(0);
} catch (\Throwable $e) {
    echo "\n[ERRO CRÍTICO] Falha ao executar ciclo diário: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
    echo $e->getTraceAsString() . "\n";
    exit(1);
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tools/release/ReleaseBuilder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tools\Release;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CoreProtectedPaths;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Empacotador determinístico de Releases oficiais do Domain System (Modelo A).
 *
 * Gera `dist/domain-system-X.Y.Z.zip` (com `manifest.json` assinado por SHA-256)
 * e `dist/domain-system-X.Y.Z.zip.sha256`.
 */
final class ReleaseBuilder
{
    private string $rootDir;
    private CoreProtectedPaths $protectedPaths;

    public function __construct(string $rootDir, ?CoreProtectedPaths $protectedPaths = null)
    {
        $this->rootDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootDir), '/');
        $this->protectedPaths = $protectedPaths ?? new CoreProtectedPaths();
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $removedPaths Lista opcional de caminhos obsoletos a declarar em `removed`.
     * @return array{
     *   version: string,
     *   zipPath: string,
     *   sha256Path: string,
     *   sha256: string,
     *   fileCount: int,
     *   migrationCount: int,
     *   manifest: array<string, mixed>
     * }
     */
    public function build(?string $outputDir = null, array $removedPaths = []): array
    {
        $autoloadPath = $this->rootDir . '/vendor/autoload.php';
        if (!is_file($autoloadPath)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                'vendor/autoload.php não encontrado. Execute "composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader" antes de empacotar a Release.'
            );
        }

        $version = $this->extractConstantFromBootstrap('DS_VERSION');
        $osVersion = $this->extractConstantFromBootstrap('DS_OS_VERSION', '2.3');
        $excludePatterns = $this->loadExcludePatterns();

        $candidateFiles = $this->collectCandidateFiles($excludePatterns);
        $filesManifest = [];
        $seenLower = [];

        foreach ($candidateFiles as $relPath) {
            $lower = strtolower($relPath);
            if (isset($seenLower[$lower])) {
                continue;
            }

            $mode = (str_starts_with($relPath, 'config/') && str_ends_with($relPath, '.json'))
                ? 'default_if_missing'
                : 'replace';

            if (!$this->protectedPaths->isAllowedPath(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', $relPath, $mode)) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($mode === 'replace' && $this->protectedPaths->isProtectedPath(UpdateKind::Core, 'core', $relPath)) {
                continue;
            }

            $absPath = $this->rootDir . '/' . $relPath;
            if (!is_file($absPath) || is_link($absPath)) {
                continue;
            }

            $size = filesize($absPath);
            $sha256 = hash_file('sha256', $absPath);
            if ($size === false || $sha256 === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível calcular tamanho/hash de "%s".', $relPath));
            }

            $seenLower[$lower] = true;
            $filesManifest[] = [
                'path'   => $relPath,
                'sha256' => strtolower($sha256),
                'size'   => $size,
                'mode'   => $mode,
            ];
        }

        if ($filesManifest === []) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Nenhum arquivo elegível encontrado para empacotamento da Release.');
        }

        $migrationsManifest = $this->collectMigrations($seenLower);
        $expects = $this->loadSchemaExpects();

        $manifestData = [
            'protocol'           => 1,
            'minUpdaterProtocol' => 1,
            'kind'               => 'core',
            'slug'               => 'core',
            'version'            => $version,
            'requires'           => [
                'php'        => '8.1',
                'extensions' => ['pdo', 'zip', 'mbstring', 'openssl', 'json', 'curl'],
                'osVersion'  => $osVersion,
            ],
            'files'              => $filesManifest,
            'removed'            => array_values($removedPaths),
            'migrations'         => $migrationsManifest,
            'expects'            => $expects,
        ];

        $distDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $outputDir ?? ($this->rootDir . '/dist')), '/');
        if (!is_dir($distDir) && !@mkdir($distDir, 0775, true) && !is_dir($distDir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de saída "%s".', $distDir));
        }

        $zipFilename = sprintf('domain-system-%s.zip', $version);
        $zipPath = $distDir . '/' . $zipFilename;
        if (is_file($zipPath)) {
            @unlink($zipPath);
        }

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Falha ao criar arquivo ZIP "%s".', $zipPath));
        }

        foreach ($filesManifest as $fileEntry) {
            $rel = $fileEntry['path'];
            $abs = $this->rootDir . '/' . $rel;
            if (!$zip->addFile($abs, $rel)) {
                $zip->close();
                throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Falha ao adicionar "%s" ao pacote ZIP.', $rel));
            }
        }

        $manifestJson = json_encode($manifestData, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($manifestJson === false || !$zip->addFromString('manifest.json', $manifestJson . "\n")) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao gravar manifest.json dentro do pacote ZIP.');
        }

        if (!$zip->close()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao finalizar arquivo ZIP da Release.');
        }

        $zipSha256 = hash_file('sha256', $zipPath);
        if ($zipSha256 === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Não foi possível calcular SHA-256 do pacote ZIP gerado.');
        }
        $zipSha256 = strtolower($zipSha256);

        $sha256Path = $zipPath . '.sha256';
        file_put_contents($sha256Path, sprintf("%s  %s\n", $zipSha256, $zipFilename));

        return [
            'version'        => $version,
            'zipPath'        => $zipPath,
            'sha256Path'     => $sha256Path,
            'sha256'         => $zipSha256,
            'fileCount'      => count($filesManifest),
            'migrationCount' => count($migrationsManifest),
            'manifest'       => $manifestData,
        ];
    }

    private function extractConstantFromBootstrap(string $constantName, ?string $default = null): string
    {
        $bootstrapPath = $this->rootDir . '/bootstrap.php';
        if (!is_file($bootstrapPath)) {
            if ($default !== null) {
                return $default;
            }
            throw new RuntimeException('Arquivo bootstrap.php não encontrado na raiz informada.');
        }

        $contents = (string)file_get_contents($bootstrapPath);
        $pattern = sprintf("/define\(\s*'%s'\s*,\s*'([^']+)'\s*\)/", preg_quote($constantName, '/'));
        if (preg_match($pattern, $contents, $matches) === 1) {
            return trim($matches[1]);
        }

        if ($default !== null) {
            return $default;
        }

        throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Constante %s não encontrada em bootstrap.php.', $constantName));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function loadExcludePatterns(): array
    {
        $excludeFile = $this->rootDir . '/release/exclude.txt';
        if (!is_file($excludeFile)) {
            return [
                '.git*',
                '.github/',
                'tests/',
                'docs/',
                'wiki/',
                'auditoria/',
                'scratch/',
                'token/',
                'storage/',
                'temp/',
                'dist/',
                '*.phar',
                '*.zip',
                '.env',
                'database.sqlite',
            ];
        }

        $lines = file($excludeFile, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES) ?: [];
        $patterns = [];
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $trimmed = trim($line);
            if ($trimmed === '' || str_starts_with($trimmed, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $patterns[] = $trimmed;
        }

        return $patterns;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $excludePatterns
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function collectCandidateFiles(array $excludePatterns): array
    {
        $all = $this->scanDirectoryRecursive($this->rootDir, $excludePatterns);
        sort($all, SORT_STRING);
        return array_values(array_unique($all));
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $excludePatterns
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function scanDirectoryRecursive(string $baseDir, array $excludePatterns): array
    {
        $results = [];
        $baseLen = strlen($baseDir) + 1;

        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($baseDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            if ($item->isLink() || !$item->isFile()) {
                continue;
            }

            $fullPath = str_replace('\\', '/', $item->getPathname());
            $relPath = substr($fullPath, $baseLen);
            if ($relPath === '' || $this->isExcluded($relPath, $excludePatterns)) {
                continue;
            }

            $results[] = $relPath;
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $excludePatterns
     */
    private function isExcluded(string $relPath, array $excludePatterns): bool
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
        $basename = basename($normalized);

        foreach ($excludePatterns as $pattern) {
            $normPattern = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $pattern), '/');
            if ($normPattern === '') {
                continue;
            }

            if (str_ends_with($normPattern, '/')) {
                $prefix = rtrim($normPattern, '/');
                if ($normalized === $prefix || str_starts_with($normalized, $normPattern)) {
                    return true;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (fnmatch($normPattern, $normalized) || fnmatch($normPattern, $basename)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, bool> $includedFilesLower
     * @return list<array{scope: string, name: string, sha256: string, type: string}>
     */
    private function collectMigrations(array $includedFilesLower): array
    {
        $migrations = [];

        $coreMigDir = $this->rootDir . '/src/Core/Database/migrations';
        if (is_dir($coreMigDir)) {
            $files = glob($coreMigDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
            sort($files, SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                $relPath = 'src/Core/Database/migrations/' . basename($file);
                if (!isset($includedFilesLower[strtolower($relPath)])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $hash = hash_file('sha256', $file);
                if ($hash !== false) {
                    $migrations[] = [
                        'scope'  => '__core__',
                        'name'   => basename($file, '.php'),
                        'sha256' => strtolower($hash),
                        'type'   => 'additive',
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        $pluginMigDirs = glob($this->rootDir . '/src/Plugins/*/migrations') ?: [];
        sort($pluginMigDirs, SORT_STRING);
        foreach ($pluginMigDirs as $migDir) {
            $slug = basename(dirname($migDir));
            $files = glob($migDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
            sort($files, SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                $relPath = 'src/Plugins/' . $slug . '/migrations/' . basename($file);
                if (!isset($includedFilesLower[strtolower($relPath)])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $hash = hash_file('sha256', $file);
                if ($hash !== false) {
                    $migrations[] = [
                        'scope'  => $slug,
                        'name'   => basename($file, '.php'),
                        'sha256' => strtolower($hash),
                        'type'   => 'additive',
                    ];
                }
            }
        }

        return $migrations;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function loadSchemaExpects(): array
    {
        $expectsFile = $this->rootDir . '/release/schema-expects.json';
        if (!is_file($expectsFile)) {
            return [];
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($expectsFile), true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('release/schema-expects.json contém JSON inválido.');
        }

        $result = [];
        foreach ($decoded as $table => $columns) {
            if (is_string($table) && is_array($columns)) {
                $result[$table] = array_values(array_map('strval', $columns));
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }
}




/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/os-cli.php

<?php
/**
 * OS-CLI: O Terminal Emulado do Domain System
 * 
 * Uma interface de linha de comando segura (Sandbox) desenvolvida em PHP.
 * Aceita comandos no formato nativo do Linux (ls, mkdir, cat, rm) para 
 * ser amigável a Inteligências Artificiais e Desenvolvedores web, 
 * protegendo o sistema contra fugas de diretório (Path Traversal).
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

// Verificação de segurança (Se está rodando via CLI de verdade ou Web Terminal)
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli' && !isset($_GET['web_cli_token'])) {
    die("Acesso Restrito: Execute via terminal (php os-cli.php) ou forneça token válido.");
}

$args = $argv;
array_shift($args); // Remove o nome do script

if (empty($args)) {
    echo "OS-CLI v2.4.0 - Domain System Sandbox\n";
    echo "Comandos Suportados: ls, mkdir, rm, cat, touch, make:plugin, make:widget, system:check, system:status, system:update, system:rollback, system:health, dropship:cycle\n";
    exit;
}

$command = strtolower($args[0]);
$basePath = __DIR__ . '/workstation';

// Cria a pasta workstation se não existir
if (!is_dir($basePath)) {
    mkdir($basePath, 0777, true);
}

// Função auxiliar para sanitizar caminhos e prevenir sair do diretório workstation
function sanitizePath($base, $path) {
    $realBase = realpath($base);
    $target = $base . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    $realTarget = realpath(dirname($target)) . '/' . basename($target);
    
    // Se o caminho tentar sair da raiz da workstation, bloqueia
    if (strpos(realpath(dirname($target)), $realBase) !== 0) {
         die("Erro de Segurança: Caminho fora do Laboratório (workstation) permitido.");
    }
    return $target;
}

switch ($command) {
    case 'ls':
        $dir = sanitizePath($basePath, $args[1] ?? '.');
        if (is_dir($dir)) {
            $files = scandir($dir);
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                if ($file !== '.' && $file !== '..') {
                    echo (is_dir($dir . '/' . $file) ? "[DIR] " : "[FILE] ") . $file . "\n";
                }
            }
        } else {
            echo "Erro: Diretório não encontrado no workstation.\n";
        }
        break;

    case 'mkdir':
        if (!isset($args[1])) die("Erro: Falta o nome da pasta (ex: mkdir meu_plugin)\n");
        $dir = sanitizePath($basePath, $args[1]);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0777, true);
            echo "Diretório criado no workstation: {$args[1]}\n";
        } else {
            echo "Aviso: Diretório já existe.\n";
        }
        break;

    case 'cat':
        if (!isset($args[1])) die("Erro: Faltou o nome do arquivo.\n");
        $file = sanitizePath($basePath, $args[1]);
        if (file_exists($file) && is_file($file)) {
            echo file_get_contents($file) . "\n";
        } else {
            echo "Erro: Arquivo não encontrado no workstation.\n";
        }
        break;

    case 'rm':
        if (!isset($args[1])) die("Erro: Faltou o nome do arquivo/pasta.\n");
        // Simulação super simplificada de remoção
        $target = sanitizePath($basePath, end($args)); 
        if (file_exists($target)) {
            if (is_dir($target)) {
                echo "Use comandos mais específicos do PHP para remover pastas por agora.\n";
            } else {
                unlink($target);
                echo "Arquivo removido do workstation: " . end($args) . "\n";
            }
        } else {
            echo "Erro: Alvo não encontrado.\n";
        }
        break;

    case 'make:plugin':
        if (!isset($args[1])) die("Erro: Qual o nome do plugin? (ex: make:plugin radio_online)\n");
        $pluginName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', strtolower($args[1]));
        $pascalName = str_replace(' ', '', ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', $pluginName)));
        $dir = sanitizePath($basePath, $pluginName);

        foreach (['', '/Contracts', '/Controllers', '/views', '/manual'] as $sub) {
            if (!is_dir($dir . $sub)) {
                mkdir($dir . $sub, 0777, true);
            }
        }

        // 1. plugin.json
        file_put_contents($dir . '/plugin.json', json_encode([
            "name"        => $pluginName,
            "version"     => "1.0.0",
            "author"      => "CLI-Workstation",
            "description" => "Plugin Ring 3 gerado via OS-CLI com contratos SOLID.",
            "core"        => false,
            "os_version"  => "2.4"
        ], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));

        // 2. Contracts/<Pascal>ServiceInterface.php
        file_put_contents($dir . "/Contracts/{$pascalName}ServiceInterface.php", <<<PHP
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\\Plugins\\{$pluginName}\\Contracts;

interface {$pascalName}ServiceInterface
{
    public function getTitle(): string;
}
PHP
        );

        // 3. Controllers/<Pascal>Controller.php
        file_put_contents($dir . "/Controllers/{$pascalName}Controller.php", <<<PHP
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\\Plugins\\{$pluginName}\\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\\Core\\Contracts\\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\\Core\\Http\\Request;
use DomainSystem\\Core\\Http\\Responses\\ViewResponse;

class {$pascalName}Controller
{
    public function index(Request \$request): ResponseInterface
    {
        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/index.php';
        return new ViewResponse((string)ob_get_clean());
    }
}
PHP
        );

        // 4. views/index.php
        file_put_contents($dir . '/views/index.php', <<<HTML
<div class="wrap">
    <h1>🧩 Módulo: {$pascalName}</h1>
    <p>Plugin gerado em conformidade com os contratos Ring 3 do Domain-System OS.</p>
</div>
HTML
        );

        // 5. manual/module.php (Auto-descoberto pelo ManualModuleInterface)
        file_put_contents($dir . '/manual/module.php', <<<PHP
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use DomainSystem\\Core\\Contracts\\ManualModuleInterface;

return new class implements ManualModuleInterface {
    public function getId(): string { return '{$pluginName}'; }
    public function getTitle(): string { return 'Plugin {$pascalName}'; }
    public function getSubtitle(): string { return 'Módulo gerado via OS-CLI com contrato ManualModuleInterface.'; }
    public function getBadge(): string { return 'Módulo Auto-Descoberto'; }
    public function getAccentColor(): string { return '#06b6d4'; }
    public function getAdminUrl(): ?string { return '/admin/{$pluginName}'; }
    public function getChecklistItems(): array
    {
        return [
            ['id' => '{$pluginName}-boot', 'label' => 'Validar rota administrativa /admin/{$pluginName} sem erros.'],
        ];
    }
    public function renderContent(string \$baseUrl = ''): string
    {
        return '<p>Documentação automática do módulo <strong>{$pascalName}</strong>.</p>';
    }
};
PHP
        );

        // 6. Plugin.php (OsExtensionInterface)
        file_put_contents($dir . '/Plugin.php', <<<PHP
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\\Plugins\\{$pluginName};

use DomainSystem\\Core\\Contracts\\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\\Core\\Contracts\\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\\Core\\Contracts\\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\\Core\\Plugin\\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\\Core\\Routing\\Router;
use DomainSystem\\Plugins\\{$pluginName}\\Controllers\\{$pascalName}Controller;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface \$os): void
    {
        \$os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        \$os->listenHook('router.register');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface \$runtime): void
    {
        \$runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function (array \$menus, string \$role = 'guest'): array {
            if (\$role === 'admin') {
                \$menus[] = [
                    'title' => '{$pascalName}',
                    'url'   => '/admin/{$pluginName}',
                    'icon'  => '🧩',
                ];
            }
            return \$menus;
        });

        \$runtime->onHook('router.register', function (Router \$router): void {
            \$router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/{$pluginName}', [{$pascalName}Controller::class, 'index'], '{$pluginName}', ['admin']);
        });
    }
}
PHP
        );

        echo "✅ Plugin SOLID Scaffolded com sucesso no Workstation: {$pluginName}\n";
        echo "Estrutura criada: plugin.json, Plugin.php, Contracts/, Controllers/, views/ e manual/module.php\n";
        echo "Após terminar o desenvolvimento, compacte e instale pelo painel!\n";
        break;

    case 'system:check':
    case 'system:status':
    case 'system:update':
    case 'system:rollback':
    case 'system:health':
        $app = require __DIR__ . '/bootstrap.php';
        $app->boot();
        $container = $app->getContainer();
        \DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\UpdateServiceBinder::bind($container, __DIR__);

        $handler = new \DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Console\UpdateCliCommandHandler(
            $container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\CoreUpdaterInterface::class),
            $container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface::class),
            $container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
            $container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface::class),
            $container->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface::class)
                ? $container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface::class)
                : null,
        );

        $cliArgs = array_values(array_slice($args, 1));
        $result = $handler->execute($command, $cliArgs);
        echo $result['output'];
        exit($result['exitCode']);

    case 'dropship:cycle':
        $force = in_array('--force', $args, true);
        $itemsPerCategory = 3;
        foreach (array_slice($args, 1) as $arg) {
            if (is_numeric($arg) && (int)$arg > 0) {
                $itemsPerCategory = min(20, (int)$arg);
                break;
            }
        }

        $app = require __DIR__ . '/bootstrap.php';
        $app->boot();
        $container = $app->getContainer();

        if (!$container->has(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface::class)) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Erro: Plugin domain_drop não está ativo ou registrado no container.\n");
            exit(1);
        }

        /** @var \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface $miningService */
        $miningService = $container->make(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface::class);
        $cycleInfo = $miningService->getDailyCycleInfo();

        if (!$force && empty($cycleInfo['auto_sync_enabled'])) {
            echo "Ciclo diário ignorado: auto_sync_enabled está desativado.\n";
            exit(0);
        }
        if (!$force && empty($cycleInfo['is_due'])) {
            echo "Ciclo diário vigente. Próxima execução em {$cycleInfo['formatted_remaining']} ({$cycleInfo['next_cycle_date']}).\n";
            exit(0);
        }

        $result = $miningService->runDailyAutomatedRotation($itemsPerCategory);
        if (!empty($result['skipped'])) {
            echo "Rotação ignorada ({$result['reason']}): outro processo já está executando o ciclo.\n";
            exit(0);
        }

        echo "Rotação diária concluída em {$result['executed_date']}: {$result['total_mined']} produto(s) processado(s).\n";
        exit(!empty($result['success']) ? 0 : 1);

    default:
        echo "Comando não reconhecido: {$command}\n";
        break;
}
