// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Database\MigrationRunner.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Database;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Runner de migrações versionadas do Kernel.
 *
 * Cada plugin pode ter uma pasta `migrations/` com arquivos no formato:
 *   YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_descricao.php
 *
 * Cada arquivo deve retornar um array associativo com:
 *   ['up' => function(PDO $pdo) {...}, 'down' => function(PDO $pdo) {...}]
 *
 * Comportamento de falha (Auto-Heal e Atualizador):
 *   A execução por escopo/plugin para imediatamente na primeira falha (`stopped_at`),
 *   sem registrar a migration defeituosa em `kernel_migrations` e sem executar as
 *   migrations seguintes daquele escopo.
 */
class MigrationRunner
{
    private PDO $db;
    private string $migrationsTable = 'kernel_migrations';

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->db = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
        $this->ensureMigrationsTable();
    }

    private function ensureMigrationsTable(): void
    {
        $driver = $this->db->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoInc = $driver === 'sqlite' ? 'INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT' : 'INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY';

        $this->db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {$this->migrationsTable} (
                id {$autoInc},
                plugin VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                migration VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                executed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                UNIQUE(plugin, migration)
            )
        ");
    }

    /**
     * Executa as migrations pendentes de um plugin em ordem lexicográfica,
     * interrompendo imediatamente na primeira falha.
     *
     * @return array{executed: array<int, string>, errors: array<int, string>, stopped_at: ?string}
     */
    public function runForPlugin(string $pluginName, string $migrationsPath): array
    {
        if (!is_dir($migrationsPath)) {
            return ['executed' => [], 'errors' => [], 'stopped_at' => null];
        }

        $files = glob($migrationsPath . '/*.php') ?: [];
        sort($files);

        $executed = [];
        $errors = [];
        $stoppedAt = null;

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $migrationName = basename($file, '.php');

            if ($this->alreadyExecuted($pluginName, $migrationName)) {
                continue;
            }

            try {
                $migration = require $file;
                if (!is_array($migration) || !isset($migration['up']) || !is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                    $errors[] = "Formato inválido: {$migrationName}";
                    $stoppedAt = $migrationName;
                    break;
                }

                $migration['up']($this->db);
                $this->recordExecution($pluginName, $migrationName);
                $executed[] = $migrationName;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $errors[] = "{$migrationName}: {$e->getMessage()}";
                $stoppedAt = $migrationName;
                break;
            }
        }

        return [
            'executed'   => $executed,
            'errors'     => $errors,
            'stopped_at' => $stoppedAt,
        ];
    }

    private function alreadyExecuted(string $plugin, string $migration): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT 1 FROM {$this->migrationsTable} WHERE plugin = ? AND migration = ?"
        );
        $stmt->execute([$plugin, $migration]);
        return (bool)$stmt->fetch();
    }

    private function recordExecution(string $plugin, string $migration): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO {$this->migrationsTable} (plugin, migration) VALUES (?, ?)"
        );
        $stmt->execute([$plugin, $migration]);
    }

    public function getExecutedMigrations(?string $plugin = null): array
    {
        if ($plugin !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM {$this->migrationsTable} WHERE plugin = ? ORDER BY executed_at DESC");
            $stmt->execute([$plugin]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM {$this->migrationsTable} ORDER BY executed_at DESC");
        }
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : [];
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Database\PluginMigrationScanner.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Database;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SchemaDoctorInterface;

/**
 * Implementação de SchemaDoctorInterface via auto-descoberta de `migrations/*.php` (Pilar 3 v2.4).
 *
 * Comportamento do Auto-Heal:
 *   Ao executar `healAll()`, as migrations pendentes de cada plugin são aplicadas em ordem.
 *   Se uma migration falhar, o processo daquele plugin é interrompido imediatamente na primeira
 *   falha (`stopped_at`), sem executar nem registrar as migrations seguintes.
 */
class PluginMigrationScanner implements SchemaDoctorInterface
{
    private string $pluginsBaseDir;
    private ?DatabaseConnectionInterface $dbConnection;

    public function __construct(?string $rootPath = null, ?DatabaseConnectionInterface $dbConnection = null)
    {
        $root = $rootPath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3));
        $this->pluginsBaseDir = rtrim($root, '/\\') . '/src/Plugins';
        $this->dbConnection = $dbConnection;
    }

    /**
     * Descobre todos os diretórios `migrations/` de plugins que possuem arquivos `.php`.
     *
     * @return array<string, array{path: string, files: array<int, string>}>
     */
    public function discover(): array
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->pluginsBaseDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $entries = scandir($this->pluginsBaseDir);
        if ($entries === false) {
            return [];
        }

        $discovered = [];
        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                continue;
            }

            $pluginDir = $this->pluginsBaseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $entry;
            if (!is_dir($pluginDir)) {
                continue;
            }

            $migrationsDir = $pluginDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'migrations';
            if (!is_dir($migrationsDir)) {
                continue;
            }

            $files = glob($migrationsDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
            if (empty($files)) {
                continue;
            }

            sort($files);
            $migrationNames = array_map(static fn(string $f): string => basename($f, '.php'), $files);

            $discovered[$entry] = [
                'path'  => $migrationsDir,
                'files' => $migrationNames,
            ];
        }

        ksort($discovered);
        return $discovered;
    }

    /**
     * Inspeciona o status das migrações de todos os plugins via contrato.
     *
     * @return array<string, array{
     *     plugin: string,
     *     total: int,
     *     executed: array<int, string>,
     *     pending: array<int, string>,
     *     status: string
     * }>
     */
    public function inspectStatus(?MigrationRunner $runner = null): array
    {
        $effectiveRunner = $runner ?? $this->createDefaultRunner();
        if ($effectiveRunner === null) {
            return [];
        }

        $discovered = $this->discover();
        $executedRows = $effectiveRunner->getExecutedMigrations();

        $executedMap = [];
        foreach ($executedRows as $row) {
            $p = (string)($row['plugin'] ?? '');
            $m = (string)($row['migration'] ?? '');
            if ($p !== '' && $m !== '') {
                $executedMap[$p][$m] = true;
            }
        }

        $report = [];
        foreach ($discovered as $pluginName => $info) {
            $executedList = [];
            $pendingList = [];

            foreach ($info['files'] as $migName) {
                if (!empty($executedMap[$pluginName][$migName])) {
                    $executedList[] = $migName;
                } else {
                    $pendingList[] = $migName;
                }
            }

            $report[$pluginName] = [
                'plugin'   => $pluginName,
                'total'    => count($info['files']),
                'executed' => $executedList,
                'pending'  => $pendingList,
                'status'   => empty($pendingList) ? 'ok' : 'pending',
            ];
        }

        return $report;
    }

    /**
     * Executa todas as migrações pendentes de todos os plugins descobertos (Auto-Heal),
     * interrompendo na primeira falha de cada plugin (`stopped_at`).
     *
     * @return array{executed: array<string, array<int, string>>, errors: array<string, array<int, string>>, stopped_at: array<string, string>}
     */
    public function healAll(?MigrationRunner $runner = null): array
    {
        $effectiveRunner = $runner ?? $this->createDefaultRunner();
        if ($effectiveRunner === null) {
            return ['executed' => [], 'errors' => [], 'stopped_at' => []];
        }

        $discovered = $this->discover();
        $allExecuted = [];
        $allErrors = [];
        $allStoppedAt = [];

        foreach ($discovered as $pluginName => $info) {
            $res = $effectiveRunner->runForPlugin($pluginName, $info['path']);
            if (!empty($res['executed'])) {
                $allExecuted[$pluginName] = $res['executed'];
            }
            if (!empty($res['errors'])) {
                $allErrors[$pluginName] = $res['errors'];
            }
            if (!empty($res['stopped_at'])) {
                $allStoppedAt[$pluginName] = (string)$res['stopped_at'];
            }
        }

        return [
            'executed'   => $allExecuted,
            'errors'     => $allErrors,
            'stopped_at' => $allStoppedAt,
        ];
    }

    private function createDefaultRunner(): ?MigrationRunner
    {
        if ($this->dbConnection === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return new MigrationRunner($this->dbConnection->getPdo());
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Database\Update\PdoMigrationRegistry.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MigrationRegistryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Implementação somente leitura de `MigrationRegistryInterface` via PDO.
 *
 * Não cria a tabela `kernel_migrations` nem produz efeitos colaterais no banco.
 * Se a tabela ainda não existir, devolve `[]`.
 */
final class PdoMigrationRegistry implements MigrationRegistryInterface
{
    private PDO $db;
    private string $table;

    public function __construct(
        DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection,
        string $table = 'kernel_migrations',
    ) {
        $this->db = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
        $this->table = $table;
    }

    public function executed(string $scope): array
    {
        if (trim($scope) === '') {
            return [];
        }

        try {
            $stmt = @$this->db->prepare(
                "SELECT migration FROM {$this->table} WHERE plugin = ? ORDER BY id ASC"
            );
            if ($stmt === false) {
                return [];
            }

            $ok = @$stmt->execute([$scope]);
            if (!$ok) {
                return [];
            }

            $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN, 0);
            if (!is_array($rows)) {
                return [];
            }

            $names = [];
            foreach ($rows as $val) {
                if (is_string($val) && trim($val) !== '') {
                    $names[] = $val;
                }
            }

            return $names;
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return [];
        }
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Database\Update\PdoSchemaProbe.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaProbeInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Sondagem agnóstica de tabelas e colunas via SQL ANSI (`SELECT 1 FROM t LIMIT 1`).
 *
 * Trata tanto retorno `false` quanto `PDOException` (SQLite e MySQL).
 */
final class PdoSchemaProbe implements SchemaProbeInterface
{
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->db = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
    }

    public function hasTable(string $table): bool
    {
        if (!$this->isValidIdentifier($table)) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $stmt = @$this->db->query("SELECT 1 FROM {$table} LIMIT 1");
            return $stmt !== false;
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function hasColumn(string $table, string $column): bool
    {
        if (!$this->isValidIdentifier($table) || !$this->isValidIdentifier($column)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$this->hasTable($table)) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $stmt = @$this->db->query("SELECT {$column} FROM {$table} LIMIT 1");
            return $stmt !== false;
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private function isValidIdentifier(string $identifier): bool
    {
        return preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/', $identifier) === 1;
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Database\Update\RunnerSchemaMigrator.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaMigratorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\MigrationRunner;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaPlan;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\SchemaResult;
use PDO;

/**
 * Executor de migrações do atualizador sobre o `MigrationRunner` corrigido (Passo 0).
 *
 * Executa por escopo na ordem do plano e interrompe imediatamente na primeira falha.
 */
final class RunnerSchemaMigrator implements SchemaMigratorInterface
{
    private PDO $db;
    private string $rootPath;

    public function __construct(
        DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection,
        string $rootPath,
    ) {
        $this->db = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
        $this->rootPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
    }

    public function migrate(SchemaPlan $plan): SchemaResult
    {
        if ($plan->pending === []) {
            return new SchemaResult([]);
        }

        $runner = new MigrationRunner($this->db);

        $orderedScopes = [];
        foreach ($plan->pending as $item) {
            $scope = $item['scope'];
            if (!in_array($scope, $orderedScopes, true)) {
                $orderedScopes[] = $scope;
            }
        }

        $allExecuted = [];
        foreach ($orderedScopes as $scope) {
            $migrationsDir = $this->resolveMigrationsDirectory($scope);
            $result = $runner->runForPlugin($scope, $migrationsDir);

            foreach ($result['executed'] as $executedName) {
                $allExecuted[] = $executedName;
            }

            if ($result['stopped_at'] !== null || $result['errors'] !== []) {
                $failedName = $result['stopped_at'] ?? 'unknown';
                $errorMsg = $result['errors'][0] ?? sprintf('Falha na migration %s.', $failedName);

                return new SchemaResult(
                    executed: $allExecuted,
                    failed: $failedName,
                    error: $errorMsg,
                );
            }
        }

        return new SchemaResult(executed: $allExecuted);
    }

    private function resolveMigrationsDirectory(string $scope): string
    {
        if ($scope === '__core__') {
            return $this->rootPath . '/src/Core/Database/migrations';
        }

        return $this->rootPath . '/src/Plugins/' . trim($scope, '/\\') . '/migrations';
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Error\CircuitBreaker.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Error;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use Throwable;

class CircuitBreaker
{
    private const PROTECTED_PLUGINS = ['SystemMonitor', 'SystemAdmin'];

    private string $configPath;
    private string $disarmedPath;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    /** @var array<string, int> */
    private array $routeFailureCounts = [];

    public function __construct(
        string $configPath,
        string $disarmedPath,
        JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = new AtomicJsonStore()
    ) {
        $this->configPath = $configPath;
        $this->disarmedPath = $disarmedPath;
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore;
    }

    public function detectCulpritPlugin(Throwable $e): ?string
    {
        $file = $e->getFile();
        $trace = $e->getTraceAsString();
        $message = $e->getMessage();

        if (preg_match("/src[\/\\\\]Plugins[\/\\\\]([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i", $file, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        if (preg_match("/src[\/\\\\]Plugins[\/\\\\]([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i", $trace, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        if (preg_match("/src[\/\\\\]Plugins[\/\\\\]([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i", $message, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function analyzeAndDisarm(Throwable $e): ?string
    {
        $pluginName = $this->detectCulpritPlugin($e);
        if ($pluginName === null || in_array($pluginName, self::PROTECTED_PLUGINS, true)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->disarmPlugin($pluginName);
    }

    /**
     * Registra uma falha durante o despacho de uma rota HTTP de plugin (Pilar 2 v2.4).
     * Só desarma o plugin quando o número de falhas atinge o threshold configurado.
     */
    public function recordRouteException(Throwable $e, int $threshold = 3): ?string
    {
        $pluginName = $this->detectCulpritPlugin($e);
        if ($pluginName === null || in_array($pluginName, self::PROTECTED_PLUGINS, true)) {
            return null;
        }

        $threshold = max(1, $threshold);
        $this->routeFailureCounts[$pluginName] = ($this->routeFailureCounts[$pluginName] ?? 0) + 1;

        if ($this->routeFailureCounts[$pluginName] >= $threshold) {
            return $this->disarmPlugin($pluginName);
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function getRouteFailureCount(string $pluginName): int
    {
        return $this->routeFailureCounts[$pluginName] ?? 0;
    }

    private function disarmPlugin(string $pluginName): ?string
    {
        if (!file_exists($this->configPath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $wasDisarmed = false;
        $this->jsonStore->update($this->configPath, static function (array $states) use ($pluginName, &$wasDisarmed): array {
            if (isset($states[$pluginName]) && $states[$pluginName] === true) {
                $states[$pluginName] = false;
                $wasDisarmed = true;
            }
            return $states;
        });

        if ($wasDisarmed) {
            $this->jsonStore->update($this->disarmedPath, static function (array $disarmed) use ($pluginName): array {
                $disarmed[$pluginName] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
                return $disarmed;
            });
            return $pluginName;
        }

        return null;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Error\ErrorHandler.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Error;

use Throwable;

class ErrorHandler
{
    private ErrorLogger $logger;
    private CircuitBreaker $circuitBreaker;
    private ErrorRenderer $renderer;

    public function __construct(
        ErrorLogger $logger,
        CircuitBreaker $circuitBreaker,
        ErrorRenderer $renderer
    ) {
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->circuitBreaker = $circuitBreaker;
        $this->renderer = $renderer;
    }

    public function register(): void
    {
        set_error_handler([$this, 'handleError']);
        set_exception_handler([$this, 'handleException']);
        register_shutdown_function([$this, 'handleShutdown']);
    }

    public function handleException(Throwable $e): void
    {
        $this->logger->log($e);
        $disarmedPlugin = $this->circuitBreaker->analyzeAndDisarm($e);
        $this->renderer->render($e, $disarmedPlugin);
    }

    public function handleError(int $level, string $message, string $file, int $line): bool
    {
        if (!(error_reporting() & $level)) {
            return false;
        }

        $isFatalLevel = in_array($level, [
            E_ERROR,
            E_PARSE,
            E_CORE_ERROR,
            E_COMPILE_ERROR,
            E_USER_ERROR,
            E_RECOVERABLE_ERROR
        ], true);

        $isDevelopment = (getenv('APP_ENV') ?: ($_ENV['APP_ENV'] ?? 'production')) === 'development';

        if ($isFatalLevel || $isDevelopment) {
            $e = new \ErrorException($message, 0, $level, $file, $line);
            $this->handleException($e);
            return true;
        }

        // Em produção, registra avisos e depreciações no log silenciosamente sem derrubar o sistema
        $this->logger->log(new \ErrorException($message, 0, $level, $file, $line));
        return true;
    }

    public function handleShutdown(): void
    {
        $error = error_get_last();
        if ($error && in_array($error['type'], [E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR])) {
            $e = new \ErrorException($error["message"], 0, $error["type"], $error["file"], $error["line"]);
            $this->handleException($e);
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Error\ErrorLogger.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Error;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use Throwable;

class ErrorLogger
{
    private string $logPath;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    public function __construct(string $logPath, JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = new AtomicJsonStore())
    {
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore;
    }

    public function log(Throwable $e): void
    {
        $dir = dirname($this->logPath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
            @file_put_contents($dir . '/.htaccess', "Deny from all\n", LOCK_EX);
        }

        $errorData = [
            "timestamp" => date("Y-m-d H:i:s"),
            "type"      => get_class($e),
            "message"   => $e->getMessage(),
            "file"      => $e->getFile(),
            "line"      => $e->getLine(),
            "trace"     => $e->getTraceAsString(),
            "url"       => $_SERVER["REQUEST_URI"] ?? "CLI",
            "method"    => $_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] ?? "CLI",
        ];

        $this->jsonStore->update($this->logPath, static function (array $logs) use ($errorData): array {
            array_unshift($logs, $errorData);
            if (count($logs) > 50) {
                $logs = array_slice($logs, 0, 50);
            }
            return $logs;
        });
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Events\EventDispatcher.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Events;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;

class EventDispatcher implements EventDispatcherInterface
{
    private array $listeners = [];

    public function addListener(string $eventName, callable $listener, int $priority = 10): void
    {
        $this->listeners[$eventName][$priority][] = $listener;
    }

    public function removeListener(string $eventName, callable $listener): void
    {
        if (!isset($this->listeners[$eventName])) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($this->listeners[$eventName] as $priority => $listenersGroup) {
            foreach ($listenersGroup as $key => $registeredListener) {
                if ($registeredListener === $listener) {
                    unset($this->listeners[$eventName][$priority][$key]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function dispatch(string $eventName, ...$args): void
    {
        if (!isset($this->listeners[$eventName])) {
            return;
        }

        // Sort by priority (lower number = higher priority, or vice-versa)
        // Let's use lower number = executes first, but we'll sort ascending
        ksort($this->listeners[$eventName]);

        foreach ($this->listeners[$eventName] as $priority => $listenersGroup) {
            foreach ($listenersGroup as $listener) {
                call_user_func_array($listener, $args);
            }
        }
    }

    public function applyFilters(string $filterName, mixed $value, ...$args): mixed
    {
        if (!isset($this->listeners[$filterName])) {
            return $value;
        }

        ksort($this->listeners[$filterName]);

        foreach ($this->listeners[$filterName] as $priority => $listenersGroup) {
            foreach ($listenersGroup as $listener) {
                $argsToPass = array_merge([$value], $args);
                $value = call_user_func_array($listener, $argsToPass);
            }
        }

        return $value;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Events\HookPriority.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Events;

/**
 * Constantes canônicas de prioridade para Eventos e Hooks do Kernel.
 * Como o EventDispatcher usa ksort() (ordem ascendente), números menores executam PRIMEIRO.
 */
final class HookPriority
{
    public const HIGHEST = -1000; // Executa primeiro (ex: Installer, Guard de Manutenção)
    public const HIGH    = -500;  // Executa antes dos padrões (ex: Autenticação/RBAC)
    public const NORMAL  = 0;     // Padrão de execução para plugins
    public const LOW     = 500;   // Executa depois dos padrões
    public const LOWEST  = 1000;  // Executa por último (ex: Loggers, Fallbacks)

    private function __construct() {}
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Exceptions\HttpResponseException.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Exceptions;

use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Exceção de curto-circuito HTTP (ex: redirecionamentos em router.before_dispatch).
 * Permite encerrar o fluxo de roteamento retornando um objeto Response limpo e testável,
 * sem precisar invocar header() ou exit().
 */
class HttpResponseException extends RuntimeException
{
    private Response $response;

    public function __construct(Response $response, string $message = '', int $code = 0)
    {
        $statusCode = $code !== 0 ? $code : $response->getStatusCode();
        parent::__construct($message, $statusCode);
        $this->response = $response;
    }

    public function getResponse(): Response
    {
        return $this->response;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Http\CachePolicy.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;

/**
 * Política declarativa de cabeçalhos anti-cache HTTP.
 * Garante que rotas administrativas e logout nunca fiquem em cache de proxies/CDNs (Hostinger/Cloudflare).
 */
class CachePolicy
{
    private const SENSITIVE_PREFIXES = [
        '/admin',
        '/login',
        '/logout',
        '/setup',
        '/api',
        '/emergency',
    ];

    private const DYNAMIC_STOREFRONT_PATHS = [
        '/',
        '/loja',
        '/produto',
        '/cadastro',
        '/acessar',
        '/minha-conta',
        '/rastrear',
        '/carrinho',
        '/checkout',
    ];

    /**
     * Aplica os cabeçalhos apropriados à resposta antes do envio.
     */
    public function apply(RequestInterface $request, ResponseInterface $response): ResponseInterface
    {
        $uri = '/' . ltrim(strtok($request->uri(), '?'), '/');

        if ($this->isSensitivePath($uri) || $this->hasActiveSession()) {
            return $this->applyStrictNoCache($response, $uri);
        }

        if ($this->isDynamicStorefrontPath($uri) && $this->missingCacheControl($response)) {
            return $this->applyHeaders($response, [
                'Cache-Control' => 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0',
                'Pragma'        => 'no-cache',
                'Expires'       => 'Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT',
                'Vary'          => 'Cookie, Accept-Encoding',
            ]);
        }

        return $response;
    }

    public function isSensitivePath(string $uri): bool
    {
        foreach (self::SENSITIVE_PREFIXES as $prefix) {
            if ($uri === $prefix || str_starts_with($uri, $prefix . '/')) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public function isDynamicStorefrontPath(string $uri): bool
    {
        foreach (self::DYNAMIC_STOREFRONT_PATHS as $prefix) {
            if ($uri === $prefix) {
                return true;
            }
            if ($prefix !== '/' && str_starts_with($uri, $prefix . '/')) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function applyStrictNoCache(ResponseInterface $response, string $uri): ResponseInterface
    {
        $headers = [
            'Cache-Control' => 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private, max-age=0, post-check=0, pre-check=0',
            'Pragma'        => 'no-cache',
            'Expires'       => 'Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT',
            'Vary'          => 'Cookie, Authorization, Accept-Encoding',
        ];

        // No logout, compele o navegador a expurgar o cache local da aplicação
        if ($uri === '/logout') {
            $headers['Clear-Site-Data'] = '"cache", "storage"';
        }

        return $this->applyHeaders($response, $headers);
    }

    private function applyHeaders(ResponseInterface $response, array $headers): ResponseInterface
    {
        foreach ($headers as $name => $value) {
            if (method_exists($response, 'setHeader')) {
                $response->setHeader($name, $value);
            } elseif (method_exists($response, 'withHeader')) {
                $response = $response->withHeader($name, $value);
            }
        }

        return $response;
    }

    private function missingCacheControl(ResponseInterface $response): bool
    {
        return !method_exists($response, 'getHeader') || $response->getHeader('Cache-Control') === null;
    }

    private function hasActiveSession(): bool
    {
        return session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE
            && (!empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || !empty($_SESSION['customer_id']));
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Http\HttpKernel.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RouteBoundaryGuardInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RouterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Error\CircuitBreaker;
use DomainSystem\Core\Exceptions\HttpResponseException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Monitoring\RequestMetricsRecorder;
use DomainSystem\Core\Workspace\WorkspaceManager;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Orquestrador HTTP do Kernel (SRP & Testabilidade E2E).
 * Centraliza o despacho da requisição, política de manutenção, normalização de Response,
 * isolamento de fronteiras via RouteBoundaryGuardInterface, CachePolicy e telemetria.
 */
class HttpKernel
{
    private RouterInterface $router;
    private ContainerInterface $container;
    private ?WorkspaceManager $workspaceManager;
    private CachePolicy $cachePolicy;
    private int $routeFailureThreshold;
    private RouteBoundaryGuardInterface $boundaryGuard;

    public function __construct(
        RouterInterface $router,
        ContainerInterface $container,
        ?WorkspaceManager $workspaceManager = null,
        ?CachePolicy $cachePolicy = null,
        int $routeFailureThreshold = 3,
        ?RouteBoundaryGuardInterface $boundaryGuard = null
    ) {
        $this->router = $router;
        $this->container = $container;
        $this->workspaceManager = $workspaceManager;
        $this->cachePolicy = $cachePolicy ?? new CachePolicy();
        $this->routeFailureThreshold = max(1, $routeFailureThreshold);
        $this->boundaryGuard = $boundaryGuard ?? new RouteBoundaryGuard();
    }

    public function handle(
        Request $request,
        bool $maintenanceFileExists = false,
        ?string $maintenancePagePath = null
    ): Response {
        $uri = strtok($request->uri(), '?') ?: '/';

        $siteState = null;
        $userRole = '';
        try {
            if ($this->container->has(SiteStateInterface::class)) {
                $siteState = $this->container->make(SiteStateInterface::class);
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $siteState = null;
        }

        try {
            if ($this->container->has(SessionManagerInterface::class)) {
                $sessionForState = $this->container->make(SessionManagerInterface::class);
                $userRole = (string)$sessionForState->get('user_role', '');
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $userRole = '';
        }

        if (MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock($uri, $maintenanceFileExists, $siteState, $userRole)) {
            $maintHtml = ($maintenancePagePath !== null && file_exists($maintenancePagePath))
                ? (string)file_get_contents($maintenancePagePath)
                : "<h1 style='text-align:center; font-family:sans-serif; margin-top:50px;'>Manutenção do Sistema. Voltamos em breve.</h1>";
            $response = new Response($maintHtml, 503, ['Retry-After' => '3600']);
        } else {
            try {
                $response = $this->router->dispatch($request);
            } catch (HttpResponseException $e) {
                throw $e;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                try {
                    if ($this->container->has(CircuitBreaker::class)) {
                        /** @var CircuitBreaker $breaker */
                        $breaker = $this->container->make(CircuitBreaker::class);
                        $breaker->recordRouteException($e, $this->routeFailureThreshold);
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $inner) {
                    // Ignora erro interno do registrador de falhas
                }
                throw $e;
            }
        }

        if (!$response instanceof Response) {
            if (is_array($response) || is_object($response)) {
                $response = new JsonResponse($response);
            } else {
                $wrap = false;
                if (strpos($uri, '/admin') === 0 && !isset($request->query['raw']) && !str_starts_with($uri, '/admin/themes/preview')) {
                    $wrap = true;
                }
                $response = new ViewResponse((string)$response, $wrap);
            }
        }

        // GUARDA DE FRONTEIRA E SEGURANÇA (DIP / SOLID):
        // Nenhuma rota pública ou de aluno pode jamais ser envelopada pela casca do admin!
        if ($this->boundaryGuard->canWrapInAdminWorkspace($uri, $response) && $userRole !== '') {
            $workspaceManager = $this->workspaceManager;
            if ($workspaceManager === null) {
                try {
                    $workspaceManager = $this->container->make(WorkspaceManager::class);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    $workspaceManager = null;
                }
            }

            if ($workspaceManager !== null) {
                $workspace = $workspaceManager->getWorkspace($userRole);
                $wrappedContent = $workspace->wrap($response->getContent());
                $response->setContent($wrappedContent);
            }
        }

        $response = $this->cachePolicy->apply($request, $response);

        try {
            if ($this->container->has(RequestMetricsRecorder::class)) {
                $metricsRecorder = $this->container->make(RequestMetricsRecorder::class);
                $metricsRecorder->record($uri, $request->method());
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Não interrompe a resposta caso a gravação de métricas falhe
        }

        return $response;
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Http\MaintenancePolicy.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;

/**
 * Política de verificação e normalização de rotas para Modo de Manutenção (N-6).
 *
 * Previne bypass por query string (/?x=/login) ou falso prefixo (/blog/admin-dicas)
 * e integra o lock físico (.maintenance) com o SiteStateInterface.
 */
class MaintenancePolicy
{
    /**
     * Extrai e normaliza apenas o caminho (PHP_URL_PATH) da URI, removendo
     * subpastas de instalação (ex: /domain-system ou /domain-system/public) em limites de segmento.
     */
    public static function normalizePath(string $requestUri, string $baseFolder = '', string $scriptName = ''): string
    {
        $rawPath = parse_url($requestUri, PHP_URL_PATH);
        $path = is_string($rawPath) && $rawPath !== '' ? $rawPath : '/';
        $path = str_replace('\\', '/', $path);

        $scriptName = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $scriptName), '/');
        if ($scriptName !== '' && $scriptName !== '/') {
            if ($path === $scriptName) {
                $path = '/';
            } elseif (str_starts_with($path, $scriptName . '/')) {
                $path = substr($path, strlen($scriptName));
            }
        }

        $baseFolder = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $baseFolder), '/');
        if ($baseFolder !== '' && $baseFolder !== '/') {
            if ($path === $baseFolder) {
                $path = '/';
            } elseif (str_starts_with($path, $baseFolder . '/')) {
                $path = substr($path, strlen($baseFolder));
            }
        }

        if ($path === '' || $path[0] !== '/') {
            $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }

        return $path;
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se o caminho normalizado pertence às rotas críticas isentas de bloqueio de manutenção.
     */
    public static function isExemptPath(string $normalizedPath): bool
    {
        return preg_match('#^/(admin|login|logout|api|setup)(/|$)#', $normalizedPath) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * Determina se a requisição deve receber 503 Service Unavailable.
     */
    public static function shouldBlock(
        string $normalizedPath,
        bool $maintenanceLockExists,
        ?SiteStateInterface $siteState = null,
        ?string $userRole = null
    ): bool {
        $isMaintenanceActive = $maintenanceLockExists || ($siteState !== null && $siteState->isMaintenance());
        if (!$isMaintenanceActive) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($userRole === 'admin') {
            return false;
        }

        return !self::isExemptPath($normalizedPath);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Http\Request.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;

class Request implements RequestInterface
{
    public array $query;
    public array $request;
    public array $server;
    public array $cookies;
    public array $files;
    private array $jsonBody;
    private string $rawBody = '';

    public function __construct(
        array $query = [],
        array $request = [],
        array $server = [],
        array $cookies = [],
        array $files = [],
        array $jsonBody = [],
        string $rawBody = ''
    ) {
        $this->query = $query;
        $this->request = $request;
        $this->server = $server;
        $this->cookies = $cookies;
        $this->files = $files;
        $this->jsonBody = $jsonBody;
        $this->rawBody = $rawBody;
    }

    public static function capture(): self
    {
        $post = $_POST;
        $jsonBody = [];

        // Se o corpo for JSON (enviado pelo fetch do front-end), parsear aqui
        $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? ($_SERVER['HTTP_CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '');
        $rawBody = file_get_contents('php://input');
        $rawString = is_string($rawBody) ? $rawBody : '';
        if (trim($rawString) !== '') {
            if (
                str_contains(strtolower((string)$contentType), 'application/json') ||
                str_starts_with(ltrim($rawString), '{') ||
                str_starts_with(ltrim($rawString), '[')
            ) {
                $jsonData = json_decode($rawString, true);
                if (is_array($jsonData)) {
                    $jsonBody = $jsonData;
                    $post = array_merge($post, $jsonData);
                }
            }
        }

        return new self($_GET, $post, $_SERVER, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, $jsonBody, $rawString);
    }

    public function rawBody(): string
    {
        return $this->rawBody;
    }

    /**
     * Retorna o payload JSON decodificado associado a esta requisição (sem depender de leitura global repetida).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function json(): array
    {
        return $this->jsonBody;
    }

    /**
     * Define explicitamente o corpo JSON (útil em testes unitários isolados de php://input).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $jsonBody
     */
    public function withJsonBody(array $jsonBody): self
    {
        $clone = clone $this;
        $clone->jsonBody = $jsonBody;
        $clone->request = array_merge($clone->request, $jsonBody);
        $clone->rawBody = (string)json_encode($jsonBody);
        return $clone;
    }

    public function input(string $key, $default = null)
    {
        return $this->request[$key] ?? $this->query[$key] ?? $default;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->request) || array_key_exists($key, $this->query);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return array_merge($this->query, $this->request);
    }

    public function method(): string
    {
        return $this->server['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';
    }

    public function uri(): string
    {
        return $this->server['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/';
    }

    public function file(string $key)
    {
        return $this->files[$key] ?? null;
    }

    public function header(string $name, ?string $default = null): ?string
    {
        $formatted = 'HTTP_' . strtoupper(str_replace('-', '_', $name));
        if (isset($this->server[$formatted])) {
            return (string)$this->server[$formatted];
        }
        $direct = strtoupper(str_replace('-', '_', $name));
        if (isset($this->server[$direct])) {
            return (string)$this->server[$direct];
        }
        return $default;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Http\Response.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;

class Response implements ResponseInterface
{
    protected string $content;
    protected int $statusCode;
    protected array $headers;

    public function __construct(string $content = '', int $statusCode = 200, array $headers = [])
    {
        $this->content = $content;
        $this->statusCode = $statusCode;
        $this->headers = $headers;
        
        // Ensure default charset for HTML responses to prevent mojibake
        $hasContentType = false;
        foreach (array_keys($this->headers) as $k) {
            if (strtolower($k) === 'content-type') {
                $hasContentType = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!$hasContentType) {
            $this->headers['Content-Type'] = 'text/html; charset=utf-8';
        }
    }

    public function setContent(string $content): self
    {
        $this->content = $content;
        return $this;
    }

    public function getContent(): string
    {
        return $this->content;
    }

    public function getStatusCode(): int
    {
        return $this->statusCode;
    }

    public function setStatusCode(int $code): self
    {
        $this->statusCode = $code;
        return $this;
    }

    public function setHeader(string $name, string $value): self
    {
        $this->headers[$name] = $value;
        return $this;
    }

    public function getHeader(string $name): ?string
    {
        foreach ($this->headers as $k => $v) {
            if (strtolower($k) === strtolower($name)) return $v;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function send(): void
    {
        $headersSent = headers_sent();
        if (!$headersSent) {
            http_response_code($this->statusCode);
            foreach ($this->headers as $name => $value) {
                header($name . ': ' . $value);
            }
        }

        $location = $this->getHeader('Location');
        if ($location !== null && $headersSent) {
            $escapedLocation = htmlspecialchars($location, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            echo "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"><meta http-equiv=\"refresh\" content=\"0;url={$escapedLocation}\"><script>window.location.href=" . json_encode($location) . ";</script></head><body>Redirecionando para <a href=\"{$escapedLocation}\">{$escapedLocation}</a>...</body></html>";
            return;
        }

        echo $this->content;
    }

    public static function json($data, int $status = 200): self
    {
        return new self(json_encode($data), $status, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json; charset=utf-8']);
    }

    public static function redirect(string $url, int $status = 302): self
    {
        $escaped = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $fallbackBody = "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"><meta http-equiv=\"refresh\" content=\"0;url={$escaped}\"><title>Redirecionando...</title></head><body>Redirecionando para <a href=\"{$escaped}\">{$escaped}</a>...<script>window.location.href=" . json_encode($url) . ";</script></body></html>";
        return new self($fallbackBody, $status, ['Location' => $url]);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Http\RouteBoundaryGuard.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RouteBoundaryGuardInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;

/**
 * Implementação padrão do Guarda de Fronteira de Rotas.
 * Garante que nenhuma rota fora de /admin jamais receba layout do painel administrativo.
 */
class RouteBoundaryGuard implements RouteBoundaryGuardInterface
{
    public function isAdminRoute(string $uri): bool
    {
        $path = parse_url($uri, PHP_URL_PATH) ?? $uri;
        $clean = '/' . ltrim((string)$path, '/');

        // Rotas administrativas iniciam estritamente com /admin
        if (!str_starts_with($clean, '/admin')) {
            return false;
        }

        // Exceções conhecidas no admin que rodam raw/isoladas
        if (str_starts_with($clean, '/admin/themes/preview')) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function canWrapInAdminWorkspace(string $uri, ResponseInterface $response): bool
    {
        // Se não for estritamente rota administrativa, NUNCA permite envelopamento
        if (!$this->isAdminRoute($uri)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($response instanceof ViewResponse) {
            return $response->shouldWrapLayout();
        }

        return false;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\I18n\Translator.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\I18n;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\TranslatorInterface;

/**
 * Motor central de internacionalização (i18n) do Domain-System.
 *
 * Carrega dicionários JSON leves, suporta fallback em cascata,
 * interpolação de variáveis e exportação de catálogo para frontend (JavaScript).
 */
class Translator implements TranslatorInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_LOCALE = 'pt_BR';

    public const SUPPORTED_LOCALES = [
        'pt_BR' => 'Português (Brasil)',
        'en_US' => 'English (US)',
        'es_ES' => 'Español',
        'zh_CN' => '简体中文',
    ];

    private string $locale;
    private string $resourcesPath;
    /** @var array<string, array<string, string>> */
    private array $catalogs = [];

    public function __construct(?string $resourcesPath = null, string $defaultLocale = self::DEFAULT_LOCALE)
    {
        $root = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $this->resourcesPath = rtrim($resourcesPath ?? ($root . '/resources/lang'), '/\\');
        $this->locale = $this->sanitizeLocale($defaultLocale);
    }

    public function getLocale(): string
    {
        return $this->locale;
    }

    public function setLocale(string $locale): void
    {
        $this->locale = $this->sanitizeLocale($locale);
    }

    public function trans(string $key, array $replace = [], ?string $locale = null): string
    {
        $targetLocale = $locale !== null ? $this->sanitizeLocale($locale) : $this->locale;
        $catalog = $this->getCatalog($targetLocale);

        $translation = $catalog[$key] ?? null;

        // Fallback em cascata: se não achar no idioma alvo, busca no padrão (pt_BR)
        if ($translation === null && $targetLocale !== self::DEFAULT_LOCALE) {
            $defaultCatalog = $this->getCatalog(self::DEFAULT_LOCALE);
            $translation = $defaultCatalog[$key] ?? null;
        }

        // Se ainda assim não achar, retorna a própria chave
        if ($translation === null) {
            $translation = $key;
        }

        if (!empty($replace)) {
            foreach ($replace as $placeholder => $value) {
                $translation = str_replace(
                    [':' . $placeholder, '{' . $placeholder . '}'],
                    (string)$value,
                    $translation
                );
            }
        }

        return $translation;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getCatalog(?string $locale = null): array
    {
        $targetLocale = $locale !== null ? $this->sanitizeLocale($locale) : $this->locale;

        if (isset($this->catalogs[$targetLocale])) {
            return $this->catalogs[$targetLocale];
        }

        $file = $this->resourcesPath . '/' . $targetLocale . '.json';
        if (file_exists($file)) {
            $content = (string)file_get_contents($file);
            $data = json_decode($content, true);
            if (is_array($data)) {
                $this->catalogs[$targetLocale] = $data;
                return $this->catalogs[$targetLocale];
            }
        }

        $this->catalogs[$targetLocale] = [];
        return $this->catalogs[$targetLocale];
    }

    private function sanitizeLocale(string $locale): string
    {
        $normalized = trim($locale);
        if (isset(self::SUPPORTED_LOCALES[$normalized])) {
            return $normalized;
        }

        // Tenta matching por prefixo (ex: 'en' -> 'en_US', 'es' -> 'es_ES', 'zh' -> 'zh_CN')
        $langCode = strtolower(substr($normalized, 0, 2));
        foreach (array_keys(self::SUPPORTED_LOCALES) as $valid) {
            if (strtolower(substr($valid, 0, 2)) === $langCode) {
                return $valid;
            }
        }

        return self::DEFAULT_LOCALE;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Manual\ArrayManualModuleAdapter.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Manual;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ManualModuleInterface;

/**
 * Adaptador que permite definir um módulo de manual de forma declarativa
 * retornando um array em `manual/module.php`.
 */
class ArrayManualModuleAdapter implements ManualModuleInterface
{
    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    private array $config;
    private string $manualDir;

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $config
     */
    public function __construct(array $config, string $manualDir)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->manualDir = $manualDir;
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->config['id'] ?? basename(dirname($this->manualDir)));
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->config['title'] ?? ucfirst($this->getId()));
    }

    public function getSubtitle(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->config['subtitle'] ?? '');
    }

    public function getBadge(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->config['badge'] ?? 'Módulo de Plugin');
    }

    public function getAccentColor(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->config['accent_color'] ?? '#45f3ff');
    }

    public function getAdminUrl(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->config['admin_url']) ? (string)$this->config['admin_url'] : null;
    }

    public function renderContent(string $baseUrl = ''): string
    {
        if (isset($this->config['render']) && is_callable($this->config['render'])) {
            return (string)($this->config['render'])($baseUrl);
        }

        $viewFile = $this->manualDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . (string)($this->config['view'] ?? 'content.php');
        $realView = realpath($viewFile);
        $realDir = realpath($this->manualDir);
        if ($realView !== false && $realDir !== false && str_starts_with($realView, $realDir) && is_file($realView)) {
            ob_start();
            include $realView;
            return (string)ob_get_clean();
        }

        return (string)($this->config['content'] ?? '');
    }

    public function getChecklistItems(): array
    {
        $items = $this->config['checklist'] ?? [];
        return is_array($items) ? $items : [];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Manual\PluginManualScanner.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Manual;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ManualModuleInterface;

/**
 * Varredor (Scanner) desacoplado que rastreia pastas `manual/` dentro dos
 * Plugins e SystemApps e carrega automaticamente cada módulo que implemente
 * ManualModuleInterface (ou defina um array declarativo em manual/module.php).
 */
class PluginManualScanner
{
    /** @var array<int, string> */
    private array $scanRoots;

    /**
     * @param array<int, string>|string|null $scanRoots Diretórios base de plugins/apps a escanear ou diretório raiz do projeto
     */
    public function __construct(array|string|null $scanRoots = null)
    {
        if (is_string($scanRoots)) {
            $baseRoot = rtrim($scanRoots, '/\\');
            $this->scanRoots = [
                $baseRoot . '/src/SystemApps',
                $baseRoot . '/src/Plugins',
            ];
            return;
        }

        $baseRoot = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $this->scanRoots = $scanRoots ?? [
            $baseRoot . '/src/SystemApps',
            $baseRoot . '/src/Plugins',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Descobre todos os manuais de plugins presentes nas pastas `manual/`.
     *
     * @return array<string, ManualModuleInterface> Indexado por getId()
     */
    public function discover(): array
    {
        $modules = [];

        foreach ($this->scanRoots as $root) {
            if (!is_dir($root)) {
                continue;
            }

            $pluginDirs = glob(rtrim($root, '/\\') . '/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR) ?: [];
            foreach ($pluginDirs as $pluginDir) {
                $manualDir = $pluginDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'manual';
                if (!is_dir($manualDir)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $moduleFile = $manualDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'module.php';
                if (!is_file($moduleFile)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $loaded = $this->loadModuleFile($moduleFile, $manualDir);
                if ($loaded instanceof ManualModuleInterface) {
                    $modules[$loaded->getId()] = $loaded;
                }
            }
        }

        return $modules;
    }

    private function loadModuleFile(string $moduleFile, string $manualDir): ?ManualModuleInterface
    {
        $realModule = realpath($moduleFile);
        $realManualDir = realpath($manualDir);
        if ($realModule === false || $realManualDir === false || !str_starts_with($realModule, $realManualDir)) {
            return null;
        }

        $result = require $realModule;
        if ($result instanceof ManualModuleInterface) {
            return $result;
        }

        if (is_array($result)) {
            return new ArrayManualModuleAdapter($result, $realManualDir);
        }

        return null;
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Monitoring\NotificationManager.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Monitoring;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;

class NotificationManager implements NotificationManagerInterface
{
    private string $storageFile;

    public function __construct(string $basePath)
    {
        $this->storageFile = rtrim($basePath, '/\\') . '/temp/notifications.json';
    }

    public function push(string $message, string $type = 'info', ?string $source = null, array $context = []): void
    {
        $data = $this->getAll();
        
        $notification = [
            'id'        => uniqid('notif_'),
            'timestamp' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            'type'      => $type,
            'source'    => $source ?? 'Sistema',
            'message'   => $message,
            'context'   => $context,
            'read'      => false
        ];
        
        array_unshift($data, $notification); // Mais recentes primeiro
        
        // Mantém limite de 200 para não estourar o disco
        if (count($data) > 200) {
            $data = array_slice($data, 0, 200);
        }

        $this->save($data);
    }

    public function getUnread(): array
    {
        $all = $this->getAll();
        return array_filter($all, fn($n) => empty($n['read']));
    }

    public function markAsRead(): void
    {
        $all = $this->getAll();
        $updated = false;
        foreach ($all as &$n) {
            if (empty($n['read'])) {
                $n['read'] = true;
                $updated = true;
            }
        }
        if ($updated) {
            $this->save($all);
        }
    }

    public function getAll(): array
    {
        if (!file_exists($this->storageFile)) {
            return [];
        }
        $content = file_get_contents($this->storageFile);
        if (!$content) return [];
        return json_decode($content, true) ?: [];
    }

    public function clear(): void
    {
        if (file_exists($this->storageFile)) {
            unlink($this->storageFile);
        }
    }

    private function save(array $data): void
    {
        file_put_contents($this->storageFile, json_encode($data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Monitoring\RequestMetricsRecorder.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Monitoring;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;

/**
 * Registra métricas reais de pico de memória e tempo de execução por requisição HTTP (H-05)
 * utilizando gravação atômica via AtomicJsonStore (Pilar 1 v2.4).
 */
class RequestMetricsRecorder
{
    private string $metricsFile;
    private int $maxEntries;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $basePath = null,
        int $maxEntries = 30,
        JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = new AtomicJsonStore()
    ) {
        $base = $basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3));
        $this->metricsFile = rtrim($base, '/\\') . '/temp/request_metrics.json';
        $this->maxEntries = max(5, $maxEntries);
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore;
    }

    /**
     * Registra uma amostra de requisição concluída.
     */
    public function record(string $uri, string $method = 'GET', ?float $peakMb = null, ?float $allocatedMb = null, ?float $durationMs = null): void
    {
        if (str_contains($uri, '/api/os/monitor/stack')) {
            return;
        }

        $sample = [
            'uri'          => $uri,
            'method'       => strtoupper($method),
            'peak_mb'      => $peakMb ?? round(memory_get_peak_usage(true) / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            'allocated_mb' => $allocatedMb ?? round(memory_get_usage(true) / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            'duration_ms'  => $durationMs ?? 0.0,
            'timestamp'    => time(),
            'time_str'     => date('H:i:s'),
        ];

        $maxEntries = $this->maxEntries;
        $this->jsonStore->update($this->metricsFile, static function (array $entries) use ($sample, $maxEntries): array {
            $entries[] = $sample;
            if (count($entries) > $maxEntries) {
                $entries = array_slice($entries, -$maxEntries);
            }
            return $entries;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function getRecentEntries(): array
    {
        return $this->jsonStore->read($this->metricsFile, []);
    }

    /**
     * Retorna o maior pico de memória (em MB) observado nas requisições recentes.
     */
    public function getMaxRecentPeakMb(): float
    {
        $max = 0.0;
        foreach ($this->getRecentEntries() as $entry) {
            $peak = (float)($entry['peak_mb'] ?? 0.0);
            if ($peak > $max) {
                $max = $peak;
            }
        }
        return round($max, 2);
    }

    public function clear(): void
    {
        if (file_exists($this->metricsFile)) {
            @unlink($this->metricsFile);
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Plugin;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use Exception;

abstract class AbstractPlugin implements PluginInterface
{
    
    protected string $path;
    protected array $metadata = [];
    protected bool $isActive = false;
    
    

    public function __construct(string $path) { $this->path = rtrim($path, "/\\"); $this->loadMetadata(); }

    private function loadMetadata(): void
    {
        $jsonPath = $this->path . '/plugin.json';
        if (!file_exists($jsonPath)) {
            throw new Exception("Missing plugin.json at {$this->path}");
        }

        $content = file_get_contents($jsonPath);
        $this->metadata = json_decode($content, true) ?? [];
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return $this->metadata['name'] ?? 'unknown';
    }

    public function getVersion(): string
    {
        return $this->metadata['version'] ?? '1.0.0';
    }
    
    public function getDescription(): string
    {
        return $this->metadata['description'] ?? '';
    }

    public function getDependencies(): array
    {
        return $this->metadata['dependencies'] ?? [];
    }

    public function isActive(): bool
    {
        return $this->isActive;
    }

    public function isCore(): bool
    {
        return isset($this->metadata['core']) && $this->metadata['core'] === true;
    }
    
    public function setActive(bool $active): void
    {
        $this->isActive = $active;
    }

    

    abstract public function register(): void;
    
    // Lifecycle hooks defaults
    public function boot(): void {}
    public function activate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void {}
    public function deactivate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void {}
    public function uninstall(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void {}

    public function getSubPluginsPath(): ?string
    {
        return null;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Plugin;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use Exception;

class LinkRegistry
{
    /**
     * Map of linkName => className (or Closure)
     */
    private array $providedLinks = [];

    /**
     * Map of pluginName => OsConnector (to keep track of who requires what)
     */
    private array $connectors = [];

    public function __construct(private ContainerInterface $container)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Called by the bootstrapper to register a plugin's manifest
     */
    public function registerConnector(string $pluginName, OsConnector $connector): void
    {
        $this->connectors[$pluginName] = $connector;

        // Register all provided links globally
        foreach ($connector->getProvidedLinks() as $linkName => $providerClass) {
            if (isset($this->providedLinks[$linkName])) {
                throw new Exception("Conflito de Link: O link '{$linkName}' já está sendo fornecido por outro plugin.");
            }
            $this->providedLinks[$linkName] = $providerClass;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a link if it exists.
     */
    public function resolve(string $linkName)
    {
        if (isset($this->providedLinks[$linkName])) {
            $providerClass = $this->providedLinks[$linkName];
            return $this->container->make($providerClass);
        }

        // --- FALLBACK DO KERNEL (LINKS OFICIAIS DO SO) ---
        if ($linkName === 'core.session') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Security\SessionManager::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.db') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.identity') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Security\IdentityManager::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.router') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RouterInterface::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.theme') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.storage') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.theme_parts') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface::class);
        }
        if ($linkName === 'core.events') {
            return $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        }

        throw new Exception("Link não encontrado: Nenhum plugin ativo fornece o link '{$linkName}'.");
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se um link está disponível (via plugin ou core fallback).
     */
    public function hasLink(string $linkName): bool
    {
        if (isset($this->providedLinks[$linkName])) {
            return true;
        }

        return in_array($linkName, [
            'core.session',
            'core.db',
            'core.identity',
            'core.router',
            'core.theme',
            'core.storage',
            'core.theme_parts',
            'core.events',
        ], true);
    }

    /**
     * Validate that all required links across all registered connectors are met
     * Can be used for auditing or pre-boot checks.
     */
    public function validateDependencies(): array
    {
        $missing = [];
        foreach ($this->connectors as $pluginName => $connector) {
            foreach ($connector->getRequiredLinks() as $linkName) {
                // If it's not a core link and not provided by a plugin, it's missing
                if (!str_starts_with($linkName, 'core.') && !isset($this->providedLinks[$linkName])) {
                    $missing[$pluginName][] = $linkName;
                }
            }
        }
        return $missing;
    }

    public function getUnmetLinks(string $pluginName): array
    {
        if (!isset($this->connectors[$pluginName])) {
            return [];
        }
        $missing = [];
        foreach ($this->connectors[$pluginName]->getRequiredLinks() as $linkName) {
            if (!str_starts_with($linkName, 'core.') && !isset($this->providedLinks[$linkName])) {
                $missing[] = $linkName;
            }
        }
        return $missing;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Plugin\OsConnector.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Plugin;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;

/**
 * OsConnector (A Ponte de Negociação)
 *
 * Utilizado pelos plugins na Fase 1 para declarar suas intenções ao SO.
 * O SO guarda estas informações para auditar e aprovar os recursos.
 */
class OsConnector implements OsConnectorInterface
{
    private array $requiredLinks = [];
    private array $providedLinks = [];
    private array $requestedSlots = [];
    
    // Novo: Gatilhos/Eventos
    private array $listenedHooks = [];
    private array $providedHooks = [];

    /**
     * O Plugin avisa: "Eu PRECISO deste serviço de outro plugin/core para funcionar."
     * Ex: $os->requireLink('core.db'); // Banco de dados oficial do sistema
     */
    public function requireLink(string $linkName): self
    {
        $this->requiredLinks[] = $linkName;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * O Plugin avisa: "Eu FORNEÇO este serviço para o sistema."
     */
    public function provideLink(string $linkName, string $className): self
    {
        $this->providedLinks[$linkName] = $className;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * O Plugin avisa: "Eu QUERO renderizar algo nesta área visual."
     */
    public function requestSlot(string $slotName): self
    {
        $this->requestedSlots[] = $slotName;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * NOVO: O Plugin avisa: "Eu QUERO ser notificado quando X acontecer."
     * Ex: $os->listenHook('user.created');
     */
    public function listenHook(string $hookName): self
    {
        $this->listenedHooks[] = $hookName;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * NOVO: O Plugin avisa: "Eu VOU DISPARAR este evento para os outros ouvirem."
     * Ex: $os->provideHook('order.canceled');
     */
    public function provideHook(string $hookName): self
    {
        $this->providedHooks[] = $hookName;
        return $this;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // Métodos internos que o KERNEL usará para ler o manifesto
    // -------------------------------------------------------------

    public function getRequiredLinks(): array
    {
        return $this->requiredLinks;
    }

    public function getProvidedLinks(): array
    {
        return $this->providedLinks;
    }

    public function getRequestedSlots(): array
    {
        return $this->requestedSlots;
    }

    public function getListenedHooks(): array
    {
        return $this->listenedHooks;
    }

    public function getProvidedHooks(): array
    {
        return $this->providedHooks;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Plugin;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use Exception;

/**
 * OsRuntime (A Ponte de Execução)
 *
 * Utilizado pelos plugins na Fase 2 para pedir os recursos.
 * Aplica o Princípio do Menor Privilégio: se o plugin não pediu na Fase 1, o Runtime barra!
 */
class OsRuntime implements OsRuntimeInterface
{
    private ContainerInterface $container;
    private OsConnector $connectorManifest;
    private LinkRegistry $linkRegistry;
    private \DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface $eventDispatcher;

    private string $pluginNamespace = '';

    public function __construct(
        ContainerInterface $container,
        OsConnector $connectorManifest,
        LinkRegistry $linkRegistry,
        \DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface $eventDispatcher,
        string $pluginNamespace = ''
    ) {
        $this->pluginNamespace = $pluginNamespace;
        $this->container = $container;
        $this->connectorManifest = $connectorManifest;
        $this->linkRegistry = $linkRegistry;
        $this->eventDispatcher = $eventDispatcher;
    }

    /**
     * Entrega a instância de um Link (Serviço) ao Plugin.
     */
    public function getLink(string $linkName)
    {
        // 🚨 O GUARDIÃO DE PERMISSÕES 🚨
        if (!in_array($linkName, $this->connectorManifest->getRequiredLinks(), true)) {
            throw new Exception("Auditoria de Segurança (Bloqueio): O plugin tentou acessar o Link '{$linkName}', mas não o requisitou durante a Fase de Registro.");
        }

        return $this->linkRegistry->resolve($linkName);
    }

    /**
     * Permite ao plugin injetar visual/dado em um Slot que ele pediu acesso.
     */
    public function contributeTo(string $slotName, mixed $payload): void
    {
        // 🚨 O GUARDIÃO DE PERMISSÕES 🚨
        if (!in_array($slotName, $this->connectorManifest->getRequestedSlots(), true)) {
            throw new Exception("Auditoria de Segurança (Bloqueio): O plugin tentou modificar o Slot visual '{$slotName}', mas não pediu permissão no registro.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Permite ao plugin executar um código (callback) quando o evento acontecer.
     */
    public function onHook(string $hookName, callable $callback, int $priority = 0): void
    {
        // 🚨 O GUARDIÃO DE PERMISSÕES 🚨
        if (!in_array($hookName, $this->connectorManifest->getListenedHooks(), true)) {
            throw new Exception("Auditoria de Segurança (Bloqueio): O plugin tentou escutar o Evento/Hook '{$hookName}', mas não declarou intenção no registro.");
        }

        // Repassa para o EventDispatcher real do Kernel
        $this->eventDispatcher->addListener($hookName, $callback, $priority);
    }

    /**
     * Permite ao plugin avisar o sistema que algo aconteceu.
     */
    public function dispatchHook(string $hookName, mixed ...$payload): void
    {
        // 🚨 O GUARDIÃO DE PERMISSÕES 🚨
        if (!in_array($hookName, $this->connectorManifest->getProvidedHooks(), true)) {
            throw new Exception("Auditoria de Segurança (Bloqueio): O plugin tentou disparar o Evento/Hook '{$hookName}', mas não declarou que o forneceria no registro.");
        }

        // Repassa para o EventDispatcher real do Kernel
        $this->eventDispatcher->dispatch($hookName, ...$payload);
    }

    /**
     * Permite ao plugin aplicar modificações sobre um valor usando filtros.
     */
    public function applyFilter(string $filterName, mixed $value, mixed ...$args): mixed
    {
        // 🚨 O GUARDIÃO DE PERMISSÕES 🚨
        if (!in_array($filterName, $this->connectorManifest->getProvidedHooks(), true)) {
            throw new Exception("Auditoria de Segurança (Bloqueio): O plugin tentou aplicar o filtro '$filterName', mas não declarou que o forneceria no registro.");
        }

        // Repassa para o EventDispatcher real do Kernel
        if (method_exists($this->eventDispatcher, 'applyFilters')) {
            return $this->eventDispatcher->applyFilters($filterName, $value, ...$args);
        }

        return $value;
    }

    public function bind(string $abstract, callable|string $concrete): void
    {
        $this->container->bind($abstract, $concrete);
    }

    public function singleton(string $abstract, callable|string $concrete): void
    {
        $this->container->singleton($abstract, $concrete);
    }

    public function make(string $class)
    {
        $normalized = ltrim($class, '\\');
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, 'DomainSystem\\Core\\')) {
            throw new \Exception("Auditoria de Seguranca: Um Plugin Ring 3 nao pode instanciar Core classes diretamente. Use getLink().");
        }
        $ringZeroAppsPrefix = 'DomainSystem\\' . 'SystemApps\\';
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, $ringZeroAppsPrefix) || str_starts_with($normalized, 'DomainSystem\\Plugins\\')) {
            $ownPrefix = ltrim($this->pluginNamespace, '\\');
            if (empty($ownPrefix) || !str_starts_with($normalized, $ownPrefix)) {
                throw new \Exception("Auditoria de Seguranca: Isolamento quebrado. Nao e permitido instanciar classes de outros plugins ou SystemApps diretamente ($class). Use getLink().");
            }
        }
        return $this->container->make($normalized);
    }

    public function has(string $abstract): bool
    {
        return $this->container->has($abstract);
    }

    public function hasLink(string $linkName): bool
    {
        return $this->linkRegistry->hasLink($linkName);
    }

    public function registerCapability(string $slug, string $context = ''): void
    {
        try {
            $repo = $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\CapabilityRegistrarInterface::class);
            $repo->registerCapability($slug, $context);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            // Silently ignore if Auth plugin is not active/available yet
        }
    }
}
