// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Utils\SlugHelper.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils;

/**
 * Utilitário canônico de sanitização e geração de slugs em todo o sistema.
 * Trata acentuação pt-BR, caracteres especiais e transliteração sem dependências externas.
 */
class SlugHelper
{
    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    /**
     * Converte qualquer string em slug limpo no padrão URL/pasta (kebab-case).
     */
    public static function slugify(string $text, string $fallback = 'item'): string
    {
        $text = strtr(trim($text), self::$accentMap);

        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $clean = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        return $clean !== '' ? $clean : $fallback;
    }
}

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

use Exception;

class ExtractorFactory
{
    public static function create(): ExtractorInterface
    {
        if (class_exists('ZipArchive')) {
            return new ZipArchiveExtractor();
        }

        if (class_exists('PharData')) {
            return new PharDataExtractor();
        }

        throw new Exception("Nenhum descompactador disponível no sistema (ZipArchive ou PharData).");
    }

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Utils\Archive\ExtractorInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

interface ExtractorInterface
{
    /**
     * Extrai um pacote ZIP e retorna o nome da pasta do componente.
     * Deve lançar uma Exception caso seja um pacote inválido (sem o descritor).
     */
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationPath, string $descriptorFile = 'plugin.json'): string;
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Utils\Archive\PharDataExtractor.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

use Exception;
use PharData;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

class PharDataExtractor implements ExtractorInterface
{
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationPath, string $descriptorFile = 'plugin.json'): string
    {
        $phar = new PharData($archivePath);
        $archiveRootPrefix = 'phar://' . str_replace('\\', '/', $archivePath) . '/';

        // 1. Valida recursivamente todos os caminhos internos do arquivo
        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator($phar, RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST);
        foreach ($iterator as $entry) {
            $fullPath = str_replace('\\', '/', $entry->getPathname());
            $relative = str_starts_with($fullPath, $archiveRootPrefix)
                ? substr($fullPath, strlen($archiveRootPrefix))
                : $entry->getFilename();

            if (
                $relative === ''
                || strpos($relative, "\0") !== false
                || str_starts_with($relative, '/')
                || str_starts_with($relative, '\\')
                || preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z]:|^[a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+:\/\//', $relative) === 1
                || strpos($relative, '../') !== false
                || strpos($relative, '..\\') !== false
            ) {
                throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Caminho inválido detectado no pacote.");
            }

            foreach (explode('/', rtrim($relative, '/')) as $segment) {
                if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                    throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Segmento inválido detectado no pacote.");
                }
            }
        }

        $hasDescriptor = false;
        $componentDirName = null;

        foreach ($phar as $file) {
            if ($file->isDir()) {
                $dirName = $file->getFilename();
                if (
                    preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $dirName) === 1
                    && isset($phar[$dirName . '/' . $descriptorFile])
                ) {
                    $hasDescriptor = true;
                    $componentDirName = $dirName;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!$hasDescriptor && isset($phar[$descriptorFile])) {
            $json = file_get_contents($phar[$descriptorFile]->getPathname());
            $data = is_string($json) ? json_decode($json, true) : null;
            if (is_array($data) && isset($data['name']) && is_string($data['name'])) {
                $hasDescriptor = true;
                $componentDirName = trim((string) preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', strtolower($data['name'])), '-');

                if ($componentDirName === '') {
                    throw new Exception("Nome de componente inválido no manifesto ($descriptorFile).");
                }

                @mkdir($destinationPath . '/' . $componentDirName, 0755, true);
                $phar->extractTo($destinationPath . '/' . $componentDirName, null, true);
                return $componentDirName;
            }
        }

        if ($hasDescriptor && $componentDirName) {
            $phar->extractTo($destinationPath, null, true);
            return $componentDirName;
        }

        throw new Exception("ZIP inválido: Não possui um arquivo $descriptorFile válido no pacote.");
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Utils\Archive\ZipArchiveExtractor.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Utils\Archive;

use Exception;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CLASSE: ZipArchiveExtractor (Extração Segura em Quarentena)
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Responsável por validar e extrair pacotes ZIP de plugins e temas em
 * diretório temporário de quarentena antes da movimentação final.
 *
 * MEDIDAS DE SEGURANÇA NA EXTRAÇÃO:
 * 1. Bloqueia Path Traversal relativo ("../", "..\") e segmentos "." / "..".
 * 2. Bloqueia caminhos absolutos Unix/Windows ("/home/...", "\...", "C:\...")
 *    e wrappers de stream ("phar://", "file://").
 * 3. Bloqueia links simbólicos (symlinks UNIX no cabeçalho externo do ZIP).
 * 4. Realiza extração controlada via stream entrada por entrada (sem delegar
 *    caminhos ao ZipArchive::extractTo nativo), validando que o destino real
 *    (realpath) permanece estritamente confinado dentro da pasta de quarentena.
 */
class ZipArchiveExtractor implements ExtractorInterface
{
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationPath, string $descriptorFile = 'plugin.json'): string
    {
        $zip = new ZipArchive();

        if ($zip->open($archivePath) !== true) {
            throw new Exception("Não foi possível abrir o arquivo ZIP com ZipArchive.");
        }

        $hasDescriptor = false;
        $componentDirName = null;
        $escapedDescriptor = preg_quote($descriptorFile, '#');

        try {
            // 1. ANÁLISE DO PACOTE E VALIDAÇÃO ESTRITA DE CAMINHOS E SYMLINKS
            for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
                $filename = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
                if (!is_string($filename) || $filename === '') {
                    throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Entrada inválida no pacote ZIP.");
                }

                $this->assertSafeEntry($zip, $i, $filename);

                $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $filename);
                if (preg_match('#^([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/' . $escapedDescriptor . '$#', $normalized, $matches)) {
                    $hasDescriptor = true;
                    $componentDirName = $matches[1];
                }
            }

            // 2. PREPARAÇÃO DA QUARENTENA
            $baseTemp = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') && is_dir(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp')
                ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp'
                : sys_get_temp_dir();
            $tempDir = $baseTemp . '/quarentena_zip_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
            if (!@mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($tempDir)) {
                throw new Exception("Não foi possível criar o diretório de quarentena para extração.");
            }

            // Se o ZIP não tem pasta raiz (os arquivos estão soltos na raiz do ZIP)
            if (!$hasDescriptor) {
                $idx = $zip->locateName($descriptorFile);
                if ($idx !== false) {
                    $json = $zip->getFromIndex($idx);
                    $data = is_string($json) ? json_decode($json, true) : null;
                    if (is_array($data) && isset($data['name']) && is_string($data['name'])) {
                        $hasDescriptor = true;
                        $componentDirName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/', '-', strtolower($data['name'])) ?: '';
                        $componentDirName = trim($componentDirName, '-');

                        if ($componentDirName === '') {
                            throw new Exception("Nome de componente inválido no manifesto ($descriptorFile).");
                        }

                        $this->safeExtract($zip, $tempDir);
                        $zip->close();

                        $this->moveToDestination($tempDir, $destinationPath, $componentDirName, $descriptorFile);
                        return $componentDirName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!$hasDescriptor || !$componentDirName) {
                if (is_dir($tempDir)) {
                    $this->deleteDirectory($tempDir);
                }
                throw new Exception("ZIP inválido: Não possui o arquivo manifesto ($descriptorFile) válido no pacote.");
            }

            // 3. EXTRAÇÃO CONTROLADA PARA QUARENTENA
            $this->safeExtract($zip, $tempDir);
            $zip->close();

            // 4. TRANSFERÊNCIA DA QUARENTENA PARA A PASTA FINAL
            $sourcePath = $tempDir . '/' . $componentDirName;
            $this->moveToDestination($sourcePath, $destinationPath, $componentDirName, $descriptorFile);
            $this->deleteDirectory($tempDir);

            return $componentDirName;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            @$zip->close();
            if (isset($tempDir) && is_dir($tempDir)) {
                $this->deleteDirectory($tempDir);
            }
            throw $e instanceof Exception ? $e : new Exception($e->getMessage(), (int) $e->getCode(), $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Valida se uma entrada do ZIP é segura contra Zip-Slip, caminhos absolutos,
     * letras de unidade, wrappers de stream e symlinks UNIX.
     */
    private function assertSafeEntry(ZipArchive $zip, int $index, string $filename): void
    {
        if (strpos($filename, "\0") !== false) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Byte nulo detectado no caminho do ZIP.");
        }

        // Bloqueia caminhos absolutos Unix (/...) ou Windows (\... ou \\...)
        if (str_starts_with($filename, '/') || str_starts_with($filename, '\\')) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Caminho absoluto não permitido no pacote ZIP.");
        }

        // Bloqueia letras de unidade do Windows (C:...) e wrappers (phar://, file://, etc.)
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z]:|^[a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+:\/\//', $filename) === 1) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Drive ou protocolo absoluto não permitido no pacote ZIP.");
        }

        // Bloqueia traversal relativo bruto
        if (strpos($filename, '../') !== false || strpos($filename, '..\\') !== false) {
            throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): O pacote contém caminhos maliciosos.");
        }

        $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $filename);
        $segments = explode('/', rtrim($normalized, '/'));
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Segmento de diretório inválido no pacote ZIP.");
            }
        }

        // Bloqueia links simbólicos UNIX (S_IFLNK = 0120000 nos atributos externos)
        $opsys = 0;
        $attr = 0;
        if ($zip->getExternalAttributesIndex($index, $opsys, $attr)) {
            $unixMode = ($attr >> 16) & 0170000;
            if ($unixMode === 0120000) {
                throw new Exception("Vulnerabilidade Crítica (Zip-Slip): Links simbólicos (symlinks) não são permitidos no pacote ZIP.");
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extrai os arquivos via stream entrada por entrada (sem usar ZipArchive::extractTo),
     * garantindo confinamento real dentro de $tempDir via realpath().
     */
    private function safeExtract(ZipArchive $zip, string $tempDir): void
    {
        $realTempRoot = realpath($tempDir);
        if ($realTempRoot === false) {
            throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Diretório de quarentena inacessível.");
        }
        $realTempPrefix = rtrim($realTempRoot, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $filename = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
            if (!is_string($filename) || $filename === '') {
                throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Entrada inválida dentro do ZIP.");
            }

            $this->assertSafeEntry($zip, $i, $filename);

            $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $filename);
            $isDirectory = str_ends_with($normalized, '/');
            $relativePath = str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, rtrim($normalized, '/'));
            $targetPath = $realTempPrefix . $relativePath;

            if ($isDirectory) {
                if (!is_dir($targetPath) && !@mkdir($targetPath, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetPath)) {
                    throw new Exception("Falha ao criar diretório na quarentena.");
                }
                $realTargetDir = realpath($targetPath);
                if ($realTargetDir === false || !str_starts_with($realTargetDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $realTempPrefix)) {
                    throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Escape de diretório detectado na quarentena.");
                }
                continue;
            }

            $parentDir = dirname($targetPath);
            if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                throw new Exception("Falha ao criar diretório pai na quarentena.");
            }

            $realParent = realpath($parentDir);
            if (
                $realParent === false
                || ($realParent !== $realTempRoot && !str_starts_with($realParent . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $realTempPrefix))
            ) {
                throw new Exception("Falha de Segurança: Caminho fora da área de quarentena.");
            }

            $stream = $zip->getStream($filename);
            if (!is_resource($stream)) {
                throw new Exception("Falha ao ler stream do arquivo no pacote ZIP.");
            }

            $out = @fopen($targetPath, 'wb');
            if (!is_resource($out)) {
                fclose($stream);
                throw new Exception("Falha ao gravar arquivo na quarentena.");
            }

            stream_copy_to_stream($stream, $out);
            fclose($out);
            fclose($stream);
        }
    }

    private function moveToDestination(string $sourcePath, string $destinationPath, string $componentDirName, string $descriptorFile): void
    {
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $componentDirName) !== 1) {
            $this->deleteDirectory($sourcePath);
            throw new Exception("Bloqueio de Segurança: Nome de diretório de componente inválido.");
        }

        if (!is_dir($destinationPath)) {
            @mkdir($destinationPath, 0755, true);
        }

        $targetPath = $destinationPath . '/' . $componentDirName;

        // Proteção Ring 0: impede sobrescrever um SystemApp protegido via upload ZIP
        if (file_exists($targetPath . '/' . $descriptorFile)) {
            $meta = json_decode((string) file_get_contents($targetPath . '/' . $descriptorFile), true);
            if (!empty($meta['core'])) {
                $this->deleteDirectory($sourcePath);
                throw new Exception("Bloqueio de Segurança: Não é permitido sobrescrever um SystemApp protegido via upload ZIP.");
            }
        }

        if (file_exists($targetPath)) {
            $this->deleteDirectory($targetPath);
        }

        if (!@rename($sourcePath, $targetPath)) {
            $this->copyDirectory($sourcePath, $targetPath);
            $this->deleteDirectory($sourcePath);
        }
    }

    private function copyDirectory(string $source, string $dest): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dest)) {
            @mkdir($dest, 0755, true);
        }
        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($source, \RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            \RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST
        );
        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            $target = $dest . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $iterator->getSubPathname();
            if ($item->isDir()) {
                if (!is_dir($target)) {
                    @mkdir($target, 0755, true);
                }
            } else {
                copy($item->getPathname(), $target);
            }
        }
    }

    private function deleteDirectory(string $dir): bool
    {
        if (!file_exists($dir)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return unlink($dir);
        }

        $items = scandir($dir);
        if ($items === false) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!$this->deleteDirectory($dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return rmdir($dir);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Workspace\DefaultWorkspace.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Workspace;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;

class DefaultWorkspace implements WorkspaceInterface
{
    private ThemeManager $theme;
    private ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifManager;

    public function __construct(ThemeManager $theme, ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifManager = null)
    {
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->notifManager = $notifManager;
    }

    public function wrap(string $content): string
    {
        $unreadNotifs = [];
        $allNotifs = [];

        if ($this->notifManager) {
            $unreadNotifs = $this->notifManager->getUnread();
            $allNotifs = $this->notifManager->getAll();
            if (!empty($unreadNotifs)) {
                $this->notifManager->markAsRead();
            }
        }

        return $this->theme->render('layout', [
            'content' => $content,
            'unreadNotifs' => $unreadNotifs,
            'allNotifs' => $allNotifs
        ]);
    }

    public function getThemeName(): string
    {
        return 'admin';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Workspace\WorkspaceInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Workspace;

/**
 * A "Tomada" (Interface / Contrato)
 * Define o padrão que todos os workspaces devem seguir.
 */
interface WorkspaceInterface
{
    /**
     * Envelopa o conteúdo bruto no layout do workspace.
     */
    public function wrap(string $content): string;

    /**
     * Retorna o nome da pasta do tema (CockPIT) que este workspace utiliza.
     */
    public function getThemeName(): string;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Core\Workspace\WorkspaceManager.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Workspace;

use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;

/**
 * O Gerenciador de Workspaces
 * Funciona como um Registro de Tomadas. Não sabe nada sobre médicos ou advogados.
 */
class WorkspaceManager
{
    private Container $container;
    private ThemeManager $theme;
    private array $workspaces = [];

    public function __construct(Container $container, ThemeManager $theme)
    {
        $this->container = $container;
        $this->theme = $theme;
    }

    /**
     * Registra um novo layout/workspace para um cargo específico.
     */
    public function registerWorkspace(string $role, WorkspaceInterface $workspace): void
    {
        $this->workspaces[strtolower($role)] = $workspace;
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a implementação correta da interface baseada no cargo
     */
    public function getWorkspace(string $role): WorkspaceInterface
    {
        $role = strtolower($role);
        
        if (isset($this->workspaces[$role])) {
            $workspace = $this->workspaces[$role];
        } else {
            $notifManager = null;
            if ($this->container->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface::class)) {
                $notifManager = $this->container->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface::class);
            }
            $workspace = new DefaultWorkspace($this->theme, $notifManager);
        }

        // Troca automaticamente a fiação do motor de renderização para o CockPIT atual!
        $basePath = dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $themeName = $workspace->getThemeName();
        if (is_dir($themeName)) {
            $this->theme->setActiveThemePath($themeName);
        } else {
            $this->theme->setActiveThemePath($basePath . '/themes/' . $themeName);
        }

        return $workspace;
    }
}

        // 5. Integração com Pagamentos / Webhooks (DIP & Event-driven): ativa matrícula automaticamente
        $runtime->onHook('payment.approved', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $userId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $courseId = (int)($payload['course_id'] ?? ($payload['item_id'] ?? 0));
            $orderRef = isset($payload['order_ref']) ? (string)$payload['order_ref'] : null;
            $expiresAt = isset($payload['expires_at']) && $payload['expires_at'] instanceof \DateTimeImmutable
                ? $payload['expires_at']
                : null;

            if ($userId > 0 && $courseId > 0) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService */
                    $enrollmentService = $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class);
                    $enrollmentService->enroll($userId, $courseId, $expiresAt, $orderRef);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[Academy] Falha ao matricular aluno em payment.approved: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 5b. Revogação de Matrícula por Reembolso (T13):
        $runtime->onHook('payment.refunded', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $userId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $courseId = (int)($payload['course_id'] ?? ($payload['item_id'] ?? 0));

            if ($userId > 0 && $courseId > 0) {
                try {
                    if ($runtime->has(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class)) {
                        /** @var CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo */
                        $enrollmentRepo = $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $enrollmentRepo->updateStatus($userId, $courseId, 'cancelled');
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[Academy] Falha ao revogar matrícula por reembolso: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 6. Conexão com o Commerce (Padrão Adapter): expõe cursos como itens vendíveis
        $runtime->onHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers', function ($resolver) use ($runtime) {
            if ($resolver instanceof PurchasableItemResolverInterface) {
                $resolver->registerResolver('course', function (int $id) use ($runtime) {
                    try {
                        /** @var CourseRepositoryInterface $repo */
                        $repo = $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $course = $repo->findById($id);
                        return $course ? new CoursePurchasableAdapter($course) : null;
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                });
            }
        });

        // 7. Registro de Blocos Semânticos no Flex Builder via Contrato (SOLID - OCP / DIP)
        $registerAcademyBlocks = function ($registry) use ($runtime) {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'has') && !$registry->has('user_auth')) {
                $session = null;
                try {
                    $session = $runtime->getLink('core.session');
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

                $provider = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Blocks\AcademyBlockProvider(
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    $session
                );
                $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
            }
        };

        $runtime->onHook('theme.blocks.register', $registerAcademyBlocks);
        $runtime->onHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks', $registerAcademyBlocks);
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db');
        new PdoCourseRepository($db);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($db);
        $structureRepo->ensureTables();
        $enrollmentRepo = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($db);
        $enrollmentRepo->ensureTable();
        $progressRepo = new PdoStudentProgressRepository($db);
        $progressRepo->ensureTable();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\academy\Adapters\CoursePurchasableAdapter.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Adapters;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemInterface;

/**
 * Adaptador que transforma um Curso do Academy em um Item Vendável do Commerce (Padrão Adapter / DIP).
 */
class CoursePurchasableAdapter implements PurchasableItemInterface
{
    private array $course;
    private ?string $thumbnailUrl;

    public function __construct(array $course, ?string $thumbnailUrl = null)
    {
        $this->course = $course;
        $this->thumbnailUrl = $thumbnailUrl;
    }

    public function getId(): int
    {
        return (int)($this->course['id'] ?? 0);
    }

    public function getItemType(): string
    {
        return 'course';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->course['title'] ?? 'Curso sem título');
    }

    public function getPrice(): float
    {
        return (float)($this->course['price'] ?? 0.0);
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool
    {
        return ($this->course['status'] ?? '') === 'published';
    }

    public function getDescription(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->course['description'] ?? '');
    }

    public function getThumbnailUrl(): ?string
    {
        return $this->thumbnailUrl ?: ($this->course['image'] ?? null);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\academy\Blocks\AcademyBlockProvider.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\UserAuthBlock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;

/**
 * Provedor de Blocos Semânticos do Plugin Academy para o Flex Builder (SOLID - OCP / DIP).
 *
 * Registra o bloco 'Área de Login / Aluno' (user_auth) de forma extensível.
 * Caso o plugin Academy esteja desativado, este provedor não é carregado,
 * mantendo o Flex Builder 100% desacoplado.
 */
class AcademyBlockProvider implements BlockProviderInterface
{
    private ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;
    private ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private ?SessionManagerInterface $session;

    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?SessionManagerInterface $session = null
    ) {
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer;
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver;
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer;
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    public function registerBlocks(BlockRegistryInterface $registry): void
    {
        if (!$registry->has('user_auth')) {
            $registry->register(new UserAuthBlock(
                $this->htmlSanitizer,
                $this->urlResolver,
                $this->styleRenderer,
                $this->session
            ));
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts;

use DateTimeImmutable;

/**
 * Contrato de Gerenciamento de Matrículas e Acesso a Cursos (DIP / SOLID).
 * 
 * Responsabilidade Única (SRP):
 * - Controlar a autorização de acesso dos alunos aos cursos.
 * - Manter o ciclo de vida das matrículas (ativa, expirada, cancelada).
 * - Totalmente desacoplado de provedores de pagamento ou checkout.
 */
interface CourseEnrollmentInterface
{
    /**
     * Verifica se o aluno possui matrícula ativa no curso informado.
     * Cursos gratuitos/públicos ou administradores podem conceder acesso irrestrito.
     */
    public function hasActiveEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool;

    /**
     * Matricula o aluno no curso, opcionalmente com prazo de expiração (para assinaturas)
     * e referência ao pedido financeiro.
     */
    public function enroll(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool;

    /**
     * Revoga ou cancela o acesso do aluno ao curso (ex: estorno, inadimplência ou cancelamento).
     */
    public function revoke(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna a lista de IDs de cursos nos quais o aluno possui matrícula ativa.
     *
     * @return array<int>
     */
    public function getActiveCourseIds(int $studentId): array;

    /**
     * Retorna os detalhes da matrícula de um aluno em um curso específico.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function getEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): ?array;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato estrito para a navegação de cursos e aulas no Domain-System OS.
 * 
 * Segue os princípios SOLID (DIP e ISP):
 * Permite que qualquer template ou workspace consuma e renderize a árvore
 * de navegação de um curso (módulos, aulas e links) sem acoplamento a tabelas SQL.
 */
interface CourseNavigationInterface
{
    /**
     * Retorna a árvore hierárquica completa do curso (módulos e suas respectivas aulas).
     *
     * @param string|int $courseIdentifier Slug ou ID do curso

     *     id: int,
     *     title: string,
     *     position: int,
     *     lessons: array<int, array{
     *         id: int,
     *         title: string,
     *         slug: string,
     *         url: string,
     *         source_type: string,
     *         source?: ?string,
     *         position: int,
     *         status: string
     *     }>
     * }>
     */
    public function getCourseTree(string|int $courseIdentifier): array;

    /**
     * Renderiza o container semântico <nav class="course-nav"> com a árvore de módulos e aulas.
     *
     * @param string|int $courseIdentifier Slug ou ID do curso
     * @param string $currentLessonSlug Slug da aula atualmente ativa para destaque
     * @param array<string, mixed> $options Opções visuais customizadas
     * @return string HTML seguro do container <nav>
     */
    public function renderCourseNav(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug = '', array $options = []): string;

    /**
     * Retorna as aulas adjacentes (anterior e próxima) para paginação de navegação linear.
     *
     * @param string|int $courseIdentifier Slug ou ID do curso
     * @param string $currentLessonSlug Slug da aula atual
     * @return array{
     *     prev: ?array{id: int, title: string, slug: string, url: string},
     *     next: ?array{id: int, title: string, slug: string, url: string}
     * }
     */
    public function getAdjacentLessons(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug): array;
}

     */
    public function slugify(string $title): string;

     * Cria fisicamente uma pasta/módulo dentro de `pages/` do tema ativo.
     *
     * @param string $folderTitle Nome ou título da pasta/módulo
     * @return array{slug: string, relative_path: string, full_path: string}
     */
    public function createFolder(string $folderTitle): array;

     * Fabrica automaticamente um arquivo `.php` pré-configurado (com CSS e JS padrão Mobile/Desktop
     * e suporte ao Editor de Blocos) a partir do Título da aula/página.
     *
     * Ex: Título "Estrutura de Dados" -> arquivo `estrutura-de-dados.php`
     *     Slug relativo: `pages/estrutura-de-dados.php` (ou `pages/{folder}/estrutura-de-dados.php`)
     *
     * @param string      $title         Título da aula ou página (ex: "Estrutura de Dados")
     * @param string|null $folder        Subpasta opcional dentro de pages/ (ex: "curso-de-python" ou "")

     *   full_path: string,
     *   public_url: string
     * }
     */
    public function fabricateLessonFile(
        string $title,
        ?string $folder = null,
        ?string $blocksJson = null,
        string $mobileProfile = 'drawer'
    ): array;

    /**
     * Inspeciona um arquivo PHP existente de aula para extrair metadados inteligentes:
     * - Título real (via docblock "* Título: ..." ou tag <h1>)
     * - Slug normalizado
     * - Perfil mobile ("* Perfil Mobile: ...")
     * - Se contém blocos DS_BLOCKS_B64 e seu JSON decodificado
     *
     * @param string $relativePath Caminho relativo ao tema (ex: 'pages/curso/aula.php')
     * @return array{
     *   title: string,
     *   slug: string,
     *   mobile_profile: string,
     *   has_blocks: bool,
     *   blocks_json: string|null
     * }

     *     total_students: int,
     *     active_students: int,
     *     suspended_students: int,
     *     total_enrollments: int
     * }
     */
    public function getStudentMetrics(): array;

    /**
     * Concede matrícula manual imediata a um curso.
     */
    public function enrollStudent(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool;

    /**
     * Revoga ou cancela a matrícula de um aluno em um curso.
     */
    public function revokeEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool;

    /**
     * Atualiza o status do aluno ('active', 'suspended', 'banned').
     */
    public function setStudentStatus(int $studentId, string $status): bool;

    /**
     * Redefine a senha de acesso do aluno.
     */
    public function resetStudentPassword(int $studentId, string $newPassword): bool;
}

/**

    public function getStudentNote(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): string;

    /**
     * Lista os arquivos salvos pelo aluno na sua pasta pessoal.
     *
     * @return array<array{name: string, size: int, modified_at: int}>
     */
    public function listStudentFiles(int $studentId): array;

    /**
     * Remove um arquivo da pasta pessoal do aluno de forma segura (com proteção contra traversal).
     */
    public function deleteStudentFile(int $studentId, string $filename): bool;

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseAdminController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CoursePackageServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CoursePackageService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseService;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Throwable;

class CourseAdminController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private CourseService $service;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private ThemePageResolverInterface|ThemeManagerInterface|null $pageResolver;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;
    private ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder;
    private ?CoursePackageServiceInterface $packageService;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $repository,
        CourseService $service,
        SessionManagerInterface $session,
        ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo = null,
        ThemePageResolverInterface|ThemeManagerInterface|null $pageResolver = null,
        ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null,
        ?LessonFileScaffolderInterface $scaffolder = null,
        ?CoursePackageServiceInterface $packageService = null
    ) {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->service = $service;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->pageResolver = $pageResolver;
        $this->storage = $storage;
        $this->scaffolder = $scaffolder;
        $this->packageService = $packageService;

        if ($this->packageService === null && $this->structureRepo !== null && $this->pageResolver instanceof ThemePageResolverInterface) {
            $this->packageService = new CoursePackageService(
                $this->repository,
                $this->structureRepo,
                $this->pageResolver,
                $this->service,
                $this->scaffolder
            );
        }
    }

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $courses = $this->repository->findAll();
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/courses/index', [
            'courses'          => $courses,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'flashType'        => $flashType,
            'flashMsg'         => $flashMsg,
            'storage'          => $this->storage,
            'commerceSettings' => $this->getCommerceSettings(),
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $course = $this->repository->findById((int)$id);
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;

        $initialStructure = [];
        $availablePages = [];

        if ($this->structureRepo !== null) {
            $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules((int)$course['id']);
            $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);
            $availablePages = $this->resolvePublicThemePages();
            $availablePagesMeta = [];
            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                foreach ($availablePages as $p) {
                    $availablePagesMeta[$p] = $this->scaffolder->inspectLessonFile($p);
                }
            }

            $lessonsByMod = [];
            $standaloneLessons = [];
            foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
                $mId = $l['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$l['module_id'] : null;
                if ($mId !== null && $mId > 0) {
                    $lessonsByMod[$mId][] = $l;
                } else {
                    $standaloneLessons[] = $l;
                }
            }

            foreach ($modules as $m) {
                $mId = (int)$m['id'];
                $initialStructure[] = [
                    'id'          => $mId,
                    'title'       => (string)$m['title'],
                    'folder_slug' => (string)($m['folder_slug'] ?? ''),
                    'position'    => (int)$m['position'],
                    'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $les): array {
                        return [
                            'id'             => (int)$les['id'],
                            'title'          => (string)$les['title'],
                            'slug'           => (string)$les['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => (string)$les['source_type'],
                            'source'         => (string)($les['source'] ?? ''),
                            'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                            'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                            'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                        ];
                    }, $lessonsByMod[$mId] ?? []),
                ];
            }

            if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
                $initialStructure[] = [
                    'title'       => 'Módulo Geral',
                    'folder_slug' => '',
                    'position'    => 999,
                    'lessons'     => array_map(static function (array $les): array {
                        return [
                            'id'             => (int)$les['id'],
                            'title'          => (string)$les['title'],
                            'slug'           => (string)$les['slug'],
                            'source_type'    => (string)$les['source_type'],
                            'source'         => (string)($les['source'] ?? ''),
                            'content'        => (string)($les['content'] ?? ''),
                            'mobile_profile' => (string)($les['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer'),
                            'status'         => (string)($les['status'] ?? 'published'),
                        ];
                    }, $standaloneLessons),
                ];
            }
        }

        $html = $this->renderView('admin/courses/edit', [
            'course'           => $course,
            'csrfToken'        => $csrfToken,
            'baseUrl'          => $baseUrl,
            'flashType'        => $flashType,
            'flashMsg'         => $flashMsg,
            'storage'          => $this->storage,
            'hasStructureRepo' => $this->structureRepo !== null,
            'initialStructure' => $initialStructure,
            'availablePages'       => $availablePages,
            'availablePagesMeta'   => $availablePagesMeta ?? [],
            'commerceSettings' => $this->getCommerceSettings(),
        ]);

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    /**
     * Cria uma pasta física dentro de pages/ do tema ativo e adiciona o módulo correspondente ao curso.
     */
    public function createThemeFolder(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        $folderName = trim((string)($request->input('folder_name') ?? ''));
        if ($folderName === '') {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O nome da pasta/módulo é obrigatório.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        try {
            $folderSlug = null;
            $relDir = '';
            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                $courseSlug = trim((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));
                $targetPath = $this->resolveCourseWorkspacePath($courseSlug, $folderName);

                $folderInfo = $this->scaffolder->createFolder($targetPath);
                $relDir = (string)($folderInfo['relative_path'] ?? '');
                $folderSlug = (string)($folderInfo['slug'] ?? $this->scaffolder->slugify($targetPath));
            }

            if ($this->structureRepo !== null) {
                $existingModules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
                $nextPos = count($existingModules) + 1;
                if (method_exists($this->structureRepo, 'createModule')) {
                    $this->structureRepo->createModule($courseId, $folderName, $nextPos, $folderSlug);
                }
            }

            $msg = $relDir !== ''
                ? "Pasta '{$relDir}' e módulo '{$folderName}' criados com sucesso!"
                : "Módulo '{$folderName}' criado com sucesso!";
            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao criar pasta/módulo: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function updateStructure(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)$id;

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);
        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso não encontrado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->structureRepo === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Repositório de estrutura não disponível.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
        }

        $rawJson = $request->input('structure_json');
        if (!empty($rawJson)) {
            $structure = json_decode((string)$rawJson, true);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', "Formato da estrutura inválido.");
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
            }
        } else {
            $structure = $request->input('structure', []);
            if (!is_array($structure)) {
                $structure = [];
            }
        }

        $autoFabricate = (string)($request->input('auto_fabricate_php') ?? '') === '1';

        try {
            $fabricatedFilesCount = 0;
            $courseSlug = trim((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));

            if ($this->scaffolder !== null) {
                foreach ($structure as &$modData) {
                    $rawFolder = isset($modData['folder_slug']) && trim((string)$modData['folder_slug']) !== ''
                        ? trim((string)$modData['folder_slug'])
                        : '';

                    // Assegura isolamento no workspace do curso: se folder_slug estiver vazio, usa a pasta do curso.
                    // Se especificado, aninha dentro de pages/{course_slug}/{modulo}
                    if ($rawFolder === '') {
                        $folderSlug = $courseSlug !== '' ? $courseSlug : null;
                    } else {
                        $folderSlug = $this->resolveCourseWorkspacePath($courseSlug, $rawFolder);
                    }

                    if ($folderSlug !== null && $autoFabricate) {
                        $this->scaffolder->createFolder($folderSlug);
                    }
                    $modData['folder_slug'] = $folderSlug ?? '';

                    if (!isset($modData['lessons']) || !is_array($modData['lessons'])) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    foreach ($modData['lessons'] as &$lesson) {
                        $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? ''));
                        if ($title === '') {
                            continue;
                        }

                        $srcType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                        $source = trim((string)($lesson['source'] ?? ''));
                        $shouldFabricate = !empty($lesson['auto_fabricate'])
                            || ($autoFabricate && ($source === '' || $srcType === 'content'));

                        if ($shouldFabricate) {
                            $rawContent = (string)($lesson['content'] ?? '');

                            $fabricated = $this->scaffolder->fabricateLessonFile(
                                $title,
                                $folderSlug,
                                $rawContent !== '' ? $rawContent : null,
                                (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer')
                            );

                            if (empty($lesson['slug']) || preg_match('/^aula-\d+$/', (string)$lesson['slug'])) {
                                $lesson['slug'] = $fabricated['slug'];
                            }
                            if ($source === '') {
                                $lesson['source'] = $fabricated['relative_path'];
                            }
                            $fabricatedFilesCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    unset($lesson);
                }
                unset($modData);
            }

            $this->structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
            $extraMsg = $fabricatedFilesCount > 0 ? " ({$fabricatedFilesCount} arquivo(s) .php fabricado(s) em pages/)" : '';
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Estrutura do curso atualizada com sucesso!{$extraMsg}");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar estrutura: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $courseId);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $this->extractUploadedThumbnail($request);
            $rawPrice = str_replace(',', '.', (string)($request->input('price') ?? '0'));
            $price = max(0.0, (float)$rawPrice);
            $isFreeInput = $request->input('is_free');
            if ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '1') {
                $isFree = 1;
                $price = 0.00;
            } elseif ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '0') {
                $isFree = 0;
                if ($price <= 0.0) {
                    $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe um preço maior que zero para cursos pagos ou marque o curso como gratuito.');
                    return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
                }
            } else {
                $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? 0 : 1;
            }
            $maxInstallments = max(1, min(24, (int)($request->input('max_installments') ?? 12)));

            $data = [
                'title'                 => $request->input('title'),
                'description'           => $request->input('description'),
                'status'                => $request->input('status'),
                'link'                  => $request->input('link'),
                'price'                 => $price,
                'is_free'               => $isFree,
                'max_installments'      => $maxInstallments,
                'external_platform'     => $request->input('external_platform'),
                'external_product_id'   => $request->input('external_product_id'),
                'external_checkout_url' => $request->input('external_checkout_url'),
            ];

            $this->service->createCourse($data, $file);
            $this->syncGatewaySettingsFromRequest($request);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso cadastrado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao cadastrar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $file = $this->extractUploadedThumbnail($request);
            $rawPrice = str_replace(',', '.', (string)($request->input('price') ?? '0'));
            $price = max(0.0, (float)$rawPrice);
            $isFreeInput = $request->input('is_free');
            if ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '1') {
                $isFree = 1;
                $price = 0.00;
            } elseif ($isFreeInput !== null && (string)$isFreeInput === '0') {
                $isFree = 0;
                if ($price <= 0.0) {
                    $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe um preço maior que zero para cursos pagos ou marque o curso como gratuito.');
                    return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $id);
                }
            } else {
                $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? 0 : 1;
            }
            $maxInstallments = max(1, min(24, (int)($request->input('max_installments') ?? 12)));

            $data = [
                'title'                 => $request->input('title'),
                'description'           => $request->input('description'),
                'status'                => $request->input('status'),
                'link'                  => $request->input('link'),
                'price'                 => $price,
                'is_free'               => $isFree,
                'max_installments'      => $maxInstallments,
                'external_platform'     => $request->input('external_platform'),
                'external_product_id'   => $request->input('external_product_id'),
                'external_checkout_url' => $request->input('external_checkout_url'),
            ];

            $this->service->updateCourse((int)$id, $data, $file);
            $this->syncGatewaySettingsFromRequest($request);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso atualizado com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao atualizar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $id);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    public function delete(Request $request, $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $this->service->deleteCourse((int)$id);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso excluído com sucesso!");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao excluir curso: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    private function extractUploadedThumbnail(Request $request): ?array
    {
        $file = $request->file('thumbnail');
        if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("O arquivo de imagem enviado excedeu o tamanho máximo permitido pelo servidor.");
            }
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo de imagem (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
        }
        return $file;
    }

    public function exportZip(Request $request, $id = null): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $courseId = (int)($id ?? $request->input('id'));
        $course = $this->repository->findById($courseId);

        if (!$course) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Curso ID {$courseId} não encontrado para exportação.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->packageService === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O serviço de empacotamento de cursos não está configurado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $zipPath = $this->packageService->exportCourseZip($courseId);
            $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9_-]/i', '_', (string)$course['slug']) ?: 'curso';
            $fileName = 'curso-' . $slug . '.zip';
            $zipContent = (string)file_get_contents($zipPath);
            @unlink($zipPath);

            return new Response($zipContent, 200, [
                'Content-Type'        => 'application/zip',
                'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $fileName . '"',
                'Content-Length'      => (string)strlen($zipContent),
                'Pragma'              => 'no-cache',
                'Expires'             => '0',
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Erro ao exportar curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }
    }

    public function importZip(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrfToken($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Token de segurança CSRF inválido.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        if ($this->packageService === null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "O serviço de importação de cursos não está configurado.");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }

        try {
            $zipUpload = $this->extractUploadedZipFile($request);
            if (!$zipUpload || empty($zipUpload['tmp_name'])) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', "Por favor, selecione um arquivo .zip de curso para importar.");
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
            }

            $res = $this->packageService->importCourseZip($zipUpload['tmp_name']);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Curso '{$res['title']}' importado com sucesso! ({$res['modules_count']} módulo(s) e {$res['lessons_count']} aula(s) restauradas).");
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy/edit/' . $res['course_id']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha na importação do curso: " . $e->getMessage());
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/academy');
        }
    }

    private function extractUploadedZipFile(Request $request): ?array
    {
        $file = $request->file('course_zip');
        if ($file && (empty($file['tmp_name']) || ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($file && ($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_OK) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Erro no envio do arquivo ZIP (Código: " . ($file['error'] ?? 'desconhecido') . ").");
        }
        return $file;
    }

    private function verifyCsrfToken(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        if ($token === '' || $expected === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        if ($this->pageResolver instanceof ThemePageResolverInterface) {
            return $this->pageResolver->resolvePublicThemePages();
        }

        if ($this->pageResolver instanceof ThemeManagerInterface) {
            $pages = $this->pageResolver->getAvailablePages();
            $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
            natsort($pages);
            return array_values($pages);
        }

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = []): string
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        return (string)ob_get_clean();
    }

    /**
     * Retorna as configurações ativas do DomainCommerce para pré-preenchimento dos gateways.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function getCommerceSettings(): array
    {
        if (class_exists(\DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings::class)) {
            return (new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings())->all();
        }
        return [];
    }

    /**
     * Salva ou sincroniza credenciais do PayPal ou Stripe enviadas diretamente pelo formulário do curso.
     */
    private function syncGatewaySettingsFromRequest(Request $request): void
    {
        if (!class_exists(\DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings::class)) {
            return;
        }

        $commSettings = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings();
        $toSave = [];

        // PayPal
        if ($request->input('paypal_client_id') !== null) {
            $cid = trim((string)$request->input('paypal_client_id'));
            $csec = trim((string)$request->input('paypal_client_secret'));
            if ($cid !== '') $toSave['paypal_client_id'] = $cid;
            if ($csec !== '') $toSave['paypal_client_secret'] = $csec;
            if ($cid !== '' && $csec !== '') $toSave['paypal_enabled'] = true;
            // Checkbox HTML: se não vier no POST, significa que foi desmarcado (false)
            $toSave['paypal_sandbox'] = !empty($request->input('paypal_sandbox'));
        }

        // Stripe
        if ($request->input('stripe_secret_key') !== null) {
            $ssec = trim((string)$request->input('stripe_secret_key'));
            $spub = trim((string)$request->input('stripe_publishable_key'));
            if ($ssec !== '') $toSave['stripe_secret_key'] = $ssec;
            if ($spub !== '') $toSave['stripe_publishable_key'] = $spub;
            if ($ssec !== '') $toSave['stripe_enabled'] = true;
            // Checkbox HTML: se não vier no POST, significa que foi desmarcado (false)
            $toSave['stripe_sandbox'] = !empty($request->input('stripe_sandbox'));
        }

        if (!empty($toSave)) {
            $commSettings->save($toSave);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Garante que subpastas ou módulos fiquem isolados sob o workspace do curso: pages/{course_slug}/{modulo}
     */
    private function resolveCourseWorkspacePath(string $courseSlug, string $rawFolder): string
    {
        $clean = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rawFolder), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($clean, 'pages/')) {
            $clean = substr($clean, 6);
        }
        if ($courseSlug !== '' && !str_starts_with($clean, $courseSlug . '/') && $clean !== $courseSlug) {
            return $courseSlug . '/' . $clean;
        }
        return $clean;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseFrontController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\AccountStatusProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\seo\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface;
use Throwable;

class CourseFrontController
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private CourseNavigationInterface $navService;
    private CourseCatalogRendererInterface $catalogRenderer;
    private ?SeoManagerInterface $seo;
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;

        ?SeoManagerInterface $seo = null,
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer = null,
        ?ThemePageResolverInterface $pageResolver = null,
        ?CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollment = null,
        ?SessionManagerInterface $session = null,
        ?StudentProgressInterface $progressService = null,
        ?AccountStatusProviderInterface $accountStatus = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->navService = $navService;
        $this->catalogRenderer = $catalogRenderer;
        $this->seo = $seo;
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
        $this->pageResolver = $pageResolver;
