// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com o PayPal (Vendas Globais / Moeda Estrangeira e Checkout Oficial v2).
 * Compatível com SOLID / DIP.
 */
class PayPalGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $clientId;
    private ?string $clientSecret;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $clientId = null,
        ?string $clientSecret = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->clientId = $clientId 
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('paypal_client_id')
                ?: (getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID') ?: null));
        $this->clientSecret = $clientSecret 
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('paypal_client_secret')
                ?: (getenv('PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'paypal';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'PayPal (Cartões Globais & Saldo PayPal)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->clientId) && !empty($this->clientSecret);
    }

    public function isSandbox(): bool
    {
        if ($this->settings && $this->settings->get('paypal_sandbox') !== null) {
            return (bool)$this->settings->get('paypal_sandbox');
        }
        return true; // Padrão seguro é Sandbox a menos que explicitamente desligado
    }

    private function getApiBaseUrl(): string
    {
        return $this->isSandbox() ? 'https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com' : 'https://api-m.paypal.com';
    }

    private function resolveAbsoluteUrl(string $path): string
    {
        if (str_starts_with($path, 'http://') || str_starts_with($path, 'https://')) {
            return $path;
        }

        $scheme = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') ? 'https' : 'http';
        $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? ($_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ?? 'localhost');
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'https://')) {
            return rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }

        return $scheme . '://' . $host . $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        $total = (float)($orderData['total'] ?? 0.0);
        $currency = strtoupper((string)($this->settings?->get('active_currency', 'BRL') ?: 'BRL'));

        if ($total <= 0.0) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Valor do pedido inválido para cobrança no PayPal.', 'paypal');
        }

        // Se estiver configurado, cria ordem oficial via API REST v2 do PayPal
        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                $token = $this->getAccessToken();
                if (!$token) {
                    return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Falha de autenticação com o PayPal. Verifique o Client ID e Client Secret.', 'paypal');
                }

                $returnUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/paypal/success?order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
                $cancelUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/curso/' . (int)($orderData['item_id'] ?? 0) . '?cancelled=1');

                $orderPayload = [
                    'intent'         => 'CAPTURE',
                    'purchase_units' => [
                        [
                            'reference_id' => $orderRef,
                            'description'  => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Curso Academy - Pedido {$orderRef}"),
                            'amount'       => [
                                'currency_code' => $currency,
                                'value'         => number_format($total, 2, '.', ''),
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                    'application_context' => [
                        'brand_name'          => 'Academy',
                        'landing_page'        => 'BILLING',
                        'user_action'         => 'PAY_NOW',
                        'return_url'          => $returnUrl,
                        'cancel_url'          => $cancelUrl,
                    ],
                ];

                $response = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', '/v2/checkout/orders', $orderPayload, $token);
                $links = $response['links'] ?? [];
                $approveUrl = null;

                foreach ($links as $link) {
                    if (($link['rel'] ?? '') === 'approve') {
                        $approveUrl = (string)($link['href'] ?? '');
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!empty($approveUrl)) {
                    return PaymentResult::redirect(
                        $orderRef,
                        $approveUrl,
                        'paypal',
                        'Redirecionando para o ambiente seguro do PayPal...'
                    );
                }

                $errMsg = (string)($response['message'] ?? 'Não foi possível gerar o link de pagamento do PayPal.');
                if (!empty($response['details']) && is_array($response['details'])) {
                    $details = [];
                    foreach ($response['details'] as $detail) {
                        if (!empty($detail['description'])) {
                            $details[] = $detail['description'];
                        }
                    }
                    if (!empty($details)) {
                        $errMsg .= ' (' . implode('; ', $details) . ')';
                    }
                }
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'PayPal: ' . $errMsg, 'paypal');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Erro de comunicação com o PayPal: ' . $e->getMessage(), 'paypal');
            }
        }

        // Modo Simulação Local (somente com commerce_demo_mode=true)
        if (!(bool)($this->settings?->get('commerce_demo_mode', false))) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Gateway PayPal não configurado.', 'paypal');
        }

        return PaymentResult::approved(
            $orderRef,
            'paypal',
            'PAYPAL_DEMO_' . time(),
            'Modo Demonstração: Pagamento PayPal aprovado!'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Captura o pagamento após o aluno retornar do PayPal aprovado.
     */
    public function captureOrder(string $paypalOrderId): ?array
    {
        if (!$this->isConfigured() || empty($paypalOrderId)) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $token = $this->getAccessToken();
            if (!$token) {
                return null;
            }

            $response = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', '/v2/checkout/orders/' . urlencode($paypalOrderId) . '/capture', [], $token);
            $status = (string)($response['status'] ?? '');

            if ($status === 'COMPLETED') {
                $pu = $response['purchase_units'][0] ?? [];
                $capture = $pu['payments']['captures'][0] ?? [];
                return [
                    'order_ref'      => (string)($pu['reference_id'] ?? ''),
                    'status'         => 'approved',
                    'transaction_id' => (string)($capture['id'] ?? $paypalOrderId),
                    'total'          => (float)($capture['amount']['value'] ?? 0.0),
                    'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                ];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Obtém o Access Token de autorização OAuth2 da API v1 do PayPal.
     */
    public function getAccessToken(?string $clientId = null, ?string $clientSecret = null): ?string
    {
        $id = trim((string)($clientId ?: $this->clientId));
        $sec = trim((string)($clientSecret ?: $this->clientSecret));

        if ($id === '' || $sec === '') {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $ch = curl_init($this->getApiBaseUrl() . '/v1/oauth2/token');
            curl_setopt_array($ch, [
                CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                CURLOPT_POST           => true,
                CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS     => 'grant_type=client_credentials',
                CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
                    'Authorization: Basic ' . base64_encode($id . ':' . $sec),
                    'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    'Accept: application/json',
                ],
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 10,
            ]);
            $res = curl_exec($ch);
            $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            curl_close($ch);

            $data = json_decode((string)$res, true);
            if ($code === 200 && is_array($data) && !empty($data['access_token'])) {
                return (string)$data['access_token'];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do PayPal.
     *
     * @return array{ok: bool, message: string}
     */
    public function testCredentials(?string $clientId = null, ?string $clientSecret = null): array
    {
        $id = trim((string)($clientId ?: $this->clientId));
        $sec = trim((string)($clientSecret ?: $this->clientSecret));

        if ($id === '' || $sec === '') {
            return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Client ID e Client Secret do PayPal são obrigatórios para teste.'];
        }

        $token = $this->getAccessToken($id, $sec);
        if ($token !== null) {
            $env = $this->isSandbox() ? 'Sandbox (Testes)' : 'Produção (Live)';
            return [
                'ok'      => true,
                'message' => "PayPal Conectado com Sucesso! Autenticação OAuth2 aprovada em {$env}.",
            ];
        }

        return [
            'ok'      => false,
            'message' => 'Falha de autenticação no PayPal: Client ID ou Client Secret inválidos.',
        ];
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $payload = $request->json();
        $eventType = (string)($payload['event_type'] ?? '');

        if ($eventType !== 'CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED' && $eventType !== 'PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED') {
            return null;
        }

        $resource = $payload['resource'] ?? [];
        $orderRef = (string)($resource['purchase_units'][0]['reference_id'] ?? ($resource['custom_id'] ?? ''));
        $txId = (string)($resource['id'] ?? '');

        if ($orderRef === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => 'paypal',
        ];
    }

    private function sendHttpRequest(string $method, string $path, array $data = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init($this->getApiBaseUrl() . $path);
        $headers = [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . ($accessToken ?: ''),
            'Content-Type: application/json',
            'Accept: application/json',
        ];

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 15);

        if ($method === 'POST') {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($data));
        }

        $res = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($res === false || $httpCode >= 500) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha de conexão com a API do PayPal (HTTP {$httpCode}).");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$res, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RequestInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\StripeSignatureVerifier;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Driver de Integração com o Stripe (Cartão de Crédito Global / Internacional e Stripe Checkout Oficial).
 * Compatível com SOLID / DIP.
 */
class StripeGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    private ?string $secretKey;
    private ?string $publishableKey;
    private ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;
    private string $apiBaseUrl = 'https://api.stripe.com';

    public function __construct(
        ?string $secretKey = null,
        ?string $publishableKey = null,
        ?CommerceSettingsInterface $settings = null
    ) {
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('stripe_secret_key')
                ?: (getenv('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY') ?: null));

        $this->publishableKey = $publishableKey
            ?: ($this->settings?->get('stripe_publishable_key')
                ?: (getenv('STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY') ?: null));
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return 'stripe';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return 'Stripe (Cartão de Crédito Global, Apple Pay & Google Pay)';
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return !empty($this->secretKey);
    }

    public function isSandbox(): bool
    {
        if ($this->settings && (bool)$this->settings->get('stripe_sandbox', false)) {
            return true;
        }
        return str_starts_with((string)$this->secretKey, 'sk_test_');
    }

    private function resolveAbsoluteUrl(string $path): string
    {
        if (str_starts_with($path, 'http://') || str_starts_with($path, 'https://')) {
            return $path;
        }

        $scheme = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') ? 'https' : 'http';
        $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? ($_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'] ?? 'localhost');
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($baseUrl, 'https://')) {
            return rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }

        return $scheme . '://' . $host . $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    public function processPayment(array $orderData, array $paymentInput): PaymentResult
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($orderData['order_ref'] ?? ('ORD_' . uniqid('', true)));
        $total = (float)($orderData['total'] ?? 0.0);
        $studentEmail = (string)($orderData['student_email'] ?? 'aluno@exemplo.com');
        $currency = strtolower((string)($this->settings?->get('active_currency', 'BRL') ?: 'BRL'));

        if ($total <= 0.0) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Valor do pedido inválido para cobrança no Stripe.', 'stripe');
        }

        // Se estiver em modo de produção/configurado com chaves ativas
        if ($this->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                $successUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/stripe/success?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}&order_ref=' . urlencode($orderRef));
                $cancelUrl = $this->resolveAbsoluteUrl('/checkout/curso/' . (int)($orderData['item_id'] ?? 0) . '?cancelled=1');

                $params = [
                    'mode'                 => 'payment',
                    'customer_email'       => $studentEmail,
                    'client_reference_id'  => $orderRef,
                    'metadata'             => [
                        'order_ref' => $orderRef,
                        'item_id'   => (string)($orderData['item_id'] ?? ''),
                    ],
                    'line_items'           => [
                        [
                            'quantity'   => 1,
                            'price_data' => [
                                'currency'     => $currency,
                                'unit_amount'  => (int)round($total * 100),
                                'product_data' => [
                                    'name' => (string)($orderData['description'] ?? "Curso Academy - Pedido {$orderRef}"),
                                ],
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                    'success_url'          => $successUrl,
                    'cancel_url'           => $cancelUrl,
                ];

                $session = $this->sendHttpRequest('POST', '/v1/checkout/sessions', $params);

                if (!empty($session['url'])) {
                    return PaymentResult::redirect(
                        $orderRef,
                        (string)$session['url'],
                        'stripe',
                        'Redirecionando para o Stripe Checkout seguro...'
                    );
                }

                $errMsg = (string)($session['error']['message'] ?? 'Falha ao criar sessão de pagamento no Stripe.');
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Stripe: ' . $errMsg, 'stripe');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Erro de comunicação com o Stripe: ' . $e->getMessage(), 'stripe');
            }
        }

        // Modo Simulação / Sandbox (somente com commerce_demo_mode=true)
        if (!(bool)($this->settings?->get('commerce_demo_mode', false))) {
            return PaymentResult::failure($orderRef, 'Gateway Stripe não configurado.', 'stripe');
        }

        return PaymentResult::approved(
            $orderRef,
            'stripe',
            'STRIPE_DEMO_' . time(),
            'Modo Demonstração: Pagamento Stripe aprovado instantaneamente!'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Consulta e valida o status de uma sessão do Stripe Checkout após o retorno do aluno.
     */
    public function verifySession(string $sessionId): ?array
    {
        if (!$this->isConfigured() || empty($sessionId)) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $session = $this->sendHttpRequest('GET', '/v1/checkout/sessions/' . urlencode($sessionId));
            if (($session['payment_status'] ?? '') === 'paid') {
                return [
                    'order_ref'      => (string)($session['client_reference_id'] ?? ($session['metadata']['order_ref'] ?? '')),
                    'status'         => 'approved',
                    'transaction_id' => (string)($session['payment_intent'] ?? $sessionId),
                    'total'          => isset($session['amount_total']) ? ((float)$session['amount_total'] / 100.0) : 0.0,
                    'gateway'        => $this->getId(),
                ];
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Validação em tempo real das credenciais do Stripe contra a API oficial.
     *
     * @return array{ok: bool, message: string}
     */
    public function testCredentials(?string $secretKey = null): array
    {
        $key = trim((string)($secretKey ?: $this->secretKey));
        if ($key === '') {
            return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nenhuma Secret Key do Stripe informada para teste.'];
        }

        try {
            $ch = curl_init($this->apiBaseUrl . '/v1/balance');
            curl_setopt_array($ch, [
                CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
                CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
                    'Authorization: Bearer ' . $key,
                    'Accept: application/json',
                ],
                CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 8,
            ]);
            $res = curl_exec($ch);
            $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
            curl_close($ch);

            $data = json_decode((string)$res, true);
            if ($code === 200 && is_array($data) && isset($data['object'])) {
                $env = str_starts_with($key, 'sk_test_') ? 'Modo Teste (Sandbox)' : 'Produção Real (Live)';
                return [
                    'ok'      => true,
                    'message' => "Stripe Conectado com Sucesso! Chave Secreta Válida em {$env}.",
                ];
            }

            $detail = is_array($data) ? (string)($data['error']['message'] ?? 'Credencial inválida') : "HTTP {$code}";
            return [
                'ok'      => false,
                'message' => "Falha no Stripe: {$detail} (Código HTTP {$code}).",
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [
                'ok'      => false,
                'message' => 'Erro ao comunicar com a API do Stripe: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ];
        }
    }

    public function handleWebhook(RequestInterface $request): ?array
    {
        $secret = (string)($this->settings?->get('stripe_webhook_secret') ?: (getenv('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET') ?: ''));
        $raw = method_exists($request, 'rawBody') ? $request->rawBody() : '';
        if ($raw === '' && !empty($request->json())) {
            $raw = (string)json_encode($request->json());
        }

        $sigHeader = (string)($request->header('Stripe-Signature') ?? ($request->server['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE'] ?? ''));
        $verifier = new StripeSignatureVerifier($secret);
        if (!$verifier->verify($raw, ['stripe-signature' => $sigHeader])) {
            return null; // Assinatura ausente ou inválida => ignora
        }

        $payload = $request->json();
        $eventType = (string)($payload['type'] ?? '');

        if (!in_array($eventType, ['checkout.session.completed', 'payment_intent.succeeded'], true)) {
            return null;
        }

        $dataObj = $payload['data']['object'] ?? [];
        $orderRef = (string)($dataObj['client_reference_id'] ?? ($dataObj['metadata']['order_ref'] ?? ''));
        $txId = (string)($dataObj['id'] ?? '');

        if ($orderRef === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'order_ref'      => $orderRef,
            'status'         => 'approved',
            'transaction_id' => $txId,
            'gateway'        => 'stripe',
        ];
    }

    private function sendHttpRequest(string $method, string $path, array $data = []): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init($this->apiBaseUrl . $path);
        $headers = [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->secretKey,
            'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            'Accept: application/json',
        ];

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 15);

        if ($method === 'POST') {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($data));
        }

        $res = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($res === false || $httpCode >= 500) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha de conexão com a API do Stripe (HTTP {$httpCode}).");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$res, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }
}

<script>
(function() {
    var activeOrderId = null;

    function notify(msg, type) {
        if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
            window.OS.notify(msg, type);
        } else if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && typeof window.DS.ui.toast === 'function') {
            window.DS.ui.toast(msg, type);
        } else {
            console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
        }
    }

    window.dsConfirmApproval = function(orderId, orderRef) {
        activeOrderId = orderId;
        var modal = document.getElementById('dsApprovalModal');
        var refElem = document.getElementById('dsModalOrderRef');
        if (refElem) refElem.textContent = 'Pedido: ' + orderRef;
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
    };

    window.dsCloseApprovalModal = function() {
        activeOrderId = null;
        var modal = document.getElementById('dsApprovalModal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    };

    var confirmBtn = document.getElementById('dsModalConfirmBtn');
    if (confirmBtn) {
        confirmBtn.onclick = function() {
            if (!activeOrderId) return;
            var orderId = activeOrderId;
            confirmBtn.disabled = true;
            confirmBtn.textContent = 'Aprovando...';

            var formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('status', 'paid');
            formData.append('csrf_token', <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>);

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/orders/' + orderId + '/status', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?> },
                body: formData
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirmar e Liberar';
                window.dsCloseApprovalModal();

                if (data && data.success) {
                    notify('Pedido #' + orderId + ' aprovado e matrícula liberada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    setTimeout(function() { window.location.reload(); }, 1000);
                } else {
                    notify('Erro: ' + (data && data.message ? data.message : 'Falha ao atualizar pedido.'), 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirmar e Liberar';
                window.dsCloseApprovalModal();
                notify('Erro de conexão ao aprovar pedido.', 'error');
            });
        };
    }

    // Renderização dos Gráficos com Chart.js
    var timelineData = <?= json_encode($salesTimeline, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;
    var breakdownData = <?= json_encode($paymentBreakdown, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;

    function initCharts() {
        if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;

        // 1. Gráfico de Linha (Faturamento)
        var salesCtx = document.getElementById('dsSalesChart');
        if (salesCtx && timelineData && timelineData.labels) {
            var ctx = salesCtx.getContext('2d');
            var gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 200);
            gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.28)');
            gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.01)');

            new Chart(salesCtx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: timelineData.labels,
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Faturamento (R$)',
                        data: timelineData.totals,
                        borderColor: '#00d284',
                        backgroundColor: gradient,
                        borderWidth: 2.5,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.35,
                        pointBackgroundColor: '#00d284',
                        pointBorderColor: '#0f141c',
                        pointBorderWidth: 2,
                        pointRadius: timelineData.labels.length > 20 ? 2 : 4,
                        pointHoverRadius: 6,
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                            titleColor: '#f8fafc',
                            bodyColor: '#00d284',
                            borderColor: 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.3)',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 10,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    var val = Number(context.raw || 0);
                                    return ' R$ ' + val.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', borderColor: 'transparent' },
                            ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 11, family: 'system-ui' } }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', borderColor: 'transparent' },
                            ticks: {
                                color: '#64748b',
                                font: { size: 11, family: 'system-ui' },
                                callback: function(value) {
                                    return 'R$ ' + value.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // 2. Gráfico Donut (Mix de Pagamentos)
        var mixCtx = document.getElementById('dsPaymentMixChart');
        if (mixCtx && breakdownData && Object.keys(breakdownData).length > 0) {
            var mixLabels = [];
            var mixTotals = [];
            var mixColors = [];

            for (var key in breakdownData) {
                if (breakdownData.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                    mixLabels.push(breakdownData[key].label);
                    mixTotals.push(breakdownData[key].total);
                    mixColors.push(breakdownData[key].color);
                }
            }

            new Chart(mixCtx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: mixLabels,
                    datasets: [{
                        data: mixTotals,
                        backgroundColor: mixColors,
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        borderColor: '#0f141c',
                        hoverOffset: 4
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '72%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                            titleColor: '#f8fafc',
                            borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 10,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    var val = Number(context.raw || 0);
                                    return ' ' + context.label + ': R$ ' + val.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    if (typeof Chart !== 'undefined') {
        initCharts();
    } else {
        var chartScript = document.createElement('script');
        chartScript.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js';
        chartScript.async = true;
        chartScript.onload = initCharts;
        document.head.appendChild(chartScript);
    }
})();
</script>

        function notify(msg, type) {
            if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
                window.OS.notify(msg, type);
            } else if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && typeof window.DS.ui.toast === 'function') {
                window.DS.ui.toast(msg, type);
            } else {
                console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
            }
        }

        function testMercadoPagoCredentials() {
            var tokenInput = document.getElementById('mp_access_token_input');
            var pubkeyInput = document.getElementById('mp_public_key_input');
            var tokenBox = document.getElementById('mp_token_status_box');
            var pubkeyBox = document.getElementById('mp_pubkey_status_box');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_mp');
            var spinner = document.getElementById('mp_test_spinner');

            var accessToken = tokenInput ? tokenInput.value.trim() : '';
            var publicKey = pubkeyInput ? pubkeyInput.value.trim() : '';

            if (!accessToken && !publicKey) {
                notify('Preencha ao menos o Access Token ou a Public Key para realizar o teste de validação.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            spinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
            tokenBox.style.display = 'none';
            pubkeyBox.style.display = 'none';

            var payload = {
                csrf_token: <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>,
                access_token: accessToken,
                public_key: publicKey
            };

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/test-mercadopago', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                spinner.style.display = 'none';

                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    var errorMsg = (data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao executar teste';
                    notify(errorMsg, 'error');
                    return;
                }

                notify('Teste de conexão com a API do Mercado Pago concluído!', 'success');

                // Renderiza Status do Access Token (Verde ou Vermelho)
                if (data.access_token) {
                    tokenBox.style.display = 'block';
                    if (data.access_token.ok) {
                        tokenBox.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        tokenBox.style.color = '#00d284';
                        tokenBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        tokenBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🟢</span><strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.access_token.message;
                    } else {
                        tokenBox.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        tokenBox.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        tokenBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        tokenBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🔴</span><strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.access_token.message;
                    }
                }

                // Renderiza Status da Public Key (Verde ou Vermelho)
                if (data.public_key) {
                    pubkeyBox.style.display = 'block';
                    if (data.public_key.ok) {
                        pubkeyBox.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        pubkeyBox.style.color = '#00d284';
                        pubkeyBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        pubkeyBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🟢</span><strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.public_key.message;
                    } else {
                        pubkeyBox.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        pubkeyBox.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        pubkeyBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        pubkeyBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🔴</span><strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.public_key.message;
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                spinner.style.display = 'none';
                notify('Erro de conexão ao testar credenciais: ' + err, 'error');
            });
        }

        function testPayPalCredentials() {
            var clientId = (document.getElementById('pp_client_id_input') || {}).value || '';
            var clientSecret = (document.getElementById('pp_client_secret_input') || {}).value || '';
            var box = document.getElementById('pp_status_box');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_paypal');

            if (!clientId.trim() || !clientSecret.trim()) {
                notify('Informe o Client ID e Client Secret do PayPal para testar.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = '⏳ Testando...';
            box.style.display = 'none';

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/test-paypal', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    csrf_token: <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>,
                    client_id: clientId.trim(),
                    client_secret: clientSecret.trim()
                })
            })
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '⚡ Testar Credenciais do PayPal';
                box.style.display = 'block';
                if (data && data.success && data.result) {
                    if (data.result.ok) {
                        box.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        box.style.color = '#00d284';
                        box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        box.innerHTML = '🟢 <strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.result.message;
                        notify('Conexão com PayPal validada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    } else {
                        box.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        box.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        box.innerHTML = '🔴 <strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.result.message;
                        notify(data.result.message, 'error');
                    }
                } else {
                    notify((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha no teste PayPal.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '⚡ Testar Credenciais do PayPal';
                notify('Erro de conexão ao testar PayPal: ' + err, 'error');
            });
        }

    <!-- Sistema Oficial de Notificações Toast -->
    <script src="<?= $baseUrl ?>/assets/js/core/toast.js"></script>

    <script>
        var baseUrl = <?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?>;
        var csrfToken = <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>;
        var courseId = <?= (int)$courseId ?>;
        var unitPrice = <?= json_encode((float)$unitPrice) ?>;
        var currentQty = <?= (int)$quantity ?>;
        var isItemRemoved = false;
        var hasAvailableGateway = <?= ($hasMercadoPago || $hasStripe || $hasPayPal) ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
        var selectedMethod = 'pix';

        function formatBrlAmount(val) {
            return Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
        }

        function getCurrentFormattedTotal() {
            return formatBrlAmount(unitPrice * currentQty);
        }

        function updateOrderTotalsUI() {
            var formatted = getCurrentFormattedTotal();
            var qtyEl = document.getElementById('checkout_qty_display');
            var subEl = document.getElementById('checkout_subtotal_val');
            var totEl = document.getElementById('checkout_total_val');
            if (qtyEl) qtyEl.textContent = String(currentQty);
            if (subEl) subEl.textContent = 'R$ ' + formatted;
            if (totEl) totEl.textContent = 'R$ ' + formatted;
            selectPaymentMethod(selectedMethod, selectedGateway);
        }

        function adjustCheckoutQty(delta) {
            if (isItemRemoved) return;
            var nextQty = currentQty + delta;
            if (nextQty < 1) {
                removeCheckoutItem();
                return;
            }
            if (nextQty > 99) nextQty = 99;
            currentQty = nextQty;
            updateOrderTotalsUI();
        }

        function removeCheckoutItem() {
            isItemRemoved = true;
            var summaryEl = document.getElementById('checkout_item_summary');
            var emptyEl = document.getElementById('checkout_empty_state');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment');
            if (summaryEl) summaryEl.style.display = 'none';
            if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
            if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
            showNotify('Produto removido do resumo de compra.', 'info');
        }

        function restoreCheckoutItem() {
            isItemRemoved = false;
            if (currentQty < 1) currentQty = 1;
            var summaryEl = document.getElementById('checkout_item_summary');
            var emptyEl = document.getElementById('checkout_empty_state');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment');
            if (summaryEl) summaryEl.style.display = 'block';
            if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
            if (btn) btn.disabled = !hasAvailableGateway;
            updateOrderTotalsUI();
            showNotify('Produto restabelecido no pedido!', 'success');
        }

        function showNotify(msg, type) {
            type = type || 'info';
            if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && window.DS.ui.toast) {
                if (type === 'error') DS.ui.toast.error(msg);
                else if (type === 'success') DS.ui.toast.success(msg);
                else if (type === 'warning') DS.ui.toast.warning(msg);
                else DS.ui.toast.info(msg);
            } else {
                console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
            }
        }

        function formatCpfInput(el) {
            var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
            if (v.length > 9) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,2})/, '$1.$2.$3-$4');
            } else if (v.length > 6) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2.$3');
            } else if (v.length > 3) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2');
            } else {
                el.value = v;
            }
        }

        function formatPhoneInput(el) {
            var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
            if (v.length > 10) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{1,4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
            } else if (v.length > 6) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d{1,4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
            } else if (v.length > 2) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{1,5})/, '($1) $2');
            } else if (v.length > 0) {
                el.value = '(' + v;
            } else {
                el.value = '';
            }
        }

        function formatCepAndSearch(el) {
            var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
            if (v.length > 5) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{5})(\d{1,3})/, '$1-$2');
            } else {
                el.value = v;
            }
            if (v.length === 8) {
                fetch('https://viacep.com.br/ws/' + v + '/json/')
                    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
                    .then(function(data) {
                        if (!data.erro) {
                            var addr = document.getElementById('shipping_address');
                            var neigh = document.getElementById('shipping_neighborhood');
                            var city = document.getElementById('shipping_city');
                            var uf = document.getElementById('shipping_state');
                            var num = document.getElementById('shipping_number');
                            if (addr && data.logradouro) addr.value = data.logradouro;
                            if (neigh && data.bairro) neigh.value = data.bairro;
                            if (city && data.localidade) city.value = data.localidade;
                            if (uf && data.uf) uf.value = data.uf;
                            if (num) num.focus();
                            showNotify('Endereço preenchido automaticamente via CEP!', 'success');
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(function() {});
            }
        }

        var selectedMethod = 'pix';
        var selectedGateway = 'mercadopago';

        function selectPaymentMethod(m, g) {
            selectedMethod = m;
            selectedGateway = g || (m === 'stripe' ? 'stripe' : (m === 'paypal' ? 'paypal' : 'mercadopago'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.ds-method-option').forEach(function(el) {
                el.classList.remove('active');
            });
            var rad = document.querySelector('input[value="' + m + '"]');
            if (rad) {
                rad.checked = true;
                rad.closest('.ds-method-option').classList.add('active');
            }

            var cpfGroup = document.getElementById('cpf_field_group');
            var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment_text');
            var formattedTotalNow = getCurrentFormattedTotal();
            if (m === 'pix') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'block';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '⚡ Gerar QR Code Pix (R$ ' + formattedTotalNow + ')';
            } else if (m === 'checkout_pro') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '💳 Pagar com Mercado Pago (R$ ' + formattedTotalNow + ')';
            } else if (m === 'stripe') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '🌐 Pagar com Cartão / Stripe (R$ ' + formattedTotalNow + ')';
            } else if (m === 'paypal') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '🅿️ Pagar com PayPal (R$ ' + formattedTotalNow + ')';
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            var cpfEl = document.getElementById('payer_cpf');
            if (cpfEl && cpfEl.value) {
                formatCpfInput(cpfEl);
            }
            var phoneEl = document.getElementById('payer_phone');
            if (phoneEl && phoneEl.value) {
                formatPhoneInput(phoneEl);
            }
            <?php if ($hasPayPal && ($coursePlatform === 'paypal' || (!$hasMercadoPago && !$hasStripe))): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('paypal', 'paypal');
            <?php elseif ($hasStripe && ($coursePlatform === 'stripe' || (!$hasMercadoPago && !$hasPayPal))): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('stripe', 'stripe');
            <?php elseif ($hasMercadoPago): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('pix', 'mercadopago');
            <?php elseif ($hasPayPal): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('paypal', 'paypal');
            <?php elseif ($hasStripe): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('stripe', 'stripe');
            <?php endif; ?>
        });

        var pixPollInterval = null;

        function startPixPolling(orderRef) {
            if (pixPollInterval) clearInterval(pixPollInterval);
            pixPollInterval = setInterval(function() {
                if (!orderRef) return;
                fetch(baseUrl + '/checkout/status/' + encodeURIComponent(orderRef), {
                    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
                })
                .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
                .then(function(res) {
                    if (res && res.paid) {
                        clearInterval(pixPollInterval);
                        var hint = document.getElementById('pix_status_hint');
                        var isPhysical = <?= $isPhysicalOrDropship ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
                        if (hint) {
                            hint.innerHTML = isPhysical ? '✅ Pagamento confirmado pelo banco! Pedido registrado com sucesso...' : '✅ Pagamento confirmado pelo banco! Liberando seu curso...';
                            hint.style.color = '#00d284';
                        }
                        showNotify('🎉 Pagamento Pix confirmado com sucesso! Redirecionando...', 'success');
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            window.location.href = res.redirect_url || (isPhysical ? (baseUrl + '/checkout/sucesso/' + encodeURIComponent(orderRef)) : (baseUrl + '/aluno/painel'));
                        }, 1200);
                    }
                })
                .catch(function() {});
            }, 3500);
        }

        function handlePaymentSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (isItemRemoved || currentQty < 1) {
                showNotify('O item foi removido do pedido. Restabeleça o produto antes de finalizar.', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment');
            var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment_text');
            var cpfInput = document.getElementById('payer_cpf');
            var rawCpf = cpfInput ? cpfInput.value.replace(/\D/g, '') : '';

            var isPhysical = <?= $isPhysicalOrDropship ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
            var payerNameEl = document.getElementById('payer_name');
            var payerEmailEl = document.getElementById('payer_email');
            var payerPhoneEl = document.getElementById('payer_phone');
            var shipZipEl = document.getElementById('shipping_zip');
            var shipAddrEl = document.getElementById('shipping_address');
            var shipNumEl = document.getElementById('shipping_number');
            var shipCompEl = document.getElementById('shipping_complement');
            var shipNeighEl = document.getElementById('shipping_neighborhood');
            var shipCityEl = document.getElementById('shipping_city');
            var shipStateEl = document.getElementById('shipping_state');

            if (isPhysical) {
                if (payerNameEl && !payerNameEl.value.trim()) {
                    showNotify('Informe seu nome completo para entrega.', 'warning');
                    payerNameEl.focus();
                    return;
                }
                if (payerEmailEl && !payerEmailEl.value.trim()) {
                    showNotify('Informe seu e-mail para receber o rastreio.', 'warning');
                    payerEmailEl.focus();
                    return;
                }
                if (shipZipEl && !shipZipEl.value.trim()) {
                    showNotify('Informe o CEP para entrega.', 'warning');
                    shipZipEl.focus();
                    return;
                }
                if (shipAddrEl && !shipAddrEl.value.trim()) {
                    showNotify('Informe a rua / logradouro de entrega.', 'warning');
                    shipAddrEl.focus();
                    return;
                }
                if (shipNumEl && !shipNumEl.value.trim()) {
                    showNotify('Informe o número do endereço.', 'warning');
                    shipNumEl.focus();
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (selectedMethod === 'pix' && rawCpf.length !== 11) {
                showNotify('Por favor, informe seu CPF com 11 dígitos para emissão do Pix.', 'warning');
                if (cpfInput) {
                    cpfInput.focus();
                    cpfInput.style.borderColor = '#45f3ff';
                }
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '⏳ Processando Pagamento...';

            showNotify('Conectando ao gateway de pagamento seguro...', 'info');

            var gateway = selectedGateway;

            var payload = {
                csrf_token: csrfToken,
                course_id: courseId,
                quantity: currentQty,
                gateway: gateway,
                payment_method: selectedMethod,
                payer_cpf: rawCpf,
                payer_name: payerNameEl ? payerNameEl.value.trim() : '',
                payer_email: payerEmailEl ? payerEmailEl.value.trim() : '',
                payer_phone: payerPhoneEl ? payerPhoneEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_zip: shipZipEl ? shipZipEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_address: shipAddrEl ? shipAddrEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_number: shipNumEl ? shipNumEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_complement: shipCompEl ? shipCompEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_neighborhood: shipNeighEl ? shipNeighEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_city: shipCityEl ? shipCityEl.value.trim() : '',
                shipping_state: shipStateEl ? shipStateEl.value.trim() : ''
            };

            fetch(baseUrl + '/checkout/process', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(function(res) {
                return res.text().then(function(text) {
                    try {
                        return JSON.parse(text);
                    } catch (parseErr) {
                        console.error('Resposta não-JSON recebida:', text);
                        throw new Error('Resposta inválida do servidor: ' + text.substring(0, 100));
                    }
                });
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                selectPaymentMethod(selectedMethod);

                if (data && data.success) {
                    if (data.status === 'approved') {
                        showNotify(data.message || 'Pagamento aprovado com sucesso! Redirecionando...', 'success');
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            window.location.href = data.redirect_url || (isPhysical && data.order_ref ? (baseUrl + '/checkout/sucesso/' + encodeURIComponent(data.order_ref)) : (baseUrl + '/aluno/painel'));
                        }, 1200);
                    } else if (data.payment_method === 'pix' && data.pix_copia_e_cola) {
                        showNotify('Chave Pix gerada! Escaneie o QR Code ou copie o código abaixo.', 'success');
                        var box = document.getElementById('pix_result_box');
                        box.style.display = 'block';
                        document.getElementById('pix_copia_cola_text').value = data.pix_copia_e_cola;
                        
                        var qrImgUrl = data.pix_qr_code || ('https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=220x220&margin=8&data=' + encodeURIComponent(data.pix_copia_e_cola));
                        document.getElementById('pix_qr_image_wrap').innerHTML = '<img src="' + qrImgUrl + '" alt="QR Code Pix" style="max-width:210px; border-radius:10px; border:2px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.4); padding:8px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display:inline-block;">';
                        
                        box.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                        if (data.order_ref) {
                            startPixPolling(data.order_ref);
                        }
                    } else if (data.redirect_url) {
                        var targetName = (data.payment_method === 'paypal') ? 'PayPal' : ((data.payment_method === 'stripe') ? 'Stripe' : 'Mercado Pago');
                        showNotify(data.message || ('Redirecionando para o ambiente seguro do ' + targetName + '...'), 'info');
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            window.location.href = data.redirect_url;
                        }, 900);
                    } else if (data.boleto_url) {
                        showNotify('Boleto bancário gerado com sucesso!', 'success');
                        window.open(data.boleto_url, '_blank');
                    } else {
                        showNotify(data.message || 'Solicitação processada.', 'info');
                    }
                } else {
                    showNotify((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao processar pagamento.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                selectPaymentMethod(selectedMethod);
                showNotify('Erro de conexão ao processar pagamento: ' + err.message, 'error');
            });
        }

        function copyPixCode() {
            var txt = document.getElementById('pix_copia_cola_text');
            txt.select();
            txt.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt.value).then(function() {
                    showNotify('Código Pix copiado para a área de transferência!', 'success');
                });
            } else {
                document.execCommand('copy');
                showNotify('Código Pix copiado com sucesso!', 'success');
            }
        }
        document.title = <?= json_encode('Checkout Seguro | ' . html_entity_decode($courseTitle, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . ' — RachidD.com', JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?>;
    </script>
</section>

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop;
