/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PLUGIN: DomainDrop (Motor Autônomo de Dropshipping & Mineração E-commerce)
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Responsável pelo Hub central de dropshipping, integração direta com a API
 * AliExpress Open Platform (App ISV Drop Shipping 558628), conversão cambial
 * em tempo real, enriquecimento de produtos com IA e orquestração de catálogo.
 */
class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void
    {
    }

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->requireLink('core.session');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers');
        $os->listenHook('payment.approved');
        $os->listenHook('theme.blocks.register');
        $os->listenHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $root = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        $configFile = $root . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';

        // 1. Injeção de Dependências no Container via Contratos (SOLID / DIP)
        $runtime->singleton(CurrencyConverterInterface::class, function () use ($root, $configFile) {
            $markup = 100.0;
            $minMargin = 30.0;
            if (file_exists($configFile)) {
                $data = @json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
                if (is_array($data)) {
                    $markup = (float)($data['default_markup_percent'] ?? $markup);
                    $minMargin = (float)($data['min_profit_margin_brl'] ?? $minMargin);
                }
            }

            return new CurrencyConverterService(
                cacheDirOrFile: $root . '/storage/cache/exchange_rates.json',
                defaultMarkupPercent: $markup,
                minProfitBrl: $minMargin
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class, function () use ($configFile) {
            $appKey = '558628';
            $appSecret = '';
            $accessToken = null;

            if (file_exists($configFile)) {
                $data = @json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
                if (is_array($data)) {
                    $appKey = (string)($data['app_key'] ?? $appKey);
                    $appSecret = (string)($data['app_secret'] ?? '');
                    $accessToken = !empty($data['access_token']) ? (string)$data['access_token'] : null;
                }
            }

            return new AliExpressApiClient(
                appKey: $appKey,
                appSecret: $appSecret,
                gatewayUrl: 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync',
                timeout: 15,
                accessToken: $accessToken
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(AiProductEnricherInterface::class, function () {
            return new AiProductEnricherService();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoDropshipCatalogRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoDropshipOrderRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoDropshipCustomerRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new PdoDropshipDisputeRepository($runtime->getLink('core.db'));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(OrderSlaProgressService::class, function () {
            return new OrderSlaProgressService();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DisputeAttachmentService::class, function () use ($root) {
            return new DisputeAttachmentService($root, true);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(SellerMediationService::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $mailer = null;
            try {
                if ($runtime->has(EmailSenderInterface::class)) {
                    $mailer = $runtime->make(EmailSenderInterface::class);
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $mailer = null;
            }

            return new SellerMediationService(
                disputeRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface::class),
                mailer: $mailer
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CustomerAccountController::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $themeManager = null;
            try {
                $themeManager = $runtime->getLink('core.theme');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
            }

            return new CustomerAccountController(
                customerRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface::class),
                orderRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class),
                disputeRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface::class),
                session: $runtime->getLink('core.session'),
                attachmentService: $runtime->make(DisputeAttachmentService::class),
                slaService: $runtime->make(OrderSlaProgressService::class),
                themeManager: $themeManager,
                apiClient: $runtime->make(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class),
                catalogRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProductLinkScraperInterface::class, function () {
            return new AliExpressLinkScraperService();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProductMediaSyncInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new ProductMediaSyncService(
                repository: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                scraper: $runtime->make(ProductLinkScraperInterface::class),
                aiEnricher: $runtime->make(AiProductEnricherInterface::class),
                currencyConverter: $runtime->make(CurrencyConverterInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProductMiningServiceInterface::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            return new ProductMiningService(
                apiClient: $runtime->make(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class),
                currencyConverter: $runtime->make(CurrencyConverterInterface::class),
                aiEnricher: $runtime->make(AiProductEnricherInterface::class),
                repository: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                linkScraper: $runtime->make(ProductLinkScraperInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(DropshipAdminController::class, function () use ($runtime, $root) {
            return new DropshipAdminController(
                catalogRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                miningService: $runtime->make(ProductMiningServiceInterface::class),
                currencyConverter: $runtime->make(CurrencyConverterInterface::class),
                session: $runtime->getLink('core.session'),
                orderRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class),
                mediaSync: $runtime->make(ProductMediaSyncInterface::class),
                basePath: $root,
                customerRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface::class),
                disputeRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface::class),
                slaService: $runtime->make(OrderSlaProgressService::class),
                mediationService: $runtime->make(SellerMediationService::class),
                apiClient: $runtime->make(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, function () use ($runtime) {
            $themeManager = null;
            try {
                $themeManager = $runtime->getLink('core.theme');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
            }

            return new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController(
                catalogRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class),
                themeManager: $themeManager,
                miningService: $runtime->make(ProductMiningServiceInterface::class),
                orderRepo: $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class),
                apiClient: $runtime->make(AliExpressApiClientInterface::class)
            );
        });

        // 2. Menu Administrativo
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role = 'guest') {
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title'   => 'DomainDrop',
                    'url'     => '#',
                    'icon'    => '📦',
                    'submenu' => [
                        [
                            'title' => 'Catálogo & Mineração',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship',
                            'icon'  => '🛰️',
                        ],
                        [
                            'title' => 'Pedidos Dropshipping',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship/orders',
                            'icon'  => '🛍️',
                        ],
                        [
                            'title' => 'Clientes & Compradores',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship/customers',
                            'icon'  => '👥',
                        ],
                        [
                            'title' => 'Configurações & API',
                            'url'   => '/admin/dropship/settings',
                            'icon'  => '⚙️',
                        ],
                    ],
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // 3. Rotas Administrativas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function (Router $router) {
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'index'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/mine', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'mine'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/import-url', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'importUrl'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/import-browser-source', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'importBrowserSource'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship/orders', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'orders'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/orders/{id}/fulfillment', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'updateFulfillment'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/orders/{id}/check-sdk', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'checkOrderSdk'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/orders/{id}/mediate', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'mediateDispute'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship/customers', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'customers'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/customers/{id}/status', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'updateCustomerStatus'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dropship/settings', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'settings'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/settings', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'saveSettings'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/test-connection', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'testConnection'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/product/{id}/sync-images', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'syncImages'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/product/{id}/images', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'updateImages'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/product/{id}/price', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'updatePrice'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/run-daily-cycle', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'runDailyCycle'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/sync-all-images', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'syncAllImages'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/dropship/delete/{id}', [DropshipAdminController::class, 'delete'], 'domain_drop', ['admin']);

            // 4. Rotas Públicas da Loja Virtual, Vitrine & Área do Cliente
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/loja', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'storefront'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/produto/{slug}', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'singleProduct'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/rastrear', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'trackOrder'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/politica-de-envio', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController::class, 'shippingPolicy'], 'domain_drop');

            // 5. Cadastro, Login, Pedidos e Reclamações de Clientes
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/cadastro', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'showRegister'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/cadastro', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'register'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/entrar', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'showLogin'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/entrar', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'login'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/sair', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'logout'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/sair', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'logout'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/minha-conta', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'account'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/minha-conta/reclamar', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'submitComplaint'], 'domain_drop');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/dropship/disputes/attachment/{id}/{file}', [CustomerAccountController::class, 'serveAttachment'], 'domain_drop');
        });

        // 4. Integração com DomainCommerce (Resolução de Itens Vendáveis no Checkout)
        $runtime->onHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers', function ($resolver) use ($runtime) {
            if ($resolver instanceof PurchasableItemResolverInterface) {
                $resolveDropshipItem = function (int $id) use ($runtime) {
                    try {
                        /** @var DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $repo */
                        $repo = $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $product = $repo->findById($id);
                        return $product !== null ? new DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter($product) : null;
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                };

                $resolver->registerResolver('dropship_product', $resolveDropshipItem);
                $resolver->registerResolver('dropship', $resolveDropshipItem);
                $resolver->registerResolver('product', $resolveDropshipItem);
            }
        });

        // 5. Integração com Pagamentos Aprovados (Criação de Pedido de Dropshipping)
        $runtime->onHook('payment.approved', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $itemType = (string)($payload['item_type'] ?? '');
            $itemId = (int)($payload['item_id'] ?? ($payload['course_id'] ?? 0));
            $orderRef = (string)($payload['order_ref'] ?? '');

            if (in_array($itemType, ['dropship_product', 'dropship', 'product'], true) && $orderRef !== '') {
                try {
                    /** @var DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo */
                    $orderRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface::class);
                    $existing = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                    if ($existing === null) {
                        $sellerOrigin = 'CN';
                        $expectedDays = 25;
                        $sellerName = null;
                        $productSlug = null;
                        $productTitle = null;
                        $aeProductId = null;

                        if ($itemId > 0) {
                            try {
                                /** @var DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catRepo */
                                $catRepo = $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class);
                                $productDto = $catRepo->findById($itemId);
                                if ($productDto !== null) {
                                    $sellerInfo = $productDto->getSellerInfo();
                                    $isBr = !empty($sellerInfo['is_brazil']);
                                    $sellerOrigin = $isBr ? 'BR' : 'CN';
                                    $expectedDays = $isBr ? 7 : 25;
                                    $sellerName = (string)($sellerInfo['store_name'] ?? '');
                                    $productSlug = $productDto->slug;
                                    $productTitle = $productDto->title;
                                    $aeProductId = $productDto->aliexpressId;
                                }
                            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                            }
                        }

                        $orderRepo->create([
                            'order_ref'              => $orderRef,
                            'customer_name'          => (string)($payload['customer_name'] ?? 'Cliente'),
                            'customer_email'         => (string)($payload['customer_email'] ?? ''),
                            'customer_document'      => isset($payload['customer_document']) ? (string)$payload['customer_document'] : null,
                            'shipping_address'       => isset($payload['shipping_address']) ? $payload['shipping_address'] : null,
                            'status'                 => 'paid',
                            'total_paid_brl'         => (float)($payload['total'] ?? 0.0),
                            'seller_origin'          => $sellerOrigin,
                            'seller_name'            => $sellerName,
                            'expected_delivery_days' => $expectedDays,
                            'product_slug'           => $productSlug,
                            'product_title'          => $productTitle,
                            'aliexpress_product_id'  => $aeProductId,
                        ]);
                    } else {
                        $orderRepo->updateFulfillment($orderRef, 'paid');
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[DomainDrop] Falha ao registrar pedido em payment.approved: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 6. Registro de Blocos Semânticos no Flex Builder via Contrato (SOLID - OCP / DIP)
        $registerDropshipBlocks = function ($registry) use ($runtime) {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'has') && !$registry->has('dropship_showcase')) {
                try {
                    $provider = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipBlockProvider(
                        $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
                    );
                    $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Isolamento gracioso
                }
            }
        };

        $runtime->onHook('theme.blocks.register', $registerDropshipBlocks);
        $runtime->onHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks', $registerDropshipBlocks);

        // 7. Shortcode para Vitrine de Dropshipping: [dropship_vitrine limit="8" cols="4" category=""]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('dropship_vitrine', function ($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    $block = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipShowcaseBlock(
                        $runtime->make(DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface::class)
                    );
                    $attributes = [
                        'limit'    => isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 8,
                        'columns'  => isset($attrs['cols']) ? (int)$attrs['cols'] : (isset($attrs['columns']) ? (int)$attrs['columns'] : 4),
                        'category' => isset($attrs['category']) ? (string)$attrs['category'] : '',
                        'title'    => isset($attrs['title']) ? (string)$attrs['title'] : 'Tendências em Alta & Mais Vendidos',
                    ];
                    return $block->render($attributes);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94;'>Vitrine Dropshipping em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Adapters\DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Adapters;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PurchasableItemInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;

/**
 * Adaptador que transforma um Produto do DomainDrop em um Item Vendável do Commerce (Padrão Adapter / DIP).
 */
class DropshipProductPurchasableAdapter implements PurchasableItemInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipProductDto $product
    ) {
    }

    public function getId(): int
    {
        return (int)($this->product->id ?? 0);
    }

    public function getItemType(): string
    {
        return 'dropship_product';
    }

    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        return $this->product->title;
    }

    public function getPrice(): float
    {
        return $this->product->salePriceBrl;
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->product->status, ['published', 'active'], true);
    }

    public function getDescription(): string
    {
        return $this->product->description;
    }

    public function getThumbnailUrl(): ?string
    {
        return $this->product->mainImageUrl;
    }

    public function getProduct(): DropshipProductDto
    {
        return $this->product;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipBlockProvider.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Provedor de Blocos Semânticos do Plugin DomainDrop para o Flex Builder (SOLID - OCP / DIP).
 */
class DropshipBlockProvider implements BlockProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catalogRepo,
        private readonly ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        private readonly ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        private readonly ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null
    ) {
    }

    public function registerBlocks(BlockRegistryInterface $registry): void
    {
        if (!$registry->has('dropship_showcase')) {
            $registry->register(new DropshipShowcaseBlock(
                $this->catalogRepo,
                $this->styleRenderer,
                $this->htmlSanitizer,
                $this->urlResolver
            ));
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks\DropshipShowcaseBlock.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Blocks;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\Styles\StylableElementInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Traits\StylableElementTrait;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Bloco Semântico de Vitrine de Dropshipping para o Flex Builder / Storefront.
 *
 * Renderiza cards ultra responsivos em CSS Grid conectados ao catálogo de produtos
 * minerados do AliExpress, com checkout direto integrado ao DomainCommerce.
 */
class DropshipShowcaseBlock implements BlockInterface, StylableElementInterface
{
    use StylableElementTrait;

    private DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catalogRepo;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;

    public function __construct(
        DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catalogRepo,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null,
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver = null
    ) {
        $this->catalogRepo = $catalogRepo;
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
        $this->urlResolver = $urlResolver;
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return 'dropship_showcase';
    }

    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Vitrine Dropshipping (AliExpress)';
    }

    public function getIcon(): string
    {
        return '🛍️';
    }

    public function getCategory(): string
    {
        return 'ecommerce';
    }

    public function getAllowedPartTypes(): array
    {
        return [ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER];
    }

    public function getSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'title' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Título da Vitrine',
                'default' => 'Tendências em Alta & Mais Vendidos',
            ],
            'subtitle' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Subtítulo',
                'default' => 'Produtos virais selecionados com envio direto e garantia de satisfação.',
            ],
            'columns' => [
                'type' => 'select',
                'label' => 'Colunas no Desktop',
                'options' => [
                    ['value' => '1', 'label' => '1 Coluna'],
                    ['value' => '2', 'label' => '2 Colunas'],
                    ['value' => '3', 'label' => '3 Colunas'],
                    ['value' => '4', 'label' => '4 Colunas (Padrão E-commerce)'],
                ],
                'default' => '4',
            ],
            'limit' => [
                'type' => 'number',
                'label' => 'Limite de Produtos',
                'default' => 8,
                'min' => 1,
                'max' => 24,
            ],
            'category' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Filtrar por Categoria (opcional)',
                'default' => '',
            ],
            'button_text' => [
                'type' => 'text',
                'label' => 'Texto do Botão de Compra',
                'default' => 'Comprar Agora',
            ],
            'show_rating' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Avaliação por Estrelas',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_badge' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Selo de Categoria',
                'default' => true,
            ],
            'show_countdown' => [
                'type' => 'boolean',
                'label' => 'Exibir Contador de Urgência 24h',
                'default' => true,
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function render(array $data = [], array $context = []): string
    {
        $attributes = $data;
        $title = (string)($attributes['title'] ?? 'Tendências em Alta & Mais Vendidos');
        $subtitle = (string)($attributes['subtitle'] ?? 'Produtos virais selecionados com envio direto.');
        $columns = max(1, min(4, (int)($attributes['columns'] ?? 4)));
        $limit = max(1, min(24, (int)($attributes['limit'] ?? 8)));
        $category = trim((string)($attributes['category'] ?? ''));
        $btnText = (string)($attributes['button_text'] ?? 'Comprar Agora');
        $showRating = (bool)($attributes['show_rating'] ?? true);
        $showBadge = (bool)($attributes['show_badge'] ?? true);
        $showCountdown = !isset($attributes['show_countdown']) || (bool)$attributes['show_countdown'];

        $criteria = ['status' => 'published'];
        if ($category !== '') {
            $criteria['category'] = $category;
        }

        $products = $this->catalogRepo->list($criteria, $limit, 0);

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        if ($this->urlResolver !== null) {
            $resolvedBase = $this->urlResolver->resolve('/');
            if (!empty($resolvedBase)) {
                $baseUrl = rtrim($resolvedBase, '/');
            }
        }

        $cssClasses = 'domain-drop-showcase ds-block-dropship-showcase ' . $this->styleRenderer->getResponsiveVisibilityClasses($data);
        $customStyles = $this->styleRenderer->renderStyleString($data);
        $uniqueId = 'drop_showcase_' . uniqid();

        ob_start();
        ?>

                        </div>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                    <?php if (!empty($title)): ?>
                        <h2 style="font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px); font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin: 0 0 10px 0; letter-spacing: -0.5px;">
                            <?= htmlspecialchars($title) ?>
                        </h2>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                    <?php if (!empty($subtitle)): ?>
                        <p style="font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); margin: 0; line-height: 1.5;">
                            <?= htmlspecialchars($subtitle) ?>
                        </p>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                </div>
            <?php endif; ?>

            <?php if (empty($products)): ?>
                <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; padding: 48px 20px; text-align: center; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
                    <div style="font-size: 38px; margin-bottom: 12px;">🛍️</div>
                    <h3 style="color: #fff; margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 18px;">Vitrine em Atualização</h3>

                <div class="drop-grid">

                        $checkoutUrl = $baseUrl . '/checkout/produto/' . (int)$p->id;
                        $costRef = $p->salePriceBrl * 1.35; // Preço original tachado simulado

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de comunicação com a AliExpress Open Platform API (DIP / SOLID).
 */
interface AliExpressApiClientInterface
{
    /**
     * Executa uma chamada oficial ao gateway da AliExpress Open Platform.
     * 
     * @param string $apiMethod Nome oficial do método (ex: 'aliexpress.ds.product.get')
     * @param array<string, mixed> $params Parâmetros específicos da API
     * @param string|null $accessToken Token OAuth2 de sessão (opcional)
     * @return array<string, mixed> Resposta decodificada em array
     */
    public function execute(string $apiMethod, array $params = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array;

    /**
     * Consulta detalhes completos de um produto pelo ID do AliExpress.
     * 
     * @param string|int $productId ID numérico do produto no AliExpress
     * @param string $targetLanguage Idioma desejado (padrão 'pt')
     * @param string $targetCurrency Moeda base (padrão 'USD')
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getProductDetails(string|int $productId, string $targetLanguage = 'pt', string $targetCurrency = 'USD'): array;

    /**
     * Pesquisa ou minera produtos em alta por termo ou categoria.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filters
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function searchProducts(array $filters = []): array;

    /**
     * Consulta eventos logísticos e rastreamento oficial de um envio no SDK AliExpress.
     *
     * @param string $logisticsNo Código de rastreio da transportadora (Correios/Cainiao)
     * @param string $origin Origem da ordem no AliExpress (padrão 'ESCROW')
     * @param string $outRef ID do pedido no AliExpress
     * @param string $serviceName Serviço logístico / transportadora (ex: 'CAINIAO', 'CORREIOS')
     * @param string $toArea País de destino ISO-2 (padrão 'BR')
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function queryTrackingInfo(
        string $logisticsNo,
        string $origin = 'ESCROW',
        string $outRef = '',
        string $serviceName = 'CAINIAO',
        string $toArea = 'BR'
    ): array;
}

/**
 * Contrato de Conversão Cambial e Precificação com Margem de Lucro (DIP / SOLID).
 */
interface CurrencyConverterInterface
{
    /**
     * Retorna a taxa de câmbio atual de USD para a moeda de destino (ex: BRL).
     */
    public function getExchangeRate(string $from = 'USD', string $to = 'BRL'): float;

    /**
     * Converte o custo original em USD para BRL e calcula o preço final de venda

     * @param float $costUsd Custo original do fornecedor em Dólar

     * @return float Preço final sugerido de venda em Reais (BRL)
     */
    public function calculateSalePrice(float $costUsd, ?float $customMarkupPercent = null, ?float $minProfitBrl = null): float;
}

/**

 */
interface DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface
{
    /**
     * Salva ou atualiza um produto minerado no repositório.
     * Retorna o ID do registro no banco.
     */
    public function save(DropshipProductDto $product): int;

    /**
     * Localiza um produto pelo ID interno.
     */
    public function findById(int $id): ?DropshipProductDto;

    /**
     * Localiza um produto pelo ID original do AliExpress.
     */
    public function findByAliExpressId(string $aliexpressId): ?DropshipProductDto;

    /**
     * Localiza um produto pelo slug amigável da URL.
     */
    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?DropshipProductDto;

    /**
     * Lista produtos minerados com paginação e filtros.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $criteria
     * @return array<int, DropshipProductDto>
     */
    public function list(array $criteria = [], int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0): array;

    /**
     * Retorna a quantidade total de produtos minerados.
     */
    public function count(array $criteria = []): int;

    /**
     * Remove um produto pelo ID.
     */
    public function delete(int $id): bool;

    /**
     * Atualiza o preço de venda (BRL) e opcionalmente o custo (USD) de um produto.
     */
    public function updatePrice(int $id, float $salePriceBrl, ?float $costPriceUsd = null): bool;

    /**
     * Retorna lista de categorias únicas disponíveis no catálogo.
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getCategories(): array;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto;

/**
 * Contrato para Motores de Scraping e Extração por Link Oficial (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Responsável exclusivo por inspecionar a URL oficial do fornecedor,
 * extrair em tempo real imagens Full HD (capa e galeria), título oficial e precificação.
 */
interface ProductLinkScraperInterface
{
    /**
     * Verifica se este scraper suporta a URL ou identificador informado.
     */
    public function canHandle(string $urlOrId): bool;

    /**
     * Executa a extração em tempo real diretamente do link oficial do produto.
     * Retorna o DTO fortemente tipado com garantias de integridade de mídia.
     * 
     * @param string $urlOrId URL pública ou ID do produto
     * @return ScrapedProductDto|null Retorna null se a página estiver indisponível ou inacessível
     */
    public function scrape(string $urlOrId): ?ScrapedProductDto;

    /**
     * Analisa o código-fonte bruto (HTML ou JSON do anúncio copiado do navegador)
     * e extrai os dados estruturados do produto sem realizar requisições de rede.
     * 
     * @param string $rawSource Código HTML ou payload JSON
     * @param string $sourceUrl URL de origem (opcional)
     * @return ScrapedProductDto|null
     */
    public function parseRawHtml(string $rawSource, string $sourceUrl = ''): ?ScrapedProductDto;

    /**
     * Verifica rapidamente se o link do produto existe e está ativo (filtra páginas 404/indisponíveis).
     */
    public function isProductAlive(string $urlOrId): bool;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;

/**
 * Contrato do Orquestrador de Mineração de Produtos (SRP / DIP).
 */
interface ProductMiningServiceInterface
{
    /**
     * Minera produtos em alta no AliExpress, executa a conversão cambial,
     * enriquece títulos e descrições com I.A. e retorna os DTOs processados.
     * 
     * @param string $category Categoria ou palavra-chave de busca
     * @param int $limit Quantidade de produtos para minerar
     * @param bool $autoPersist Se deve persistir automaticamente no catálogo
     * @param string $sort Critério de ordenação ('volume_desc', 'price_asc', etc.)
     * @return array<int, DropshipProductDto>
     */
    public function mineTrendingProducts(string $category = 'Eletrônicos', int $limit = 10, bool $autoPersist = true, string $sort = 'volume_desc'): array;

    /**
     * Importa um produto específico através da URL ou ID do AliExpress.
     * 
     * @param string|int $productIdOrUrl
     * @return DropshipProductDto
     */
    public function importSingleProduct(string|int $productIdOrUrl): DropshipProductDto;

    /**
     * Importa um produto a partir do código-fonte bruto (HTML ou JSON) copiado diretamente
     * do navegador autenticado do lojista, contornando bloqueios anti-robô/slider captcha.
     * Utiliza buffer transitório por item com isolamento de memória.
     * 
     * @param string $rawSource HTML completo (Ctrl+U) ou JSON do anúncio
     * @param string|null $category Categoria opcional para sobrepor a inferida
     * @return DropshipProductDto
     */
    public function importFromBrowserSource(string $rawSource, ?string $category = null): DropshipProductDto;

    /**
     * Executa o ciclo de rotação diária automatizada de 24 horas.
     * Minera produtos virais aleatórios para todas as 9 categorias oficiais:
     * - Eletrônicos & Gadget
     * - Casa Inteligente & Organização
     * - Beleza, Cuidados & Estilo
     * - Ferramentas & Utilidades
     * - Pet Shop & Pets Virais
     * - Acessórios para Veículos
     * - Moda, Roupas & Vestuário
     * - Moda Íntima, Lingeries & Pijamas
     * - Sex Shop & Produtos Adultos (+18)
     * 
     * Atualiza o catálogo, registra a data/hora de conclusão e retorna o resumo estatístico.
     * 
     * @param int $itemsPerCategory Quantidade de produtos frescos minerados por categoria
     * @return array<string, mixed> Resumo da rodada executada
     */
    public function runDailyAutomatedRotation(int $itemsPerCategory = 4): array;

    /**
     * Retorna os metadados do ciclo diário de 24 horas:
     * timestamp da última execução, próxima execução, segundos restantes, tempo formatado (HH:MM:SS),
     * status se expirado (is_due) e estatísticas de produtos por categoria.
     * 
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getDailyCycleInfo(): array;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Controlador público para cadastro, login, pedidos, rastreio integrado e abertura de reclamações/dúvidas/observações de clientes.

    public function showRegister(Request $request): ResponseInterface

    public function register(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->baseUrl();
        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Atualize a página e tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/cadastro');
        }

        $name = trim((string)$request->input('name', ''));
        $email = strtolower(trim((string)$request->input('email', '')));
        $cpf = preg_replace('/[^0-9.-]/', '', trim((string)$request->input('cpf', ''))) ?? '';
        $phone = trim((string)$request->input('phone', ''));
        $password = (string)$request->input('password', '');
        $confirm = (string)$request->input('password_confirm', '');

        if (mb_strlen($name) < 2) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe seu nome completo.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/cadastro');
        }
        if ($email === '' || filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) === false) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe um endereço de e-mail válido.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/cadastro');
        }
        if (strlen($password) < 6) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'A senha deve conter no mínimo 6 caracteres.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/cadastro');
        }
        if ($confirm !== '' && $password !== $confirm) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'A confirmação de senha não confere.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/cadastro');
        }

        if ($this->customerRepo->findByEmail($email) !== null) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Este e-mail já possui cadastro. Faça login para acessar seus pedidos.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar?email=' . rawurlencode($email));
        }

        $customerId = $this->customerRepo->create([
            'name'          => $name,
            'email'         => $email,
            'cpf'           => $cpf,
            'phone'         => $phone,
            'password_hash' => password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT),
            'status'        => 'active',
        ]);

        $this->authenticateCustomerSession([
            'id'    => $customerId,
            'name'  => $name,
            'email' => $email,
            'cpf'   => $cpf,
        ]);

        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Cadastro realizado com sucesso! Seus pedidos e garantias estão disponíveis aqui.');
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta');
    }

    public function showLogin(Request $request): ResponseInterface

        $baseUrl = $this->baseUrl();
        if ($this->isLoggedIn()) {
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta');

        return $this->wrapWithThemeOrRaw($content, 'Entrar na Minha Conta - RachidD.com');

    public function login(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->baseUrl();
        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar');
        }

        $email = strtolower(trim((string)$request->input('email', '')));
        $password = (string)$request->input('password', '');

        if ($email === '' || $password === '') {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Informe e-mail e senha para entrar.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar');
        }

        $customer = $this->customerRepo->findByEmail($email);
        if ($customer === null || !password_verify($password, (string)($customer['password_hash'] ?? ''))) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar?email=' . rawurlencode($email));
        }

        if (($customer['status'] ?? 'active') !== 'active') {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Conta temporariamente suspensa. Entre em contato com o suporte.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar');
        }

        $this->authenticateCustomerSession($customer);
        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Bem-vindo de volta!');

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta');
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->baseUrl();
        $this->session->remove('customer_id');
        $this->session->remove('customer_name');
        $this->session->remove('customer_email');
        $this->session->remove('customer_cpf');

        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Você saiu da sua conta com segurança.');
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/');
    }

    public function account(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->baseUrl();
        if (!$this->isLoggedIn()) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Faça login ou crie sua conta para visualizar pedidos e abrir reclamações.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar');
        }

        $customerId = (int)$this->session->get('customer_id', 0);
        $customerEmail = (string)$this->session->get('customer_email', '');
        $customer = $this->customerRepo->findById($customerId) ?? [
            'id'    => $customerId,
            'name'  => (string)$this->session->get('customer_name', 'Cliente'),
            'email' => $customerEmail,
            'cpf'   => (string)$this->session->get('customer_cpf', ''),
        ];

        $orders = $this->orderRepo->findByCustomerEmail($customerEmail, 50);
        $orderRefs = array_values(array_filter(array_map(static fn (array $o): string => (string)($o['order_ref'] ?? ''), $orders)));
        $disputesByOrder = $this->disputeRepo->mapByOrderRefs($orderRefs);

        foreach ($orders as &$order) {
            $ref = (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '');
            $orderDisputes = $disputesByOrder[$ref] ?? [];
            $order['disputes'] = $orderDisputes;
            $order['sla'] = $this->slaService->calculate($order, $orderDisputes);
        }
        unset($order);

        $disputes = $this->disputeRepo->findByCustomerEmail($customerEmail);
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $selectedOrderRef = trim((string)$request->input('pedido', ''));
        $selectedProductId = (int)$request->input('produto', 0);
        $catalogProducts = $this->catalogRepo !== null
            ? $this->catalogRepo->list(['status' => 'published', 'sort' => 'updated_desc'], 100, 0)
            : [];

        // Rastreio integrado dentro da Área do Cliente (/minha-conta?rastrear=...)
        $trackQuery = trim((string)$request->input('rastrear', ''));
        $trackedOrder = null;
        $trackedCodeOnly = '';
        $sdkEvents = [];
        $sdkOfficialUrl = '';

        if ($trackQuery !== '') {
            foreach ($orders as $ord) {
                $oRef = (string)($ord['order_ref'] ?? '');
                $tCode = (string)($ord['tracking_code'] ?? '');
                if (strcasecmp($oRef, $trackQuery) === 0 || ($tCode !== '' && strcasecmp($tCode, $trackQuery) === 0)) {
                    $trackedOrder = $ord;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ($trackedOrder === null && preg_match('/^[A-Z0-9\-]{6,32}$/i', $trackQuery)) {
                $trackedCodeOnly = strtoupper($trackQuery);
            }
        } elseif (!empty($orders)) {
            $trackedOrder = $orders[0];
        }

        if ($trackedOrder !== null && $this->apiClient !== null) {
            $tCode = trim((string)($trackedOrder['tracking_code'] ?? ''));
            $aliOrderId = trim((string)($trackedOrder['aliexpress_order_id'] ?? ''));
            if ($tCode !== '' && $aliOrderId !== '') {
                try {
                    $sdkRes = $this->apiClient->queryTrackingInfo(
                        logisticsNo: $tCode,
                        origin: 'ESCROW',
                        outRef: $aliOrderId,
                        serviceName: 'CAINIAO_STANDARD',
                        toArea: 'BR'
                    );
                    if (!empty($sdkRes['details']) && is_array($sdkRes['details'])) {
                        $sdkEvents = $sdkRes['details'];
                    }
                    if (!empty($sdkRes['official_website'])) {
                        $sdkOfficialUrl = (string)$sdkRes['official_website'];
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                }
            }
        }

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/front/customer_account.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return $this->wrapWithThemeOrRaw($content, 'Minha Conta, Rastreio e Atendimento - RachidD.com');
    }

    public function submitComplaint(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = $this->baseUrl();
        if (!$this->isLoggedIn()) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'É necessário estar conectado para abrir uma reclamação ou mensagem.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/entrar');
        }

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta');
        }

        $customerId = (int)$this->session->get('customer_id', 0);
        $customerEmail = strtolower(trim((string)$this->session->get('customer_email', '')));
        $orderRef = trim((string)$request->input('order_ref', ''));
        $manualOrderRef = trim((string)$request->input('manual_order_ref', ''));
        $catalogProductId = (int)$request->input('catalog_product_id', 0);
        $reason = trim((string)$request->input('reason', 'produto_danificado'));
        $description = trim((string)$request->input('description', ''));

        $allowedReasons = [
            'produto_danificado',
            'entrega_atrasada',
            'item_errado',
            'arrependimento',
            'duvida_entrega',
            'duvida_produto',
            'observacao_pedido',
            'outro',
        ];
        if (!in_array($reason, $allowedReasons, true)) {
            $reason = 'outro';
        }

        if (mb_strlen($description) < 10) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Descreva sua dúvida, observação ou reclamação com pelo menos 10 caracteres.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta?pedido=' . rawurlencode($orderRef ?: 'GERAL'));
        }

        $isGeneralInquiry = ($orderRef === '' || strtoupper($orderRef) === 'GERAL');
        $order = null;

        if (!$isGeneralInquiry) {
            $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
            if ($order === null || strtolower(trim((string)($order['customer_email'] ?? ''))) !== $customerEmail) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Você ainda não possui o pedido selecionado vinculado à sua conta. Você pode deixar como "Sem pedido na lista" ou informar o código/produto opcionalmente.');
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta');
            }
        } elseif ($manualOrderRef !== '') {
            $cleanManualRef = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9\-_#\/]/', '', $manualOrderRef) ?: '';
            $cleanManualRef = substr(strtoupper($cleanManualRef), 0, 60);
            if ($cleanManualRef !== '') {
                $orderRef = $cleanManualRef;
                $order = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($cleanManualRef);
            } else {
                $orderRef = 'GERAL';
            }
        } else {
            $orderRef = 'GERAL';
        }

        $linkedProduct = ($catalogProductId > 0 && $this->catalogRepo !== null)
            ? $this->catalogRepo->findById($catalogProductId)
            : null;

        $contextPrefixParts = [];
        if ($manualOrderRef !== '' && $isGeneralInquiry) {
            $contextPrefixParts[] = 'Ref. Informada: ' . $manualOrderRef;
        }
        if ($linkedProduct !== null) {
            $contextPrefixParts[] = 'Produto: #' . $linkedProduct->id . ' - ' . $linkedProduct->title;
            if ($orderRef === 'GERAL') {
                $orderRef = 'PROD-' . $linkedProduct->id;
            }
        } elseif (!empty($order['product_title'])) {
            $contextPrefixParts[] = 'Produto do Pedido: ' . (string)$order['product_title'];
        }

        if (!empty($contextPrefixParts)) {
            $description = '[' . implode(' | ', $contextPrefixParts) . "]\n" . $description;
        }

        if (mb_strlen($description) > 3000) {
            $description = mb_substr($description, 0, 3000);
        }

        $fileInput = $request->files['evidences'] ?? null;
        $uploadResult = $this->attachmentService->storeUploadedFiles(is_array($fileInput) ? $fileInput : null);
        if (!empty($uploadResult['errors'])) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', implode(' ', $uploadResult['errors']));
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta?pedido=' . rawurlencode($orderRef));
        }

        $sellerOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)($order['seller_origin'] ?? '')));
        $sellerName = $order['seller_name'] ?? null;
        $sellerEmail = $order['seller_email'] ?? null;

        if ($linkedProduct !== null) {
            $sellerInfo = $linkedProduct->getSellerInfo();
            if ($sellerOrigin === '') {
                $isNational = !empty($linkedProduct->attributes['origem_brasil'])
                    || (($linkedProduct->attributes['ship_from'] ?? '') === 'BR');
                $sellerOrigin = $isNational ? 'BR' : 'CN';
            }
            if ($sellerName === null || $sellerName === '') {
                $sellerName = $sellerInfo['store_name'] . ' (' . $sellerInfo['seller_id'] . ')';
            }
        }

        if ($sellerOrigin !== 'BR' && $sellerOrigin !== 'CN') {
            $sellerOrigin = 'BR';
        }

        $this->disputeRepo->create([
            'order_ref'        => $orderRef,
            'customer_id'      => $customerId > 0 ? $customerId : null,
            'customer_email'   => $customerEmail,
            'reason'           => $reason,
            'description'      => $description,
            'attachments_json' => $uploadResult['attachments'],
            'seller_origin'    => $sellerOrigin,
            'seller_name'      => $sellerName,
            'seller_email'     => $sellerEmail,
            'mediation_status' => 'open',
        ]);

        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Sua solicitação foi registrada com sucesso! Nossa equipe analisará e responderá em breve.');
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/minha-conta');
    }

    public function serveAttachment(Request $request, string $id, string $file): ResponseInterface
    {
        $dispute = $this->disputeRepo->findById((int)$id);
        if ($dispute === null) {
            return new Response('Arquivo não encontrado.', 404);
        }

        $role = (string)$this->session->get('user_role', '');
        $isAdmin = in_array($role, ['admin', 'manager'], true);
        $sessionCustomerEmail = strtolower(trim((string)$this->session->get('customer_email', '')));
        $isOwner = $sessionCustomerEmail !== '' && $sessionCustomerEmail === strtolower(trim((string)($dispute['customer_email'] ?? '')));

        if (!$isAdmin && !$isOwner) {
            return new Response('Acesso negado ao anexo solicitado.', 403);
        }

        $matchedMeta = null;
        $attachments = is_array($dispute['attachments'] ?? null) ? $dispute['attachments'] : [];
        foreach ($attachments as $att) {
            if (is_array($att) && ($att['filename'] ?? '') === $file) {
                $matchedMeta = $att;
                break;
            }
        }
        if ($matchedMeta === null) {
            return new Response('Anexo não pertence a esta solicitação.', 404);
        }

        $safePath = $this->attachmentService->resolveSafePath($file);
        if ($safePath === null) {
            return new Response('Arquivo indisponível no armazenamento.', 404);
        }

        $bytes = @file_get_contents($safePath);
        if ($bytes === false) {
            return new Response('Erro ao ler anexo.', 500);
        }

        $mime = (string)($matchedMeta['mime'] ?? 'application/octet-stream');
        $downloadName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '_', (string)($matchedMeta['original_name'] ?? $file)) ?: $file;

        return new Response($bytes, 200, [
            'Content-Type'           => $mime,
            'Content-Disposition'    => 'inline; filename="' . $downloadName . '"',
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'Cache-Control'          => 'private, max-age=3600',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $customer
     */
    private function authenticateCustomerSession(array $customer): void
    {
        $this->session->regenerate();
        $this->session->set('customer_id', (int)($customer['id'] ?? 0));
        $this->session->set('customer_name', (string)($customer['name'] ?? 'Cliente'));
        $this->session->set('customer_email', strtolower(trim((string)($customer['email'] ?? ''))));
        $this->session->set('customer_cpf', (string)($customer['cpf'] ?? ''));
    }

    private function isLoggedIn(): bool
    {
        return (int)$this->session->get('customer_id', 0) > 0
            && trim((string)$this->session->get('customer_email', '')) !== '';
    }

    private function verifyCsrf(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token', (string)$request->input('_csrf', (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '')));
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();

        return $token !== '' && hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    private function baseUrl(): string
    {
        return defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
    }

    private function wrapWithThemeOrRaw(string $content, string $title): ResponseInterface
    {
        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            try {
                $wrapped = $this->themeManager->render('page', [
                    'title'   => $title,
                    'content' => $content,
                ]);
                return new Response($wrapped);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback direto
            }
        }

        return new Response($content ?: '');
    }
}

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface

        $rate = $this->currencyConverter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');

    public function mine(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $category = (string)$request->input('category', 'Eletrônicos');
        $limit = max(1, min(30, (int)$request->input('limit', 10)));
        $sort = (string)$request->input('sort', 'volume_desc');

        try {
            $mined = $this->miningService->mineTrendingProducts($category, $limit, true, $sort);
            $count = count($mined);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "🚀 Mineração concluída com sucesso! {$count} produtos com alta reputação minerados e adicionados ao catálogo.");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha ao minerar produtos: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }
