    public function saveSettings(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $config['app_key'] = trim((string)$request->input('app_key', $config['app_key'] ?? ''));
        $newSecret = trim((string)$request->input('app_secret', ''));
        if ($newSecret !== '' && !str_starts_with($newSecret, '***')) {
            $config['app_secret'] = $newSecret;
        }
        $newAccessToken = trim((string)$request->input('access_token', ''));
        if ($newAccessToken !== '' && !str_starts_with($newAccessToken, '***')) {
            $config['access_token'] = $newAccessToken;
        }
        $config['default_markup_percent'] = max(10.0, (float)$request->input('default_markup_percent', 100.0));
        $config['min_profit_margin_brl'] = max(0.0, (float)$request->input('min_profit_margin_brl', 30.0));

        @file_put_contents($this->configFile, json_encode($config, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Configurações do DomainDrop salvas com sucesso!');

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
    }

    public function testConnection(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado. Atualize a página e tente novamente.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $appKey = trim((string)$request->input('app_key', $config['app_key'] ?? ''));
        $appSecret = trim((string)$request->input('app_secret', ''));
        if ($appSecret === '' || str_starts_with($appSecret, '***')) {
            $appSecret = (string)($config['app_secret'] ?? '');
        }
        $accessToken = trim((string)$request->input('access_token', ''));
        if ($accessToken === '' || str_starts_with($accessToken, '***')) {
            $accessToken = (string)($config['access_token'] ?? '');
        }
        $gatewayUrl = (string)($config['gateway_url'] ?? 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync');

        if ($appKey === '' || $appSecret === '') {
            $msg = '❌ O AppKey e o AppSecret são obrigatórios para testar a conexão com o servidor do AliExpress.';
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => $msg], 400);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }

        try {
            $client = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient(
                appKey: $appKey,
                appSecret: $appSecret,
                gatewayUrl: $gatewayUrl,
                timeout: 10,
                accessToken: $accessToken !== '' ? $accessToken : null
            );

            // Testa endpoint de detalhes de produto no gateway oficial do AliExpress
            $res = $client->getProductDetails('1005006093867086');

            if (isset($res['error_response'])) {
                $err = $res['error_response'];
                $errCode = (string)($err['code'] ?? '');
                $errMsg = (string)($err['msg'] ?? '');

                if (str_contains(strtolower($errMsg), 'access_token') || str_contains($errCode, 'MissingParameter') || str_contains($errCode, 'IllegalAccessToken') || str_contains($errCode, 'InvalidAccessToken')) {
                    $status = 'warning';
                    $msg = "⚠️ Conexão física OK com o servidor do AliExpress (api-sg.aliexpress.com), mas a aplicação está em modo TEST ou o Access Token não foi fornecido. Clique no botão 'Apply Online' no portal do AliExpress para ir para Produção e cole o Access Token gerado.";
                } elseif (str_contains($errCode, 'InvalidAppKey') || str_contains($errMsg, 'AppKey') || str_contains($errCode, 'IncompleteSignature') || str_contains($errCode, 'Signature')) {
                    $status = 'error';
                    $msg = "❌ Credenciais inválidas. O servidor do AliExpress rejeitou o AppKey ou AppSecret informados. Verifique se foram digitados corretamente ou gere novas credenciais no portal openservice.aliexpress.com.";
                } else {
                    $status = 'warning';
                    $msg = "⚠️ Resposta do Servidor AliExpress: [{$errCode}] {$errMsg}. Verifique as permissões da aplicação no painel de desenvolvedores.";
                }

                if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                    return new JsonResponse([
                        'success' => false,
                        'status'  => $status,
                        'message' => $msg,
                        'code'    => $errCode,
                    ]);
                }

                $this->session->setFlash($status === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'error', $msg);
                return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
            }

            // Sucesso Total
            $msg = "✔️ Conexão e sincronização 100% estabelecidas com o servidor do AliExpress! Protocolo HMAC-SHA256 validado e credenciais operantes.";
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success' => true,
                    'status'  => 'ok',
                    'message' => $msg,
                ]);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');

        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $msg = "❌ Falha de rede ao conectar com o servidor do AliExpress: " . $e->getMessage() . ". Verifique se o servidor possui saída HTTPS para api-sg.aliexpress.com.";
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => $msg], 500);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/settings');
        }
    }

    public function orders(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $status = (string)$request->input('status', '');
        $search = (string)$request->input('q', '');

        $filters = [];
        if ($status !== '') {
            $filters['status'] = $status;
        }
        if ($search !== '') {
            $filters['search'] = $search;
        }

        $orders = $this->orderRepo !== null ? $this->orderRepo->list($filters, 50, 0) : [];
        $registeredCustomers = $this->customerRepo !== null ? $this->customerRepo->listAll(200, 0) : [];
        $customersByEmail = [];
        foreach ($registeredCustomers as $cust) {
            $em = strtolower(trim((string)($cust['email'] ?? '')));
            if ($em !== '') {
                $customersByEmail[$em] = $cust;
            }
        }

        $orderRefs = array_values(array_filter(array_map(static fn (array $o): string => (string)($o['order_ref'] ?? ''), $orders)));
        $disputesByOrder = $this->disputeRepo !== null ? $this->disputeRepo->mapByOrderRefs($orderRefs) : [];
        $slaCalc = $this->slaService ?? new OrderSlaProgressService();

        foreach ($orders as &$ord) {
            $ref = (string)($ord['order_ref'] ?? '');
            $em = strtolower(trim((string)($ord['customer_email'] ?? '')));
            $ordDisputes = $disputesByOrder[$ref] ?? [];
            $ord['disputes'] = $ordDisputes;
            $ord['is_registered_customer'] = isset($customersByEmail[$em]);
            $ord['sla'] = $slaCalc->calculate($ord, $ordDisputes);
        }
        unset($ord);

        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $flashMsg = $flash['msg'] ?? null;
        $flashType = $flash['type'] ?? null;

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/admin/orders.php';
        $content = ob_get_clean();

        return new ViewResponse($content ?: '');
    }

    public function updateFulfillment(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $orderRef = (string)$request->input('order_ref', '');
        $status = (string)$request->input('status', 'paid');
        $aeOrderId = trim((string)$request->input('aliexpress_order_id', ''));
        $tracking = trim((string)$request->input('tracking_code', ''));
        $sellerOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)$request->input('seller_origin', '')));
        $expectedDays = (int)$request->input('expected_delivery_days', 0);
        $sellerEmail = trim((string)$request->input('seller_email', ''));

        if ($this->orderRepo !== null && $orderRef !== '') {
            $this->orderRepo->updateFulfillment(
                $orderRef,
                $status,
                $aeOrderId !== '' ? $aeOrderId : null,
                $tracking !== '' ? $tracking : null
            );

            if ($sellerOrigin !== '') {
                $days = $expectedDays > 0 ? $expectedDays : ($sellerOrigin === 'CN' ? 25 : 7);
                $this->orderRepo->updateSellerAndSla(
                    $orderRef,
                    $sellerOrigin,
                    $days,
                    null,
                    $sellerEmail !== '' ? $sellerEmail : null
                );
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Status de envio do pedido atualizado com sucesso!');
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
    }

    /**
     * Consulta o SDK oficial do AliExpress para verificar se o item chegou ao destino.
     */
    public function checkOrderSdk(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $orderRef = trim((string)$request->input('order_ref', ''));
        $order = ($this->orderRepo !== null && $orderRef !== '') ? $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef) : null;
        if ($order === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pedido não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Pedido não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $trackingCode = trim((string)($order['tracking_code'] ?? ''));
        $aeOrderId = trim((string)($order['aliexpress_order_id'] ?? ''));

        if ($trackingCode === '' || $this->apiClient === null) {
            $msg = 'Informe o código de rastreio do pedido antes de consultar o SDK logístico.';
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $msg], 422);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        try {
            $sdkRes = $this->apiClient->queryTrackingInfo(
                logisticsNo: $trackingCode,
                origin: 'ESCROW',
                outRef: $aeOrderId,
                serviceName: str_starts_with(strtoupper($trackingCode), 'BR') ? 'CORREIOS' : 'CAINIAO',
                toArea: 'BR'
            );

            $slaCalc = $this->slaService ?? new OrderSlaProgressService();
            $parsed = $slaCalc->parseSdkTracking($sdkRes);
            $summaryJson = json_encode($sdkRes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '{}';

            if ($parsed['delivered']) {
                $this->orderRepo->updateSdkTracking(
                    $orderRef,
                    date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                    $summaryJson,
                    'delivered'
                );
                $msg = 'SDK AliExpress confirmou: item entregue no local! Pedido atualizado para "Tudo Ok".';
            } else {
                $this->orderRepo->updateSdkTracking($orderRef, null, $summaryJson, null);
                $msg = 'SDK consultado: encomenda ainda em trânsito (' . ($parsed['last_event'] !== '' ? $parsed['last_event'] : $parsed['status_code']) . ').';
            }

            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => true, 'delivered' => $parsed['delivered'], 'message' => $msg, 'tracking' => $parsed]);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $msg = 'Falha ao consultar SDK logístico: ' . $e->getMessage();
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $msg], 500);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
    }

    /**
     * Botão único de intermediação com o fornecedor (PT-BR se Brasil, traduzido para Chinês se China).
     */
    public function mediateDispute(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $orderRef = trim((string)$request->input('order_ref', ''));
        $disputeId = (int)$request->input('dispute_id', 0);

        $order = ($this->orderRepo !== null && $orderRef !== '') ? $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef) : null;
        if ($order === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pedido não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Pedido não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $dispute = null;
        if ($this->disputeRepo !== null) {
            $dispute = $disputeId > 0 ? $this->disputeRepo->findById($disputeId) : null;
            if ($dispute === null) {
                $list = $this->disputeRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
                $dispute = $list[0] ?? null;
            }
        }

        if ($dispute === null || $this->mediationService === null) {
            $msg = 'Nenhuma reclamação aberta encontrada para intermediar.';
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $msg], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $msg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
        }

        $overrideOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)$request->input('seller_origin', '')));
        if (in_array($overrideOrigin, ['BR', 'CN'], true)) {
            $dispute['seller_origin'] = $overrideOrigin;
        }

        $result = $this->mediationService->sendMediation($order, $dispute, $baseUrl);
        $langLabel = ($result['seller_language'] ?? '') === 'zh-CN'
            ? 'Chinês Simplificado (zh-CN)'
            : 'Português (pt-BR)';

        $msg = "Intermediação enviada ao fornecedor em {$langLabel}!";
        if ($isAjax) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'            => true,
                'message'            => $msg,
                'seller_language'    => $result['seller_language'] ?? 'zh-CN',
                'channel'            => $result['channel'] ?? 'aliexpress_mediation_log',
                'translated_message' => $result['translated_message'] ?? '',
            ]);
        }

        $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/orders');
    }

    public function syncImages(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        if ($this->mediaSync === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Serviço de sincronização de mídia indisponível.'], 503);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Serviço de sincronização de mídia indisponível.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        try {
            $updated = $this->mediaSync->syncProductMedia((int)$id);
            $images = $this->filterImageUrls(array_merge([$updated->mainImageUrl], $updated->images));
            $mainImageUrl = $updated->mainImageUrl ?: ($images[0] ?? '');
            $imgCount = count($images);
            $msg = "🔄 Produto '{$updated->title}' sincronizado com sucesso! {$imgCount} foto(s) em alta resolução carregada(s).";

            if ($isAjax) {
                $rate = $this->currencyConverter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
                if ($rate <= 0) {
                    $rate = 5.50;
                }
                return new JsonResponse([
                    'success'        => true,
                    'message'        => $msg,
                    'title'          => $updated->title,
                    'main_image_url' => $mainImageUrl,
                    'images'         => $images,
                    'count'          => $imgCount,
                    'sale_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($updated->salePriceBrl, 2, ',', '.'),
                    'cost_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($updated->costPriceUsd * $rate, 2, ',', '.'),
                    'cost_price_usd' => $updated->costPriceUsd,
                ]);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $errMsg = 'Falha ao sincronizar imagens: ' . $e->getMessage();
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $errMsg], 422);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $errMsg);
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    public function updateImages(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $isAjax = $this->isAjaxOrJson($request);

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $product = $this->catalogRepo->findById((int)$id);
        if ($product === null) {
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Produto não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Produto não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $rawImages = $request->input('images_json');
        $parsedImages = [];
        if (is_string($rawImages) && trim($rawImages) !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($rawImages, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $parsedImages = $decoded;
            }
        } elseif (is_array($request->input('images'))) {
            $parsedImages = $request->input('images');
        }

        $mainImageInput = trim((string)$request->input('main_image_url', ''));
        $validImages = $this->filterImageUrls($parsedImages);
        $validMain = $this->filterImageUrls([$mainImageInput])[0] ?? ($validImages[0] ?? '');

        if ($validMain === '' && empty($validImages)) {
            $errMsg = 'Informe pelo menos 1 URL de imagem HTTP/HTTPS válida.';
            if ($isAjax) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => $errMsg], 422);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', $errMsg);
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        // Garante que a imagem principal esteja na lista (em primeiro lugar)
        $orderedImages = $this->filterImageUrls(array_merge([$validMain], $validImages));

        $updatedDto = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: $product->aliexpressId,
            title: $product->title,
            slug: $product->slug,
            costPriceUsd: $product->costPriceUsd,
            salePriceBrl: $product->salePriceBrl,
            mainImageUrl: $validMain,
            images: $orderedImages,
            category: $product->category,
            description: $product->description,
            rating: $product->rating,
            ordersCount: $product->ordersCount,
            attributes: $product->attributes,
            status: $product->status,
            id: $product->id
        );

        $this->catalogRepo->save($updatedDto);

        $count = count($orderedImages);
        $msg = "🖼️ Galeria de '{$product->title}' atualizada! {$count} foto(s) salva(s).";

        if ($isAjax) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'        => true,
                'message'        => $msg,
                'main_image_url' => $validMain,
                'images'         => $orderedImages,
                'count'          => $count,
            ]);
        }

        $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, mixed> $urls
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function filterImageUrls(array $urls): array
    {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($urls as $raw) {
            if (!is_string($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $url = trim($raw);
            if ($url === '' || !filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL)) {
                continue;
            }
            $scheme = strtolower((string)parse_url($url, PHP_URL_SCHEME));
            if ($scheme !== 'http' && $scheme !== 'https') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($url, $clean, true)) {
                $clean[] = $url;
            }
        }
        return $clean;
    }

    public function syncAllImages(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', "Falha na sincronização em lote: " . $e->getMessage());
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    public function updatePrice(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Token de segurança expirado.'], 403);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $productId = (int)$id;
        $product = $this->catalogRepo->findById($productId);
        if ($product === null) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new JsonResponse(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Produto não encontrado.'], 404);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Produto não encontrado.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
        }

        $rate = $this->currencyConverter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        if ($rate <= 0) {
            $rate = 5.50;
        }

        // Preço de venda em BRL
        $salePriceBrl = max(0.01, $this->parseCurrency($request->input('sale_price_brl')));

        // Custo pode ser informado em BRL ou USD
        $costPriceUsd = null;
        if ($request->input('cost_price_brl') !== null && $request->input('cost_price_brl') !== '') {
            $costBrl = max(0.0, $this->parseCurrency($request->input('cost_price_brl')));
            $costPriceUsd = round($costBrl / $rate, 2);
        } elseif ($request->input('cost_price_usd') !== null && $request->input('cost_price_usd') !== '') {
            $costPriceUsd = max(0.0, $this->parseCurrency($request->input('cost_price_usd')));
        }

        $this->catalogRepo->updatePrice($productId, $salePriceBrl, $costPriceUsd);

        $finalCostUsd = $costPriceUsd ?? $product->costPriceUsd;
        $finalCostBrl = $finalCostUsd * $rate;
        $profitBrl = $salePriceBrl - $finalCostBrl;
        $marginPercent = ($salePriceBrl > 0) ? round(($profitBrl / $salePriceBrl) * 100, 1) : 0;

        $msg = "💰 Preço de '{$product->title}' atualizado com sucesso! Venda: R$ " . number_format($salePriceBrl, 2, ',', '.') . " (Margem: {$marginPercent}% / R$ " . number_format($profitBrl, 2, ',', '.') . ")";

        if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'success'        => true,
                'message'        => $msg,
                'sale_price_brl' => $salePriceBrl,
                'sale_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($salePriceBrl, 2, ',', '.'),
                'cost_price_usd' => $finalCostUsd,
                'cost_price_brl' => round($finalCostBrl, 2),
                'cost_formatted' => 'R$ ' . number_format($finalCostBrl, 2, ',', '.'),
                'profit_brl'     => round($profitBrl, 2),
                'margin_percent' => $marginPercent,
            ]);
        }

        $this->session->setFlash('success', $msg);
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship');
    }

    private function isAjaxOrJson(Request $request): bool
    {
        return str_contains((string)$request->header('Accept', ''), 'application/json')
            || (bool)$request->input('ajax', false)
            || ($request->header('X-Requested-With') === 'XMLHttpRequest');
    }

    private function parseCurrency(string|float|int|null $value): float
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            return (float)$value;
        }
        $str = trim((string)$value);
        $str = str_replace(['R$', '$', ' '], '', $str);

        if (str_contains($str, ',')) {
            // Formato brasileiro: 1.234,56 -> remove pontos, substitui vírgula por ponto
            $str = str_replace('.', '', $str);
            $str = str_replace(',', '.', $str);
        }

        return (float)$str;
    }

    public function runDailyCycle(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Token CSRF inválido']), 403, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash('Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.', 'error');
            return new Response('', 302, ['Location' => $baseUrl . '/admin/dropship']);
        }

        try {
            $itemsPerCategory = max(1, min(10, (int)$request->input('items_per_category', 3)));
            $result = $this->miningService->runDailyAutomatedRotation($itemsPerCategory);
            $cycleInfo = $this->miningService->getDailyCycleInfo();

            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode([
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => "Ciclo diário 24h finalizado com sucesso! Total minerado: {$result['total_mined']} produtos.",
                    'result'  => $result,
                    'cycle'   => $cycleInfo,
                ]), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }

            $this->session->setFlash("Ciclo diário 24h concluído com sucesso! {$result['total_mined']} novos produtos minerados nas 9 categorias oficiais.", 'success');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->isAjaxOrJson($request)) {
                return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
            }
            $this->session->setFlash("Falha ao executar ciclo diário: " . $e->getMessage(), 'error');
        }

        return new Response('', 302, ['Location' => $baseUrl . '/admin/dropship']);
    }

    /**
     * Gestão Administrativa de Clientes Cadastrados (semelhante a Alunos & Matrículas do Academy).
     */
    public function customers(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $search = trim((string)$request->input('q', ''));
        $status = trim((string)$request->input('status', 'all'));
        $page = max(1, (int)$request->input('page', 1));
        $perPage = 15;

        $customers = [];
        $total = 0;
        $metrics = [
            'total_customers'     => 0,
            'active_customers'    => 0,
            'suspended_customers' => 0,
            'linked_orders'       => 0,
        ];

        if ($this->customerRepo !== null) {
            if (method_exists($this->customerRepo, 'listCustomers')) {
                $res = $this->customerRepo->listCustomers(
                    $page,
                    $perPage,
                    $search !== '' ? $search : null,
                    $status !== 'all' ? $status : null
                );
                $customers = $res['items'] ?? [];
                $total = (int)($res['total'] ?? count($customers));
            } else {
                $customers = $this->customerRepo->listAll($perPage, ($page - 1) * $perPage);
                $total = count($customers);
            }

            if (method_exists($this->customerRepo, 'getCustomerMetrics')) {
                $metrics = $this->customerRepo->getCustomerMetrics();
            }
        }

        $totalPages = max(1, (int)ceil($total / $perPage));
        $csrfToken = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        $flash = $this->session->getFlash();
        $currentSearch = $search;
        $currentStatus = $status;
        $recentDisputes = ($this->disputeRepo !== null && method_exists($this->disputeRepo, 'listRecent'))
            ? $this->disputeRepo->listRecent(30)
            : [];

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/admin/customers.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return new ViewResponse($content, true);
    }

    /**
     * Ativa ou suspende a conta de um cliente cadastrado no DomainDrop.
     */
    public function updateCustomerStatus(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        if (!$this->verifyCsrf($request)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Token de segurança expirado. Tente novamente.');
            return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/customers');
        }

        $customerId = (int)$id;
        $newStatus = trim((string)$request->input('status', 'active'));
        if (!in_array($newStatus, ['active', 'suspended', 'blocked'], true)) {
            $newStatus = 'active';
        }

        if ($this->customerRepo !== null && method_exists($this->customerRepo, 'updateStatus')) {
            $this->customerRepo->updateStatus($customerId, $newStatus);
            $label = $newStatus === 'active' ? 'ativado' : 'suspenso';
            $this->session->setFlash('success', "Status do cliente #{$customerId} atualizado ({$label}).");
        } else {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Repositório de clientes não disponível.');
        }

        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/dropship/customers');
    }

    private function verifyCsrf(Request $request): bool
    {
        $token = (string)$request->input('csrf_token', (string)$request->input('_csrf', (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '')));
        $expected = (string)$this->session->getCsrfToken();
        return $token !== '' && hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    private function loadConfig(): array
    {
        if (file_exists($this->configFile)) {
            $json = @file_get_contents($this->configFile);
            if ($json !== false) {
                return json_decode($json, true) ?: [];
            }
        }
        return [
            'app_key' => '558628',
            'app_secret' => '',
            'default_markup_percent' => 100.0,
            'min_profit_margin_brl' => 30.0,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers\DropshipFrontController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMiningServiceInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Controlador Público da Loja Virtual de Dropshipping (SRP / DIP).
 */
class DropshipFrontController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $catalogRepo,
        private readonly ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        private readonly ?ProductMiningServiceInterface $miningService = null,
        private readonly ?DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface $orderRepo = null,
        private readonly ?AliExpressApiClientInterface $apiClient = null
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Vitrine Completa da Loja: GET /loja
     */
    public function storefront(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $selectedCategory = trim((string)$request->input('cat', ''));
        $search = trim((string)$request->input('q', ''));

        // Metadados do Ciclo Diário de 24 Horas (somente leitura na vitrine; execução via CLI dropship:cycle ou Admin)
        $cycleInfo = $this->miningService ? $this->miningService->getDailyCycleInfo() : [
            'formatted_remaining' => '24:00:00',
            'seconds_remaining'   => 86400,
            'is_due'              => false,
            'auto_sync_enabled'   => true,
        ];

        $sort = trim((string)$request->input('sort', ''));

        $criteria = ['status' => 'published'];
        if ($selectedCategory !== '') {
            $criteria['category'] = $selectedCategory;
        }
        if ($search !== '') {
            $criteria['search'] = $search;
        }
        if ($sort !== '') {
            $criteria['sort'] = $sort;
        }

        $products = $this->catalogRepo->list($criteria, 48, 0);
        $totalCount = $this->catalogRepo->count($criteria);

        // Se uma busca com categoria restrita não encontrou nada, expande para busca global na loja
        if ($totalCount === 0 && $selectedCategory !== '' && $search !== '') {
            $fallbackCriteria = $criteria;
            unset($fallbackCriteria['category']);
            $fallbackProducts = $this->catalogRepo->list($fallbackCriteria, 48, 0);
            if (!empty($fallbackProducts)) {
                $products = $fallbackProducts;
                $totalCount = $this->catalogRepo->count($fallbackCriteria);
                $selectedCategory = ''; // Expande visualmente para exibir o resultado global
            }
        }

        $categories = $this->catalogRepo->getCategories();

        // Resposta ultra-rápida de AJAX para o Palco Dinâmico (Sem recarregar página nem pular para cima!)
        if ($request->input('ajax') === '1' || $request->header('X-Requested-With') === 'XMLHttpRequest') {
            ob_start();
            include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/front/stage.php';
            $stageHtml = ob_get_clean();

            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success'          => true,
                'totalCount'       => $totalCount,
                'count'            => count($products),
                'selectedCategory' => $selectedCategory,
                'search'           => $search,
                'sort'             => $sort,
                'html'             => $stageHtml ?: '',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/front/storefront.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return $this->wrapWithThemeOrRaw($content, 'Loja Oficial - Produtos Selecionados');
    }

    /**
     * Página Dedicada do Produto: GET /produto/{slug}
     */
    public function singleProduct(Request $request, string $slug): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        // Tenta buscar por ID numérico ou pelo slug amigável do produto
        $product = null;
        if (is_numeric($slug)) {
            $product = $this->catalogRepo->findById((int)$slug);
        } else {
            $product = $this->catalogRepo->findBySlug($slug);
        }

        if (!$product) {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Produto não encontrado na loja</h1>", 404);
        }

        $checkoutUrl = $baseUrl . '/checkout/produto/' . (int)$product->id;

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/front/product.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return $this->wrapWithThemeOrRaw($content, $product->title . ' - Loja Oficial');
    }

    /**
     * Rastreamento Público de Pedidos: GET /rastrear
     */
    public function trackOrder(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $searchCode = trim((string)($request->input('codigo', '') ?: $request->input('q', '')));
        $matchedOrders = [];
        $trackingCodeToInspect = '';
        $aliExpressOrderId = '';
        $sdkEvents = [];
        $sdkOfficialUrl = '';

        if ($searchCode !== '' && $this->orderRepo !== null) {
            $exact = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($searchCode);
            if ($exact !== null) {
                $matchedOrders[] = $exact;
            } else {
                $matchedOrders = $this->orderRepo->list(['search' => $searchCode], 10, 0);
            }

            foreach ($matchedOrders as &$ord) {
                if (!empty($ord['customer_email'])) {
                    $ord['customer_email_masked'] = $this->maskEmail((string)$ord['customer_email']);
                }
                if ($trackingCodeToInspect === '' && !empty($ord['tracking_code'])) {
                    $trackingCodeToInspect = trim((string)$ord['tracking_code']);
                    $aliExpressOrderId = trim((string)($ord['aliexpress_order_id'] ?? ''));
                }
            }
            unset($ord);
        }

        // Se o visitante digitou diretamente um código de objeto (ex: BR123456789CN ou NM123456789BR)
        if ($trackingCodeToInspect === '' && $searchCode !== '' && !str_contains($searchCode, '@')) {
            if (preg_match('/^[A-Z]{2}\d{8,12}[A-Z]{2}$/i', $searchCode) || str_starts_with(strtoupper($searchCode), 'LP') || str_starts_with(strtoupper($searchCode), 'CN')) {
                $trackingCodeToInspect = strtoupper($searchCode);
            }
        }

        if ($trackingCodeToInspect !== '' && $this->apiClient !== null) {
            try {
                $serviceName = preg_match('/BR$/i', $trackingCodeToInspect) ? 'CORREIOS' : 'CAINIAO';
                $sdkRes = $this->apiClient->queryTrackingInfo(
                    logisticsNo: $trackingCodeToInspect,
                    origin: 'ESCROW',
                    outRef: $aliExpressOrderId,
                    serviceName: $serviceName,
                    toArea: 'BR'
                );
                if (!empty($sdkRes['details']) && is_array($sdkRes['details'])) {
                    $sdkEvents = $sdkRes['details'];
                }
                if (!empty($sdkRes['official_website'])) {
                    $sdkOfficialUrl = (string)$sdkRes['official_website'];
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Silencioso: fallback para links oficiais Correios/Cainiao e linha do tempo do pedido
            }
        }

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/front/track_order.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return $this->wrapWithThemeOrRaw($content, 'Rastrear Meu Pedido - RachidD.com');
    }

    /**
     * Página Oficial de Política de Envio & Prazos: GET /politica-de-envio
     */
    public function shippingPolicy(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/front/shipping_policy.php';
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return $this->wrapWithThemeOrRaw($content, 'Política de Envio & Prazos - RachidD.com');
    }

    private function wrapWithThemeOrRaw(string $content, string $title): ResponseInterface
    {
        $headers = [
            'Cache-Control' => 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0',
            'Pragma'        => 'no-cache',
            'Expires'       => 'Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT',
            'Vary'          => 'Cookie, Accept-Encoding',
        ];

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            try {
                $wrapped = $this->themeManager->render('page', [
                    'title'   => $title,
                    'content' => $content,
                ]);
                return new Response($wrapped, 200, $headers);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Fallback para SeoMiddleware ou entrega direta
            }
        }

        return new Response($content ?: '', 200, $headers);
    }

    private function maskEmail(string $email): string
    {
        $parts = explode('@', trim($email));
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return '';
        }
        $local = $parts[0];
        $visible = mb_substr($local, 0, min(2, mb_strlen($local)));
        return $visible . '***@' . $parts[1];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO;

/**
 * DTO Imutável com a representação canônica de um produto minerado do Dropshipping.
 */
final class DropshipProductDto
{
    /**
     * @param array<int, string> $images Lista de URLs de imagens do produto
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes Especificações técnicas e variações
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $aliexpressId,
        public readonly string $title,
        public readonly string $slug,
        public readonly float $costPriceUsd,
        public readonly float $salePriceBrl,
        public readonly string $mainImageUrl,
        public readonly array $images = [],
        public readonly string $category = 'Geral',
        public readonly string $description = '',
        public readonly float $rating = 4.8,
        public readonly int $ordersCount = 0,
        public readonly array $attributes = [],
        public readonly string $status = 'published',
        public readonly ?int $id = null
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Retorna identificação estruturada do vendedor / entreposto responsável por este produto.
     *
     * @return array{seller_id: string, store_name: string, warehouse: string, aliexpress_id: string}
     */
    public function getSellerInfo(): array
    {
        $cleanAe = preg_replace('/\W+/', '', $this->aliexpressId) ?: '';
        $codeSeed = $cleanAe !== '' ? substr($cleanAe, -6) : str_pad((string)($this->id ?? 0), 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $shortSeed = substr($codeSeed, -4);
        $isNational = !empty($this->attributes['origem_brasil'])
            || (($this->attributes['ship_from'] ?? '') === 'BR');

        $sellerId = trim((string)($this->attributes['seller_id'] ?? ($this->attributes['shop_id'] ?? '')));
        if ($sellerId === '') {
            $sellerId = 'VND-' . strtoupper($codeSeed);
        }

        $storeName = trim((string)($this->attributes['seller_name'] ?? ($this->attributes['store_name'] ?? '')));
        if ($storeName === '') {
            $storeName = $isNational
                ? 'Distribuidor Oficial BR #' . $shortSeed
                : 'Fornecedor Oficial Global #' . $shortSeed;
        }

        return [
            'seller_id'     => $sellerId,
            'store_name'    => $storeName,
            'warehouse'     => $isNational ? 'Entreposto Nacional (Brasil)' : 'Centro Internacional',
            'aliexpress_id' => $this->aliexpressId,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'id'               => $this->id,
            'aliexpress_id'    => $this->aliexpressId,
            'title'            => $this->title,
            'slug'             => $this->slug,
            'cost_price_usd'   => $this->costPriceUsd,
            'sale_price_brl'   => $this->salePriceBrl,
            'main_image_url'   => $this->mainImageUrl,
            'images'           => json_encode($this->images, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'category'         => $this->category,
            'description'      => $this->description,
            'rating'           => $this->rating,
            'orders_count'     => $this->ordersCount,
            'attributes'       => json_encode($this->attributes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'status'           => $this->status,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO;

use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * DTO Imutável com Garantia Contratual de Integridade de Mídia e Origem (Clean Architecture / Value Object).
 * 
 * Garante por invariante que:
 * 1. O produto possui um ID e URL de origem válidos.
 * 2. A imagem principal (mainImageUrl) é obrigatoriamente vinculada ao produto.
 * 3. Todas as imagens da galeria (galleryImages) pertencem à mesma origem do produto.
 */
final class ScrapedProductDto
{
    /**
     * @param array<int, string> $galleryImages
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $sourceId,
        public readonly string $sourceUrl,
        public readonly string $rawTitle,
        public readonly string $mainImageUrl,
        public readonly array $galleryImages = [],
        public readonly float $costPriceUsd = 10.0,
        public readonly string $category = 'Geral',
        public readonly float $rating = 4.8,
        public readonly int $ordersCount = 0,
        public readonly array $attributes = []
    ) {
        if (trim($this->sourceId) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O identificador de origem do produto (sourceId) não pode ser vazio.');
        }

        if (trim($this->mainImageUrl) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("A imagem principal do produto {$this->sourceId} não pode ser vazia.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a lista completa e normalizada de imagens (garantindo a principal na 1ª posição).
     * 
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getAllImages(): array
    {
        $all = [];
        if (!empty($this->mainImageUrl)) {
            $all[] = $this->mainImageUrl;
        }

        foreach ($this->galleryImages as $img) {
            $img = trim($img);
            if ($img !== '' && !in_array($img, $all, true)) {
                $all[] = $img;
            }
        }

        return $all;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'source_id'      => $this->sourceId,
            'source_url'     => $this->sourceUrl,
            'raw_title'      => $this->rawTitle,
            'main_image_url' => $this->mainImageUrl,
            'gallery_images' => $this->galleryImages,
            'cost_price_usd' => $this->costPriceUsd,
            'category'       => $this->category,
            'rating'         => $this->rating,
            'orders_count'   => $this->ordersCount,
            'attributes'     => $this->attributes,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\DomainDropSchemaEnsurer.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Garante de forma idempotente e segura que as tabelas do DomainDrop
 * (incluindo clientes, reclamações e colunas de SLA) existam mesmo antes
 * de uma execução manual do CLI bin/migrate.php.
 */
final class DomainDropSchemaEnsurer
{
    /** @var array<int, bool> */
    private static array $ensuredConnections = [];

    public static function ensure(PDO $pdo): void
    {
        $connId = spl_object_id($pdo);
        if (isset(self::$ensuredConnections[$connId])) {
            return;
        }
        self::$ensuredConnections[$connId] = true;

        if (self::schemaAlreadyPresent($pdo)) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $migrationsDir = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations';
            foreach ([
                '2026_11_10_000001_create_domain_drop_tables.php',
                '2026_11_12_000001_create_customer_disputes_and_mediation.php',
            ] as $file) {
                $path = $migrationsDir . '/' . $file;
                if (is_file($path)) {
                    $migration = require $path;
                    if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                        ($migration['up'])($pdo);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Não mascara erro real se o banco estiver indisponível; o caller tratará.
        }
    }

    private static function schemaAlreadyPresent(PDO $pdo): bool
    {
        try {
            $driver = (string)$pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            if ($driver === 'mysql') {
                $c1 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_customers'");
                $c2 = $pdo->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'domain_drop_disputes'");
                $cols = $pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM domain_drop_orders LIKE 'seller_origin'");
                return $c1 !== false && $c1->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $c2 !== false && $c2->fetchColumn() !== false
                    && $cols !== false && $cols->fetchColumn() !== false;
            }

            $c1 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_customers'");
            $c2 = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='domain_drop_disputes'");
            $cols = $pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(domain_drop_orders)");
            $colNames = $cols ? array_column($cols->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'name') : [];

            return $c1 !== false && $c1->fetchColumn() !== false
                && $c2 !== false && $c2->fetchColumn() !== false
                && in_array('seller_origin', $colNames, true);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories\PdoDropshipCatalogRepository.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para o Catálogo de Produtos Minerados do DomainDrop (DIP / SRP).
 */
class PdoDropshipCatalogRepository implements DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
    }

    public function save(DropshipProductDto $product): int
    {
        $existing = $this->findByAliExpressId($product->aliexpressId);
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $imagesJson = json_encode($product->images, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        $attrJson = json_encode($product->attributes, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        if ($existing !== null && $existing->id !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
                SET title = ?, slug = ?, cost_price_usd = ?, sale_price_brl = ?,
                    main_image_url = ?, images = ?, category = ?, description = ?,
                    rating = ?, orders_count = ?, attributes = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");

            $stmt->execute([
                $product->title,
                $product->slug,
                $product->costPriceUsd,
                $product->salePriceBrl,
                $product->mainImageUrl,
                $imagesJson,
                $product->category,
                $product->description,
                $product->rating,
                $product->ordersCount,
                $attrJson,
                $product->status,
                $now,
                $existing->id,
            ]);

            return $existing->id;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_catalog
                (aliexpress_id, title, slug, cost_price_usd, sale_price_brl, main_image_url, images, category, description, rating, orders_count, attributes, status, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $product->aliexpressId,
            $product->title,
            $product->slug,
            $product->costPriceUsd,
            $product->salePriceBrl,
            $product->mainImageUrl,
            $imagesJson,
            $product->category,
            $product->description,
            $product->rating,
            $product->ordersCount,
            $attrJson,
            $product->status,
            $now,
            $now,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function findByAliExpressId(string $aliexpressId): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE aliexpress_id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$aliexpressId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?DropshipProductDto
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE slug = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->hydrate($row) : null;
    }

    public function list(array $criteria = [], int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($criteria['category'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildCategoryClause((string)$criteria['category'], $params);
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['slug'])) {
            $where[] = "slug = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['slug'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['search'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildSearchClause((string)$criteria['search'], $params);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_catalog";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where);
        }

        $orderBy = "id DESC";
        if (!empty($criteria['sort'])) {
            $sortVal = (string)$criteria['sort'];
            if ($sortVal === 'sales' || $sortVal === 'best_sellers' || $sortVal === 'volume_desc') {
                $orderBy = "orders_count DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'updated_desc' || $sortVal === 'recent' || $sortVal === 'cycle') {
                $orderBy = "updated_at DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'price_asc') {
                $orderBy = "sale_price_brl ASC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'price_desc') {
                $orderBy = "sale_price_brl DESC, id DESC";
            } elseif ($sortVal === 'rating') {
                $orderBy = "rating DESC, id DESC";
            }
        }

        $sql .= " ORDER BY {$orderBy} LIMIT {$limit} OFFSET {$offset}";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'hydrate'], $rows);
    }

    public function count(array $criteria = []): int
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($criteria['category'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildCategoryClause((string)$criteria['category'], $params);
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['slug'])) {
            $where[] = "slug = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['slug'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = ?";
            $params[] = (string)$criteria['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($criteria['search'])) {
            $where[] = $this->buildSearchClause((string)$criteria['search'], $params);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_catalog";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    /**
     * Constrói cláusula SQL inteligente para busca textual tolerante a tokens, plural/singular,
     * remoção de preposições (stop words) e sinônimos frequentes de mercado.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    public function buildSearchClause(string $search, array &$params): string
    {
        $search = trim($search);
        if ($search === '') {
            return '1=1';
        }

        $stopWords = ['de', 'da', 'do', 'das', 'dos', 'em', 'na', 'no', 'nas', 'nos', 'com', 'por', 'para', 'pra', 'um', 'uma', 'uns', 'umas', 'e', 'ou', 'a', 'o', 'as', 'os', 'ao', 'aos', 'que', 'se'];

        // Separa em palavras/tokens limpos
        $rawTokens = preg_split('/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u', mb_strtolower($search, 'UTF-8'), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) ?: [];

        // Filtra stop words se sobrarem outros termos significativos
        $filtered = array_values(array_filter($rawTokens, fn($t) => !in_array($t, $stopWords, true)));
        $tokens = !empty($filtered) ? $filtered : $rawTokens;

        if (empty($tokens)) {
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            return "(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?)";
        }

        $tokenClauses = [];
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            $variants = [$token];

            // 1. Versão sem acentos
            $unaccented = preg_replace(
                ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u'],
                ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c'],
                $token
            );
            if ($unaccented !== $token) {
                $variants[] = $unaccented;
            }

            // 2. Singular / Plural inteligente em português
            if (mb_strlen($token, 'UTF-8') > 3 && str_ends_with($token, 's')) {
                $variants[] = mb_substr($token, 0, -1, 'UTF-8');
                if (str_ends_with($token, 'es')) {
                    $variants[] = mb_substr($token, 0, -2, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } elseif (mb_strlen($token, 'UTF-8') >= 3) {
                $variants[] = $token . 's';
            }

            // 3. Normalização das variantes geradas
            foreach ($variants as $v) {
                $unacc = preg_replace(
                    ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u'],
                    ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c'],
                    $v
                );
                if ($unacc !== $v) {
                    $variants[] = $unacc;
                }
            }

            // 4. Sinônimos de mercado comuns
            if (in_array($unaccented, ['relogio', 'relogios', 'smartwatch', 'smartwatches', 'watch'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'relogio';
                $variants[] = 'relógio';
                $variants[] = 'smartwatch';
                $variants[] = 'watch';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['fone', 'fones', 'ouvido', 'tws', 'headset'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'fone';
                $variants[] = 'tws';
                $variants[] = 'ouvido';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['lampada', 'lampadas', 'luminaria', 'luminarias'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'lampada';
                $variants[] = 'lâmpada';
                $variants[] = 'luminaria';
                $variants[] = 'luminária';
            } elseif (in_array($unaccented, ['secador', 'secadora', 'secadores', 'escova', 'escovas'], true)) {
                $variants[] = 'secador';
                $variants[] = 'secadora';
                $variants[] = 'escova';
            }

            $variants = array_unique(array_filter($variants, fn($v) => mb_strlen($v, 'UTF-8') >= 2));

            $subClauses = [];
            foreach ($variants as $v) {
                $subClauses[] = "(title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ? OR category LIKE ?)";
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
                $params[] = '%' . $v . '%';
            }

            $tokenClauses[] = '(' . implode(' OR ', $subClauses) . ')';
        }

        return '(' . implode(' AND ', $tokenClauses) . ')';
    }

    /**
     * Constrói cláusula SQL inteligente para categoria com tolerância a apelidos e termos semânticos.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $params
     */
    private function buildCategoryClause(string $category, array &$params): string
    {
        $raw = trim($category);
        $lower = mb_strtolower($raw, 'UTF-8');

        return match ($lower) {
            'tecnologia', 'tecnologia & gadgets', 'gadgets', 'eletrônicos', 'eletrônicos & gadget', 'eletronicos', 'eletronicos & gadget' =>
                "(category IN ('Tecnologia & Gadgets', 'Eletrônicos & Gadget', 'Eletrônicos') OR category LIKE '%Tecnologia%' OR category LIKE '%Eletrônicos%' OR category LIKE '%Eletronicos%' OR category LIKE '%Gadget%')",

            'smartwatches', 'smartwatch', 'smartwatches & pulseiras', 'pulseiras' =>
                "(category IN ('Smartwatches', 'Smartwatches & Pulseiras') OR category LIKE '%Smartwatch%' OR title LIKE '%Smartwatch%' OR title LIKE '%Relógio%' OR title LIKE '%Relogio%' OR title LIKE '%Apple Watch%' OR title LIKE '%Pulseira%')",

            'áudio', 'audio', 'fones', 'fones bluetooth tws', 'fones tws' =>
                "(category IN ('Áudio', 'Audio', 'Fones Bluetooth TWS') OR category LIKE '%Áudio%' OR category LIKE '%Audio%' OR title LIKE 'Fone%' OR title LIKE '% Fone%' OR title LIKE '%Tws%' OR title LIKE '%Earphone%' OR title LIKE '%Headphone%' OR title LIKE '%Microfone%')",

            'smartwatches & áudio', 'smartwatches & audio' =>
                "(category IN ('Smartwatches & Áudio', 'Smartwatches & Audio') OR category LIKE '%Smartwatch%' OR category LIKE '%Áudio%' OR category LIKE '%Audio%' OR title LIKE '%Smartwatch%' OR title LIKE '%Relógio%' OR title LIKE '%Watch%' OR title LIKE '%Fone%' OR title LIKE '%Tws%')",

            'casa', 'casa inteligente', 'casa inteligente & organização', 'casa inteligente & organizacao', 'casa & organização', 'casa & organização inteligente', 'casa & organizacao inteligente' =>
                "(category IN ('Casa Inteligente', 'Casa Inteligente & Organização') OR category LIKE '%Casa%')",

            'celular', 'acessórios para celular', 'acessorios para celular', 'smartphone', 'smartphones' =>
                "(category IN ('Acessórios para Celular') OR title LIKE '%Celular%' OR title LIKE '%Smartphone%' OR title LIKE '%Reparo Do Telefone%' OR title LIKE '%iPhone%' OR title LIKE '%Usb-C%' OR title LIKE '%Lightning%' OR title LIKE '%Carregador%' OR title LIKE '%Capinha%' OR title LIKE '%MagSafe%')",

            'acessorios', 'acessórios', 'acessórios virais', 'acessorios virais', 'ferramentas', 'ferramentas & utilidades' =>
                "(category IN ('Acessórios Virais', 'Ferramentas & Utilidades', 'Acessórios para Veículos') OR category LIKE '%Acessório%' OR category LIKE '%Acessorio%' OR category LIKE '%Ferramenta%')",

            'beleza', 'saúde', 'saude', 'saúde & cuidados', 'saude & cuidados', 'beleza, cuidados & estilo', 'estilo' =>
                "(category IN ('Saúde & Cuidados', 'Beleza, Cuidados & Estilo') OR category LIKE '%Beleza%' OR category LIKE '%Saúde%' OR category LIKE '%Saude%' OR category LIKE '%Cuidado%')",

            'moda', 'roupas', 'vestuário', 'vestuario', 'moda, roupas & vestuário', 'moda, roupas & vestuario', 'moda & vestuário' =>
                "(category IN ('Moda, Roupas & Vestuário', 'Roupas', 'Vestuário') OR category LIKE '%Moda%' OR category LIKE '%Roupa%' OR category LIKE '%Vestuário%' OR category LIKE '%Vestuario%')",

            'lingerie', 'lingeries', 'moda íntima', 'moda intima', 'moda íntima, lingeries & pijamas', 'moda intima, lingeries & pijamas', 'pijamas' =>
                "(category IN ('Moda Íntima, Lingeries & Pijamas', 'Lingeries') OR category LIKE '%Lingerie%' OR category LIKE '%Íntima%' OR category LIKE '%Intima%')",

            'sex shop', 'sexshop', 'adulto', 'adultos', 'produtos adultos', 'sex shop & produtos adultos (+18)', '+18' =>
                "(category IN ('Sex Shop & Produtos Adultos (+18)', 'Sex Shop') OR category LIKE '%Sex Shop%' OR category LIKE '%Adulto%' OR category LIKE '%+18%')",

            'pets', 'pet shop', 'pet shop & pets virais' =>
                "(category IN ('Pet Shop & Pets Virais', 'Pet Shop') OR category LIKE '%Pet%')",

            'veiculos', 'veículos', 'acessórios para veículos', 'acessorios para veiculos', 'automotivo' =>
                "(category IN ('Acessórios para Veículos') OR category LIKE '%Veículo%' OR category LIKE '%Veiculo%' OR category LIKE '%Auto%')",

            default => (function() use ($raw, &$params) {
                $params[] = $raw;
                $params[] = '%' . $raw . '%';
                return "(category = ? OR category LIKE ?)";
            })()
        };
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function updatePrice(int $id, float $salePriceBrl, ?float $costPriceUsd = null): bool
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        if ($costPriceUsd !== null && $costPriceUsd >= 0) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
                SET sale_price_brl = ?, cost_price_usd = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            return $stmt->execute([$salePriceBrl, $costPriceUsd, $now, $id]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_catalog
            SET sale_price_brl = ?, updated_at = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$salePriceBrl, $now, $id]);
    }

    public function getCategories(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT DISTINCT category FROM domain_drop_catalog WHERE category != '' ORDER BY category ASC");
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN) : [];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     */
    private function hydrate(array $row): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $images = [];
        if (!empty($row['images'])) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['images'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $images = $decoded;
            }
        }

        $attributes = [];
        if (!empty($row['attributes'])) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['attributes'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $attributes = $decoded;
            }
        }

        return new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: (string)$row['aliexpress_id'],
            title: (string)$row['title'],
            slug: (string)$row['slug'],
            costPriceUsd: (float)($row['cost_price_usd'] ?? 0.0),
            salePriceBrl: (float)($row['sale_price_brl'] ?? 0.0),
            mainImageUrl: (string)$row['main_image_url'],
            images: $images,
            category: (string)($row['category'] ?? 'Geral'),
            description: (string)($row['description'] ?? ''),
            rating: (float)($row['rating'] ?? 4.8),
            ordersCount: (int)($row['orders_count'] ?? 0),
            attributes: $attributes,
            status: (string)($row['status'] ?? 'published'),
            id: (int)$row['id']
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para clientes cadastrados na vitrine RachidD.com / DomainDrop.
 */
class PdoDropshipCustomerRepository implements DropshipCustomerRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $email = strtolower(trim((string)($data['email'] ?? '')));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_customers (
                name, email, cpf, phone, password_hash, status, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :name, :email, :cpf, :phone, :password_hash, :status, :created_at, :updated_at
            )
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            ':name'          => trim((string)($data['name'] ?? '')),
            ':email'         => $email,
            ':cpf'           => isset($data['cpf']) && trim((string)$data['cpf']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['cpf']) : null,
            ':phone'         => isset($data['phone']) && trim((string)$data['phone']) !== '' ? trim((string)$data['phone']) : null,
            ':password_hash' => (string)($data['password_hash'] ?? ''),
            ':status'        => (string)($data['status'] ?? 'active'),
            ':created_at'    => (string)($data['created_at'] ?? $now),
            ':updated_at'    => (string)($data['updated_at'] ?? $now),
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_customers WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_customers WHERE LOWER(email) = :email LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':email' => strtolower(trim($email))]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function listAll(int $limit = 100, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_customers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT " . max(1, (int)$limit) . " OFFSET " . max(0, (int)$offset)
        );
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function listCustomers(int $page = 1, int $perPage = 15, ?string $search = null, ?string $status = null): array
    {
        $page = max(1, $page);
        $perPage = max(1, min(100, $perPage));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if ($status !== null && $status !== '' && $status !== 'all') {
            $where[] = 'c.status = :status';
            $params[':status'] = $status;
        }

        if ($search !== null && trim($search) !== '') {
            $q = '%' . strtolower(trim($search)) . '%';
            $where[] = '(LOWER(c.name) LIKE :q1 OR LOWER(c.email) LIKE :q2 OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.cpf, \'\')) LIKE :q3 OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.phone, \'\')) LIKE :q4)';
            $params[':q1'] = $q;
            $params[':q2'] = $q;
            $params[':q3'] = $q;
            $params[':q4'] = $q;
        }

        $whereSql = !empty($where) ? ('WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where)) : '';

        $countStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_customers c {$whereSql}");
        $countStmt->execute($params);
        $total = (int)$countStmt->fetchColumn();

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                c.*,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_orders o WHERE LOWER(o.customer_email) = LOWER(c.email)) AS orders_count,
                (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_paid_brl), 0) FROM domain_drop_orders o WHERE LOWER(o.customer_email) = LOWER(c.email)) AS total_spent_brl,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_disputes d WHERE LOWER(d.customer_email) = LOWER(c.email)) AS disputes_count
            FROM domain_drop_customers c
            {$whereSql}
            ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT {$perPage} OFFSET {$offset}
        ";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $items = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return [
            'items' => $items,
            'total' => $total,
        ];
    }

    public function getCustomerMetrics(): array
    {
        $total = (int)$this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_customers")->fetchColumn();
        $active = (int)$this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_customers WHERE status = 'active'")->fetchColumn();
        $suspended = max(0, $total - $active);
        $linkedOrders = (int)$this->pdo->query("
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_drop_orders o
            WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM domain_drop_customers c WHERE LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(o.customer_email))
        ")->fetchColumn();

        return [
            'total_customers'     => $total,
            'active_customers'    => $active,
            'suspended_customers' => $suspended,
            'linked_orders'       => $linkedOrders,
        ];
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $allowed = ['active', 'suspended', 'blocked'];
        $normalized = in_array($status, $allowed, true) ? $status : 'active';

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_customers
            SET status = :status, updated_at = :updated_at
            WHERE id = :id
        ");

        return $stmt->execute([
            ':status'     => $normalized,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ':id'         => $id,
        ]);
    }
}
