<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para reclamações e intermediações com fornecedores.
 */
class PdoDropshipDisputeRepository implements DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $attachments = $data['attachments_json'] ?? [];
        if (is_array($attachments)) {
            $attachmentsJson = json_encode(array_values($attachments), JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '[]';
        } else {
            $attachmentsJson = (string)$attachments;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO domain_drop_disputes (
                order_ref, customer_id, customer_email, reason, description,
                attachments_json, seller_origin, seller_name, seller_email,
                seller_language, translated_message, mediation_status,
                mediation_channel, mediation_sent_at, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :order_ref, :customer_id, :customer_email, :reason, :description,
                :attachments_json, :seller_origin, :seller_name, :seller_email,
                :seller_language, :translated_message, :mediation_status,
                :mediation_channel, :mediation_sent_at, :created_at, :updated_at
            )
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            ':order_ref'          => (string)($data['order_ref'] ?? ''),
            ':customer_id'        => isset($data['customer_id']) ? (int)$data['customer_id'] : null,
            ':customer_email'     => strtolower(trim((string)($data['customer_email'] ?? ''))),
            ':reason'             => (string)($data['reason'] ?? 'produto_danificado'),
            ':description'        => trim((string)($data['description'] ?? '')),
            ':attachments_json'   => $attachmentsJson,
            ':seller_origin'      => strtoupper((string)($data['seller_origin'] ?? 'CN')),
            ':seller_name'        => isset($data['seller_name']) ? (string)$data['seller_name'] : null,
            ':seller_email'       => isset($data['seller_email']) ? (string)$data['seller_email'] : null,
            ':seller_language'    => isset($data['seller_language']) ? (string)$data['seller_language'] : null,
            ':translated_message' => isset($data['translated_message']) ? (string)$data['translated_message'] : null,
            ':mediation_status'   => (string)($data['mediation_status'] ?? 'open'),
            ':mediation_channel'  => isset($data['mediation_channel']) ? (string)$data['mediation_channel'] : null,
            ':mediation_sent_at'  => isset($data['mediation_sent_at']) ? (string)$data['mediation_sent_at'] : null,
            ':created_at'         => (string)($data['created_at'] ?? $now),
            ':updated_at'         => (string)($data['updated_at'] ?? $now),
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $this->decodeRow($row) : null;
    }

    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE order_ref = :ref ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([':ref' => $orderRef]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'decodeRow'], $rows);
    }

    public function findByCustomerEmail(string $email): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE LOWER(customer_email) = :email ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([':email' => strtolower(trim($email))]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        return array_map([$this, 'decodeRow'], $rows);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function listRecent(int $limit = 30): array
    {
        $lim = max(1, min(100, $limit));
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT {$lim}");
        $rows = $stmt !== false ? ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: []) : [];

        return array_map([$this, 'decodeRow'], $rows);
    }

    public function mapByOrderRefs(array $orderRefs): array
    {
        $refs = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('strval', $orderRefs))));
        if ($refs === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $placeholders = implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($refs), '?'));
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_disputes WHERE order_ref IN ($placeholders) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC");
        $stmt->execute($refs);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];

        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $decoded = $this->decodeRow($row);
            $ref = (string)($decoded['order_ref'] ?? '');
            if ($ref !== '') {
                $grouped[$ref][] = $decoded;
            }
        }

        return $grouped;
    }

    public function markMediationSent(
        int $disputeId,
        string $sellerLanguage,
        string $translatedMessage,
        string $channel = 'email'
    ): bool {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE domain_drop_disputes
            SET seller_language = :lang,
                translated_message = :msg,
                mediation_status = 'sent',
                mediation_channel = :channel,
                mediation_sent_at = :sent_at,
                updated_at = :updated_at
            WHERE id = :id
        ");

        return $stmt->execute([
            ':lang'       => $sellerLanguage,
            ':msg'        => $translatedMessage,
            ':channel'    => $channel,
            ':sent_at'    => $now,
            ':updated_at' => $now,
            ':id'         => $disputeId,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function decodeRow(array $row): array
    {
        $raw = (string)($row['attachments_json'] ?? '[]');
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
        $row['attachments'] = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];

        return $row;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para Ordens de Dropshipping (SRP / DIP).
 */
class PdoDropshipOrderRepository implements DropshipOrderRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    /** @var array<int, string>|null */
    private ?array $tableColumns = null;

    public function __construct(PDO|DatabaseConnectionInterface $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
        DomainDropSchemaEnsurer::ensure($this->pdo);
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $createdAt = (string)($data['created_at'] ?? $now);
        $updatedAt = (string)($data['updated_at'] ?? $createdAt);

        $columns = [
            'order_ref',
            'customer_name',
            'customer_email',
            'customer_document',
            'shipping_address',
            'aliexpress_order_id',
            'tracking_code',
            'status',
            'total_paid_brl',
            'created_at',
            'updated_at',
        ];

        $params = [
            ':order_ref'           => (string)($data['order_ref'] ?? uniqid('ORD_DROP_')),
            ':customer_name'       => (string)($data['customer_name'] ?? 'Cliente'),
            ':customer_email'      => strtolower(trim((string)($data['customer_email'] ?? ''))),
            ':customer_document'   => isset($data['customer_document']) ? (string)$data['customer_document'] : null,
            ':shipping_address'    => isset($data['shipping_address'])
                ? (is_array($data['shipping_address']) ? json_encode($data['shipping_address'], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) : (string)$data['shipping_address'])
                : null,
            ':aliexpress_order_id' => isset($data['aliexpress_order_id']) ? (string)$data['aliexpress_order_id'] : null,
            ':tracking_code'       => isset($data['tracking_code']) ? (string)$data['tracking_code'] : null,
            ':status'              => (string)($data['status'] ?? 'pending'),
            ':total_paid_brl'      => (float)($data['total_paid_brl'] ?? 0.0),
            ':created_at'          => $createdAt,
            ':updated_at'          => $updatedAt,
        ];

        $optionalMap = [
            'seller_origin'          => strtoupper((string)($data['seller_origin'] ?? 'BR')),
            'seller_name'            => isset($data['seller_name']) ? (string)$data['seller_name'] : null,
            'seller_email'           => isset($data['seller_email']) ? (string)$data['seller_email'] : null,
            'expected_delivery_days' => isset($data['expected_delivery_days']) ? max(1, (int)$data['expected_delivery_days']) : 7,
            'sdk_delivered_at'       => isset($data['sdk_delivered_at']) ? (string)$data['sdk_delivered_at'] : null,
            'sdk_tracking_summary'   => isset($data['sdk_tracking_summary']) ? (string)$data['sdk_tracking_summary'] : null,
            'product_slug'           => isset($data['product_slug']) ? (string)$data['product_slug'] : null,
            'product_title'          => isset($data['product_title']) ? (string)$data['product_title'] : null,
            'aliexpress_product_id'  => isset($data['aliexpress_product_id']) ? (string)$data['aliexpress_product_id'] : null,
        ];

        $existingCols = $this->getTableColumns();
        foreach ($optionalMap as $col => $val) {
            if (in_array($col, $existingCols, true)) {
                $columns[] = $col;
                $params[':' . $col] = $val;
            }
        }

        $placeholders = array_map(static fn (string $c): string => ':' . $c, $columns);
        $sql = 'INSERT INTO domain_drop_orders (' . implode(', ', $columns) . ') VALUES (' . implode(', ', $placeholders) . ')';

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findByOrderRef(string $orderRef): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders WHERE order_ref = :ref LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([':ref' => $orderRef]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function findByCustomerEmail(string $email, int $limit = 50): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders WHERE LOWER(customer_email) = :email ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT " . max(1, (int)$limit)
        );
        $stmt->execute([':email' => strtolower(trim($email))]);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function updateFulfillment(string $orderRef, string $status, ?string $aliExpressOrderId = null, ?string $trackingCode = null): bool
    {
        $fields = ['status = :status', 'updated_at = :updated_at'];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':status'     => $status,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if ($aliExpressOrderId !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'aliexpress_order_id = :ae_id';
            $params[':ae_id'] = $aliExpressOrderId;
        }

        if ($trackingCode !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'tracking_code = :track';
            $params[':track'] = $trackingCode;
        }

        if ($status === 'delivered' && in_array('sdk_delivered_at', $this->getTableColumns(), true)) {
            $fields[] = 'sdk_delivered_at = COALESCE(sdk_delivered_at, :delivered_at)';
            $params[':delivered_at'] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function updateSellerAndSla(
        string $orderRef,
        string $sellerOrigin,
        int $expectedDays,
        ?string $sellerName = null,
        ?string $sellerEmail = null
    ): bool {
        $existingCols = $this->getTableColumns();
        if (!in_array('seller_origin', $existingCols, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $fields = [
            'seller_origin = :origin',
            'expected_delivery_days = :days',
            'updated_at = :updated_at',
        ];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':origin'     => strtoupper($sellerOrigin) === 'CN' ? 'CN' : 'BR',
            ':days'       => max(1, min(90, $expectedDays)),
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if ($sellerName !== null && in_array('seller_name', $existingCols, true)) {
            $fields[] = 'seller_name = :sname';
            $params[':sname'] = $sellerName;
        }
        if ($sellerEmail !== null && in_array('seller_email', $existingCols, true)) {
            $fields[] = 'seller_email = :semail';
            $params[':semail'] = $sellerEmail;
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function updateSdkTracking(
        string $orderRef,
        ?string $sdkDeliveredAt,
        ?string $summaryJson,
        ?string $newStatus = null
    ): bool {
        $existingCols = $this->getTableColumns();
        $fields = ['updated_at = :updated_at'];
        $params = [
            ':ref'        => $orderRef,
            ':updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ];

        if (in_array('sdk_delivered_at', $existingCols, true) && $sdkDeliveredAt !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'sdk_delivered_at = :delivered_at';
            $params[':delivered_at'] = $sdkDeliveredAt;
        }
        if (in_array('sdk_tracking_summary', $existingCols, true) && $summaryJson !== null) {
            $fields[] = 'sdk_tracking_summary = :summary';
            $params[':summary'] = $summaryJson;
        }
        if ($newStatus !== null && $newStatus !== '') {
            $fields[] = 'status = :status';
            $params[':status'] = $newStatus;
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE domain_drop_orders SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE order_ref = :ref";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function list(array $filters = [], int $limit = 50, int $offset = 0): array
    {
        $where = [];
        $params = [];

        if (!empty($filters['status'])) {
            $where[] = "status = :st";
            $params[':st'] = (string)$filters['status'];
        }

        if (!empty($filters['search'])) {
            $term = '%' . (string)$filters['search'] . '%';
            $where[] = "(order_ref LIKE :q1 OR customer_name LIKE :q2 OR customer_email LIKE :q3 OR tracking_code LIKE :q4)";
            $params[':q1'] = $term;
            $params[':q2'] = $term;
            $params[':q3'] = $term;
            $params[':q4'] = $term;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM domain_drop_orders";
        if (!empty($where)) {
            $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(' AND ', $where);
        }
        $sql .= " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT " . (int)$limit . " OFFSET " . (int)$offset;

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function getTableColumns(): array
    {
        if ($this->tableColumns !== null) {
            return $this->tableColumns;
        }

        try {
            $driver = (string)$this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            if ($driver === 'mysql') {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM domain_drop_orders");
                $this->tableColumns = $stmt ? array_column($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'Field') : [];
            } else {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(domain_drop_orders)");
                $this->tableColumns = $stmt ? array_column($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC), 'name') : [];
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->tableColumns = [];
        }

        return $this->tableColumns;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AiProductEnricherService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AiProductEnricherInterface;

/**
 * Motor de Higienização de Títulos e Copywriting de Produtos (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Transforma os textos poluídos e genéricos do AliExpress em páginas de produtos
 * profissionais, com títulos concisos e descrições orientadas à conversão (AIDA).
 */
class AiProductEnricherService implements AiProductEnricherInterface
{
    /**
     * Palavras e termos de spam frequentemente encontrados em anúncios brutos da China.
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    private array $spamKeywords = [
        '2024', '2025', '2026', 'novo', 'nova', 'novos', 'novas',
        'quente', 'venda', 'promoção', 'barato', 'frete grátis',
        'alta qualidade', 'top', 'luxo', 'moda', 'marca', 'original',
        'atacado', 'china', 'direto da fábrica', 'melhor preço', 'aliexpress',
        'hot sale', 'new', 'luxury', 'free shipping', 'drop shipping', 'dropshipping', 'dropship',
    ];

    public function polishTitle(string $rawTitle, ?string $category = null): string
    {
        $clean = trim($rawTitle);

        // 1. Remove termos de spam comuns
        foreach ($this->spamKeywords as $spam) {
            $pattern = '/\b' . preg_quote($spam, '/') . '\b/iu';
            $clean = (string)preg_replace($pattern, '', $clean);
        }

        // 2. Remove caracteres estranhos repetidos (ex: |||, ***, ---, [ ])
        $clean = (string)preg_replace('/[\[\]\|\*\#\_]+/', ' ', $clean);
        $clean = (string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $clean);
        $clean = trim($clean, " -.,:;\t\n\r\0\x0B");

        // 3. Limita o tamanho do título para 65-80 caracteres (ideal para SEO e e-commerce)
        $words = explode(' ', $clean);
        if (count($words) > 10) {
            $words = array_slice($words, 0, 10);
            $clean = implode(' ', $words);
        }

        // 4. Formata com inicial maiúscula elegante
        $clean = mb_convert_case($clean, MB_CASE_TITLE, 'UTF-8');

        if ($clean === '' && $category !== null) {
            return "Produto Premium - {$category}";
        }

        return $clean !== '' ? $clean : 'Produto Importado Exclusivo';
    }

    public function generateSalesCopy(string $rawDescription, array $attributes = []): string
    {
        $cleanText = strip_tags($rawDescription);
        $cleanText = (string)preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $cleanText);
        $summary = mb_substr(trim($cleanText), 0, 320);

        $specsHtml = '';
        if (!empty($attributes)) {
            $specsHtml .= '<div style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">';
            $specsHtml .= '<h4 style="margin-top:0; color:#45f3ff; font-size:14px; text-transform:uppercase;">📐 Especificações Técnicas</h4>';
            $specsHtml .= '<ul style="margin:0; padding-left:20px; font-size:13px; color:#cbd5e1; line-height:1.7;">';
            foreach ($attributes as $k => $v) {
                if (is_scalar($v) && trim((string)$v) !== '') {
                    $specsHtml .= '<li><strong>' . htmlspecialchars((string)$k) . ':</strong> ' . htmlspecialchars((string)$v) . '</li>';
                }
            }
            $specsHtml .= '</ul></div>';
        }

        return <<<HTML
<div class="domain-drop-product-description" style="font-size:14px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--text-main, #cbd5e1);">
    <p style="font-size:15px; font-weight:500; color:#fff; margin-bottom:16px;">
        {$summary}...
    </p>

    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap:12px; margin:20px 0;">
        <div style="background:rgba(0,210,132,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(0,210,132,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:12px;">
            <strong style="color:#00d284; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">✨ Qualidade Comprovada</strong>
            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Item selecionado entre os mais bem avaliados do catálogo internacional.</span>
        </div>
        <div style="background:rgba(69,243,255,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:12px;">
            <strong style="color:#45f3ff; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">🚚 Envio com Rastreio</strong>
            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Código de rastreamento enviado automaticamente no seu WhatsApp e E-mail.</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    {$specsHtml}
</div>
HTML;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressApiClient.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AliExpressApiClientInterface;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Cliente Oficial de Comunicação com a AliExpress Open Platform API (DIP / SOLID).
 * 
 * Implementa o protocolo de assinatura criptográfica oficial HMAC-SHA256 (IOP Protocol),
 * compatível com o gateway internacional: https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync.
 */
class AliExpressApiClient implements AliExpressApiClientInterface
{
    private string $appKey;
    private string $appSecret;
    private string $gatewayUrl;
    private int $timeout;
    private string $sdkVersion = 'iop-sdk-php-20220608';

    public function __construct(
        string $appKey,
        string $appSecret,
        string $gatewayUrl = 'https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync',
        int $timeout = 15,
        private ?string $accessToken = null
    ) {
        $this->appKey = trim($appKey);
        $this->appSecret = trim($appSecret);
        $this->gatewayUrl = rtrim($gatewayUrl, '/');
        $this->timeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function execute(string $apiMethod, array $params = [], ?string $accessToken = null): array
    {
        if ($this->appKey === '' || $this->appSecret === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('[AliExpressApiClient] AppKey ou AppSecret não configurados no DomainDrop.');
        }

        $token = $accessToken ?? $this->accessToken;

        $sysParams = [
            'app_key'     => $this->appKey,
            'sign_method' => 'sha256',
            'timestamp'   => $this->getMillisecondTimestamp(),
            'method'      => $apiMethod,
            'partner_id'  => $this->sdkVersion,
            'format'      => 'json',
            'simplify'    => 'true',
        ];

        if ($token !== null && $token !== '') {
            $sysParams['session'] = $token;
        }

        // Combina parâmetros de sistema e de API para cálculo da assinatura
        $allParams = array_merge($params, $sysParams);
        $sysParams['sign'] = $this->generateSignature($apiMethod, $allParams);

        // Monta a Query String dos parâmetros de sistema
        $requestUrl = $this->gatewayUrl . '?' . http_build_query($sysParams);

        return $this->sendHttpRequest($requestUrl, $params);
    }

    public function getProductDetails(string|int $productId, string $targetLanguage = 'pt', string $targetCurrency = 'USD'): array
    {
        $numericId = (string)$productId;
        // Se for URL completa do AliExpress, extrai o ID numérico
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/', $numericId, $matches)) {
            $numericId = $matches[1];
        }

        $params = [
            'product_id'      => $numericId,
            'target_language' => $targetLanguage,
            'target_currency' => $targetCurrency,
            'ship_to_country' => 'BR',
        ];

        return $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.product.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
    }

    public function searchProducts(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $sort = (string)($filters['sort'] ?? 'volume_desc');
        $mappedSort = match ($sort) {
            'evaluate_rate_desc' => 'LAST_VOLUME_DESC',
            'choice_desc'        => 'SALE_PRICE_ASC',
            default              => 'LAST_VOLUME_DESC',
        };

        $params = [
            'category_id'       => (string)($filters['category_id'] ?? ''),
            'keywords'          => (string)($filters['keywords'] ?? 'trending'),
            'page_size'         => (string)($filters['page_size'] ?? '20'),
            'page_no'           => (string)($filters['page_no'] ?? '1'),
            'sort'              => $mappedSort,
            'feed_name'         => (string)($filters['feed_name'] ?? 'DS bestseller'),
            'target_language'   => 'pt',
            'target_currency'   => 'USD',
            'ship_to_country'   => (string)($filters['ship_to_country'] ?? 'BR'),
            'ship_from_country' => (string)($filters['ship_from_country'] ?? 'BR'),
        ];

        try {
            $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.ds.recommend.feed.get', $params, $this->accessToken);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [];
        }

        // Normaliza diferentes formatos de payload do IOP SDK (feed ou busca de produtos)
        $products = $response['result']['products']['traffic_product_d_t_o']
            ?? ($response['result']['products']['product'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_recommend_feed_get_response']['result']['products']['traffic_product_d_t_o'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_ds_recommend_feed_get_response']['result']['products'] ?? []);

        return is_array($products) ? $products : [];
    }

    public function queryTrackingInfo(
        string $logisticsNo,
        string $origin = 'ESCROW',
        string $outRef = '',
        string $serviceName = 'CAINIAO',
        string $toArea = 'BR'
    ): array {
        $logisticsNo = trim($logisticsNo);
        if ($logisticsNo === '' && trim($outRef) === '') {
            return [];
        }

        $params = [
            'logistics_no' => $logisticsNo,
            'origin'       => $origin !== '' ? $origin : 'ESCROW',
            'out_ref'      => trim($outRef),
            'service_name' => $serviceName !== '' ? $serviceName : 'CAINIAO',
            'to_area'      => $toArea !== '' ? strtoupper($toArea) : 'BR',
        ];

        $response = $this->execute('aliexpress.logistics.ds.trackinginfo.query', $params, $this->accessToken);

        $details = $response['result']['details']['details']
            ?? ($response['result']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['details']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['result']['details']['details'] ?? null)
            ?? ($response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['result']['details'] ?? []);

        return [
            'official_website' => (string)($response['result']['official_website'] ?? $response['aliexpress_logistics_ds_trackinginfo_query_response']['official_website'] ?? ''),
            'details'          => is_array($details) ? $details : [],
            'raw'              => $response,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Algoritmo Oficial de Assinatura IOP da AliExpress Open Platform.
     * 1. Ordena parâmetros alfabeticamente por chave (ksort).
     * 2. Concatena chave e valor em string corrida.
     * 3. Calcula HMAC-SHA256 em maiúsculas usando o AppSecret.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $params
     */
    public function generateSignature(string $apiMethod, array $params): string
    {
        ksort($params);

        $stringToBeSigned = '';
        if (str_contains($apiMethod, '/')) {
            $stringToBeSigned .= $apiMethod;
        }

        foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
            if ($v !== null && $v !== '') {
                $stringToBeSigned .= "$k$v";
            }
        }

        return strtoupper(hash_hmac('sha256', $stringToBeSigned, $this->appSecret));
    }

    /**
     * Retorna o timestamp em milissegundos exigido pela AliExpress API.
     */
    private function getMillisecondTimestamp(): string
    {
        return (string)(int)(microtime(true) * 1000);
    }

    /**
     * Executa requisição HTTP segura via cURL com POST.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $postData
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function sendHttpRequest(string $url, array $postData = []): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($postData));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $this->timeout);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, $this->sdkVersion);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);

        $rawResponse = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $error = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($rawResponse === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("[AliExpressApiClient] Falha na conexão com o gateway do AliExpress: {$error}");
        }

        $decoded = json_decode((string)$rawResponse, true);

        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            // Se vier XML ou erro de gateway
            return [
                'raw_response' => (string)$rawResponse,
                'http_code'    => $httpCode,
            ];
        }

        // Se o AliExpress retornar erro formal na resposta
        if (isset($decoded['code']) && (int)$decoded['code'] !== 0 && !isset($decoded['result'])) {
            $msg = $decoded['message'] ?? ($decoded['sub_msg'] ?? 'Erro desconhecido da AliExpress API');
            throw new RuntimeException("[AliExpress Gateway Error: {$decoded['code']}] {$msg}");
        }

        return $decoded;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\AliExpressLinkScraperService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\ScrapedProductDto;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Motor de Scraping em Tempo Real para Links Oficiais do AliExpress (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Extrai diretamente do HTML da página pública:
 * - Imagem de capa oficial (og:image) em alta resolução
 * - Galeria completa de imagens Full HD (imagePathList)
 * - Título original do fornecedor
 * - Preço promocional em vigor (pdp_npi)
 */
class AliExpressLinkScraperService implements ProductLinkScraperInterface
{
    public function canHandle(string $urlOrId): bool
    {
        $trim = trim($urlOrId);
        if (str_contains($trim, 'aliexpress.com') || str_contains($trim, 'aliexpress-media.com')) {
            return true;
        }

        // Verifica se é um ID numérico típico do AliExpress (10 a 20 dígitos)
        return (bool)preg_match('/^\d{10,20}$/', $trim);
    }

    public function scrape(string $urlOrId): ?ScrapedProductDto
    {
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($urlOrId);
        if ($productId === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html?country=BR&locale=pt_BR&currency=BRL";
        $targetUrl = str_starts_with($urlOrId, 'http') ? $urlOrId : $canonicalUrl;

        try {
            $html = $this->fetchHtml($targetUrl);
            if ($html === null || strlen($html) < 200) {
                return null;
            }

            return $this->parseRawHtml($html, $targetUrl);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function parseRawHtml(string $rawSource, string $sourceUrl = ''): ?ScrapedProductDto
    {
        if (trim($rawSource) === '') {
            return null;
        }

        // 1. Filtro de Link Morto / 404 / Página Desativada / Desafio Anti-Robô (Slider Captcha)
        if (stripos($rawSource, 'Página não encontrada') !== false 
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Page Not Found') !== false 
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Item no longer available') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Não conseguimos encontrar esta página') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'Arraste o controle deslizante') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'controle deslizante para verificar') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'verificação garante acesso normal') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'sec.aliexpress.com') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'slide to verify') !== false
            || stripos($rawSource, 'rgv587_flag') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // 2. Extração do Product ID
        $productId = $this->extractProductId($sourceUrl);
        if ($productId === '') {
            if (preg_match('/(?:productId|itemId)["\']?\s*:\s*["\']?(\d{10,20})["\']?/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            } elseif (preg_match('/item\/(\d{10,20})\.html/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            } elseif (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $rawSource, $pm)) {
                $productId = $pm[1];
            }
        }

        if ($productId === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $canonicalUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html";

        // 3. Extração do Título
        $title = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:title" content="([^"]+)"/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        } elseif (preg_match('/<title>([^<]+)<\/title>/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        } elseif (preg_match('/["\'](?:subject|title|productTitle)["\']\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode($m[1]);
        }

        if (empty($title) 
            || stripos($title, 'Página não encontrada') !== false 
            || stripos($title, 'Page Not Found') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        // 4. Extração da Imagem Principal
        $mainImage = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:image" content="([^"]+)"/i', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $mainImage = $this->cleanImageUrl($m[1]);
        }

        // 5. Extração da Galeria Completa (imagePathList ou regex de CDN)
        $gallery = [];
        if (preg_match('/"imagePathList":(\[[^\]]+\])/', $rawSource, $m)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($m[1], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                foreach ($decoded as $img) {
                    $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl((string)$img);
                    if ($clean !== '' && !in_array($clean, $gallery, true)) {
                        $gallery[] = $clean;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Se imagePathList não veio ou veio vazio, busca todas as imagens do CDN no código
        if (empty($gallery)) {
            preg_match_all('/https?:\/\/(?:ae-pic-[a-z0-9\-]+\.aliexpress-media\.com|[a-z0-9\-]+\.alicdn\.com)\/kf\/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp)/i', $rawSource, $allCdnImgs);
            if (!empty($allCdnImgs[0])) {
                foreach ($allCdnImgs[0] as $cdnImg) {
                    $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl($cdnImg);
                    if ($clean !== '' && !in_array($clean, $gallery, true)) {
                        $gallery[] = $clean;
                    }
                    if (count($gallery) >= 8) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($gallery) && !empty($mainImage)) {
            $gallery[] = $mainImage;
        }

        if (empty($mainImage) && !empty($gallery)) {
            $mainImage = $gallery[0];
        }

        if (empty($mainImage)) {
            return null;
        }

        // 6. Preço Promocional
        $costPriceUsd = 12.0;
        $decodedFull = urldecode($sourceUrl . ' ' . $rawSource);
        if (preg_match('/dis!([A-Z]{3})![0-9.]+!([0-9.]+)/i', $decodedFull, $pm)) {
            $currency = strtoupper($pm[1]);
            $promoVal = (float)$pm[2];
            if ($currency === 'BRL') {
                $costPriceUsd = round($promoVal / 5.25, 2);
            } elseif ($currency === 'USD') {
                $costPriceUsd = $promoVal;
            }
        } elseif (preg_match('/["\'](?:actSkuCalPrice|minActivityAmount|formatedAmount|app_sale_price)["\']\s*:\s*["\']?([0-9.]+)/i', $rawSource, $pm)) {
            $val = (float)$pm[1];
            if ($val > 100) { // Provavelmente BRL
                $costPriceUsd = round($val / 5.25, 2);
            } elseif ($val > 0) {
                $costPriceUsd = $val;
            }
        }

        // 7. Métricas reais do anúncio (jamais inventar vendas ou notas fixas quando ausentes)
        $ordersCount = 0;
        $ordersCountKnown = false;
        if (preg_match('/"(?:tradeCount|orders_count)"\s*:\s*(\d+)/i', $rawSource, $om)) {
            $ordersCount = max(0, (int)$om[1]);
            $ordersCountKnown = true;
        } elseif (preg_match('/"formatTradeCount"\s*:\s*"([\d.,]+)"/i', $rawSource, $om)) {
            $ordersCount = max(0, (int)str_replace(['.', ','], '', $om[1]));
            $ordersCountKnown = true;
        } elseif (preg_match('/(\d[\d.]*)\s*\+?\s*(?:vendidos|orders|sold)\b/i', $rawSource, $om)) {
            $ordersCount = max(0, (int)str_replace(['.', ','], '', $om[1]));
            $ordersCountKnown = true;
        }

        $rating = 0.0;
        if (preg_match('/"(?:evarageStar|averageStar|ratingValue)"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)"?/i', $rawSource, $rm)) {
            $parsedRating = (float)$rm[1];
            if ($parsedRating > 0.0 && $parsedRating <= 5.0) {
                $rating = round($parsedRating, 1);
            }
        }

        // 8. Categoria inferida
        $category = $this->inferCategory($title);

        return new ScrapedProductDto(
            sourceId: $productId,
            sourceUrl: $canonicalUrl,
            rawTitle: $title !== '' ? $title : "Produto AliExpress {$productId}",
            mainImageUrl: $mainImage,
            galleryImages: $gallery,
            costPriceUsd: $costPriceUsd,
            category: $category,
            rating: $rating,
            ordersCount: $ordersCount,
            attributes: [
                'Origem'            => 'Importação Oficial AliExpress',
                'Envio'             => 'Rastreamento Internacional Expresso',
                'Vendas_Informadas' => $ordersCountKnown ? 'sim' : 'nao',
            ]
        );
    }

    private function extractProductId(string $urlOrId): string
    {
        $str = trim($urlOrId);
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/i', $str, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        if (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $str, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }

        return '';
    }

    public function isProductAlive(string $urlOrId): bool
    {
        return $this->scrape($urlOrId) !== null;
    }

    private function fetchHtml(string $url): ?string
    {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 4);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 3);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
            'Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language: pt-BR,pt;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
            'Cookie: aep_usuc_f=region=BR&site=bra&b_locale=pt_BR&c_tp=BRL; xman_us_f=x_locale=pt_BR; intl_locale=pt_BR;',
            'Cache-Control: no-cache',
            'Pragma: no-cache',
        ]);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $effectiveUrl = (string)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL);
        curl_close($ch);

        // Se o servidor retornar 404, 410 ou redirecionar para página de erro, descarta imediatamente
        if ($httpCode !== 200) {
            return null;
        }

        if (str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'notfound') || str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'page-not-found') || str_contains($effectiveUrl, 'item-not-found')) {
            return null;
        }

        return is_string($html) ? $html : null;
    }

    private function cleanImageUrl(string $url): string
    {
        $url = trim($url);
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }
        if (str_starts_with($url, '//')) {
            $url = 'https:' . $url;
        }
        // Remove sufixos de thumbnails e redimensionamento como _80x80.jpg, _50x50.jpg, _.webp
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_[0-9]+x[0-9]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);

        return $url;
    }

    private function inferCategory(string $title): string
    {
        $t = mb_strtolower($title, 'UTF-8');
        if (str_contains($t, 'pulseira') || str_contains($t, 'watch') || str_contains($t, 'relogio') || str_contains($t, 'fone') || str_contains($t, 'projetor') || str_contains($t, 'carregador')) {
            return 'Eletrônicos';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'lampada') || str_contains($t, 'luminaria') || str_contains($t, 'led') || str_contains($t, 'aspirador') || str_contains($t, 'cozinha') || str_contains($t, 'quarto')) {
            return 'Casa Inteligente';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'cabelo') || str_contains($t, 'pele') || str_contains($t, 'maquiagem') || str_contains($t, 'barbeador') || str_contains($t, 'beleza')) {
            return 'Beleza & Estilo';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'carro') || str_contains($t, 'suporte veicular') || str_contains($t, 'automotivo')) {
            return 'Acessórios Auto';
        }
        if (str_contains($t, 'pet') || str_contains($t, 'cachorro') || str_contains($t, 'gato')) {
            return 'Pet Shop';
        }

        return 'Geral';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\CurrencyConverterService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CurrencyConverterInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de Conversão Cambial Dinâmica e Precificação (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Obtém cotação USD/BRL em tempo real com cache inteligente de 12 horas
 * e aplica regras de margem de lucro (markup percentual e lucro mínimo garantido).
 */
class CurrencyConverterService implements CurrencyConverterInterface
{
    private string $cacheFile;
    private float $defaultMarkupPercent;
    private float $minProfitBrl;
    private float $fallbackUsdRate = 5.80;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $cacheDirOrFile = null,
        float $defaultMarkupPercent = 100.0,
        float $minProfitBrl = 30.0,
        float $fallbackUsdRate = 5.80
    ) {
        if ($cacheDirOrFile !== null && str_ends_with(strtolower($cacheDirOrFile), '.json')) {
            $this->cacheFile = $cacheDirOrFile;
            $dir = dirname($cacheDirOrFile);
            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
            }
        } else {
            $baseDir = $cacheDirOrFile ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/storage/cache' : dirname(__DIR__, 4) . '/storage/cache');
            if (!is_dir($baseDir)) {
                @mkdir($baseDir, 0775, true);
            }
            $this->cacheFile = $baseDir . '/exchange_rates.json';
        }
        $this->defaultMarkupPercent = $defaultMarkupPercent;
        $this->minProfitBrl = $minProfitBrl;
        $this->fallbackUsdRate = $fallbackUsdRate;
    }

    public function getExchangeRate(string $from = 'USD', string $to = 'BRL'): float
    {
        if (strtoupper($from) === strtoupper($to)) {
            return 1.0;
        }

        // 1. Tenta carregar do cache local (válido por 12 horas)
        $cached = $this->loadCachedRate($from, $to);
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return $cached;
        }

        // 2. Consulta API pública de cotação (AwesomeAPI - Banco Central)
        try {
            $url = "https://economia.awesomeapi.com.br/last/{$from}-{$to}";
            $ctx = stream_context_create([
                'http' => [
                    'timeout'    => 3,
                    'user_agent' => 'DomainDrop-CurrencyConverter/1.0',
                ],
            ]);

            $json = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
            if ($json !== false) {
                $data = json_decode($json, true);
                $key = "{$from}{$to}";
                if (isset($data[$key]['bid'])) {
                    $rate = (float)$data[$key]['bid'];
                    if ($rate > 0) {
                        $this->saveCachedRate($from, $to, $rate);
                        return $rate;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia para fallback defensivo
        }

        // 3. Fallback defensivo para não travar a loja offline
        return $this->fallbackUsdRate;
    }

    public function calculateSalePrice(float $costUsd, ?float $customMarkupPercent = null, ?float $minProfitBrl = null): float
    {
        if ($costUsd <= 0.0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $rate = $this->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        $costBrl = $costUsd * $rate;

        $markup = $customMarkupPercent ?? $this->defaultMarkupPercent;
        $minProfit = $minProfitBrl ?? $this->minProfitBrl;

        // Calcula com o markup (ex: 100% de markup dobra o custo original)
        $calculatedSalePrice = $costBrl * (1 + ($markup / 100.0));

        // Assegura que o lucro líquido em Reais seja no mínimo o configurado
        $profit = $calculatedSalePrice - $costBrl;
        if ($profit < $minProfit) {
            $calculatedSalePrice = $costBrl + $minProfit;
        }

        // Arredondamento comercial atraente (ex: termina em .90 ou .00)
        return round($calculatedSalePrice, 2);
    }

    private function loadCachedRate(string $from, string $to): ?float
    {
        if (!file_exists($this->cacheFile)) {
            return null;
        }

        $raw = @file_get_contents($this->cacheFile);
        if ($raw === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $cache = json_decode($raw, true);
        $key = "{$from}_{$to}";

        if (isset($cache[$key]['rate'], $cache[$key]['time'])) {
            // Expira em 12 horas (43.200 segundos)
            if ((time() - (int)$cache[$key]['time']) < 43200) {
                return (float)$cache[$key]['rate'];
            }
        } elseif (isset($cache[$from]) && is_numeric($cache[$from])) {
            return (float)$cache[$from];
        } elseif (isset($cache[$key]) && is_numeric($cache[$key])) {
            return (float)$cache[$key];
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function saveCachedRate(string $from, string $to, float $rate): void
    {
        $cache = [];
        if (file_exists($this->cacheFile)) {
            $raw = @file_get_contents($this->cacheFile);
            if ($raw !== false) {
                $cache = json_decode($raw, true) ?: [];
            }
        }

        $key = "{$from}_{$to}";
        $cache[$key] = [
            'rate' => $rate,
            'time' => time(),
        ];

        @file_put_contents($this->cacheFile, json_encode($cache, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\DisputeAttachmentService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

/**
 * Valida e persiste anexos (PDF e imagens) de reclamações de clientes fora da pasta pública.
 */
class DisputeAttachmentService
{
    public const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 5242880; // 5 MB
    public const MAX_FILES_PER_DISPUTE = 4;

    private const ALLOWED_MIME_MAP = [
        'pdf'  => ['application/pdf'],
        'jpg'  => ['image/jpeg', 'image/pjpeg'],
        'jpeg' => ['image/jpeg', 'image/pjpeg'],
        'png'  => ['image/png'],
        'webp' => ['image/webp'],
    ];

    private string $storageDir;

    public function __construct(?string $basePath = null, private readonly bool $requireUploadedFile = true)
    {
        $root = $basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->storageDir = rtrim($root, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'storage' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'domain_drop' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'disputes';
    }

    public function getStorageDir(): string
    {
        return $this->storageDir;
    }

    /**
     * Valida e armazena arquivos enviados via $request->files['evidences'].
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $fileInput
     * @return array{attachments: array<int, array<string, mixed>>, errors: array<int, string>}
     */
    public function storeUploadedFiles(?array $fileInput): array
    {
        if (empty($fileInput) || empty($fileInput['name'])) {
            return ['attachments' => [], 'errors' => []];
        }

        $normalized = $this->normalizeFiles($fileInput);
        if (count($normalized) > self::MAX_FILES_PER_DISPUTE) {
            return [
                'attachments' => [],
                'errors'      => ['Envie no máximo ' . self::MAX_FILES_PER_DISPUTE . ' arquivos (PDF ou imagem).'],
            ];
        }

        $attachments = [];
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($normalized as $file) {
            $err = (int)($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE);
            if ($err === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($err !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $errors[] = 'Falha no upload do arquivo "' . (string)($file['name'] ?? 'anexo') . '".';
                continue;
            }

            $originalName = basename((string)($file['name'] ?? ''));
            $tmpPath = (string)($file['tmp_name'] ?? '');
            $size = (int)($file['size'] ?? 0);

            if ($tmpPath === '' || !is_file($tmpPath)) {
                $errors[] = 'Arquivo temporário inválido.';
                continue;
            }
            if ($this->requireUploadedFile && !is_uploaded_file($tmpPath)) {
                $errors[] = 'Origem de arquivo não permitida.';
                continue;
            }
            if ($size <= 0 || $size > self::MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
                $errors[] = "O arquivo '{$originalName}' excede o limite de 5 MB.";
                continue;
            }

            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($originalName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            if (!isset(self::ALLOWED_MIME_MAP[$ext])) {
                $errors[] = "Formato não permitido para '{$originalName}'. Envie apenas PDF, JPG, PNG ou WEBP.";
                continue;
            }

            $detectedMime = $this->detectMime($tmpPath);
            if (!in_array($detectedMime, self::ALLOWED_MIME_MAP[$ext], true)) {
                $errors[] = "Conteúdo incompatível para '{$originalName}' (MIME detectado: {$detectedMime}).";
                continue;
            }

            if (!is_dir($this->storageDir)) {
                @mkdir($this->storageDir, 0775, true);
            }

            $storedFilename = bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) . '.' . $ext;
            $targetPath = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $storedFilename;

            $moved = $this->requireUploadedFile
                ? @move_uploaded_file($tmpPath, $targetPath)
                : @copy($tmpPath, $targetPath);

            if (!$moved) {
                $errors[] = "Não foi possível salvar '{$originalName}'.";
                continue;
            }

            $attachments[] = [
                'filename'      => $storedFilename,
                'original_name' => $originalName,
                'mime'          => $detectedMime,
                'size'          => $size,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'attachments' => $attachments,
            'errors'      => $errors,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Resolve caminho absoluto seguro de um anexo já armazenado.
     */
    public function resolveSafePath(string $filename): ?string
    {
        $clean = basename($filename);
        if ($clean === '' || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}\.(pdf|jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i', $clean)) {
            return null;
        }

        $candidate = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $clean;
        if (!is_file($candidate)) {
            return null;
        }

        $realBase = realpath($this->storageDir);
        $realFile = realpath($candidate);
        if ($realBase === false || $realFile === false || !str_starts_with($realFile, $realBase)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $realFile;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $fileInput
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function normalizeFiles(array $fileInput): array
    {
        if (!is_array($fileInput['name'])) {
            return [$fileInput];
        }

        $items = [];
        $count = count($fileInput['name']);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $items[] = [
                'name'     => $fileInput['name'][$i] ?? '',
                'type'     => $fileInput['type'][$i] ?? '',
                'tmp_name' => $fileInput['tmp_name'][$i] ?? '',
                'error'    => $fileInput['error'][$i] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE,
                'size'     => $fileInput['size'][$i] ?? 0,
            ];
        }

        return $items;
    }

    private function detectMime(string $path): string
    {
        if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {
            $finfo = @finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
            if ($finfo !== false) {
                $mime = (string)@finfo_file($finfo, $path);
                @finfo_close($finfo);
                if ($mime !== '') {
                    return strtolower(trim($mime));
                }
            }
        }

        return 'application/octet-stream';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\OrderSlaProgressService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Calcula a barra de progresso regressiva (contagem até entrega) e o estado de SLA
 * de cada pedido para exibição no painel administrativo e área do cliente.
 */
class OrderSlaProgressService
{
    public const DEFAULT_DAYS_BR = 7;
    public const DEFAULT_DAYS_INTL = 25;

    /**
     * Calcula o estado de progresso regressivo do pedido.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $order
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $disputes
     * @param DateTimeImmutable|null $now
     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $sdkTracking
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function calculate(
        array $order,
        array $disputes = [],
        ?DateTimeImmutable $now = null,
        ?array $sdkTracking = null
    ): array {
        $now = $now ?? new DateTimeImmutable('now');
        $origin = strtoupper(trim((string)($order['seller_origin'] ?? 'BR')));
        if ($origin !== 'CN') {
            $origin = 'BR';
        }

        $expectedDays = (int)($order['expected_delivery_days'] ?? 0);
        if ($expectedDays <= 0) {
            $expectedDays = $origin === 'CN' ? self::DEFAULT_DAYS_INTL : self::DEFAULT_DAYS_BR;
        }

        $createdAt = $this->parseDate((string)($order['created_at'] ?? '')) ?? $now;
        $createdDay = $createdAt->setTime(0, 0, 0);
        $nowDay = $now->setTime(0, 0, 0);

        $daysElapsed = $nowDay >= $createdDay ? (int)$createdDay->diff($nowDay)->days : 0;
        $daysRemaining = max(0, $expectedDays - $daysElapsed);
        $percentRemaining = (int)max(0, min(100, round(($daysRemaining / max(1, $expectedDays)) * 100)));

        $trackingAnalysis = $sdkTracking !== null ? $this->parseSdkTracking($sdkTracking) : [
            'delivered'   => false,
            'last_event'  => '',
            'status_code' => '',
        ];

        $hasComplaint = !empty($disputes);
        $latestDispute = $hasComplaint ? $disputes[0] : null;
        $mediationSent = is_array($latestDispute) && (($latestDispute['mediation_status'] ?? '') === 'sent');

        $sdkDelivered = !empty($order['sdk_delivered_at'])
            || strtolower((string)($order['status'] ?? '')) === 'delivered'
            || ($trackingAnalysis['delivered'] === true);

        if ($hasComplaint) {
            return [
                'origin'            => $origin,
                'expected_days'     => $expectedDays,
                'days_elapsed'      => $daysElapsed,
                'days_remaining'    => $daysRemaining,
                'percent_remaining' => $percentRemaining,
                'bar_percent'       => max(8, $percentRemaining),
                'state'             => 'complaint_open',
                'tone'              => 'danger',
                'sdk_delivered'     => $sdkDelivered,
                'has_complaint'     => true,
                'mediation_sent'    => $mediationSent,
                'last_sdk_event'    => $trackingAnalysis['last_event'],
                'label'             => $mediationSent
                    ? 'Reclamação Aberta • Intermediação Enviada'
                    : 'Reclamação do Cliente Aberta',
            ];
        }

        if ($sdkDelivered) {
            return [
                'origin'            => $origin,
                'expected_days'     => $expectedDays,
                'days_elapsed'      => $daysElapsed,
                'days_remaining'    => 0,
                'percent_remaining' => 0,
                'bar_percent'       => 100,
                'state'             => 'ok_delivered',
                'tone'              => 'success',
                'sdk_delivered'     => true,
                'has_complaint'     => false,
                'mediation_sent'    => false,
                'last_sdk_event'    => $trackingAnalysis['last_event'],
                'label'             => 'Tudo Ok! Entregue no local sem reclamações',
            ];
        }

        if ($daysRemaining <= 0) {
            return [
                'origin'            => $origin,
                'expected_days'     => $expectedDays,
                'days_elapsed'      => $daysElapsed,
                'days_remaining'    => 0,
                'percent_remaining' => 0,
                'bar_percent'       => 100,
                'state'             => 'delayed_awaiting_customer',
                'tone'              => 'warning',
                'sdk_delivered'     => false,
                'has_complaint'     => false,
                'mediation_sent'    => false,
                'last_sdk_event'    => $trackingAnalysis['last_event'],
                'label'             => 'Entrega em atraso — Aguardando cliente',
            ];
        }

        return [
            'origin'            => $origin,
            'expected_days'     => $expectedDays,
            'days_elapsed'      => $daysElapsed,
            'days_remaining'    => $daysRemaining,
            'percent_remaining' => $percentRemaining,
            'bar_percent'       => $percentRemaining,
            'state'             => 'in_transit_countdown',
            'tone'              => $daysRemaining <= 2 ? 'amber' : 'info',
            'sdk_delivered'     => false,
            'has_complaint'     => false,
            'mediation_sent'    => false,
            'last_sdk_event'    => $trackingAnalysis['last_event'],
            'label'             => sprintf('%d de %d dias restantes', $daysRemaining, $expectedDays),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Analisa resposta do método queryTrackingInfo do SDK AliExpress para detectar entrega local.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $trackingResponse
     * @return array{delivered: bool, last_event: string, status_code: string}
     */
    public function parseSdkTracking(array $trackingResponse): array
    {
        if (isset($trackingResponse['delivered']) && $trackingResponse['delivered'] === true) {
            return [
                'delivered'   => true,
                'last_event'  => (string)($trackingResponse['last_event'] ?? 'Entregue ao destinatário'),
                'status_code' => (string)($trackingResponse['status'] ?? 'DELIVERED'),
            ];
        }

        $json = strtolower((string)json_encode($trackingResponse, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
        $deliveredSignals = [
            'delivered',
            'signed_by_customer',
            'objeto entregue ao destinat',
            'entregue no local',
            'package delivered',
            'successfully delivered',
        ];

        $delivered = false;
        foreach ($deliveredSignals as $signal) {
            if (str_contains($json, $signal)) {
                $delivered = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        $lastEvent = '';
        $details = $trackingResponse['aliexpress_logistics_buyer_freight_get_response']['result']['details']['details']
            ?? $trackingResponse['details']
            ?? $trackingResponse['events']
            ?? [];
        if (is_array($details) && !empty($details)) {
            $first = reset($details);
            if (is_array($first)) {
                $lastEvent = (string)($first['event_desc'] ?? $first['desc'] ?? $first['status'] ?? '');
            } elseif (is_string($first)) {
                $lastEvent = $first;
            }
        }

        return [
            'delivered'   => $delivered,
            'last_event'  => $lastEvent,
            'status_code' => $delivered ? 'DELIVERED' : (string)($trackingResponse['status'] ?? 'IN_TRANSIT'),
        ];
    }

    private function parseDate(string $value): ?DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $trimmed = trim($value);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return new DateTimeImmutable($trimmed);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\ProductMediaSyncService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\AiProductEnricherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\CurrencyConverterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductLinkScraperInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\ProductMediaSyncInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\DTO\DropshipProductDto;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de Sincronização e Integridade de Mídia (SRP / DIP).
 * 
 * Garante que produtos no catálogo tenham suas imagens (capa e galeria)
 * permanentemente alinhadas aos links oficiais de origem do fornecedor.
 */
class ProductMediaSyncService implements ProductMediaSyncInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $repository,
        private readonly ProductLinkScraperInterface $scraper,
        private readonly AiProductEnricherInterface $aiEnricher,
        private readonly CurrencyConverterInterface $currencyConverter
    ) {
    }

    public function syncProductMedia(int $productId): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $existing = $this->repository->findById($productId);
        if ($existing === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Produto ID {$productId} não encontrado no catálogo.");
        }

        $sourceId = $existing->aliexpressId;
        if (empty($sourceId)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("O produto ID {$productId} não possui identificador de origem do fornecedor.");
        }

        $scraped = $this->scraper->scrape($sourceId);
        if ($scraped === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Não foi possível acessar a página oficial do produto {$sourceId} para sincronização.");
        }

        // Título polido a partir do título oficial raspado do link
        $polishedTitle = $this->aiEnricher->polishTitle($scraped->rawTitle, $scraped->category);
        $slug = $existing->slug ?: $this->slugify($polishedTitle . '-' . substr($sourceId, -4));

        // Conversão de preço caso o scraper tenha pego cotação atualizada
        $costUsd = $scraped->costPriceUsd > 0 ? $scraped->costPriceUsd : $existing->costPriceUsd;
        $saleBrl = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePrice($costUsd);

        // Galeria com todas as imagens reais raspadas
        $allImages = $scraped->getAllImages();
        $mainImage = $scraped->mainImageUrl ?: ($allImages[0] ?? $existing->mainImageUrl);

        $updatedDto = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: $sourceId,
            title: $polishedTitle,
            slug: $slug,
            costPriceUsd: $costUsd,
            salePriceBrl: $saleBrl,
            mainImageUrl: $mainImage,
            images: $allImages,
            category: $scraped->category ?: $existing->category,
            description: $existing->description,
            rating: $scraped->rating > 0 ? $scraped->rating : $existing->rating,
            ordersCount: $scraped->ordersCount > 0 ? $scraped->ordersCount : $existing->ordersCount,
            attributes: !empty($scraped->attributes) ? $scraped->attributes : $existing->attributes,
            status: $existing->status,
            id: $existing->id
        );

        $this->repository->save($updatedDto);

        return $this->repository->findById($productId) ?? $updatedDto;
    }

    public function syncAllCatalogMedia(): array
    {
        $products = $this->repository->list([], 200, 0);
        $synced = 0;
        $failed = 0;
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($products as $prod) {
            if ($prod->id === null) {
                continue;
            }

            // Apenas sincroniza produtos com ID real numérico do fornecedor
            if (!preg_match('/^\d{10,20}$/', $prod->aliexpressId)) {
                continue;
            }

            try {
                $this->syncProductMedia((int)$prod->id);
                $synced++;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $failed++;
                $errors[] = "Produto #{$prod->id} ({$prod->title}): " . $e->getMessage();
            }
        }

        return [
            'total'  => count($products),
            'synced' => $synced,
            'failed' => $failed,
            'errors' => $errors,
        ];
    }

    private function slugify(string $text): string
    {
        $str = mb_strtolower(trim($text), 'UTF-8');
        $str = preg_replace(
            ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u', '/[ñ]/u'],
            ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c', 'n'],
            $str
        ) ?? $str;
        $str = (string)preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/i', '-', $str);

        return trim($str, '-') ?: 'produto-dropship';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\ProductMiningService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

/**
 * Orquestrador do Motor de Mineração e Enriquecimento Inteligente (SRP / DIP).
 */
class ProductMiningService implements ProductMiningServiceInterface
{
    public const OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES = [

    public function __construct(

        private readonly AiProductEnricherInterface $aiEnricher,
        private readonly DropshipCatalogRepositoryInterface $repository,

    /**
     * Normaliza categorias legadas e apelidos para uma das categorias oficiais.
     */
    public static function normalizeCategory(string $category): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($category);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return 'Eletrônicos & Gadget';
        }

        $map = [
            'Eletrônicos'                       => 'Eletrônicos & Gadget',

            'Automotivo'                        => 'Acessórios para Veículos',
