    public function mineTrendingProducts(string $category = 'Eletrônicos & Gadget', int $limit = 10, bool $autoPersist = true, string $sort = 'volume_desc'): array
    {
        $category = self::normalizeCategory($category);
        $rawProducts = [];
        try {
            $rawProducts = $this->apiClient->searchProducts([
                'keywords'          => $category,
                'page_size'         => (string)min(max($limit * 2, $limit), 50),
                'sort'              => $sort,
                'ship_from_country' => 'BR',
                'ship_to_country'   => 'BR',
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $rawProducts = [];
        }

        // Se a API remota oficial não estiver conectada (ou em modo Test), utiliza catálogo curado e verificado
        if (empty($rawProducts)) {
            $rawProducts = $this->getCuratedTrendingFallback($category, $limit, $sort);
        } else {
            $rawProducts = self::scoreAndSortByReputation($rawProducts, $sort, 4.5, 50, $limit);
        }

        $mined = [];
        foreach ($rawProducts as $item) {
            try {
                $itemId = (string)($item['product_id'] ?? ($item['item_id'] ?? uniqid('ae_')));
                $dto = $this->processWithTransientBuffer(
                    $itemId,
                    $item,
                    function (array $rawItem) use ($category, $autoPersist) {
                        $transformed = $this->transformRawItemToDto($rawItem, $category);
                        if ($autoPersist) {
                            $savedId = $this->repository->save($transformed);
                            return $this->repository->findById($savedId) ?? $transformed;
                        }
                        return $transformed;
                    }
                );
                $mined[] = $dto;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Isolamento de falha individual de produto malformado
            }
        }

        return $mined;
    }

    /**
     * Calcula o índice do Termômetro de Curadoria (0 a 100) combinando nota e aprovações/volume.
     */
    public static function calculateThermometerScore(float $rating, int $ordersCount): int
    {
        $clampedRating = max(0.0, min(5.0, $rating > 0.0 ? $rating : 4.8));
        $ratingScore = ($clampedRating / 5.0) * 60.0;
        $ordersScore = $ordersCount > 0 ? min(40.0, log10($ordersCount + 1) * 10.5) : 15.0;

        return (int)max(10, min(100, round($ratingScore + $ordersScore)));
    }

    /**
     * Filtra e ordena resultados brutos do SDK do AliExpress por nota, aprovações e termômetro.
     *
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function scoreAndSortByReputation(
        array $items,
        string $sort = 'volume_desc',
        float $minRating = 4.5,
        int $minOrders = 50,
        int $limit = 20
    ): array {
        $scored = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if (!is_array($item)) {
                continue;
            }
            $baseInfo = $item['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? [];
            $rating = (float)($item['evaluate_rate'] ?? ($baseInfo['avg_evaluation_rating'] ?? ($item['rating'] ?? 4.8)));
            $orders = (int)($item['volume'] ?? ($item['orders_count'] ?? ($item['lastest_volume'] ?? 0)));
            $thermometer = self::calculateThermometerScore($rating, $orders);

            $scored[] = [
                'item'        => $item,
                'rating'      => $rating,
                'orders'      => $orders,
                'thermometer' => $thermometer,
                'qualified'   => ($rating === 0.0 || $rating >= $minRating) && ($orders === 0 || $orders >= $minOrders),
            ];
        }

        $qualified = array_values(array_filter($scored, static fn($row) => $row['qualified']));
        $pool = !empty($qualified) ? $qualified : $scored;

        usort($pool, static function (array $a, array $b) use ($sort): int {
            return match ($sort) {
                'evaluate_rate_desc' => ($b['rating'] <=> $a['rating'])
                    ?: ($b['thermometer'] <=> $a['thermometer'])
                    ?: ($b['orders'] <=> $a['orders']),
                'choice_desc' => ($b['thermometer'] <=> $a['thermometer'])
                    ?: ($b['rating'] <=> $a['rating'])
                    ?: ($b['orders'] <=> $a['orders']),
                default => ($b['orders'] <=> $a['orders'])
                    ?: ($b['thermometer'] <=> $a['thermometer'])
                    ?: ($b['rating'] <=> $a['rating']),
            };
        });

        $sliced = array_slice($pool, 0, max(1, $limit));
        return array_map(static fn(array $row): array => $row['item'], $sliced);
    }

    /**
     * Minera produtos reais e ativos em tempo real através da página pública de tendências do AliExpress.
     * Garante que 100% dos produtos minerados possuam links reais, títulos oficiais e fotos autênticas,
     * sem dependência de scraping individual por página e imune a bloqueios de WAF.
     *
     * @return array<int, DropshipProductDto>
     */
    protected function mineLiveFromAliExpressSearch(string $category, int $limit, bool $autoPersist): array
    {
        $category = self::normalizeCategory($category);

        $searchTerms = [
            'Eletrônicos & Gadget'           => ['smartwatch brasil', 'fone sem fio bluetooth brasil', 'projetor portatil 4k', 'mini drone 4k camera', 'power bank inducao', 'caixa som bluetooth potente', 'camera seguranca wifi 360'],
            'Casa Inteligente & Organização' => ['lampada led inteligente wifi rgb', 'tomada inteligente wifi tuya', 'sensor presenca inteligente', 'dispensador sabonete automatico sensor', 'fita led rgb inteligente wifi', 'aspirador po robo inteligente', 'fechadura digital biometrica'],
            'Beleza, Cuidados & Estilo'      => ['modelador cabelo profissional automatico', 'escova secadora modeladora eletrica', 'depilador laser luz pulsada ipl', 'massageador facial eletrico gua sha', 'maquina corte cabelo vintage profissional', 'espelho led maquiagem recarregavel'],
            'Ferramentas & Utilidades'       => ['alicate desencapador fios multifuncional', 'trena laser digital fita metrica', 'parafusadeira eletrica recarregavel sem fio', 'canivete tatico multifuncional', 'chave universal precisao multifuncoes', 'lanterna tatica led potente militar'],
            'Pet Shop & Pets Virais'         => ['coleira led luminosa cachorro recarregavel', 'bebedouro fonte automatica pet gato', 'escova a vapor pet removedora pelos', 'brinquedo interativo inteligente pet gato', 'cama nuvem calmante cachorro', 'cortador unhas pet com led'],
            'Acessórios para Veículos'       => ['suporte celular veicular carregador inducao', 'aspirador portatil automotivo sem fio', 'transmissor bluetooth veicular fm', 'compressor ar portatil eletrico pneus carro', 'led interno veicular sensor som', 'camera dvr veicular gravador transito'],
        ];

        $termList = $searchTerms[$category] ?? ['smartwatch brasil', 'fone bluetooth'];
        $searchTerm = $termList[array_rand($termList)];
        // Empurra para a vitrine e estoques do Brasil (Remessa Conforme e Envio Local)
        $searchUrl = "https://pt.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-" . urlencode($searchTerm) . ".html?country=BR&locale=pt_BR&currency=BRL&isrefine=y";

        $html = $this->fetchLiveSearchHtml($searchUrl);
        if (!$html || !is_string($html)) {
            return [];
        }

        // 1. Extração direta da carga estruturada de produtos injetada pelo AliExpress (init_data)
        $initData = null;
        if (preg_match('/window\._dida_config_\._init_data_\s*=\s*(\{.+?\})\s*(?:;|\/\*)/s', $html, $m)) {
            $jsonStr = preg_replace('/^\{\s*data\s*:/', '{"data":', $m[1]);
            $initData = json_decode($jsonStr, true);
        }
        if (empty($initData) && preg_match('/window\._dida_config_\._init_data_\s*=\s*(\{.+?\})\/\*!-->init-data-end--\*\//s', $html, $m2)) {
            $jsonStr = preg_replace('/^\{\s*data\s*:/', '{"data":', $m2[1]);
            $initData = json_decode($jsonStr, true);
        }

        $itemList = $initData['data']['data']['root']['fields']['mods']['itemList']['content'] 
            ?? ($initData['mods']['itemList']['content'] ?? []);

        if (empty($itemList) || !is_array($itemList)) {
            return [];
        }

        $mined = [];
        $collected = 0;
        $usdRate = $this->currencyConverter->getExchangeRate('USD', 'BRL');
        if ($usdRate <= 0.0) {
            $usdRate = 5.80;
        }

        foreach ($itemList as $raw) {
            if ($collected >= $limit) {
                break;
            }

            try {
                $aeId = (string)($raw['productId'] ?? ($raw['item_id'] ?? ''));
                if (empty($aeId) || !is_numeric($aeId)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $rawTitle = trim((string)($raw['title']['displayTitle'] ?? ($raw['title']['title'] ?? '')));
                if ($rawTitle === '') {
                    continue;
                }

                $rawMainImg = (string)($raw['image']['imgUrl'] ?? '');
                if ($rawMainImg === '') {
                    continue;
                }

                $mainImg = $this->cleanImageUrl($rawMainImg);
                if (str_starts_with($mainImg, '//')) {
                    $mainImg = 'https:' . $mainImg;
                }

                $images = [$mainImg];
                if (!empty($raw['images']) && is_array($raw['images'])) {
                    foreach ($raw['images'] as $imgObj) {
                        $u = is_array($imgObj) ? ($imgObj['imgUrl'] ?? '') : (string)$imgObj;
                        if (!empty($u)) {
                            $cleaned = $this->cleanImageUrl($u);
                            if (str_starts_with($cleaned, '//')) {
                                $cleaned = 'https:' . $cleaned;
                            }
                            if (!empty($cleaned) && !in_array($cleaned, $images, true)) {
                                $images[] = $cleaned;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Precificação oficial em BRL e conversão limpa para USD de custo
                $minPriceBrl = (float)($raw['prices']['salePrice']['minPrice'] ?? ($raw['prices']['originalPrice']['minPrice'] ?? 0.0));
                $costPriceUsd = $minPriceBrl > 0.0 ? round($minPriceBrl / $usdRate, 2) : 12.00;
                $salePriceBrl = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePrice($costPriceUsd);
                if ($salePriceBrl <= $minPriceBrl) {
                    $salePriceBrl = round($minPriceBrl * 1.45, 2);
                }

                // Avaliações e Métricas reais de compra
                $rating = (float)($raw['evaluation']['starRating'] ?? 4.8);
                if ($rating <= 0.0 || $rating > 5.0) {
                    $rating = 4.8;
                }

                $ordersCount = 0;
                $ordersCountKnown = false;
                $tradeDesc = trim((string)($raw['trade']['tradeDesc'] ?? ''));
                if ($tradeDesc !== '' && preg_match('/(\d+[\.,]?\d*)/', $tradeDesc, $mTrade)) {
                    $ordersCount = max(0, (int)str_replace(['.', ','], '', $mTrade[1]));
                    $ordersCountKnown = true;
                } elseif (isset($raw['trade']['tradeCount']) && is_numeric($raw['trade']['tradeCount'])) {
                    $ordersCount = max(0, (int)$raw['trade']['tradeCount']);
                    $ordersCountKnown = true;
                } elseif (isset($raw['orders_count']) && is_numeric($raw['orders_count'])) {
                    $ordersCount = max(0, (int)$raw['orders_count']);
                    $ordersCountKnown = true;
                }

                // Enriquecimento e Polimento de Cópia Comercial por IA
                $polishedTitle = $this->aiEnricher->polishTitle($rawTitle, $category);
                $slug = $this->slugify($polishedTitle . '-' . substr($aeId, -4));

                $salesLabel = $ordersCount > 0
                    ? "{$ordersCount} vendidos"
                    : ($ordersCountKnown ? '0 vendidos' : 'vendas não informadas');

                $attributes = [
                    'Origem'            => 'Estoque Brasil / Remessa Conforme',
                    'Categoria'         => $category,
                    'Garantia'          => '90 dias contra defeitos de fabricação',
                    'Envio'             => 'Rastreamento Expresso com Seguro',
                    'Avaliações'        => "{$rating} estrelas ({$salesLabel})",
                    'Vendas_Informadas' => $ordersCountKnown ? 'sim' : 'nao',
                ];
                if (!empty($raw['sellingPoints']) && is_array($raw['sellingPoints'])) {
                    foreach ($raw['sellingPoints'] as $sp) {
                        $tagText = trim((string)($sp['tagContent']['tagText'] ?? ''));
                        if ($tagText !== '') {
                            $attributes['Destaque'] = $tagText;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $salesCopy = $this->aiEnricher->generateSalesCopy($polishedTitle, $attributes);

                $dto = new DropshipProductDto(
                    aliexpressId: $aeId,
                    title: $polishedTitle,
                    slug: $slug,
                    costPriceUsd: $costPriceUsd,
                    salePriceBrl: $salePriceBrl,
                    mainImageUrl: $mainImg,
                    images: $images,
                    category: $category,
                    description: $salesCopy,
                    rating: $rating,
                    ordersCount: $ordersCount,
                    attributes: $attributes,
                    status: 'published'
                );

                // Processamento com buffer transitório em arquivo com descarte imediato
                $savedDto = $this->processWithTransientBuffer(
                    $aeId,
                    $raw,
                    function () use ($dto, $autoPersist) {
                        if ($autoPersist) {
                            $savedId = $this->repository->save($dto);
                            return $this->repository->findById($savedId) ?? $dto;
                        }
                        return $dto;
                    }
                );

                $mined[] = $savedDto;
                $collected++;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Isolamento de falha individual de produto malformado
            }
        }

        return $mined;
    }

    /**
     * Executa requisição HTTPS para a página pública de busca com verificação estrita de certificado SSL.
     */
    protected function fetchLiveSearchHtml(string $searchUrl): ?string
    {
        $ch = curl_init($searchUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 6);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 4);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
            'Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8',
            'Accept-Language: pt-BR,pt;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
            'Cookie: aep_usuc_f=region=BR&site=bra&b_locale=pt_BR&c_tp=BRL; xman_us_f=x_locale=pt_BR; intl_locale=pt_BR;',
        ]);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        return is_string($html) && $html !== '' ? $html : null;
    }

    public function importSingleProduct(string|int $productIdOrUrl): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $inputStr = trim((string)$productIdOrUrl);

        // 1. Se for uma URL completa, tenta extrair em tempo real diretamente da página web oficial
        if (str_starts_with($inputStr, 'http://') || str_starts_with($inputStr, 'https://')) {
            $scraped = $this->linkScraper->scrape($inputStr);
            if ($scraped !== null) {
                return $this->createAndSaveDtoFromScraped($scraped);
            }
        }

        // 2. Extrai ID numérico
        $numericId = $inputStr;
        if (preg_match('/\/item\/(\d+)\.html/', $numericId, $matches)) {
            $numericId = $matches[1];
        } elseif (preg_match('/(\d{10,20})/', $numericId, $matches)) {
            $numericId = $matches[1];
        }

        // 3. Tenta via API Oficial (IOP SDK)
        $productData = null;
        try {
            $raw = $this->apiClient->getProductDetails($numericId);
            $productData = $raw['result'] 
                ?? ($raw['aliexpress_ds_product_get_response']['result'] ?? null);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $productData = null;
        }

        if (!empty($productData)) {
            $dto = $this->transformRawItemToDto($productData);
            $savedId = $this->repository->save($dto);
            return $this->repository->findById($savedId) ?? $dto;
        }

        // 4. Se a API não retornou dados, tenta scraper pelo ID numérico
        $scrapedById = $this->linkScraper->scrape($numericId);
        if ($scrapedById !== null) {
            return $this->createAndSaveDtoFromScraped($scrapedById);
        }

        // 5. Se for uma URL pública e nem o scraper nem a API encontraram o produto, o anúncio não existe (404)
        if (str_starts_with($inputStr, 'http://') || str_starts_with($inputStr, 'https://')) {
            throw new RuntimeException("O link informado não foi encontrado ou está desativado no AliExpress (Erro 404). Por favor, forneça o link de um anúncio ativo.");
        }

        // 6. Fallback estruturado para testes com IDs sintéticos
        $productData = $this->createFallbackItemFromIdOrUrl($numericId, (string)$productIdOrUrl);
        $dto = $this->transformRawItemToDto($productData);
        $savedId = $this->repository->save($dto);

        return $this->repository->findById($savedId) ?? $dto;
    }

    public function importFromBrowserSource(string $rawSource, ?string $category = null): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $rawSource = trim($rawSource);
        if ($rawSource === '') {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("O código-fonte ou texto do produto fornecido está vazio.");
        }

        // 1. Extração estruturada via Scraper Service
        $scraped = $this->linkScraper->parseRawHtml($rawSource);
        if ($scraped === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Não foi possível extrair os dados do produto do código colado. Verifique se copiou o código completo (Ctrl+U ou F12) de uma página de anúncio ativa do AliExpress.");
        }

        // 2. Processa com Buffer Transitório por Item com descarte imediato
        return $this->processWithTransientBuffer(
            $scraped->sourceId,
            [
                'source_id'  => $scraped->sourceId,
                'raw_title'  => $scraped->rawTitle,
                'main_image' => $scraped->mainImageUrl,
                'gallery'    => $scraped->galleryImages,
                'cost_usd'   => $scraped->costPriceUsd,
                'category'   => $category ?? $scraped->category,
                'attributes' => $scraped->attributes,
            ],
            function () use ($scraped, $category) {
                return $this->createAndSaveDtoFromScraped($scraped, $category);
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Gerencia um buffer transitório em arquivo por produto, com garantia de descarte imediato
     * e liberação de memória pelo coletor do PHP (gc_collect_cycles).
     * 
     * @param string $itemIdentifier ID do produto
     * @param array<string, mixed>|string $payload Dados brutos para armazenar temporariamente
     * @param callable $processor Função de transformação e persistência
     */
    private function processWithTransientBuffer(string $itemIdentifier, array|string $payload, callable $processor): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $tempDir = dirname(__DIR__, 4) . '/storage/cache/domain_drop_transient';
        if (!is_dir($tempDir)) {
            @mkdir($tempDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $sanitizedId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '', $itemIdentifier) ?: uniqid('item_');
        $tempFile = $tempDir . "/temp_item_{$sanitizedId}_" . hrtime(true) . ".json";

        try {
            $content = is_array($payload) ? json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) : $payload;
            file_put_contents($tempFile, $content, LOCK_EX);

            /** @var DropshipProductDto $dto */
            $dto = $processor($payload);

            return $dto;
        } finally {
            // Garante que o buffer transitório seja SEMPRE apagado imediatamente passo a passo
            if (file_exists($tempFile)) {
                @unlink($tempFile);
            }
            // Força a liberação de ciclos de memória do motor PHP
            gc_collect_cycles();
        }
    }

    private function createAndSaveDtoFromScraped(ScrapedProductDto $scraped, ?string $overrideCategory = null): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $category = $overrideCategory !== null ? self::normalizeCategory($overrideCategory) : self::normalizeCategory($scraped->category);
        $polishedTitle = $this->aiEnricher->polishTitle($scraped->rawTitle, $category);
        $slug = $this->slugify($polishedTitle . '-' . substr($scraped->sourceId, -4));
        $salePriceBrl = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePrice($scraped->costPriceUsd);
        $salesCopy = $this->aiEnricher->generateSalesCopy(
            "Produto importado oficial de alta durabilidade com compatibilidade e acabamento premium.",
            $scraped->attributes
        );

        $dto = new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: $scraped->sourceId,
            title: $polishedTitle,
            slug: $slug,
            costPriceUsd: $scraped->costPriceUsd,
            salePriceBrl: $salePriceBrl,
            mainImageUrl: $scraped->mainImageUrl,
            images: $scraped->getAllImages(),
            category: $category,
            description: $salesCopy,
            rating: $scraped->rating,
            ordersCount: $scraped->ordersCount,
            attributes: $scraped->attributes,
            status: 'published'
        );

        $savedId = $this->repository->save($dto);

        return $this->repository->findById($savedId) ?? $dto;
    }

    /**
     * Transforma o payload bruto do AliExpress em um DTO limpo e precificado.
     * Suporta tanto o payload oficial do IOP SDK (ae_item_base_info_dto, ae_multimedia_info_dto, ae_item_sku_info_dtos)
     * quanto feeds diretos, web scraping (imagePathList) e listas planas.
     * 
     * @param array<string, mixed> $item
     */
    private function transformRawItemToDto(array $item, string $defaultCategory = 'Eletrônicos & Gadget'): DropshipProductDto
    {
        $baseInfo = $item['ae_item_base_info_dto'] ?? [];
        $multiMedia = $item['ae_multimedia_info_dto'] ?? [];
        $skuDtos = $item['ae_item_sku_info_dtos']['ae_item_sku_info_d_t_o'] ?? ($item['ae_item_sku_info_dtos'] ?? []);

        $aeId = (string)($item['product_id'] ?? ($baseInfo['product_id'] ?? ($item['item_id'] ?? uniqid('ae_'))));
        $rawTitle = (string)($item['product_title'] ?? ($baseInfo['subject'] ?? ($item['title'] ?? 'Produto Internacional')));
        $rawCat = (string)($item['category_name'] ?? $defaultCategory);
        $category = self::normalizeCategory($rawCat);

        // 1. Higienização por I.A.
        $polishedTitle = $this->aiEnricher->polishTitle($rawTitle, $category);
        $slug = $this->slugify($polishedTitle . '-' . substr($aeId, -4));

        // 2. Extração de Imagens e Galeria Completa (Multi-Image Carousel)
        $rawMainImage = (string)($item['product_main_image_url'] ?? ($item['image_url'] ?? ''));
        $collectedImages = [];

        // 2.1 Da galeria oficial do IOP SDK (image_urls delimitado por ponto-e-vírgula ';')
        if (!empty($multiMedia['image_urls'])) {
            $splitUrls = is_array($multiMedia['image_urls']) ? $multiMedia['image_urls'] : explode(';', (string)$multiMedia['image_urls']);
            foreach ($splitUrls as $u) {
                $collectedImages[] = (string)$u;
            }
        }

        // 2.2 Da lista web de alta resolução (imagePathList)
        if (!empty($item['imagePathList']) && is_array($item['imagePathList'])) {
            foreach ($item['imagePathList'] as $u) {
                $collectedImages[] = (string)$u;
            }
        }

        // 2.3 Da chave direta images
        if (!empty($item['images']) && is_array($item['images'])) {
            foreach ($item['images'] as $u) {
                $collectedImages[] = (string)$u;
            }
        }

        // 2.4 De thumbnails oficiais da API de afiliados (product_small_image_urls)
        if (!empty($item['product_small_image_urls']['string'])) {
            $smallUrls = (array)$item['product_small_image_urls']['string'];
            foreach ($smallUrls as $u) {
                $collectedImages[] = (string)$u;
            }
        }

        // 2.5 De variantes/SKUs oficiais do AliExpress
        if (is_array($skuDtos)) {
            foreach ($skuDtos as $sku) {
                if (!empty($sku['sku_image_url'])) {
                    $collectedImages[] = (string)$sku['sku_image_url'];
                }
            }
        }

        // 2.6 Higienização, desduplicação e normalização para Full HD (remove sufixos de thumbnails _80x80.jpg)
        $images = [];
        if (!empty($rawMainImage)) {
            $cleanedMain = $this->cleanImageUrl($rawMainImage);
            $images[] = $cleanedMain;
            $mainImage = $cleanedMain;
        } else {
            $mainImage = '';
        }

        foreach ($collectedImages as $img) {
            $clean = $this->cleanImageUrl($img);
            if (!empty($clean) && !in_array($clean, $images, true)) {
                $images[] = $clean;
            }
        }

        if (empty($mainImage) && !empty($images)) {
            $mainImage = $images[0];
        }

        // 3. Precificação em Dólar e Conversão em Reais
        $costPriceUsd = (float)($item['target_sale_price'] ?? ($item['sale_price'] ?? ($item['original_price'] ?? 10.0)));
        $salePriceBrl = $this->currencyConverter->calculateSalePrice($costPriceUsd);

        // 4. Métricas e Atributos de Curadoria
        $rating = (float)($item['evaluate_rate'] ?? ($baseInfo['avg_evaluation_rating'] ?? 4.8));
        $effectiveRating = $rating > 0 ? $rating : 4.8;
        $ordersCount = (int)($item['volume'] ?? ($item['orders_count'] ?? 0));
        $thermometer = self::calculateThermometerScore($effectiveRating, $ordersCount);

        $props = is_array($item['properties'] ?? null) ? $item['properties'] : [];
        $props['curadoria_nota'] = number_format($effectiveRating, 1) . ' ★';
        $props['termometro_demanda'] = $thermometer . '%';
        if (!isset($props['ship_from'])) {
            $props['ship_from'] = 'BR';
            $props['origem_brasil'] = true;
        }

        $rawDesc = (string)($item['product_description'] ?? ($baseInfo['detail'] ?? ($item['description'] ?? '')));
        $salesCopy = $this->aiEnricher->generateSalesCopy($rawDesc, $props);

        return new DropshipProductDto(
            aliexpressId: $aeId,
            title: $polishedTitle,
            slug: $slug,
            costPriceUsd: $costPriceUsd,
            salePriceBrl: $salePriceBrl,
            mainImageUrl: $mainImage,
            images: $images,
            category: $category,
            description: $salesCopy,
            rating: $effectiveRating,
            ordersCount: $ordersCount,
            attributes: $props,
            status: 'published'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Limpa e padroniza a URL de imagem do AliExpress para máxima resolução.
     */
    private function cleanImageUrl(string $url): string
    {
        $url = trim($url);
        if ($url === '') {
            return '';
        }
        if (str_starts_with($url, '//')) {
            $url = 'https:' . $url;
        }
        // Remove sufixos de thumbnails como _80x80.jpg, _50x50.jpg, etc.
        $url = (string)preg_replace('/_[0-9]+x[0-9]+\.(?:jpg|png|webp|jpeg)$/i', '', $url);

        return $url;
    }

    private function slugify(string $text): string
    {
        $str = mb_strtolower(trim($text), 'UTF-8');
        // Normaliza caracteres acentuados para URLs limpas (sem 'port-til' ou 'tit-nio')
        $str = preg_replace(
            ['/[áàãâä]/u', '/[éèêë]/u', '/[íìîï]/u', '/[óòõôö]/u', '/[úùûü]/u', '/[ç]/u', '/[ñ]/u'],
            ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', 'c', 'n'],
            $str
        ) ?? $str;
        $str = (string)preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/i', '-', $str);

        return trim($str, '-') ?: 'produto-dropship';
    }

                        'https://ae-pic-a1.aliexpress-media.com/kf/Se8423334ceed4803a5171b1b8dd7d485n.jpg',
                    ],
                    'evaluate_rate' => '4.9',
                    'volume' => 9600,
                    'product_description' => 'Design anatômico flexível com cabeça inclinável e vibrações concentradas para massagens relaxantes corporais e íntimas.',
                    'properties' => ['Classificação' => '🔞 Adulto (+18)', 'Velocidades' => '5 Frequências Ajustáveis', 'Carregador' => 'Cabo USB Incluso', 'Envio' => '100% Discreto'],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        // Mapeia apelidos para a categoria oficial do pool
        $normalizedCat = self::normalizeCategory($category);
        $pool = $catalog[$normalizedCat] ?? ($catalog[$category] ?? $catalog['Eletrônicos & Gadget'] ?? $catalog['Eletrônicos']);

        // Se o limite solicitado for maior que o pool da categoria, completa com itens de outras categorias
        if (count($pool) < $limit) {
            foreach ($catalog as $catName => $items) {
                if ($catName !== $category) {
                    foreach ($items as $extraItem) {
                        $pool[] = $extraItem;
                        if (count($pool) >= $limit) {
                            break 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ordena pelo critério de reputação solicitado: maior volume de vendas ou maior avaliação por estrelas
        if ($sort === 'evaluate_rate_desc') {
            usort($pool, fn($a, $b) => ((float)($b['evaluate_rate'] ?? 0)) <=> ((float)($a['evaluate_rate'] ?? 0)));
        } else {
            usort($pool, fn($a, $b) => ((int)($b['volume'] ?? 0)) <=> ((int)($a['volume'] ?? 0)));
        }

        $slice = array_slice($pool, 0, $limit);
        foreach ($slice as &$p) {
            $p['category_name'] = $normalizedCat;
        }
        unset($p);

        return $slice;
    }

    /**
     * Gera estrutura de dados de fallback inteligente para um ID ou URL informada.
     * Tenta primeiro extrair dados reais (título, galeria HD imagePathList e preço) diretamente da página web.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function createFallbackItemFromIdOrUrl(string $productId, string $url): array
    {
        $liveWebData = $this->fetchProductDataFromWeb($productId, $url);
        if ($liveWebData !== null) {
            return $liveWebData;
        }

        $title = 'Produto Importado AliExpress ' . $productId;
        $category = 'Geral';

        // Tenta inferir o título a partir da URL
        if (preg_match('/item\/\d+-([^.]+)\.html/i', $url, $m)) {
            $words = explode('-', $m[1]);
            $title = ucwords(implode(' ', array_filter($words)));
            if (stripos($url, 'watch') !== false || stripos($url, 'relogio') !== false) {
                $category = 'Eletrônicos';
            } elseif (stripos($url, 'fone') !== false || stripos($url, 'earphone') !== false) {
                $category = 'Eletrônicos';
            } elseif (stripos($url, 'lamp') !== false || stripos($url, 'luz') !== false) {
                $category = 'Casa Inteligente';
            }
        }

        return [
            'product_id' => $productId,
            'product_title' => $title,
            'category_name' => $category,
            'target_sale_price' => '14.00',
            'product_main_image_url' => 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526738549149-8e07eca6c147?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
            'evaluate_rate' => '4.8',
            'volume' => 2400,
            'product_description' => "Produto de alta qualidade importado diretamente do fabricante com envio rastreado.",
            'properties' => ['Garantia' => 'Internacional', 'Envio' => 'Rastreio Oficial'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Extrai dados em tempo real diretamente do HTML da página pública do AliExpress.
     * Captura título limpo, imagem de capa, galeria Full HD (imagePathList) e precificação via pdp_npi.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    private function fetchProductDataFromWeb(string $productId, string $url): ?array
    {
        $targetUrl = str_starts_with($url, 'http') ? $url : "https://pt.aliexpress.com/item/{$productId}.html";

        $ch = curl_init($targetUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 8);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        $html = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if (!$html || !is_string($html)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Descarta se for página de desafio anti-bot ou link quebrado
        if (stripos($html, 'Arraste o controle deslizante') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'sec.aliexpress.com') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'punish') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'baxia') !== false
            || stripos($html, 'Página não encontrada') !== false
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        $title = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:title" content="([^"]+)"/i', $html, $m)) {
            $title = html_entity_decode(preg_replace('/\s*-\s*AliExpress.*$/i', '', $m[1]));
        }

        $mainImage = '';
        if (preg_match('/<meta property="og:image" content="([^"]+)"/i', $html, $m)) {
            $mainImage = $m[1];
        }

        $images = [];
        if (preg_match('/"imagePathList":(\[[^\]]+\])/', $html, $m)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($m[1], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $images = $decoded;
            }
        }

        if (empty($title) && empty($mainImage) && empty($images)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Tenta inferir preço da query string (pdp_npi) ou HTML
        $costPriceUsd = 12.00;
        $decodedUrl = urldecode($targetUrl . ' ' . $html);
        if (preg_match('/dis!([A-Z]{3})![0-9.]+!([0-9.]+)/i', $decodedUrl, $pm)) {
            $currency = strtoupper($pm[1]);
            $promoVal = (float)$pm[2];
            if ($currency === 'BRL') {
                $costPriceUsd = round($promoVal / 5.25, 2);
            } elseif ($currency === 'USD') {
                $costPriceUsd = $promoVal;
            }
        }

        // Categoria inteligente
        $category = 'Eletrônicos';
        if (stripos($title, 'pulseira') !== false || stripos($title, 'watch') !== false || stripos($title, 'relogio') !== false) {
            $category = 'Eletrônicos';
        } elseif (stripos($title, 'beleza') !== false || stripos($title, 'cabelo') !== false || stripos($title, 'pele') !== false) {
            $category = 'Beleza & Estilo';
        } elseif (stripos($title, 'luminaria') !== false || stripos($title, 'casa') !== false || stripos($title, 'quarto') !== false) {
            $category = 'Casa Inteligente';
        }

        return [
            'product_id' => $productId,
            'product_title' => $title ?: ('Produto AliExpress ' . $productId),
            'category_name' => $category,
            'target_sale_price' => (string)$costPriceUsd,
            'product_main_image_url' => $mainImage,
            'images' => $images,
            'imagePathList' => $images,
            'evaluate_rate' => '4.8',
            'volume' => 1350,
            'product_description' => "Produto importado oficial de alta durabilidade com compatibilidade e acabamento premium.",
            'properties' => [
                'Origem' => 'Importação Oficial',
                'Garantia' => 'Garantia do Fabricante',
                'Envio' => 'Rastreamento Internacional Expresso',
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Executa o ciclo de rotação diária automatizada de 24 horas.
     * Minera produtos virais aleatórios para todas as 9 categorias oficiais,
     * atualiza o catálogo, registra a data/hora de conclusão e retorna o resumo estatístico.
     *
     * @param int $itemsPerCategory Quantidade de novos produtos minerados por categoria
     * @return array<string, mixed> Resumo da rodada executada
     */
    public function runDailyAutomatedRotation(int $itemsPerCategory = 4): array
    {
        $lockPath = $this->getConfigFilePath() . '.rotation.lock';
        $lockDir = dirname($lockPath);
        if (!is_dir($lockDir)) {
            @mkdir($lockDir, 0775, true);
        }

        $lockHandle = @fopen($lockPath, 'c+');
        if ($lockHandle === false) {
            return [
                'success'         => false,
                'skipped'         => true,
                'reason'          => 'lock_file_unavailable',
                'executed_at'     => 0,
                'total_mined'     => 0,
                'category_counts' => [],
            ];
        }

        if (!flock($lockHandle, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            fclose($lockHandle);
            return [
                'success'         => false,
                'skipped'         => true,
                'reason'          => 'rotation_already_running',
                'executed_at'     => 0,
                'total_mined'     => 0,
                'category_counts' => [],
            ];
        }

        try {
            $results = [];
            $totalProducts = 0;

            foreach (self::OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES as $cat) {
                try {
                    $mined = $this->mineTrendingProducts(category: $cat, limit: $itemsPerCategory, autoPersist: true);
                    $count = count($mined);
                    $results[$cat] = $count;
                    $totalProducts += $count;
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    $results[$cat] = 0;
                }
            }

            // Registra a conclusão do ciclo de 24 horas
            $now = time();
            $this->updateConfigField('last_daily_cycle_at', $now);

            return [
                'success'         => true,
                'skipped'         => false,
                'executed_at'     => $now,
                'executed_date'   => date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $now),
                'total_mined'     => $totalProducts,
                'category_counts' => $results,
            ];
        } finally {
            flock($lockHandle, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($lockHandle);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retorna os metadados do ciclo diário de 24 horas:
     * timestamp da última execução, próxima execução, segundos restantes, tempo formatado (HH:MM:SS),
     * status se expirado (is_due) e estatísticas de produtos por categoria.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function getDailyCycleInfo(): array
    {
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $intervalSeconds = (int)($config['cycle_interval_seconds'] ?? 86400); // 24 horas padrão
        if ($intervalSeconds <= 0) {
            $intervalSeconds = 86400;
        }

        $lastCycleAt = isset($config['last_daily_cycle_at']) && is_numeric($config['last_daily_cycle_at'])
            ? (int)$config['last_daily_cycle_at']
            : 0;

        $now = time();
        $autoSyncEnabled = !isset($config['auto_sync_enabled']) || !empty($config['auto_sync_enabled']);

        if ($lastCycleAt <= 0) {
            // Se nunca executou, marca como vencido para disparar a primeira rodada
            $nextCycleAt = $now;
            $secondsRemaining = 0;
            $isDue = true;
        } else {
            $nextCycleAt = $lastCycleAt + $intervalSeconds;
            $secondsRemaining = max(0, $nextCycleAt - $now);
            $isDue = ($secondsRemaining === 0);
        }

        $hours = (int)floor($secondsRemaining / 3600);
        $minutes = (int)floor(($secondsRemaining % 3600) / 60);
        $seconds = (int)($secondsRemaining % 60);
        $formatted = sprintf('%02d:%02d:%02d', $hours, $minutes, $seconds);

        return [
            'last_cycle_at'       => $lastCycleAt,
            'last_cycle_date'     => $lastCycleAt > 0 ? date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $lastCycleAt) : 'Pendente de primeira execução',
            'next_cycle_at'       => $nextCycleAt,
            'next_cycle_date'     => date('d/m/Y H:i:s', $nextCycleAt),
            'interval_seconds'    => $intervalSeconds,
            'seconds_remaining'   => $secondsRemaining,
            'formatted_remaining' => $formatted,
            'is_due'              => $isDue,
            'auto_sync_enabled'   => $autoSyncEnabled,
            'official_categories' => self::OFFICIAL_CATEGORIES,
        ];
    }

    private function getConfigFilePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->configFilePath !== null) {
            return $this->configFilePath;
        }
        $root = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);
        return $root . '/config/plugins/domain_drop.json';
    }

    private function loadConfig(): array
    {
        $file = $this->getConfigFilePath();
        if (file_exists($file)) {
            $content = @file_get_contents($file);
            if ($content !== false) {
                $data = json_decode($content, true);
                if (is_array($data)) {
                    return $data;
                }
            }
        }
        return [
            'enabled'                => true,
            'auto_sync_enabled'      => true,
            'cycle_interval_seconds' => 86400,
        ];
    }

    private function updateConfigField(string $key, mixed $value): void
    {
        $file = $this->getConfigFilePath();
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $config[$key] = $value;
        $dir = dirname($file);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
        }
        @file_put_contents($file, json_encode($config, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\domain_drop\Services\SellerMediationService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\domain_drop\Contracts\DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\EmailSenderInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de Intermediação de Reclamações com Fornecedor (1 clique no admin).
 * Mantém português para fornecedores brasileiros e traduz para chinês simplificado (zh-CN)
 * quando o fornecedor for da China/Internacional.
 */
class SellerMediationService
{
    /** @var callable|null */
    private $translatorCallback;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly DropshipDisputeRepositoryInterface $disputeRepo,
        private readonly ?EmailSenderInterface $mailer = null,
        ?callable $translatorCallback = null
    ) {
        $this->translatorCallback = $translatorCallback;
    }

    /**
     * Monta, traduz (se chinês) e registra/envia a intermediação ao vendedor em 1 chamada.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $order
     * @param array<string, mixed> $dispute
     * @param string $baseUrl
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function sendMediation(array $order, array $dispute, string $baseUrl = ''): array
    {
        $sellerOrigin = strtoupper(trim((string)($dispute['seller_origin'] ?: ($order['seller_origin'] ?? 'CN'))));
        if ($sellerOrigin !== 'BR') {
            $sellerOrigin = 'CN';
        }

        $language = $sellerOrigin === 'BR' ? 'pt-BR' : 'zh-CN';
        $message = $this->composeMessage($order, $dispute, $language, $baseUrl);

        $sellerEmail = trim((string)($dispute['seller_email'] ?: ($order['seller_email'] ?? '')));
        $channel = 'aliexpress_mediation_log';
        $emailDispatched = false;

        if ($sellerEmail !== '' && filter_var($sellerEmail, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false && $this->mailer !== null) {
            $subject = $language === 'zh-CN'
                ? '[售后订单协助] 订单 ' . (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '') . ' 客户反馈处理'
                : '[Mediação de Pedido] ' . (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '') . ' - Reclamação de Cliente';
            try {
                $this->mailer->send($sellerEmail, $subject, $message);
                $channel = 'email';
                $emailDispatched = true;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Registra como disponível no painel sem interromper a operação do administrador.
                $channel = 'email_fallback_log';
            }
        }

        $disputeId = (int)($dispute['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($disputeId > 0) {
            $this->disputeRepo->markMediationSent($disputeId, $language, $message, $channel);
        }

        return [
            'success'           => true,
            'dispute_id'        => $disputeId,
            'seller_origin'     => $sellerOrigin,
            'seller_language'   => $language,
            'channel'           => $channel,
            'email_dispatched'  => $emailDispatched,
            'translated_message'=> $message,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Gera a mensagem completa de intermediação no idioma do fornecedor.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $order
     * @param array<string, mixed> $dispute
     */
    public function composeMessage(array $order, array $dispute, string $language, string $baseUrl = ''): string
    {
        $orderRef = (string)($order['order_ref'] ?? '');
        $aeOrderId = (string)($order['aliexpress_order_id'] ?? 'N/A');
        $trackingCode = (string)($order['tracking_code'] ?? 'N/A');
        $reasonCode = (string)($dispute['reason'] ?? 'produto_danificado');
        $descriptionPt = trim((string)($dispute['description'] ?? ''));
        $attachments = is_array($dispute['attachments'] ?? null) ? $dispute['attachments'] : [];
        $disputeId = (int)($dispute['id'] ?? 0);

        $attachmentLines = [];
        foreach ($attachments as $att) {
            if (!is_array($att)) {
                continue;
            }
            $file = (string)($att['filename'] ?? '');
            $orig = (string)($att['original_name'] ?? $file);
            if ($file === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $url = rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . '/dropship/disputes/attachment/' . $disputeId . '/' . rawurlencode($file);
            $attachmentLines[] = "- {$orig}: {$url}";
        }
        $evidenceText = $attachmentLines !== []
            ? implode("\n", $attachmentLines)
            : ($language === 'zh-CN' ? '暂无附件' : 'Nenhum arquivo anexado.');

        if ($language === 'pt-BR') {
            $reasonPt = $this->reasonLabelPt($reasonCode);

            return implode("\n", [
                "Prezado Fornecedor (Brasil),",
                "Encaminhamos uma solicitação de intermediação de pós-venda aberta pelo cliente comprador.",
                "",
                "Pedido Loja: {$orderRef}",
                "Pedido AliExpress: {$aeOrderId}",
                "Código de Rastreio: {$trackingCode}",
                "Motivo: {$reasonPt}",
                "",
                "Descrição do Problema (Cliente):",
                $descriptionPt,
                "",
                "Evidências / Fotos / PDF:",
                $evidenceText,
                "",
                "Solicitamos retorno com orientação de reembolso, troca ou solução amigável dentro do prazo de garantia.",
            ]);
        }

        $translatedProblem = $this->translatePortugueseToChinese($descriptionPt);
        $reasonZh = $this->reasonLabelZh($reasonCode);

        return implode("\n", [
            "尊敬的供应商您好：",
            "我们收到买家的售后服务/退款沟通请求，请协助核实并处理以下订单问题：",
            "",
            "店铺订单号 (Loja): {$orderRef}",
            "速卖通订单号 (AliExpress Order ID): {$aeOrderId}",
            "物流追踪号 (Tracking): {$trackingCode}",
            "问题类型: {$reasonZh}",
            "",
            "问题详情（中文翻译）:",
            $translatedProblem,
            "",
            "客户原始反馈 (Original PT-BR):",
            $descriptionPt,
            "",
            "买家提供的凭证（图片 / PDF 文件）:",
            $evidenceText,
            "",
            "请告知补发、部分退款或全额退款方案，谢谢您的配合！",
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Traduz frases e termos comuns de reclamação PT-BR para Chinês Simplificado (zh-CN).
     */
    public function translatePortugueseToChinese(string $text): string
    {
        if ($this->translatorCallback !== null) {
            $custom = (string)call_user_func($this->translatorCallback, $text);
            if (trim($custom) !== '') {
                return $custom;
            }
        }

        $normalized = trim($text);
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return '买家反馈商品存在问题，请协助核实。';
        }

        $dictionary = [
            'produto danificado'       => '商品损坏',
            'chegou com dano'          => '到货时已损坏',
            'chegou quebrado'          => '到货时已破损',
            'veio quebrado'            => '收到时已破损',
            'embalagem violada'        => '外包装破损',
            'embalagem amassada'       => '包装严重变形',
            'entrega atrasada'         => '物流严重延迟',
            'atraso na entrega'        => '配送超时延迟',
            'nao chegou'               => '尚未收到包裹',
            'não chegou'               => '尚未收到包裹',
            'pacote perdido'           => '包裹疑似丢失',
            'produto errado'           => '发错商品',
            'item errado'              => '商品与下单不符',
            'cor errada'               => '颜色错误',
            'tamanho errado'           => '尺寸/尺码错误',
            'nao funciona'             => '无法正常使用',
            'não funciona'             => '无法正常使用',
            'com defeito'              => '存在功能缺陷',
            'faltando peças'           => '缺少零件或配件',
            'faltando acessorios'      => '缺少配件',
            'faltando acessórios'      => '缺少配件',
            'solicito reembolso'       => '申请退款',
            'quero reembolso'          => '要求全额退款',
            'reembolso total'          => '全额退款',
            'troca do produto'         => '申请换货/补发',
            'em anexo'                 => '详见附件照片/PDF',
            'segue foto'               => '已附实拍照片',
            'segue pdf'                => '已附PDF证明文件',
            'vidro quebrado'           => '玻璃已碎裂',
            'tela trincada'            => '屏幕破裂',
            'arranhado'                => '表面有划痕',
            'molhado'                  => '商品受潮进水',
        ];

        $lower = mb_strtolower($normalized, 'UTF-8');
        $matchedSegments = [];
        foreach ($dictionary as $pt => $zh) {
            if (str_contains($lower, $pt)) {
                $matchedSegments[] = $zh;
            }
        }

        $unique = array_values(array_unique($matchedSegments));
        if ($unique !== []) {
            return '核心问题：' . implode('；', $unique) . '。';
        }

        return '买家反馈订单存在售后问题，请结合附件图片/PDF与原始葡语说明核实处理。';
    }

    private function reasonLabelPt(string $reason): string
    {
        return match ($reason) {
            'produto_danificado' => 'Produto Danificado / Avaria',
            'entrega_atrasada'   => 'Entrega em Atraso / Extravio',
            'item_errado'        => 'Produto Diferente / Incompleto',
            'arrependimento'     => 'Devolução / Garantia 7 a 15 Dias',
            default              => 'Solicitação de Suporte / Reembolso',
        };
    }

    private function reasonLabelZh(string $reason): string
    {
        return match ($reason) {
            'produto_danificado' => '商品损坏 / 运输受损',
            'entrega_atrasada'   => '物流延迟 / 包裹疑丢失',
            'item_errado'        => '错发 / 漏发商品',
            'arrependimento'     => '退货退款申请 (7-15天无理由/售后)',
            default              => '订单售后协商 / 退款请求',
        };
    }
}

<?php
/**

    <script>
    (function() {
        var adminRemSeconds = <?= $adminRemSeconds ?>;
        var hElem = document.getElementById('adminTimerH');
        var mElem = document.getElementById('adminTimerM');
        var sElem = document.getElementById('adminTimerS');
        var form = document.getElementById('formRunDailyCycle');
        var btn = document.getElementById('btnRunDailyCycle');

        if (form && btn) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.style.opacity = '0.7';
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Minerando 6 Categorias no AliExpress...';
            });
        }

        setInterval(function() {
            if (adminRemSeconds <= 0) {
                if (hElem) hElem.textContent = '00';
                if (mElem) mElem.textContent = '00';
                if (sElem) sElem.textContent = '00';
                return;
            }
            adminRemSeconds--;
            var h = Math.floor(adminRemSeconds / 3600);
            var m = Math.floor((adminRemSeconds % 3600) / 60);
            var s = adminRemSeconds % 60;
            if (hElem) hElem.textContent = String(h).padStart(2, '0');
            if (mElem) mElem.textContent = String(m).padStart(2, '0');
            if (sElem) sElem.textContent = String(s).padStart(2, '0');
        }, 1000);
    })();
    </script>

        @keyframes dsModalIn {

    <script>
        const systemExchangeRate = <?= (float)$rate ?>;
        const baseAdminUrl = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/dropship';

        function openPriceModal(id, title, costUsd, costBrl, saleBrl) {
            document.getElementById('modalProductId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('modalProductTitle').innerText = title;
            document.getElementById('modalProductTitle').title = title;
            document.getElementById('priceEditForm').action = baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + id + '/price';

            document.getElementById('modalCostBrl').value = parseFloat(costBrl).toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value = parseFloat(saleBrl).toFixed(2);

            recalcMargin();
            var modal = document.getElementById('priceEditModal');
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closePriceModal() {
            var modal = document.getElementById('priceEditModal');
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closePriceModal();
                closeImagesModal();
            }
        });

        document.getElementById('priceEditModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) closePriceModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('imagesEditModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) closeImagesModal();
        });

        function recalcMargin() {
            const costBrl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalCostBrl').value) || 0;
            const saleBrl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value) || 0;

            const costUsd = (systemExchangeRate > 0) ? (costBrl / systemExchangeRate) : 0;
            document.getElementById('modalCostUsdHint').innerText = '$' + costUsd.toFixed(2);

            const profit = saleBrl - costBrl;
            const margin = saleBrl > 0 ? ((profit / saleBrl) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;

            const profitEl = document.getElementById('modalProfitBrl');
            const marginEl = document.getElementById('modalMarginPercent');

            profitEl.innerText = (profit >= 0 ? '+R$ ' : '-R$ ') + Math.abs(profit).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
            profitEl.style.color = profit >= 0 ? '#5cd67d' : '#ef4444';

            marginEl.innerText = margin + '%';
            marginEl.style.color = margin >= 0 ? '#45f3ff' : '#ef4444';
        }

        function applyMarkup(percent) {
            const costBrl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalCostBrl').value) || 0;
            if (costBrl > 0) {
                const newSale = costBrl * (1 + (percent / 100));
                document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value = newSale.toFixed(2);
                recalcMargin();
            }
        }

        function roundTo90() {
            let sale = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value) || 0;
            if (sale > 0) {
                let rounded = Math.floor(sale) + 0.90;
                if (rounded < sale && (sale - rounded) > 0.4) {
                    rounded += 1;
                }
                document.getElementById('modalSaleBrl').value = rounded.toFixed(2);
                recalcMargin();
            }
        }

        function handlePriceSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const form = document.getElementById('priceEditForm');
            const id = document.getElementById('modalProductId').value;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnSavePrice');
            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Salvando...';

            const formData = new FormData(form);
            formData.append('ajax', '1');

            fetch(form.action, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: formData
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                if (data && data.success) {
                    // Atualiza os valores visuais no card na hora
                    const saleEl = document.getElementById('prod-sale-brl-' + id);
                    if (saleEl) saleEl.innerText = data.sale_formatted;

                    const costBrlEl = document.getElementById('prod-cost-brl-' + id);
                    if (costBrlEl) costBrlEl.innerText = data.cost_formatted;

                    const costUsdEl = document.getElementById('prod-cost-usd-' + id);
                    if (costUsdEl) costUsdEl.innerText = '$' + parseFloat(data.cost_price_usd).toFixed(2);

                    closePriceModal();
                    alert(data.message);
                } else {
                    alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao salvar preço.');
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                // Fallback para envio padrão se fetch falhar
                form.submit();
            });
        }

        <?php
        $mediaMap = [];
        foreach ($products as $p) {
            if ($p->id === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $imgs = !empty($p->images) ? array_values($p->images) : [];
            if (!empty($p->mainImageUrl) && !in_array($p->mainImageUrl, $imgs, true)) {
                array_unshift($imgs, $p->mainImageUrl);
            }
            $mediaMap[(string)(int)$p->id] = [
                'id'           => (int)$p->id,
                'title'        => (string)$p->title,
                'aliexpressId' => (string)$p->aliexpressId,
                'mainImageUrl' => (string)($p->mainImageUrl ?: ($imgs[0] ?? '')),
                'images'       => $imgs,
            ];
        }
        ?>
        const dropshipCsrfToken = <?= json_encode($csrfToken, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;
        const dropshipProductsMedia = <?= json_encode($mediaMap, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) ?>;
        let activeImagesState = { id: null, title: '', aliexpressId: '', mainImageUrl: '', images: [] };

        function setImagesModalStatus(msg, type) {
            const el = document.getElementById('imagesModalStatus');
            if (!el) return;
            if (!msg) {
                el.style.display = 'none';
                el.textContent = '';
                return;
            }
            el.style.display = 'block';
            el.textContent = msg;
            if (type === 'error') {
                el.style.background = 'rgba(220,50,50,0.16)';
                el.style.border = '1px solid #dc3232';
                el.style.color = '#ff8080';
            } else if (type === 'info') {
                el.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.12)';
                el.style.border = '1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.4)';
                el.style.color = '#45f3ff';
            } else {
                el.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.16)';
                el.style.border = '1px solid #28a745';
                el.style.color = '#5cd67d';
            }
        }

        function openImagesModal(id) {
            const item = dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)];
            if (!item) return;

            activeImagesState = {
                id: item.id,
                title: item.title,
                aliexpressId: item.aliexpressId,
                mainImageUrl: item.mainImageUrl,
                images: Array.isArray(item.images) ? item.images.slice() : []
            };

            document.getElementById('imagesModalTitle').textContent = activeImagesState.title;
            document.getElementById('imagesModalTitle').title = activeImagesState.title;
            document.getElementById('imagesModalAeLink').href = 'https://www.aliexpress.com/item/' + encodeURIComponent(activeImagesState.aliexpressId) + '.html';
            document.getElementById('imagesModalNewUrl').value = '';
            setImagesModalStatus('', 'info');
            renderImagesModalGrid();

            document.getElementById('imagesEditModal').style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeImagesModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('imagesEditModal');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function renderImagesModalGrid() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('imagesModalGrid');
            if (!grid) return;
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            if (!activeImagesState.images.length) {
                const empty = document.createElement('div');
                empty.style.cssText = 'grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 26px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 13px;';
                empty.textContent = 'Nenhuma imagem cadastrada ainda. Clique em "Sincronizar do AliExpress" ou cole uma URL abaixo.';
                grid.appendChild(empty);
                return;
            }

            activeImagesState.images.forEach(function(url, idx) {
                const isMain = (url === activeImagesState.mainImageUrl);

                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.style.cssText = 'background: #0b0f17; border: 1px solid ' + (isMain ? '#fbbf24' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)') + '; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;';

                const thumbWrap = document.createElement('div');
                thumbWrap.style.cssText = 'position: relative; width: 100%; height: 120px; background: #070a10;';

                const img = document.createElement('img');
                img.src = url;
                img.alt = 'Foto ' + (idx + 1);
                img.style.cssText = 'width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;';
                thumbWrap.appendChild(img);

                if (isMain) {
                    const badge = document.createElement('span');
                    badge.style.cssText = 'position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; background: #fbbf24; color: #0b0f17; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;';
                    badge.textContent = 'CAPA';
                    thumbWrap.appendChild(badge);
                }

                const openLink = document.createElement('a');
                openLink.href = url;
                openLink.target = '_blank';
                openLink.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
                openLink.title = 'Abrir imagem em tamanho original';
                openLink.style.cssText = 'position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: #45f3ff; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 11px; text-decoration: none;';
                openLink.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i>';
                thumbWrap.appendChild(openLink);

                const actions = document.createElement('div');
                actions.style.cssText = 'padding: 8px; display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;';

                const coverBtn = document.createElement('button');
                coverBtn.type = 'button';
                coverBtn.disabled = isMain;
                coverBtn.style.cssText = 'flex: 1; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: ' + (isMain ? 'default' : 'pointer') + '; border: 1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.35); background: ' + (isMain ? 'rgba(251,191,36,0.18)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)') + '; color: ' + (isMain ? '#fbbf24' : '#cbd5e1') + ';';
                coverBtn.textContent = isMain ? 'Capa Atual' : 'Definir Capa';
                coverBtn.onclick = function() {
                    activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = url;
                    renderImagesModalGrid();
                };

                const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
                delBtn.type = 'button';
                delBtn.title = 'Remover foto da galeria';
                delBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35); background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); color: #ef4444;';
                delBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i>';
                delBtn.onclick = function() {
                    activeImagesState.images.splice(idx, 1);
                    if (activeImagesState.mainImageUrl === url) {
                        activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = activeImagesState.images[0] || '';
                    }
                    renderImagesModalGrid();
                };

                actions.appendChild(coverBtn);
                actions.appendChild(delBtn);
                card.appendChild(thumbWrap);
                card.appendChild(actions);
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function addManualImageUrl() {
            const input = document.getElementById('imagesModalNewUrl');
            const raw = (input ? input.value : '').trim();
            if (!/^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(raw)) {
                setImagesModalStatus('Informe uma URL válida começando com http:// ou https://', 'error');
                return;
            }
            if (!activeImagesState.images.includes(raw)) {
                activeImagesState.images.push(raw);
            }
            if (!activeImagesState.mainImageUrl) {
                activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = raw;
            }
            input.value = '';
            setImagesModalStatus('Imagem adicionada à prévia. Clique em "Salvar Galeria" para gravar.', 'info');
            renderImagesModalGrid();
        }

        function updateCardImagesUi(id, mainUrl, imagesList) {
            const imgEl = document.getElementById('prod-main-img-' + id);
            if (imgEl && mainUrl) {
                imgEl.src = mainUrl;
            }
            const badge = document.getElementById('prod-imgs-badge-' + id);
            const countEl = document.getElementById('prod-imgs-count-' + id);
            const count = Array.isArray(imagesList) ? imagesList.length : 0;
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = String(count);
            if (badge) badge.style.display = count > 1 ? 'flex' : 'none';

            if (dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)]) {
                dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)].mainImageUrl = mainUrl;
                dropshipProductsMedia[String(id)].images = imagesList.slice();
            }
        }

        function syncImagesNow() {
            if (!activeImagesState.id) return;
            const id = activeImagesState.id;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnSyncImagesNow');
            const origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Sincronizando...';
            setImagesModalStatus('Consultando fotos oficiais direto do AliExpress...', 'info');

            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('csrf_token', dropshipCsrfToken);
            fd.append('ajax', '1');

            fetch(baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + id + '/sync-images', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: fd
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                if (data && data.success) {
                    activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = data.main_image_url || '';
                    activeImagesState.images = Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : [];
                    renderImagesModalGrid();
                    updateCardImagesUi(id, activeImagesState.mainImageUrl, activeImagesState.images);
                    setImagesModalStatus(data.message || 'Imagens sincronizadas com sucesso!', 'success');
                } else {
                    setImagesModalStatus((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'O AliExpress bloqueou a coleta automática neste item. Você pode adicionar URLs de fotos manualmente abaixo.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                setImagesModalStatus('Erro de comunicação ao sincronizar imagens.', 'error');
            });
        }

        function handleImagesSave() {
            if (!activeImagesState.id) return;
            const id = activeImagesState.id;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnSaveImagesGallery');
            const origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Salvando...';

            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('csrf_token', dropshipCsrfToken);
            fd.append('ajax', '1');
            fd.append('main_image_url', activeImagesState.mainImageUrl || '');
            fd.append('images_json', JSON.stringify(activeImagesState.images || []));

            fetch(baseAdminUrl + '/product/' + id + '/images', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: fd
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                if (data && data.success) {
                    activeImagesState.mainImageUrl = data.main_image_url || '';
                    activeImagesState.images = Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : [];
                    renderImagesModalGrid();
                    updateCardImagesUi(id, activeImagesState.mainImageUrl, activeImagesState.images);
                    setImagesModalStatus(data.message || 'Galeria salva com sucesso!', 'success');
                } else {
                    setImagesModalStatus((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao salvar galeria.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
                setImagesModalStatus('Erro de comunicação ao salvar galeria.', 'error');
            });
        }
    </script>
</div>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var btnTest = document.getElementById('btnTestAliExpressConn');
        var resultBox = document.getElementById('connResultBox');
        var badge = document.getElementById('connBadge');
        var iconBadge = document.getElementById('connIconBadge');
        var title = document.getElementById('connTitle');

        if (!btnTest) return;

        btnTest.addEventListener('click', function() {
            var appKeyInput = document.querySelector('input[name="app_key"]');
            var appSecretInput = document.querySelector('input[name="app_secret"]');
            var accessTokenInput = document.querySelector('input[name="access_token"]');
            var csrfInput = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]');

            var originalHtml = btnTest.innerHTML;
            btnTest.disabled = true;
            btnTest.style.opacity = '0.7';
            btnTest.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Testando Conexão...';

            resultBox.style.display = 'block';
            resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.08)';
            resultBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.25)';
            resultBox.style.color = '#cbd5e1';
            resultBox.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sync fa-spin" style="color: #45f3ff;"></i> Enviando pacote criptográfico assinado com HMAC-SHA256 para o gateway api-sg.aliexpress.com...';

            var formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('csrf_token', csrfInput ? csrfInput.value : '');
            formData.append('app_key', appKeyInput ? appKeyInput.value : '');
            formData.append('app_secret', appSecretInput ? appSecretInput.value : '');
            formData.append('access_token', accessTokenInput ? accessTokenInput.value : '');
            formData.append('ajax', '1');

            fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/dropship/test-connection', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: {
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                }
            })
            .then(function(res) {
                return res.json().catch(function() {
                    return { success: false, status: 'error', message: 'Erro na resposta HTTP (' + res.status + ')' };
                });
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                btnTest.disabled = false;
                btnTest.style.opacity = '1';
                btnTest.innerHTML = originalHtml;

                if (data.status === 'ok' || data.success === true) {
                    // ✔️ Conexão OK
                    badge.textContent = '✔️ Conectado & Operante';
                    badge.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.2)';
                    badge.style.color = '#5cd67d';
                    badge.style.border = '1px solid rgba(40,167,69,0.4)';

                    iconBadge.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.2)';
                    iconBadge.style.borderColor = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.4)';
                    iconBadge.style.color = '#5cd67d';
                    iconBadge.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>';

                    resultBox.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.12)';
                    resultBox.style.border = '1px solid #28a745';

                        '</div>';

            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btnTest.disabled = false;
                btnTest.style.opacity = '1';

<script>
function ddMaskCpf(el) {
    var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
    if (v.length > 9) {
        el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,2})/, '$1.$2.$3-$4');
    } else if (v.length > 6) {
        el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2.$3');
    } else if (v.length > 3) {
        el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2');
    } else {
        el.value = v;
    }
}
function ddMaskPhone(el) {
    var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
    if (v.length > 10) {
        el.value = v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{1,4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
    } else if (v.length > 6) {
        el.value = v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d{1,4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
    } else if (v.length > 2) {
        el.value = v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{1,5})/, '($1) $2');
    } else if (v.length > 0) {
        el.value = '(' + v;
    } else {
        el.value = '';
    }
}
function ddTogglePass(inputId, btn) {
    var input = document.getElementById(inputId);
    if (!input) return;
    var show = input.type === 'password';
    input.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
    btn.textContent = show ? '🙈' : '👁️';
    btn.style.color = show ? '#F0D060' : '#94a3b8';
}
</script>
