<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ShortcodeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemePathResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\TranslatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\DesignTokensInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartCompilerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartValidatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Validation\ThemePartValidator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\MediaUploadServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartManagementServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers\ThemeController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers\ThemePartsAdminController;

/**
 * Bootstrapper dedicado do subsistema Flex Builder (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 *
 * Isola o registro de singletons, provedores e menus administrativos do motor
 * Full Site Editing (FSE) baseado em Theme/Parts do arquivo principal Plugin.php.
 */
class BuilderFlexBootstrapper
{
    public function boot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $basePath = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);

        // 1. Serviços de infraestrutura e aplicação do FlexTheme / Flex Builder
        if (!$runtime->has(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class)) {
            $runtime->singleton(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class, fn() => new BaseUrlResolver());
        }
        if (!$runtime->has(SiteStateInterface::class)) {
            $runtime->singleton(SiteStateInterface::class, fn() => new EnvSiteState());
        }

        $runtime->singleton(ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface::class, fn() => new ThemeDiscoveryService($basePath));
        $runtime->singleton(MediaUploadServiceInterface::class, fn() => new MediaUploadService($basePath));

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePathResolverInterface::class, fn() => new SafeThemeResolver([
            $basePath . '/themes',
            dirname(__DIR__) . '/themes',
        ]));

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartCompilerInterface::class, fn($c) => $c->make(ThemePartRendererInterface::class));

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartValidatorInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new ThemePartValidator(
                $c->make(BlockRegistryInterface::class),
                $c->make(LayoutGridInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new ThemePartPreviewService(
                $c->make(ThemePartCompilerInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartManagementServiceInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new ThemePartManagementService(
                $c->make(ThemePartRepositoryInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartAssociationInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartValidatorInterface::class)
            );
        });
        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartManagementService::class, fn($c) => $c->make(ThemePartManagementServiceInterface::class));

        // 2. Controllers do FlexTheme / Flex Builder com todas as dependências injetadas via Container
        $runtime->singleton(ThemeController::class, function ($c) use ($basePath) {
            $siteState = $c->make(SiteStateInterface::class);
            $partRenderer = $c->has(ThemePartRendererInterface::class) ? $c->make(ThemePartRendererInterface::class) : null;
            $shortcodes = $c->has(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                ? $c->make(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                : ($c->has(ShortcodeManager::class) ? $c->make(ShortcodeManager::class) : null);
            $urlResolver = $c->make(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class);
            $themeResolver = $c->make(ThemePathResolverInterface::class);

            return new ThemeController(
                $siteState,
                $partRenderer,
                $shortcodes,
                $urlResolver,
                $themeResolver,
                $basePath
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartsAdminController::class, function ($c) use ($basePath) {
            $shortcodes = $c->has(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                ? $c->make(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                : $c->make(ShortcodeManager::class);
            $urlResolver = $c->make(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class);

            return new ThemePartsAdminController(
                $c->make(ThemePartRepositoryInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartAssociationInterface::class),
                $c->make(DesignTokensInterface::class),
                $c->make(BlockRegistryInterface::class),
                $c->make(LayoutGridInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartRendererInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemeManagerInterface::class),
                $shortcodes,
                $c->has(MenuProviderInterface::class) ? $c->make(MenuProviderInterface::class) : null,
                $c->has(SessionManagerInterface::class) ? $c->make(SessionManagerInterface::class) : null,
                $basePath,
                $c->make(ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface::class),
                $c->make(MediaUploadServiceInterface::class),
                $c->has(TranslatorInterface::class) ? $c->make(TranslatorInterface::class) : null,
                $c->has(ElementStyleRendererInterface::class) ? $c->make(ElementStyleRendererInterface::class) : null,
                $c->make(ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartManagementServiceInterface::class),
                $urlResolver
            );
        });

        // 3. Adiciona o submenu do Flex Builder e Design Tokens dentro do menu "Temas"
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role) {
            if (in_array($role, ['admin', 'manager'])) {
                $inserted = false;

                foreach ($menus as &$menu) {
                    if (isset($menu['title']) && $menu['title'] === 'Temas') {
                        if (!isset($menu['submenu'])) {
                            $menu['submenu'] = [];
                        }
                        $menu['submenu'][] = [
                            'title' => 'Flex Builder',
                            'url'   => '/admin/builder',
                        ];
                        $menu['submenu'][] = [
                            'title' => 'Design Tokens',
                            'url'   => '/admin/builder/tokens',
                        ];
                        $inserted = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!$inserted) {
                    $menus[] = [
                        'title' => 'Flex Builder',
                        'url'   => '/admin/builder',
                        'icon'  => '🏗️'
                    ];
                    $menus[] = [
                        'title' => 'Design Tokens',
                        'url'   => '/admin/builder/tokens',
                        'icon'  => '🎨'
                    ];
                }
            }
            return $menus;
        });
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\flextheme\Services\MediaUploadService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\MediaUploadServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço responsável pelo upload seguro de imagens para o Flex Builder.
 *
 * Aplica validação de tamanho máximo, whitelist estrita de extensões e tipos MIME,
 * sanitização de nomes com entropia criptográfica e isolamento no sistema de arquivos.
 */
class MediaUploadService implements MediaUploadServiceInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE = 52428800; // 50MB em bytes

    public const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = [
        'png',
        'jpg',
        'jpeg',
        'webp',
        'svg',
        'gif',
        'mp4',
        'webm',
        'ogg',
        'mov',
    ];

    public const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = [
        'image/png',
        'image/jpeg',
        'image/webp',
        'image/svg+xml',
        'image/gif',
        'video/mp4',
        'video/webm',
        'video/ogg',
        'video/quicktime',
    ];

    private string $uploadDir;
    private string $baseUrl;
    private int $maxBytes;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $basePath = null,
        ?string $baseUrl = null,
        int $maxBytes = self::DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE
    ) {
        $root = rtrim($basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4)), '/\\');
        $this->uploadDir = $root . '/public/uploads/builder';
        $this->baseUrl   = rtrim($baseUrl ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : ''), '/\\');
        $this->maxBytes  = $maxBytes;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $file
     * @return array{success: bool, url?: string, filename?: string, message: string}
     */
    public function upload(array $file): array
    {
        $error = $file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE;
        if ($error !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK || empty($file['tmp_name'])) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Nenhum arquivo enviado ou erro durante o envio.',
            ];
        }

        $tmpName = (string)$file['tmp_name'];
        if (!file_exists($tmpName) || !is_readable($tmpName)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Arquivo temporário indisponível ou ilegível.',
            ];
        }

        $size = (int)($file['size'] ?? filesize($tmpName));
        if ($size <= 0 || $size > $this->maxBytes) {
            $maxMb = round($this->maxBytes / (1024 * 1024), 1);
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "O arquivo excede o limite máximo permitido de {$maxMb}MB.",
            ];
        }

        $origName = (string)($file['name'] ?? 'upload');
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($origName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));

        if (!in_array($ext, self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS, true)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Extensão não permitida. Envie PNG, SVG, JPG, WEBP, GIF ou vídeos MP4, WEBM, OGG, MOV.',
            ];
        }

        // Validação estrita por detecção de MIME real via finfo
        if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {
            $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
            if ($finfo !== false) {
                $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $tmpName);
                finfo_close($finfo);

                if (is_string($mime) && !in_array($mime, self::ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES, true)) {
                    // Tolerância específica para arquivos SVG puros que podem ser reportados como text/plain ou text/xml
                    if ($ext === 'svg' && (str_contains($mime, 'xml') || str_contains($mime, 'text'))) {
                        // Válido
                    } else {
                        return [
                            'success' => false,
                            'message' => "Tipo de arquivo inválido ($mime).",
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!is_dir($this->uploadDir)) {
            @mkdir($this->uploadDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $safeName = 'media_' . time() . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
        $destPath = $this->uploadDir . '/' . $safeName;

        // Sanitização estrita de arquivos SVG contra Stored XSS (<script>, <foreignObject>, on* handlers, javascript:)
        if ($ext === 'svg') {
            $rawSvg = @file_get_contents($tmpName);
            if ($rawSvg === false || stripos($rawSvg, '<svg') === false) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Arquivo SVG inválido ou malformado.',
                ];
            }

            $sanitizedSvg = $this->sanitizeSvgContent($rawSvg);
            if (stripos($sanitizedSvg, '<svg') === false) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Arquivo SVG bloqueado por conter conteúdo inseguro.',
                ];
            }

            if (@file_put_contents($destPath, $sanitizedSvg, LOCK_EX) === false) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Falha ao salvar o arquivo SVG sanitizado no diretório de destino.',
                ];
            }
        } else {
            // Suporte tanto a uploads normais via HTTP (is_uploaded_file / move_uploaded_file)
            // quanto testes unitários (copy)
            $moved = false;
            if (is_uploaded_file($tmpName)) {
                $moved = @move_uploaded_file($tmpName, $destPath);
            }
            if (!$moved) {
                $moved = @copy($tmpName, $destPath);
            }

            if (!$moved) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Falha ao salvar o arquivo no diretório de destino.',
                ];
            }
        }

        $publicUrl = $this->baseUrl . '/uploads/builder/' . $safeName;

        return [
            'success'  => true,
            'url'      => $publicUrl,
            'filename' => $safeName,
            'message'  => 'Imagem enviada com sucesso!',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Valida a árvore XML do SVG via DOMDocument e remove quaisquer elementos ou atributos fora da whitelist segura.
     */
    public function sanitizeSvgContent(string $svg): string
    {
        if (trim($svg) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Bloqueia declarações DOCTYPE / ENTITY (prevenção contra XXE / Billion Laughs)
        if (preg_match('/<!(?:DOCTYPE|ENTITY)\b/i', $svg)) {
            return '';
        }

        // 1. Pré-limpeza de blocos perigosos antes do parser XML
        $clean = preg_replace('#<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script>#is', '', $svg) ?? $svg;
        $clean = preg_replace('#<script\b[^>]*/?>#is', '', $clean) ?? $clean;
        $clean = preg_replace('#<foreignObject\b[^>]*>.*?</foreignObject>#is', '', $clean) ?? $clean;
        $clean = preg_replace('#<foreignObject\b[^>]*/?>#is', '', $clean) ?? $clean;

        if (!class_exists(\DOMDocument::class)) {
            return '';
        }

        $dom = new \DOMDocument();
        $prevUseErrors = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $loaded = $dom->loadXML($clean, LIBXML_NONET | LIBXML_NOERROR | LIBXML_NOWARNING);
        libxml_clear_errors();
        libxml_use_internal_errors($prevUseErrors);

        if (!$loaded || $dom->documentElement === null || strtolower($dom->documentElement->localName ?? $dom->documentElement->nodeName) !== 'svg') {
            return '';
        }

        $allowedTags = [
            'svg', 'g', 'a', 'image', 'path', 'rect', 'circle', 'ellipse', 'line', 'polyline', 'polygon',
            'text', 'tspan', 'defs', 'lineargradient', 'radialgradient', 'stop', 'clippath',
            'mask', 'pattern', 'symbol', 'use', 'title', 'desc', 'metadata', 'style',
            'filter', 'fegaussianblur', 'feoffset', 'feblend', 'fecolormatrix', 'femerge', 'femergenode', 'fedropshadow',
        ];

        $this->sanitizeDomElement($dom->documentElement, $allowedTags);

        $serialized = $dom->saveXML($dom->documentElement);
        return is_string($serialized) ? $serialized : '';
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $allowedTags
     */
    private function sanitizeDomElement(\DOMElement $element, array $allowedTags): void
    {
        // Sanitiza atributos do elemento atual
        if ($element->hasAttributes()) {
            $attrsToRemove = [];
            foreach ($element->attributes as $attr) {
                if (!$attr instanceof \DOMAttr) {
                    continue;
                }
                $attrName = strtolower($attr->nodeName);
                $localName = strtolower($attr->localName ?? $attrName);
                $val = html_entity_decode($attr->nodeValue ?? '', ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
                $normVal = strtolower(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x20\s]+/', '', $val) ?? '');

                if (str_starts_with($attrName, 'on') || str_starts_with($localName, 'on')) {
                    $attrsToRemove[] = $attr->nodeName;
                    continue;
                }

                if ($localName === 'href' || $attrName === 'href' || $attrName === 'xlink:href') {
                    if (
                        str_starts_with($normVal, 'javascript:') ||
                        str_starts_with($normVal, 'vbscript:') ||
                        str_starts_with($normVal, 'data:') ||
                        str_starts_with($normVal, '//') ||
                        (preg_match('/^([a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*):/i', $normVal, $m) && !in_array(strtolower($m[1]), ['http', 'https'], true))
                    ) {
                        $attr->nodeValue = '#';
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if ($localName === 'style') {
                    if (
                        str_contains($normVal, 'expression(') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'javascript:') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'vbscript:') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, '@import') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'url(javascript:') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'url(data:')
                    ) {
                        $attrsToRemove[] = $attr->nodeName;
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach ($attrsToRemove as $attrName) {
                $element->removeAttribute($attrName);
            }
        }

        if (strtolower($element->localName ?? $element->nodeName) === 'style') {
            $css = html_entity_decode($element->textContent ?? '', ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
            $normCss = strtolower(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x20\s]+/', '', $css) ?? '');
            if (
                str_contains($normCss, 'expression(') ||
                str_contains($normCss, 'javascript:') ||
                str_contains($normCss, 'vbscript:') ||
                str_contains($normCss, '@import')
            ) {
                $element->nodeValue = '';
            }
        }

        // Percorre filhos (copia para array estático antes de remover nós)
        $children = [];
        foreach ($element->childNodes as $child) {
            $children[] = $child;
        }

        foreach ($children as $child) {
            if ($child instanceof \DOMElement) {
                $tagName = strtolower($child->localName ?? $child->nodeName);
                if (!in_array($tagName, $allowedTags, true)) {
                    $element->removeChild($child);
                    continue;
                }
                $this->sanitizeDomElement($child, $allowedTags);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemeDiscoveryService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço responsável pela descoberta de temas disponíveis, resolução do tema ativo e listagem de templates.
 *
 * Desacopla a exploração de diretórios do sistema de arquivos e arquivos de configuração
 * dos controladores HTTP (respeito estrito ao SRP - Single Responsibility Principle).
 */
class ThemeDiscoveryService implements ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface
{
    private string $basePath;

    public function __construct(?string $basePath = null)
    {
        $this->basePath = rtrim($basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4)), '/\\');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, string>>
     */
    public function getAvailableThemes(): array
    {
        $themes = [];
        $seen = [];

        // 1. Diretório raiz /themes
        $themesDir = $this->basePath . '/themes';
        if (is_dir($themesDir)) {
            foreach (glob($themesDir . '/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR) ?: [] as $dir) {
                $folder = basename($dir);
                if (in_array($folder, ['admin', 'manager'], true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $seen[$folder] = true;
                $themeJson = $dir . '/theme.json';
                $json = file_exists($themeJson) ? json_decode((string)file_get_contents($themeJson), true) : [];
                $themes[] = [
                    'folder'                => $folder,
                    'name'                  => is_array($json) && isset($json['name']) && is_string($json['name']) ? $json['name'] : ucfirst($folder),
                    'supports_flex_builder' => $this->supportsFlexBuilder($folder),
                ];
            }
        }

        // 2. Bundled themes dentro de plugins
        $pluginsDir = $this->basePath . '/src/Plugins';
        if (is_dir($pluginsDir)) {
            foreach (glob($pluginsDir . '/*/themes/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR) ?: [] as $dir) {
                $folder = basename($dir);
                if (isset($seen[$folder])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $seen[$folder] = true;
                $themeJson = $dir . '/theme.json';
                $json = file_exists($themeJson) ? json_decode((string)file_get_contents($themeJson), true) : [];
                $themes[] = [
                    'folder'                => $folder,
                    'name'                  => is_array($json) && isset($json['name']) && is_string($json['name']) ? $json['name'] : ucfirst($folder),
                    'supports_flex_builder' => $this->supportsFlexBuilder($folder),
                ];
            }
        }

        return $themes;
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se o tema possui ligação com o motor de Header/Footer dinâmico do Flex Builder.
     * Temas nativos independentes (como rachidd_store) declaram "flex_builder": false ou não usam ThemePartRendererInterface no layout.
     */
    public function supportsFlexBuilder(string $themeFolder): bool
    {
        $folder = basename(trim($themeFolder));
        if ($folder === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $candidateDirs = [
            $this->basePath . '/themes/' . $folder,
            $this->basePath . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/' . $folder,
        ];

        foreach ($candidateDirs as $dir) {
            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                continue;
            }
            $themeJson = $dir . '/theme.json';
            if (is_file($themeJson)) {
                $json = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($themeJson), true);
                if (is_array($json) && array_key_exists('flex_builder', $json)) {
                    return (bool)$json['flex_builder'];
                }
            }

            $mainLayout = $dir . '/layouts/main.php';
            if (is_file($mainLayout)) {
                $layoutSrc = (string)file_get_contents($mainLayout);
                return str_contains($layoutSrc, 'ThemePartRendererInterface')
                    || str_contains($layoutSrc, 'renderHeader(')
                    || str_contains($layoutSrc, 'renderFooter(');
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function getActiveThemeFolder(): string
    {
        $activeFile = $this->basePath . '/config/active_theme.json';
        if (file_exists($activeFile)) {
            $data = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($activeFile), true);
            $theme = $data['active_theme'] ?? ($data['active'] ?? null);
            if (is_string($theme) && trim($theme) !== '') {
                return basename(trim($theme));
            }
        }

        return 'default';
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getThemeTemplates(string $themeFolder): array
    {
        $possibleDirs = [
            $this->basePath . '/themes/' . $themeFolder . '/templates',
            $this->basePath . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/' . $themeFolder . '/templates',
        ];

        $templates = [];
        foreach ($possibleDirs as $dir) {
            if (is_dir($dir)) {
                foreach (glob($dir . '/*.php') ?: [] as $file) {
                    $base = basename($file, '.php');
                    $templates[$base] = $base . '.php';
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($templates)) {
            $templates = [
                'home'        => 'home.php (Página Inicial)',
                'sobre'       => 'sobre.php (Página Sobre)',
                'blog'        => 'blog.php (Blog / Artigos)',
                'privacidade' => 'privacidade.php',
                'termos'      => 'termos.php',
            ];
        }

        return $templates;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemePartManagementService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartValidatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartManagementServiceInterface;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de aplicação responsável pela criação, validação estrutural, persistência verificada
 * e atribuição consistente (com compensação em caso de falha) de partes visuais de tema (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 */
class ThemePartManagementService implements ThemePartManagementServiceInterface
{
    private ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo;
    private ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc;
    private ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface $themeDiscovery;
    private ThemePartValidatorInterface $validator;

    public function __construct(
        ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo,
        ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc,
        ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface $themeDiscovery,
        ThemePartValidatorInterface $validator
    ) {
        $this->partRepo = $partRepo;
        $this->partAssoc = $partAssoc;
        $this->themeDiscovery = $themeDiscovery;
        $this->validator = $validator;
    }

    /**
     * Constrói uma nova ThemePart com o preset e blocos iniciais recomendados para o tipo.
     */
    public function createDefaultPart(string $requestedType): ThemePartInterface
    {
        $type = in_array($requestedType, [
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION,
        ], true) ? $requestedType : ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER;

        $defaultPreset = match ($type) {
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER  => '3_cols_header',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER  => '4_cols_footer',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION => '1_col',
            default => '1_col',
        };

        $defaultSettings = [
            'is_full_width' => false,
            'max_width'     => '1280px',
            'gap'           => '24px',
            'padding'       => '20px 24px',
            'align_items'   => 'center',
            'background'    => '',
        ];

        $initialColumns = match ($defaultPreset) {
            '3_cols_header' => [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'Domain<span style="color:var(--color-primary);">System</span>', 'height' => '32px']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'nav_menu', 'data' => ['align' => 'center']]],
                2 => [['type' => 'cta_button', 'data' => ['label' => 'Acessar', 'url' => '/login', 'variant' => 'primary', 'align' => 'right']]],
            ],
            '4_cols_footer' => [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'DomainSystem', 'height' => '28px']], ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Ecossistema modular de alto desempenho.', 'font_size' => '0.85rem']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Navegação', 'level' => 'h4', 'font_size' => '1rem']], ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => '<a href="/" style="color:inherit;">Início</a><br><a href="/cursos" style="color:inherit;">Cursos</a>', 'font_size' => '0.85rem']]],
                2 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Comunidade', 'level' => 'h4', 'font_size' => '1rem']], ['type' => 'social_icons', 'data' => []]],
                3 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Legal', 'level' => 'h4', 'font_size' => '1rem']], ['type' => 'copyright', 'data' => ['site_name' => 'Domain-System']]],
            ],
            default => [
                0 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Título da Seção', 'level' => 'h2']], ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Insira seu texto e blocos aqui.']]],
            ]
        };

        return new ThemePart(
            uniqid('part_', true),
            $type,
            'Novo ' . ucfirst($type),
            $defaultPreset,
            $defaultSettings,
            $initialColumns,
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC,
            false
        );
    }

    /**
     * Valida estruturalmente o documento, salva a ThemePart e aplica atribuições verificadas
     * com compensação automática caso uma atribuição posterior falhe.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $input
     */
    public function saveFromPayload(array $input): ThemePartInterface
    {
        // 1. Validação estrutural completa antes de qualquer efeito colateral
        $this->validator->validate($input);

        $id = trim((string)($input['id'] ?? ''));
        if ($id === '') {
            $id = uniqid('part_', true);
        }

        $type = (string)($input['type'] ?? ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER);
        $title = trim((string)($input['title'] ?? 'Sem Título'));
        $preset = (string)($input['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
        $settings = (array)($input['container_settings'] ?? []);
        unset($settings['hide_desktop'], $settings['hide_laptop'], $settings['hide_tablet'], $settings['hide_mobile']);
        $columnsData = (array)($input['columns_data'] ?? []);
        $mobileToggleStyle = (string)($input['mobile_toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC);
        $mobileToggleAlign = (string)($input['mobile_toggle_align'] ?? 'right');
        $isDefault = !empty($input['is_default']);
        $sections = (array)($input['sections'] ?? []);

        foreach ($sections as &$sec) {
            if (is_array($sec)) {
                if (isset($sec['container_settings']) && is_array($sec['container_settings'])) {
                    unset(
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_desktop'],
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_laptop'],
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_tablet'],
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_mobile']
                    );
                }
                if (isset($sec['settings']) && is_array($sec['settings'])) {
                    unset(
                        $sec['settings']['hide_desktop'],
                        $sec['settings']['hide_laptop'],
                        $sec['settings']['hide_tablet'],
                        $sec['settings']['hide_mobile']
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        unset($sec);

        // Captura snapshot anterior da parte e associações para compensação caso uma associação falhe após o save
        $previousPart = $this->partRepo->findById($id);
        $previousGlobalDefault = $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault($type);
        $assignedTheme = !empty($input['assigned_theme']) ? (string)$input['assigned_theme'] : '';
        $previousThemeAssignedId = $assignedTheme !== '' ? $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId($assignedTheme, $type) : null;
        $targetTheme = $assignedTheme !== ''
            ? $assignedTheme
            : $this->themeDiscovery->getActiveThemeFolder();
        $previousSectionTemplate = ($type === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION && isset($input['assigned_template']))
            ? $this->partAssoc->getAssignedTemplateForSection($targetTheme, $id)
            : null;

        $part = new ThemePart(
            $id,
            $type,
            $title !== '' ? $title : 'Sem Título',
            $preset,
            $settings,
            $columnsData,
            $mobileToggleStyle,
            $isDefault,
            isset($input['created_at']) ? (int)$input['created_at'] : ($previousPart?->getCreatedAt()),
            time(),
            $sections,
            $mobileToggleAlign
        );

        $saved = $this->partRepo->save($part);
        if (!$saved) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao gravar os dados da parte visual no armazenamento.');
        }

        try {
            if ($isDefault) {
                if (!$this->partAssoc->setGlobalDefault($type, $id)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao definir a parte visual como padrão global.');
                }
            }

            if ($assignedTheme !== '') {
                if (!$this->partAssoc->assignPart($assignedTheme, $type, $id)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao associar a parte visual ao tema '{$assignedTheme}'.");
                }
            }

            if ($type === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION && isset($input['assigned_template'])) {
                $templateChoice = trim((string)$input['assigned_template']);
                $effectiveTemplate = ($templateChoice !== '' && $templateChoice !== 'none') ? $templateChoice : null;
                if (!$this->partAssoc->assignTemplateToSection($targetTheme, $id, $effectiveTemplate)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao associar a seção ao template '{$templateChoice}'.");
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Compensação: restaura integralmente o estado anterior da parte e de todas as associações
            if ($isDefault) {
                $this->partAssoc->setGlobalDefault($type, $previousGlobalDefault);
            }
            if ($assignedTheme !== '') {
                $this->partAssoc->assignPart($assignedTheme, $type, $previousThemeAssignedId);
            }
            if ($type === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION && isset($input['assigned_template'])) {
                $this->partAssoc->assignTemplateToSection($targetTheme, $id, $previousSectionTemplate);
            }
            if ($previousPart !== null) {
                $this->partRepo->save($previousPart);
            } else {
                $this->partRepo->delete($id);
            }

            if ($e instanceof RuntimeException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao atualizar as associações da parte visual: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        return $part;
    }

    /**
     * Processa uma solicitação de atribuição (tema <-> parte, global ou seção <-> template).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $input
     */
    public function assignFromPayload(array $input): bool
    {
        $themeFolder = trim((string)($input['theme_folder'] ?? ''));
        $partType    = trim((string)($input['part_type'] ?? ''));
        $partId      = trim((string)($input['part_id'] ?? ''));
        $sectionId   = trim((string)($input['section_id'] ?? $partId));
        $isGlobal    = !empty($input['is_global']);

        if ($partType === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $resolvedPartId = ($partId !== '' && $partId !== 'none' && $partId !== 'fallback') ? $partId : null;

        if (str_starts_with($partType, 'template:')) {
            $slug = substr($partType, strlen('template:'));
            $targetSectionId = $resolvedPartId ?? $sectionId;
            if ($targetSectionId === '' || $targetSectionId === 'none' || $themeFolder === '') {
                return false;
            }
            $effectiveSlug = ($partType !== 'template:none' && $resolvedPartId !== null) ? $slug : null;
            return $this->partAssoc->assignTemplateToSection($themeFolder, $targetSectionId, $effectiveSlug);
        }

        if ($isGlobal) {
            return $this->partAssoc->setGlobalDefault($partType, $resolvedPartId);
        }

        if ($themeFolder === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->partAssoc->assignPart($themeFolder, $partType, $resolvedPartId);
    }

    /**
     * Exclui uma parte visual e limpa quaisquer referências órfãs nas associações de temas/templates/globais.
     */
    public function deletePart(string $id): bool
    {
        $cleanId = trim($id);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $deleted = $this->partRepo->delete($cleanId);
        if ($deleted) {
            $cleaned = $this->partAssoc->removePartReferences($cleanId);
            if (!$cleaned) {
                error_log("[ThemePartManagementService] Aviso: referências de '{$cleanId}' podem não ter sido limpas integralmente.");
            }
        }

        return $deleted;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemePartPreviewService.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartCompilerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço dedicado à pré-visualização ao vivo (Preview) no Studio do Flex Builder (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 *
 * Delega integralmente a compilação da parte visual ao motor oficial (ThemePartCompilerInterface),
 * garantindo caminho único de compilação entre o Preview do Studio e a publicação no Frontend,
 * sem qualquer instanciação direta de classes concretas de infraestrutura.
 */
class ThemePartPreviewService implements ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface
{
    private ThemePartCompilerInterface $compiler;

    public function __construct(ThemePartCompilerInterface $compiler)
    {
        $this->compiler = $compiler;
    }

    public function renderPreview(array $payload): string
    {
        $rawType = (string)($payload['type'] ?? ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION);
        $validTypes = [ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION];
        $partType = in_array($rawType, $validTypes, true) ? $rawType : ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION;

        $enforceTypeFilter = isset($payload['type']) && in_array($rawType, $validTypes, true);

        $preset = (string)($payload['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
        $settings = (array)($payload['container_settings'] ?? []);
        $columnsData = (array)($payload['columns_data'] ?? []);
        $mobileToggleStyle = (string)($payload['mobile_toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC);
        $mobileToggleAlign = (string)($payload['mobile_toggle_align'] ?? 'right');
        $sections = (array)($payload['sections'] ?? []);

        $ephemeralPart = new ThemePart(
            'preview_part',
            $partType,
            (string)($payload['title'] ?? 'Preview'),
            $preset,
            $settings,
            $columnsData,
            $mobileToggleStyle,
            false,
            null,
            null,
            $sections,
            $mobileToggleAlign
        );

        return $this->compiler->compilePart(
            $ephemeralPart,
            [
                'preview'            => true,
                '_enforce_part_type' => $enforceTypeFilter,
            ],
            true,
            false
        );
    }
}

            <button type="button" id="acceptPrivacy" class="btn-primary" style="padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.9rem; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: var(--primary); color: #0b0c10; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer;">Aceitar</button>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const privacyNotice = document.getElementById('privacyNotice');
    if (!privacyNotice) return;

    const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('acceptPrivacy');
    const rejectBtn = document.getElementById('rejectPrivacy');

    function hideNotice() {
        privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
        setTimeout(() => { privacyNotice.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
    }

    if (acceptBtn) {
        acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            localStorage.setItem('ds_privacy_accepted', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    if (rejectBtn) {
        rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            sessionStorage.setItem('ds_privacy_rejected', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    const privacyAccepted = localStorage.getItem('ds_privacy_accepted');
    const privacyRejected = sessionStorage.getItem('ds_privacy_rejected');
    
    if (privacyAccepted !== 'true' && privacyRejected !== 'true') {
        setTimeout(() => {
            privacyNotice.style.display = 'block';
            // Force reflow
            void privacyNotice.offsetWidth;
            privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }, 1000);
    }
});
</script>

    <header>
        <h1>Engine Architecture</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>How does the Kernel work?</h2>
        <p>The <strong>Domain-System</strong> is initialized via <code>bootstrap.php</code>. At this moment, the <strong>Dependency Injection Container</strong> is assembled. The Container is the brain that manages the creation of all important classes, ensuring no one creates objects the wrong way with "new" scattered throughout the code.</p>

        <h2>Core Components</h2>
        <ul>
            <li><strong>SessionManager:</strong> The single authority over user memory storage (prevents loose superglobals like $_SESSION across the code).</li>
            <li><strong>Router (Gatekeeper):</strong> Maps URLs to Controllers and acts as a Bouncer (ACL), validating roles even before instantiating controllers.</li>
            <li><strong>EventDispatcher (Triggers):</strong> Manages Actions (Hooks) and Filters. If a plugin wants to change the menu, it "listens" to the <code>admin.menu</code> event.</li>
            <li><strong>PluginManager:</strong> Reads the <code>src/Plugins/</code> folder, validates <code>plugin.json</code>, and calls the <code>register()</code> method of each active plugin.</li>
            <li><strong>ThemeManager:</strong> Manages the Front-end. Intercepts requests that are not from the API or Dashboard, and delivers visuals using Server-Side Rendering (SSR).</li>
        </ul>

        <h2>Request Flow (Life-cycle)</h2>
        <pre>
1. User accesses the browser.
2. public/index.php receives the request.
3. bootstrap.php loads the Container and Services (Database, EventDispatcher, SessionManager).
4. PluginManager activates the Plugins (each plugin injects its Routes and Repositories).
5. Router evaluates the URL and checks Access Rules (ACL).
6. Specific Controller is instantiated via Dependency Injection.
7. The Controller accesses the Repository Layer (Repository Pattern) which handles the DB via PDO.
8. A purely HTTP Response is returned to the user.</pre>

    </div>

    <header>
        <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/index" class="back-link">&larr; Voltar ao Índice</a>
        <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/circuit-breaker_en" class="lang-toggle">🇺🇸 English</a>
        <h1>⚡ Resiliência e Circuit Breaker</h1>
        <p>Como o Domain-System se protege sozinho de plugins fatais e erros críticos.</p>
    </header>
    <div class="content">
        <h2>O Problema Clássico (Tela Branca da Morte)</h2>
        <p>Nos sistemas monolíticos ou baseados em plugins tradicionais (como o WordPress antigo), um simples erro de digitação de um desenvolvedor — como esquecer um ponto-e-vírgula em um plugin recém-instalado — pode causar a famosa "Tela Branca da Morte". O PHP interrompe abruptamente toda a execução, e o site inteiro fica inacessível para todos (inclusive para os administradores).</p>
        <h2>A Solução: Circuit Breaker (Disjuntor)</h2>
        <p>O <strong>Domain-System</strong> foi desenhado com um conceito avançado de arquitetura focado na alta resiliência: o <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/https://martinfowler.com/bliki/CircuitBreaker" target="_blank">Circuit Breaker</a> (Disjuntor).</p>
        <p>Funciona de maneira muito semelhante a um disjuntor de energia em uma casa. Quando ocorre uma "sobrecarga" (um erro fatal) em um dos cômodos (plugins), o disjuntor "desarma" apenas aquela linha, protegendo o núcleo geral de queimar.</p>
        <h3>Como Funciona nos Bastidores</h3>
        <ol>
            <li><strong>Interceptação Global (ErrorHandler):</strong> Uma camada de defesa, conectada diretamente ao <code>register_shutdown_function</code> do PHP, vigia todos os eventos fatais em nível de hardware e compilação (Erros de Sintaxe, Parse Errors, etc).</li>
            <li><strong>Rastreamento Isolado:</strong> Quando uma exceção fatal explode, o Vigia captura o <em>Stack Trace</em> para descobrir a origem exata do erro.</li>
            <li><strong>Desarme Automático:</strong> Se o sistema identifica que a falha veio de um arquivo pertencente à pasta de um Plugin específico, ele intercepta o arquivo <code>config/plugins.json</code> e <strong>desconecta / desativa o plugin em milissegundos</strong>.</li>
            <li><strong>Proteção do Painel:</strong> O sistema limpa os buffers pela metade e renderiza uma tela limpa de "Sobrecarga de Núcleo" <strong>apenas para o autor da requisição afetada</strong>. Na mesma tela, exibe um botão para Recarregar o Sistema Seguro.</li>
            <li><strong>Log e Alerta Visuais:</strong> O sistema adiciona um registro da queda ao arquivo temporário de <code>disarmed.json</code>. Assim que o administrador acessa a tela nativa de Plugins (via <em>SystemAdmin</em>), ele vê um alerta brilhante apontando o plugin desarmado, com o atalho para a tela de relatórios detalhados (<em>SystemMonitor</em>).</li>
        </ol>
    </div>

    <header>
        <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/index_en" class="back-link">&larr; Back to Index</a>

        <h1>⚡ Resilience & Circuit Breaker</h1>
        <p>How Domain-System protects itself from fatal plugins and critical errors.</p>
    </header>
    <div class="content">
        <h2>The Classic Problem (White Screen of Death)</h2>
        <p>In traditional monolithic or plugin-based systems (like legacy WordPress), a simple typo by a developer — such as forgetting a semicolon in a newly installed plugin — can cause the infamous "White Screen of Death". PHP abruptly halts all execution, and the entire site becomes inaccessible for everyone (including administrators).</p>
        <h2>The Solution: Circuit Breaker</h2>
        <p>The <strong>Domain-System</strong> was designed with an advanced architectural concept focused on high resilience: the <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/https://martinfowler.com/bliki/CircuitBreaker" target="_blank">Circuit Breaker</a>.</p>
        <p>It works very similarly to an electrical circuit breaker in a house. When an "overload" (a fatal error) occurs in one of the rooms (plugins), the breaker "trips" only that line, protecting the overall core from burning out.</p>
        <h3>How It Works Under the Hood</h3>
        <ol>
            <li><strong>Global Interception (ErrorHandler):</strong> A defense layer, directly hooked into PHP's <code>register_shutdown_function</code>, watches all fatal events at the hardware and compilation level (Syntax Errors, Parse Errors, etc).</li>
            <li><strong>Isolated Tracking:</strong> When a fatal exception blows up, the Watchman captures the <em>Stack Trace</em> to discover the exact origin of the error.</li>
            <li><strong>Automatic Disarming:</strong> If the system identifies that the failure came from a file belonging to a specific Plugin's folder, it intercepts the <code>config/plugins.json</code> file and <strong>disconnects / disables the plugin in milliseconds</strong>.</li>
            <li><strong>Panel Protection:</strong> The system clears half-rendered buffers and displays a clean "Core Overload" screen <strong>only for the author of the affected request</strong>. On the same screen, it displays a button to Reload the Safe System.</li>
            <li><strong>Log and Visual Alerts:</strong> The system adds a record of the crash to the temporary <code>disarmed.json</code> file. As soon as the administrator accesses the native Plugins screen (via <em>SystemAdmin</em>), they see a bright alert highlighting the disarmed plugin, with a shortcut to the detailed reports screen (<em>SystemMonitor</em>).</li>
        </ol>
    </div>

    <header>
        <h1>Contratos e Interfaces</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>A Importância das Interfaces (SOLID)</h2>
        <p>No Domain-System, aplicamos estritamente a "Letra I" do SOLID (Interface Segregation Principle). Classes não dependem umas das outras, elas dependem de <strong>Contratos (Interfaces)</strong>.</p>
        <p>Se o sistema espera que você extraia arquivos ZIP, ele não depende da biblioteca nativa do ZIP, ele pede um <code>ExtractorInterface</code>. Isso significa que amanhã você pode trocar o método de extração sem quebrar o sistema inteiro.</p>

        <h2>PluginInterface</h2>
        <p>Todo plugin DEVE assinar este contrato indiretamente (ao estender a classe abstrata <code>AbstractPlugin</code>). Ele dita as regras do ciclo de vida:</p>
        <pre><code>interface PluginInterface
{
    public function register(): void;
    public function boot(): void;
    public function activate(): void;
    public function deactivate(): void;
    public function uninstall(): void;
}</code></pre>

        <h3>Explicação dos Métodos:</h3>
        <ul>
            <li><strong>register():</strong> O lugar certo para registrar Rotas, Listeners de Eventos, e Menus no painel. Executado a cada requisição.</li>
            <li><strong>boot():</strong> Executado após todos os plugins terminarem de se registrar.</li>
            <li><strong>activate():</strong> Rodado <strong>apenas uma vez</strong> quando você liga o Plugin no Painel (Ideal para Migrations e criação de tabelas).</li>
            <li><strong>deactivate() / uninstall():</strong> Usados para limpar os rastros que o plugin deixou quando for desativado ou deletado.</li>
        </ul>

    </div>

    <header>
        <h1>Contracts and Interfaces</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>The Importance of Interfaces (SOLID)</h2>
        <p>In the Domain-System, we strictly apply the "Letter I" of SOLID (Interface Segregation Principle). Classes don't depend on each other, they depend on <strong>Contracts (Interfaces)</strong>.</p>
        <p>If the system expects you to extract ZIP files, it doesn't depend on the native ZIP library, it asks for an <code>ExtractorInterface</code>. This means tomorrow you can change the extraction method without breaking the entire system.</p>

        <h2>PluginInterface</h2>
        <p>Every plugin MUST sign this contract indirectly (by extending the abstract class <code>AbstractPlugin</code>). It dictates the lifecycle rules:</p>
        <pre><code>interface PluginInterface
{
    public function register(): void;
    public function boot(): void;
    public function activate(): void;
    public function deactivate(): void;
    public function uninstall(): void;
}</code></pre>

        <h3>Explanation of Methods:</h3>
        <ul>
            <li><strong>register():</strong> The right place to register Routes, Event Listeners, and Dashboard Menus. Executed on every request.</li>
            <li><strong>boot():</strong> Executed after all plugins finish registering.</li>
            <li><strong>activate():</strong> Run <strong>only once</strong> when you turn on the Plugin in the Dashboard (Ideal for Migrations and table creation).</li>
            <li><strong>deactivate() / uninstall():</strong> Used to clean up the traces the plugin left when deactivated or deleted.</li>
        </ul>

    </div>

        <h1 data-i18n="title">O Fluxo de Vida do Plugin</h1>

    <div class="container">
        <p class="intro" data-i18n="intro">
            Como o Domain-System OS impede que um plugin quebre o sistema inteiro? Ele não executa códigos cegamente. O Kernel segue um rigoroso <strong>processo de alfândega em 3 etapas</strong>. Clique nas etapas abaixo para entender a mágica.
        </p>

        <div class="timeline">
            
            <!-- STEP 1 -->
            <div class="timeline-step active" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step1_title"><span>🛂</span> 1. O Passaporte (JSON)</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step1_subtitle">A verificação de identidade antes do código.</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step1_desc">A primeira coisa que o Kernel faz é ler o arquivo <code style="color:var(--accent-purple)">plugin.json</code>. Nenhuma linha de código PHP foi executada ainda. O Kernel apenas olha o documento e avalia: <em>"Quem é você? Qual sua versão? Você precisa de outro plugin para funcionar?"</em>. Se algo estiver corrompido, ele barra a entrada aqui, evitando a famosa "Tela Branca da Morte".</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre>{
    <span class="s">"name"</span>: <span class="s">"test_os"</span>,
    <span class="s">"version"</span>: <span class="s">"1.0.0"</span>,
    <span class="s">"description"</span>: <span class="s">"Plugin de Teste para o novo Sistema Operacional Web"</span>,
    <span class="s">"core"</span>: <span class="v">false</span>,
    <span class="s">"dependencies"</span>: []
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- STEP 2 -->
            <div class="timeline-step" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step2_title"><span>🤝</span> 2. A Entrevista (Negociação)</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step2_subtitle">O Método osRegister()</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step2_desc">Se o passaporte estiver válido e ativado, o Kernel carrega o seu arquivo PHP. Mas ele não deixa você trabalhar ainda! Ele chama você para uma sala de entrevista (<code style="color:var(--accent-purple)">osRegister</code>). O Kernel pergunta: <em>"O que você vai precisar usar aqui dentro?"</em>. Você responde anotando na prancheta do conector.</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// Anotando na prancheta o que eu preciso</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.menu'</span>);
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- STEP 3 -->
            <div class="timeline-step" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step3_title"><span>🛠️</span> 3. O Crachá (Execução)</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step3_subtitle">O Método osBoot() e a Injeção de Dependências</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step3_desc">Com a entrevista aprovada, o Kernel finalmente te entrega o crachá de acesso (<code style="color:var(--accent-purple)">OsRuntime</code>). Ele diz: <em>"Pode começar a trabalhar! Aqui estão as ferramentas que você pediu."</em>. Através do Runtime, o SO injeta as dependências diretamente na sua mão. Se você tentar pegar algo que não pediu no Passo 2, o crachá é bloqueado imediatamente.</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// O SO te entrega a sessão pronta e segura</span>
    <span class="v">$session</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// O SO deixa você desenhar no menu administrativo</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.menu'</span>, [
        <span class="s">'title'</span> => <span class="s">'Minha Clínica'</span>
    ]);
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- STEP 4 -->
            <div class="timeline-step" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step4_title"><span>🧩</span> 4. O Código Completo</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step4_subtitle">Juntando todas as peças</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step4_desc">Veja como fica o arquivo final da sua Extensão, com os "uses" (namespaces) obrigatórios e o método legado exigido pela arquitetura de transição.</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre><span class="k">namespace</span> DomainSystem\Plugins\test_os;

    <span class="c">// Método Legado (ignorado pelo OS novo, mas exigido)</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">register</span>(): <span class="k">void</span> {}
    
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);

    {
        <span class="c">/** @var SessionManager $session */</span>
        <span class="v">$session</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);

        <span class="f">error_log</span>(<span class="s">"🚀 BINGO! O Plugin TestOS foi aprovado!"</span>);
        
        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
            <span class="s">'type'</span> => <span class="s">'success'</span>,
            <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'O novo Sistema Operacional Web está operante!'</span>
        ]);
    }

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
        }

        function activateStep(element) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.timeline-step').forEach(step => {
                step.classList.remove('active');
            });
            element.classList.add('active');
        }

    <header>
        <h1>Visão, Propósito e Público-Alvo</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>Por que criar este projeto?</h2>
        <p>A web atual sofre com dois extremos: de um lado, sistemas monolíticos pesados e lentos (como versões legadas e infladas de CMS tradicionais) repletos de "gambiarras"; do outro lado, frameworks modernos e complexos que exigem uma curva de aprendizado altíssima e dependências infinitas via Composer.</p>
        <p>O <strong>Domain-System</strong> nasceu da necessidade de encontrar o <em>meio-termo perfeito</em>: um sistema <strong>simples em sua essência</strong> (PHP puro), mas <strong>extremamente robusto em sua arquitetura</strong> (100% focado nos princípios SOLID e Padrões de Projeto).</p>

        <h2>Qual é o propósito?</h2>
        <p>Criar um <strong>Kernel (Núcleo)</strong> ultraleve, seguro e agnóstico, cujo único trabalho seja <em>orquestrar</em> aplicativos menores (Plugins) e Exibições (Temas). O núcleo não sabe o que é um "Paciente" ou um "Agendamento". Ele apenas fornece Ferramentas (Injeção de Dependência, Roteador, Banco de Dados Seguro) para que os Plugins façam o trabalho duro.</p>
        <p>Dessa forma, criamos um <strong>SaaS White-label (Software as a Service)</strong> escalável. Se amanhã quisermos criar um sistema para Advogados em vez de Clínicas, o núcleo continua o mesmo, bastando apenas conectar novos Plugins.</p>

        <h2>Para quem é este projeto?</h2>
        <p>Para clínicas médicas, consultórios e desenvolvedores corporativos que precisam de um ecossistema <strong>flexível, rápido e próprio</strong>, sem pagar licenças milionárias ou ficar refém do código espaguete de terceiros. A estrutura é feita para desenvolvedores sérios que apreciam Clean Architecture e TDD (Test-Driven Development).</p>

        <h2>Como poderá ser estendido?</h2>
        <p>A escalabilidade é infinita. Graças à arquitetura <em>Event-Driven</em> (Orientada a Eventos), desenvolvedores futuros podem injetar comportamentos (via Filtros e Ações) sem nunca tocar no código original (Open/Closed Principle).</p>
        <p>Você pode adicionar um Plugin de Gateway de Pagamento, um Plugin de WhatsApp Inteligente (Z-API), ou conectar o frontend via APIs REST, tudo isso respeitando o fluxo natural de rotas do sistema.</p>
    </div>

        <h1>Vision, Purpose and Target Audience</h1>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>Why create this project?</h2>
        <p>The current web suffers from two extremes: on one side, heavy and slow monolithic systems (like legacy and bloated versions of traditional CMS) full of workarounds; on the other side, modern and complex frameworks that require a very high learning curve and infinite dependencies via Composer.</p>
        <p>The <strong>Domain-System</strong> was born from the need to find the <em>perfect middle ground</em>: a system <strong>simple in its essence</strong> (pure PHP), but <strong>extremely robust in its architecture</strong> (100% focused on SOLID principles and Design Patterns).</p>

        <h2>What is the purpose?</h2>
        <p>Create an ultralight, secure and agnostic <strong>Kernel</strong>, whose sole job is to <em>orchestrate</em> smaller applications (Plugins) and Views (Themes). The core doesn't know what a "Patient" or an "Appointment" is. It just provides Tools (Dependency Injection, Router, Secure Database) for the Plugins to do the hard work.</p>
        <p>This way, we created a scalable <strong>White-label SaaS (Software as a Service)</strong>. If tomorrow we want to create a system for Lawyers instead of Clinics, the core remains the same, just requiring new Plugins to be connected.</p>

        <h2>Who is this project for?</h2>
        <p>For medical clinics, offices, and enterprise developers who need a <strong>flexible, fast and proprietary</strong> ecosystem, without paying expensive licenses or being held hostage by third-party spaghetti code. The structure is made for serious developers who appreciate Clean Architecture and TDD (Test-Driven Development).</p>

        <h2>How can it be extended?</h2>
        <p>Scalability is infinite. Thanks to the <em>Event-Driven</em> architecture, future developers can inject behaviors (via Filters and Actions) without ever touching the original code (Open/Closed Principle).</p>
        <p>You can add a Payment Gateway Plugin, a Smart WhatsApp Plugin (Z-API), or connect the frontend via REST APIs, all respecting the system's natural routing flow.</p>
    </div>

                <p style="color: #fca5a5; margin: 0;" data-i18n="alert_desc">To build for Domain-System OS, <strong>you must understand Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts</strong>. The system does not use loose global functions. Everything is based on Interfaces, Contracts, Classes, and Encapsulation.</p>

        <!-- TAB 1 -->
        <div id="tab1" class="tab-content active">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab1_h2">The End of Global Mess</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p1">If you come from WordPress, you are used to creating a <code class="highlight">functions.php</code> and using global functions. In Domain-System OS, this is strictly prohibited.</p>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p2">Every Extension (Plugin or Theme) is a Class that must sign a contract called <code class="highlight">OsExtensionInterface</code>. This contract divides your plugin's lifecycle into two isolated security phases.</p>
            
            <h3 data-i18n="tab1_h3">Dependency Injection (The Waiter)</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p3">Here, you don't hunt for system resources by instantiating random variables globally. The system works on a "Waiter" model: you sit down, ask for what you want (Phase 1), and the Operating System <strong class="highlight">injects</strong> the ready tool right into your hands (Phase 2).</p>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 2 -->
        <div id="tab2" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab2_h2">Phase 1: Negotiation (osRegister)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab2_p1">Before running any business logic, you use the <code class="highlight">OsConnector</code> object to notify the Operating System what you will need to use. If you do not request permission here, you will be blocked in Phase 2.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// 1. LINKS (Tools/Services)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// 2. SLOTS (Visual injection)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>);

    <span class="c">// 3. HOOKS (Events/Triggers)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>);
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 3 -->
        <div id="tab3" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab3_h2">Phase 2: Execution (osBoot)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab3_p1">After approving your contract, the OS hands you the <code class="highlight">OsRuntime</code>. This is where you actually work, receiving the requested resources strictly via Dependency Injection.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// 1. GETTING TOOLS</span>
    <span class="v">$db</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// 2. INJECTING VISUALS</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
        <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'Plugin successfully booted!'</span>
    ]);

    <span class="c">// 3. LISTENING TO EVENTS</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$patientId</span>) <span class="k">use</span> (<span class="v">$db</span>) {
        <span class="c">// Safe to execute logic here!</span>
    });
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 4 -->
        <div id="tab4" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab4_h2">Complete Extension Structure</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab4_p1">Every extension needs two files to exist: the Manifest (JSON) and the Contract (PHP Class).</p>
            
            <h3 style="color: var(--accent-purple);" data-i18n="tab4_json_title">1. The Manifest (plugin.json or theme.json)</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab4_json_desc">This file acts as the passport for your extension. It tells the OS who you are before any PHP code runs.</p>

<pre><span class="k">namespace</span> DomainSystem\Plugins\meu_plugin;

<span class="c">// 1. Importação Obrigatória dos Módulos do OS</span>
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime;

<span class="k">class</span> <span class="f">Plugin</span> <span class="k">extends</span> AbstractPlugin <span class="k">implements</span> OsExtensionInterface
{
    <span class="c">// Método legado (Ignorado pelo OS Novo, mas exigido pela classe Abstrata)</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">register</span>(): <span class="k">void</span> {}

    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="c">// FASE 1: NEGOCIAÇÃO</span>
    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>);
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>);
    }

    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="c">// FASE 2: EXECUÇÃO</span>
    <span class="c">// ==========================================</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="v">$db</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
        
        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
            <span class="s">'type'</span> => <span class="s">'success'</span>,
            <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'O novo Sistema Operacional Web está operante!'</span>
        ]);

        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$patientId</span>) <span class="k">use</span> (<span class="v">$db</span>) {
            <span class="v">$db</span>-><span class="f">query</span>(<span class="s">"INSERT INTO log..."</span>);
        });
    }
}</pre>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            // Update buttons
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
            
            // Update copy buttons text
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.innerText = lang === 'en' ? 'Copy' : 'Copiar';
            });
        }

        function openTab(tabId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function copyCode(btn) {
            const code = btn.nextElementSibling.innerText;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                const originalText = btn.innerText;
                const isEnglish = document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.contains('active');
                btn.innerText = isEnglish ? 'Copied!' : 'Copiado!';
                btn.style.color = '#10b981';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.color = '';
                    btn.style.borderColor = '';
                }, 2000);
            });
        }
        
        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>

            <h3 data-i18n="h3_1">As 5 Camadas de Auditoria</h3>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_1">Camada 1: Auditoria Sintática (Automática)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c1_1">Plugin.php compila</li>
                <li data-i18n="c1_2">Sem erros de sintaxe</li>
                <li data-i18n="c1_3">Sem código morto e variáveis não usadas</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_2" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 2: Auditoria de Contratos (Automática)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c2_1">Todos os Links exigidos existem</li>
                <li data-i18n="c2_2">Todos os Hooks escutados existem</li>

                <li data-i18n="c2_5">Nenhuma Contribution invade área de outro plugin</li>
            </ul>

            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c3_1">Analisa intenção vs. implementação.</li>
                <li data-i18n="c3_2">Valida se os Hooks e Links escolhidos fazem sentido para o objetivo de negócio.
                </li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_4" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 4: Auditoria SOLID (Estática + Regras)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c4_1">SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP.</li>
                <li data-i18n="c4_2">Valida tamanho de classes, interfaces infladas e acoplamento.</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_5" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 5: Auditoria de Segurança e LGPD</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c5_1">Bloqueia funções perigosas (<code>eval</code>, <code>shell_exec</code>).</li>
                <li data-i18n="c5_2">Previne SSRF, SQL Injection, XSS.</li>
                <li data-i18n="c5_3">Valida exposição de PII (Personally Identifiable Information).</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
            <h2 data-i18n="h2_3">Como Isso Se Encaixa com a DSL</h2>
            <p data-i18n="p3_1">A auditoria funciona perfeitamente <strong class="highlight">porque o Domain-System
                    possui uma DSL</strong>. Sem DSL, a auditoria precisa entender código livre (impossível com 100% de
                precisão). Com DSL, a auditoria sabe exatamente o que esperar de cada plugin (Análise Contratual).</p>

            <p><strong class="highlight text-blue" data-i18n="p3_example">Exemplo de Validação Contratual:</strong></p>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li><strong data-i18n="ex_1">Declarado:</strong>
                    <code>getSubscribedHooks() => ['appointment.canceled']</code></li>
                <li><strong data-i18n="ex_2">Implementado:</strong>
                    <code>public function onAppointmentCanceled($appointment)</code></li>
                <li data-i18n="ex_3">A auditoria verifica a correspondência e o respeito à assinatura do contrato.</li>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('diagram1').textContent = lang === 'en' ? diag1_en : diag1_pt;
            document.getElementById('diagram2').textContent = lang === 'en' ? diag2_en : diag2_pt;

            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
        }

        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>
