// Arquivo: domain-system/src\SystemApps\SystemMonitor\Plugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemMonitor;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemMonitor\Controllers\MonitorController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    // ==========================================
    // 1. FASE DE NEGOCIAÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ==========================================
    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 2. FASE DE EXECUÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ==========================================
    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/monitor', [MonitorController::class, 'index'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/monitor/clear', [MonitorController::class, 'clear'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/monitor/restart-kernel', [MonitorController::class, 'restartKernel'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/monitor/schema-heal', [MonitorController::class, 'healSchema'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/monitor/snapshot/create', [MonitorController::class, 'createSnapshot'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/monitor/snapshot/restore', [MonitorController::class, 'restoreSnapshot'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/api/os/notifications/clear', [MonitorController::class, 'clearApi'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/api/os/monitor/stack', [MonitorController::class, 'getStackApi'], 'SystemMonitor', ['admin']);
        });
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function($menu) {
            $menu[] = [
                'title' => 'Supervisão (Erros)',
                'url' => '/admin/monitor',
                'icon' => '🚨'
            ];
            return $menu;
        }, 99);
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src\SystemApps\SystemMonitor\Controllers\MonitorController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemMonitor\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SchemaDoctorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Monitoring\RequestMetricsRecorder;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\Services\ProcessRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\StateSnapshotManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;

class MonitorController
{
    private string $logPath;
    private string $basePath;
    private ThemeManagerInterface $theme;
    private ?\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface $notifManager;
    private RequestMetricsRecorder $metricsRecorder;
    private ?SchemaDoctorInterface $schemaDoctor;
    private StateSnapshotManager $snapshotManager;

    public function __construct(
        ThemeManagerInterface $theme,
        ?\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface $notifManager = null,
        ?RequestMetricsRecorder $metricsRecorder = null,
        ?string $basePath = null,
        ?SchemaDoctorInterface $schemaDoctor = null,
        ?StateSnapshotManager $snapshotManager = null
    ) {
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->notifManager = $notifManager;
        $this->basePath = $basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->logPath = rtrim($this->basePath, '/\\') . '/temp/error_logs.json';
        $this->metricsRecorder = $metricsRecorder ?? new RequestMetricsRecorder($this->basePath);
        $this->schemaDoctor = $schemaDoctor;
        $this->snapshotManager = $snapshotManager ?? new StateSnapshotManager($this->basePath);
    }

    public function index()
    {
        $logs = [];
        if (file_exists($this->logPath)) {
            $content = file_get_contents($this->logPath);
            $logs = json_decode($content, true) ?: [];
        }

        // Carrega a Pilha de Serviços (PIDs) do último boot
        $processes = [];
        $stackPath = rtrim($this->basePath, '/\\') . '/temp/process_stack.json';
        if (file_exists($stackPath)) {
            $processes = json_decode(file_get_contents($stackPath), true) ?: [];
        }

        $systemMemory = $this->getSystemMemoryStats();
        $singletonId = ProcessRegistry::getActiveSingletonId() ?: 'KRN-LIVE';

        $schemaReport = [];
        if ($this->schemaDoctor !== null) {
            try {
                $schemaReport = $this->schemaDoctor->inspectStatus();
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $schemaReport = [];
            }
        }

        $snapshots = $this->snapshotManager->listSnapshots();

        return $this->theme->render('admin_monitor', [
            'logs'          => $logs,
            'processes'     => $processes,
            'system_memory' => $systemMemory,
            'singleton_id'  => $singletonId,
            'schema_report' => $schemaReport,
            'snapshots'     => $snapshots,
        ], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');
    }

    public function healSchema()
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $stoppedParam = '';
        if ($this->schemaDoctor !== null) {
            try {
                $res = $this->schemaDoctor->healAll();
                if (!empty($res['stopped_at']) && is_array($res['stopped_at'])) {
                    $firstPlugin = (string)array_key_first($res['stopped_at']);
                    $firstMigration = (string)$res['stopped_at'][$firstPlugin];
                    $stoppedParam = '&stopped_at=' . rawurlencode("{$firstPlugin}:{$firstMigration}");
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Silencioso no redirect
            }
        }
        return \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::redirect($baseUrl . "/admin/monitor?healed=1" . $stoppedParam);
    }

    public function createSnapshot(Request $request)
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $label = (string)($request->input('label') ?? 'Snapshot Manual');
        try {
            $this->snapshotManager->createSnapshot($label);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            // Silencioso
        }
        return \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::redirect($baseUrl . "/admin/monitor?snap_created=1");
    }

    public function restoreSnapshot(Request $request)
    {
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $snapshotId = (string)($request->input('snapshot_id') ?? '');
        try {
            if ($snapshotId !== '') {
                $this->snapshotManager->restoreSnapshot($snapshotId);
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            // Silencioso
        }
        return \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::redirect($baseUrl . "/admin/monitor?snap_restored=1");
    }

    /**
     * Limpa exclusivamente o histórico de erros/logs e desarmes, sem matar o ciclo do Kernel (M-05).
     */
    public function clear()
    {
        if (file_exists($this->logPath)) {
            @unlink($this->logPath);
        }

        $disarmedPath = rtrim($this->basePath, '/\\') . '/temp/disarmed.json';
        if (file_exists($disarmedPath)) {
            @unlink($disarmedPath);
        }

        $this->metricsRecorder->clear();

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        return \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::redirect($baseUrl . "/admin/monitor?cleared=1");
    }

    /**
     * Reinicia explicitamente o ciclo de vida do Kernel Singleton (novos PIDs no próximo boot) (M-05).
     */
    public function restartKernel()
    {
        ProcessRegistry::killSingleton($this->basePath);
        Application::kill();

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        return \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::redirect($baseUrl . "/admin/monitor?restarted=1");
    }

    public function getStackApi()
    {
        $app = Application::getInstance();
        $processes = [];
        if ($app) {
            $processes = $app->getProcessRegistry()->getProcesses();
        }

        $stackPath = rtrim($this->basePath, '/\\') . '/temp/process_stack.json';
        if (empty($processes) && file_exists($stackPath)) {
            $processes = json_decode(file_get_contents($stackPath), true) ?: [];
        }

        $lastModified = file_exists($stackPath) ? filemtime($stackPath) : time();

        return new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse([
            'success'       => true,
            'processes'     => $processes,
            'lastModified'  => $lastModified,
            'singleton_id'  => ProcessRegistry::getActiveSingletonId() ?: 'KRN-LIVE',
            'system_memory' => $this->getSystemMemoryStats(),
        ]);
    }

    public function clearApi()
    {
        try {
            if ($this->notifManager) {
                $this->notifManager->clear();
            }
            return new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse(['success' => true]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse(['success' => false]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Coleta métricas de consumo e alocação de memória do worker atual e picos reais registrados (H-05).
     */
    private function getSystemMemoryStats(): array
    {
        $currentBytes = memory_get_usage(false);
        $allocatedBytes = memory_get_usage(true);
        $workerPeakBytes = memory_get_peak_usage(true);

        $workerPeakMb = round($workerPeakBytes / (1024 * 1024), 2);
        $recentPeakMb = $this->metricsRecorder->getMaxRecentPeakMb();
        $effectivePeakMb = max($workerPeakMb, $recentPeakMb);

        $limitStr = ini_get('memory_limit') ?: '128M';
        $limitBytes = $this->parseMemoryLimit($limitStr);

        $percentage = $limitBytes > 0 ? round(($allocatedBytes / $limitBytes) * 100, 1) : 0;

        return [
            'current_mb'      => round($currentBytes / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            'allocated_mb'    => round($allocatedBytes / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            'peak_mb'         => $effectivePeakMb,
            'worker_peak_mb'  => $workerPeakMb,
            'recent_peak_mb'  => $recentPeakMb,
            'recent_requests' => $this->metricsRecorder->getRecentEntries(),
            'limit'           => $limitStr,
            'limit_mb'        => round($limitBytes / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            'percentage'      => $percentage,
            'timestamp'       => time(),
            'time_str'        => date('H:i:s'),
        ];
    }

    private function parseMemoryLimit(string $limit): int
    {
        $limit = trim($limit);
        if ($limit === '-1') {
            return 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 2GB fallback para ilimitado
        }
        $last = strtolower($limit[strlen($limit) - 1]);
        $val = (int) $limit;
        switch ($last) {
            case 'g':
                $val *= 1024;
                // fall through
            case 'm':
                $val *= 1024;
                // fall through
            case 'k':
                $val *= 1024;
                break;
        }
        return $val > 0 ? $val : 128 * 1024 * 1024;
    }
}

<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// Sistema de Abas
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
function openSysTab(evt, tabId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.sys-content').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.sys-tab').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
    evt.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
    if (tabId === 'tab-processos' && window.DS_TRIGGER_CHART_RESIZE) {
        setTimeout(window.DS_TRIGGER_CHART_RESIZE, 50);
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// Gráfico ao Vivo de Memória & Heartbeat da Pilha
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    let pollInterval = null;
    const maxHistoryPoints = 30;
    
    // Inicializa o buffer histórico com dados iniciais do PHP
    const initialAllocated = <?= (float)($system_memory['allocated_mb'] ?? 0) ?>;
    const initialPeak = <?= (float)($system_memory['peak_mb'] ?? 0) ?>;
    const initialTime = "<?= htmlspecialchars($system_memory['time_str'] ?? date('H:i:s')) ?>";

    const memoryHistory = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        memoryHistory.push({
            time: initialTime,
            allocated: initialAllocated,
            peak: initialPeak
        });
    }

    // Mapa de memória anterior por PID para detectar oscilações dinâmicas
    const previousMemoryMap = {};
    <?php foreach ($processes as $pid => $proc): ?>
        previousMemoryMap['<?= htmlspecialchars($pid) ?>'] = <?= (float)($proc['memory_used_kb'] ?? 0) ?>;
    <?php endforeach; ?>

    const canvas = document.getElementById('os-memory-chart');
    const ctx = canvas ? canvas.getContext('2d') : null;

    function resizeCanvas() {
        if (!canvas || !ctx) return;
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
        canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
        drawLiveChart();
    }
    window.DS_TRIGGER_CHART_RESIZE = resizeCanvas;
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

    function drawLiveChart() {
        if (!canvas || !ctx || memoryHistory.length === 0) return;

        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        const w = canvas.width / dpr;
        const h = canvas.height / dpr;

        ctx.save();
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

        // Calcula escala mínima e máxima dinâmica com margem
        let minVal = Infinity;
        let maxVal = -Infinity;
        memoryHistory.forEach(pt => {
            if (pt.allocated < minVal) minVal = pt.allocated;
            if (pt.allocated > maxVal) maxVal = pt.allocated;
            if (pt.peak > maxVal) maxVal = pt.peak;
        });

        if (minVal === Infinity) minVal = 0;
        if (maxVal <= minVal) maxVal = minVal + 5;

        const paddingBottom = 22;
        const paddingTop = 15;
        const paddingLeft = 45;
        const paddingRight = 15;
        const plotW = w - paddingLeft - paddingRight;
        const plotH = h - paddingTop - paddingBottom;

        const valSpan = (maxVal - minVal) * 1.15 || 1;
        const baseMin = Math.max(0, minVal - valSpan * 0.05);
        const baseMax = baseMin + valSpan;

        function getY(val) {
            const norm = (val - baseMin) / (baseMax - baseMin);
            return paddingTop + plotH - norm * plotH;
        }

        function getX(idx) {
            if (memoryHistory.length <= 1) return paddingLeft;
            return paddingLeft + (idx / (memoryHistory.length - 1)) * plotW;
        }

        // 1. Grid Lines e Rótulos Y
        const gridSteps = 4;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.font = '10px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

        for (let i = 0; i <= gridSteps; i++) {
            const stepVal = baseMin + (i / gridSteps) * (baseMax - baseMin);
            const y = getY(stepVal);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(paddingLeft, y);
            ctx.lineTo(w - paddingRight, y);
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.fillText(stepVal.toFixed(1) + 'M', paddingLeft - 6, y);
        }

        // 2. Linha do Pico Máximo (Tracejada Dourada)
        const latestPeak = memoryHistory[memoryHistory.length - 1].peak;
        if (latestPeak > 0) {
            const peakY = getY(latestPeak);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(paddingLeft, peakY);
            ctx.lineTo(w - paddingRight, peakY);
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
            ctx.font = '10px monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillText('Pico ' + latestPeak.toFixed(1) + 'M', w - paddingRight, Math.max(peakY - 5, paddingTop));
            ctx.restore();
        }

        // 3. Área Preenchida com Gradiente Neon
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddingTop, 0, paddingTop + plotH);
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.0)');

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(getX(0), getY(memoryHistory[0].allocated));
        for (let i = 1; i < memoryHistory.length; i++) {
            const prevX = getX(i - 1);
            const prevY = getY(memoryHistory[i - 1].allocated);
            const curX = getX(i);
            const curY = getY(memoryHistory[i].allocated);
            const midX = (prevX + curX) / 2;
            ctx.bezierCurveTo(midX, prevY, midX, curY, curX, curY);
        }
        ctx.lineTo(getX(memoryHistory.length - 1), paddingTop + plotH);
        ctx.lineTo(getX(0), paddingTop + plotH);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fill();

        // 4. Linha Principal Neon Cyan da Memória Alocada
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(getX(0), getY(memoryHistory[0].allocated));
        for (let i = 1; i < memoryHistory.length; i++) {
            const prevX = getX(i - 1);
            const prevY = getY(memoryHistory[i - 1].allocated);
            const curX = getX(i);
            const curY = getY(memoryHistory[i].allocated);
            const midX = (prevX + curX) / 2;
            ctx.bezierCurveTo(midX, prevY, midX, curY, curX, curY);
        }
        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.8)';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#06b6d4';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        // 5. Ponto Pulsante da Leitura Mais Recente
        const lastIdx = memoryHistory.length - 1;
        const lastX = getX(lastIdx);
        const lastY = getY(memoryHistory[lastIdx].allocated);

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(lastX, lastY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(lastX, lastY, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.restore();
    }

    function setLiveStatus(status, color) {
        const dot = document.getElementById('os-live-dot');
        const txt = document.getElementById('os-live-text');
        if (dot) {
            dot.style.background = color;
            dot.style.boxShadow = '0 0 8px ' + color;
        }
        if (txt) txt.textContent = status;
    }

    function updateKpis(mem, singletonId) {
        if (!mem) return;
        const elAllocated = document.getElementById('kpi-mem-allocated');
        const elCurrent   = document.getElementById('kpi-mem-current');
        const elPeak      = document.getElementById('kpi-mem-peak');
        const elPercent   = document.getElementById('kpi-mem-percent');
        const elBar       = document.getElementById('kpi-mem-bar');
        const elLiveVal   = document.getElementById('chart-live-val');
        const elLatestLbl = document.getElementById('chart-latest-label');
        const elSingleton = document.getElementById('kpi-singleton-id');
        const elBadge     = document.getElementById('os-singleton-badge');

        if (elAllocated) elAllocated.textContent = parseFloat(mem.allocated_mb).toFixed(2);
        if (elCurrent) elCurrent.textContent = parseFloat(mem.current_mb).toFixed(2);
        if (elPeak) elPeak.textContent = parseFloat(mem.peak_mb).toFixed(2);
        if (elPercent) elPercent.textContent = mem.percentage + '%';
        if (elLiveVal) elLiveVal.textContent = parseFloat(mem.allocated_mb).toFixed(2) + ' MB';
        if (elLatestLbl) elLatestLbl.textContent = 'Tempo real: ' + mem.time_str;
        if (elBar) {
            const p = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, mem.percentage));
            elBar.style.width = p + '%';
            if (p > 80) {
                elBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444)';
            } else if (p > 60) {
                elBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #f59e0b)';
            } else {
                elBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #06b6d4, #38bdf8)';
            }
        }
        if (singletonId) {
            if (elSingleton) elSingleton.textContent = singletonId;
            if (elBadge) elBadge.textContent = singletonId;
        }
    }

    const previousDurationMap = {};

    function renderProcessTable(processes) {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('process-table-body');
        const table = document.getElementById('os-process-table');
        const empty = document.getElementById('os-empty-stack');
        if (!tbody) return;

        let hasProcesses = false;
        for (let pid in processes) {
            hasProcesses = true;
            let p = processes[pid];
            let row = document.getElementById('proc-row-' + p.pid);

            let curMem = parseFloat(p.memory_used_kb || 0);
            let prevMem = previousMemoryMap[pid] !== undefined ? previousMemoryMap[pid] : curMem;
            let delta = Math.round((curMem - prevMem) * 100) / 100;
            previousMemoryMap[pid] = curMem;

            // Se o servidor já enviou delta explícito, usamos
            if (p.memory_delta_kb !== undefined && Math.abs(parseFloat(p.memory_delta_kb)) > 0) {
                delta = parseFloat(p.memory_delta_kb);
            }

            let curDuration = parseFloat(p.duration_ms || 0);
            let prevDuration = previousDurationMap[pid] !== undefined ? previousDurationMap[pid] : curDuration;
            previousDurationMap[pid] = curDuration;

            let deltaBadge = '';
            if (delta > 0) {
                deltaBadge = `<span class="proc-delta-badge" style="font-size:11px; margin-left:6px; padding:1px 5px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(239,68,68,0.15); color:#f87171; border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3);">▲ +${delta.toFixed(2)} KB</span>`;
            } else if (delta < 0) {
                deltaBadge = `<span class="proc-delta-badge" style="font-size:11px; margin-left:6px; padding:1px 5px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color:#34d399; border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3);">▼ ${delta.toFixed(2)} KB</span>`;
            }

            let memC = curMem > 5000 ? '#ef4444' : 'var(--text-main)';
            let peakMem = parseFloat(p.peak_memory_kb || curMem).toFixed(2);
            let timeC = curDuration > 100 ? '#ef4444' : 'var(--accent-green)';
            let st = p.status === 'Running'
                ? '<span style="color:var(--accent-green);">● Estável</span>'
                : '<span style="color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold;">✖ Crashed</span>';

            let ring = p.type === 'SystemApp'
                ? '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(88,166,255,0.1);color:var(--accent-blue);border:1px solid var(--accent-blue);">Ring 0 (Core)</span>'
                : '<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(245,110,40,0.1);color:var(--accent-orange);border:1px solid var(--accent-orange);">Ring 3 (User)</span>';

            if (row) {
                const memCell = row.querySelector('.proc-mem-cell');
                if (memCell) {
                    memCell.innerHTML = `<span class="proc-mem-val" style="font-weight:600; color:${memC};">${curMem.toFixed(2)} KB</span> ${deltaBadge}`;
                }
                const peakCell = row.querySelector('.proc-peak-cell');
                if (peakCell) {
                    peakCell.textContent = peakMem + ' KB';
                }
                const timeCell = row.querySelector('.proc-time-cell');
                if (timeCell) {
                    timeCell.style.color = timeC;
                    timeCell.textContent = curDuration.toFixed(2) + ' ms';
                    if (Math.abs(curDuration - prevDuration) > 0.01) {
                        timeCell.style.transition = 'text-shadow 0.3s ease';
                        timeCell.style.textShadow = '0 0 10px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.9)';
                        setTimeout(() => { timeCell.style.textShadow = 'none'; }, 600);
                    }
                }
                const statusCell = row.querySelector('.proc-status-cell');
                if (statusCell) {
                    statusCell.innerHTML = st;
                }
            } else {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.id = 'proc-row-' + p.pid;
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:bold;color:var(--accent-blue);">${p.pid}</td>
                    <td><strong>${p.name}</strong></td>
                    <td>${ring}</td>
                    <td class="proc-mem-cell">
                        <span class="proc-mem-val" style="font-weight:600; color:${memC};">${curMem.toFixed(2)} KB</span>
                        ${deltaBadge}
                    </td>
                    <td class="proc-peak-cell" style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">${peakMem} KB</td>
                    <td class="proc-time-cell" style="color:${timeC}; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 500;">${curDuration.toFixed(2)} ms</td>
                    <td class="proc-status-cell">${st}</td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            }
        }

        if (hasProcesses) {
            if (table) table.style.display = '';
            if (empty) empty.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function poll() {
        const tab = document.getElementById('tab-processos');
        if (!tab || !tab.classList.contains('active')) {
            setLiveStatus('Pausado (aba inativa)', '#334155');
            return;
        }

        setLiveStatus('Consultando...', '#f59e0b');

        fetch(window.DS_BASE_URL + 'api/os/monitor/stack')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.success) {
                    if (data.system_memory) {
                        updateKpis(data.system_memory, data.singleton_id);
                        memoryHistory.push({
                            time: data.system_memory.time_str,
                            allocated: parseFloat(data.system_memory.allocated_mb),
                            peak: parseFloat(data.system_memory.peak_mb)
                        });
                        if (memoryHistory.length > maxHistoryPoints) {
                            memoryHistory.shift();
                        }
                        drawLiveChart();
                    }

                    if (data.processes) {
                        renderProcessTable(data.processes);
                    }

                    setLiveStatus('Monitor Ativo', '#10b981');
                }
            })
            .catch(() => setLiveStatus('Erro de conexão', '#ef4444'));
    }

    // Inicializa o Canvas ao carregar a página
    setTimeout(resizeCanvas, 100);

    // Heartbeat a cada 3 segundos
    pollInterval = setInterval(poll, 3000);

    // Executa imediatamente ao abrir a aba
    document.querySelectorAll('.sys-tab').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                resizeCanvas();
                poll();
            }, 100);
        });
    });
})();
</script>

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Plugin.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\CoreUpdaterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\DatabaseBackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\UpdateServiceBinder;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateNotifier;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Controllers\UpdateController;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Widgets\UpdateWidgetProvider;
use Throwable;

final class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void
    {
    }

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.session');
        $os->requireLink('core.dashboard.widgets');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('dashboard.register_widgets');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $rootPath = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 3);
        UpdateServiceBinder::bind($runtime, $rootPath);

        $runtime->bind(UpdateController::class, static function ($c): UpdateController {
            return new UpdateController(
                theme: $c->make(ThemeManagerInterface::class),
                session: $c->make(SessionManagerInterface::class),
                checker: $c->make(UpdateCheckerInterface::class),
                targetResolver: $c->make(UpdateTargetResolverInterface::class),
                stateStore: $c->make(UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
                notifications: self::resolveOptional($c, NotificationManagerInterface::class),
                notifier: self::resolveOptional($c, UpdateNotifier::class),
                healthCheck: self::resolveOptional($c, HealthCheckInterface::class),
                coreUpdater: self::resolveOptional($c, CoreUpdaterInterface::class),
                backup: self::resolveOptional($c, BackupInterface::class),
                databaseBackup: self::resolveOptional($c, DatabaseBackupInterface::class),
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateWidgetProvider::class, static function ($c): UpdateWidgetProvider {
            return new UpdateWidgetProvider(
                checker: $c->make(UpdateCheckerInterface::class),
                targetResolver: $c->make(UpdateTargetResolverInterface::class),
                stateStore: self::resolveOptional($c, UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
                notifier: self::resolveOptional($c, UpdateNotifier::class),
                notifications: self::resolveOptional($c, NotificationManagerInterface::class),
            );
        });

        $runtime->onHook('router.register', static function (Router $router): void {
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/settings/updates', [UpdateController::class, 'index'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/settings/updates/core/check', [UpdateController::class, 'check'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/settings/updates/core/begin', [UpdateController::class, 'begin'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/settings/updates/core/advance', [UpdateController::class, 'advance'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/settings/updates/core/rollback', [UpdateController::class, 'rollback'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/settings/updates/core/backups/prune', [UpdateController::class, 'pruneBackups'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/settings/updates/backups/prune', [UpdateController::class, 'pruneBackups'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/settings/updates/core/health', [UpdateController::class, 'health'], 'SystemUpdater', ['admin']);
        });

        $sessionManager = $runtime->getLink('core.session');
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', static function (array $menu) use ($sessionManager): array {
            $role = strtolower((string)$sessionManager->get('user_role', 'admin'));
            if ($role === 'admin') {
                $menu[] = [
                    'title' => 'Atualizações',
                    'url'   => '/admin/settings/updates',
                    'icon'  => '🔄',
                ];
            }
            return $menu;
        }, 98);

        try {
            $registry = $runtime->getLink('core.dashboard.widgets');
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'registerProvider')) {
                $registry->registerProvider($runtime->make(UpdateWidgetProvider::class));
            }
        } catch (Throwable) {
        }

        $runtime->onHook('dashboard.register_widgets', static function ($registry) use ($runtime): void {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'registerProvider')) {
                $registry->registerProvider($runtime->make(UpdateWidgetProvider::class));
            }
        });
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->registerCapability('system.update', 'SystemUpdater');
    }

    private static function resolveOptional(mixed $container, string $abstract): mixed
    {
        if (!is_object($container) || !method_exists($container, 'make')) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            if (method_exists($container, 'has') && !$container->has($abstract)) {
                return null;
            }
            return $container->make($abstract);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Console\UpdateCliCommandHandler.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Console;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\CoreUpdaterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStep;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateState;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Camada de comando CLI para o atualizador do sistema (testável sem I/O real).
 *
 * Comandos suportados:
 * - `system:check`
 * - `system:status`
 * - `system:update [--yes] [--confirm-no-db-backup]`
 * - `system:rollback [id]`
 * - `system:health`
 */
final class UpdateCliCommandHandler
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly CoreUpdaterInterface $updater,
        private readonly UpdateTargetResolverInterface $targetResolver,
        private readonly UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore,
        private readonly HealthCheckInterface $healthCheck,
        private readonly ?BackupInterface $backup = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $args Argumentos após o nome do comando (ex.: `['--yes']`).
     * @return array{exitCode: int, output: string}
     */
    public function execute(string $command, array $args = []): array
    {
        return match (strtolower(trim($command))) {
            'system:check'    => $this->handleCheck(),
            'system:status'   => $this->handleStatus(),
            'system:update'   => $this->handleUpdate($args),
            'system:rollback' => $this->handleRollback($args),
            'system:health'   => $this->handleHealth(),
            default           => [
                'exitCode' => 1,
                'output'   => sprintf("Comando desconhecido: %s\n", $command),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return array{exitCode: int, output: string}
     */
    private function handleCheck(): array
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $result = $this->updater->check($target, true);

        $lines = [
            sprintf('Alvo: %s (%s)', $target->slug, $target->repository),
            sprintf('Versão instalada: v%s', $target->installedVersion),
            sprintf('Status: %s', $result->status->value),
        ];

        if ($result->release !== null) {
            $lines[] = sprintf('Versão disponível: v%s (%s)', $result->release->version, $result->release->tag);
        }

        foreach ($result->reasons as $reason) {
            $lines[] = 'Motivo: ' . $reason;
        }

        return [
            'exitCode' => $result->status === UpdateStatus::Unknown ? 1 : 0,
            'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{exitCode: int, output: string}
     */
    private function handleStatus(): array
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);

        $lines = [
            sprintf('Update ID: %s', $state->updateId),
            sprintf('Versão instalada: v%s', $target->installedVersion),
            sprintf('Etapa atual: %s', $state->step->value),
            sprintf('Atualizado em: %s', $state->updatedAt),
        ];

        if ($state->release !== null) {
            $lines[] = sprintf('Release alvo: v%s', $state->release->version);
        }
        if ($state->error !== null) {
            $lines[] = sprintf('Erro: %s', $state->error);
        }

        return [
            'exitCode' => $state->step === UpdateStep::Failed ? 1 : 0,
            'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $args
     * @return array{exitCode: int, output: string}
     */
    private function handleUpdate(array $args): array
    {
        $confirmed = in_array('--yes', $args, true) || in_array('-y', $args, true);
        if (!$confirmed) {
            return [
                'exitCode' => 1,
                'output'   => "Confirmação obrigatória: execute 'php os-cli.php system:update --yes' para aplicar a atualização.\n",
            ];
        }

        $confirmNoDbBackup = in_array('--confirm-no-db-backup', $args, true);
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $lines = [];

        try {
            $state = $this->updater->begin($target, [
                'confirmNoDbBackup' => $confirmNoDbBackup,
            ]);
            $lines[] = sprintf('[%s] Atualização iniciada (ID: %s)', $state->step->value, $state->updateId);
            $updateId = $state->updateId;

            $maxIterations = 20;
            $iteration = 0;

            while ($iteration < $maxIterations) {
                $iteration++;
                $state = $this->updater->advance($updateId);
                $lines[] = sprintf('[%s] Etapa processada', $state->step->value);

                if (($state->context['awaiting'] ?? null) === 'health') {
                    $lines[] = '[health] Executando verificação de saúde pós-atualização...';
                    $report = $this->healthCheck->run($target);
                    $ctx = $state->context;
                    $ctx['health_report'] = $report->toArray();
                    unset($ctx['awaiting']);
                    $stateWithHealth = new UpdateState(
                        updateId: $state->updateId,
                        target: $state->target,
                        step: $state->step,
                        release: $state->release,
                        etag: $state->etag,
                        lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
                        context: $ctx,
                        error: $state->error,
                        updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
                    );
                    $this->stateStore->save($stateWithHealth);
                    continue;
                }

                if ($state->step === UpdateStep::Done) {
                    $lines[] = sprintf(
                        '✅ Atualização concluída com sucesso para v%s.',
                        $state->release?->version ?? $state->target->installedVersion
                    );
                    return [
                        'exitCode' => 0,
                        'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
                    ];
                }

                if ($state->step === UpdateStep::RolledBack || $state->step === UpdateStep::Failed) {
                    $lines[] = sprintf(
                        '❌ Atualização encerrada em estado "%s": %s',
                        $state->step->value,
                        (string)$state->error
                    );
                    return [
                        'exitCode' => 1,
                        'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
                    ];
                }
            }

            $lines[] = '❌ Limite de iterações excedido durante atualização.';
            return [
                'exitCode' => 1,
                'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $lines[] = '❌ Erro ao executar atualização: ' . $e->getMessage();
            return [
                'exitCode' => 1,
                'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
            ];
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $args
     * @return array{exitCode: int, output: string}
     */
    private function handleRollback(array $args): array
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);
        $requestedId = isset($args[0]) && !str_starts_with($args[0], '-') ? trim($args[0]) : '';

        try {
            // Se o argumento corresponder a um ID de backup específico na listagem, restaura-o
            if ($requestedId !== '' && $requestedId !== $state->updateId && $this->backup !== null) {
                $scope = new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core');
                foreach ($this->backup->list($scope) as $record) {
                    if ($record->id === $requestedId) {
                        $this->backup->restore($record);
                        return [
                            'exitCode' => 0,
                            'output'   => sprintf("✅ Backup '%s' restaurado com sucesso.\n", $record->id),
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }

            $updateId = $requestedId !== '' ? $requestedId : $state->updateId;
            $rolledBack = $this->updater->rollback($updateId);

            if ($rolledBack->step === UpdateStep::RolledBack) {
                return [
                    'exitCode' => 0,
                    'output'   => sprintf("✅ Rollback concluído para a atualização '%s'.\n", $rolledBack->updateId),
                ];
            }

            return [
                'exitCode' => 1,
                'output'   => sprintf(
                    "❌ Rollback terminou em estado '%s': %s\n",
                    $rolledBack->step->value,
                    (string)$rolledBack->error
                ),
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [
                'exitCode' => 1,
                'output'   => '❌ Erro ao executar rollback: ' . $e->getMessage() . "\n",
            ];
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array{exitCode: int, output: string}
     */
    private function handleHealth(): array
    {
        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $report = $this->healthCheck->run($target);

        $lines = [
            sprintf('Saúde do sistema: %s', $report->ok ? 'OK' : 'FALHA'),
        ];

        foreach ($report->toArray()['checks'] as $check) {
            $id = (string)($check['id'] ?? 'check');
            $level = (string)($check['level'] ?? (($check['ok'] ?? false) ? 'ok' : 'block'));
            $msg = (string)($check['message'] ?? '');
            $lines[] = sprintf(' - [%s] %s: %s', strtoupper($level), $id, $msg);
        }

        return [
            'exitCode' => $report->ok ? 0 : 1,
            'output'   => implode("\n", $lines) . "\n",
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Controllers\UpdateController.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\CoreUpdaterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\DatabaseBackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStep;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateNotifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateState;
use Throwable;

final class UpdateController
{
    private UpdateNotifier $notifier;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ThemeManagerInterface $theme,
        private readonly SessionManagerInterface $session,
        private readonly UpdateCheckerInterface $checker,
        private readonly UpdateTargetResolverInterface $targetResolver,
        private readonly UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore,
        ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifications = null,
        ?UpdateNotifier $notifier = null,
        private readonly ?HealthCheckInterface $healthCheck = null,
        private readonly ?CoreUpdaterInterface $coreUpdater = null,
        private readonly ?BackupInterface $backup = null,
        private readonly ?DatabaseBackupInterface $databaseBackup = null,
    ) {
        $this->notifier = $notifier ?? new UpdateNotifier($this->stateStore, $notifications);
    }

    public function index(?Request $request = null): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new Response('Acesso restrito a administradores.', 403);
        }

        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $checkResult = $this->checker->check($target, false);
        $this->notifier->notifyIfAvailable($checkResult);

        $currentState = $this->stateStore->load($target);
        $backups = $this->backup !== null
            ? $this->backup->list(new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core'))
            : [];
        $dbBackupSupported = $this->databaseBackup === null || $this->databaseBackup->isSupported();

        $checkedNow = $request !== null && (string)($request->input('checked') ?? '') === '1';

        $html = $this->theme->render('updates', [
            'target'              => $target,
            'check_result'        => $checkResult,
            'update_state'        => $currentState,
            'backups'             => $backups,
            'db_backup_supported' => $dbBackupSupported,
            'csrf_token'          => $this->session->getCsrfToken(),
            'checked_now'         => $checkedNow,
            'base_url'            => defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim((string)BASE_URL, '/') : '',
        ], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function check(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new Response('Acesso restrito a administradores.', 403);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        if (!$this->session->validateCsrfToken($token)) {
            return new Response('Token CSRF inválido.', 403);
        }

        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $checkResult = $this->checker->check($target, true);
        $this->notifier->notifyIfAvailable($checkResult);

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim((string)BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        return Response::redirect($baseUrl . '/admin/settings/updates?checked=1');
    }

    public function begin(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Acesso restrito a administradores.'], 403);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        if (!$this->session->validateCsrfToken($token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        if ($this->coreUpdater === null) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Orquestrador CoreUpdater não disponível.'], 500);
        }

        $confirmNoDbBackup = in_array(
            (string)($request->input('confirm_no_db_backup') ?? ''),
            ['1', 'true', 'on'],
            true
        );

        try {
            $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
            $state = $this->coreUpdater->begin($target, [
                'confirmNoDbBackup' => $confirmNoDbBackup,
            ]);

            return new JsonResponse([
                'ok'    => true,
                'state' => $state->toArray(),
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'ok'    => false,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ], 400);
        }
    }

    public function advance(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        @set_time_limit(300);

        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Acesso restrito a administradores.'], 403);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        if (!$this->session->validateCsrfToken($token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        if ($this->coreUpdater === null) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Orquestrador CoreUpdater não disponível.'], 500);
        }

        $updateId = trim((string)($request->input('update_id') ?? ''));
        if ($updateId === '') {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'O parâmetro update_id é obrigatório.'], 400);
        }

        try {
            $state = $this->coreUpdater->advance($updateId);
            $isOk = !in_array($state->step, [UpdateStep::Failed, UpdateStep::RolledBack], true);

            return new JsonResponse([
                'ok'    => $isOk,
                'state' => $state->toArray(),
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'ok'    => false,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ], 400);
        }
    }

    public function rollback(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        @set_time_limit(300);

        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Acesso restrito a administradores.'], 403);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        if (!$this->session->validateCsrfToken($token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        $backupId = trim((string)($request->input('backup_id') ?? ''));
        if ($backupId !== '' && $this->backup !== null) {
            try {
                $scope = new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core');
                foreach ($this->backup->list($scope) as $record) {
                    if ($record->id === $backupId) {
                        $this->backup->restore($record);
                        if ($record->dumpPath !== null && $this->databaseBackup !== null) {
                            $this->databaseBackup->restore($record->dumpPath);
                        }
                        return new JsonResponse([
                            'ok'      => true,
                            'message' => sprintf('Backup %s restaurado com sucesso.', $record->id),
                        ]);
                    }
                }
                return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Backup não encontrado.'], 404);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()], 500);
            }
        }

        if ($this->coreUpdater === null) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Orquestrador CoreUpdater não disponível.'], 500);
        }

        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $currentState = $this->stateStore->load($target);
        $updateId = trim((string)($request->input('update_id') ?? $currentState->updateId));

        try {
            $state = $this->coreUpdater->rollback($updateId);
            return new JsonResponse([
                'ok'    => $state->step === UpdateStep::RolledBack,
                'state' => $state->toArray(),
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return new JsonResponse([
                'ok'    => false,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ], 400);
        }
    }

    public function pruneBackups(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Acesso restrito a administradores.'], 403);
        }

        $token = (string)($request->input('csrf_token') ?? '');
        if (!$this->session->validateCsrfToken($token)) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Token CSRF inválido.'], 403);
        }

        if ($this->backup === null) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Serviço de backup não configurado.'], 500);
        }

        $removed = $this->backup->prune(new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core'), 2);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'ok'      => true,
            'removed' => $removed,
        ]);
    }

    public function health(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        if (!$this->isAdmin()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Acesso restrito a administradores.'], 403);
        }

        if ($this->healthCheck === null) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Serviço HealthCheck não configurado.'], 500);
        }

        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $state = $this->stateStore->load($target);

        $requestedId = trim((string)($request->input('update_id') ?? ''));
        if ($requestedId !== '' && $state->updateId !== $requestedId) {
            return new JsonResponse(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'update_id inválido ou divergente do estado ativo.'], 400);
        }

        $report = $this->healthCheck->run($target);

        $context = $state->context;
        $context['health_report'] = $report->toArray();
        unset($context['awaiting']);

        $updatedState = new UpdateState(
            updateId: $state->updateId,
            target: $state->target,
            step: $state->step,
            release: $state->release,
            etag: $state->etag,
            lastCheckAt: $state->lastCheckAt,
            context: $context,
            error: $state->error,
            updatedAt: gmdate('c'),
        );
        $this->stateStore->save($updatedState);

        return new JsonResponse([
            'ok'     => $report->ok,
            'report' => $report->toArray(),
            'state'  => $updatedState->toArray(),
        ]);
    }

    private function isAdmin(): bool
    {
        $role = strtolower((string)$this->session->get('user_role', 'admin'));
        return $role === 'admin';
    }
}

                        <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: <?= !$dbBackupSupported ? '#fbbf24' : '#94a3b8' ?>; cursor: pointer;">

                            <span>

                <button
                    type="button"
                    id="ds-btn-prune-backups"
                    class="button"
                    style="background: #334155; border-color: #475569; color: #f8fafc; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;">
                    🧹 Remover antigos (manter 2 mais recentes)
                </button>

        <?php if (empty($backupsList)): ?>
            <p style="margin: 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 13px;">Nenhum ponto de restauração registrado até o momento.</p>

                        <th style="padding: 8px;">Criado em</th>
                        <th style="padding: 8px;">Banco Incluído</th>
                        <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">Ações</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    <?php foreach ($backupsList as $record): ?>
                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #1e293b;">
                            <td style="padding: 8px;"><code><?= htmlspecialchars($record->id, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?></code></td>
                            <td style="padding: 8px;"><?= htmlspecialchars($record->label, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?></td>

<script>
(function () {
    const csrfToken = <?= json_encode($csrf_token ?? '') ?>;
    const urls = {
        begin: <?= json_encode($basePrefix . '/admin/settings/updates/core/begin') ?>,
        advance: <?= json_encode($basePrefix . '/admin/settings/updates/core/advance') ?>,
        health: <?= json_encode($basePrefix . '/admin/settings/updates/core/health') ?>,
        rollback: <?= json_encode($basePrefix . '/admin/settings/updates/core/rollback') ?>,
        prune: <?= json_encode($basePrefix . '/admin/settings/updates/backups/prune') ?>
    };

    const orderedSteps = [
        'checked',
        'downloaded',
        'verified',
        'preflighted',
        'backed_up',
        'maintenance_on',
        'applied',
        'migrated',
        'schema_verified',
        'health_checked',
        'done'
    ];

    function askConfirmation(message, onConfirm) {
        if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.confirm === 'function') {
            window.OS.confirm(message, onConfirm);
            return;
        }
        if (window.confirm(message)) {
            onConfirm();
        }
    }

    function updateStepIndicators(currentStep, isError) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('ds-update-progress-panel');
        const bar = document.getElementById('ds-update-progress-bar');
        if (panel) panel.style.display = 'block';

        const idx = orderedSteps.indexOf(currentStep);
        if (bar && idx >= 0) {
            const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round(((idx + 1) / orderedSteps.length) * 100));
            bar.style.width = pct + '%';
            if (isError) {
                bar.style.background = '#ef4444';
            }
        }

        const items = document.querySelectorAll('#ds-update-steps-list li[data-step]');
        items.forEach(function (li) {
            const stepName = li.getAttribute('data-step');
            const stepIdx = orderedSteps.indexOf(stepName);
            const labelText = li.textContent.replace(/^([^\s]+)\s/, '');
            if (stepIdx < idx || currentStep === 'done') {
                li.textContent = '✅ ' + labelText;
                li.style.color = '#34d399';
            } else if (stepIdx === idx) {
                li.textContent = (isError ? '❌ ' : '🔄 ') + labelText;
                li.style.color = isError ? '#f87171' : '#38bdf8';
            } else {
                li.textContent = '⏳ ' + labelText;
                li.style.color = '#94a3b8';
            }
        });
    }

    function setStatusText(text, isError) {
        const el = document.getElementById('ds-update-status-message');
        if (!el) return;
        el.textContent = text;
        el.style.color = isError ? '#fca5a5' : '#e2e8f0';
    }

    async function postForm(url, params) {
        const body = new URLSearchParams(params);
        body.set('csrf_token', csrfToken);
        const resp = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
            body: body.toString()
        });
        return resp.json();
    }

    async function runUpdateLoop() {
        const startBtn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-start-update');
        if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = true;

        const confirmNoDbCheckbox = document.getElementById('ds-confirm-no-db-backup');
        const confirmNoDb = confirmNoDbCheckbox && confirmNoDbCheckbox.checked ? '1' : '0';

        try {
            setStatusText('Iniciando atualização e adquirindo lock exclusivo...', false);
            const beginRes = await postForm(urls.begin, { confirm_no_db_backup: confirmNoDb });

            if (!beginRes.ok || !beginRes.state) {
                setStatusText('Falha ao iniciar: ' + (beginRes.error || 'Erro desconhecido.'), true);
                if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false;
                return;
            }

            let state = beginRes.state;
            const updateId = state.updateId || state.update_id;
            updateStepIndicators(state.step, false);

            let guard = 0;
            while (guard < 25) {
                guard++;
                setStatusText('Executando etapa após ' + state.step + '...', false);
                const advRes = await postForm(urls.advance, { update_id: updateId });

                if (!advRes.state) {
                    setStatusText('Erro na comunicação: ' + (advRes.error || 'Resposta inválida.'), true);
                    updateStepIndicators(state.step, true);
                    return;
                }

                state = advRes.state;
                updateStepIndicators(state.step, !advRes.ok);

                if (state.context && state.context.awaiting === 'health') {
                    setStatusText('Verificando saúde do sistema em nova requisição HTTP...', false);
                    const healthUrl = urls.health + '?update_id=' + encodeURIComponent(updateId);
                    await fetch(healthUrl, { method: 'GET', credentials: 'same-origin' });
                    continue;
                }

                if (state.step === 'done') {
                    setStatusText('✅ Atualização concluída com sucesso! Recarregando página...', false);
                    setTimeout(function () { window.location.reload(); }, 1500);
                    return;
                }

                if (state.step === 'rolled_back' || state.step === 'failed' || !advRes.ok) {
                    setStatusText(
                        '❌ Atualização interrompida (' + state.step + '): ' + (state.error || advRes.error || ''),
                        true
                    );
                    return;
                }
            }
        } catch (err) {
            setStatusText('Erro inesperado de rede: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)), true);
            if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    const startBtn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-start-update');
    if (startBtn) {
        startBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const ver = startBtn.getAttribute('data-version') || '';
            askConfirmation(
                'Deseja iniciar a atualização automática do núcleo para v' + ver + '? Um backup completo será criado antes da aplicação.',
                runUpdateLoop
            );
        });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.ds-btn-restore-backup').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const backupId = btn.getAttribute('data-backup-id') || '';
            askConfirmation(
                'Deseja restaurar o backup "' + backupId + '"? Os arquivos atuais serão substituídos pela versão do backup.',
                async function () {
                    const res = await postForm(urls.rollback, { backup_id: backupId });
                    if (res.ok) {
                        window.location.reload();
                    } else {
                        alert('Erro ao restaurar backup: ' + (res.error || 'Falha desconhecida.'));
                    }
                }
            );
        });
    });

    const pruneBtn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-prune-backups');
    if (pruneBtn) {
        pruneBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            askConfirmation(
                'Deseja remover os backups antigos e manter apenas os 2 mais recentes?',
                async function () {
                    const res = await postForm(urls.prune, {});
                    if (res.ok) {
                        window.location.reload();
                    } else {
                        alert('Erro ao limpar backups: ' + (res.error || 'Falha desconhecida.'));
                    }
                }
            );
        });
    }
})();
</script>

// Arquivo: domain-system/src\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Widgets\UpdateWidgetProvider.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemUpdater\Widgets;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DashboardWidgetProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateStatus;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateNotifier;

final class UpdateWidgetProvider implements DashboardWidgetProviderInterface
{
    public const WIDGET_ID = 'sys_version_status';

    private ?UpdateNotifier $notifier;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly UpdateCheckerInterface $checker,
        private readonly UpdateTargetResolverInterface $targetResolver,
        ?UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore = null,
        ?UpdateNotifier $notifier = null,
        ?NotificationManagerInterface $notifications = null,
    ) {
        if ($notifier !== null) {
            $this->notifier = $notifier;
        } elseif ($stateStore !== null) {
            $this->notifier = new UpdateNotifier($stateStore, $notifications);
        } else {
            $this->notifier = null;
        }
    }

    public function getProviderName(): string
    {
        return 'Atualizações do Sistema';
    }

    public function getAvailableWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            self::WIDGET_ID => [
                'title'       => 'Versão do Sistema',
                'description' => 'Exibe a versão instalada do núcleo e avisa quando há uma nova Release disponível.',
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function renderWidget(string $widgetId): string
    {
        if ($widgetId !== self::WIDGET_ID) {
            return '';
        }

        $target = $this->targetResolver->core();
        $result = $this->checker->check($target, false);
        $this->notifier?->notifyIfAvailable($result);

        $installed = htmlspecialchars($target->installedVersion, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim((string)BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $updatesUrl = htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/admin/settings/updates', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

        if ($result->status === UpdateStatus::Available && $result->release !== null) {
            $availableVersion = htmlspecialchars($result->release->version, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            return "
            <div style='display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;'>
                <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;'>
                    <span style='color:var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size:13px;'>Versão Instalada</span>
                    <span style='font-weight:600; font-family:monospace;'>v{$installed}</span>
                </div>
                <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background:rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); border:1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px;'>
                    <span style='color:#fbbf24; font-weight:600; font-size:13px;'>🔔 Nova versão disponível</span>
                    <span class='badge' style='background:#f59e0b; color:#0f172a; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-family:monospace;'>v{$availableVersion}</span>
                </div>
                <div style='text-align:right; margin-top:4px;'>
                    <a href='{$updatesUrl}' style='color:var(--accent-blue, #38bdf8); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none;'>Ver detalhes da atualização →</a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        }

        if ($result->status === UpdateStatus::UpToDate) {
            return "
            <div style='display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;'>
                <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;'>
                    <span style='color:var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size:13px;'>Versão Instalada</span>
                    <span style='font-weight:600; font-family:monospace;'>v{$installed}</span>
                </div>
                <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;'>
                    <span style='color:var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size:13px;'>Status</span>
                    <span style='color:var(--accent-green, #10b981); font-weight:600; font-size:13px;'>✔ Sistema atualizado</span>
                </div>
                <div style='text-align:right; margin-top:4px;'>
                    <a href='{$updatesUrl}' style='color:var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size:12px; text-decoration:none;'>Gerenciar atualizações →</a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        }

        return "
        <div style='display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;'>
            <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;'>
                <span style='color:var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size:13px;'>Versão Instalada</span>
                <span style='font-weight:600; font-family:monospace;'>v{$installed}</span>
            </div>
            <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;'>
                <span style='color:var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size:13px;'>Status</span>
                <span style='color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;'>Verificação pendente</span>
            </div>
            <div style='text-align:right; margin-top:4px;'>
                <a href='{$updatesUrl}' style='color:var(--accent-blue, #38bdf8); font-size:12px; text-decoration:none;'>Verificar agora →</a>
            </div>
        </div>";
    }
}

<script>
// Mantém o JSON do catálogo no JS para popular o segundo combobox dinamicamente
const catalog = <?= json_encode($catalog) ?>;
const currentUserWidgets = <?= json_encode($userWidgets) ?>;

const addWidgetBtn = document.getElementById('addWidgetBtn');
const widgetModal = document.getElementById('widgetModal');
const closeModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeModalBtn');
const providerSelect = document.getElementById('providerSelect');
const widgetSelect = document.getElementById('widgetSelect');
const addWidgetForm = document.getElementById('addWidgetForm');

addWidgetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    widgetModal.style.display = 'flex';
});

closeModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    widgetModal.style.display = 'none';
});

// Popula os widgets quando o provedor muda
providerSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const providerClass = this.value;
    widgetSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Escolha --</option>';
    
    if (!providerClass) {
        widgetSelect.disabled = true;
        return;
    }

    const providerData = catalog.find(p => p.provider_class === providerClass);
    if (providerData && providerData.widgets) {
        Object.entries(providerData.widgets).forEach(([id, meta]) => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = id;
            opt.textContent = meta.title + ' (' + meta.description + ')';
            widgetSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
        widgetSelect.disabled = false;
    }
});

// Ao submeter, envia a nova array de widgets via form dinâmico
addWidgetForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pClass = providerSelect.value;
    const wId = widgetSelect.value;
    
    if(!pClass || !wId) {
        alert("Selecione um módulo e um widget!");
        return;
    }

    // Adiciona na array
    currentUserWidgets.push({provider: pClass, id: wId});
    
    // Cria form invisível e submete para save-layout
    const form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/dashboard/save-layout';
    
    // INJETANDO O CSRF TOKEN TAMBÉM NO FORM INVISÍVEL PARA NÃO DAR ERRO DE CSRF DEPOIS!
    const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    currentUserWidgets.forEach(w => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'widgets[]';
        input.value = JSON.stringify(w);
        form.appendChild(input);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
});

// Remove um widget da array pelo index e salva o layout
function removeWidget(index) {
    // Remove o widget do index específico
    currentUserWidgets.splice(index, 1);
    
    // Cria o form para salvar
    const form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/dashboard/save-layout';
    
    const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    currentUserWidgets.forEach(w => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'hidden';
        input.name = 'widgets[]';
        input.value = JSON.stringify(w);
        form.appendChild(input);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
}
</script>

        <?php
            // Motor Dinâmico de Skins (Estilo VS Code)

                $skinData = json_decode(file_get_contents($skinFile), true);
                if (isset($skinData['variables'])) {
                    $vars = array_merge($vars, $skinData['variables']);
                }
            }
            
            echo ":root {\n";
            foreach ($vars as $key => $val) {
                echo "            {$key}: {$val};\n";
            }
            echo "        }\n";
